name: SurfaceBlowup.main_dvr
statement:
theorem main_dvr (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O))
    (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    SurfaceBlowup.monicDensity O n σ =
        densityValue (monicExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) ∧
    SurfaceBlowup.projectiveDensity O n σ =
        densityValue (projectiveExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
proof:
:= by
  rw [orig_monicDensity_eq O htop, orig_projectiveDensity_eq O htop]
  exact ⟨monicDensityF_eq_densityValue O htop n σ, projectiveDensityF_eq_densityValue O htop n σ⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.main_field_form
statement:
theorem main_field_form (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    ∃ A R : RatFunc ℚ, A = (monicExpr n σ).rational ∧ R = (projectiveExpr n σ).rational ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, PrimePower q → RegularAt A q ∧ RegularAt R q) ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, PrimePower q → RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q A = (monicExpr n σ).eval q ∧
        RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q R = (projectiveExpr n σ).eval q) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ_[p] K] [Algebra ℤ_[p] K]
        [IsScalarTower ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] K]
        [TopologicalSpace (padicIntegers p K)] [IsTopologicalRing (padicIntegers p K)]
        [CompactSpace (padicIntegers p K)] [T2Space (padicIntegers p K)]
        [SecondCountableTopology (padicIntegers p K)] [MeasurableSpace (padicIntegers p K)]
        [BorelSpace (padicIntegers p K)],
        PadicUnramified p K → IsAdic (Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)}) →
          monicDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = densityValue (monicExpr n σ)
            (Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)})) ∧
          projectiveDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = densityValue (projectiveExpr n σ)
            (Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)})) ∧
          monicDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = ENNReal.ofReal ((RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ)
            ((Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)}) : ℕ) : ℚ) A :
              ℚ) : ℝ) ∧
          projectiveDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = ENNReal.ofReal ((RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ)
            ((Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)}) : ℕ) : ℚ) R :
              ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl, global_formula_regular n σ, global_rational_eval n σ, ?_⟩
  intro p _ K _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hun had
  have hdvr := padicIntegers_isDVR p K
  have := padicIntegers_maximal_adic_complete p K hdvr
  have := padicIntegers_residueField_finite p K hdvr
  have hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (padicIntegers p K) = Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)} :=
    hun.maximalIdeal_eq
  have hcard : Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (padicIntegers p K)) =
      Nat.card (padicIntegers p K ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : padicIntegers p K)}) :=
    Nat.card_congr (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hmax).toEquiv
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := main_dvr (padicIntegers p K) (hmax ▸ had) n σ
  rw [hcard] at h1 h2
  obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := global_rational_eval n σ _ (hcard ▸ finite_field_card_primePower _)
  exact ⟨h1, h2, by rw [h1, e1], by rw [h2, e2]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.main_field_form_ramified
statement:
theorem main_field_form_ramified (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type)
    [Field K] [Algebra ℚ_[p] K] [Algebra ℤ_[p] K] [IsScalarTower ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] K]
    [TopologicalSpace (padicIntegers p K)] [IsTopologicalRing (padicIntegers p K)]
    [CompactSpace (padicIntegers p K)] [T2Space (padicIntegers p K)]
    [SecondCountableTopology (padicIntegers p K)] [MeasurableSpace (padicIntegers p K)]
    [BorelSpace (padicIntegers p K)]
    (had : letI := padicIntegers_isDVR p K; IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (padicIntegers p K))) :
    letI
proof:
:= padicIntegers_isDVR p K
    monicDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = ENNReal.ofReal ((RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ)
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (padicIntegers p K)) : ℚ) (monicExpr n σ).rational :
          ℚ) : ℝ) ∧
      projectiveDensity (padicIntegers p K) n σ = ENNReal.ofReal ((RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ)
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (padicIntegers p K)) : ℚ)
          (projectiveExpr n σ).rational : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  let hdvr := padicIntegers_isDVR p K
  have := padicIntegers_maximal_adic_complete p K hdvr
  have := padicIntegers_residueField_finite p K hdvr
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := main_dvr (padicIntegers p K) had n σ
  obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := global_rational_eval n σ _
    (finite_field_card_primePower (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (padicIntegers p K)))
  exact ⟨by rw [h1, e1], by rw [h2, e2]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.hasPolynomialType_one_iff
statement:
private theorem hasPolynomialType_one_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (σ : FactorType) :
    HasPolynomialType O 1 σ ↔ σ = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨gs, hirr, -, hprod, rfl⟩
    cases gs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons g gs =>
      exfalso
      have hg : g ∣ (g :: gs).prod := List.dvd_prod List.mem_cons_self
      rw [← hprod] at hg
      exact (hirr g List.mem_cons_self).2.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_one hg)
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨[], by simp, List.Pairwise.nil, by simp, rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.clusterCell_eq_image
statement:
private theorem clusterCell_eq_image (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) :
    clusterCell O n = (fun z : Fin n → O => pi • z) '' Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hI := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer pi).1 hpi
  ext a
  simp only [clusterCell, hI, Ideal.mem_span_singleton', Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.image_univ,
    Set.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro h
    choose z hz using h
    exact ⟨z, funext fun j => by simp [mul_comm, ← hz j]⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩ j
    exact ⟨z j, by simp [mul_comm]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.clusterCell_inter_eq_image
statement:
private theorem clusterCell_inter_eq_image (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterCell O n ∩ {a | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O a) σ} =
      (fun z : Fin n → O => pi • z) ''
        {z | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ}
proof:
:= by
  rw [clusterCell_eq_image O pi hpi n]
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨z, -, rfl⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨z, h, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, h, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨z, trivial, rfl⟩, h⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.main_dvr_cluster
statement:
theorem main_dvr_cluster (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterDensity O n σ =
      densityValue (clusterExpr n σ) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
proof:
:= by
  have hprob := coefficient_measure_probability O htop n
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · have hC : clusterCell O 0 = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun _ i => i.elim0
    have hE : {a : Fin 0 → O | HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ} =
        if σ = 0 then Set.univ else ∅ := by
      ext a
      have h1 : monicPolynomial O a = 1 := by simp [monicPolynomial]
      rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, h1, hasPolynomialType_one_iff]
      split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
    rw [clusterDensity, hC, hE, clusterExpr, rootLaw, if_pos rfl]
    by_cases hσ : σ = 0
    · subst hσ
      simp [lawCoeff, lawOne, Expr.sum, densityValue, Expr.eval]
    · rw [if_neg hσ]
      simp [lawCoeff, lawOne, Expr.sum, densityValue, Expr.eval, Ne.symm hσ]
  · obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
    obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := root_cell_law O htop pi hpi n hn σ
    obtain ⟨-, hU2⟩ := scaling_image_borel_mass O htop pi hpi n Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
    obtain ⟨-, hT2⟩ := scaling_image_borel_mass O htop pi hpi n _ hR1
    have hae : (clusterCell O n ∩ {a | HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ} :
        Set (Fin n → O)) =ᵐ[coefficientMeasure O n]
        (clusterCell O n ∩ {a | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O a) σ} :
          Set (Fin n → O)) :=
      (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.1 (monic_inseparable_null O htop n)).mono fun _ ha =>
        propext <| and_congr_right fun _ =>
          (hasPolynomialTypeF_iff_of_separable O (not_not.1 ha)).symm
    have hc0 : (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n ≠ 0 :=
      pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.2 (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _))
    have hct : (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n ≠ ⊤ :=
      ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 (by exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos.ne'))
    rw [clusterDensity, measure_congr hae, clusterCell_inter_eq_image O pi hpi n σ, hT2,
      clusterCell_eq_image O pi hpi n, hU2, measure_univ, ENNReal.mul_div_mul_left _ _ hc0 hct,
      div_one, hR2, clusterExpr, rootLaw, if_neg hn.ne']

name: SurfaceBlowup.clusterDensity_eq_etale
statement:
theorem clusterDensity_eq_etale (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterDensity O n σ =
      coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n ∩
        {a | (monicPolynomial O a).Separable ∧ HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}) /
        coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (· / _) <| measure_congr <|
    (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.1 (monic_inseparable_null O htop n)).mono fun _ ha =>
      propext <| and_congr_right fun _ => (and_iff_right (not_not.1 ha)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.cluster_formula_regular
statement:
theorem cluster_formula_regular (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    ∀ q : ℕ, PrimePower q → RegularAt (clusterExpr n σ).rational q
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hL : LawSafe (rootLaw n) := by
    unfold rootLaw
    split_ifs with h
    · intro z hz q _
      simp only [lawOne, List.mem_singleton] at hz
      subst hz
      trivial
    · exact local_law_safe _ ⟨Nat.one_pos, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h⟩
  refine expression_regular _ _ (expression_sum_safe _ _ fun x hx => ?_)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  by_cases h : z.1 = σ
  · simp only [h, if_true]; exact hL z hz q (prime_power_ge_two q hq)
  · simp [h, Expr.safe]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipRat_recipPoly

name: SurfaceBlowup.rat_smul_eq_scalar_mul
statement: theorem rat_smul_eq_scalar_mul (q : ℚ) (x : Coef) : q • x = scalar (RatFunc.C q) * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [scalar_eq_algebraMap, Algebra.smul_def,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℚ (RatFunc ℚ) Coef, eq_ratCast (algebraMap ℚ _) q,
    eq_ratCast RatFunc.C q]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipCoef_qpow
statement: private theorem recipCoef_qpow (j : ℤ) : recipCoef (qpow j) = qpow (-j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qpow, recipCoef_scalar, recipRat_zpow_X, qpow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsCoef_qpow
statement:
private theorem adamsCoef_qpow (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (j : ℤ) :
    adamsCoef δ (qpow j) = qpow ((δ : ℤ) * j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qpow, adamsCoef_scalar, adamsRat_zpow_X δ hδ, qpow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qpow_natCast
statement: theorem qpow_natCast (n : ℕ) : qpow (n : ℤ) = scalar ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qpow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qpow_one
statement: theorem qpow_one : qpow 1 = scalar (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
proof: := by simp [qpow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qpow_neg_mul_qpow
statement: theorem qpow_neg_mul_qpow (j : ℤ) : qpow (-j) * qpow j = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← qpow_add, neg_add_cancel, qpow_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.QPositive.qmul
statement:
theorem QPositive.qmul {U V : QSer} (hU : QPositive U) (hV : QPositive V) :
    QPositive (qmul U V)
proof:
:= by
  intro c h hc hn
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp hr
  have : U p.1 r.1 * V p.2 r.2 = 0 := by
    rcases hc with rfl | rfl
    · by_cases h1 : r.1 = 0
      · have : r.2 ≠ 0 := by omega
        have : p.1 = 0 := by omega
        have : p.2 = 0 := by omega
        rw [hV p.2 r.2 (Or.inl ‹_›) (by omega), mul_zero]
      · rw [hU p.1 r.1 (Or.inl (by omega)) (by omega), zero_mul]
    · by_cases h1 : p.1 = 0
      · have : p.2 ≠ 0 := by omega
        rw [hV p.2 r.2 (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega), mul_zero]
      · rw [hU p.1 r.1 (Or.inr (by omega)) (by omega), zero_mul]
  rw [this, mul_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.QPositive.qdagger
statement: theorem QPositive.qdagger {U : QSer} (hU : QPositive U) : QPositive (qdagger U)
proof:
:=
  fun c h hc hn ↦ by simp [SurfaceBlowup.qdagger, hU c h hc hn]

name: SurfaceBlowup.QPositive.qplus
statement: theorem QPositive.qplus {U : QSer} (hU : QPositive U) : QPositive (qplus U)
proof:
:= by
  intro c k hc hn
  unfold SurfaceBlowup.qplus
  split_ifs with h1
  · rw [hU c (k - c) (by omega) (by omega), mul_zero]
  · rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.QPositive.qminus
statement: theorem QPositive.qminus {U : QSer} (hU : QPositive U) : QPositive (qminus U)
proof:
:= by
  intro k h hc hn
  unfold SurfaceBlowup.qminus
  split_ifs with h1
  · rw [hU (k - h) h (by omega) (by omega), mul_zero]
  · rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.qPositive_qdiag
statement: theorem qPositive_qdiag (f : Ser) : QPositive (qdiag f)
proof:
:= fun c h hc hn ↦ by
  unfold qdiag
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qmul_zero_zero
statement: theorem qmul_zero_zero (U V : QSer) : (qmul U V) 0 0 = U 0 0 * V 0 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [qmul, qpow_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsSer_subst
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : PowerSeries.HasSubst (PowerSeries.map (adamsCoef k) f) :=
    PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (by
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, PowerSeries.coeff_map,
        PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hf, map_zero])
  have hm : PowerSeries.map (adamsCoef k) (φ.subst f) =
      φ.subst (PowerSeries.map (adamsCoef k) f) := by
    have := PowerSeries.map_subst (h := adamsCoef k)
      (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hf) φ
    rwa [hφ] at this
  rw [adamsSer, adamsSer, dif_neg hk, dif_neg hk, hm]
  exact PowerSeries.expand_subst k hk hs' φ

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsSer_logSer
statement:
theorem adamsSer_logSer (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    adamsSer k (logSer g) = logSer (adamsSer k g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [logSer, logSer, PowerSeries.logOf_eq, PowerSeries.logOf_eq,
    adamsSer_subst k hk _ (PowerSeries.map_log _) _ (by simp [hg]), adamsSer_sub k hk,
    adamsSer_one k hk]

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_divisors_sum_divisors_div
statement:
theorem sum_divisors_sum_divisors_div {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ)
    (F : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    ∑ k ∈ n.divisors, ∑ j ∈ (n / k).divisors, F k j
      = ∑ m ∈ n.divisors, ∑ k ∈ m.divisors, F k (m / k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun x _ ↦ ⟨x.1 * x.2, x.1⟩) (fun y _ ↦ ⟨y.2, y.1 / y.2⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨k, j⟩ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Nat.mem_divisors] at h ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨hk, hn⟩, hj, hnk⟩ := h
    refine ⟨⟨?_, hn⟩, Dvd.intro _ rfl, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hj
      exact ⟨a, by rw [mul_assoc, ← ha, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hk]⟩
    · have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hn (zero_dvd_iff.1 hk)
      have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hnk (zero_dvd_iff.1 hj)
      exact mul_ne_zero hk0 hj0
  · rintro ⟨m, k⟩ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Nat.mem_divisors] at h ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨hm, hn⟩, hk, hm0⟩ := h
    refine ⟨⟨dvd_trans hk hm, hn⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hm
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hk
      have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact hm0 (by simpa using hb))
      refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
      rw [ha, hb, mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hk0, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hk0]
    · have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hk (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0)
      have := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) (dvd_trans hk hm)) hk0
      omega
  · rintro ⟨k, j⟩ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Nat.mem_divisors] at h
    have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp at h)
    simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hk0]
  · rintro ⟨m, k⟩ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Nat.mem_divisors] at h
    simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel' h.2.1]
  · rintro ⟨k, j⟩ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Nat.mem_divisors] at h
    have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp at h)
    simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hk0]

name: SurfaceBlowup.plethSum_eq
statement: private theorem plethSum_eq (f : Ser) : plethSum f = divisorTransform (fun k ↦ (k : ℚ)⁻¹) f
proof: := rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.moebiusSum_eq
statement:
private theorem moebiusSum_eq (f : Ser) :
    moebiusSum f = divisorTransform (fun k ↦ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius k : ℤ) : ℚ) / k) f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_divisorTransform_comp
statement:
private theorem coeff_divisorTransform_comp (a b : ℕ → ℚ) (f : Ser) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (divisorTransform a (divisorTransform b f)) =
      ∑ m ∈ n.divisors, (∑ k ∈ m.divisors, a k * b (m / k)) •
        adamsCoef m (PowerSeries.coeff (n / m) f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [divisorTransform, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_sum, map_rat_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  have h1 : ∀ k ∈ n.divisors, ∀ j ∈ (n / k).divisors,
      a k • b j • adamsCoef k (adamsCoef j (PowerSeries.coeff (n / k / j) f))
        = (fun k j ↦ (a k * b j) • adamsCoef (k * j) (PowerSeries.coeff (n / (k * j)) f)) k j := by
    intro k hk j hj
    have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk
    have hj0 : 0 < j := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hj
    simp only [smul_smul, adamsCoef_adamsCoef k j hk0 hj0, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl (h1 k hk),
    sum_divisors_sum_divisors_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ ?_
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hk)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_divisors_moebius
statement:
theorem sum_divisors_moebius (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ m.divisors, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius k : ℤ) : ℚ) = if m = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun F ↦ F m) (ArithmeticFunction.moebius_mul_coe_zeta)
  simp only [ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply, ArithmeticFunction.one_apply] at this
  rw [← Int.cast_sum, this]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisorTransform_inv
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_divisorTransform_comp]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp [hf]
  · simp only [hab, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    simp [Nat.ne_of_gt hn, adamsCoef_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.moebius_weight_left
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · simp
  have : ∀ k ∈ m.divisors,
      (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius k : ℤ) : ℚ) / (k : ℚ)) * ((m / k : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹
      = ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius k : ℤ) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : (k : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk).ne'
    rw [Nat.cast_div (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hk) hk0]
    have : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
    field_simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_divisors_moebius]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.moebius_weight_right
statement:
private theorem moebius_weight_right (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ m.divisors,
      ((k : ℚ))⁻¹ * (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (m / k) : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((m / k : ℕ) : ℚ))
      = if m = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · simp
  have : ∀ k ∈ m.divisors,
      ((k : ℚ))⁻¹ * (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (m / k) : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((m / k : ℕ) : ℚ))
      = ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (m / k) : ℤ) : ℚ) * (m : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : (k : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk).ne'
    rw [Nat.cast_div (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hk) hk0]
    have : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
    field_simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, ← Finset.sum_mul,
    Nat.sum_div_divisors m (fun k ↦ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius k : ℤ) : ℚ)),
    sum_divisors_moebius]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.moebiusSum_plethSum
statement:
theorem moebiusSum_plethSum (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    moebiusSum (plethSum f) = f
proof:
:=
  divisorTransform_inv _ _ f hf moebius_weight_left

name: SurfaceBlowup.plethSum_moebiusSum
statement:
theorem plethSum_moebiusSum (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    plethSum (moebiusSum f) = f
proof:
:=
  divisorTransform_inv _ _ f hf moebius_weight_right

name: SurfaceBlowup.plethSum_add
statement: theorem plethSum_add (f g : Ser) : plethSum (f + g) = plethSum f + plethSum g
proof:
:= by
  ext n; simp [plethSum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_plethSum
statement: theorem constantCoeff_plethSum (f : Ser) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (plethSum f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]; simp [plethSum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_moebiusSum
statement: theorem constantCoeff_moebiusSum (f : Ser) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (moebiusSum f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]; simp [moebiusSum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.fraction_pow_var
statement:
private theorem fraction_pow_var (i : ℕ) :
    (Expr.pow Expr.var i).fraction = ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) ^ i, 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp [Expr.pow, Expr.fraction]
  | succ k ih => simp [Expr.pow, Expr.fraction, ih, pow_succ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.fraction_sum_pow_var
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [Expr.sum, Expr.fraction]
  | cons a L ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, Expr.sum, List.foldr_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [Expr.fraction, ih, fraction_pow_var]
    simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_projectiveNormalizer
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectiveNormalizer Expr.rational
  rw [fraction_sum_pow_var]
  simp only [map_one, div_one]
  have e (m : ℕ) (f : ℕ → Polynomial ℚ) :
      ((List.range m).map f).sum = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, f i := by
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]; simp
  rw [e, map_sum]
  simp [map_pow, RatFunc.algebraMap_X]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipRat_projectiveNormalizer
statement:
theorem recipRat_projectiveNormalizer (n : ℕ) :
    recipRat (projectiveNormalizer n).rational =
      (RatFunc.X ^ n)⁻¹ * (projectiveNormalizer n).rational
proof:
:= by
  rw [rational_projectiveNormalizer, map_sum]
  simp only [map_pow, recipRat_X, inv_pow]
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  rw [show i + k + 1 - 1 - i = k by omega, pow_add]
  have : (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  field_simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.projectiveNormalizer_rational_ne_zero
statement: theorem projectiveNormalizer_rational_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : (projectiveNormalizer n).rational ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ i = algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ)
      (RatFunc ℚ) (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) ^ i) := by
    simp [map_sum, RatFunc.algebraMap_X]
  rw [rational_projectiveNormalizer, this]
  refine RatFunc.algebraMap_ne_zero fun h ↦ ?_
  have := congrArg (fun p ↦ Polynomial.coeff p 0) h
  simp [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_qact
statement:
theorem recipSer_qact (U : QSer) (f : Ser) :
    recipSer (qact U f) = qactRecip (qrecip U) (recipSer f)
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  simp only [recipSer, qact, qactRecip, qrecip, PowerSeries.coeff_map, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
    map_sum, map_mul, recipCoef_qpow]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  congr 2; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.qdagger_qmul
statement: theorem qdagger_qmul (U V : QSer) : qdagger (qmul U V) = qmul (qdagger V) (qdagger U)
proof:
:= by
  funext c h
  simp only [qdagger, qmul, map_sum, map_mul, recipCoef_qpow, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp hr
  subst hp hr
  simp only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap, neg_neg]
  have e : qpow ((((p.1 + p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((r.1 + r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        ((p.1 + p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((r.1 + r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ))) * qpow ((p.2 : ℤ) * (r.1 : ℤ)) =
      qpow (-((p.1 : ℤ) * (r.2 : ℤ))) * (qpow ((p.1 : ℤ) + (r.1 : ℤ) - (p.1 : ℤ) * (r.1 : ℤ)) *
        qpow ((p.2 : ℤ) + (r.2 : ℤ) - (p.2 : ℤ) * (r.2 : ℤ))) := by
    rw [← qpow_add, ← qpow_add, ← qpow_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  linear_combination (recipCoef (U p.2 r.2) * recipCoef (V p.1 r.1)) * e

name: SurfaceBlowup.qdagger_twist
statement:
private theorem qdagger_twist (c k : ℕ) (x : Coef) (hck : c ≤ k) :
    qpow ((c : ℤ) + k - c * k) * (recipCoef (qpow (-(chooseTwo c : ℤ)) * x)) =
      qpow (-(chooseTwo c : ℤ)) *
        (qpow (((c : ℤ) + ((k - c : ℕ) : ℤ)) - c * ((k - c : ℕ) : ℤ)) * recipCoef x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, recipCoef_qpow, neg_neg, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← qpow_add, ← qpow_add]
  have := two_mul_chooseTwo c
  congr 2
  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hck]
  linarith

name: SurfaceBlowup.qdagger_qplus
statement: theorem qdagger_qplus (U : QSer) : qdagger (qplus U) = qplus (qdagger U)
proof:
:= by
  funext c k
  simp only [qdagger, qplus]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact qdagger_twist c k _ h
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.qdagger_qminus
statement: theorem qdagger_qminus (U : QSer) : qdagger (qminus U) = qminus (qdagger U)
proof:
:= by
  funext k h
  simp only [qdagger, qminus]
  split_ifs with hh
  · rw [show ((k : ℤ) + h - k * h) = ((h : ℤ) + k - h * k) by ring,
      show (((k - h : ℕ) : ℤ) + h - ((k - h : ℕ) : ℤ) * h) =
        ((h : ℤ) + ((k - h : ℕ) : ℤ)) - h * ((k - h : ℕ) : ℤ) by ring]
    exact qdagger_twist h k (U (k - h) h) hh
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_antidiagonal_assoc
statement:
private theorem sum_antidiagonal_assoc (n : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Coef) :
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, ∑ q ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal p.1,
      F q.1 q.2 p.2 =
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, ∑ q ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal p.2,
      F p.1 q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun x _ ↦ ⟨(x.2.1, x.2.2 + x.1.2), (x.2.2, x.1.2)⟩)
    (fun x _ ↦ ⟨(x.1.1 + x.2.1, x.2.2), (x.1.1, x.2.1)⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  all_goals rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨c, d⟩⟩ hx
  all_goals simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hx ⊢
  all_goals first
    | rfl
    | (constructor <;> first | trivial | omega)
    | (obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx; subst h2; simp)

name: SurfaceBlowup.qmul_assoc
statement:
theorem qmul_assoc (U V W : QSer) :
    qmul (qmul U V) W = qmul U (qmul V W)
proof:
:= by
  funext c h
  let K : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Coef := fun a b e x y z ↦
    qpow (-((a : ℤ) * (y : ℤ)) - (a : ℤ) * (z : ℤ) - (b : ℤ) * (z : ℤ)) *
      (U a x * (V b y * W e z))
  have hL : qmul (qmul U V) W c h = ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal c,
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal p.1,
      (fun a b e ↦ ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal h,
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal r.1, K a b e s.1 s.2 r.2) q.1 q.2 p.2 := by
    simp only [qmul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp ↦ ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq' ↦ ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r hr ↦ ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq'
    simp only [K]
    rw [show -((q.1 : ℤ) * (s.2 : ℤ)) - (q.1 : ℤ) * (r.2 : ℤ) - (q.2 : ℤ) * (r.2 : ℤ)
        = -((p.1 : ℤ) * (r.2 : ℤ)) + -((q.1 : ℤ) * (s.2 : ℤ)) by rw [← hq']; push_cast; ring,
      qpow_add]
    ring
  have hR : qmul U (qmul V W) c h = ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal c,
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal p.2,
      (fun a b e ↦ ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal h,
        ∑ s ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal r.2, K a b e r.1 s.1 s.2) p.1 q.1 q.2 := by
    simp only [qmul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp ↦ ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q hq' ↦ ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r hr ↦ ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hs
    simp only [K, ← hs]
    rw [mul_left_comm (U _ _), ← mul_assoc, ← qpow_add, Nat.cast_add]
    congr 2; ring
  rw [hL, hR]
  refine (sum_antidiagonal_assoc c (fun a b e ↦ ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal h,
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal r.1, K a b e s.1 s.2 r.2)).trans ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ ↦ ?_))
  exact sum_antidiagonal_assoc h (fun x y z ↦ K p.1 q.1 q.2 x y z)

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_recipSer
statement:
theorem coeff_recipSer (f : Ser) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (recipSer f) = recipCoef (PowerSeries.coeff n f)
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.coeff_map _ _ _

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_mul
statement: theorem recipSer_mul (f g : Ser) : recipSer (f * g) = recipSer f * recipSer g
proof: := map_mul _ f g

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_sub
statement:
private theorem recipSer_sub (f g : Ser) : recipSer
    (f - g) = recipSer f - recipSer g
proof: := map_sub _ f g

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_one
statement: private theorem recipSer_one : recipSer (1 : Ser) = 1
proof: := map_one _

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_C_mul
statement:
private theorem recipSer_C_mul (a : Coef) (f : Ser) :
    recipSer (PowerSeries.C a * f) = PowerSeries.C (recipCoef a) * recipSer f
proof:
:= by
  rw [recipSer, map_mul, PowerSeries.map_C]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_recipSer
statement: theorem recipSer_recipSer (f : Ser) : recipSer (recipSer f) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext m; simp [coeff_recipSer, recipCoef_recipCoef]

name: SurfaceBlowup.scalar_X_pow
statement: private theorem scalar_X_pow (m : ℕ) : (scalar (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)) ^ m = qpow (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [scalar, qpow, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, zpow_natCast]

name: SurfaceBlowup.scalar_X_inv_pow
statement:
private theorem scalar_X_inv_pow (m : ℕ) :
    (scalar (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)⁻¹) ^ m = qpow (-(m : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  simp [scalar, qpow, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.scalar_X_mul_scalar_X_inv
statement:
private theorem scalar_X_mul_scalar_X_inv :
    scalar (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) * scalar (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← scalar_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero, scalar_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rescale_C
statement:
private theorem rescale_C (a b : Coef) :
    PowerSeries.rescale b (PowerSeries.C a) = PowerSeries.C a
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_dilate
statement:
theorem coeff_dilate (f : Ser) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (dilate f) = qpow (n : ℤ) * PowerSeries.coeff n f
proof:
:= by
  simp [dilate, PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, scalar_X_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_codilate
statement:
theorem coeff_codilate (f : Ser) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (codilate f) = qpow (-(n : ℤ)) * PowerSeries.coeff n f
proof:
:= by
  simp [codilate, PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, scalar_X_inv_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_mul
statement: theorem dilate_mul (f g : Ser) : dilate (f * g) = dilate f * dilate g
proof: := map_mul _ _ _

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_C_mul
statement:
private theorem dilate_C_mul (a : Coef) (f : Ser) :
    dilate (PowerSeries.C a * f) = PowerSeries.C a * dilate f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dilate, map_mul, rescale_C]

name: SurfaceBlowup.codilate_dilate
statement: theorem codilate_dilate (f : Ser) : codilate (dilate f) = f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dilate, codilate, PowerSeries.rescale_rescale, scalar_X_mul_scalar_X_inv,
    PowerSeries.rescale_one, RingHom.id_apply]

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_codilate
statement: theorem dilate_codilate (f : Ser) : dilate (codilate f) = f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dilate, codilate, PowerSeries.rescale_rescale, mul_comm (scalar RatFunc.X⁻¹),
    scalar_X_mul_scalar_X_inv, PowerSeries.rescale_one, RingHom.id_apply]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_dilate
statement: theorem recipSer_dilate (f : Ser) : recipSer (dilate f) = codilate (recipSer f)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [coeff_recipSer, coeff_dilate, coeff_codilate, coeff_recipSer, map_mul, recipCoef_qpow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.dilate
statement:
theorem SCongr.dilate {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) :
    SCongr n (SurfaceBlowup.dilate f) (SurfaceBlowup.dilate g)
proof:
:= fun m hm ↦ by
  rw [coeff_dilate, coeff_dilate, h m hm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rescale_subst
statement:
private theorem rescale_subst (r : Coef) (h f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    PowerSeries.rescale r (h.subst f) = h.subst (PowerSeries.rescale r f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.rescale_eq_subst, PowerSeries.rescale_eq_subst,
    PowerSeries.subst_comp_subst_apply (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hf)
      (PowerSeries.HasSubst.smul_X' r)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_codilate
statement:
private theorem constantCoeff_codilate (f : Ser) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (codilate f) = PowerSeries.constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
    ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_codilate]
  simp [qpow_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_expSer
statement:
private theorem dilate_expSer (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    dilate (expSer f) = expSer (dilate f)
proof:
:=
  rescale_subst _ _ _ hf

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_logSer
statement:
private theorem dilate_logSer (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    dilate (logSer g) = logSer (dilate g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [logSer, logSer, PowerSeries.logOf_eq, PowerSeries.logOf_eq, dilate,
    rescale_subst _ _ _ (by simp [hg]), map_sub, map_one]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_divisorTransform
statement:
private theorem dilate_divisorTransform (w : ℕ → ℚ) (f : Ser) :
    dilate (divisorTransform w f) = divisorTransform w (dilate f)
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  simp only [coeff_dilate, divisorTransform, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ ?_
  rw [map_mul, adamsCoef_qpow k (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk), mul_smul_comm,
    ← Nat.cast_mul, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hk)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_pLog
statement:
private theorem dilate_pLog (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    dilate (pLog g) = pLog (dilate g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pLog, pLog, ← dilate_logSer g hg]
  exact dilate_divisorTransform _ _

name: SurfaceBlowup.dilate_pPow
statement:
theorem dilate_pPow (w : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    dilate (pPow w g) = pPow w (dilate g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pPow, pPow, pExp, pExp, dilate_expSer _ (constantCoeff_plethSum _), plethSum_eq,
    plethSum_eq, dilate_divisorTransform, dilate_C_mul, dilate_pLog g hg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.codilate_pPow
statement:
theorem codilate_pPow (w : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    codilate (pPow w g) = pPow w (codilate g)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← dilate_codilate g]
  rw [← dilate_pPow w _ (by rw [constantCoeff_codilate, hg]), codilate_dilate]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_gaussPhi
statement: theorem recipSer_gaussPhi (f : Ser) : recipSer (gaussPhi f) = gaussPhiInv (recipSer f)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [gaussPhi, gaussPhiInv, coeff_recipSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_mul,
    recipCoef_qpow, neg_neg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.gaussPhi_dilate
statement: theorem gaussPhi_dilate (f : Ser) : gaussPhi (dilate f) = dilate (gaussPhi f)
proof:
:= by
  ext n : 1
  simp only [gaussPhi, coeff_dilate, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, mul_left_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.gaussPhi_sub
statement: theorem gaussPhi_sub (f g : Ser) : gaussPhi (f - g) = gaussPhi f - gaussPhi g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [gaussPhi, map_sub, mul_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: SurfaceBlowup.gaussPhi_qactRecip_gaussPhiInv
statement:
theorem gaussPhi_qactRecip_gaussPhiInv (V : QSer) (hV : ∀ c h : ℕ, V c h = V h c) (f : Ser) :
    gaussPhi (qactRecip (qrecip V) (gaussPhiInv f)) = codilate (qact (qdagger V) (dilate f))
proof:
:= by
  have hL (a b c : ℤ) (x y : Coef) :
      qpow a * (qpow b * (x * (qpow c * y))) = qpow (a + b + c) * (x * y) := by
    rw [qpow_add, qpow_add]; ring
  have hR (a b c d : ℤ) (x y : Coef) :
      qpow a * (qpow b * (qpow c * x * (qpow d * y))) = qpow (a + b + c + d) * (x * y) := by
    rw [qpow_add, qpow_add, qpow_add]; ring
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_codilate]
  simp only [gaussPhi, gaussPhiInv, qactRecip, qact, qrecip, qdagger, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
    coeff_dilate]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
  simp only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap]
  rw [hV r.2 r.1, hL, hR]
  congr 2
  have e1 := two_mul_tri (r.1 + r.2 + p.2)
  have e2 := two_mul_tri r.1
  have e3 := two_mul_tri r.2
  have e4 := two_mul_tri p.2
  have hn : n = r.1 + r.2 + p.2 := by omega
  subst hn
  push_cast at e1 ⊢
  linarith

name: SurfaceBlowup.qdiag_mul
statement: theorem qdiag_mul (f g : Ser) : qdiag (f * g) = qmul (qdiag f) (qdiag g)
proof:
:= by
  funext c h
  simp only [qmul, qdiag]
  by_cases hch : c = h
  · subst hch
    rw [if_pos rfl, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
    · rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      simp only [if_true]
      rw [← hp, show (-(((chooseTwo (p.1 + p.2) : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
        -((p.1 : ℤ) * p.2) + (-(chooseTwo p.1 : ℤ) + -(chooseTwo p.2 : ℤ)) by
          rw [chooseTwo_add]; ring,
        qpow_add, qpow_add]
      ring
    · intro r _ hr
      by_cases h1 : p.1 = r.1
      · have h2 : p.2 ≠ r.2 := fun h2 ↦ hr (Prod.ext h1.symm h2.symm)
        simp [h2]
      · simp [h1]
    · intro hp'; exact absurd hp hp'
  · rw [if_neg hch]
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r hr ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp hr
    by_cases h1 : p.1 = r.1
    · have h2 : p.2 ≠ r.2 := by omega
      simp [h2]
    · simp [h1]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qdiag_one
statement: private theorem qdiag_one : qdiag 1 = qone
proof:
:= by
  funext c h
  simp only [qdiag, qone, PowerSeries.coeff_one]
  by_cases hch : c = h
  · subst hch
    rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc
    · simp [chooseTwo, qpow_zero]
    · simp [hc]
  · simp only [if_neg hch]
    split_ifs with h' <;> first | rfl | omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.qdagger_qdiag
statement: private theorem qdagger_qdiag (f : Ser) : qdagger (qdiag f) = qdiag (dilate (recipSer f))
proof:
:= by
  funext c h
  simp only [qdagger, qdiag]
  by_cases hch : c = h
  · subst hch
    simp only [if_true, map_mul, recipCoef_qpow, coeff_dilate, coeff_recipSer]
    have e := two_mul_chooseTwo c
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← qpow_add, ← qpow_add]
    congr 2
    linarith
  · simp [hch]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qcongr_qdiag_mul_qdagger
statement:
theorem qcongr_qdiag_mul_qdagger (M s : ℕ)
    (h : SCongr M (dilate (recipSer (eulerSer (-1) s)) * eulerSer (-1) s) 1) :
    QCongr (2 * M + 1) (qmul (qdiag (eulerSer (-1) s)) (qdagger (qdiag (eulerSer (-1) s))))
      qone
proof:
:= by
  rw [qdagger_qdiag, ← qdiag_mul, mul_comm (eulerSer (-1) s), ← qdiag_one]
  exact h.qdiag

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipSer_pPow
statement:
theorem recipSer_pPow (w : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    recipSer (pPow w g) = pPow (recipRat w) (recipSer g)
proof:
:= by
  have hexp (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
      recipSer (expSer f) = expSer (recipSer f) :=
    (PowerSeries.map_subst (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hf)
      (PowerSeries.exp Coef)).trans (by rw [PowerSeries.map_exp]; rfl)
  have hlog : recipSer (logSer g) = logSer (recipSer g) := by
    have h1 : recipSer (g - 1) = recipSer g - 1 := by rw [recipSer_sub, recipSer_one]
    unfold recipSer at h1 ⊢
    rw [logSer, logSer, PowerSeries.logOf_eq, PowerSeries.logOf_eq, ← h1]
    exact (PowerSeries.map_subst (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (by simp [hg]))
      (PowerSeries.log Coef)).trans (by rw [PowerSeries.map_log]; rfl)
  have hdt (u : ℕ → ℚ) (f : Ser) :
      recipSer (divisorTransform u f) = divisorTransform u (recipSer f) := by
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
    simp only [coeff_recipSer, divisorTransform, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_sum, map_rat_smul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by
      rw [recipCoef_adamsCoef k (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk)]
  rw [pPow, pPow, pExp, pExp, hexp _ (constantCoeff_plethSum _), plethSum_eq, plethSum_eq, hdt,
    recipSer_C_mul, recipCoef_scalar, pLog, pLog, moebiusSum_eq, moebiusSum_eq, hdt, hlog]

name: SurfaceBlowup.scalar_mul_left_cancel
statement:
theorem scalar_mul_left_cancel {w : RatFunc ℚ} (hw : w ≠ 0) {x y : Coef}
    (h : scalar w * x = scalar w * y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (scalar w⁻¹ * ·) h
  simp only [← mul_assoc, ← scalar_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw, scalar_one, one_mul] at this
  exact this

name: SurfaceBlowup.eq_zero_of_scalar_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_scalar_mul_eq_zero {w : RatFunc ℚ} (hw : w ≠ 0) {x : Coef}
    (h : scalar w * x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  scalar_mul_left_cancel hw (by rw [h, mul_zero])

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.refl
statement: @[refl] theorem SCongr.refl (n : ℕ) (f : Ser) : SCongr n f f
proof: := fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.of_eq
statement: theorem SCongr.of_eq {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : f = g) : SCongr n f g
proof: := h ▸ SCongr.refl n f

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.symm
statement: theorem SCongr.symm {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) : SCongr n g f
proof:
:=
  fun i hi ↦ (h i hi).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.trans
statement:
theorem SCongr.trans {n : ℕ} {f g u : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) (h' : SCongr n g u) :
    SCongr n f u
proof:
:=
  fun i hi ↦ (h i hi).trans (h' i hi)

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.mono
statement: theorem SCongr.mono {n m : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) (hmn : m ≤ n) : SCongr m f g
proof:
:=
  fun i hi ↦ h i (hi.trans hmn)

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.mul
statement:
theorem SCongr.mul {n : ℕ} {f g u v : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) (h' : SCongr n u v) :
    SCongr n (f * u) (g * v)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
  rw [h x.1 (by omega), h' x.2 (by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.C_mul
statement:
theorem SCongr.C_mul {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) (a : Coef) :
    SCongr n (PowerSeries.C a * f) (PowerSeries.C a * g)
proof:
:= fun i hi ↦ by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, h i hi]

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.pow
statement: theorem SCongr.pow {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) (p : ℕ) : SCongr n (f ^ p) (g ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => exact SCongr.refl n 1
  | succ p ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact ih.mul h

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.of_mul_right
statement:
theorem SCongr.of_mul_right {n : ℕ} {f g u : Ser} (hu : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u = 1)
    (h : SCongr n (f * u) (g * u)) : SCongr n f g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
    (PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by rw [hu]; exact isUnit_one)).exists_right_inv
  simpa [mul_assoc, hv] using h.mul (SCongr.refl n v)

name: SurfaceBlowup.scongr_subst
proof:
:= by
  have ht : PowerSeries.trunc (n+1) f = PowerSeries.trunc (n+1) g := by
    refine Polynomial.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_trunc, PowerSeries.coeff_trunc]
    split_ifs with hm
    · exact h m (by omega)
    · rfl
  intro m hm
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_subst' (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hf),
    PowerSeries.coeff_subst' (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hg)]
  congr 1
  funext d
  congr 1
  have h1 := PowerSeries.trunc_trunc_pow f (n+1) d
  have h2 := PowerSeries.trunc_trunc_pow g (n+1) d
  rw [ht] at h1
  have := congrArg (fun p ↦ Polynomial.coeff p m) (h1.symm.trans h2)
  simpa [PowerSeries.coeff_trunc, show m < n + 1 by omega] using this

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.expSer
statement:
theorem SCongr.expSer {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 0) (h : SCongr n f g) :
    SCongr n (SurfaceBlowup.expSer f) (SurfaceBlowup.expSer g)
proof:
:=
  scongr_subst n (PowerSeries.exp Coef) f g hf hg h

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.logSer
statement:
theorem SCongr.logSer {n : ℕ} {u v : Ser} (hu : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u = 1)
    (hv : PowerSeries.constantCoeff v = 1) (huv : SCongr n u v) :
    SCongr n (SurfaceBlowup.logSer u) (SurfaceBlowup.logSer v)
proof:
:=
  scongr_subst n (PowerSeries.log Coef) (u - 1) (v - 1) (by simp [hu]) (by simp [hv])
    fun m hm ↦ by simp [huv m hm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_castLE_extend
statement:
@[to_additive]
private theorem prod_castLE_extend {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (N N' : ℕ) (hNN' : N ≤ N')
    (f : Fin N' → M) (g : Fin N → M) (h1 : ∀ i : Fin N, f (Fin.castLE hNN' i) = g i)
    (h2 : ∀ i : Fin N', N ≤ i.val → f i = 1) : ∏ i, f i = ∏ i, g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.prod_subset (Finset.subset_univ (Finset.univ.map (Fin.castLEEmb hNN')))]
  · rw [Finset.prod_map]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ h1 i)
  · intro i _ hi
    apply h2
    by_contra hc
    exact hi (Finset.mem_map.2 ⟨⟨i.val, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext rfl⟩)

name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_row_castLE
statement:
@[to_additive]
private theorem prod_row_castLE {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : ℕ → ℕ → M)
    (hg : ∀ j, g j 0 = 1) (i : Fin N) :
    ∏ j : Fin N', g j (m' (Fin.castLE hNN' i, j)).val = ∏ j : Fin N, g j (m (i, j)).val
proof:
:=
  prod_castLE_extend N N' hNN' _ _ (fun j ↦ by simp [h]) fun j hj ↦ by simp [h, not_lt.2 hj, hg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_row_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
private theorem prod_row_eq_one {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : ℕ → ℕ → M)
    (hg : ∀ j, g j 0 = 1) (i : Fin N') (hi : N ≤ i.val) :
    ∏ j : Fin N', g j (m' (i, j)).val = 1
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ ↦ by simp [h, not_lt.2 hi, hg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_pattern_extend
statement:
@[to_additive]
private theorem prod_pattern_extend {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → M)
    (hg : ∀ i j, g i j 0 = 1) :
    ∏ ij : Fin N' × Fin N', g ij.1 ij.2 (m' ij).val =
      ∏ ij : Fin N × Fin N, g ij.1 ij.2 (m ij).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type, Fintype.prod_prod_type]
  exact prod_castLE_extend N N' hNN' _ _ (fun i ↦ prod_row_castLE hNN' h (g i) (hg i) i)
    fun i hi ↦ prod_row_eq_one h (g i) (hg i) i hi

name: SurfaceBlowup.patternWeight_extend
statement: private theorem patternWeight_extend : patternWeight m' = patternWeight m
proof:
:=
  sum_pattern_extend hNN' h (fun i j k ↦ (i + 1) * (j + 1) * k) fun _ _ ↦ mul_zero _

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_divisorCount_extend
statement:
private theorem rational_divisorCount_extend (ε : ℤ) :
    (divisorCount ε m').rational = (divisorCount ε m).rational
proof:
:= by
  rw [rational_divisorCount, rational_divisorCount]
  refine prod_castLE_extend N N' hNN' _ _ (fun i ↦ ?_) fun i hi ↦ ?_
  · rw [sum_row_castLE hNN' h (fun _ k ↦ k) (fun _ ↦ rfl),
      prod_row_castLE hNN' h (fun _ k ↦ ((k.factorial : ℕ) : ℚ)) (fun _ ↦ by simp)]
    simp
  · rw [sum_row_eq_zero h (fun _ k ↦ k) (fun _ ↦ rfl) i hi,
      prod_row_eq_one h (fun _ k ↦ ((k.factorial : ℕ) : ℚ)) (fun _ ↦ by simp) i hi]
    simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.patternSum_extend
statement:
private theorem patternSum_extend (ε : ℤ) (a N N' w : ℕ) (hNN' : N ≤ N') (hw : w ≤ N) :
    patternSum ε a N w = patternSum ε a N' w
proof:
:= by
  let ext : Pattern N → Pattern N' := fun m ij ↦
    if hij : ij.1.val < N ∧ ij.2.val < N then
      Fin.castLE (by omega) (m (⟨ij.1.val, hij.1⟩, ⟨ij.2.val, hij.2⟩)) else 0
  let res : Pattern N' → Pattern N := fun m' ij ↦
    ⟨min (m' (Fin.castLE hNN' ij.1, Fin.castLE hNN' ij.2)).val N, by omega⟩
  have hext (m : Pattern N) (i j : Fin N') : ((ext m) (i, j)).val =
      if hij : i.val < N ∧ j.val < N then (m (⟨i.val, hij.1⟩, ⟨j.val, hij.2⟩)).val else 0 := by
    simp only [ext]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hres (m' : Pattern N') (hm : patternWeight m' = w) (i j : Fin N') : (m' (i, j)).val =
      if hij : i.val < N ∧ j.val < N then ((res m') (⟨i.val, hij.1⟩, ⟨j.val, hij.2⟩)).val
      else 0 := by
    split_ifs with hij
    · simpa [res, Fin.castLE] using
        (pattern_entry_le_patternWeight N' m' (i, j)).trans (hm.trans_le hw)
    · refine pattern_entry_eq_zero_of_lt N' m' (i, j) ?_
      rw [hm]
      rcases not_and_or.mp hij with h | h <;> dsimp only <;> nlinarith
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' ext res (fun m hm ↦ ?_) (fun m' hm' ↦ ?_) (fun m _ ↦ ?_)
    (fun m' hm' ↦ ?_) fun m _ ↦ ?_
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hm ⊢
    rw [patternWeight_extend hNN' (hext m), hm]
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hm' ⊢
    rw [← patternWeight_extend hNN' (hres m' hm'), hm']
  · funext ij
    have := (m ij).isLt
    simp only [res, Fin.ext_iff, hext, Fin.val_castLE, ij.1.isLt, ij.2.isLt, and_self, dite_true,
      Fin.eta, Prod.mk.eta]
    omega
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hm'
    funext ⟨i, j⟩
    exact Fin.ext ((hext _ i j).trans (hres m' hm' i j).symm)
  · rw [rational_divisorCount_extend hNN' (hext m),
      prod_pattern_extend hNN' (hext m) (fun i j k ↦
        adamsCoef (i + 1) (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (j + 1)))) ^ k) fun _ _ ↦ pow_zero _]

name: SurfaceBlowup.patternSum_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem patternSum_eq_of_le (ε : ℤ) (a N N' w : ℕ) (hN : w ≤ N) (hN' : w ≤ N') :
    patternSum ε a N w = patternSum ε a N' w
proof:
:= by
  rw [patternSum_extend ε a N (max N N') w (le_max_left _ _) hN,
    patternSum_extend ε a N' (max N N') w (le_max_right _ _) hN']

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawWf_stateLaw
statement: theorem lawWf_stateLaw (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) : LawWf (stateLaw s)
proof:
:=
  (local_law_safe s hs).lawWf

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawWf_globalLaw
statement: theorem lawWf_globalLaw (ε : Bool) (n : ℕ) : LawWf (globalLaw ε n)
proof:
:=
  (global_law_safe n ε).lawWf

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_lawCoef_globalLaw_false
statement:
theorem coeff_lawCoef_globalLaw_false (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    (lawCoef (globalLaw false n)).coeff σ = (monicExpr n σ).rational
proof:
:=
  coeff_lawCoef _ (lawWf_globalLaw false n) σ

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_lawCoef_globalLaw_true
statement:
theorem coeff_lawCoef_globalLaw_true (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    (lawCoef (globalLaw true n)).coeff σ = (projectiveExpr n σ).rational
proof:
:=
  coeff_lawCoef _ (lawWf_globalLaw true n) σ

name: SurfaceBlowup.wf_subst_and_rational_subst
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | const r =>
    refine ⟨trivial, ?_⟩
    simp only [Expr.subst, Expr.rational_const]
    rw [eq_ratCast RatFunc.C r, map_ratCast]
  | var => exact ⟨he, by simp only [Expr.subst, Expr.rational_var, hX]⟩
  | add a b iha ihb =>
    obtain ⟨wa, ea⟩ := iha hx.1
    obtain ⟨wb, eb⟩ := ihb hx.2
    refine ⟨⟨wa, wb⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Expr.subst]
    rw [Expr.rational_add wa wb, Expr.rational_add hx.1 hx.2, map_add, ea, eb]
  | mul a b iha ihb =>
    obtain ⟨wa, ea⟩ := iha hx.1
    obtain ⟨wb, eb⟩ := ihb hx.2
    refine ⟨⟨wa, wb⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Expr.subst]
    rw [Expr.rational_mul, Expr.rational_mul a b, map_mul, ea, eb]
  | inv a iha =>
    obtain ⟨ha, hn⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨wa, ea⟩ := iha ha
    have hr : a.rational ≠ 0 :=
      div_ne_zero (RatFunc.algebraMap_ne_zero hn)
        (RatFunc.algebraMap_ne_zero (Expr.fraction_snd_ne_zero ha))
    refine ⟨⟨wa, fun h ↦ ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · refine hr (φ.injective ?_)
      rw [← ea, map_zero, Expr.rational, h, map_zero, zero_div]
    · simp only [Expr.subst]
      rw [Expr.rational_inv, Expr.rational_inv a, map_inv₀, ea]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_subst_of_wf
proof:
:=
  (wf_subst_and_rational_subst e he φ hX x hx).2

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_subst_inv_var
statement:
private theorem rational_subst_inv_var (x : Expr) (hx : x.wf) :
    (x.subst (.inv .var)).rational = recipRat x.rational
proof:
:=
  rational_subst_of_wf (.inv .var) ⟨trivial, by simp [Expr.fraction, Polynomial.X_ne_zero]⟩ recipRat
    (by rw [Expr.rational_inv, Expr.rational_var, recipRat_X]) hx

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_recipCoef_lawCoef
statement:
theorem coeff_recipCoef_lawCoef (L : Law) (hL : LawWf L) (σ : FactorType) :
    (recipCoef (lawCoef L)).coeff σ = ((lawCoeff L σ).subst (.inv .var)).rational
proof:
:= by
  rw [recipCoef_coeff, coeff_lawCoef L hL σ, rational_subst_inv_var _ (hL.wf_lawCoeff σ)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_lawDescend
statement:
private theorem lawCoef_lawDescend (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (L : Law) (hL : LawWf L) :
    lawCoef (lawDescend δ L) = adamsCoef δ (lawCoef L)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lawCoef lawDescend
  rw [map_list_sum, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left fun z hz ↦ ?_
  simp only [Function.comp]
  rw [rational_subst_of_wf _ (Expr.wf_pow (x := Expr.var) trivial δ) (adamsRat δ)
    (by rw [Expr.rational_pow, Expr.rational_var, adamsRat_X δ hδ]) (hL z hz), adamsCoef_single]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_otherChildren
statement:
private theorem lawCoef_otherChildren (a N : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (m : Pattern N) :
    lawCoef (lawProd ((otherChildren a m).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))) =
        ∏ ij : Fin N × Fin N, (adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1) (lawCoef
        (stateLaw (State.single a (ij.2.val + 1))))) ^ (m ij).val
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ ij : Fin N × Fin N, lawCoef (lawDescend (ij.1.val + 1)
      (stateLaw (State.single a (ij.2.val + 1)))) = adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1)
      (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (ij.2.val + 1)))) := by
    intro ij
    refine lawCoef_lawDescend _ (Nat.succ_pos _) _ ?_
    exact (lawWf_stateLaw _ (by simp [State.Valid]; omega))
  rw [(lawCoef_lawProd _)]
  unfold otherChildren
  simp only [List.map_flatMap, List.map_replicate, hf]
  rw [List.flatMap_def, List.prod_flatten, List.map_map, Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod,
      ← Multiset.prod_map_toList]
  simp [List.prod_replicate, Finset.toList, Function.comp_def]

name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_lawCoef_optional_child
statement:
private theorem prod_lawCoef_optional_child (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (s' : State)
    (hv : ¬p → s'.Valid) :
    ((if p then [] else [((1 : ℕ), s')]).map
        (lawCoef ∘ fun z : ℕ × State ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))).prod
      = if p then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw s')
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · simp
  · simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one,
      Function.comp]
    rw [lawCoef_lawDescend 1 one_pos _ (lawWf_stateLaw _ (hv h)), adamsCoef_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_crossing_term
statement:
private theorem lawCoef_crossing_term (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hh : 0 < h)
    (P : TangentPattern (State.crossing a b c h).degree) (hP : Allowed (State.crossing a b c h) P) :
    lawCoef (lawScale (.mul (tangentCount (State.crossing a b c h) P)
        (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) P.d.val))
        (lawProd ((children (State.crossing a b c h) P).map fun z ↦
        lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))) = scalar ((divisorCount (-1) P.other).rational *
        (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) P.d.val).rational) *
        ((if P.rt.val = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) a P.rt.val
        (c - P.d.val)))) * (if P.rx.val = 0 then 1 else lawCoef
        (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) b P.rx.val (h - P.d.val)))) *
        ∏ ij : Fin (State.crossing a b c h).degree × Fin (State.crossing a b c h).degree,
        (adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1) (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single (a + b) (ij.2.val + 1))))) ^
        (P.other ij).val)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∀ z ∈ children (State.crossing a b c h) P, z.2.Valid :=
    children_valid (State.crossing a b c h) ⟨ha, hb, hc, hh⟩ P hP
  rw [lawCoef_lawScale, Expr.rational_mul]
  congr 1
  have hch : children (State.crossing a b c h) P =
      (if P.rt.val=0 then [] else [(1,State.crossing (a+b) a P.rt.val (c-P.d.val))]) ++
      (if P.rx.val=0 then [] else [(1,State.crossing (a+b) b P.rx.val (h-P.d.val))]) ++
      otherChildren (a+b) P.other := rfl
  have hoth := lawCoef_otherChildren (a+b) _ (by omega) P.other
  rw [lawCoef_lawProd, List.map_map] at hoth
  rw [lawCoef_lawProd, List.map_map, hch, List.map_append, List.map_append, List.prod_append,
    List.prod_append, ← hoth, prod_lawCoef_optional_child _ _ ?_,
    prod_lawCoef_optional_child _ _ ?_]
  all_goals first | rfl | exact fun h1 ↦ hv (1, _) (by rw [hch]; simp [h1])

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_patterns_scalar_mul_eq_patternSum
statement:
theorem sum_patterns_scalar_mul_eq_patternSum (ε : ℤ) (a N w : ℕ) (Y : RatFunc ℚ) (B : Coef) :
    ∑ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern N)).filter (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = w),
      scalar ((divisorCount ε m).rational * Y) * (B * ∏ ij : Fin N × Fin N,
        (adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1) (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (ij.2.val + 1))))) ^
          (m ij).val) = scalar Y * (B * patternSum ε a N w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold patternSum
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
  rw [scalar_mul, Algebra.smul_def, ← scalar_eq_algebraMap]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_exitLaw_crossing
statement:
private theorem lawCoef_exitLaw_crossing (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hh : 0 < h) :
    lawCoef (exitLaw (State.crossing a b c h)) = ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min c h),
        ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        (if ((0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ rt + rx ≤ d) then scalar
        (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) d).rational *
        ((if rt = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) a rt (c - d)))) *
        (if rx = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) b rx (h - d)))) *
        patternSum (-1) (a + b) (a * c + b * h) (d - rt - rx)) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold exitLaw
  rw [lawCoef_flatMap, Finset.sum_map_toList]
  have hns : ∀ P, ¬ SelfPattern (State.crossing a b c h) P := by
    rintro P ⟨a', c', h1, -⟩
    exact State.noConfusion h1
  simp only [hns, if_false]
  refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun P hP ↦ lawCoef_crossing_term a b c h ha hb hc hh P
    (by unfold allowedPatterns at hP; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hP).2))).trans ?_
  rw [sum_allowedPatterns_crossing a b c h ha hb hh (fun d rt rx m ↦
    scalar ((divisorCount (-1) m).rational * (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h)
        d).rational) *
      ((if rt = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) a rt (c - d)))) *
        (if rx = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) b rx (h - d)))) *
        ∏ ij : Fin (State.crossing a b c h).degree × Fin (State.crossing a b c h).degree,
          (adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1) (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single (a + b) (ij.2.val + 1))))) ^
              (m ij).val))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl
      (fun rt _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun rx _ ↦ ?_)))
  by_cases hcond : ((0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ rt + rx ≤ d)
  · rw [if_pos hcond, if_pos hcond]; exact sum_patterns_scalar_mul_eq_patternSum _ _ _ _ _ _
  · rw [if_neg hcond, if_neg hcond]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_residue_flatMap
statement:
private theorem lawCoef_residue_flatMap (n : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    lawCoef ((residuePatterns n).toList.flatMap fun m ↦
      lawScale (divisorCount (if b then 1 else 0) m)
        (lawProd ((otherChildren 1 m).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))))
      = patternSum (if b then 1 else 0) 1 n n
proof:
:= by
  rw [lawCoef_flatMap]
  unfold patternSum residuePatterns
  rw [Finset.sum_map_toList]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
  rw [lawCoef_lawScale, lawCoef_otherChildren 1 n Nat.one_pos m, Algebra.smul_def]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_globalLaw_false
statement:
theorem lawCoef_globalLaw_false (n : ℕ) :
    lawCoef (globalLaw false n) = qpow (-(n : ℤ)) * patternSum 0 1 n n
proof:
:= by
  have k0 := lawCoef_residue_flatMap n false
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at k0
  unfold globalLaw
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  rw [lawCoef_lawScale, k0, Expr.rational_inv, Expr.rational_pow, Expr.rational_var, qpow,
    zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_globalLaw_true
statement:
theorem lawCoef_globalLaw_true (n : ℕ) :
    lawCoef (globalLaw true n) =
      scalar (((projectiveNormalizer n).rational)⁻¹) * patternSum 1 1 n n
proof:
:= by
  have k1 := lawCoef_residue_flatMap n true
  simp only [if_true] at k1
  unfold globalLaw
  simp only [if_true]
  rw [lawCoef_lawScale, k1, Expr.rational_inv]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_single_term
statement:
theorem lawCoef_single_term (a n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n)
    (P : TangentPattern (State.single a n).degree) (hP : Allowed (State.single a n) P) :
    lawCoef (lawScale (.mul (tangentCount (State.single a n) P)
        (divisorProbability (State.single a n) P.d.val))
        (lawProd ((children (State.single a n) P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))) =
        scalar ((divisorCount 0 P.other).rational * (divisorProbability (State.single a n)
        P.d.val).rational) * ((if P.rt.val = 0 then 1 else lawCoef
        (stateLaw (State.crossing a a P.rt.val (n - P.d.val)))) *
        ∏ ij : Fin (State.single a n).degree × Fin (State.single a n).degree,
        (adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1) (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (ij.2.val + 1))))) ^
        (P.other ij).val)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∀ z ∈ children (State.single a n) P, z.2.Valid :=
    children_valid (State.single a n) ⟨ha, hn⟩ P hP
  rw [lawCoef_lawScale, Expr.rational_mul]
  congr 1
  have hch : children (State.single a n) P =
      (if P.rt.val=0 then [] else [(1,State.crossing a a P.rt.val (n-P.d.val))]) ++
      otherChildren a P.other := rfl
  have hoth := lawCoef_otherChildren a _ ha P.other
  rw [lawCoef_lawProd, List.map_map] at hoth
  rw [lawCoef_lawProd, List.map_map, hch, List.map_append, List.prod_append, ← hoth,
    prod_lawCoef_optional_child _ _ ?_]
  all_goals first | rfl | exact fun h1 ↦ hv (1, _) (by rw [hch]; simp [h1])

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_divisorProbability_single
statement:
theorem rational_divisorProbability_single (a c d : ℕ) :
    (divisorProbability (State.single a c) d).rational =
      ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ tri d)⁻¹ *
        ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) - 1) ^ (if d < c then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [divisorProbability, Expr.rational_mul, Expr.rational_inv, Expr.rational_pow,
    Expr.rational_var, rational_eminusOne]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_divisorProbability_crossing
statement:
private theorem rational_divisorProbability_crossing (a b c h d : ℕ) :
    (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) d).rational =
      ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ chooseTwo d)⁻¹ * (if (if d < c then 1 else 0) +
        (if d < h then 1 else 0) = 0 then ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) - 1)⁻¹ else
        ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) - 1) ^
          ((if d < c then 1 else 0) + (if d < h then 1 else 0) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [divisorProbability]
  rw [Expr.rational_mul, Expr.rational_inv, Expr.rational_pow, Expr.rational_var]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Expr.rational_inv, Expr.rational_pow, rational_eminusOne]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_returnWeight
statement:
theorem rational_returnWeight (c : ℕ) :
    (returnWeight c).rational = (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) * ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ tri c)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [returnWeight, Expr.rational_mul, Expr.rational_inv, Expr.rational_pow,
    Expr.rational_var]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_pointCount
statement:
private theorem rational_pointCount (δ : ℕ) : (pointCount δ).rational = RatFunc.C (1 / (δ : ℚ)) *
    ∑ j ∈ δ.divisors, RatFunc.C (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ)) *
    (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ (δ / j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pointCount
  rw [Expr.rational_mul, Expr.rational_const, Expr.rational_sum]
  · rw [List.map_map, ← Finset.sum_map_toList]
    congr 2
    refine List.map_congr_left fun j _ ↦ ?_
    simp [Expr.rational_mul, Expr.rational_const, Expr.rational_pow, Expr.rational_var]
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz
    exact ⟨trivial, Expr.wf_pow (x := Expr.var) trivial _⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.rational_availablePoints
proof:
:= by
  unfold availablePoints
  split_ifs
  · rw [Expr.rational_add (x := Expr.var) (y := Expr.const (ε : ℚ)) trivial trivial,
      Expr.rational_var, Expr.rational_const, map_intCast]
  · rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.X_mul_X_inv_sub_X_zpow_neg_tri
proof:
:= by
  rw [rational_returnWeight n, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, mul_sub, mul_inv_cancel₀ RatFunc.X_ne_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.one_sub_rational_returnWeight_ne_zero
statement:
theorem one_sub_rational_returnWeight_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 - (returnWeight n).rational ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : 3 ≤ tri n := by
    unfold tri
    have : 6 ≤ n * (n + 1) := by nlinarith
    omega
  intro h0
  have hX : (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ≠ 0 := RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have h1 : (returnWeight n).rational = 1 := by linear_combination -h0
  rw [rational_returnWeight] at h1
  have hk : (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) = (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ tri n := by
    have := congrArg (· * (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ tri n) h1
    simpa [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hX)] using this
  have hp : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) = Polynomial.X ^ tri n := by
    apply RatFunc.algebraMap_injective ℚ
    simpa [RatFunc.algebraMap_X] using hk
  have := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hp
  simp at this
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.X_inv_sub_X_zpow_neg_tri_ne_zero
statement:
theorem X_inv_sub_X_zpow_neg_tri_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)⁻¹ - (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ (-(tri n : ℤ)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := X_mul_X_inv_sub_X_zpow_neg_tri n
  rw [h, mul_zero] at this
  exact one_sub_rational_returnWeight_ne_zero n hn this.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsRat_X_add_int
statement:
private theorem adamsRat_X_add_int (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (ε : ℤ) :
    adamsRat k (RatFunc.X + (ε : RatFunc ℚ)) = RatFunc.X ^ k + (ε : RatFunc ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, map_intCast, (adamsRat_X k hk)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.availablePoints_rational_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem availablePoints_rational_eq_sum (ε : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∑ k ∈ m.divisors, (RatFunc.C ((k : ℚ)⁻¹ * (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (m / k) : ℤ) : ℚ) /
        ((m / k : ℕ) : ℚ))))
      * ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ k + (ε : RatFunc ℚ)) = (availablePoints ε m).rational
proof:
:= by
  rw [rational_availablePoints]
  have hm' : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  have ht : ∀ k ∈ m.divisors,
      RatFunc.C ((k : ℚ)⁻¹ * (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (m / k) : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((m / k : ℕ) : ℚ)))
        * ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ k + (ε : RatFunc ℚ))
      = (fun j : ℕ ↦ RatFunc.C (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ) / m)
          * ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ (m / j) + (ε : RatFunc ℚ))) (m / k) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : (k : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk).ne'
    simp only [Nat.div_div_self (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hk) hm.ne']
    congr 2
    rw [Nat.cast_div (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hk) hk0]
    field_simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl ht, Nat.sum_div_divisors m (fun j : ℕ ↦
      RatFunc.C (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ) / m)
          * ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ (m / j) + (ε : RatFunc ℚ)))]
  split_ifs with h1
  · subst h1; simp
  · rw [rational_pointCount]
    simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    have h0 : ∑ j ∈ m.divisors, RatFunc.C (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ) / m) *
        (ε : RatFunc ℚ) = 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← map_sum, ← Finset.sum_div, sum_divisors_moebius, if_neg h1]; simp
    rw [h0, add_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
    congr 2
    field_simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.plethSum_C_mul_moebiusSum
proof:
:= by
  ext n : 1
  simp only [plethSum, moebiusSum, countSum, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  have h1 : ∀ k ∈ n.divisors, ∀ j ∈ (n / k).divisors,
      (k : ℚ)⁻¹ • adamsCoef k (scalar (RatFunc.X + (ε : RatFunc ℚ)) *
        ((((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ)) / (j : ℚ)) •
            adamsCoef j (PowerSeries.coeff (n / k / j) L))
        = (fun (k j : ℕ) ↦ scalar (RatFunc.C ((k : ℚ)⁻¹ *
            (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ) / (j : ℚ))) *
            ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ k + (ε : RatFunc ℚ))) *
            adamsCoef (k * j) (PowerSeries.coeff (n / (k * j)) L)) k j := by
    intro k hk j hj
    have hk0 : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk
    have hj0 : 0 < j := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hj
    rw [mul_smul_comm, map_rat_smul, map_mul, adamsCoef_adamsCoef k j hk0 hj0,
        Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,
      adamsCoef_scalar k, adamsRat_X_add_int k hk0, smul_smul, rat_smul_eq_scalar_mul, ← mul_assoc,
      ← scalar_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl (h1 k hk),
    sum_divisors_sum_divisors_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
  have hm0 : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hm
  have h2 : ∀ k ∈ m.divisors, k * (m / k) = m := fun k hk ↦
      Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hk)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ by
      rw [h2 k hk], ← Finset.sum_mul, ← availablePoints_rational_eq_sum ε m hm0]
  simp only [scalar_eq_algebraMap, ← map_sum, Algebra.smul_def]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_stateLaw_crossing_comm
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (state_law_unfold (.crossing a b c h) ⟨ha, hb, hc, hh⟩ rfl).2 a b c h rfl
  have h2 := (state_law_unfold (.crossing b a h c) ⟨hb, ha, hh, hc⟩ rfl).2 b a h c rfl
  rw [h1, h2, lawCoef_exitLaw_crossing a b c h ha hb hc hh,
    lawCoef_exitLaw_crossing b a h c hb ha hh hc, Nat.min_comm h c]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ ↦ ?_
  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun rt _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun rx _ ↦ ?_
  have hp : (divisorProbability (State.crossing b a h c) d).rational
      = (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) d).rational := by
    rw [rational_divisorProbability_crossing b a h c d,
      rational_divisorProbability_crossing a b c h d,
      Nat.add_comm (if d < h then 1 else 0)]
  rw [hp, Nat.add_comm b a, Nat.add_comm (b * h) (a * c), Nat.sub_right_comm d rx rt]
  by_cases hc1 : ((0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ rt + rx ≤ d)
  · have hc2 : ((0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ (0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ rx + rt ≤ d) := by
      obtain ⟨x, y, z⟩ := hc1; exact ⟨y, x, by omega⟩
    rw [if_pos hc1, if_pos hc2, mul_comm (if rx = 0 then _ else _)]
  · have hc2 : ¬ ((0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ (0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ rx + rt ≤ d) := by
      rintro ⟨y, x, z⟩; exact hc1 ⟨x, y, by omega⟩
    rw [if_neg hc1, if_neg hc2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossingQ_zero_zero
statement: theorem crossingQ_zero_zero (a b : ℕ) : crossingQ a b 0 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [crossingQ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qPositive_crossingQ
statement: private theorem qPositive_crossingQ (a b : ℕ) : QPositive (crossingQ a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro c h h1 h2
  have : ¬ (0 < c ∧ 0 < h) := by omega
  simp [crossingQ, h2, this]

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossingQ_of_pos
statement:
private theorem crossingQ_of_pos (a b c h : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hh : 0 < h) :
    crossingQ a b c h = scalar (RatFunc.X - 1) * lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing a b c h))
proof:
:= by
  have : ¬ (c = 0 ∧ h = 0) := by omega
  simp [crossingQ, this, hc, hh]

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossingQ_symm
statement:
theorem crossingQ_symm (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    crossingQ a b c h = crossingQ b a h c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : c = 0 ∧ h = 0
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h1
    simp [crossingQ]
  · by_cases h2 : 0 < c ∧ 0 < h
    · rw [crossingQ_of_pos a b c h h2.1 h2.2, crossingQ_of_pos b a h c h2.2 h2.1,
        lawCoef_stateLaw_crossing_comm a b c h ha hb h2.1 h2.2]
    · rw [qPositive_crossingQ a b c h (by omega) h1,
        qPositive_crossingQ b a h c (by omega) (by tauto)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.expSer_sum
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using expSer_zero
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha,
      expSer_add _ _ (hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)),
          ih (fun m hm ↦ hF m (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hm))]
    rw [map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m hm ↦ hF m (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hm))

name: SurfaceBlowup.pPow_scongr_prod_formalPow_adamsSer
statement:
private theorem pPow_scongr_prod_formalPow_adamsSer (ε : ℤ) (B : Ser)
    (hB : PowerSeries.constantCoeff B = 1) (N : ℕ) :
    SCongr N (pPow (RatFunc.X + (ε : RatFunc ℚ)) B) (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        formalPow (availablePoints ε m).rational (adamsSer m B))
proof:
:= by
  set L := logSer B with hLdef
  have hL : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0 := (constantCoeff_logSer B hB)
  have hp : pPow (RatFunc.X + (ε : RatFunc ℚ)) B = expSer (countSum ε L) := by
    rw [pPow, pExp, pLog, plethSum_C_mul_moebiusSum]
  set S : Ser := ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
    PowerSeries.C (scalar (availablePoints ε m).rational) * adamsSer m L with hS
  have hterm : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, PowerSeries.constantCoeff
      (PowerSeries.C (scalar (availablePoints ε m).rational) * adamsSer m L) = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm).1; omega
    rw [map_mul, (constantCoeff_adamsSer m hm0 L), hL, map_zero, mul_zero]
  have hS0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff S = 0 := by
    rw [hS, map_sum]; exact Finset.sum_eq_zero hterm
  have hc0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (countSum ε L) = 0 := by
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]; simp [countSum]
  have h1 : SCongr N (countSum ε L) S := by
    intro n hn
    rw [hS, map_sum]
    have hrw : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, PowerSeries.coeff n
        (PowerSeries.C (scalar (availablePoints ε m).rational) * adamsSer m L) =
        if m ∣ n then (availablePoints ε m).rational • adamsCoef m (PowerSeries.coeff (n / m) L)
            else 0 := by
      intro m hm
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm).1; omega
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, (coeff_adamsSer m hm0 L n), scalar_mul_eq_smul]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hrw, ← Finset.sum_filter]
    simp only [countSum, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hnpos
    · simp only [Nat.divisors_zero, Finset.sum_empty, Nat.zero_div]
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at hL
      simp [hL]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr _ (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
      ext m
      simp only [Nat.mem_divisors, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hd, hn0⟩
        exact ⟨⟨Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd hnpos, (Nat.le_of_dvd hnpos hd).trans hn⟩, hd⟩
      · rintro ⟨_, hd⟩
        exact ⟨hd, by omega⟩
  have h2 := (SCongr.expSer hc0 hS0 h1)
  have h3 : expSer S = ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, formalPow (availablePoints ε m).rational
      (adamsSer m B) := by
    rw [hS, expSer_sum _ _ hterm]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm).1; omega
    rw [formalPow, ← (adamsSer_logSer m hm0 B hB)]
  rw [hp, ← h3]; exact h2

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_eulerSer_eq_coeff_prod
statement:
private theorem coeff_eulerSer_eq_coeff_prod (ε : ℤ) (a n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (eulerSer ε a) = PowerSeries.coeff n
        (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, formalPow (availablePoints ε m).rational
        (adamsSer m (clusterSer a)))
proof:
:= by
  have hB : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (clusterSer a) = 1 := by
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
    simp [clusterSer]
  exact pPow_scongr_prod_formalPow_adamsSer ε (clusterSer a) hB n n le_rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_eulerSer
statement:
theorem coeff_eulerSer (ε : ℤ) (a n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (eulerSer ε a) = patternSum ε a n n
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_eulerSer_eq_coeff_prod,
    prod_formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr ε a n n le_rfl,
    coeff_euler_families_eq_patternSum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossing_factorization_term
statement:
private theorem crossing_factorization_term (a b c h d rt rx : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hdc : d ≤ min c h) :
    (if (rt + rx ≤ d ∧ d ≤ min c h) then
      qpow (-(chooseTwo (rx + (d - rt - rx) + rt) : ℤ)) *
        (crossingQ (a + b) b rx (h - (rx + (d - rt - rx) + rt)) *
          (PowerSeries.coeff (d - rt - rx) (eulerSer (-1) (a + b)) *
            crossingQ a (a + b) (c - (rx + (d - rt - rx) + rt)) rt)) else 0)
    = scalar (RatFunc.X - 1) * (if ((0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ rt + rx ≤ d) then scalar
        (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) d).rational *
        ((if rt = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) a rt (c - d)))) *
        (if rx = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) b rx (h - d)))) *
        patternSum (-1) (a + b) (a * c + b * h) (d - rt - rx)) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsum : rt + rx ≤ d
  swap
  · simp [hsum]
  rw [show rx + (d - rt - rx) + rt = d by omega]
  simp only [hsum, hdc, and_self, if_true, and_true]
  rw [coeff_eulerSer,
    patternSum_eq_of_le (-1) (a + b) (d - rt - rx) (a * c + b * h) (d - rt - rx) le_rfl (by
      have : c ≤ a * c := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left c ha
      have := min_le_left c h
      omega)]
  set P := patternSum (-1) (a + b) (a * c + b * h) (d - rt - rx)
  by_cases hT : (0 < rt ↔ d < c)
  swap
  · have : crossingQ a (a + b) (c - d) rt = 0 := by
      unfold crossingQ; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    simp [this, hT]
  by_cases hX : (0 < rx ↔ d < h)
  swap
  · have : crossingQ (a + b) b rx (h - d) = 0 := by
      unfold crossingQ; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    simp [this, hX]
  simp only [hT, hX, and_self, if_true]
  set Bt := (if rt = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) a rt (c - d))))
  set Bx := (if rx = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) b rx (h - d))))
  set i := (if d < c then 1 else 0)
  set k := (if d < h then 1 else 0)
  have eT : crossingQ a (a + b) (c - d) rt = scalar ((RatFunc.X - 1) ^ i) * Bt := by
    by_cases h1 : d < c
    · have hrt : 0 < rt := hT.2 h1
      simp only [i, Bt, crossingQ, if_pos h1, pow_one, if_neg
          (show ¬ (c - d = 0 ∧ rt = 0) by omega),
        if_pos (show 0 < c - d ∧ 0 < rt by omega), if_neg (show ¬ rt = 0 by omega)]
      rw [lawCoef_stateLaw_crossing_comm a (a + b) (c - d) rt ha (by omega) (by omega) hrt]
    · have hrt : rt = 0 := by omega
      simp only [i, Bt, crossingQ, if_neg h1, pow_zero, scalar_one, if_pos hrt, mul_one,
        if_pos (show c - d = 0 ∧ rt = 0 by omega)]
  have eX : crossingQ (a + b) b rx (h - d) = scalar ((RatFunc.X - 1) ^ k) * Bx := by
