    by_cases h1 : d < h
    · have hrx : 0 < rx := hX.2 h1
      simp only [k, Bx, crossingQ, if_pos h1, pow_one, if_neg
          (show ¬ (rx = 0 ∧ h - d = 0) by omega),
        if_pos (show 0 < rx ∧ 0 < h - d by omega), if_neg (show ¬ rx = 0 by omega)]
    · have hrx : rx = 0 := by omega
      simp only [k, Bx, crossingQ, if_neg h1, pow_zero, scalar_one, if_pos hrx, mul_one,
        if_pos (show rx = 0 ∧ h - d = 0 by omega)]
  rw [eT, eX, rational_divisorProbability_crossing a b c h d,
    show qpow (-(chooseTwo d : ℤ)) = scalar (((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ chooseTwo d)⁻¹) by
      rw [qpow, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]]
  calc scalar ((RatFunc.X ^ chooseTwo d)⁻¹) * (scalar ((RatFunc.X - 1) ^ k) * Bx *
      (P * (scalar ((RatFunc.X - 1) ^ i) * Bt)))
      = scalar ((RatFunc.X ^ chooseTwo d)⁻¹ * ((RatFunc.X - 1) ^ (i + k))) * (Bt * Bx * P) := by
        rw [pow_add, scalar_mul, scalar_mul]; ring
    _ = _ := by
        rw [← X_sub_one_mul_crossingWeight (i + k), ← mul_assoc (scalar (RatFunc.X - 1)),
          ← scalar_mul]
        simp only [mul_assoc]
        congr 2
        ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_crossingQ_apply
statement:
private theorem qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_crossingQ_apply (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hc : 0 < c) :
    qmul (qmul (qplus (crossingQ (a + b) b)) (qdiag (eulerSer (-1) (a + b))))
        (qminus (crossingQ a (a + b))) c h = scalar (RatFunc.X - 1) *
        (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min c h), ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        (if ((0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ rt + rx ≤ d) then scalar
        (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) d).rational *
        ((if rt = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) a rt (c - d)))) *
        (if rx = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing (a + b) b rx (h - d)))) *
        patternSum (-1) (a + b) (a * c + b * h) (d - rt - rx)) else 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_apply]
  set G : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Coef := fun rx m rt ↦
    qpow (-(chooseTwo (rx + m + rt) : ℤ)) *
        (crossingQ (a + b) b rx (h - (rx + m + rt)) *
          (PowerSeries.coeff m (eulerSer (-1) (a + b)) *
            crossingQ a (a + b) (c - (rx + m + rt)) rt)) with hG
  have step1 : ∀ rx m rt : ℕ, (if (rx + m + rt ≤ c ∧ rx + m + rt ≤ h) then qpow
      (-(chooseTwo rx : ℤ) - (chooseTwo m : ℤ) - (chooseTwo rt : ℤ) - (rx : ℤ) *
      (m : ℤ) - ((rx : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) * (rt : ℤ)) * (crossingQ (a + b) b rx (h - (rx + m + rt)) *
      (PowerSeries.coeff m (eulerSer (-1) (a + b)) * crossingQ a (a + b) (c - (rx + m + rt)) rt))
      else 0)
      = if rx + m + rt ≤ min c h then G rx m rt else 0 := by
    intro rx m rt
    have e : (chooseTwo rx : ℤ) + chooseTwo m + chooseTwo rt + rx * m + rx * rt + m * rt =
        ((chooseTwo (rx + m + rt) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [chooseTwo_add, chooseTwo_add]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hG]
    simp only [le_min_iff]
    split_ifs
    · congr 2
      rw [← e]; ring
    · rfl
  simp only [step1]
  rw [sum_triple_reindex c (min c h) (min_le_left _ _) G, Finset.mul_sum]
  symm
  have hsub : Finset.Icc 1 (min c h) ⊆ Finset.range (c + 1) := fun d hd ↦ by
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_range] at hd ⊢; omega
  have hzero : ∀ d ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), d ∉ Finset.Icc 1 (min c h) →
      (∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), if rt + rx ≤ d ∧ d ≤
          min c h then G rx (d - rt - rx) rt else 0) = 0 := by
    intro d hd hnot
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hnot
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun rt hrt ↦ Finset.sum_eq_zero fun rx hrx ↦ ?_
    rcases hnot with h0 | h1
    · obtain rfl : d = 0 := by omega
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hrt hrx
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : rt = 0 ∧ rx = 0 := by omega
      have hz : crossingQ a (a + b) c 0 = 0 := qPositive_crossingQ _ _ c 0 (Or.inr rfl) (by omega)
      simp [hG, hz]
    · exact if_neg (by omega)
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub hzero]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun rt _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun rx _ ↦
    (crossing_factorization_term a b c h d rt rx ha hb (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hd).2).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossingQ_eq_qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus
statement:
theorem crossingQ_eq_qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    crossingQ a b c h = qmul (qmul (qplus (crossingQ (a + b) b)) (qdiag (eulerSer (-1) (a + b))))
        (qminus (crossingQ a (a + b))) c h
proof:
:= by
  have Q2 : QPositive (qmul (qplus (crossingQ (a + b) b)) (qdiag (eulerSer (-1) (a + b)))) :=
    (qPositive_crossingQ _ _).qplus.qmul (qPositive_qdiag _)
  by_cases h00 : c = 0 ∧ h = 0
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h00
    rw [qmul_zero_zero, qmul_zero_zero, crossingQ_zero_zero]
    simp [qplus, qminus, qdiag, chooseTwo, crossingQ_zero_zero, qpow_zero, coeff_zero_eulerSer]
  · by_cases hp : 0 < c ∧ 0 < h
    · rw [qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_crossingQ_apply a b c h ha hb hp.1,
        ← lawCoef_exitLaw_crossing a b c h ha hb hp.1 hp.2,
        ← (state_law_unfold (.crossing a b c h) ⟨ha, hb, hp.1, hp.2⟩ rfl).2 a b c h rfl,
        crossingQ_of_pos a b c h hp.1 hp.2]
    · have z : c = 0 ∨ h = 0 := by omega
      rw [Q2.qmul (qPositive_crossingQ _ _).qminus c h z h00, qPositive_crossingQ a b c h z h00]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qcongr_crossingQ_mul_qdagger
statement:
theorem qcongr_crossingQ_mul_qdagger (M : ℕ) (hS : ∀ a : ℕ, 0 < a →
    SCongr M (eulerSer 0 a) (dilate (recipSer (clusterSer a)))) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2 * M + 1)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    QCongr j (qmul (crossingQ a b) (qdagger (crossingQ a b))) qone
proof:
:= by
  have refl : ∀ (k : ℕ) (U : QSer), QCongr k U U := fun k U c h _ ↦ rfl
  have posUU : ∀ x y : ℕ, QPositive (qmul (crossingQ x y) (qdagger (crossingQ x y))) :=
    fun x y ↦ (qPositive_crossingQ x y).qmul (qPositive_crossingQ x y).qdagger
  induction j generalizing a b with
  | zero =>
    intro c h hc
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : c = 0 ∧ h = 0 := by omega
    rw [qmul_zero_zero]
    simp [qdagger, qone, crossingQ_zero_zero, qpow_zero]
  | succ j ih =>
    have hj' : j ≤ 2 * M + 1 := by omega
    set s := a + b with hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by omega
    set A := crossingQ s b
    set D := qdiag (eulerSer (-1) s)
    set Cq := crossingQ a s
    have hfac : crossingQ a b = qmul (qmul (qplus A) D) (qminus Cq) := by
      funext c h; exact crossingQ_eq_qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus a b c h ha hb
    have hdag : qdagger (crossingQ a b) =
        qmul (qminus (qdagger Cq)) (qmul (qdagger D) (qplus (qdagger A))) := by
      rw [hfac, qdagger_qmul, qdagger_qmul, qdagger_qplus, qdagger_qminus]
    rw [hdag, hfac]
    
    have e1 : qmul (qmul (qmul (qplus A) D) (qminus Cq))
        (qmul (qminus (qdagger Cq)) (qmul (qdagger D) (qplus (qdagger A)))) =
        qmul (qmul (qplus A) D) (qmul (qminus (qmul Cq (qdagger Cq)))
          (qmul (qdagger D) (qplus (qdagger A)))) := by
      rw [qminus_qmul, qmul_assoc, ← qmul_assoc (qminus Cq)]
    rw [e1]
    have hC : QCongr (j + 1) (qminus (qmul Cq (qdagger Cq))) qone :=
      qcongr_qminus_qone (j + 1) _ (posUU a s) (by simpa using ih hj' a s ha hs0)
    have hA : QCongr (j + 1) (qplus (qmul A (qdagger A))) qone :=
      qcongr_qplus_qone (j + 1) _ (posUU s b) (by simpa using ih hj' s b hs0 hb)
    have hD : QCongr (j + 1) (qmul D (qdagger D)) qone :=
      (qcongr_qdiag_mul_qdagger M s
        (dilate_recipSer_eulerSer_mul_scongr_one M s hs0 hS)).mono (by omega)
    refine ((refl _ _).qmul (hC.qmul (refl _ _))).trans ?_
    rw [qone_qmul, qmul_assoc, ← qmul_assoc D]
    refine ((refl _ _).qmul (hD.qmul (refl _ _))).trans ?_
    rw [qone_qmul, ← qplus_qmul]
    exact hA

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_one_eulerSer_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_one_eulerSer_zero (a : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 1 (eulerSer 0 a) = qpow 1 * AddMonoidAlgebra.single ({(a, 1)} : FactorType)
        1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_eulerSer]
  let m1 : Pattern 1 := fun _ ↦ 1
  have hf : (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern 1)).filter (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = 1) = {m1} := by
    ext m
    have key : patternWeight m = (m (0,0)).val := by
      simp [patternWeight, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton, key]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro h
      funext ij
      have : ij = (0,0) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst this
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa [m1] using h
    · intro h; subst h; rfl
  unfold patternSum
  rw [hf, Finset.sum_singleton]
  have hc : lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a 1)) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single ({(a, 1)} : FactorType) 1 :=
    (coeff_succ_clusterSer a 0).symm.trans (coeff_one_clusterSer a)
  have hP : (∏ ij : Fin 1 × Fin 1,
      (adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1) (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (ij.2.val + 1))))) ^ (m1 ij).val)
      = AddMonoidAlgebra.single ({(a, 1)} : FactorType) 1 := by
    simp [m1, hc, adamsCoef_one]
  have hD : (divisorCount 0 m1).rational = RatFunc.X := by
    rw [rational_divisorCount]
    simp [m1, rational_availablePoints]
  rw [hP, hD, Algebra.smul_def, qpow_one, scalar_eq_algebraMap]

name: SurfaceBlowup.cluster_reciprocity_one
statement:
theorem cluster_reciprocity_one (a : ℕ) :
    SCongr 1 (eulerSer 0 a) (dilate (recipSer (clusterSer a)))
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  interval_cases m
  · rw [coeff_zero_eulerSer, coeff_zero_dilate_recipSer_clusterSer]
  · rw [coeff_one_eulerSer_zero a, coeff_one_dilate_recipSer_clusterSer]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_qact_crossingQ_gaussPhi_eulerSer
statement:
theorem coeff_qact_crossingQ_gaussPhi_eulerSer (a n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (qact (crossingQ a a) (gaussPhi (eulerSer 0 a))) =
        (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        (if ((0 < r ↔ d < n) ∧ r ≤ d) then scalar (divisorProbability (State.single a n)
        d).rational * ((if r = 0 then 1 else lawCoef (stateLaw (State.crossing a a r (n - d)))) *
        patternSum 0 a (a * n) (d - r)) else 0)) + (if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : ∀ d r, d ≤ n → PowerSeries.coeff (d - r) (eulerSer 0 a) =
      patternSum 0 a (a * n) (d - r) := by
    intro d r hd
    rw [coeff_eulerSer]
    apply patternSum_eq_of_le
    · exact le_rfl
    · have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n ha; omega
  rw [coeff_qact_gaussPhi, Finset.sum_range_succ']
  congr 1
  · have hI : Finset.Icc 1 n = Finset.Ico 1 (n + 1) := by
      ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega
    rw [hI, Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hd
    rw [add_comm 1 d]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hr
    rw [hG _ _ (by omega), rational_divisorProbability_single a n (d+1)]
    simp only [crossingQ, qpow]
    have hX : (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ (-((tri (d+1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ tri (d+1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
    rw [hX]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h0 | h0
    · subst h0
      by_cases hdn : d + 1 < n
      · have : ¬ (n - (d+1) = 0) := by omega
        simp [hdn, this]
      · have : n - (d+1) = 0 := by omega
        simp [hdn, this]
    · by_cases hdn : d + 1 < n
      · have : 0 < n - (d+1) := by omega
        have hr' : r ≤ d + 1 := by omega
        simp only [h0.ne', false_and, if_false, h0, this, hdn, iff_self, hr', and_self, if_true,
            pow_one, scalar_mul]
        ring
      · have : ¬ (0 < n - (d+1)) := by omega
        simp [h0.ne', hdn, this]
  · have ht : tri 0 = 0 := rfl
    simp only [zero_add, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.sub_self, ht, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, qpow_zero,
      one_mul, coeff_zero_eulerSer, mul_one, crossingQ]
    by_cases hn : n = 0 <;> simp [hn]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoef_single_self_term
statement:
theorem lawCoef_single_self_term (a n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : TangentPattern (State.single a n).degree) (hP : Allowed (State.single a n) P)
    (hself : SelfPattern (State.single a n) P) :
    lawCoef (lawScale (.mul (tangentCount (State.single a n) P)
        (divisorProbability (State.single a n) P.d.val))
        (lawProd ((children (State.single a n) P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))) =
        qpow (-(tri n : ℤ)) * (qpow 1 * lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lawCoef_single_term a n ha (by omega) P hP]
  obtain ⟨hd, hrt, -, hother⟩ := (selfPattern_single_iff a n ha hn P hP).1 hself
  have hdeg : (State.single a n).degree = a * n := rfl
  have hpos : 0 < (State.single a n).degree := by rw [hdeg]; exact Nat.mul_pos ha (by omega)
  have hn1 : n - 1 < (State.single a n).degree := by
    rw [hdeg]; have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n ha; omega
  have hprob : (divisorProbability (State.single a n) P.d.val).rational
      = ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ tri n)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hd, rational_divisorProbability_single a n n]; simp
  have hf : ∀ b, (∏ j : Fin (State.single a n).degree,
      ((Nat.factorial (P.other (b, j)).val : ℕ) : ℚ)) = 1 := fun b ↦
    Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ ↦ by rw [hother]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have hcount : (divisorCount 0 P.other).rational = (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) := by
    rw [rational_divisorCount, Finset.prod_eq_single (⟨0, hpos⟩ : Fin (State.single a n).degree)]
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨n - 1, hn1⟩ : Fin (State.single a n).degree), hf]
      · simp [hother, rational_availablePoints]
      · intro b _ hb
        simp [hother, show b.val ≠ n - 1 from fun h ↦ hb (Fin.ext h)]
      · simp
    · intro b _ hb
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ ↦ by
        simp [hother, show b.val ≠ 0 from fun h ↦ hb (Fin.ext h)], hf]
      simp
    · simp
  have hprod : (∏ ij : Fin (State.single a n).degree × Fin (State.single a n).degree,
      (adamsCoef (ij.1.val + 1) (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (ij.2.val + 1))))) ^
          (P.other ij).val)
      = lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a n)) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single ((⟨0, hpos⟩, ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩) : Fin (State.single a n).degree × Fin
        (State.single a n).degree)]
    · rw [hother]
      simp only [and_self, if_true, pow_one]
      rw [show n - 1 + 1 = n by omega, adamsCoef_one]
    · intro b _ hb
      rw [hother, if_neg, pow_zero]
      rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact hb (Prod.ext (Fin.ext h1) (Fin.ext h2))
    · simp
  rw [hprod, hprob, hcount, if_pos hrt, one_mul, scalar_mul, ← qpow_one,
    show qpow (-(tri n : ℤ)) = scalar (((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ tri n)⁻¹) by
      rw [qpow, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.eval₂_C_X_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem eval₂_C_X_eq_algebraMap (g : Polynomial ℚ) :
    Polynomial.eval₂ (RatFunc.C : ℚ →+* RatFunc ℚ) (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) g =
      algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) g
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | monomial n a => simp [RatFunc.algebraMap_monomial]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipPoly_ne_zero
statement: private theorem recipPoly_ne_zero (p : Polynomial ℚ) (hp : p ≠ 0) : recipPoly p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Invertible (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) := invertibleOfNonzero RatFunc.X_ne_zero
  have key := Polynomial.eval₂_reflect_eq_zero_iff (RatFunc.C : ℚ →+* RatFunc ℚ)
    (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) p.natDegree (p.reflect p.natDegree)
    (by simpa using Polynomial.natDegree_reflect_le (N := p.natDegree) (p := p))
  rw [Polynomial.reflect_reflect, invOf_eq_inv] at key
  intro h
  have h3 := key.mp h
  rw [eval₂_C_X_eq_algebraMap] at h3
  exact hp (Polynomial.reflect_eq_zero_iff.mp
    (not_not.1 fun hne ↦ RatFunc.algebraMap_ne_zero hne h3))

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipPoly_injective
statement: private theorem recipPoly_injective : Function.Injective recipPoly
proof:
:=
  (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun p hp ↦ not_not.1 fun hne ↦ recipPoly_ne_zero p hne hp

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsPoly_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem adamsPoly_ne_zero (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (p : Polynomial ℚ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    adamsPoly δ p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 : Polynomial.eval₂ (RatFunc.C : ℚ →+* RatFunc ℚ) (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ)
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) ^ δ) = (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ δ := by simp
  change Polynomial.eval₂ _ ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ δ) p = 0 at h
  rw [← h2, ← Polynomial.eval₂_comp, eval₂_C_X_eq_algebraMap] at h
  rcases Polynomial.comp_eq_zero_iff.mp
      (not_not.1 fun hne ↦ RatFunc.algebraMap_ne_zero hne h) with h4 | ⟨_, h5⟩
  · exact hp h4
  · have h6 := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree h5
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow, Polynomial.natDegree_C] at h6
    omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsPoly_injective
statement: private theorem adamsPoly_injective (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : Function.Injective (adamsPoly δ)
proof:
:=
  (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun p hp ↦ not_not.1 fun hne ↦ adamsPoly_ne_zero δ hδ p hne hp

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_mul_tri
statement: theorem two_mul_tri (n : ℕ) : 2 * (tri n : ℤ) = n * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : 2 * tri n = n * (n + 1) := by
    unfold tri; exact Nat.two_mul_div_two_of_even (Nat.even_mul_succ_self n)
  exact_mod_cast this

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_mul_chooseTwo
statement: theorem two_mul_chooseTwo (n : ℕ) : 2 * (chooseTwo n : ℤ) = n * (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : 2 * chooseTwo n = n * (n - 1) := by
    unfold chooseTwo; exact Nat.two_mul_div_two_of_even (Nat.even_mul_pred_self n)
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp [chooseTwo]
  · have h' : (2 * chooseTwo (n + 1) : ℤ) = (n + 1) * n := by exact_mod_cast h
    rw [h']; push_cast; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.tri_add
statement: private theorem tri_add (r m : ℕ) : (tri (r + m) : ℤ) = tri r + r * m + tri m
proof:
:= by
  have := two_mul_tri (r + m); have := two_mul_tri r; have := two_mul_tri m
  push_cast at *; linarith

name: SurfaceBlowup.chooseTwo_add
statement:
theorem chooseTwo_add (r s : ℕ) :
    (chooseTwo (r + s) : ℤ) = chooseTwo r + chooseTwo s + r * s
proof:
:= by
  have := two_mul_chooseTwo (r + s); have := two_mul_chooseTwo r; have := two_mul_chooseTwo s
  push_cast at *; linarith

name: SurfaceBlowup.qpow_add
statement: theorem qpow_add (j k : ℤ) : qpow (j + k) = qpow j * qpow k
proof:
:= by
  simp [qpow, scalar, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, zpow_add₀ (RatFunc.X_ne_zero (K := ℚ))]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qpow_zero
statement: theorem qpow_zero : qpow 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [qpow, scalar, AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsRat_algebraMap
statement:
private theorem adamsRat_algebraMap (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (g : Polynomial ℚ) :
    adamsRat δ (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) g) = adamsPoly δ g
proof:
:= by
  unfold adamsRat; rw [dif_pos hδ]; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipRat_algebraMap
statement:
theorem recipRat_algebraMap (g : Polynomial ℚ) :
    recipRat (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) g) = recipPoly g
proof:
:= by
  simp [recipRat]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipRat_C
statement: theorem recipRat_C (r : ℚ) : recipRat (RatFunc.C r) = RatFunc.C r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RatFunc.algebraMap_C, recipRat_algebraMap]; simp [recipPoly]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsRat_X
statement: theorem adamsRat_X (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : adamsRat δ RatFunc.X = RatFunc.X ^ δ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RatFunc.algebraMap_X, adamsRat_algebraMap δ hδ]; simp [adamsPoly]

name: SurfaceBlowup.recipRat_X
statement: theorem recipRat_X : recipRat RatFunc.X = RatFunc.X⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RatFunc.algebraMap_X, recipRat_algebraMap]; simp [recipPoly]

name: SurfaceBlowup.ratFunc_ringHom_ext
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [← RatFunc.num_div_denom f, map_div₀, map_div₀, h, h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.ringHom_eval₂
statement:
private theorem ringHom_eval₂ (φ : RatFunc ℚ →+* RatFunc ℚ) (g : Polynomial ℚ) (a : RatFunc ℚ) :
    φ (g.eval₂ RatFunc.C a) = g.eval₂ RatFunc.C (φ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
  congr 1
  ext r; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsRat_recipRat
statement:
theorem adamsRat_recipRat (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (f : RatFunc ℚ) :
    adamsRat δ (recipRat f) = recipRat (adamsRat δ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine DFunLike.congr_fun (ratFunc_ringHom_ext ((adamsRat δ).comp recipRat)
    (recipRat.comp (adamsRat δ)) fun g ↦ ?_) f
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [recipRat_algebraMap, adamsRat_algebraMap δ hδ]
  change adamsRat δ (g.eval₂ RatFunc.C (RatFunc.X)⁻¹) = recipRat (g.eval₂ RatFunc.C (RatFunc.X ^ δ))
  rw [ringHom_eval₂, ringHom_eval₂, map_inv₀, map_pow, adamsRat_X δ hδ, recipRat_X, inv_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsRat_adamsRat
statement:
theorem adamsRat_adamsRat (δ k : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hk : 0 < k) (f : RatFunc ℚ) :
    adamsRat δ (adamsRat k f) = adamsRat (δ * k) f
proof:
:= by
  refine DFunLike.congr_fun (ratFunc_ringHom_ext ((adamsRat δ).comp (adamsRat k))
    (adamsRat (δ * k)) fun g ↦ ?_) f
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [adamsRat_algebraMap k hk, adamsRat_algebraMap (δ * k) (Nat.mul_pos hδ hk)]
  change adamsRat δ (g.eval₂ RatFunc.C (RatFunc.X ^ k)) = g.eval₂ RatFunc.C (RatFunc.X ^ (δ * k))
  rw [ringHom_eval₂, map_pow, adamsRat_X δ hδ, pow_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsRat_one
statement: theorem adamsRat_one (f : RatFunc ℚ) : adamsRat 1 f = f
proof:
:= by
  refine DFunLike.congr_fun (ratFunc_ringHom_ext (adamsRat 1) (RingHom.id _) fun g ↦ ?_) f
  rw [adamsRat_algebraMap 1 one_pos]
  change g.eval₂ RatFunc.C (RatFunc.X ^ 1) = _
  rw [pow_one, eval₂_C_X_eq_algebraMap]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsRat_zpow_X
statement:
theorem adamsRat_zpow_X (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (j : ℤ) :
    adamsRat δ ((RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ j) = (RatFunc.X : RatFunc ℚ) ^ ((δ : ℤ) * j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zpow₀, adamsRat_X δ hδ, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_adamsSer
statement:
theorem coeff_adamsSer (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (f : Ser) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (adamsSer k f) =
      if k ∣ n then adamsCoef k (PowerSeries.coeff (n / k) f) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adamsSer, dif_neg hk, PowerSeries.coeff_expand, PowerSeries.coeff_map]

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_adamsSer
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_adamsSer (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (f : Ser) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (adamsSer k f) = adamsCoef k (PowerSeries.constantCoeff f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_adamsSer k hk]; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsSer_one
statement: theorem adamsSer_one (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) : adamsSer k (1 : Ser) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [adamsSer, dif_neg hk]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsSer_sub
statement:
theorem adamsSer_sub (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (f g : Ser) :
    adamsSer k (f - g) = adamsSer k f - adamsSer k g
proof:
:= by
  simp [adamsSer, dif_neg hk]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adamsSer_clusterSer_sub_one_scongr
statement:
theorem adamsSer_clusterSer_sub_one_scongr (a m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    SCongr n (adamsSer m (clusterSer a) - 1)
      (∑ r : Fin n, PowerSeries.C (adamsCoef m (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (r.val + 1))))) *
        (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * (r.val + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [map_sub, coeff_adamsSer m hm.ne', map_sum]
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_one]
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · subst h0
    have : ∀ r : Fin n, ¬ (0 = m * (r.val + 1)) := fun r ↦ (Nat.mul_pos hm r.val.succ_pos).ne
    simp [this, clusterSer]
  by_cases hd : m ∣ i
  · obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hd
    have hs : 0 < s := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun e ↦ h0 (by simp [e]))
    have hsn : s ≤ n := by nlinarith
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨s - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin n)]
    · have e : s - 1 + 1 = s := by omega
      simp [h0, clusterSer, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hm, hs.ne', e]
    · intro r _ hr
      rw [if_neg]
      intro hh
      exact hr (Fin.ext (by have := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hm hh; simp; omega))
    · simp
  · rw [if_neg hd, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ ↦ if_neg fun h ↦ hd ⟨_, h⟩]
    simp [h0]

name: SurfaceBlowup.binomial_series_ode
statement:
theorem binomial_series_ode (c : RatFunc ℚ) :
    (1 + PowerSeries.X) * PowerSeries.derivative Coef (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦
      ((n.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef))) =
    PowerSeries.C (scalar c) * PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦
      ((n.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef)))
proof:
:= by
  set b : ℕ → Coef := fun n ↦
    ((n.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef)) with hb
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • b (n + 1) = (scalar c - (n : ℚ) • (1 : Coef)) * b n := by
    intro n
    simp only [hb, Finset.prod_range_succ, smul_smul, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
    rw [mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul, mul_comm _ (scalar c - _),
      mul_smul_comm]
  have hd : ∀ m : ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff m (PowerSeries.derivative Coef (PowerSeries.mk b))
      = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • b (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, mul_comm, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast; rfl
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, add_mul, one_mul, map_add]
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_X_mul, add_zero, hd, key]
    simp [hb]
  · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, hd, hd, key, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, sub_add_cancel]

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_expSer
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_expSer (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (expSer f) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff _ = 1
  rw [expSer, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hf),
    finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · simp [PowerSeries.coeff_exp]
    rfl
  · intro d hd
    have h0 : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0 := hf
    simp [h0, zero_pow hd]

name: SurfaceBlowup.derivative_expSer
statement:
theorem derivative_expSer (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    PowerSeries.derivative Coef (expSer f) = PowerSeries.derivative Coef f * expSer f
proof:
:= by
  rw [expSer, PowerSeries.derivative_subst (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hf),
    PowerSeries.derivative_exp, mul_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.expSer_zero
statement: theorem expSer_zero : expSer (0 : Ser) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [expSer, PowerSeries.subst_zero_eq_C_constantCoeff]
  ext n
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_logSer
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_logSer (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (logSer g) = 0
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.constantCoeff_logOf hg

name: SurfaceBlowup.mul_derivative_logSer
statement:
theorem mul_derivative_logSer (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    g * PowerSeries.derivative Coef (logSer g) = PowerSeries.derivative Coef g
proof:
:= by
  have hs : PowerSeries.HasSubst (g - 1) :=
    PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' (by simp [hg])
  set G : Ser := PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ algebraMap ℚ Coef ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n) with hG
  have hgeom : (1 + PowerSeries.X) * G = 1 := by
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, map_add]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [hG]; rfl
    · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul]
      simp only [hG, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_one]
      rw [← map_add, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), pow_succ]
      simp
  have hsub : g * G.subst (g - 1) = 1 := by
    have := congrArg (fun f : Ser ↦ f.subst (g - 1)) hgeom
    rw [PowerSeries.subst_mul hs, PowerSeries.subst_add hs, PowerSeries.subst_X hs] at this
    have h1 : (1 : Ser).subst (g - 1) = (1 : Ser) := by
      rw [← map_one (PowerSeries.C (R := Coef)), PowerSeries.subst_C]; rfl
    rwa [h1, add_sub_cancel] at this
  rw [logSer, PowerSeries.logOf_eq, PowerSeries.derivative_subst hs, PowerSeries.deriv_log, ← hG,
    map_sub, PowerSeries.derivative_one, sub_zero, ← mul_assoc, hsub, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_pow_eq_of_scongr
statement:
private theorem coeff_pow_eq_of_scongr (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f g : Ser)
    (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 0)
    (h : SCongr (n - 1) f g) (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 1) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (f ^ d) = PowerSeries.coeff n (g ^ d)
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with _ | _ | k
  · simp [PowerSeries.coeff_one, hn.ne']
  · exact absurd rfl hd
  have htr : PowerSeries.trunc n f = PowerSeries.trunc n g := by
    refine Polynomial.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_trunc]
    split_ifs with hm
    · exact h m (by omega)
    · rfl
  have hk : ∀ i, i ≤ n - 1 →
      PowerSeries.coeff i (f ^ (k + 1)) = PowerSeries.coeff i (g ^ (k + 1)) := by
    intro i hi
    have e : PowerSeries.trunc n (f ^ (k + 1)) = PowerSeries.trunc n (g ^ (k + 1)) := by
      rw [← PowerSeries.trunc_trunc_pow, htr, PowerSeries.trunc_trunc_pow]
    simpa only [PowerSeries.coeff_trunc, if_pos (show i < n by omega)] using
      congrArg (fun p ↦ Polynomial.coeff p i) e
  rw [pow_succ f, pow_succ g, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  by_cases hj : p.2 = 0
  · simp [hj, hf, hg]
  by_cases hi : p.1 = 0
  · simp [hi, hf, hg]
  rw [hk p.1 (by omega), h p.2 (by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_subst_eq_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_subst_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (P f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (P.subst f) =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), PowerSeries.coeff d P • PowerSeries.coeff n (f ^ d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_subst' (PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hf)]
  refine finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun d hd ↦ ?_
  simp only [Function.mem_support, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at hd ⊢
  by_contra hc
  refine hd ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff.1 (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd (PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.2 hf) d) n
    (by omega), smul_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_subst_sub
statement:
private theorem coeff_subst_sub (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (P f g : Ser)
    (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 0)
    (h : SCongr (n - 1) f g) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (P.subst f) - PowerSeries.coeff n (P.subst g) =
      PowerSeries.coeff 1 P • (PowerSeries.coeff n f - PowerSeries.coeff n g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_subst_eq_sum n P f hf, coeff_subst_eq_sum n P g hg, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_eq_single 1]
  · rw [pow_one, pow_one, smul_sub]
  · intro d _ hd
    rw [coeff_pow_eq_of_scongr n hn f g hf hg h d hd, sub_self]
  · intro h1; simp at h1; omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_expSer_sub_of_scongr
statement:
theorem coeff_expSer_sub_of_scongr (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f g : Ser)
    (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 0)
    (h : SCongr (n - 1) f g) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (expSer f) - PowerSeries.coeff n (expSer g) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n f - PowerSeries.coeff n g
proof:
:= by
  rw [expSer, expSer, coeff_subst_sub n hn _ f g hf hg h, PowerSeries.coeff_exp]
  simp only [Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one, div_one, map_one, one_smul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_logSer_sub_of_scongr
statement:
theorem coeff_logSer_sub_of_scongr (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (u v : Ser)
    (hu : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u = 1) (hv : PowerSeries.constantCoeff v = 1)
    (huv : SCongr (n - 1) u v) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (logSer u) - PowerSeries.coeff n (logSer v) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n u - PowerSeries.coeff n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [logSer, logSer, PowerSeries.logOf_eq, PowerSeries.logOf_eq,
    coeff_subst_sub n hn _ _ _ (by simp [hu]) (by simp [hv]) (fun m hm ↦ by simp [huv m hm]),
    PowerSeries.coeff_one_log, one_smul]
  simp [PowerSeries.coeff_one, hn.ne']

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_allowedPatterns_reindex
statement:
theorem sum_allowedPatterns_reindex (s : State) (D : ℕ) (hD : D ≤ s.degree)
    (Q : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [∀ d rt rx, Decidable (Q d rt rx)]
    (hmem : ∀ P, P ∈ allowedPatterns s ↔ 0 < P.d.val ∧
      P.rt.val + P.rx.val + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val ∧ P.d.val ≤ D ∧
      Q P.d.val P.rt.val P.rx.val)
    (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Pattern s.degree → Coef) :
    ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns s, F P.d.val P.rt.val P.rx.val P.other =
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 D, ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
      (if Q d rt rx ∧ rt + rx ≤ d then
        ∑ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern s.degree)).filter
          (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = d - rt - rx), F d rt rx m
      else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := fun P ↦ P.d.val) (t := Finset.Icc 1 D)
    fun P hP ↦ by
      obtain ⟨h1, -, h3, -⟩ := (hmem P).1 hP
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_product', ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := fun P ↦ (P.rt.val, P.rx.val))
    (t := Finset.range (d + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (d + 1)) fun P hP ↦ by
      obtain ⟨hP', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hP
      obtain ⟨-, h2, -⟩ := (hmem P).1 hP'
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]; omega]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ⟨rt, rx⟩ hr ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range] at hd hr
  simp only [Finset.filter_filter, Prod.mk.injEq]
  split_ifs with hcond
  · refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun P _ ↦ P.other)
      (fun m _ ↦ ⟨⟨d, by omega⟩, ⟨rt, by omega⟩, ⟨rx, by omega⟩, m⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro P hP
      obtain ⟨hP', rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hP
      obtain ⟨-, h2, -⟩ := (hmem P).1 hP'
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]; omega
    · intro m hm
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hm
      exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨(hmem _).2 ⟨by dsimp only; omega, by dsimp only; omega,
        by dsimp only; omega, hcond.1⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨d', rt', rx', o⟩ hP
      obtain ⟨-, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hP
      rfl
    · exact fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    · intro P hP
      obtain ⟨-, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hP
      rfl
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun P hP ↦ (hcond ?_).elim
    obtain ⟨hP', rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hP
    obtain ⟨-, h2, -, h4⟩ := (hmem P).1 hP'
    exact ⟨h4, by omega⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_allowedPatterns_crossing
statement:
theorem sum_allowedPatterns_crossing (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hh : 0 < h) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Pattern (State.crossing a b c h).degree → Coef) :
    ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns (State.crossing a b c h), F P.d.val P.rt.val P.rx.val P.other =
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min c h), ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
      (if ((0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ rt + rx ≤ d) then
        ∑ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern (State.crossing a b c h).degree)).filter
          (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = d - rt - rx), F d rt rx m
      else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : min c h ≤ (State.crossing a b c h).degree := by
    change min c h ≤ a * c + b * h
    have := min_le_left c h
    nlinarith
  rw [sum_allowedPatterns_reindex _ _ hD (fun d rt rx ↦ (0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h))
    (fun P ↦ by simp [allowedPatterns, Allowed, and_assoc])]
  simp only [and_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.X_sub_one_ne_zero
statement: private theorem X_sub_one_ne_zero : (RatFunc.X - 1 : RatFunc ℚ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using RatFunc.algebraMap_ne_zero (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (1 : ℚ))

name: SurfaceBlowup.X_sub_one_mul_crossingWeight
statement:
theorem X_sub_one_mul_crossingWeight (j : ℕ) :
    (RatFunc.X - 1) * (if j = 0 then (RatFunc.X - 1 : RatFunc ℚ)⁻¹ else (RatFunc.X - 1) ^ (j - 1))
      = (RatFunc.X - 1) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  rcases j with _ | k
  · simp [X_sub_one_ne_zero]
  · simp [pow_succ, mul_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pattern_entry_mul_le
statement:
private theorem pattern_entry_mul_le (N : ℕ) (m : Pattern N) (ij : Fin N × Fin N) :
    (ij.1.val + 1) * (ij.2.val + 1) * (m ij).val ≤ patternWeight m
proof:
:=
  Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun ij : Fin N × Fin N ↦ (ij.1.val+1)*(ij.2.val+1)*(m ij).val)
    (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ ij)

name: SurfaceBlowup.pattern_entry_le_patternWeight
statement:
theorem pattern_entry_le_patternWeight (N : ℕ) (m : Pattern N) (ij : Fin N × Fin N) :
    (m ij).val ≤ patternWeight m
proof:
:=
  le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)) (pattern_entry_mul_le N m ij)

name: SurfaceBlowup.pattern_entry_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem pattern_entry_eq_zero_of_lt (N : ℕ) (m : Pattern N) (ij : Fin N × Fin N)
    (h : patternWeight m < (ij.1.val + 1) * (ij.2.val + 1)) : (m ij).val = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := pattern_entry_mul_le N m ij
  by_contra hne
  have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right ((ij.1.val + 1) * (ij.2.val + 1)) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne)
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_C_mul_X_pow_pow
statement:
theorem sum_C_mul_X_pow_pow (m n k : ℕ) (b : ℕ → Coef) :
    (∑ r : Fin n, PowerSeries.C (b (r.val + 1)) * (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * (r.val + 1))) ^ k =
    ∑ κ ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) k,
      PowerSeries.C ((Nat.multinomial Finset.univ κ : Coef) * ∏ r : Fin n, b (r.val + 1) ^ κ r) *
        (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) * κ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun κ _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun r _ ↦ mul_pow _ _ _), Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  have h2 : ∏ r : Fin n, ((PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * (r.val + 1))) ^ κ r
      = (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) * κ r) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ by rw [← pow_mul, mul_assoc]
  rw [h2]
  simp only [map_mul, map_natCast, map_prod, map_pow]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.QCongr.qact_scongr
statement:
theorem QCongr.qact_scongr {n : ℕ} {U V : QSer} (hUV : QCongr n U V) (f : Ser) :
    SCongr n (qact U f) (qact V f)
proof:
:= fun m hm ↦ by
  simp only [qact, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp hr
  rw [hUV r.1 r.2 (by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_qact_gaussPhi
statement:
theorem coeff_qact_gaussPhi (U : QSer) (f : Ser) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (qact U (gaussPhi f)) = ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        qpow (-(tri d : ℤ)) * (U r (n - d) * PowerSeries.coeff (d - r) f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qact, gaussPhi, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  have key : ∀ i r : ℕ, qpow (-(tri r : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) * ((n - i : ℕ) : ℤ)) *
      (U r (i - r) * (qpow (-(tri (n - i) : ℤ)) * PowerSeries.coeff (n - i) f)) =
      qpow (-(tri (r + (n - i)) : ℤ)) * (U r (i - r) * PowerSeries.coeff (n - i) f) := by
    intro i r
    rw [tri_add, mul_left_comm (U r (i - r)), ← mul_assoc, ← qpow_add]
    congr 2; ring
  simp only [key]
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun x _ ↦ ⟨x.2 + (n - x.1), x.2⟩) (fun x _ ↦ ⟨n - (x.1 - x.2), x.2⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  all_goals rintro ⟨i, r⟩ h; simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at h
  · simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range]; omega
  · simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range]; omega
  · simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, and_true]; omega
  · simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, and_true]; omega
  · dsimp only
    rw [show n - (r + (n - i)) = i - r by omega, show r + (n - i) - r = n - i by omega]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_qact_gaussPhi_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_qact_gaussPhi_of_lt (U : QSer) (hU0 : U 0 0 = 1) (f : Ser) (n : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ m : ℕ, m < n → PowerSeries.coeff m f = 0) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (qact U (gaussPhi f)) = qpow (-(tri n : ℤ)) * PowerSeries.coeff n f
proof:
:= by
  rw [qact, gaussPhi, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Finset.sum_eq_single (0, n)]
  · simp [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, show tri 0 = 0 from rfl, hU0, qpow_zero]
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hp hne
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have : b < n := by
      by_contra h
      exact hne (Prod.ext (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega))
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ ↦ by simp [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, hf _ this]
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.qact_qmul
statement: theorem qact_qmul (U V : QSer) (f : Ser) : qact (qmul U V) f = qact U (qact V f)
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  simp only [qact, qmul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun x ↦ ⟨(x.2.2.1.1 + x.2.2.2.1, x.2.2.1.2 + x.2.2.2.2 + x.1.2), (x.2.2.1.1, x.2.2.2.1),
      (x.2.2.1.2 + x.2.2.2.2, x.1.2), (x.2.2.1.2, x.2.2.2.2)⟩)
    (fun y ↦ ⟨(y.2.1.1 + y.2.1.2 + y.2.2.2.1 + y.2.2.2.2, y.2.2.1.2),
      (y.2.1.1 + y.2.2.2.1, y.2.1.2 + y.2.2.2.2), (y.2.1.1, y.2.2.2.1), (y.2.1.2, y.2.2.2.2)⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  all_goals rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨c, d⟩, ⟨e, g⟩, ⟨h, k⟩⟩ hx
  all_goals simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal,
    Sigma.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, and_true, true_and] at hx ⊢
  · omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · obtain ⟨h1, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
    have key : qpow (-((tri (e + g) : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((e + g : ℕ) : ℤ) * (b : ℤ)) *
        qpow (-((e : ℤ) * (k : ℤ))) = qpow (-(tri e : ℤ) - (e : ℤ) * ((g + k + b : ℕ) : ℤ)) *
          qpow (-(tri g : ℤ) - (g : ℤ) * (b : ℤ)) := by
      rw [← qpow_add, ← qpow_add, tri_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    linear_combination (U e h * V g k * PowerSeries.coeff b f) * key

name: SurfaceBlowup.qact_qone
statement: theorem qact_qone (f : Ser) : qact qone f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [qact, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, n)]
  · simp [qone, tri, qpow_zero]
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hp hne
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hne (Prod.ext h (by simp at hp ⊢; omega))
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r hr ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
    have : ¬ (r.1 = 0 ∧ r.2 = 0) := by omega
    simp [qone, this]
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.qact_sub
statement: theorem qact_sub (U : QSer) (f g : Ser) : qact U (f - g) = qact U f - qact U g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [qact, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: SurfaceBlowup.QCongr.mono
statement: theorem QCongr.mono {i j : ℕ} {U V : QSer} (h : QCongr j U V) (hij : i ≤ j) : QCongr i U V
proof:
:=
  fun c k hck ↦ h c k (hck.trans hij)

name: SurfaceBlowup.QCongr.trans
statement:
theorem QCongr.trans {j : ℕ} {U V W : QSer} (h : QCongr j U V) (h' : QCongr j V W) :
    QCongr j U W
proof:
:=
  fun c k hck ↦ (h c k hck).trans (h' c k hck)

name: SurfaceBlowup.QCongr.qmul
statement:
theorem QCongr.qmul {j : ℕ} {U U' V V' : QSer} (hU : QCongr j U U') (hV : QCongr j V V') :
    QCongr j (qmul U V) (qmul U' V')
proof:
:= fun c h hch ↦ by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp hr
  rw [hU p.1 r.1 (by omega), hV p.2 r.2 (by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.qdiag
statement:
theorem SCongr.qdiag {M : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr M f g) :
    QCongr (2 * M + 1) (qdiag f) (qdiag g)
proof:
:= by
  intro c k hck
  unfold SurfaceBlowup.qdiag
  split_ifs with e
  · subst e; rw [h c (by omega)]
  · rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.antidiagonal_shift_sum
statement:
private theorem antidiagonal_shift_sum {c k : ℕ} {p : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal c) (G : ℕ × ℕ → Coef) (hck : c ≤ k) :
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal k,
      (if p.1 ≤ r.1 ∧ p.2 ≤ r.2 then G (r.1 - p.1, r.2 - p.2) else 0) =
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (k - c), G r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun r ↦ (r.1 - p.1, r.2 - p.2)) (fun s ↦ (s.1 + p.1, s.2 + p.2))
  all_goals intro r hr
  all_goals simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr ⊢
  · omega
  · omega
  · ext <;> simp <;> omega
  · ext <;> simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.antidiagonal_shift_sum_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem antidiagonal_shift_sum_eq_zero {c k : ℕ} {p : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal c) (G : ℕ × ℕ → Coef) (hkc : k < c) :
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal k,
      (if p.1 ≤ r.1 ∧ p.2 ≤ r.2 then G (r.1 - p.1, r.2 - p.2) else 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r hr ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
  rw [if_neg]
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.qplus_qmul
statement: theorem qplus_qmul (U V : QSer) : qplus (qmul U V) = qmul (qplus U) (qplus V)
proof:
:= by
  funext c k
  simp only [qplus, qmul]
  set G : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ → Coef := fun p s ↦ qpow (-((p.1 : ℤ) * ((s.2 + p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ))) *
    ((qpow (-(chooseTwo p.1 : ℤ)) * U p.1 s.1) * (qpow (-(chooseTwo p.2 : ℤ)) * V p.2 s.2)) with hG
  have key : ∀ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal c,
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal k, qpow (-((p.1 : ℤ) * (r.2 : ℤ))) *
        ((if p.1 ≤ r.1 then qpow (-(chooseTwo p.1 : ℤ)) * U p.1 (r.1 - p.1) else 0) *
         (if p.2 ≤ r.2 then qpow (-(chooseTwo p.2 : ℤ)) * V p.2 (r.2 - p.2) else 0))) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal k,
        (if p.1 ≤ r.1 ∧ p.2 ≤ r.2 then G p (r.1 - p.1, r.2 - p.2) else 0) := by
    intro p _
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
    by_cases h1 : p.1 ≤ r.1 <;> by_cases h2 : p.2 ≤ r.2 <;> simp [hG, h1, h2]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl key]
  split_ifs with hck
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [antidiagonal_shift_sum hp (G p) hck, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    subst hp
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
    have e2 : qpow (-(((chooseTwo (p.1 + p.2) : ℕ) : ℤ))) * qpow (-((p.1 : ℤ) * (s.2 : ℤ))) =
        qpow (-((p.1 : ℤ) * ((s.2 + p.2 : ℕ) : ℤ))) *
          (qpow (-(chooseTwo p.1 : ℤ)) * qpow (-(chooseTwo p.2 : ℤ))) := by
      rw [← qpow_add, ← qpow_add, ← qpow_add, chooseTwo_add]
      push_cast; ring_nf
    calc _ = (qpow (-(((chooseTwo (p.1 + p.2) : ℕ) : ℤ))) * qpow (-((p.1 : ℤ) * (s.2 : ℤ)))) *
          (U p.1 s.1 * V p.2 s.2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [e2, hG]; ring
  · exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ antidiagonal_shift_sum_eq_zero hp (G p) (by omega)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.qminus_eq_transpose
statement:
private theorem qminus_eq_transpose (U : QSer) :
    qminus U = qtranspose (qplus (qtranspose U))
proof: := rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.qtranspose_qmul
statement:
private theorem qtranspose_qmul (U V : QSer) :
    qtranspose (qmul U V) = qmul (qtranspose V) (qtranspose U)
proof:
:= by
  funext c h
  simp only [qtranspose, qmul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap]
  rw [mul_comm (U _ _), mul_comm (r.1 : ℤ)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qminus_qmul
statement: theorem qminus_qmul (U V : QSer) : qminus (qmul U V) = qmul (qminus U) (qminus V)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qminus_eq_transpose, qtranspose_qmul, qplus_qmul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qone_qmul
statement: theorem qone_qmul (U : QSer) : qmul qone U = U
proof:
:= by
  funext c h
  simp only [qmul, qone]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, c), Finset.sum_eq_single (0, h)]
  · simp [qpow_zero]
  · intro r hr hne
    have : r.1 ≠ 0 := fun h2 ↦ hne (Prod.ext h2
      (by have := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.1 hr; simp_all))
    simp [this]
  · simp
  · intro p hp hne
    have : p.1 ≠ 0 := fun h2 ↦ hne (Prod.ext h2
      (by have := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.1 hp; simp_all))
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ ↦ by simp [this]
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.qmul_eq_sum_range
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qmul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_range_eq_sum_range_ite
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_filter]
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_eq_sum (A Cq : QSer) (D : Ser) (c h : ℕ) :
    qmul (qmul (qplus A) (qdiag D)) (qminus Cq) c h =
      ∑ x ∈ (Finset.range (c + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (h + 1)) ×ˢ
        (Finset.range (c + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (h + 1)),
        qtripleTerm A Cq D c h x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [qmul_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb ↦ ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at ha hb
  rw [Finset.sum_product, qmul_eq_sum_range, sum_range_eq_sum_range_ite _ a c (by omega),
    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ ↦ ?_
  split_ifs with h1
  · rw [sum_range_eq_sum_range_ite _ b h (by omega), Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b' _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [qtripleTerm]
    split_ifs with h2 h3 <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | simp
  · simp [qtripleTerm, h1]

name: SurfaceBlowup.qtripleTerm_eq
statement:
private theorem qtripleTerm_eq (A Cq : QSer) (D : Ser) {c h rx m rt : ℕ}
    (hc1 : rx + m + rt ≤ c) (hc2 : rx + m + rt ≤ h) :
    qtripleTerm A Cq D c h (rx + m) (h - rt) rx (h - rt - m) =
      qpow (-(chooseTwo rx : ℤ) - (chooseTwo m : ℤ) - (chooseTwo rt : ℤ) - (rx : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) -
          ((rx : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) * (rt : ℤ)) *
        (A rx (h - (rx + m + rt)) * (PowerSeries.coeff m D * Cq (c - (rx + m + rt)) rt))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [qtripleTerm, qplus, qdiag, qminus]
  rw [if_pos (by omega : rx ≤ rx + m ∧ h - rt - m ≤ h - rt),
    show rx + m - rx = m by omega, show h - rt - (h - rt - m) = m by omega,
    show h - (h - rt) = rt by omega, if_pos (show rx ≤ h - rt - m by omega), if_pos rfl,
    if_pos (show rt ≤ c - (rx + m) by omega), show h - rt - m - rx = h - (rx + m + rt) by omega,
    show c - (rx + m) - rt = c - (rx + m + rt) by omega]
  have hq : qpow (-(chooseTwo rx : ℤ) - (chooseTwo m : ℤ) - (chooseTwo rt : ℤ) -
      (rx : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) - ((rx : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) * (rt : ℤ)) =
      qpow (-(((rx + m : ℕ) : ℤ) * (rt : ℤ))) * qpow (-((rx : ℤ) * (m : ℤ))) *
        qpow (-(chooseTwo rx : ℤ)) * qpow (-(chooseTwo m : ℤ)) * qpow (-(chooseTwo rt : ℤ)) := by
    rw [← qpow_add, ← qpow_add, ← qpow_add, ← qpow_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hq]; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_apply
statement:
theorem qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_apply (A Cq : QSer) (D : Ser) (c h : ℕ) :
    qmul (qmul (qplus A) (qdiag D)) (qminus Cq) c h =
      ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (c + 1),
        (if (rx + m + rt ≤ c ∧ rx + m + rt ≤ h) then
          qpow (-(chooseTwo rx : ℤ) - (chooseTwo m : ℤ) - (chooseTwo rt : ℤ) - (rx : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) -
            ((rx : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) * (rt : ℤ)) *
            (A rx (h - (rx + m + rt)) * (PowerSeries.coeff m D * Cq (c - (rx + m + rt)) rt))
        else 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set G := qtripleTerm A Cq D c h with hG
  set T : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Coef := fun rx m rt ↦
    (if (rx + m + rt ≤ c ∧ rx + m + rt ≤ h) then
      qpow (-(chooseTwo rx : ℤ) - (chooseTwo m : ℤ) - (chooseTwo rt : ℤ) - (rx : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) -
        ((rx : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) * (rt : ℤ)) *
        (A rx (h - (rx + m + rt)) * (PowerSeries.coeff m D * Cq (c - (rx + m + rt)) rt))
    else 0) with hT
  have hval : ∀ rx m rt : ℕ, rx + m + rt ≤ c → rx + m + rt ≤ h →
      T rx m rt = G (rx + m) (h - rt) rx (h - rt - m) := fun rx m rt hc1 hc2 ↦ by
    rw [hT, hG, qtripleTerm_eq A Cq D hc1 hc2]; exact if_pos ⟨hc1, hc2⟩
  have hT0 : ∀ x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ, T x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2 ≠ 0 →
      x.1 + x.2.1 + x.2.2 ≤ c ∧ x.1 + x.2.1 + x.2.2 ≤ h := fun x hne ↦ by
    by_contra hc; exact hne (by simp only [hT]; rw [if_neg hc])
  have hR : ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (c + 1),
      T rx m rt = ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (c + 1) ×ˢ (Finset.range (c + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (c + 1)),
        T x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_product]
  rw [qmul_qplus_qdiag_qminus_eq_sum, ← hG, hR]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero
    (fun x _ _ ↦ ((x.1 + x.2.1, h - x.2.2), (x.1, h - x.2.2 - x.2.1))) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx hne
    have := hT0 x hne
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨x1, x2, x3⟩ _ hx ⟨y1, y2, y3⟩ _ hy hxy
    have := hT0 _ hx
    have := hT0 _ hy
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at *
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨a', b'⟩⟩ hmem hne
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range] at hmem
    have key : a' ≤ a ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ a - a' = b - b' ∧ h - b ≤ c - a := by
      by_contra hc
      apply hne
      simp only [hG, qtripleTerm, qplus, qdiag, qminus]
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | simp
    refine ⟨(a', a - a', h - b), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
      omega
    · dsimp only
      rw [hval _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega), show a' + (a - a') = a by omega,
        show h - (h - b) = b by omega, show b - (a - a') = b' by omega]
      exact hne
    · dsimp only
      rw [show a' + (a - a') = a by omega, show h - (h - b) = b by omega,
        show b - (a - a') = b' by omega]
  · intro x _ hx
    exact hval _ _ _ (hT0 x hx).1 (hT0 x hx).2

name: SurfaceBlowup.qcongr_qplus_qone
statement:
theorem qcongr_qplus_qone (j : ℕ) (U : QSer) (hU : QPositive U) (h : QCongr (j - 1) U qone) :
    QCongr j (qplus U) qone
proof:
:= by
  intro c k hck
  simp only [qplus, qone]
  split_ifs with hc h1 h1
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h1
    simpa [chooseTwo, qpow_zero, qone] using h 0 0 (by omega)
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with rfl | c0
    · rw [Nat.sub_zero, hU 0 k (Or.inl rfl) (by omega), mul_zero]
    · rw [h c (k - c) (by omega), qone, if_neg (by omega), mul_zero]
  · omega
  · rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.qtranspose_qcongr_qone
statement:
private theorem qtranspose_qcongr_qone {j : ℕ} {U : QSer} (h : QCongr j U qone) :
    QCongr j (qtranspose U) qone
proof:
:= fun c k hck ↦ by
  simpa [qtranspose, qone, and_comm] using h k c (by omega)

name: SurfaceBlowup.qcongr_qminus_qone
statement:
theorem qcongr_qminus_qone (j : ℕ) (U : QSer) (hU : QPositive U) (h : QCongr (j - 1) U qone) :
    QCongr j (qminus U) qone
proof:
:= by
  rw [qminus_eq_transpose]
  exact qtranspose_qcongr_qone (qcongr_qplus_qone j _
    (fun c k h1 h2 ↦ hU k c h1.symm (by tauto)) (qtranspose_qcongr_qone h))

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.plethSum
statement:
theorem SCongr.plethSum {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) :
    SCongr n (SurfaceBlowup.plethSum f) (SurfaceBlowup.plethSum g)
proof:
:= fun m hm ↦ by
  simp only [SurfaceBlowup.plethSum, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
    fun k ↦ h (m / k) ((Nat.div_le_self m k).trans hm)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.SCongr.moebiusSum
statement:
theorem SCongr.moebiusSum {n : ℕ} {f g : Ser} (h : SCongr n f g) :
    SCongr n (SurfaceBlowup.moebiusSum f) (SurfaceBlowup.moebiusSum g)
proof:
:= fun m hm ↦ by
  simp only [SurfaceBlowup.moebiusSum, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
    fun k ↦ h (m / k) ((Nat.div_le_self m k).trans hm)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisorSum_sub_of_scongr
statement:
private theorem divisorSum_sub_of_scongr (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f g : Ser)
    (h : SCongr (n - 1) f g) (w : ℕ → ℚ) (hw : w 1 = 1) :
    (∑ k ∈ n.divisors, w k • adamsCoef k (PowerSeries.coeff (n / k) f)) -
      (∑ k ∈ n.divisors, w k • adamsCoef k (PowerSeries.coeff (n / k) g)) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n f - PowerSeries.coeff n g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_eq_single 1]
  · rw [Nat.div_one, hw, one_smul, one_smul, adamsCoef_one, adamsCoef_one]
  · intro k hk hk1
    have := Nat.div_lt_self hn (by have := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hk; omega : 1 < k)
    rw [h _ (by omega), sub_self]
  · exact fun h1 ↦ absurd (Nat.one_mem_divisors.2 hn.ne') h1

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_plethSum_sub_of_scongr
statement:
private theorem coeff_plethSum_sub_of_scongr (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f g : Ser)
    (h : SCongr (n - 1) f g) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (plethSum f) - PowerSeries.coeff n (plethSum g) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n f - PowerSeries.coeff n g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [plethSum, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact divisorSum_sub_of_scongr n hn f g h (fun k ↦ ((k : ℚ)⁻¹)) (by simp)

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_moebiusSum_sub_of_scongr
statement:
private theorem coeff_moebiusSum_sub_of_scongr (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f g : Ser)
    (h : SCongr (n - 1) f g) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (moebiusSum f) - PowerSeries.coeff n (moebiusSum g) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n f - PowerSeries.coeff n g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [moebiusSum, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact divisorSum_sub_of_scongr n hn f g h
    (fun k ↦ (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius k : ℤ) : ℚ)) / (k : ℚ)) (by simp)

name: SurfaceBlowup.eq_of_mul_derivative_eq_mul
statement:
theorem eq_of_mul_derivative_eq_mul (g w E F : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1)
    (hE : g * PowerSeries.derivative Coef E = w * E)
    (hF : g * PowerSeries.derivative Coef F = w * F)
    (h0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff E = PowerSeries.constantCoeff F) :
    E = F
proof:
:= by
  have := IsAddTorsionFree.of_module_rat (M := Coef)
  set D : Ser := E - F with hDdef
  have hD : g * PowerSeries.derivative Coef D = w * D := by
    simp only [hDdef, map_sub, mul_sub, hE, hF]
  have key : ∀ n, ∀ m ≤ n, PowerSeries.coeff m D = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro m hm
      rw [Nat.le_zero.mp hm, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hDdef, map_sub, h0,
        sub_self]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro m hm
      rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hm with hm | rfl
      · exact ih m (by omega)
      have hc := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) hD
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul] at hc
      have hR : ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n,
          PowerSeries.coeff p.1 w * PowerSeries.coeff p.2 D = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ by
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
          rw [ih p.2 (by omega), mul_zero]
      have hmem : ((0 : ℕ), n) ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n := by simp
      rw [hR, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hmem] at hc
      have hL : ∑ p ∈ (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n).erase (0, n),
          PowerSeries.coeff p.1 g * PowerSeries.coeff p.2 (PowerSeries.derivative Coef D) = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ by
          rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
          have : p.1 ≠ 0 := fun h0' ↦ hp.1 (by ext <;> simp <;> omega)
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, ih (p.2 + 1) (by omega), zero_mul, mul_zero]
      rw [hL, add_zero, PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
        hg, one_mul] at hc
      refine nsmul_right_injective (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) (?_ : (n + 1) • _ = (n + 1) • (0 : Coef))
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul, smul_zero, mul_comm]
      push_cast
      exact hc
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (show D = 0 from PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ by simpa using key n n le_rfl)

name: SurfaceBlowup.expSer_add
statement:
theorem expSer_add (f g : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 0) :
    expSer (f + g) = expSer f * expSer g
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (f + g) = 0 := by rw [map_add, hf, hg, add_zero]
  apply eq_of_mul_derivative_eq_mul 1 (PowerSeries.derivative Coef (f + g)) _ _
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff_one
  · rw [one_mul, derivative_expSer _ hfg]
  · rw [one_mul, Derivation.leibniz, derivative_expSer f hf, derivative_expSer g hg, map_add]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · rw [constantCoeff_expSer _ hfg, map_mul, constantCoeff_expSer f hf, constantCoeff_expSer g hg,
      mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.expSer_logSer
statement: theorem expSer_logSer (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) : expSer (logSer g) = g
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 := constantCoeff_logSer g hg
  apply eq_of_mul_derivative_eq_mul g (PowerSeries.derivative Coef g) _ _ hg
  · rw [derivative_expSer _ hL0, ← mul_assoc, mul_derivative_logSer g hg]
  · exact mul_comm _ _
  · rw [constantCoeff_expSer _ hL0, hg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.logSer_expSer
statement: theorem logSer_expSer (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) : logSer (expSer f) = f
proof:
:= by
  have hE0 := constantCoeff_expSer f hf
  have hu : IsUnit (expSer f) := by
    rw [PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, hE0]; exact isUnit_one
  have hd : PowerSeries.derivative Coef (logSer (expSer f)) = PowerSeries.derivative Coef f :=
    hu.mul_left_cancel (by rw [mul_derivative_logSer _ hE0, derivative_expSer f hf, mul_comm])
  have := IsAddTorsionFree.of_module_rat (M := Coef)
  exact PowerSeries.derivative.ext hd (by rw [constantCoeff_logSer _ hE0, hf])

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_formalPow
proof:
:=
  constantCoeff_expSer _ (by rw [map_mul, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C, constantCoeff_logSer g hg,
    mul_zero])

name: SurfaceBlowup.mul_derivative_formalPow
statement:
private theorem mul_derivative_formalPow (c : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    g * PowerSeries.derivative Coef (formalPow c g) =
      PowerSeries.C (scalar c) * PowerSeries.derivative Coef g * formalPow c g
proof:
:= by
  have hl : PowerSeries.derivative Coef (PowerSeries.C (scalar c) * logSer g) =
      PowerSeries.C (scalar c) * PowerSeries.derivative Coef (logSer g) := by
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, PowerSeries.derivative_C]; simp
  rw [formalPow, derivative_expSer _ (by rw [map_mul, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C,
    constantCoeff_logSer g hg, mul_zero]), hl, ← mul_derivative_logSer g hg]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_formalPow
statement:
theorem coeff_formalPow (c : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (formalPow c g) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) •
      ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef))) *
        PowerSeries.coeff n ((g - 1) ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  set B : Ser := PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦
    ((n.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef)) with hB
  set y : Ser := g - 1 with hy_def
  have hy0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff y = 0 := by simp [y, hg]
  have hy : PowerSeries.HasSubst y := PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hy0
  have hODE := binomial_series_ode c
  rw [← hB] at hODE
  have hEq : B.subst y = formalPow c g := by
    refine eq_of_mul_derivative_eq_mul g (PowerSeries.C (scalar c) * PowerSeries.derivative Coef g)
      _ _ hg ?_ (mul_derivative_formalPow c g hg) ?_
    · have hs := congrArg (fun f : Ser ↦ f.subst y) hODE
      rw [PowerSeries.subst_mul hy, PowerSeries.subst_mul hy, PowerSeries.subst_add hy,
        PowerSeries.subst_X hy] at hs
      have hone : (1 : Ser).subst y = 1 := by
        simpa using (PowerSeries.subst_C (a := y) (1 : Coef))
      have hC : (PowerSeries.C (scalar c)).subst y = PowerSeries.C (scalar c) :=
        PowerSeries.subst_C _
      rw [hone, hC, show (1 : Ser) + y = g by simp [y]] at hs
      rw [PowerSeries.derivative_subst hy, show PowerSeries.derivative Coef y =
        PowerSeries.derivative Coef g by simp [y], ← mul_assoc, hs]
      ring
    · rw [constantCoeff_formalPow c g hg, ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
        coeff_subst_eq_sum 0 B y hy0]
      simp [B]
  rw [← hEq, coeff_subst_eq_sum n B y hy0]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [B, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, y]
  rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.inv_factorial_mul_multinomial
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := Nat.multinomial_spec Finset.univ κ
  rw [hk] at hspec
  have hpos : (∏ r : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (κ r) : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun r _ ↦ by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
  have hk0 : ((k.factorial : ℚ)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero _
  rw [← hspec] at hk0 ⊢
  push_cast at hk0 ⊢
  have hmn : (Nat.multinomial Finset.univ κ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hk0
  field_simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_range_sum_piAntidiag_eq_sum_fin
statement:
private theorem sum_range_sum_piAntidiag_eq_sum_fin {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (Fin n → ℕ) → M) (hF : ∀ κ, n < ∑ r, κ r → F κ = 0) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ κ ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) k, F κ =
      ∑ κ : Fin n → Fin (n + 1), F (fun r ↦ (κ r).val)
proof:
:= by
  set E : Finset (Fin n → ℕ) := Fintype.piFinset (fun _ ↦ Finset.range (n + 1)) with hE
  set D : Finset (Fin n → ℕ) := E.filter (fun κ ↦ ∑ r, κ r ≤ n) with hD
  
  have h3 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ κ ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) k,
      F κ = ∑ κ ∈ D, F κ := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := D) (t := Finset.range (n + 1))
        (g := fun κ ↦ ∑ r, κ r)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk ↦ ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      congr 1
      ext κ
      simp only [hD, hE, Finset.mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_range,
          Finset.mem_piAntidiag, Finset.mem_univ, implies_true, and_true]
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h' : ∑ r, κ r = k := h
        refine ⟨⟨fun r ↦ ?_, by omega⟩, h⟩
        have : κ r ≤ ∑ r, κ r :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := κ) (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ r)
        omega
      · rintro ⟨_, h⟩; exact h
    · intro κ hκ
      simp only [hD, Finset.mem_filter] at hκ
      simp only [Finset.mem_range]; omega
  
  have h4 : ∑ κ ∈ D, F κ = ∑ κ ∈ E, F κ :=
    Finset.sum_filter_of_ne fun κ _ hne ↦ by_contra fun h ↦ hne (hF κ (by omega))
  
  rw [h3, h4]
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun κ r ↦ ⟨κ r % (n + 1), Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos _)⟩)
      (fun κ r ↦ (κ r).val) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro _ _; exact Finset.mem_univ _
  · intro κ _
    simp only [hE, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_range]
    exact fun r ↦ (κ r).isLt
  · intro κ hκ
    simp only [hE, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_range] at hκ
    funext r; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hκ r)
  · intro κ _
    funext r; exact Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (κ r).isLt)
  · intro κ hκ
    simp only [hE, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_range] at hκ
    have : (fun r ↦ κ r % (n + 1)) = κ := funext fun r ↦ Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hκ r)
    simp only [this]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr
statement:
private theorem formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr (ε : ℤ) (a m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    SCongr n (formalPow (availablePoints ε m).rational (adamsSer m (clusterSer a)))
        (∑ κ : Fin n → Fin (n + 1), PowerSeries.C (scalar
        ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range (∑ r : Fin n, (κ r).val), ((availablePoints ε m).rational - RatFunc.C
        (j : ℚ))) * RatFunc.C ((∏ r : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (κ r).val : ℕ) : ℚ))⁻¹))) *
        (PowerSeries.C (∏ r : Fin n, (adamsCoef m (lawCoef
        (stateLaw (State.single a (r.val + 1))))) ^ (κ r).val) *
        (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) * (κ r).val)))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  intro d hd
  set c := (availablePoints ε m).rational with hc
  set g := adamsSer m (clusterSer a) with hgdef
  set b : ℕ → Coef := fun s ↦ adamsCoef m (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a s))) with hb
  set S : Ser := ∑ r : Fin n, PowerSeries.C (b (r.val + 1)) *
      (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * (r.val + 1)) with hSdef
  set T : (Fin n → ℕ) → Ser := fun κ ↦ PowerSeries.C (scalar
      ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range (∑ r : Fin n, κ r), (c - RatFunc.C (j : ℚ))) *
      RatFunc.C ((∏ r : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (κ r) : ℕ) : ℚ))⁻¹))) *
      (PowerSeries.C (∏ r : Fin n, b (r.val + 1) ^ κ r) *
      (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) * κ r)) with hTdef
  have hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1 := by
    rw [hgdef, constantCoeff_adamsSer m hm.ne', ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
    simp [clusterSer]
  have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, SCongr n ((g - 1) ^ k) (S ^ k) :=
    (adamsSer_clusterSer_sub_one_scongr a m n hm).pow
  
  have hR : (∑ κ : Fin n → Fin (n + 1), PowerSeries.C (scalar
      ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range (∑ r : Fin n, (κ r).val), ((availablePoints ε m).rational - RatFunc.C
      (j : ℚ))) * RatFunc.C ((∏ r : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (κ r).val : ℕ) : ℚ))⁻¹))) *
      (PowerSeries.C (∏ r : Fin n, (adamsCoef m (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (r.val + 1)))))
      ^ (κ r).val) * (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (m * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) * (κ r).val)))
      = ∑ κ : Fin n → Fin (n + 1), T (fun r ↦ (κ r).val) := rfl
  rw [hR, coeff_formalPow c g hg d]
  have hsum_le : ∀ κ : Fin n → ℕ, ∑ r, κ r ≤ m * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) * κ r := by
    intro κ
    calc ∑ r, κ r ≤ ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) * κ r :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ ↦ Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.succ_pos _))
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hm
  have hTcoeff : ∀ κ : Fin n → ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff d (T κ) = if d = m * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) *
      κ r then scalar ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range (∑ r : Fin n, κ r), (c - RatFunc.C (j : ℚ))) *
      RatFunc.C ((∏ r : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (κ r) : ℕ) : ℚ))⁻¹)) * ∏ r : Fin n,
      b (r.val + 1) ^ κ r else 0 := by
    intro κ
    rw [hTdef]; dsimp only
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  have hTzero : ∀ κ : Fin n → ℕ, n < ∑ r, κ r → PowerSeries.coeff d (T κ) = 0 := by
    intro κ hκ
    rw [hTcoeff, if_neg]
    have := hsum_le κ
    omega
  
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) •
      ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef))) *
      PowerSeries.coeff d ((g - 1) ^ k))
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) •
          ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef))) *
          PowerSeries.coeff d (S ^ k)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega : d + 1 ≤ n + 1))]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ ↦ ?_)
      rw [hpow k d hd]
    · intro k _ hk
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
      have hX : (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ k ∣ S ^ k := by
        apply pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd
        rw [PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff, hSdef, map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun r _ ↦ ?_)
        rw [map_mul, map_pow, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_X, zero_pow (by positivity), mul_zero]
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hX
      rw [hu, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (by omega), mul_zero, smul_zero]
  
  have h2 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) •
      ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef))) * PowerSeries.coeff d (S ^ k))
      = ∑ κ ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) k, PowerSeries.coeff d (T κ) := by
    intro k _
    rw [hSdef, sum_C_mul_X_pow_pow m n k b, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun κ hκ ↦ ?_)
    rw [Finset.mem_piAntidiag] at hκ
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, hTcoeff]
    split_ifs
    · have hk : ∑ r, κ r = k := hκ.1
      rw [hk]
      have hq := inv_factorial_mul_multinomial κ hk
      have hM : ((Nat.multinomial Finset.univ κ : ℕ) : Coef) =
          scalar (RatFunc.C (Nat.multinomial Finset.univ κ : ℚ)) := by
        rw [scalar_eq_algebraMap, map_natCast, map_natCast]
      have hP : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (scalar c - (j : ℚ) • (1 : Coef))) =
          scalar (∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (c - RatFunc.C (j : ℚ))) := by
        simp only [rat_smul_eq_scalar_mul, mul_one, scalar_eq_algebraMap, map_prod, map_sub]
      rw [rat_smul_eq_scalar_mul, hM, hP, ← hq, map_mul]
      simp only [scalar_eq_algebraMap, map_mul]
      ring
    · rw [mul_zero, smul_zero]
  rw [h1, Finset.sum_congr rfl h2, sum_range_sum_piAntidiag_eq_sum_fin n _ hTzero, map_sum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.scalar_prod
statement:
private theorem scalar_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → RatFunc ℚ) :
    scalar (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, scalar (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [scalar_eq_algebraMap, map_prod]

name: SurfaceBlowup.scongr_prod
statement:
private theorem scongr_prod {ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → Ser)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, SCongr n (f i) (g i)) : SCongr n (∏ i ∈ s, f i) (∏ i ∈ s, g i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact SCongr.refl n _
  | insert x s hx ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hx, Finset.prod_insert hx]
    exact (h x (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).mul (ih fun i hi ↦ h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr
statement:
theorem prod_formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr (ε : ℤ) (a n : ℕ) :
    SCongr n (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, formalPow (availablePoints ε m).rational
        (adamsSer m (clusterSer a))) (∑ K : Fin n → Fin n → Fin (n + 1),
        PowerSeries.C (scalar (∏ i : Fin n, ((∏ j ∈ Finset.range (∑ r : Fin n, (K i r).val),
        ((availablePoints ε (i.val + 1)).rational - RatFunc.C (j : ℚ))) *
        RatFunc.C ((∏ r : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (K i r).val : ℕ) : ℚ))⁻¹)))) *
        (PowerSeries.C (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ r : Fin n, (adamsCoef (i.val + 1)
        (lawCoef (stateLaw (State.single a (r.val + 1))))) ^ (K i r).val) *
        (PowerSeries.X : Ser) ^ (∑ i : Fin n, (i.val + 1) * ∑ r : Fin n, (r.val + 1) *
        (K i r).val)))
proof:
:= by
  have hre : ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, formalPow (availablePoints ε m).rational
      (adamsSer m (clusterSer a))
      = ∏ i : Fin n, formalPow (availablePoints ε (i.val + 1)).rational
          (adamsSer (i.val + 1) (clusterSer a)) := by
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun i ↦ formalPow (availablePoints ε (i + 1)).rational
      (adamsSer (i + 1) (clusterSer a))), ← Finset.Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc,
      Finset.prod_Ico_eq_prod_range]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, add_comm 1]
  rw [hre]
  have hprod := scongr_prod n Finset.univ _ _ (fun (i : Fin n) _ ↦
    formalPow_adamsSer_clusterSer_scongr ε a (i.val + 1) n (Nat.succ_pos _))
  refine hprod.trans ?_
  rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum, Fintype.piFinset_univ]
  refine SCongr.of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun K _ ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← map_prod, ← scalar_prod,
      Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Finset.mul_sum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pExp_add
statement: private theorem pExp_add (f g : Ser) : pExp (f + g) = pExp f * pExp g
proof:
:= by
  rw [pExp, pExp, pExp, plethSum_add]
  exact expSer_add _ _ (constantCoeff_plethSum f) (constantCoeff_plethSum g)

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_pExp
statement: private theorem constantCoeff_pExp (f : Ser) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (pExp f) = 1
proof:
:=
  constantCoeff_expSer _ (constantCoeff_plethSum f)

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_pLog
statement: private theorem constantCoeff_pLog (g : Ser) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (pLog g) = 0
proof:
:=
  constantCoeff_moebiusSum _

name: SurfaceBlowup.pExp_pLog
statement: private theorem pExp_pLog (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) : pExp (pLog g) = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [pExp, pLog, plethSum_moebiusSum _ (constantCoeff_logSer g hg), expSer_logSer g hg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pLog_pExp
statement: private theorem pLog_pExp (f : Ser) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) : pLog (pExp f) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [pExp, pLog, logSer_expSer _ (constantCoeff_plethSum f), moebiusSum_plethSum f hf]

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_pPow
statement: theorem constantCoeff_pPow (w : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (pPow w g) = 1
proof:
:=
  constantCoeff_pExp _

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_C_mul_pLog
statement:
private theorem constantCoeff_C_mul_pLog (a : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.C (scalar a) * pLog g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [constantCoeff_pLog]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pPow_pPow
statement: theorem pPow_pPow (w z : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) : pPow w (pPow z g) = pPow (w * z) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [pPow, pPow, pLog_pExp _ (constantCoeff_C_mul_pLog z g), ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul,
    ← scalar_mul, pPow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pPow_mul_pPow
statement: theorem pPow_mul_pPow (w z : RatFunc ℚ) (g : Ser) : pPow w g * pPow z g = pPow (w + z) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [pPow, pPow, pPow, ← pExp_add, scalar_add, map_add, add_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pPow_one
statement: private theorem pPow_one (g : Ser) (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) : pPow 1 g = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [pPow, scalar_one, map_one, one_mul, pExp_pLog g hg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_pPow_sub_of_scongr
statement:
theorem coeff_pPow_sub_of_scongr (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (w : RatFunc ℚ) (g h : Ser)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) (hh : PowerSeries.constantCoeff h = 1)
    (hgh : SCongr (n - 1) g h) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (pPow w g) - PowerSeries.coeff n (pPow w h) =
      scalar w * (PowerSeries.coeff n g - PowerSeries.coeff n h)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : SCongr (n - 1) (logSer g) (logSer h) := hgh.logSer hg hh
  have hP : SCongr (n - 1) (PowerSeries.C (scalar w) * pLog g)
      (PowerSeries.C (scalar w) * pLog h) := hL.moebiusSum.C_mul _
  rw [pPow, pPow, pExp, pExp, coeff_expSer_sub_of_scongr n hn _ _ (constantCoeff_plethSum _)
    (constantCoeff_plethSum _) hP.plethSum, coeff_plethSum_sub_of_scongr n hn _ _ hP,
    PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, ← mul_sub, pLog, pLog,
    coeff_moebiusSum_sub_of_scongr n hn _ _ hL, coeff_logSer_sub_of_scongr n hn g h hg hh hgh]

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_allowedPatterns_single
statement:
theorem sum_allowedPatterns_single (a n : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (F : ℕ → ℕ → Pattern (State.single a n).degree → Coef) :
    ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns (State.single a n), F P.d.val P.rt.val P.other =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), (if ((0 < r ↔ d < n) ∧ r ≤ d) then
        ∑ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern (State.single a n).degree)).filter
          (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = d - r), F d r m else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_allowedPatterns_reindex (.single a n) n (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n ha)
    (fun d rt rx ↦ rx = 0 ∧ (0 < rt ↔ d < n)) (fun P ↦ by simp [allowedPatterns, Allowed])
    (fun d rt _ m ↦ F d rt m)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun rx _ h0 ↦ if_neg fun h ↦ h0 h.1.1) (by simp)]
  simp only [true_and, add_zero, Nat.sub_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.otherChildren_length
statement:
private theorem otherChildren_length {N : ℕ} (a : ℕ) (m : Pattern N) :
    (otherChildren a m).length = ∑ ij, (m ij).val
proof:
:= by
  unfold otherChildren
  rw [List.length_flatMap]
  simp only [List.length_replicate]
  rw [Finset.sum_map_toList]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_otherChildren
statement:
private theorem mem_otherChildren {N : ℕ} (a : ℕ) (m : Pattern N) (x : ℕ × State) :
    x ∈ otherChildren a m ↔ ∃ ij, (m ij).val ≠ 0 ∧ x = (ij.1.val+1, .single a (ij.2.val+1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold otherChildren
  simp [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_replicate, eq_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.otherChildren_eq_single_iff
statement:
private theorem otherChildren_eq_single_iff (a n N : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnN : n - 1 < N)
    (m : Pattern N) :
    otherChildren a m = [(1, State.single a n)] ↔
      ∀ ij : Fin N × Fin N, (m ij).val = (if ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = n - 1 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 < N := by omega
  let ij0 : Fin N × Fin N := (⟨0, h0⟩, ⟨n-1, hnN⟩)
  have key : ∀ ij : Fin N × Fin N, (ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = n - 1) ↔ ij = ij0 := by
    intro ij
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact Prod.ext (Fin.ext h1) (Fin.ext h2)
    · rintro rfl; simp [ij0]
  have hrep : [(1, State.single a n)] = List.replicate 1 (1, State.single a n) := rfl
  rw [hrep, List.eq_replicate_iff, otherChildren_length]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlen, hall⟩
    have hsupp : ∀ ij, (m ij).val ≠ 0 → ij = ij0 := by
      intro ij hij
      have := hall _ ((mem_otherChildren a m _).2 ⟨ij, hij, rfl⟩)
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, State.single.injEq] at this
      rw [← key]; omega
    have hs : ∑ ij, (m ij).val = (m ij0).val :=
      Finset.sum_eq_single ij0 (fun b _ hb ↦ by by_contra h; exact hb (hsupp b h)) (by simp)
    intro ij
    by_cases h : ij = ij0
    · subst h; rw [if_pos ((key _).2 rfl)]; omega
    · rw [if_neg (by rw [key]; exact h)]
      by_contra h'; exact h (hsupp ij h')
  · intro hm
    constructor
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ij0]
      · rw [hm]; simp [ij0]
      · intro b _ hb; rw [hm, if_neg (by rw [key]; exact hb)]
      · simp
    · intro b hb
      obtain ⟨ij, hij, rfl⟩ := (mem_otherChildren a m b).1 hb
      rw [hm] at hij
      split_ifs at hij with h
      · simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, State.single.injEq]; exact ⟨by omega, trivial, by omega⟩
