      SurfaceUniverse.Terminates.node i c J hJc hnt fun j => (hp j).2
    refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hterm⟩, hJc⟩
    · rw [U.cells_cover i hnt]; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨c, hJc⟩
    · rw [h1]; exact U.type_add i hnt c J hJc τ fun j => (hp j).1.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_list
statement:
private theorem self_list {i : U.ι} {c : (U.M i).cellIndex} (h : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c) :
    (U.M i).childList c = [(1, (U.M i).s)]
proof:
:=
  h.choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_len
statement:
private theorem self_len {i : U.ι} {c : (U.M i).cellIndex} (h : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c) :
    ((U.M i).childList c).length = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [self_list U h]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_get
statement:
private theorem self_get {i : U.ι} {c : (U.M i).cellIndex} (h : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c)
    (j : (U.M i).childIdx c) : ((U.M i).childList c).get j = (1, (U.M i).s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [self_list U h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_delta
statement:
private theorem self_delta {i : U.ι} {c : (U.M i).cellIndex} (h : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c)
    (j : (U.M i).childIdx c) : (U.M i).childDelta c j = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold MeasuredSurface.childDelta; rw [self_get U h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_state
statement:
private theorem self_state {i : U.ι} {c : (U.M i).cellIndex} (h : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c)
    (j : (U.M i).childIdx c) : (U.M (U.child i c j)).s = (U.M i).s
proof:
:= by
  rw [U.child_state]; unfold MeasuredSurface.childState; rw [self_get U h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_sub
statement:
private theorem self_sub {i : U.ι} {c : (U.M i).cellIndex} (h : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c)
    (j j' : (U.M i).childIdx c) : j = j'
proof:
:= by
  have := self_len U h
  apply Fin.ext; have := j.2; have := j'.2; omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.scale_one
statement: private theorem scale_one (σ : FactorType) : scaleType 1 σ = σ
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleType]

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [self_delta U h, scale_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    self_len U h, one_smul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_sub
statement:
private theorem exit_sub (σ : FactorType) : ∀ k (i : U.ι), (U.M i).s.terminal = false →
    U.exitEvent σ k i ⊆ U.termTypeEvent i σ
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i hnt J hJ
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at hJ
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hJ
    rw [← term_type_event_cell_decomposition U i hnt c.1 σ] at hc
    exact hc.1
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hnt J hJ
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at hJ
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hJ
    have hJ' : J ∈ U.typeBox i c.1 σ := by
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.typeBox, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨fun _ => σ, self_sum U c.2 σ, hc.1, ?_⟩
      intro j _
      have hnt' : (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).s.terminal = false := by
        rw [self_state U c.2 j]; exact hnt
      exact ih _ hnt' (hc.2 j (Set.mem_univ _))
    rw [← term_type_event_cell_decomposition U i hnt c.1 σ] at hJ'
    exact hJ'.1

name: SurfaceBlowup.term_exit_sub
statement:
private theorem term_exit_sub : ∀ k (i : U.ι), (U.M i).s.terminal = false →
    U.termExitEvent k i ⊆ U.terminatingSet i
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i hnt J hJ
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.termExitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at hJ
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hJ
    exact SurfaceUniverse.Terminates.node i c.1 J hc.1 hnt (fun j => hc.2 j (Set.mem_univ _))
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hnt J hJ
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.termExitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at hJ
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hJ
    refine SurfaceUniverse.Terminates.node i c.1 J hc.1 hnt (fun j => ?_)
    have hnt' : (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).s.terminal = false := by
      rw [self_state U c.2 j]; exact hnt
    exact ih _ hnt' (hc.2 j (Set.mem_univ _))

name: SurfaceBlowup.term_sub_exit
proof:
:= by
  induction hT with
  | leaf i J _ ht => intro hnt; rw [ht] at hnt; cases hnt
  | node i c J hJ hnt h ih =>
    intro _ hty
    have hmem : J ∈ U.termTypeEvent i σ ∩ (U.M i).cell c :=
      ⟨⟨hty, SurfaceUniverse.Terminates.node i c J hJ hnt h⟩, hJ⟩
    rw [term_type_event_cell_decomposition U i hnt c σ] at hmem
    by_cases hs : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.typeBox, Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hb⟩ := hmem
      let j0 := selfChildIdx U hs
      have hτ0 : σ = τ j0 := by
        rw [hτ]
        simp only [self_delta U hs, scale_one]
        rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single j0 (fun j hj => absurd (self_sub U hs j j0) hj)]
      have hc0 : U.Φ i c J j0 ∈ U.termTypeEvent (U.child i c j0) (τ j0) := hb.2 j0 (Set.mem_univ _)
      rw [← hτ0] at hc0
      have hnt' : (U.M (U.child i c j0)).s.terminal = false := by
        rw [self_state U hs j0]; exact hnt
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih j0 hnt' hc0.1
      refine ⟨k+1, ?_⟩
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨c, hs⟩, hJ, ?_⟩
      intro j _
      rw [self_sub U hs j j0]; exact hk
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨c, hs⟩, hmem⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.term_sub_texit
statement:
private theorem term_sub_texit (i : U.ι) (J : Ideal (U.M i).R) (hT : U.Terminates i J) :
    (U.M i).s.terminal = false → ∃ k, J ∈ U.termExitEvent k i
proof:
:= by
  induction hT with
  | leaf i J _ ht => intro hnt; rw [ht] at hnt; cases hnt
  | node i c J hJ hnt h ih =>
    intro _
    by_cases hs : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c
    · let j0 := selfChildIdx U hs
      have hnt' : (U.M (U.child i c j0)).s.terminal = false := by
        rw [self_state U hs j0]; exact hnt
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih j0 hnt'
      refine ⟨k+1, ?_⟩
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.termExitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨c, hs⟩, hJ, ?_⟩
      intro j _
      rw [self_sub U hs j j0]; exact hk
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.termExitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨c, hs⟩, hJ, fun j _ => h j⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_disj
statement:
private theorem exit_disj (σ : FactorType) : ∀ k k' (i : U.ι), (U.M i).s.terminal = false → k ≠ k' →
    Disjoint (U.exitEvent σ k i) (U.exitEvent σ k' i)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro k' i hnt hk
    obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k' = m + 1 := ⟨k' - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro J h1 h2
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨c2, hc2⟩ := h2
    have hne : c1.1 ≠ c2.1 := fun e => c1.2 (e ▸ c2.2)
    have hJ1 : J ∈ (U.M i).cell c1.1 := by
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.typeBox, Set.mem_iUnion] at hc1
      obtain ⟨_, _, hb⟩ := hc1; exact hb.1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (U.cells_disjoint i hnt hne) hJ1 hc2.1
  | succ k ih =>
    intro k' i hnt hk
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro J h1 h2
    cases k' with
    | zero =>
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at h1 h2
      obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ := h1
      obtain ⟨c2, hc2⟩ := h2
      have hne : c1.1 ≠ c2.1 := fun e => c2.2 (e ▸ c1.2)
      have hJ2 : J ∈ (U.M i).cell c2.1 := by
        simp only [SurfaceUniverse.typeBox, Set.mem_iUnion] at hc2
        obtain ⟨_, _, hb⟩ := hc2; exact hb.1
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (U.cells_disjoint i hnt hne) hc1.1 hJ2
    | succ k' =>
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at h1 h2
      obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ := h1
      obtain ⟨c2, hc2⟩ := h2
      by_cases hne : c1.1 = c2.1
      · have : c1 = c2 := Subtype.ext hne
        subst this
        let j0 := selfChildIdx U c1.2
        have hnt' : (U.M (U.child i c1.1 j0)).s.terminal = false := by
          rw [self_state U c1.2 j0]; exact hnt
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (ih k' _ hnt' (by omega)) (hc1.2 j0 (Set.mem_univ _))
          (hc2.2 j0 (Set.mem_univ _))
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (U.cells_disjoint i hnt hne) hc1.1 hc2.1

name: SurfaceBlowup.single_state_return_chain
statement:
theorem single_state_return_chain (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false)
    (σ : FactorType) :
    (∀ a c : ℕ, (U.M i).s = State.single a c → U.termTypeEvent i σ = ⋃ k, U.exitEvent σ k i ∧
        Pairwise (fun k k' : ℕ => Disjoint (U.exitEvent σ k i) (U.exitEvent σ k' i)) ∧
        U.terminatingSet i = ⋃ k, U.termExitEvent k i) ∧
    (∀ a b c h : ℕ, (U.M i).s = State.crossing a b c h → U.termTypeEvent i σ = U.exitEvent σ 0 i ∧
        U.terminatingSet i = U.termExitEvent 0 i)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : U.termTypeEvent i σ = ⋃ k, U.exitEvent σ k i := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro J hJ
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := term_sub_exit U σ i J hJ.2 hnt hJ.1
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k, hk⟩
    · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun k => exit_sub U σ k i hnt
  have hB : U.terminatingSet i = ⋃ k, U.termExitEvent k i := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro J hJ
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := term_sub_texit U i J hJ hnt
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k, hk⟩
    · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun k => term_exit_sub U k i hnt
  refine ⟨fun _ _ _ => ⟨hA, fun k k' hk => exit_disj U σ k k' i hnt hk, hB⟩, ?_⟩
  intro a b c h hs
  have noself : ∀ c' : (U.M i).cellIndex, ¬ (U.M i).IsSelfCell c' := by
    intro c' hc'
    obtain ⟨a', c'', hs', _⟩ := hc'
    rw [hs] at hs'; cases hs'
  constructor
  · rw [hA]
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro J hJ
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hJ
      cases k with
      | zero => exact hk
      | succ k =>
        simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at hk
        obtain ⟨c', _⟩ := hk
        exact absurd c'.2 (noself c'.1)
    · exact Set.subset_iUnion (fun k => U.exitEvent σ k i) 0
  · rw [hB]
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro J hJ
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hJ
      cases k with
      | zero => exact hk
      | succ k =>
        simp only [SurfaceUniverse.termExitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at hk
        obtain ⟨c', _⟩ := hk
        exact absurd c'.2 (noself c'.1)
    · exact Set.subset_iUnion (fun k => U.termExitEvent k i) 0

name: SurfaceBlowup.universe_basic_facts
statement:
theorem universe_basic_facts (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) :
    2 ≤ (U.M i).q ∧ 0 < (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ∧ (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ≠ ⊤ ∧
    (∀ (c : (U.M i).cellIndex) (j : (U.M i).childIdx c), 2 ≤ (U.M (U.child i c j)).q) ∧
    Finite (U.M i).cellIndex
proof:
:= by
  have hq : ∀ k : U.ι, 2 ≤ (U.M k).q := fun k => by
    exact Finite.one_lt_card
  have hA0 := fun k => density_value_arith (U.M k).q (hq k) (.const 1) (.const 1)
    (by simp [Expr.eval]) (by simp [Expr.eval]) 0 (U.M k).s (U.M k).valid
  have hA := fun k => density_value_arith (U.M k).q (hq k) (stateVolume (U.M k).s) (.const 1)
    (hA0 k).2.2.2.2.2.2.1.le (by simp [Expr.eval]) 0 (U.M k).s (U.M k).valid
  refine ⟨hq i, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [U.volume]
    exact pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ((hA i).2.2.2.2.2.1 (hA0 i).2.2.2.2.2.2.1)
  · rw [U.volume]; exact (hA i).2.2.2.2.1
  · intro c j
    rw [U.child_residue]
    have hd : 0 < (U.M i).childDelta c j :=
      children_residue_degree_pos (U.M i).s c.1.1 _ (List.get_mem _ _)
    calc 2 ≤ (U.M i).q := hq i
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.le_self_pow hd.ne' _
  · have : ∀ P : (U.M i).allowedPattern, Finite (patternDivisors
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (U.M i).R) (U.M i).s P.1) :=
      fun P => U.divisors_finite i P.1
    have : Finite (U.M i).allowedPattern := inferInstance
    change Finite (Σ P : (U.M i).allowedPattern,
      patternDivisors (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (U.M i).R) (U.M i).s P.1)
    infer_instance

name: SurfaceBlowup.piFinset_sum_reindex
statement:
private theorem piFinset_sum_reindex (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    (a : Fin n → ℕ × Law) :
    (∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j : Fin m => ((a (Fin.cast h j)).2.map Prod.fst).toFinset),
      (if σ = ∑ j, scaleType (a (Fin.cast h j)).1 (τ j) then
        ∏ j, (lawCoeff (a (Fin.cast h j)).2 (τ j)).eval (q ^ (a (Fin.cast h j)).1) else 0)) =
    ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j : Fin n => ((a j).2.map Prod.fst).toFinset),
      (if σ = ∑ j, scaleType (a j).1 (τ j) then
        ∏ j, (lawCoeff (a j).2 (τ j)).eval (q ^ (a j).1) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoeff_lawProd_descend_eval
statement:
private theorem lawCoeff_lawProd_descend_eval (l : List (ℕ × State)) (hδ : ∀ z ∈ l, 0 < z.1)
    (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff (lawProd (l.map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))) σ).eval q =
    ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j : Fin l.length => ((stateLaw (l.get j).2).map Prod.fst).toFinset),
      (if σ = ∑ j, scaleType (l.get j).1 (τ j) then
        ∏ j, (lawCoeff (stateLaw (l.get j).2) (τ j)).eval (q ^ (l.get j).1) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := law_coeff_prod_descend (l.map fun z => (z.1, stateLaw z.2))
    (by intro z hz; obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hz; exact hδ w hw) σ q
  rw [List.map_map] at h
  rw [show ((fun z : ℕ × Law => lawDescend z.1 z.2) ∘ fun z : ℕ × State => (z.1, stateLaw z.2)) =
    (fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)) from rfl] at h
  have hl : (l.map fun z => (z.1, stateLaw z.2)).length = l.length := List.length_map _
  have hg : (l.map fun z => (z.1, stateLaw z.2)).get =
      fun j => ((l.get (Fin.cast hl j)).1, stateLaw (l.get (Fin.cast hl j)).2) := by
    funext j; simp
  rw [hg] at h
  rw [h]
  exact piFinset_sum_reindex σ q hl (fun j => ((l.get j).1, stateLaw (l.get j).2))

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_q_eq_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [U.child_residue i c j]; push_cast; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_child_law
proof:
:=
  hIH _ (by
    rw [U.child_state i c.1 j]
    exact nonself_child_rank_lt _ (U.M i).valid _ c.1.1.2 c.2 _ (List.get_mem _ _))

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_child_coeff_nonneg
statement:
private theorem exit_child_coeff_nonneg (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') (c : U.exitCells i)
    (j : (U.M i).childIdx c.1) (t : FactorType) :
    0 ≤ (lawCoeff (stateLaw (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).2) t).eval
      (((U.M i).q : ℚ) ^ (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).1)
proof:
:= by
  have := ((exit_child_law U i hIH c j).1 t).2.1
  rwa [U.child_state i c.1 j, child_q_eq_pow] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_cell_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem exit_cell_coeff_nonneg (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') (c : U.exitCells i)
    (σ : FactorType) :
    0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawProd (((U.M i).childList c.1).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))
      σ).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lawCoeff_lawProd_descend_eval ((U.M i).childList c.1)
    (fun z hz ↦ children_residue_degree_pos _ _ _ hz)]
  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun τ _ ↦ ?_
  split_ifs
  exacts [Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ ↦ exit_child_coeff_nonneg U i hIH c j (τ j), le_rfl]

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_child_box_mass
statement:
private theorem exit_child_box_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') (c : U.exitCells i)
    (τ : (U.M i).childIdx c.1 → FactorType) :
    (U.M i).μ (U.childBox i c.1 (fun j ↦ U.termTypeEvent (U.child i c.1 j) (τ j))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((((divisorProbability (U.M i).s ((U.M i).cellDegree c.1)).eval
        ((U.M i).q : ℚ) * (stateVolume (U.M i).s).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) *
        ∏ j, (lawCoeff (stateLaw (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).2) (τ j)).eval
          (((U.M i).q : ℚ) ^ (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).1) : ℚ)) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 2 ≤ (U.M i).q := (universe_basic_facts U i).1
  have hL := exit_child_law U i hIH c
  have hsj : ∀ j, (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).s = (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).2 :=
    fun j ↦ U.child_state i c.1 j
  
  let V : (U.M i).childIdx c.1 → ℚ := fun j ↦ (stateVolume (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).2).eval
    (((U.M i).q : ℚ) ^ (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).1)
  let C : (U.M i).childIdx c.1 → ℚ := fun j ↦
    (lawCoeff (stateLaw (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).2) (τ j)).eval
      (((U.M i).q : ℚ) ^ (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).1)
  have hC : ∀ j, 0 ≤ C j := fun j ↦ exit_child_coeff_nonneg U i hIH c j (τ j)
  have hV : ∀ j, 0 < V j := by
    intro j
    have hqc : 2 ≤ (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).q := U.child_residue i c.1 j ▸ hq.trans
      (Nat.le_self_pow (children_residue_degree_pos _ _ _ (List.get_mem _ _)).ne' _)
    have := (density_value_arith _ hqc (.const 1) (.const 1) (by simp [Expr.eval])
      (by simp [Expr.eval]) 0 _ (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).valid).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    rwa [hsj j, child_q_eq_pow] at this
  have hmeas : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (U.termTypeEvent (U.child i c.1 j) (τ j)) :=
    fun j ↦ ((hL j).1 (τ j)).1
  have hmu : ∀ j, (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).μ (U.termTypeEvent (U.child i c.1 j) (τ j)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (((C j * V j : ℚ)) : ℝ) := by
    intro j
    have e1 : (lawCoeff (stateLaw (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).s) (τ j)).eval
        ((U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).q : ℚ) = C j := by rw [hsj j, child_q_eq_pow]
    have e2 : (stateVolume (U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).s).eval ((U.M (U.child i c.1 j)).q : ℚ) =
        V j := by rw [hsj j, child_q_eq_pow]
    rw [((hL j).1 (τ j)).2.2, U.volume]
    simp only [densityValue]
    rw [e1, e2, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by exact_mod_cast hC j)]
    push_cast; rfl
  have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((U.M i).q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < (U.M i).q by omega)
  
  have hratio : ((U.M i).q : ℚ)⁻¹ ^ tri ((U.M i).cellDegree c.1) * (∏ j, V j) /
      (stateVolume (U.M i).s).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) =
      (divisorProbability (U.M i).s ((U.M i).cellDegree c.1)).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) := by
    have hprodV : (((U.M i).childList c.1).map fun z ↦
        (stateVolume z.2).eval (((U.M i).q : ℚ) ^ z.1)).prod = ∏ j, V j := by
      rw [← Fin.prod_univ_fun_getElem]; rfl
    rw [← hprodV]
    exact child_volume_ratio (U.M i).s (U.M i).valid c.1.1.1 c.1.1.2 _ hq
  have hVs := (density_value_arith _ hq (.const 1) (.const 1) (by simp [Expr.eval])
      (by simp [Expr.eval]) 0 _ (U.M i).valid).2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  change (U.M i).μ ((U.M i).cell c.1 ∩ U.Φ i c.1 ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ _) = _
  rw [U.Φ_measure i hnt c.1 _ hmeas, Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun j _ ↦ hmu j),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg (fun j _ ↦ by have := hC j; have := hV j; positivity),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hqpos,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (inv_nonneg.2 hqpos.le), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ← hratio]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  field_simp
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: SurfaceBlowup.typeBox_measure_eq_tsum
statement:
private theorem typeBox_measure_eq_tsum (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false) (c : (U.M i).cellIndex) (σ : FactorType)
    (hmeas : ∀ j t, MeasurableSet (U.termTypeEvent (U.child i c j) t)) :
    (U.M i).μ (U.typeBox i c σ) = ∑' τ : (U.M i).childIdx c → FactorType,
      if σ = ∑ j, scaleType ((U.M i).childDelta c j) (τ j) then
        (U.M i).μ (U.childBox i c (fun j ↦ U.termTypeEvent (U.child i c j) (τ j))) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold SurfaceUniverse.typeBox
  rw [MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion]
  · congr 1; funext τ
    rw [Set.iUnion_eq_if]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · exact MeasureTheory.measure_empty
  · intro τ τ' hne
    rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
    intro J hJ hJ'
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hJ hJ'
    obtain ⟨_, hJ⟩ := hJ
    obtain ⟨_, hJ'⟩ := hJ'
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hne
    have h1 := hJ.2 j (Set.mem_univ j)
    obtain ⟨σ0, -, huniq⟩ := terminates_type_unique U _ _ h1.2
    exact hj ((huniq _ h1.1.2).trans (huniq _ (hJ'.2 j (Set.mem_univ j)).1.2).symm)
  · exact fun τ ↦ MeasurableSet.iUnion fun _ ↦ U.Φ_measurable i hnt c _ fun j ↦ hmeas j (τ j)

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_cell_type_mass
statement:
theorem exit_cell_type_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') (c : U.exitCells i)
    (σ : FactorType) :
    (U.M i).μ (U.typeBox i c.1 σ) =
      densityValue (.mul (divisorProbability (U.M i).s ((U.M i).cellDegree c.1))
        (lawCoeff (lawProd (((U.M i).childList c.1).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))) σ))
        (U.M i).q * (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet
proof:
:= by
  
  have hq : 2 ≤ (U.M i).q := (universe_basic_facts U i).1
  set A : ℚ := (divisorProbability (U.M i).s ((U.M i).cellDegree c.1)).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) *
    (stateVolume (U.M i).s).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) with hAdef
  let C : (U.M i).childIdx c.1 → FactorType → ℚ := fun j t ↦
    (lawCoeff (stateLaw (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).2) t).eval
      (((U.M i).q : ℚ) ^ (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).1)
  have hC : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ C j t := exit_child_coeff_nonneg U i hIH c
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := mul_nonneg (divisor_probability_pos _ hq _ _ 2 le_rfl).1.le
    (density_value_arith _ hq (.const 1) (.const 1) (by simp [Expr.eval])
      (by simp [Expr.eval]) 0 _ (U.M i).valid).2.2.2.2.2.2.1.le
  let g : ((U.M i).childIdx c.1 → FactorType) → ℚ := fun τ ↦
    if σ = ∑ j, scaleType ((U.M i).childDelta c.1 j) (τ j) then A * ∏ j, C j (τ j) else 0
  have hg : ∀ τ, 0 ≤ g τ := fun τ ↦ by
    simp only [g]; split_ifs
    exacts [mul_nonneg hA (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ ↦ hC j (τ j)), le_rfl]
  have hstep1 : (U.M i).μ (U.typeBox i c.1 σ) = ∑' τ, ENNReal.ofReal ((g τ : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [typeBox_measure_eq_tsum U i hnt c.1 σ fun j t ↦ ((exit_child_law U i hIH c j).1 t).1]
    congr 1; funext τ
    simp only [g]
    split_ifs
    · exact exit_child_box_mass U i hnt hIH c τ
    · simp
  have hstep2 : ∑' τ, ENNReal.ofReal ((g τ : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j : (U.M i).childIdx c.1 ↦
        ((stateLaw (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).2).map Prod.fst).toFinset),
        ENNReal.ofReal ((g τ : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    refine tsum_eq_sum fun τ hτ ↦ ?_
    rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hτ
    push Not at hτ
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hτ
    have h0 : ∏ j, C j (τ j) = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j)
      ((law_coeff_prod_formula 0 Fin.elim0 (τ j) _).2 _ _ hj)
    simp [g, h0]
  have hVs := (density_value_arith _ hq (.const 1) (.const 1) (by simp [Expr.eval])
      (by simp [Expr.eval]) 0 _ (U.M i).valid).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  rw [hstep1, hstep2, ← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun τ _ ↦ by exact_mod_cast hg τ), U.volume]
  simp only [densityValue]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul' (by exact_mod_cast hVs.le), ← Rat.cast_sum, ← Rat.cast_mul, Expr.eval,
    lawCoeff_lawProd_descend_eval ((U.M i).childList c.1)
      (fun z hz ↦ children_residue_degree_pos _ _ _ hz), Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  congr 2
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun τ _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [g]
  by_cases hσ : σ = ∑ j, scaleType ((U.M i).childDelta c.1 j) (τ j)
  · rw [if_pos hσ, if_pos (show σ = ∑ j, scaleType (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).1 (τ j) from hσ)]
    ring
  · rw [if_neg hσ, if_neg (show ¬σ = ∑ j, scaleType (((U.M i).childList c.1).get j).1 (τ j) from
      hσ)]
    ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.list_sum_filter
statement:
private theorem list_sum_filter {α : Type} (s : Finset α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (f : α → ℚ) :
    ((s.toList.filter (fun x => decide (p x))).map f).sum = ∑ x ∈ s.filter p, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum, Finset.filter_val, ← Finset.coe_toList s]
  rw [Multiset.filter_coe, Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sum_coe]

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_facts
statement:
private theorem self_facts (a c q : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (s : State)
    (hs : s = State.single a c) :
    (∀ P : TangentPattern s.degree, Allowed s P → SelfPattern s P → P.d.val = c ∧ children s P =
        [(1, State.single a c)]) ∧
    (((allowedPatterns s).toList.filter (SelfPattern s)).map fun P => (tangentCount s P).eval q).sum
        = q
proof:
:= by
  subst hs; exact self_patterns_of_single_state a c q ha hc

name: SurfaceBlowup.list_get_of_eq_singleton
statement:
private theorem list_get_of_eq_singleton {α : Type} (l : List α) (x : α) (h : l = [x])
    (j : Fin l.length) : l.get j = x
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.eval_pow_nonneg
statement:
private theorem eval_pow_nonneg (x : Expr) (q : ℚ) (hx : 0 ≤ x.eval q) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ (x.pow n).eval q
proof:
:=
  expression_pow_eval x q n ▸ pow_nonneg hx n

name: SurfaceBlowup.natCard_selfCells
statement:
private theorem natCard_selfCells (M : MeasuredSurface) (hfin : ∀ P : TangentPattern M.s.degree,
    Finite (patternDivisors (IsLocalRing.ResidueField M.R) M.s P)) :
    (Nat.card {c : M.cellIndex // M.IsSelfCell c} : ℚ) =
      ∑ P ∈ (allowedPatterns M.s).filter (SelfPattern M.s),
        (Nat.card (patternDivisors (IsLocalRing.ResidueField M.R) M.s P) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  let e : {c : M.cellIndex // M.IsSelfCell c} ≃
      Σ P : {P : TangentPattern M.s.degree // Allowed M.s P ∧ SelfPattern M.s P},
        patternDivisors (IsLocalRing.ResidueField M.R) M.s P.1 :=
    { toFun := fun c => ⟨⟨c.1.1.1, c.1.1.2, c.2⟩, c.1.2⟩
      invFun := fun c => ⟨⟨⟨c.1.1, c.1.2.1⟩, c.2⟩, c.1.2.2⟩
      left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨⟨P, h⟩, d⟩, h'⟩; rfl
      right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨P, h⟩, d⟩; rfl }
  rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_sigma]
  push_cast
  symm; apply Finset.sum_subtype
  intro x; simp [allowedPatterns]

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_cells_facts
statement:
private theorem self_cells_facts (U : SurfaceUniverse) {a c : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
    (i : U.ι) (hs : (U.M i).s = State.single a c) :
    (∀ c' : U.selfCells i, (U.M i).cellDegree c'.1 = c ∧
      (U.M i).childList c'.1 = [(1, State.single a c)]) ∧
    (∀ (c' : U.selfCells i) (j : (U.M i).childIdx c'.1),
      (U.M (U.child i c'.1 j)).s = State.single a c ∧ (U.M (U.child i c'.1 j)).q = (U.M i).q) ∧
    Finite (U.selfCells i) ∧ (Nat.card (U.selfCells i) : ℚ) = (U.M i).q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hq, -, -, -, _⟩ := universe_basic_facts U i
  have hntM : (U.M i).s.terminal = false := by
    obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ : ∃ c', c = c' + 2 := ⟨c - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [hs]; rfl
  have hsf := self_facts a c (U.M i).q ha hc (U.M i).s hs
  have hcell : ∀ c' : U.selfCells i, (U.M i).cellDegree c'.1 = c ∧
      (U.M i).childList c'.1 = [(1, State.single a c)] :=
    fun c' => hsf.1 c'.1.1.1 c'.1.1.2 c'.2
  refine ⟨hcell, fun c' j => ?_, Subtype.finite, ?_⟩
  · have hg := list_get_of_eq_singleton _ _ (hcell c').2 j
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [U.child_state]; simp only [MeasuredSurface.childState, hg]
    · rw [U.child_residue]; simp only [MeasuredSurface.childDelta, hg, pow_one]
  · rw [show Nat.card (U.selfCells i) = Nat.card {c : (U.M i).cellIndex // (U.M i).IsSelfCell c}
      from rfl, natCard_selfCells (U.M i) (U.divisors_finite i), ← hsf.2, list_sum_filter]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun P hP =>
      U.divisor_count i hntM P (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hP).1).2

name: SurfaceBlowup.densityValue_returnWeight
statement:
private theorem densityValue_returnWeight (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (c : ℕ) :
    densityValue (returnWeight c) q = (q : ℝ≥0∞) * (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ tri c
proof:
:= by
  have h := density_value_arith q hq .var (.inv (.pow .var (tri c))) (by simp [Expr.eval])
    (by simp only [Expr.eval]; exact inv_nonneg.mpr (eval_pow_nonneg _ _ (by simp [Expr.eval]) _))
    (tri c) (State.single 1 1) ⟨Nat.one_pos, Nat.one_pos⟩
  rw [returnWeight, h.1, h.2.2.1]
  simp [densityValue, Expr.eval]

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_cells_union_mass
statement:
private theorem self_cells_union_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) {a c : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
    (i : U.ι) (hs : (U.M i).s = State.single a c) (E : ∀ i' : U.ι, Set (Ideal (U.M i').R))
    (m : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hE : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s = State.single a c → (U.M i').q = (U.M i).q →
      (U.M i').μ (E i') = m * (U.M i').μ (U.M i').stateSet ∧ MeasurableSet (E i')) :
    (U.M i).μ (⋃ c' : U.selfCells i, U.childBox i c'.1 (fun j ↦ E (U.child i c'.1 j))) =
      densityValue (returnWeight c) (U.M i).q * m * (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ∧
    MeasurableSet (⋃ c' : U.selfCells i, U.childBox i c'.1 (fun j ↦ E (U.child i c'.1 j)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq, -, -, -, -⟩ := universe_basic_facts U i
  have hntM : (U.M i).s.terminal = false := by
    obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ : ∃ c', c = c' + 2 := ⟨c - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [hs]; rfl
  obtain ⟨hcell, hchild, _, hcard⟩ := self_cells_facts U ha hc i hs
  
  have hbox : ∀ c' : U.selfCells i,
      MeasurableSet (U.childBox i c'.1 (fun j ↦ E (U.child i c'.1 j))) ∧
      (U.M i).μ (U.childBox i c'.1 (fun j ↦ E (U.child i c'.1 j))) =
        ((U.M i).q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ tri c * (m * (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet) := by
    intro c'
    have hG : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (E (U.child i c'.1 j)) :=
      fun j ↦ (hE _ (hchild c' j).1 (hchild c' j).2).2
    refine ⟨U.Φ_measurable i hntM c'.1 _ hG, ?_⟩
    unfold SurfaceUniverse.childBox
    rw [U.Φ_measure i hntM c'.1 _ hG, (hcell c').1]
    have j0 : (U.M i).childIdx c'.1 := ⟨0, by rw [(hcell c').2]; simp⟩
    have : Subsingleton ((U.M i).childIdx c'.1) := by
      change Subsingleton (Fin ((U.M i).childList c'.1).length)
      rw [(hcell c').2]; simp only [List.length_singleton]; infer_instance
    rw [Fintype.prod_subsingleton _ j0]
    congr 1
    rw [(hE _ (hchild c' j0).1 (hchild c' j0).2).1, U.volume, U.volume, (hchild c' j0).1, hs,
      (hchild c' j0).2]
  have hdisj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun c' : U.selfCells i ↦
      U.childBox i c'.1 (fun j ↦ E (U.child i c'.1 j))) := fun x y hxy ↦
    (U.cells_disjoint i hntM (fun h ↦ hxy (Subtype.ext h))).mono
      Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left
  let : Fintype (U.selfCells i) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  refine ⟨?_, MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c' ↦ (hbox c').1⟩
  have hcardN : Fintype.card (U.selfCells i) = (U.M i).q := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]; exact_mod_cast hcard
  rw [MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion hdisj (fun c' ↦ (hbox c').1), tsum_fintype,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c' _ ↦ (hbox c').2), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    nsmul_eq_mul, hcardN, densityValue_returnWeight _ hq]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_event_succ_mass
statement:
theorem exit_event_succ_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
    (σ : FactorType) (q₀ : ℕ) (G : ℚ)
    (hexit : ∀ i : U.ι, (U.M i).s = State.single a c → (U.M i).q = q₀ → (U.M i).μ
        (U.exitEvent σ 0 i) = ENNReal.ofReal (G : ℝ) * (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ∧ MeasurableSet
        (U.exitEvent σ 0 i))
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ i : U.ι, (U.M i).s = State.single a c → (U.M i).q = q₀ →
    (U.M i).μ (U.exitEvent σ k i) = ENNReal.ofReal ((((returnWeight c).eval (q₀ : ℚ)) ^ k * G : ℚ) :
        ℝ) * (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ∧
    MeasurableSet (U.exitEvent σ k i)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i hs hq0
    simpa using hexit i hs hq0
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hs hq0
    have hy : 0 ≤ (returnWeight c).eval (q₀ : ℚ) :=
      (return_weight_bounds _ c (hq0 ▸ (universe_basic_facts U i).1) hc).1.le
    obtain ⟨hmass, hmeas⟩ := self_cells_union_mass U ha hc i hs (U.exitEvent σ k) _
      fun i' hs' hq' ↦ ih i' hs' (hq'.trans hq0)
    refine ⟨hmass.trans ?_, hmeas⟩
    rw [hq0, densityValue, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by exact_mod_cast hy)]
    congr 2; push_cast; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.recursion_events_measurable
statement:
theorem recursion_events_measurable (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') :
    ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s = (U.M i).s → ∀ (k : ℕ) (σ : FactorType),
    MeasurableSet (U.returnEvent k i') ∧ MeasurableSet (U.exitEvent σ k i') ∧
    MeasurableSet (U.termExitEvent k i') ∧ MeasurableSet (U.badExitEvent k i')
proof:
:= by
  intro i₀ hs₀ k σ
  induction k generalizing i₀ with
  | zero =>
    have hnt' : (U.M i₀).s.terminal = false := by rw [hs₀]; exact hnt
    have : Finite (U.M i₀).cellIndex := (universe_basic_facts U i₀).2.2.2.2
    have : Countable (U.exitCells i₀) := by unfold SurfaceUniverse.exitCells; infer_instance
    have hrk : ∀ (c : U.exitCells i₀) j, (U.M (U.child i₀ c.1 j)).s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank := by
      intro c j
      rw [U.child_state, ← hs₀]
      exact nonself_child_rank_lt (U.M i₀).s (U.M i₀).valid c.1.1.1 c.1.1.2 c.2 _
        (List.get_mem _ _)
    refine ⟨U.stateSet_measurable i₀, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent]
      refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c => ?_
      unfold SurfaceUniverse.typeBox
      refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun τ => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun _ => ?_
      exact U.Φ_measurable i₀ hnt' c.1 _ fun j => ((hIH _ (hrk c j)).1 (τ j)).1
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.termExitEvent]
      refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c => ?_
      exact U.Φ_measurable i₀ hnt' c.1 _ fun j => (hIH _ (hrk c j)).2.1
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.badExitEvent]
      refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun j₀ => ?_
      refine U.Φ_measurable i₀ hnt' c.1 _ fun j => ?_
      by_cases hj : j = j₀
      · subst hj
        rw [Function.update_self]
        exact (U.stateSet_measurable _).inter (hIH _ (hrk c j)).2.1.compl
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]
        exact MeasurableSet.univ
  | succ k ih =>
    have hnt' : (U.M i₀).s.terminal = false := by rw [hs₀]; exact hnt
    have : Finite (U.M i₀).cellIndex := (universe_basic_facts U i₀).2.2.2.2
    have : Countable (U.selfCells i₀) := by unfold SurfaceUniverse.selfCells; infer_instance
    have hst : ∀ (c : U.selfCells i₀) j, (U.M (U.child i₀ c.1 j)).s = (U.M i).s := by
      intro c j
      rw [U.child_state, ← hs₀]
      obtain ⟨a, b, -, h⟩ := c.2
      have hm : ∀ z ∈ (U.M i₀).childList c.1, z = (1, (U.M i₀).s) := by
        intro z hz
        unfold MeasuredSurface.childList at hz
        rw [h] at hz
        simpa using hz
      exact congrArg Prod.snd (hm _ (List.get_mem _ _))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.returnEvent]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c =>
        U.Φ_measurable i₀ hnt' c.1 _ fun j => (ih _ (hst c j)).1
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.exitEvent]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c =>
        U.Φ_measurable i₀ hnt' c.1 _ fun j => (ih _ (hst c j)).2.1
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.termExitEvent]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c =>
        U.Φ_measurable i₀ hnt' c.1 _ fun j => (ih _ (hst c j)).2.2.1
    · simp only [SurfaceUniverse.badExitEvent]
      exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun c =>
        U.Φ_measurable i₀ hnt' c.1 _ fun j => (ih _ (hst c j)).2.2.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.bad_exit_null
statement:
theorem bad_exit_null (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s = (U.M i).s → (U.M i').μ (U.badExitEvent k i') = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i' hi'
    have hnt' : (U.M i').s.terminal = false := hi' ▸ hnt
    have : Finite (U.M i').cellIndex := (universe_basic_facts U i').2.2.2.2
    have : Countable (U.exitCells i') := by unfold SurfaceUniverse.exitCells; infer_instance
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.badExitEvent]
    refine MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null fun c => MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null fun j₀ => ?_
    have hrank : ∀ j, (U.M (U.child i' c.1 j)).s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank := by
      intro j
      rw [U.child_state, ← hi']
      exact nonself_child_rank_lt (U.M i').s (U.M i').valid c.1.1.1 c.1.1.2 c.2
        _ (List.get_mem _ _)
    have hL := hIH _ (hrank j₀)
    have hmeas : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (Function.update (fun j =>
        (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (U.M (U.child i' c.1 j)).R))) j₀
        (U.nonterminatingSet (U.child i' c.1 j₀)) j) := by
      intro j
      by_cases h : j = j₀
      · subst h; rw [Function.update_self]
        exact (U.stateSet_measurable _).inter hL.2.1.compl
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne h]; exact MeasurableSet.univ
    unfold SurfaceUniverse.childBox
    rw [U.Φ_measure i' hnt' c.1 _ hmeas]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j₀) (by rw [Function.update_self]; exact hL.2.2),
        mul_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i' hi'
    have hnt' : (U.M i').s.terminal = false := hi' ▸ hnt
    have : Finite (U.M i').cellIndex := (universe_basic_facts U i').2.2.2.2
    have : Countable (U.selfCells i') := by unfold SurfaceUniverse.selfCells; infer_instance
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.badExitEvent]
    refine MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null fun c => ?_
    have hs : ∀ j, (U.M (U.child i' c.1 j)).s = (U.M i).s := by
      intro j
      rw [U.child_state, ← hi']
      obtain ⟨a, b, _, hch⟩ := c.2
      have hm := List.get_mem ((U.M i').childList c.1) j
      have : (U.M i').childList c.1 = [(1, (U.M i').s)] := hch
      have key : ∀ z ∈ (U.M i').childList c.1, z = (1, (U.M i').s) := by
        rw [this]; simp
      have hm := key _ hm
      unfold MeasuredSurface.childState
      rw [hm]
    have hmeas : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (U.badExitEvent k (U.child i' c.1 j)) := fun j =>
      (recursion_events_measurable U i hnt hIH _ (hs j) k ∅).2.2.2
    unfold SurfaceUniverse.childBox
    rw [U.Φ_measure i' hnt' c.1 _ hmeas]
    have hpos : 0 < ((U.M i').childList c.1).length := by
      obtain ⟨a, b, _, hch⟩ := c.2
      have : (U.M i').childList c.1 = [(1, (U.M i').s)] := hch
      rw [this]; simp
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨⟨0, hpos⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ih _ (hs _)⟩, mul_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_cell_weight_sum
statement:
private theorem exit_cell_weight_sum (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false) (σ : FactorType)
    [Fintype (U.exitCells i)] :
    ∑ c : U.exitCells i,
      (divisorProbability (U.M i).s ((U.M i).cellDegree c.1)).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) *
        (lawCoeff (lawProd (((U.M i).childList c.1).map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))
          σ).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) =
      (lawCoeff (exitLaw (U.M i).s) σ).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : ∀ P, Fintype (patternDivisors (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (U.M i).R) (U.M i).s P) :=
    fun P => @Fintype.ofFinite _ (U.divisors_finite i P)
  set M := U.M i with hM
  set s := M.s with hs
  set qq : ℚ := (M.q : ℚ) with hqq
  let F : M.cellIndex → ℚ := fun c =>
    (divisorProbability s (M.cellDegree c)).eval qq *
      (lawCoeff (lawProd ((M.childList c).map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))) σ).eval qq
  let g : TangentPattern s.degree → ℚ := fun P => if SelfPattern s P then 0 else
    (tangentCount s P).eval qq * ((divisorProbability s P.d.val).eval qq *
      (lawCoeff (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))) σ).eval qq)
  have h1 : ∑ c : U.exitCells i, F c.1 =
      ∑ c : M.cellIndex, if M.IsSelfCell c then 0 else F c := by
    rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
    exact (Finset.sum_subtype _ (fun x => by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]; exact Iff.rfl) F).symm
  have h2 : (∑ c : M.cellIndex, if M.IsSelfCell c then 0 else F c) =
      ∑ P : M.allowedPattern, g P.1 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun P _ => ?_
    change ∑ D : patternDivisors (IsLocalRing.ResidueField M.R) s P.1,
        (if SelfPattern s P.1 then (0 : ℚ) else (divisorProbability s P.1.d.val).eval qq *
          (lawCoeff (lawProd ((children s P.1).map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))
              σ).eval qq)
        = g P.1
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
      U.divisor_count i hnt P.1 P.2]
    simp only [g]
    split_ifs
    · simp
    · simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff, mul_eq_zero]; left; rfl
  have h3 : ∑ P : M.allowedPattern, g P.1 = ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns s, g P :=
    (Finset.sum_subtype _ (fun x => by
      simp only [allowedPatterns, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact Iff.rfl) g).symm
  have h4 : (lawCoeff (exitLaw s) σ).eval qq = ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns s, g P := by
    unfold exitLaw
    rw [(law_coeff_flatMap _ _ _ [] [] σ qq).2.2, Finset.sum_map_toList]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun P _ => ?_
    simp only [g]
    split_ifs
    · exact (law_coeff_flatMap Unit [] (fun _ => []) [] [] σ qq).2.1
    · rw [law_coeff_scale]; change _ * _ * _ = _; ring
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans (h3.trans h4.symm))

name: SurfaceBlowup.exit_event_zero_mass
statement:
theorem exit_event_zero_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') (σ : FactorType) :
    (U.M i).μ (U.exitEvent σ 0 i) = densityValue (lawCoeff (exitLaw (U.M i).s) σ) (U.M i).q *
        (U.M i).μ (U.M i).stateSet ∧
    0 ≤ (lawCoeff (exitLaw (U.M i).s) σ).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) ∧
      MeasurableSet (U.exitEvent σ 0 i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hq, -, -, -, -⟩ := universe_basic_facts U i
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet (U.exitEvent σ 0 i) :=
    ((recursion_events_measurable U i hnt hIH) i rfl 0 σ).2.1
  set M := U.M i with hM
  set s := M.s with hs
  set qq : ℚ := (M.q : ℚ) with hqq
  
  let F : M.cellIndex → ℚ := fun c =>
    (divisorProbability s (M.cellDegree c)).eval qq *
      (lawCoeff (lawProd ((M.childList c).map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2))) σ).eval qq
  have hFnn : ∀ c : U.exitCells i, 0 ≤ F c.1 := by
    intro c
    exact mul_nonneg ((divisor_probability_pos M.q hq s _ 2 le_rfl).1.le)
      (exit_cell_coeff_nonneg U i hIH c σ)
  have hbox_sub : ∀ c σ', U.typeBox i c σ' ⊆ M.cell c := by
    intro c σ' x hx
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.typeBox, Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨τ, _, hx⟩ := hx
    exact hx.1
  have hbox_eq : ∀ c : U.exitCells i, U.typeBox i c.1 σ = U.exitEvent σ 0 i ∩ M.cell c.1 := by
    intro c
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨c, hx⟩, hbox_sub _ _ hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨hE, hc⟩
      obtain ⟨c', hx'⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hE
      by_cases h : c'.1 = c.1
      · rw [← h]; exact hx'
      · exact absurd (U.cells_disjoint i hnt h) (Set.not_disjoint_iff.2 ⟨x, hbox_sub _ _ hx', hc⟩)
  let : ∀ P, Fintype (patternDivisors (IsLocalRing.ResidueField M.R) s P) :=
    fun P => @Fintype.ofFinite _ (U.divisors_finite i P)
  let : Fintype (U.exitCells i) := by unfold SurfaceUniverse.exitCells; infer_instance
  have hsum : (M.μ (U.exitEvent σ 0 i)) = ∑ c : U.exitCells i, ENNReal.ofReal ((F c.1 : ℚ) : ℝ) *
      M.μ M.stateSet := by
    rw [show U.exitEvent σ 0 i = ⋃ c : U.exitCells i, U.typeBox i c.1 σ from rfl]
    rw [MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion, tsum_fintype]
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => exit_cell_type_mass U i hnt hIH c σ
    · intro c c' hcc'
      have hne : c.1 ≠ c'.1 := fun h => hcc' (Subtype.ext h)
      exact (U.cells_disjoint i hnt hne).mono (hbox_sub _ _) (hbox_sub _ _)
    · intro c
      rw [hbox_eq c]
      exact hmeas.inter (U.cell_measurable i hnt c.1)
  have hrat : ∑ c : U.exitCells i, F c.1 = (lawCoeff (exitLaw s) σ).eval qq :=
    exit_cell_weight_sum U i hnt σ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hmeas⟩
  · rw [hsum, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg
      (fun c _ => by exact_mod_cast hFnn c)]
    change _ = ENNReal.ofReal (((lawCoeff (exitLaw s) σ).eval qq : ℚ) : ℝ) * _
    rw [← hrat]
    push_cast
    rfl
  · rw [← hrat]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun c _ => hFnn c

name: SurfaceBlowup.recursion_crossing_law
statement:
theorem recursion_crossing_law (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (a b c h : ℕ)
    (hs : (U.M i).s = State.crossing a b c h)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') :
    U.LawStatement i
proof:
:= by
  have hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false := by rw [hs]; rfl
  have hv : (U.M i).s.Valid := (U.M i).valid
  have h560 := (single_state_return_chain U i hnt)
  have h551 := (state_law_unfold _ hv hnt).2 a b c h hs
  refine ⟨fun σ => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e := ((h560 σ).2 a b c h hs).1
    obtain ⟨m, nn, ms⟩ := exit_event_zero_mass U i hnt hIH σ
    rw [e, h551]
    exact ⟨ms, nn, m⟩
  · have e := ((h560 (default)).2 a b c h hs).2
    rw [e]
    exact (recursion_events_measurable U i hnt hIH i rfl 0 default).2.2.1
  · exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null
      ((nonterminating_subset_return_or_bad U i hnt).2 a b c h hs)
      (bad_exit_null U i hnt hIH 0 i rfl)

name: SurfaceBlowup.return_event_mass
statement:
theorem return_event_mass (U : SurfaceUniverse) (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ i : U.ι, (U.M i).s = State.single a c →
    (U.M i).μ (U.returnEvent k i) = densityValue ((returnWeight c).pow k) (U.M i).q * (U.M i).μ
        (U.M i).stateSet ∧
    MeasurableSet (U.returnEvent k i)
proof:
:= by
  have hvalid : (State.single a c).Valid := ⟨ha, by omega⟩
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i hs
    obtain ⟨hq, -, -, -, -⟩ := universe_basic_facts U i
    refine ⟨?_, U.stateSet_measurable i⟩
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.returnEvent, Expr.pow]
    rw [(density_value_arith (U.M i).q hq (.const 1) (.const 1) (by norm_num [Expr.eval])
      (by norm_num [Expr.eval]) 0 _ hvalid).2.2.2.1, one_mul]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hs
    obtain ⟨hq, -, -, -, -⟩ := universe_basic_facts U i
    obtain ⟨hmass, hmeas⟩ := self_cells_union_mass U ha hc i hs (U.returnEvent k)
      (densityValue ((returnWeight c).pow k) (U.M i).q) fun i' hs' hq' ↦ by
        rw [← hq']; exact ih i' hs'
    refine ⟨hmass.trans ?_, hmeas⟩
    have hy := (return_weight_bounds _ c hq hc).1.le
    rw [Expr.pow, (density_value_arith (U.M i).q hq _ _ (eval_pow_nonneg _ _ hy k) hy 0 _
      hvalid).1]
    ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.never_return_null
statement:
theorem never_return_null (U : SurfaceUniverse) (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c) (i : U.ι)
    (hs : (U.M i).s = State.single a c) :
    (U.M i).μ (⋂ k, U.returnEvent k i) = 0 ∧ MeasurableSet (⋂ k, U.returnEvent k i)
proof:
:= by
  have hmass := fun k => return_event_mass U a c ha hc k i hs
  refine ⟨?_, MeasurableSet.iInter fun k => (hmass k).2⟩
  obtain ⟨hq, -, hfin, -⟩ := universe_basic_facts U i
  obtain ⟨hpos, -, hlt⟩ := return_weight_bounds (U.M i).q c hq hc
  have hlt' : ENNReal.ofReal (((returnWeight c).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ) < 1 := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_one]; exact_mod_cast hlt
  have hle : ∀ k, (U.M i).μ (⋂ k, U.returnEvent k i) ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal (((returnWeight c).eval ((U.M i).q : ℚ) : ℚ) : ℝ)) ^ k * (U.M i).μ
          (U.M i).stateSet := by
    intro k
    refine (MeasureTheory.measure_mono (Set.iInter_subset _ k)).trans ?_
    rw [(hmass k).1, densityValue, expression_pow_eval, ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow
        (by exact_mod_cast hpos.le)]
    norm_cast
  have ht := ENNReal.Tendsto.mul_const (ENNReal.tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hlt')
    (Or.inr hfin)
  rw [zero_mul] at ht
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' ht hle) zero_le

name: SurfaceBlowup.recursion_single_law
statement:
theorem recursion_single_law (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (a c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c)
    (hs : (U.M i).s = State.single a c)
    (hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i') :
    U.LawStatement i
proof:
:= by
  have hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false := by
    rw [hs]; obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ : ∃ c', c = c' + 2 := ⟨c - 2, by omega⟩; rfl
  have hv : (U.M i).s.Valid := (U.M i).valid
  have ha : 0 < a := by rw [hs] at hv; exact hv.1
  have h560 := single_state_return_chain U i hnt
  have h551 := (state_law_unfold _ hv hnt).1 a c hs
  have hq := (universe_basic_facts U i).1
  obtain ⟨hl0, -, hl1⟩ := return_weight_bounds _ c hq hc
  refine ⟨fun σ => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · set q₀ := (U.M i).q with hq₀
    set lam : ℚ := (returnWeight c).eval (q₀ : ℚ) with hlam
    set G : ℚ := (lawCoeff (exitLaw (State.single a c)) σ).eval (q₀ : ℚ) with hGdef
    have hG : 0 ≤ G := by
      have := (exit_event_zero_mass U i hnt hIH σ).2.1
      rwa [hs] at this
    have hexit : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s = State.single a c → (U.M i').q = q₀ →
        (U.M i').μ (U.exitEvent σ 0 i') = ENNReal.ofReal (G : ℝ) * (U.M i').μ (U.M i').stateSet
          ∧ MeasurableSet (U.exitEvent σ 0 i') := by
      intro i' hs' hq'
      have hnt' : (U.M i').s.terminal = false := by rw [hs', ← hs]; exact hnt
      have hIH' : ∀ j : U.ι, (U.M j).s.rank < (U.M i').s.rank → U.LawStatement j := by
        rw [hs', ← hs]; exact hIH
      obtain ⟨m, -, ms⟩ := exit_event_zero_mass U i' hnt' hIH' σ
      rw [hs', hq'] at m
      exact ⟨m, ms⟩
    have hk := fun k => exit_event_succ_mass U a c ha hc σ q₀ G hexit k i hs rfl
    obtain ⟨e, hdisj, -⟩ := (h560 σ).1 a c hs
    have hcoef : (lawCoeff (stateLaw (U.M i).s) σ).eval (q₀ : ℚ) = (1 - lam)⁻¹ * G := by
      rw [h551, law_coeff_scale, hs]
      simp only [Expr.eval, Expr.sub, Expr.neg, neg_mul, one_mul, hlam, hGdef]
      ring
    have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < 1 - lam := by linarith
    rw [e, hcoef]
    refine ⟨MeasurableSet.iUnion fun k => (hk k).2, by positivity, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion hdisj fun k => (hk k).2]
    simp only [fun k => (hk k).1]
    rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, densityValue, ← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg]
    · congr 2
      have := geometric_exit_sum (lam : ℝ) (G : ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast hl0.le)
        (by exact_mod_cast hl1)
      rw [hcoef]
      push_cast
      rw [this.tsum_eq]
      field_simp
    · intro k; push_cast; positivity
    · have := geometric_exit_sum (lam : ℝ) (G : ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast hl0.le)
        (by exact_mod_cast hl1)
      push_cast
      exact this.summable
  · rw [((h560 default).1 a c hs).2.2]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun k =>
      (recursion_events_measurable U i hnt hIH i rfl k default).2.2.1
  · refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null
      ((nonterminating_subset_return_or_bad U i hnt).1 a c hs) ?_
    refine MeasureTheory.measure_union_null
      (never_return_null U a c ha hc i hs).1 ?_
    exact MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null fun k =>
      bad_exit_null U i hnt hIH k i rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.universal_law_statement
statement:
theorem universal_law_statement (U : SurfaceUniverse) :
    ∀ i : U.ι, U.LawStatement i
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ i : U.ι, (U.M i).s.rank = n → U.LawStatement i := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ n ih =>
      intro i hn
      have hIH : ∀ i' : U.ι, (U.M i').s.rank < (U.M i).s.rank → U.LawStatement i' :=
        fun i' h => ih _ (hn ▸ h) i' rfl
      have hv := (U.M i).valid
      generalize hs : (U.M i).s = s at hv
      cases s with
      | single a c =>
        by_cases h1 : c = 1
        · subst h1
          exact recursion_terminal_law U i (by rw [hs]; rfl)
        · have : 2 ≤ c := by
            have := hv.2; omega
          exact recursion_single_law U i a c this hs hIH
      | crossing a b c h =>
        exact recursion_crossing_law U i a b c h hs hIH
  exact fun i => key _ i rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.type_event_null_difference
statement:
theorem type_event_null_difference (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (σ : FactorType) :
    MeasurableSet (U.termTypeEvent i σ) ∧ U.termTypeEvent i σ ⊆ U.typeEvent i σ ∧
    U.typeEvent i σ ⊆ U.termTypeEvent i σ ∪ U.nonterminatingSet i ∧
    (U.M i).μ (U.nonterminatingSet i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := universal_law_statement U i
  refine ⟨(h.1 σ).1, Set.inter_subset_left, ?_, h.2.2⟩
  intro J hJ
  by_cases ht : J ∈ U.terminatingSet i
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hJ, ht⟩
  · refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ht⟩
    exact hJ.1

name: SurfaceBlowup.etale_type_event_measurable
statement:
theorem etale_type_event_measurable (U : SurfaceUniverse)
    (hE1 : U.ChildTypesExist) (δ : ∀ i : U.ι, Ideal (U.M i).R → ℕ) (hE2 : U.InvariantDecreases δ)
    (i : U.ι) (σ : FactorType) :
    MeasurableSet (U.typeEvent i σ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [etale_type_event_eq_term U hE1 δ hE2 i σ]
  exact (type_event_null_difference U i σ).1

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_generic_fibre_ascent
statement:
theorem unramified_generic_fibre_ascent (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ)
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi)) (B : Type)
    [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] [Algebra Oδ B] [IsScalarTower O Oδ B] (ι : Type)
    (L : ι → Type) [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra (BaseField O) (L i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) (L i)]
    (e : TensorProduct O (BaseField O) B ≃ₐ[BaseField O] (∀ i, L i)) :
    ∃ (_ : ∀ i, Algebra (BaseField Oδ) (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra Oδ (L i))
        (_ : ∀ i, IsScalarTower Oδ (BaseField Oδ) (L i))
        (_ : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional (BaseField Oδ) (L i))
        (_ : TensorProduct Oδ (BaseField Oδ) B ≃ₐ[BaseField Oδ] (∀ i, L i)),
    ∀ i (c : O),
    algebraMap Oδ (L i) (algebraMap O Oδ c) = algebraMap (BaseField O) (L i)
        (algebraMap O (BaseField O) c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hfr⟩ := unramified_fraction_base_change O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ
  set K := BaseField O
  set Kδ := BaseField Oδ
  let rA : Algebra Oδ (TensorProduct O K Oδ) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  
  let c : TensorProduct O K Oδ ≃ₐ[Oδ] TensorProduct O Oδ K :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O K Oδ).toRingEquiv) (by
      intro x
      change (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O K Oδ) ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ x) = x ⊗ₜ (1 : K)
      simp)
  have : IsFractionRing Oδ (TensorProduct O Oδ K) := IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv _ c
  let ψ : Kδ ≃ₐ[Oδ] TensorProduct O Oδ K :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors Oδ) Kδ (TensorProduct O Oδ K)
  let Θ : TensorProduct Oδ Kδ B ≃+* TensorProduct O K B :=
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm Oδ Kδ B).toRingEquiv.trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl : B ≃ₐ[Oδ] B) ψ).toRingEquiv).trans
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange O Oδ Oδ B K).toRingEquiv.trans
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O B K).toRingEquiv)
  let E₀ : TensorProduct Oδ Kδ B ≃+* (∀ i, L i) := Θ.trans e.toRingEquiv
  let f : ∀ i, Kδ →+* L i := fun i =>
    (Pi.evalRingHom L i).comp (E₀.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom)
  let iA : ∀ i, Algebra Kδ (L i) := fun i => (f i).toAlgebra
  let iB : ∀ i, Algebra Oδ (L i) := fun i => ((algebraMap Kδ (L i)).comp
      (algebraMap Oδ Kδ)).toAlgebra
  have iC : ∀ i, IsScalarTower Oδ Kδ (L i) := fun i => IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ => rfl)
  let φ : K →+* Kδ := ψ.symm.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
  let : Algebra K Kδ := φ.toAlgebra
  have hΘ : ∀ k : K, Θ (φ k ⊗ₜ 1) = k ⊗ₜ 1 := by
    intro k
    simp [Θ, φ]
  have : ∀ i, IsScalarTower K Kδ (L i) := fun i => IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun k => by
    change algebraMap K (L i) k = (e (Θ (φ k ⊗ₜ 1))) i
    rw [hΘ]
    have := e.commutes k
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply] at this
    rw [this]
    rfl)
  have iD : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional Kδ (L i) := fun i => Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite K Kδ
      (L i)
  refine ⟨iA, iB, iC, iD, AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := E₀) ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun r => rfl
  
  have hφO : ∀ c : O, φ (algebraMap O K c) = algebraMap Oδ Kδ (algebraMap O Oδ c) := by
    intro c
    change ψ.symm (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (algebraMap O K c)) = _
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O Oδ (TensorProduct O Oδ K)]
    exact ψ.symm.commutes _
  intro i c
  change algebraMap Kδ (L i) (algebraMap Oδ Kδ (algebraMap O Oδ c)) = algebraMap K (L i)
      (algebraMap O K c)
  rw [← hφO, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K Kδ (L i)]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_index_map_reindexed
statement:
theorem concrete_index_map_reindexed (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (ResidueField O)]
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta) (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (G : GluedGenerators (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    beta (curveDataDegree D)) (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) j f = (cechInputLattice (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair
    (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) G j))
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span
    {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b))^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j) (n : ℕ) (e : Fin n ≃ AllPoints D)
    (B : Fin n → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)]
    (eB : ∀ j, B j ≃+* (localRing D (e j) ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D (e j)}))
    (hB : ∀ (j : Fin n) (c : O), (eB j) (algebraMap O (B j) c) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {localCurve D (e j)}) (localFromSurface D (e j)
    (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c))) :
    ∃ ψ : ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₐ[O] ∀ j, B j, Function.Injective ψ ∧
      Module.length O ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) =
      (chooseTwo (curveDataDegree D) : ℕ∞) ∧ ∀ (r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (j : Fin n),
      (eB j) (ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) r) j) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {localCurve D (e j)}) (localFromSurface D (e j) r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hker, hlen⟩ := concrete_curve_order_index O pi hpi u a b ha beta D f G hf hG
  let _ : ∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p) := fun p =>
    ((localFromSurface D p).comp (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).toAlgebra
  set χ := childOrderMap D with hχ
  let E : childOrder D ≃+* ∀ j, B j :=
    (RingEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun p => localRing D p ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D p}) e).symm.trans
      (RingEquiv.piCongrRight fun j => (eB j).symm)
  have hE : ∀ x j, E x j = (eB j).symm (x (e j)) := fun x j => rfl
  have hχapp : ∀ r p, χ r p = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {localCurve D p})
      (localFromSurface D p r) :=
    fun r p => rfl
  have hEalg : ∀ (c : O) (j : Fin n), E (algebraMap O (childOrder D) c) j = algebraMap O (B j)
      c := by
    intro c j
    rw [hE]
    apply (eB j).injective
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hB]
    rfl
  have hsub : Ideal.span {f} ≤ RingHom.ker (E.toRingHom.comp χ) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [← hker] at hr
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply] at hr ⊢
    rw [hr, map_zero]
  let ψ₀ : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {f} →+* ∀ j, B j :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift (Ideal.span {f}) (E.toRingHom.comp χ) (fun r hr => hsub hr)
  have hψ₀ : ∀ r, ψ₀ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r) = E (χ r) := fun r => rfl
  let ψ : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₐ[O] ∀ j, B j :=
    { ψ₀ with
      commutes' := by
        intro c
        change ψ₀ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap O _ c)) = _
        rw [hψ₀]
        funext j
        rw [Pi.algebraMap_apply, ← hEalg]
        congr 2 }
  have hψ : ∀ r, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r) = E (χ r) := fun r => rfl
  let L : childOrder D ≃ₗ[O] ∀ j, B j :=
    { E.toAddEquiv with
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        funext j
        change E (c • x) j = c • E x j
        rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, Pi.mul_apply, hEalg] }
  have hL : ∀ x, L x = E x := fun x => rfl
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    rw [hψ, hψ] at hxy
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← hker, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, E.injective hxy, sub_self]
  · have hrange : LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap = (LinearMap.range φ).map L.toLinearMap := by
      ext y
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_map]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
        exact ⟨φ r, ⟨r, rfl⟩, by rw [hφ]; rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨r, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r, by rw [hφ]; rfl⟩
    rw [← hlen]
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ L hrange.symm).symm.length_eq
  · intro r j
    rw [hψ, hE, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_data_vertical_perturbation
statement:
theorem division_data_vertical_perturbation (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (f : R) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap f b w) [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)]
    (h : R) :
    ∃ E' : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R), ∀ w, E'.symm w = divisionMap (f + pi • h) b w
proof:
:= by
  set M := (Fin n → O) × R
  let r0 : M →ₗ[O] M := E.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.mulRight O h) ∘ₗ LinearMap.snd O (Fin n → O) R
  let rL : M →ₗ[O] M := pi • r0
  have hr : RaisesAdicOrder (Ideal.span {pi}) (rL : M → M) := by
    intro j x y hxy
    have h1 := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O M M (Ideal.span {pi}) r0 j x y hxy
    unfold adicCongr at h1 ⊢
    have : rL x - rL y = pi • (r0 x - r0 y) := by
      simp [rL, smul_sub]
    rw [this, pow_succ', Submodule.mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self pi) h1
  have hbij := adic_perturb_bijective O M (Ideal.span {pi}) (rL : M → M) hr
  let L : M →ₗ[O] R := E.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.id + rL)
  have hL : ∀ w, L w = divisionMap (f + pi • h) b w := by
    intro w
    simp only [L, rL, r0, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, map_add, map_smul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
      LinearMap.mulRight_apply]
    rw [hE]
    unfold divisionMap
    rw [add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_comm h]
    abel
  have hLb : Function.Bijective L := by
    have : (L : M → R) = E.symm ∘ adicPerturb (rL : M → M) := by
      funext w; simp [L, adicPerturb]
    rw [this]
    exact E.symm.bijective.comp hbij
  refine ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofBijective L hLb).symm, fun w => ?_⟩
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_symm, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply, hL]

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_quotient_basis_equiv
statement:
theorem division_quotient_basis_equiv (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (f : R) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap f b w) :
    ∃ EB : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ≃ₗ[O] (Fin n → O), ∀ z : Fin n → O, EB.symm z = Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {f}) (coordinateLift b z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨EC, hEC⟩ := division_equiv_child_coordinates O R n f b E hE
  refine ⟨EC, fun z => ?_⟩
  have h : E.symm (z, 0) = coordinateLift b z := by
    rw [hE]; simp [divisionMap]
  have h2 : E (coordinateLift b z) = (z, 0) := by rw [← h]; exact E.apply_symm_apply _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, hEC, h2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisor_affine_polynomial_normalized_factors
statement:
theorem divisor_affine_polynomial_normalized_factors (k : Type) [Field k]
    (D : ExceptionalDivisor k) :
    (divisorAffinePolynomial k D).Monic ∧ ∀ φ : AffineDirection k, Multiset.count φ.val
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (divisorAffinePolynomial k D)) = D (some φ)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ClosedDirection k → ℕ → Polynomial k := fun P r =>
    match P with | none => 1 | some phi => phi.val ^ r
  have hg : ∀ P r, (g P r).Monic := by
    intro P r
    cases P with
    | none => exact Polynomial.monic_one
    | some phi => exact phi.property.1.pow r
  have hg0 : ∀ P r, g P r ≠ 0 := fun P r => (hg P r).ne_zero
  have hprod : divisorAffinePolynomial k D = ∏ P ∈ D.support, g P (D P) := rfl
  have key : ∀ s : Finset (ClosedDirection k),
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (∏ P ∈ s, g P (D P)) =
        ∑ P ∈ s, UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (g P (D P)) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha,
        UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_mul (hg0 _ _)
          (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => hg0 _ _), ih]
  have hnf : ∀ ψ : AffineDirection k, ∀ r,
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (g (some ψ) r) = r • {ψ.val} := by
    intro ψ r
    change UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (ψ.val ^ r) = _
    rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_pow,
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_irreducible ψ.property.2,
      (Polynomial.Monic.normalize_eq_self ψ.property.1)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hprod]
    exact Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun P _ => hg _ _
  · intro φ
    rw [hprod, key, Multiset.count_sum']
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (some φ)]
    · rw [hnf]; simp
    · intro P _ hP
      cases P with
      | none => simp [g]
      | some ψ =>
        rw [hnf]
        have : ψ.val ≠ φ.val := fun h => hP (by rw [Subtype.val_injective h])
        simp [Ne.symm this]
    · intro h
      rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp h]
      simp [g]

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisor_degree_pattern_weight
statement:
private theorem divisor_degree_pattern_weight (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k) (n : ℕ) (hdeg : ∀ Q, 0 < Dv Q → directionDegree k Q ≤ n)
    (hmult : ∀ Q, Dv Q ≤ n) :
    exceptionalDegree k Dv = Dv (infinityDirection k) +
      (match s with
        | State.single _ _ => (0 : ℕ)
        | State.crossing _ _ _ _ => Dv (zeroDirection k)) +
      ∑ ij : Fin n × Fin n, (ij.1.val + 1) * (ij.2.val + 1) *
        Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
          directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧ Dv Q = ij.2.val + 1}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpos : ∀ Q, 1 ≤ directionDegree k Q := by
    intro Q
    rcases Q with _ | φ
    · simp [directionDegree]
    · exact φ.2.2.natDegree_pos
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBsum⟩ : ∃ B : Finset (ClosedDirection k),
      (∀ Q, Q ∈ boundaryDirections k s ↔ Q ∈ B) ∧
      ∑ Q ∈ B, directionDegree k Q * Dv Q = Dv (infinityDirection k) +
        (match s with
          | State.single _ _ => (0 : ℕ)
          | State.crossing _ _ _ _ => Dv (zeroDirection k)) := by
    cases s with
    | single _ _ =>
      exact ⟨{infinityDirection k}, fun Q => by simp [boundaryDirections],
        by simp [infinityDirection, directionDegree]⟩
    | crossing _ _ _ _ =>
      refine ⟨{infinityDirection k, zeroDirection k}, fun Q => by simp [boundaryDirections], ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_pair (by simp [infinityDirection, zeroDirection])]
      simp [infinityDirection, zeroDirection, directionDegree]
  set f : ClosedDirection k → ℕ := fun Q => directionDegree k Q * Dv Q with hf
  have hdegsum : exceptionalDegree k Dv = ∑ Q ∈ Dv.support, f Q := rfl
  rw [hdegsum, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Dv.support (fun Q => Q ∈ B)]
  congr 1
  · rw [← hBsum]
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro Q hQ; exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hQ).2
    · intro Q _ hQ
      have : Dv Q = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hQ (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h, by assumption⟩)
      simp [f, this]
  · rcases n with _ | m
    · have : ∀ Q, Dv Q = 0 := fun Q => Nat.le_zero.1 (hmult Q)
      simp [this]
    · set g : ClosedDirection k → Fin (m+1) × Fin (m+1) :=
        fun Q => (⟨(directionDegree k Q - 1) % (m+1), Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos _)⟩,
          ⟨(Dv Q - 1) % (m+1), Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos _)⟩)
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := Dv.support.filter (fun Q => Q ∉ B))
        (t := Finset.univ) (g := g) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ij _
      have hmem : ∀ Q, Q ∈ (Dv.support.filter (fun Q => Q ∉ B)).filter (fun Q => g Q = ij) ↔
          (Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧ directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧ Dv Q = ij.2.val +
              1) := by
        intro Q
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hB, g, Prod.ext_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
        have h1 := hpos Q
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hne, hnb⟩, ha, hb⟩
          have hd := hdeg Q (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne)
          have hm := hmult Q
          rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at ha hb
          exact ⟨hnb, by omega, by omega⟩
        · rintro ⟨hnb, ha, hb⟩
          refine ⟨⟨by omega, hnb⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [ha, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ij.1.2]
          · rw [hb, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ij.2.2]
      rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun Q => (hmem Q).symm)),
        Nat.card_eq_finsetCard, Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ => (ij.1.val + 1) *
            (ij.2.val + 1)),
        Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      intro Q hQ
      obtain ⟨_, ha, hb⟩ := (hmem Q).1 hQ
      simp [f, ha, hb]

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_le_of_weighted_sum_eq
statement:
private theorem card_le_of_weighted_sum_eq {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (w c : ι → ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (e x y : ℕ) (hid : e = x + y + ∑ i, w i * c i) (i : ι) : c i ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i ↦ w i * c i) (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (c i) (hw i)
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.allowed_pattern_of_divisor
statement:
theorem allowed_pattern_of_divisor (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State) (hs : s.Valid)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hdeg : exceptionalDegree k Dv = d)
    (hQ : ∀ Q, 0 < Dv Q → directionDegree k Q ≤ d) (hmult : ∀ Q, Dv Q ≤ d)
    (hcontact : DivisorContactCondition k s Dv d) :
    ∃ P : TangentPattern s.degree, P.d.val = d ∧ Allowed s P ∧ HasPattern k s Dv P
proof:
:= by
  have hdn : d ≤ s.degree := by
    revert hs hcontact
    cases s with
    | single a c =>
      rintro ⟨ha, -⟩ ⟨h1, -⟩
      change d ≤ a * c
      nlinarith
    | crossing a b c h =>
      rintro ⟨ha, -⟩ ⟨h1, -⟩
      change d ≤ a * c + b * h
      nlinarith
  have hid := divisor_degree_pattern_weight k s Dv s.degree
      (fun Q hQ' => (hQ Q hQ').trans hdn) (fun Q => (hmult Q).trans hdn)
  have hcb := card_le_of_weighted_sum_eq _ _ (fun _ ↦ by positivity) _ _ _ hid
  rw [hdeg] at hid hcb
  have hcb' : ∀ ij : Fin s.degree × Fin s.degree, Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k //
      Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧ directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧ Dv Q = ij.2.val + 1}
      ≤ s.degree := fun ij => (hcb ij).trans hdn
  clear hcb
  revert hcontact hid hcb' hdn
  cases s with
  | single a c =>
    intro hcontact hdn hid hcb
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcontact
    refine ⟨⟨⟨d, by omega⟩,
      ⟨Dv (infinityDirection k), by have := hmult (infinityDirection k); omega⟩,
      ⟨0, by omega⟩, fun ij => ⟨_, hcb ij |> Nat.lt_succ_of_le⟩⟩, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hd, ?_, h1, rfl, h2⟩
      simp only [patternWeight]
      simp only at hid
      omega
    · exact ⟨hdeg, rfl, trivial, fun ij => rfl⟩
  | crossing a b c h =>
    intro hcontact hdn hid hcb
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hcontact
    refine ⟨⟨⟨d, by omega⟩,
      ⟨Dv (infinityDirection k), by have := hmult (infinityDirection k); omega⟩,
      ⟨Dv (zeroDirection k), by have := hmult (zeroDirection k); omega⟩,
      fun ij => ⟨_, hcb ij |> Nat.lt_succ_of_le⟩⟩, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hd, ?_, h1, h3, h2, h4⟩
      simp only [patternWeight]
      simp only at hid
      omega
    · exact ⟨hdeg, rfl, rfl, fun ij => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.equiv_of_fiber_card_eq
statement:
theorem equiv_of_fiber_card_eq (α β γ : Type) [Finite α] [Finite β] (f : α → γ) (g : β → γ)
    (h : ∀ c : γ, Nat.card {x : α // f x = c} = Nat.card {y : β // g y = c}) :
    ∃ e : α ≃ β, ∀ x, g (e x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∀ c, {x : α // f x = c} ≃ {y : β // g y = c} := fun c => by
    haveI : Fintype {x : α // f x = c} := Fintype.ofFinite _
    haveI : Fintype {y : β // g y = c} := Fintype.ofFinite _
    exact Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using h c)
  exact ⟨Equiv.ofFiberEquiv e, fun x => Equiv.ofFiberEquiv_map e x⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.full_rank_free_submodule_finite_length
statement:
theorem full_rank_free_submodule_finite_length (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Finite (ResidueField O)] (N : Type) [AddCommGroup N] [Module O N]
    [Module.Finite O N] [Module.Free O N] (M : Submodule O N) [Module.Finite O M] [Module.Free O M]
    (hrank : Module.finrank O M = Module.finrank O N) :
    Module.length O (N ⧸ M) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hr := rank_quotient_add_rank_of_isDomain M
  rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, ← Module.finrank_eq_rank, ← Module.finrank_eq_rank, hrank] at hr
  norm_cast at hr
  have h0 : Module.finrank O (N ⧸ M) = 0 := by omega
  have htor : Module.IsTorsion O (N ⧸ M) := (Module.finrank_eq_zero_iff_isTorsion).mp h0
  obtain ⟨a, haI, ha0⟩ := Submodule.annihilator_top_inter_nonZeroDivisors htor
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero ha0
  set I := (⊤ : Submodule O (N ⧸ M)).annihilator
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  obtain ⟨k, u, rfl⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible ha hπ
  have hle : (maximalIdeal O) ^ k ≤ I := by
    rw [hπ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    have := I.mul_mem_left (↑u⁻¹ : O) haI
    simpa [← mul_assoc] using this
  have hQ : Finite (O ⧸ (maximalIdeal O) ^ k) := by
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    rw [residue_quotient_card]
    have : Nat.card (ResidueField O) ≠ 0 := Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    exact pow_ne_zero _ this
  have hI : Finite (O ⧸ I) := Finite.of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hle)
  let _ := (Module.isTorsionBySet_annihilator_top O (N ⧸ M)).module
  have : Module.Finite (O ⧸ I) (N ⧸ M) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite O _ _
  have : Finite (N ⧸ M) := Module.finite_of_finite (O ⧸ I)
  exact Module.length_ne_top

name: SurfaceBlowup.global_function_of_two_chart_curve_data
statement:
theorem global_function_of_two_chart_curve_data (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {t,x}) R]
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) (d : ℕ)
    (FA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x) (hFA : ∀ j : ℕ, leftLevelKernel D j = Ideal.span
    {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^j) (FA j)}) (FB : ℕ → BlowupChart R x t)
    (hFB : ∀ j : ℕ, rightLevelKernel D j = Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk
    ((Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x})^j) (FB j)}) (hnorm : ∃ u : Rˣ,
    (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (FA 1) - algebraMap R
    (BlowupOverlap R t x) (u : R) * ((overlapSlope R t x)^d * beta.right (FB 1)) ∈
    (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})) :
    ∃ f : R, ∃ G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d, (∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f =
      (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j)) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span
      {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span
      {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := glued_generators_of_two_chart_curve_data R t x beta D hreg hregSwap d FA hFA FB
      hFB hnorm
  obtain ⟨f, hf, _⟩ := glued_function_exists_unique R t x beta d G hreg hregSwap
  exact ⟨f, G, hf, hG⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.has_multiplicity_initial_form
statement:
theorem has_multiplicity_initial_form (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t x : R)
    (hmax : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t, x}) (d : ℕ) (f : R) (hf : f ∈ (maximalIdeal R) ^ d)
    (hf' : f ∉ (maximalIdeal R) ^ (d + 1)) :
    ∃ c : Fin (d+1) → R, f = (∑ i : Fin (d+1), c i * t^(d - i.val) * x^i.val) ∧ ∃ i₀ : Fin (d+1), c
      i₀ ∉ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [hmax] at hf
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := monomial_span_pow R t x d f hf
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  apply hf'
  rw [hc]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
  have ht : t ∈ maximalIdeal R := hmax ▸ Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := hmax ▸ Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have h1 : t^(d - i.val) * x^i.val ∈ (maximalIdeal R)^d := by
    have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ht (d - i.val)) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hx i.val)
    rwa [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)] at this
  rw [mul_assoc, pow_succ']
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hcon i) h1

name: SurfaceBlowup.homogeneous_divisor_of_polynomial
statement:
theorem homogeneous_divisor_of_polynomial (k : Type) [Field k] (d : ℕ) (H : Polynomial k)
    (hH : H ≠ 0) (hdeg : H.natDegree ≤ d) :
    ∃ Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k, HasHomogeneousDivisor k d H Dv ∧ Dv (infinityDirection k) = d -
      H.natDegree ∧ (∀ φ : AffineDirection k, Dv (some φ) = Multiset.count φ.val
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors H)) ∧ exceptionalDegree k Dv = d
proof:
:= by
  set F := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors H with hF
  have hmon : ∀ ψ ∈ F, ψ.Monic := fun ψ hψ =>
    Polynomial.normalize_eq_self_iff_monic
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_normalized_factor ψ hψ).ne_zero |>.mp
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalize_normalized_factor ψ hψ)
  have hirr : ∀ ψ ∈ F, Irreducible ψ := fun ψ hψ =>
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_normalized_factor ψ hψ
  let g : {ψ // ψ ∈ F} → ClosedDirection k := fun ψ => some ⟨ψ.1, hmon ψ.1 ψ.2, hirr ψ.1 ψ.2⟩
  let M : Multiset (ClosedDirection k) := F.attach.map g
  have hMmap : M.map (Option.map Subtype.val) = F.map some := by
    simp only [M, Multiset.map_map]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Multiset.attach_map_val F, Multiset.map_map]
    rfl
  have hMsum : Multiset.toFinsupp M = (M.map fun Q => Finsupp.single Q 1).sum := by
    induction M using Multiset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | cons a s ih => rw [← Multiset.singleton_add, Multiset.toFinsupp_add, ih]; simp
  have hprod : F.prod = Polynomial.C H.leadingCoeff⁻¹ * H := by
    rw [UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors_eq hH, normalize_apply,
      Polynomial.coe_normUnit, mul_comm]
    simp [hH]
  have hdegF : F.prod.natDegree = H.natDegree := by
    rw [hprod, Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul (inv_ne_zero (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hH))]
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single none (d - H.natDegree) + Multiset.toFinsupp M, ⟨hH, hdeg, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_,
      ?_⟩
  · simp [M, g]
  · have key : ∀ (f : ClosedDirection k → ℕ → Polynomial k), (∀ P, f P 0 = 1) →
        (∀ P a b, f P (a + b) = f P a * f P b) → ∀ L : Multiset (Finsupp (ClosedDirection k) ℕ),
          L.sum.prod f = (L.map fun G => G.prod f).prod := by
      intro f hf0 hfa L
      induction L using Multiset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | cons a s ih =>
        rw [Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, Finsupp.prod_add_index' hf0
            hfa, ih]
    have hP : divisorAffinePolynomial k (Finsupp.single none (d - H.natDegree) + Multiset.toFinsupp
        M) = F.prod := by
      unfold divisorAffinePolynomial
      rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun P => by cases P <;> simp)
          (fun P a b => by cases P <;> simp [pow_add]),
        Finsupp.prod_single_index (by simp), hMsum,
        key _ (fun P => by cases P <;> simp) (fun P a b => by cases P <;> simp [pow_add])]
      simp only [M, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def]
      rw [one_mul]
      conv_rhs => rw [← Multiset.attach_map_val F]
      congr 1
      apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
      intro ψ _
      rw [Finsupp.prod_single_index (by simp [g])]
      simp [g]
    rw [hP, hprod, ← mul_assoc, ← Polynomial.C_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hH), Polynomial.C_1, one_mul]
  · simp [infinityDirection, M, g]
  · intro φ
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, reduceCtorEq, if_false, zero_add,
      Multiset.toFinsupp_apply]
    rw [← Multiset.count_map_eq_count' (Option.map Subtype.val) M
      (Option.map_injective Subtype.val_injective), hMmap]
    exact Multiset.count_map_eq_count' _ _ (Option.some_injective _) _
  · unfold exceptionalDegree
    have h0 : ∀ P : ClosedDirection k, directionDegree k P * 0 = 0 := fun _ => mul_zero _
    have ha : ∀ (P : ClosedDirection k) (a b : ℕ),
        directionDegree k P * (a + b) = directionDegree k P * a + directionDegree k P * b :=
      fun _ _ _ => mul_add _ _ _
