    rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index' h0 ha, Finsupp.sum_single_index (by simp), hMsum,
      Finsupp.multiset_sum_sum_index _ _ h0 ha]
    simp only [directionDegree, one_mul, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_apply, mul_zero,
      Finsupp.sum_single_index, mul_one, Multiset.attach_map_val', M, g]
    rw [← Polynomial.natDegree_multiset_prod_of_monic F hmon, hdegF]
    omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.homogeneous_divisor_boundary_multiplicities
statement:
theorem homogeneous_divisor_boundary_multiplicities (k : Type) [Field k] (d : ℕ) (H : Polynomial k)
    (hH : H ≠ 0) (hdeg : H.natDegree ≤ d) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k)
    (hinf : Dv (infinityDirection k) = d - H.natDegree) (haff : ∀ φ : AffineDirection k, Dv (some φ)
    = Multiset.count φ.val (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors H)) :
    (0 < Dv (infinityDirection k) ↔ H.coeff d = 0) ∧ (0 < Dv (zeroDirection k) ↔ H.coeff 0 = 0) ∧
      (∀ Q : ClosedDirection k, Dv Q ≤ d) ∧ ∀ Q : ClosedDirection k, 0 < Dv Q → directionDegree k Q
      ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D', -, hi', ha', hd'⟩ := homogeneous_divisor_of_polynomial k d H hH hdeg
  have heq : Dv = D' := by
    ext Q
    cases Q with
    | none => exact hinf.trans hi'.symm
    | some φ => exact (haff φ).trans (ha' φ).symm
  subst heq
  have hdpos : ∀ Q : ClosedDirection k, 1 ≤ directionDegree k Q := by
    intro Q
    cases Q with
    | none => simp [directionDegree]
    | some φ => exact φ.property.2.natDegree_pos
  have hle : ∀ Q : ClosedDirection k, directionDegree k Q * Dv Q ≤ d := by
    intro Q
    by_cases h : Dv Q = 0
    · simp [h]
    · rw [← hd']
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun P => directionDegree k P * Dv P)
        (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hinf]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)
    · intro h
      by_contra hc
      have : H.natDegree = d := by omega
      have := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hH
      apply this
      rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff]
      simpa [‹H.natDegree = d›] using h
  · have h1 : Dv (zeroDirection k) = Multiset.count Polynomial.X
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors H) :=
      haff ⟨Polynomial.X, Polynomial.monic_X, Polynomial.irreducible_X⟩
    rw [h1, Multiset.count_pos, ← Polynomial.X_dvd_iff]
    constructor
    · exact UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hass⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd hH
        (Polynomial.irreducible_X : Irreducible (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k)) h
      have hn := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalize_normalized_factor q hq
      have : normalize q = normalize (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k) := normalize_eq_normalize_iff.mpr
          ⟨hass.symm.dvd, hass.dvd⟩
      rw [hn, (Polynomial.normalize_eq_self_iff_monic Polynomial.X_ne_zero).mpr Polynomial.monic_X]
          at this
      rw [← this]; exact hq
  · intro Q
    exact le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (hdpos Q)) (hle Q)
  · intro Q _
    have := hle Q
    have hp : 0 < Dv Q := ‹_›
    exact le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hp) this

name: SurfaceBlowup.ideal_atlas_reindex
statement:
private theorem ideal_atlas_reindex (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (pi : O)
    (n : ℕ)
    (X : Set (Ideal R)) (A B : IdealAtlas O R pi n X) :
    ∃ e : A.ι ≃ B.ι, ∀ i, residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (A.chart i).f = residueIdealCell
      (algebraMap O R pi) (B.chart (e i)).f
proof:
:= by
  have self_mem : ∀ p f : R, Ideal.span {f} ∈ residueIdealCell p f := by
    intro p f
    refine ⟨⟨f, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Ideal.map_span]; simp
  have eq_of_mem : ∀ p f g : R, ∀ J, J ∈ residueIdealCell p f → J ∈ residueIdealCell p g →
      residueIdealCell p f = residueIdealCell p g := by
    intro p f g J hf hg
    have h : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p}) f} = Ideal.span
        {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p}) g} := hf.2.symm.trans hg.2
    ext K
    simp only [residueIdealCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, h]
  have ex : ∀ i, ∃ j, Ideal.span {(A.chart i).f} ∈ residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi)
      (B.chart j).f := by
    intro i
    have : Ideal.span {(A.chart i).f} ∈ X :=
      (Set.ext_iff.1 A.cover _).2 (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, self_mem _ _⟩)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.1 ((Set.ext_iff.1 B.cover _).1 this)
  choose e he using ex
  have hcell : ∀ i, residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (A.chart i).f = residueIdealCell
      (algebraMap O R pi) (B.chart (e i)).f :=
    fun i => eq_of_mem _ _ _ _ (self_mem _ _) (he i)
  have inj : Function.Injective e := by
    intro i i' h
    by_contra hne
    have h1 : Disjoint (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (A.chart i).f)
        (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (A.chart i').f) := A.disjoint hne
    have h2 : residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (A.chart i).f = residueIdealCell
        (algebraMap O R pi) (A.chart i').f := by
      rw [hcell i, hcell i', h]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 h1 (self_mem _ _) (self_mem _ _)
  have surj : Function.Surjective e := by
    intro j
    have : Ideal.span {(B.chart j).f} ∈ X :=
      (Set.ext_iff.1 B.cover _).2 (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, self_mem _ _⟩)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 ((Set.ext_iff.1 A.cover _).1 this)
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    by_contra hne
    have h1 : Disjoint (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (B.chart (e i)).f)
        (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (B.chart j).f) := B.disjoint fun h ↦ hne h
    have h2 := eq_of_mem _ _ _ _ hi (self_mem _ _)
    have h3 : residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (B.chart (e i)).f = residueIdealCell
        (algebraMap O R pi) (B.chart j).f := by
      rw [← hcell i, h2]
    rw [h3] at h1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 h1 (self_mem _ _) (self_mem _ _)
  exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective e ⟨inj, surj⟩, hcell⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.stateMeasure_univ_of_atlas
statement:
private theorem stateMeasure_univ_of_atlas (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (maximalIdeal O)) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (p pi : O) (hp : p = pi) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hp0 : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0)
    (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ) (X : Set (Ideal R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (A : IdealAtlas O R p n X)
    (A' : IdealAtlas O R pi n X) (V : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hA' : (letI := idealChartSigma O R pi
      stateMeasure O R pi n (Nat.card (ResidueField O)) A' Set.univ = V)) :
    letI
proof:
:= idealChartSigma O R p
    stateMeasure O R p n (Nat.card (ResidueField O)) A Set.univ = V := by
  subst hp
  let _ := idealChartSigma O R p
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ideal_atlas_reindex O R p n X A A'
  rwa [state_measure_atlas_independent O R htop p hpi n X A A' (fun j ↦
    coordinate_ideal_measurable_chart_sigma O htop R p hpi hp0 hpm n _ _
      (A'.chart j).isDivisionChart) e he hp0 hpm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_member_volume
statement:
theorem concrete_member_volume (m : ConcreteMember) :
    m.toMeasured.μ m.toMeasured.stateSet = densityValue (stateVolume m.s) m.toMeasured.q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.univ_inter m.toMeasured.stateSet, ← (concrete_member_measure_finite_support m).2]
  obtain ⟨O, htop, pi, hpi, u, a0, b0, ha, S, hS_pi, hS_t, hS_x, hS_a, hS_b, s, shape, atlas⟩ := m
  have hq : 2 ≤ Nat.card (ResidueField O) := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.2 inferInstance
  cases s with
  | single a c =>
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, hc⟩ := shape
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv O pi hpi u a 0
    obtain ⟨A', hA'⟩ := concrete_single_state_volume O pi hpi u a ha S hS_pi hS_t hS_a hS_b e he c
        hc htop
    obtain ⟨hp0, hpm⟩ := surface_vertical_parameter O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) S
    rw [hS_pi] at hp0 hpm
    have := division_coordinate_module_isAdicComplete O pi hpi u a 0 ha (a*c)
    refine (stateMeasure_univ_of_atlas O _ htop S.pi pi hS_pi hpi hp0 hpm (a*c) _ atlas A'
      _ hA').trans ?_
    exact (density_value_arith _ hq (.const 1) (.const 1) (by simp [Expr.eval])
      (by simp [Expr.eval]) c (State.single 1 1) ⟨Nat.one_pos, Nat.one_pos⟩).2.2.1.symm
  | crossing a b c h =>
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, hb, hc, hh⟩ := shape
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv O pi hpi u a b
    obtain ⟨A', hA'⟩ := concrete_crossing_state_volume O pi hpi u a b ha hb S hS_pi hS_t hS_x hS_a
        hS_b e he c h hc hh htop
    obtain ⟨hp0, hpm⟩ := surface_vertical_parameter O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S
    rw [hS_pi] at hp0 hpm
    have := division_coordinate_module_isAdicComplete O pi hpi u a b ha (a*c+b*h)
    refine (stateMeasure_univ_of_atlas O _ htop S.pi pi hS_pi hpi hp0 hpm (a*c+b*h) _
      atlas A' _ hA').trans ?_
    have hq1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (Nat.card (ResidueField O) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega)
    have hdv := density_value_arith _ hq eminusOne (.inv (.pow .var (c+h)))
      (by simp [eminusOne, Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval]; linarith)
      (by simp only [Expr.eval, expression_pow_eval]; positivity) (c+h) (State.single 1 1)
      ⟨Nat.one_pos, Nat.one_pos⟩
    have hem : densityValue eminusOne (Nat.card (ResidueField O)) =
        (Nat.card (ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) - 1 := by
      simp only [densityValue, eminusOne, Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval]
      push_cast
      rw [show ((Nat.card (ResidueField O) : ℝ) + -1 * 1) =
        (Nat.card (ResidueField O) : ℝ) - 1 by ring,
        ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ zero_le_one, ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    change _ = densityValue (stateVolume (.crossing a b c h)) (Nat.card (ResidueField O))
    rw [stateVolume, hdv.1, hdv.2.2.1, hem]

name: SurfaceBlowup.ideal_data_along_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem ideal_data_along_ringEquiv (S S' : Type) [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] (Eq : S ≃+* S')
    (I : Ideal S) (e : S) :
    ((∃ g : S, I = Ideal.span {g}) ↔ ∃ g' : S', Ideal.map (Eq : S →+* S') I = Ideal.span {g'}) ∧
      Module.length S (S ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {e})) = Module.length S'
      (S' ⧸ (Ideal.map (Eq : S →+* S') I ⊔ Ideal.span {Eq e}))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Eq g, by rw [Ideal.map_span]; simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨g', h⟩
    refine ⟨Eq.symm g', ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (Ideal.map (Eq.symm : S' →+* S)) h
    rw [Ideal.map_span] at this
    simp only [Set.image_singleton] at this
    change I = Ideal.span {(Eq.symm : S' →+* S) g'}
    rw [← this, Ideal.map_map]
    have : (Eq.symm : S' →+* S).comp (Eq : S →+* S') = RingHom.id S := by ext; simp
    rw [this, Ideal.map_id]
  · rw [module_length_quotient_ringEquiv S S' Eq (I ⊔ Ideal.span {e}), Ideal.map_sup,
      Ideal.map_span]
    rw [Set.image_singleton]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_ideal_set_map_iff_stateSet
statement:
theorem child_ideal_set_map_iff_stateSet (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.cellIndex)
    (D : CellChildData m c) (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c) (I : Ideal
    (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j))) :
    I ∈ childIdealSet m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf m.s (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) (D.point j) ↔
      Ideal.map (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j) →+*
      (D.mc j).R) I ∈ (D.mc j).toMeasured.stateSet
proof:
:= by
  have hE := ideal_data_along_ringEquiv _ _ (D.Eq j) I
    (divisorException m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j))
  have hB := (ideal_data_along_ringEquiv _ _ (D.Eq j) I
    (divisorBoundary m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j))).2
  rw [D.hEq_e j] at hE
  have hB' : (D.asg.pt j = infinityDirection (ResidueField m.R) ∨ D.asg.pt j = zeroDirection
      (ResidueField m.R)) →
      Module.length (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j))
          (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j) ⧸
          (I ⊔ Ideal.span {divisorBoundary m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j)})) =
        idealContact (D.mc j).R (Ideal.map (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1
            D.hinf (D.point j) →+* (D.mc j).R) I) (D.mc j).S.x := by
    intro h; rw [hB, D.hEq_b j h]; rfl
  obtain ⟨hP, hE⟩ := hE
  have hs : (D.mc j).s = pointChildState (ResidueField m.R) m.s (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) c.2.1
      (D.asg.pt j) :=
    (D.child j).hstate.trans (D.asg.state j)
  have hshape := (D.mc j).shape
  have hvalid := (D.mc j).shape.valid (D.mc j).ha
  have hSa := (D.mc j).hS_a
  have hSb := (D.mc j).hS_b
  change _ ↔ _ ∈ surfaceStateSet (D.mc j).O (D.mc j).R (D.mc j).S (D.mc j).s
  unfold childIdealSet surfaceStateSet
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  change _ = idealContact (D.mc j).R _ (D.mc j).S.t at hE
  rw [hP, hE]
  have hQ : (D.point j).val = D.asg.pt j := rfl
  rw [hQ, hs]
  rw [hs] at hshape hvalid
  generalize idealContact (D.mc j).R (Ideal.map (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1
      D.hinf (D.point j) →+* (D.mc j).R) I) (D.mc j).S.t = CT at *
  generalize idealContact (D.mc j).R (Ideal.map (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1
      D.hinf (D.point j) →+* (D.mc j).R) I) (D.mc j).S.x = CX at *
  generalize Module.length (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j))
      (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j) ⧸
      (I ⊔ Ideal.span {divisorBoundary m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j)})) = LB at *
  generalize (∃ g', Ideal.map (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf
      (D.point j) →+* (D.mc j).R) I = Ideal.span {g'}) = PP at *
  rw [hSa, hSb]
  clear hB hE hP hs
  generalize D.asg.pt j = Q at *
  generalize m.toMeasured.cellDegree c = d at *
  simp only [hvalid, true_and]
  clear hvalid hSa hSb hQ I
  generalize c.2.1 = Dv at *
  generalize m.s = s0 at *
  generalize (D.mc j).a = A at *
  generalize (D.mc j).b = B at *
  rcases Q with _ | φ
  · obtain rfl := hB' (Or.inl rfl)
    cases s0 <;>
    · simp only [pointChildState, infinityDirection, if_true, StateShape, stateContactT,
        stateContactX] at hshape ⊢
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hshape
      simp [zeroDirection]
  have hne : (some φ : ClosedDirection (ResidueField m.R)) ≠ infinityDirection _ := by
    simp [infinityDirection]
  cases s0 with
  | single a0 c0 =>
    simp only [pointChildState, if_neg hne, StateShape, stateContactT, stateContactX] at hshape ⊢
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hshape
    simp
  | crossing a0 b0 c0 h0 =>
    by_cases hz : (some φ : ClosedDirection (ResidueField m.R)) = zeroDirection _
    · obtain rfl := hB' (Or.inr hz)
      simp only [pointChildState, if_neg hne, if_pos hz, StateShape, stateContactT,
        stateContactX] at hshape ⊢
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hshape
      simp [hz, zeroDirection]
    · simp only [pointChildState, if_neg hne, if_neg hz, StateShape, stateContactT,
        stateContactX] at hshape ⊢
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hshape
      simp [hz]

name: SurfaceBlowup.infinity_point_child_member
statement:
theorem infinity_point_child_member (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] (htop : IsAdic (maximalIdeal O)) (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    [hinf : (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsPrime] (s' : State) (hs' : StateShape (a + b) a s') :
    ∃ mc : ConcreteMember, ∃ (_ : Algebra O mc.O) (_ : Module.Finite O mc.O)
      (_ : Module.Free O mc.O), Module.finrank O mc.O = 1 ∧ Nat.card (ResidueField mc.O) = Nat.card
      (ResidueField O) ^ 1 ∧ mc.pi = algebraMap O mc.O pi ∧ mc.a = a + b ∧ mc.b = a ∧ mc.s = s' ∧
      (∃ pc : mc.O ≃ₗ[O] (Fin 1 → O), Continuous pc ∧ Continuous pc.symm ∧ Measurable pc ∧
      Measurable pc.symm ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map pc.symm (coefficientMeasure O 1)) ∧ ∀ r
      : ℕ, coefficientMeasure mc.O r = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin r => Measure.map pc.symm
      (coefficientMeasure O 1))) ∧ ∃ Eq : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ≃+* mc.R, Eq
      ((completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))) ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (surfaceX O pi u a b))) = mc.S.t ∧ Eq
      ((completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))) (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b))) = mc.S.x ∧ ∀ c : O, Eq ((completedPointMap
      (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))
      (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)))
      ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))
      (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c))) = algebraMap O mc.R c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Eq, h1, h2, h3⟩ := x_chart_infinity_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
    (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) rfl
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, S, hSpi, hSt, hSx, hSa, hSb, ⟨atlas⟩⟩ :=
    concrete_member_data_exists O pi hpi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a (by omega) s' hs'
  have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop 1
  obtain ⟨-, hm2, hm3, hm4, hm5, hm6⟩ := coefficient_measure_pi_one O htop pi hpi 0
  refine ⟨⟨O, htop, pi, hpi, xSubstUnit O u, a + b, a, by omega, S, hSpi, hSt, hSx, hSa, hSb, s',
      hs', atlas⟩, Algebra.id O, Module.Finite.self O, Module.Free.self O, Module.finrank_self O,
      by simp, by simp, rfl, rfl, rfl,
      ⟨(LinearEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) O O).symm, hm4, hm3, hm6, hm5, by simpa using hm2,
        fun r ↦ by simpa using (coefficient_measure_pi_one O htop pi hpi r).1⟩,
      Eq, ?_, by simpa [hSx] using h2, fun c ↦ by simpa using h3 c⟩
  have := h1 (axisX O)
  rw [(chartSubst_apply_generators O 0).2.2.2.2.2.1] at this
  simpa [hSt, surfaceT, surfaceX] using this

name: SurfaceBlowup.initial_form_has_tangent_divisor
statement:
theorem initial_form_has_tangent_divisor (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (d : ℕ) (f : R) (c : Fin (d + 1) → R)
    (hc : f = (∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * S.t ^ (d - i.val) * S.x ^ i.val))
    (H : Polynomial (ResidueField R)) (hH : H = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), Polynomial.C (residue R (c i)) *
    Polynomial.X ^ i.val) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (ResidueField R))
    (hDv : HasHomogeneousDivisor (ResidueField R) d H Dv) :
    HasTangentDivisor O R S (Ideal.span {f}) d Dv
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨f, H, rfl, hDv, ?_⟩
  have hco : ∀ i : Fin (d+1), H.coeff i.val = residue R (c i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hH, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      have : i.val ≠ j.val := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h.symm)
      simp [this]
    · simp
  unfold tangentLift
  rw [hc]
  refine initial_form_lift_independent O R S d c
    (fun i => residueRepresentative R (H.coeff i.val)) fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, hco i]
  have : residue R (residueRepresentative R (residue R (c i))) = residue R (c i) :=
    Function.rightInverse_invFun IsLocalRing.residue_surjective _
  rw [this, sub_self]

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_le_length_restrict
statement:
private theorem length_le_length_restrict (O Oδ M : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [Algebra O Oδ]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] [Module Oδ M] [IsScalarTower O Oδ M] :
    Module.length Oδ M ≤ Module.length O M
proof:
:= by
  have h := Submodule.length_le_length_restrictScalars O (⊤ : Submodule Oδ M)
  rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_top] at h
  rwa [(Submodule.topEquiv (R := Oδ) (M := M)).length_eq,
    (Submodule.topEquiv (R := O) (M := M)).length_eq] at h

name: SurfaceBlowup.list_get_fiber_card_count
statement:
theorem list_get_fiber_card_count (β : Type) [DecidableEq β] (l : List β) (v : β) :
    Nat.card {j : Fin l.length // l.get j = v} = l.count v
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ l : List β, l.count v = ∑ j : Fin l.length, if l.get j = v then 1 else 0 := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a l ih =>
      rw [List.count_cons, ih]
      erw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      by_cases h : a = v <;> simp [h, Nat.add_comm]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.card_filter, key]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_integralClosure_pi_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_integralClosure_pi_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type) [Finite ι]
    (C : ι → Type)
    [∀ i, CommRing (C i)] [∀ i, Algebra O (C i)] (x : ∀ i, C i) :
    x ∈ integralClosure O (∀ i, C i) ↔ ∀ i, x i ∈ integralClosure O (C i)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  simp only [mem_integralClosure_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    exact h.map (Pi.evalAlgHom O C i)
  · intro h
    choose p hp hx using h
    refine ⟨∏ i, p i, Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hp i), ?_⟩
    have h1 : Polynomial.aeval x (∏ j, p j) = 0 := by
      funext i
      have : Polynomial.aeval x (∏ j, p j) = ∏ j, Polynomial.aeval x (p j) := map_prod _ _ _
      rw [this, Finset.prod_apply]
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (Pi.evalAlgHom O C i) x (p i)
      simp only [Pi.evalAlgHom_apply] at this
      rw [← this, Polynomial.aeval_def]
      exact hx i
    rwa [Polynomial.aeval_def] at h1

name: SurfaceBlowup.integralClosure_pi_equiv
statement:
private theorem integralClosure_pi_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type) [Finite ι]
    (C : ι → Type)
    [∀ i, CommRing (C i)] [∀ i, Algebra O (C i)] :
    ∃ e : integralClosure O (∀ i, C i) ≃ₗ[O] (∀ i, integralClosure O (C i)), ∀
      (x : integralClosure O (∀ i, C i)) (i : ι), ((e x i : integralClosure O (C i)) : C i) =
      (x : ∀ i, C i) i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{ toFun := fun x i => ⟨(x : ∀ i, C i) i, (mem_integralClosure_pi_iff O ι C x.1).1 x.2 i⟩
            map_add' := fun x y => rfl
            map_smul' := fun r x => rfl
            invFun := fun y => ⟨fun i => (y i : C i), (mem_integralClosure_pi_iff O ι C _).2
                (fun i => (y i).2)⟩
            left_inv := fun x => rfl
            right_inv := fun y => rfl }, fun x i => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.generic_closure_free_of_type
statement:
theorem generic_closure_free_of_type (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] (σ : FactorType)
    (h : HasAlgebraType O B σ) :
    Module.Finite O (GenericClosure O B) ∧ Module.Free O (GenericClosure O B) ∧ Module.finrank O
      (GenericClosure O B) = Module.finrank (BaseField O) (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, _, L, _, _, _, _, _, e, -, hsepL⟩ := h
  have : ∀ i, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (L i)) := hsepL
  have hL := fun i => integral_closure_finite_free O (BaseField O) (L i)
  have : ∀ i, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (L i)) := fun i => (hL i).1
  have : ∀ i, Module.Free O (integralClosure O (L i)) := fun i => (hL i).2.1
  obtain ⟨e₁, -⟩ := integralClosure_pi_equiv O ι L
  obtain ⟨φ, -⟩ := integral_closure_algEquiv O _ _ (e.restrictScalars O)
  let E : GenericClosure O B ≃ₗ[O] (∀ i, integralClosure O (L i)) :=
    φ.toLinearEquiv.trans e₁
  refine ⟨Module.Finite.equiv E.symm, Module.Free.of_equiv E.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [E.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_pi_fintype, e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq,
    Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (hL i).2.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.nonself_cell_child_rank_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [U.child_state]
  exact nonself_child_rank_lt _ (U.M i).valid _ c.1.2 hc _
    (List.get_mem _ _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.etale_terminates_of_invariant
statement:
private theorem etale_terminates_of_invariant (U : SurfaceUniverse) (hE1 : U.ChildTypesExist)
    (δ : ∀ i : U.ι, Ideal (U.M i).R → ℕ) (hE2 : U.InvariantDecreases δ) (i : U.ι)
    (J : Ideal (U.M i).R) (hJ : J ∈ (U.M i).stateSet) (σ : FactorType)
    (hσ : HasAlgebraType (U.M i).O ((U.M i).R ⧸ J) σ) :
    U.Terminates i J
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n r : ℕ, ∀ (i : U.ι) (J : Ideal (U.M i).R), δ i J = n → (U.M i).s.rank = r →
      J ∈ (U.M i).stateSet → (∃ σ, HasAlgebraType (U.M i).O ((U.M i).R ⧸ J) σ) →
      U.Terminates i J := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ n IHδ =>
    intro r
    induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ r IHr =>
    intro i J hn hr hJ ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    cases ht : (U.M i).s.terminal with
    | true => exact SurfaceUniverse.Terminates.leaf i J hJ ht
    | false =>
      rw [U.cells_cover i ht, Set.mem_iUnion] at hJ
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hJ
      refine SurfaceUniverse.Terminates.node i c J hc ht (fun j => ?_)
      have hτ := hE1 i ht c J hc σ hσ j
      have hmem := cell_child_mem_stateSet U i ht c J hc j
      have hδ := hE2 i ht c J hc ⟨σ, hσ⟩ j
      by_cases hself : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c
      · exact IHδ _ (hn ▸ hδ.2 hself) _ _ _ rfl rfl hmem hτ
      · have hrank := nonself_cell_child_rank_lt U i c hself j
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hδ.1 with h | h
        · exact IHδ _ (hn ▸ h) _ _ _ rfl rfl hmem hτ
        · exact IHr _ (hr ▸ hrank) _ _ (h.trans hn) rfl hmem hτ
  exact key _ _ i J rfl rfl hJ ⟨σ, hσ⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.etale_type_event_eq_term
statement:
theorem etale_type_event_eq_term (U : SurfaceUniverse) (hE1 : U.ChildTypesExist)
    (δ : ∀ i : U.ι, Ideal (U.M i).R → ℕ) (hE2 : U.InvariantDecreases δ) (i : U.ι) (σ : FactorType) :
    U.typeEvent i σ = U.termTypeEvent i σ
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (fun J hJ ↦ ⟨hJ, etale_terminates_of_invariant U hE1 δ hE2 i J hJ.1 σ hJ.2⟩)
    Set.inter_subset_left

name: SurfaceBlowup.childList_of_isSelfCell
statement:
private theorem childList_of_isSelfCell (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι) (c : (U.M i).cellIndex)
    (hc : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c) : (U.M i).childList c = [(1, (U.M i).s)]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, h⟩ := hc
  exact h

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_state_of_isSelfCell
proof:
:= by
  rw [U.child_state]
  have h := childList_of_isSelfCell U i c hc
  unfold MeasuredSurface.childState
  have : ∀ (L : List (ℕ × State)) (hL : L = [(1, (U.M i).s)]) (j : Fin L.length), (L.get j).2 =
      (U.M i).s := by
    intro L hL j
    subst hL
    have hj := j.2
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hj
    have : j = ⟨0, by simp⟩ := Fin.ext (by simp only; omega)
    subst this; rfl
  exact this _ h j

name: SurfaceBlowup.childIdx_subsingleton_of_isSelfCell
proof:
:= by
  have hl : ((U.M i).childList c).length = 1 := by rw [childList_of_isSelfCell U i c hc]; rfl
  exact Fin.ext (by have := j.2; have := j'.2; omega)

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_child_mem_nonterminatingSet
statement:
private theorem exists_child_mem_nonterminatingSet (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false)
    (c : (U.M i).cellIndex) (J : Ideal (U.M i).R) (hJc : J ∈ (U.M i).cell c)
    (hJ : J ∉ U.terminatingSet i) : ∃ j, U.Φ i c J j ∈ U.nonterminatingSet (U.child i c j)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  refine hJ (SurfaceUniverse.Terminates.node i c J hJc hnt fun j ↦ ?_)
  by_contra h
  exact hcon j ⟨cell_child_mem_stateSet U i hnt c J hJc j, h⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_returnEvent_succ_or_badExitEvent
statement:
private theorem mem_returnEvent_succ_or_badExitEvent (U : SurfaceUniverse) (k : ℕ) : ∀ (i : U.ι),
    (U.M i).s.terminal = false →
    ∀ J, J ∈ U.nonterminatingSet i → J ∈ U.returnEvent k i →
      J ∈ U.returnEvent (k+1) i ∪ U.badExitEvent k i
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i hnt J hJ _
    have hJs := hJ.1
    rw [U.cells_cover i hnt, Set.mem_iUnion] at hJs
    obtain ⟨c, hJc⟩ := hJs
    have hmem := (U.Φ_bij i hnt c).mapsTo hJc
    rw [Set.mem_univ_pi] at hmem
    by_cases hc : (U.M i).IsSelfCell c
    · left
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.returnEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hJc, Set.mem_univ_pi.2 hmem⟩
    · right
      obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := exists_child_mem_nonterminatingSet U i hnt c J hJc hJ.2
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.badExitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, j₀, hJc, Set.mem_univ_pi.2 (fun j => ?_)⟩
      by_cases hj : j = j₀
      · subst hj; simp [hj₀]
      · simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hnt J hJ hJr
    simp only [SurfaceUniverse.returnEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at hJr
    obtain ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hJc, hJpi⟩ := hJr
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi] at hJpi
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := exists_child_mem_nonterminatingSet U i hnt c J hJc hJ.2
    have hnt' : (U.M (U.child i c j₀)).s.terminal = false := by
      rw [child_state_of_isSelfCell U i c hc]; exact hnt
    rcases ih _ hnt' _ hj₀ (hJpi j₀) with h | h
    · left
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.returnEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hJc, Set.mem_univ_pi.2 (fun j => ?_)⟩
      obtain rfl := childIdx_subsingleton_of_isSelfCell U i c hc j j₀
      simpa [SurfaceUniverse.returnEvent] using h
    · right
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.badExitEvent, Set.mem_iUnion]
      refine ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hJc, Set.mem_univ_pi.2 (fun j => ?_)⟩
      obtain rfl := childIdx_subsingleton_of_isSelfCell U i c hc j j₀
      exact h

name: SurfaceBlowup.nonterminating_subset_return_or_bad
statement:
theorem nonterminating_subset_return_or_bad (U : SurfaceUniverse) (i : U.ι)
    (hnt : (U.M i).s.terminal = false) :
    (∀ a c : ℕ, (U.M i).s = State.single a c → U.nonterminatingSet i ⊆ (⋂ k, U.returnEvent k i) ∪ ⋃
      k, U.badExitEvent k i) ∧ (∀ a b c h : ℕ, (U.M i).s = State.crossing a b c h →
      U.nonterminatingSet i ⊆ U.badExitEvent 0 i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro a c _ J hJ
    by_cases hall : J ∈ ⋂ k, U.returnEvent k i
    · exact Or.inl hall
    · right
      rw [Set.mem_iInter] at hall
      push Not at hall
      have hex : ∃ n, J ∉ U.returnEvent n i := hall
      have hn0 : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ (h0 ▸ Nat.find_spec hex) hJ.1
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
      have hin : J ∈ U.returnEvent m i := by
        by_contra hc
        have := Nat.find_min' hex hc
        omega
      have hnot : J ∉ U.returnEvent (m+1) i := by
        rw [← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← hm]; exact Nat.find_spec hex
      rcases mem_returnEvent_succ_or_badExitEvent U m i hnt J hJ hin with h | h
      · exact absurd h hnot
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨m, h⟩
  · intro a b c h hs J hJ
    rcases mem_returnEvent_succ_or_badExitEvent U 0 i hnt J hJ hJ.1 with h' | h'
    · exfalso
      simp only [SurfaceUniverse.returnEvent, Set.mem_iUnion] at h'
      obtain ⟨⟨c', ⟨a', c'', hs', _⟩⟩, _⟩ := h'
      rw [hs] at hs'
      cases hs'
    · exact h'

name: SurfaceBlowup.order_defect_le_of_tower
statement:
theorem order_defect_le_of_tower (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ] [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ]
    [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ) (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi)) (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] [Algebra Oδ B]
    [IsScalarTower O Oδ B] :
    orderDefect Oδ B ≤ orderDefect O B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hfr⟩ := unramified_fraction_base_change O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ
  
  have hfr' : IsFractionRing Oδ (Oδ ⊗[O] BaseField O) := by
    let _i : Algebra Oδ (BaseField O ⊗[O] Oδ) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    refine IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors Oδ)
      (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O (BaseField O) Oδ).toRingEquiv) ?_)
    intro x
    change (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O (BaseField O) Oδ) (1 ⊗ₜ x) = _
    simp
  let ψ : BaseField Oδ ≃ₐ[Oδ] Oδ ⊗[O] BaseField O :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors Oδ) (BaseField Oδ) (Oδ ⊗[O] BaseField O)
  let Θ : BaseField Oδ ⊗[Oδ] B ≃+* BaseField O ⊗[O] B :=
    ((((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr ψ (AlgEquiv.refl (R := Oδ) (A₁ := B))).trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm Oδ _ B)).trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange O Oδ Oδ B (BaseField O))).toRingEquiv.trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O B (BaseField O)).toRingEquiv)
  have hΘ : ∀ b : B, Θ (1 ⊗ₜ b) = 1 ⊗ₜ b := by
    intro b
    simp [Θ, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  let f : Oδ →+* BaseField O ⊗[O] B :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[O] BaseField O ⊗[O] B).toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Oδ B)
  let alg : Algebra Oδ (BaseField O ⊗[O] B) := f.toAlgebra
  have hf : ∀ o, Θ (algebraMap Oδ (BaseField Oδ ⊗[Oδ] B) o) = algebraMap Oδ (BaseField O ⊗[O] B)
      o := by
    intro o
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply', hΘ]
    rfl
  have : IsScalarTower O Oδ (BaseField O ⊗[O] B) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun a => by
    change _ = (1 : BaseField O) ⊗ₜ algebraMap Oδ B (algebraMap O Oδ a)
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply', ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply])
  let Θa : BaseField Oδ ⊗[Oδ] B ≃ₐ[Oδ] BaseField O ⊗[O] B := AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := Θ) hf
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O Oδ := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite O Oδ
  have hint : ∀ z, IsIntegral Oδ z ↔ IsIntegral O (Θ z) := by
    intro z
    rw [← isIntegral_algEquiv Θa]
    exact ⟨fun h => isIntegral_trans _ h, fun h => h.tower_top⟩
  let : Module O (GenericClosure Oδ B) := Module.compHom _ (algebraMap O Oδ)
  have : IsScalarTower O Oδ (GenericClosure Oδ B) := ⟨fun a b x => by
    change (a • b) • x = (algebraMap O Oδ a) • (b • x)
    rw [Algebra.smul_def a b, mul_smul]⟩
  let θ : GenericClosure Oδ B ≃ₗ[O] GenericClosure O B :=
  { toFun := fun z => (⟨Θ (z : ↥(integralClosure Oδ (BaseField Oδ ⊗[Oδ] B))).1,
        (hint _).1 (z : ↥(integralClosure Oδ (BaseField Oδ ⊗[Oδ] B))).2⟩ :
        ↥(integralClosure O (BaseField O ⊗[O] B)))
    invFun := fun w => (⟨Θ.symm (w : ↥(integralClosure O (BaseField O ⊗[O] B))).1,
        (hint _).2 (by simpa [mem_integralClosure_iff] using
          (w : ↥(integralClosure O (BaseField O ⊗[O] B))).2)⟩ :
        ↥(integralClosure Oδ (BaseField Oδ ⊗[Oδ] B)))
    map_add' := fun z w => Subtype.ext (map_add Θ _ _)
    map_smul' := fun a z => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change Θ (algebraMap O Oδ a • (z : ↥(integralClosure Oδ (BaseField Oδ ⊗[Oδ] B))).1) = a • _
      rw [← algebraMap_smul Oδ a (Θ _)]
      exact map_smul Θa _ _
    left_inv := fun z => Subtype.ext (Θ.symm_apply_apply _)
    right_inv := fun w => Subtype.ext (Θ.apply_symm_apply _) }
  have hmap : ((orderImage Oδ B).restrictScalars O).map (θ : GenericClosure Oδ B →ₗ[O]
      GenericClosure O B)
      = orderImage O B := by
    rw [Submodule.map_equiv_eq_comap_symm]
    ext w
    change Θ.symm (w : ↥(integralClosure O (BaseField O ⊗[O] B))).1 ∈ LinearMap.range _ ↔
      (w : ↥(integralClosure O (BaseField O ⊗[O] B))).1 ∈ LinearMap.range _
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
      refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
      have := congrArg Θ hb
      simp only [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
      rw [← this]
      exact (hΘ b).symm
    · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
      refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
      change (1 : BaseField Oδ) ⊗ₜ b = _
      rw [← Θ.symm_apply_apply ((1 : BaseField Oδ) ⊗ₜ b), hΘ]
      exact congrArg Θ.symm hb
  calc orderDefect Oδ B = Module.length Oδ (GenericClosure Oδ B ⧸ orderImage Oδ B) := rfl
    _ ≤ Module.length O (GenericClosure Oδ B ⧸ orderImage Oδ B) :=
      length_le_length_restrict O Oδ _
    _ = Module.length O (GenericClosure Oδ B ⧸ (orderImage Oδ B).restrictScalars O) :=
      (Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv O (orderImage Oδ B)).length_eq.symm
    _ = orderDefect O B := (Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ θ hmap).length_eq

name: SurfaceBlowup.order_defect_pi
statement:
theorem order_defect_pi (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)] :
    orderDefect O (∀ j, B j) = ∑ j, orderDefect O (B j)
proof:
:= by
  let K := BaseField O
  let p : TensorProduct O K (∀ j, B j) ≃ₐ[O] ∀ j, TensorProduct O K (B j) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight O K K B).restrictScalars O
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := integral_closure_algEquiv O _ _ p
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := integralClosure_pi_equiv O (Fin n) (fun j => TensorProduct O K (B j))
  let E : GenericClosure O (∀ j, B j) ≃ₗ[O] ∀ j, GenericClosure O (B j) :=
    φ.toLinearEquiv.trans e₁
  have hE : ∀ (x : GenericClosure O (∀ j, B j)) (j : Fin n),
      genericClosureVal O (B j) (E x j) = p (genericClosureVal O (∀ j, B j) x) j := by
    intro x j
    have := he₁ (φ x) j
    rwa [hφ x] at this
  have hmap : (orderImage O (∀ j, B j)).map E.toLinearMap
      = Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun j => orderImage O (B j)) := by
    have hmem : ∀ (C : Type) [CommRing C] [Algebra O C] (z : GenericClosure O C),
        z ∈ orderImage O C ↔ ∃ c : C, (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[O] c = genericClosureVal O C z := by
      intro C _ _ z
      simp [orderImage, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_range,
        K]
    ext y
    simp only [Submodule.mem_map, Submodule.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ j
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hmem _ x).1 hx
      refine (hmem _ _).2 ⟨b j, ?_⟩
      rw [show (E.toLinearMap x) j = E x j from rfl, hE, ← hb]
      rfl
    · intro hy
      choose b hb using fun j => (hmem _ (y j)).1 (hy j)
      refine ⟨E.symm y, (hmem _ _).2 ⟨b, ?_⟩, by simp⟩
      apply p.injective
      funext j
      rw [← hE, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← hb j]
      rfl
  unfold orderDefect
  rw [(Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ E hmap).length_eq, (Submodule.quotientPi _).length_eq,
    Module.length_pi_of_fintype]

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_ascent
statement:
private theorem algebra_type_ascent (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ] [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ]
    [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ) (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi)) [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] [Algebra Oδ B]
    [IsScalarTower O Oδ B] (σ : FactorType) (h : HasAlgebraType O B σ) :
    ∃ τ : FactorType, HasAlgebraType Oδ B τ ∧ σ = scaleType δ τ
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨ι, hι, L, hF, _, _, _, _, e, _, hfinL⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4, E, hc⟩ :=
    unramified_generic_fibre_ascent O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ B ι L e
  
  have hfinδ (i) : Module.Finite Oδ (integralClosure Oδ (L i)) :=
    have : IsScalarTower O Oδ (L i) := .of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      rw [hc i c, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
    closure_finite_ascent O Oδ (L i) (hfinL i)
  have hτ : HasAlgebraType Oδ B (∑ i, ({fieldInvariant Oδ (L i)} : FactorType)) :=
    ⟨ι, hι, L, hF, a1, a2, a3, a4, E, rfl, hfinδ⟩
  exact ⟨_, hτ, algebra_type_unique O B σ _ h
    (algebra_type_unramified_descent O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ B _ hτ)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.etale_children_types_exist
statement:
private theorem etale_children_types_exist (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (n : ℕ)
    (Oj : Fin n → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (Oj j)] [∀ j, IsDomain (Oj j)]
    [∀ j, IsDiscreteValuationRing (Oj j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (Oj j)] [∀ j, Module.Finite O (Oj j)]
    [∀ j, Module.Free O (Oj j)] (δ : Fin n → ℕ) (hrank : ∀ j, Module.finrank O (Oj j) = δ j)
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : ∀ j, Irreducible (algebraMap O (Oj j) pi)) (A : Type)
    [CommRing A] [Algebra O A] (B : Fin n → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra (Oj j) (B j)] [∀ j, IsScalarTower O (Oj j) (B j)] (ψ : A →ₐ[O] ∀ j, B j)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ψ) (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : Module.length O
    ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) = ℓ) (σ : FactorType) (hσ : HasAlgebraType O A σ) :
    ∀ j, ∃ τ : FactorType, HasAlgebraType (Oj j) (B j) τ
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨τ₀, h₀⟩ := algebra_type_children_exists O A n B ψ hinj ℓ hℓ σ hσ j
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, -⟩ := algebra_type_ascent O (Oj j) (δ j) (hrank j) pi hpi (hpiδ j) (B j) τ₀ h₀
  exact ⟨τ, hτ⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.etale_recursion_data_abstract
statement:
private theorem etale_recursion_data_abstract (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (n : ℕ) (Oj : Fin n → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (Oj j)]
    [∀ j, IsDomain (Oj j)] [∀ j, IsDiscreteValuationRing (Oj j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (Oj j)]
    [∀ j, Module.Finite O (Oj j)] [∀ j, Module.Free O (Oj j)] (δ : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ j, Module.finrank O (Oj j) = δ j) (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (hpiδ : ∀ j, Irreducible (algebraMap O (Oj j) pi)) (A : Type) [CommRing A] [Algebra O A]
    [Module.Finite O A] [Module.Free O A] (B : Fin n → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (B j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)] [∀ j, Module.Finite O (B j)] [∀ j, Module.Free O (B j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra (Oj j) (B j)] [∀ j, IsScalarTower O (Oj j) (B j)] (ψ : A →ₐ[O] ∀ j, B j)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ψ) (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : Module.length O
    ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) = ℓ) (σ : FactorType) (hσ : HasAlgebraType O A σ) :
    ∀ j, (∃ τ : FactorType, HasAlgebraType (Oj j) (B j) τ) ∧ (orderDefect (Oj j) (B j)).toNat ≤
        (orderDefect O A).toNat ∧ (1 ≤ ℓ → (orderDefect (Oj j) (B j)).toNat <
        (orderDefect O A).toNat)
proof:
:= fun j ↦
  ⟨etale_children_types_exist O n Oj δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ A B ψ hinj ℓ hℓ σ hσ j,
    etale_invariant_children O n Oj δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ A B ψ hinj ℓ hℓ σ hσ j⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_termination_data_of_index_map
statement:
private theorem concrete_termination_data_of_index_map (m : ConcreteMember) (n : ℕ)
    (mc : Fin n → ConcreteMember) [∀ j, Algebra m.O (mc j).O] [∀ j, Module.Finite m.O (mc j).O]
    [∀ j, Module.Free m.O (mc j).O] (δ : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ j, Module.finrank m.O (mc j).O = δ j)
    (hpi : ∀ j, Irreducible (algebraMap m.O (mc j).O m.pi)) (J : Ideal m.R) (B : Fin n → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra m.O (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra (mc j).O (B j)]
    [∀ j, IsScalarTower m.O (mc j).O (B j)] [∀ j, Module.Finite (mc j).O (B j)]
    [∀ j, Module.Free (mc j).O (B j)] (ψ : (m.R ⧸ J) →ₐ[m.O] ∀ j, B j) (hψ : Function.Injective ψ)
    (ℓ : ℕ) (hlen : Module.length m.O ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) = (ℓ : ℕ∞))
    [Module.Finite m.O (m.R ⧸ J)] [Module.Free m.O (m.R ⧸ J)] (σ : FactorType)
    (hσ : HasAlgebraType m.O (m.R ⧸ J) σ) :
    ∀ j, (∃ τ : FactorType, HasAlgebraType (mc j).O (B j) τ) ∧ (orderDefect (mc j).O (B j)).toNat ≤
        (orderDefect m.O (m.R ⧸ J)).toNat ∧ (1 ≤ ℓ → (orderDefect (mc j).O (B j)).toNat <
        (orderDefect m.O (m.R ⧸ J)).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ j, Module.Finite m.O (B j) := fun j => Module.Finite.trans (mc j).O (B j)
  have : ∀ j, Module.Free m.O (B j) := fun j => Module.Free.trans (S := (mc j).O)
  have h := etale_recursion_data_abstract m.O n (fun j => (mc j).O) δ hrank m.pi m.hpi hpi
    (m.R ⧸ J) B
  exact h ψ hψ ℓ hlen σ hσ

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_type_event_measurable_of_root_cell_law
statement:
theorem monic_type_event_measurable_of_root_cell_law (hroot : RootCellLaw) (O : Type) [CommRing O]
    [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    MeasurableSet {a : Fin n→O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨S, hS⟩, hcov, -⟩ := monic_cells_partition O htop n
  have key : {a : Fin n→O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O a) σ} =
      ⋃ D ∈ S, (residueCell O n (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D) ∩
          typeEvent O n σ) := by
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff, exists_prop]
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨_, _, _, h⟩ ↦ h⟩
    obtain ⟨D, ⟨hD, ha⟩, -⟩ := hcov a
    exact ⟨D, (hS D).2 hD, ha, h⟩
  rw [key]
  refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun D hD => ?_
  have hD' := (hS D).1 hD
  obtain ⟨⟨m, hm, -⟩, -⟩ := divisor_array_exists_unique (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D hD'.2
  exact (monic_cell_law hroot O htop n D hD' m hm σ).1

name: SurfaceBlowup.root_cell_law_at_universe_member
statement:
theorem root_cell_law_at_universe_member (U : SurfaceUniverse)
    (hE1 : U.ChildTypesExist)
    (hE2 : U.InvariantDecreases fun i J ↦ (orderDefect (U.M i).O ((U.M i).R ⧸ J)).toNat)
    (i : U.ι) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hs : (U.M i).s = State.single 1 r) (f : (U.M i).R)
    (b : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → (U.M i).R)
    (hmeas : Measurable (coordinateIdeal (U.M i).S.pi f b))
    (hμ : (U.M i).μ = (((U.M i).q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (State.single 1 r).degree) •
    (coefficientMeasure (U.M i).O (State.single 1 r).degree).map
    (coordinateIdeal (U.M i).S.pi f b)) (hcell : ∀ z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → (U.M i).O,
    (coordinateIdeal (U.M i).S.pi f b) z ∈ (U.M i).stateSet)
    (htype : ∀ (z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → (U.M i).O) (σ : FactorType), HasAlgebraType
    (U.M i).O ((U.M i).R ⧸ (coordinateIdeal (U.M i).S.pi f b) z) σ ↔ HasPolynomialTypeF (U.M i).O
    (monicPolynomial (U.M i).O ((U.M i).S.pi • z)) σ) (σ : FactorType) :
    MeasurableSet {z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → (U.M i).O | HasPolynomialTypeF (U.M i).O
        (monicPolynomial (U.M i).O ((U.M i).S.pi • z)) σ} ∧ coefficientMeasure (U.M i).O
        (State.single 1 r).degree {z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → (U.M i).O |
        HasPolynomialTypeF (U.M i).O (monicPolynomial (U.M i).O ((U.M i).S.pi • z)) σ} =
        densityValue (lawCoeff (stateLaw (State.single 1 r)) σ) (U.M i).q
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : coordinateIdeal (U.M i).S.pi f b ⁻¹' U.typeEvent i σ =
      {z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → (U.M i).O | HasPolynomialTypeF (U.M i).O
          (monicPolynomial (U.M i).O ((U.M i).S.pi • z)) σ} := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, SurfaceUniverse.typeEvent, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact ⟨fun h => (htype z σ).1 h.2, fun h => ⟨hcell z, (htype z σ).2 h⟩⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hpre]
    exact hmeas (etale_type_event_measurable U hE1
      (fun i J => (orderDefect (U.M i).O ((U.M i).R ⧸ J)).toNat) hE2 i σ)
  · have hd : (State.single 1 r).degree = r := by simp [State.degree]
    have hdpos : 0 < (State.single 1 r).degree := by rw [hd]; exact hr
    obtain ⟨hFm, hFE, hEF, hN⟩ := type_event_null_difference U i σ
    have hL := ((universal_law_statement U i).1 σ).2.2
    rw [hs] at hL
    have e : stateLaw (State.single 1 (State.single 1 r).degree) = stateLaw (State.single 1 r) := by
      rw [hd]
    have key := chart_cell_law_generic (U.M i).O (U.M i).htop (U.M i).S.pi
      (U.M i).R (State.single 1 r).degree f b hmeas
      (U.M i).stateSet hcell (U.M i).μ hμ htype σ (U.termTypeEvent i σ) (U.nonterminatingSet i)
      hFm hFE hEF hN (by rw [e]; exact hL)
    rw [e] at key
    exact key.1

name: SurfaceBlowup.root_cell_law_of_universe
statement: private theorem root_cell_law_of_universe (hU : ConcreteUniverse) : RootCellLaw
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, eι, hM, hE1, hE2⟩ := hU
  intro O _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ htop pi hpi r hr σ
  obtain ⟨hD, hReg, S, hSpi, hSt, hSx, -, hSa, hSb⟩ :=
    concrete_surface_data_exists_unconditional O pi hpi 1 1 0 one_pos
  obtain ⟨A, i₀, hi₀, hf, hb, hμA⟩ :=
    repeated_root_one_chart_atlas O pi hpi S hSpi hSt hSa hSb r hr
  have hshape : StateShape 1 0 (State.single 1 r) := ⟨rfl, rfl, hr⟩
  let m₀ : ConcreteMember :=
    { O := O, htop := htop, pi := pi, hpi := hpi, u := 1, a := 1, b := 0, ha := one_pos,
      S := S, hS_pi := hSpi, hS_t := hSt, hS_x := hSx, hS_a := hSa, hS_b := hSb,
      s := State.single 1 r, shape := hshape, atlas := A }
  set i := eι.symm m₀
  have hMi : U.M i = m₀.toMeasured := by rw [hM i]; simp [i]
  have hdeg : 0 < (State.single 1 r).degree := by simpa [State.degree] using hr
  have key : ∀ M : MeasuredSurface, M = m₀.toMeasured →
      (M.s = State.single 1 r) ∧ ∃ (f : M.R) (b : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → M.R),
        Measurable (coordinateIdeal M.S.pi f b) ∧
        M.μ = ((M.q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (State.single 1 r).degree) •
          (coefficientMeasure M.O (State.single 1 r).degree).map (coordinateIdeal M.S.pi f b) ∧
        (∀ z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → M.O, (coordinateIdeal M.S.pi f b) z ∈ M.stateSet) ∧
        (∀ (z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → M.O) (σ : FactorType),
          HasAlgebraType M.O (M.R ⧸ (coordinateIdeal M.S.pi f b) z) σ ↔
            HasPolynomialTypeF M.O (monicPolynomial M.O (M.S.pi • z)) σ) := by
    intro M hM'
    subst hM'
    have hch := concrete_member_charts m₀ i₀
    refine ⟨rfl, (A.chart i₀).f, (A.chart i₀).b, hch.2.2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · let _ : MeasurableSpace (Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0)) :=
        idealChartSigma O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0) S.pi
      change stateMeasure O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0) S.pi (State.single 1 r).degree
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A = _
      rw [hμA]
      change _ = _ • (coefficientMeasure O (State.single 1 r).degree).map
        (coordinateIdeal S.pi (A.chart i₀).f (A.chart i₀).b)
      rw [hf, hb]
      rfl
    · intro z
      have hz : coordinateIdeal m₀.S.pi (m₀.atlas.chart i₀).f (m₀.atlas.chart i₀).b z ∈
          residueIdealCell (algebraMap m₀.O m₀.R m₀.S.pi) (m₀.atlas.chart i₀).f := by
        rw [← hch.2.1]; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
      exact (Set.ext_iff.1 A.cover _).2 (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i₀, hz⟩)
    · intro z τ
      have e : ∀ z' : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → O,
          HasAlgebraType O (ConcreteSurface O pi 1 1 0 ⧸
            coordinateIdeal S.pi (A.chart i₀).f (A.chart i₀).b z') τ ↔
          HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (S.pi • z')) τ := by
        intro z'
        rw [hf, hb, hSpi]
        exact repeated_root_chart_type O pi hpi _ hdeg z' τ
      exact e z
  have back : ∀ M : MeasuredSurface, M = m₀.toMeasured →
      (MeasurableSet {z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → M.O | HasPolynomialTypeF M.O
          (monicPolynomial M.O (M.S.pi • z)) σ} ∧ coefficientMeasure M.O (State.single 1 r).degree
          {z : Fin (State.single 1 r).degree → M.O | HasPolynomialTypeF M.O
          (monicPolynomial M.O (M.S.pi • z)) σ} = densityValue
          (lawCoeff (stateLaw (State.single 1 r)) σ) M.q) →
      MeasurableSet {z : Fin r → O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ} ∧
      coefficientMeasure O r {z : Fin r → O | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ} =
        densityValue (lawCoeff (stateLaw (State.single 1 r)) σ)
            (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) := by
    intro M hM' h
    subst hM'
    have hpi' : m₀.toMeasured.S.pi = pi := hSpi
    rw [hpi'] at h
    exact root_cell_clauses_reindex O pi σ _ _ r (Nat.one_mul r) h
  obtain ⟨hs, f, b, hmeas, hμ, hcell, htype⟩ := key (U.M i) hMi
  exact back (U.M i) hMi (root_cell_law_at_universe_member U hE1 hE2 i r hr hs f b hmeas hμ hcell
      htype σ)

name: SurfaceBlowup.pattern_degree_facts_of_hasPattern
statement:
private theorem pattern_degree_facts_of_hasPattern (k : Type) [Field k] (a b : ℕ) (s : State)
    (hsh : StateShape a b s)
    (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (hP : Allowed s P) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k)
        (hD : HasPattern k s Dv P) :
    0 < P.d.val ∧
    ((∃ c : ℕ, s = State.single a c ∧ b = 0) ∨ (∃ c h : ℕ, s = State.crossing a b c h ∧ 0 < b)) ∧
    P.d.val ≤ stateContactT s ∧ (∀ h : ℕ, stateContactX s = some h → P.d.val ≤ h) ∧
    (0 < Dv none ↔ P.d.val < stateContactT s) ∧
    (∀ h : ℕ, stateContactX s = some h → (0 < Dv (zeroDirection k) ↔ P.d.val < h)) ∧
    exceptionalDegree k Dv = P.d.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdeg, hinf, hz, -⟩ := hD
  have hinf' : Dv none = P.rt.val := hinf
  cases s with
  | single a' c =>
    obtain ⟨rfl, hb, -⟩ := hsh
    obtain ⟨h0, -, h1, -, h3⟩ := hP
    refine ⟨h0, Or.inl ⟨c, rfl, hb⟩, h1, fun h hh => by simp [stateContactX] at hh, ?_,
      fun h hh => by simp [stateContactX] at hh, hdeg⟩
    rw [hinf']; exact h3
  | crossing a' b' c h =>
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, hb, -, -⟩ := hsh
    obtain ⟨h0, -, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hP
    have hz' : Dv (zeroDirection k) = P.rx.val := hz
    refine ⟨h0, Or.inr ⟨c, h, rfl, hb⟩, h1, fun h' hh => ?_, ?_, fun h' hh => ?_, hdeg⟩
    · simp only [stateContactX, Option.some.injEq] at hh; subst hh; exact h2
    · rw [hinf']; exact h3
    · simp only [stateContactX, Option.some.injEq] at hh; subst hh; rw [hz']; exact h4

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisorStrictTransform_bijOn
statement:
private theorem divisorStrictTransform_bijOn (m : ConcreteMember) (t x : m.R)
    (ht : t = surfaceT m.O m.pi m.u m.a m.b) (hx : x = surfaceX m.O m.pi m.u m.a m.b)
    (e : (BlowupChart m.R t x ⧸ chartExceptional m.R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField m.R))
    (he : ∀ r : m.R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional m.R t x) (chartBase m.R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue m.R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional m.R t x) (chartSlope m.R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (hinf : (infinityPoint m.R t x).IsPrime)
    (P : TangentPattern m.s.degree) (hP : Allowed m.s P)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField m.R))
    (hD : HasPattern (IsLocalRing.ResidueField m.R) m.s Dv P) :
    Set.BijOn (fun J Q => divisorStrictTransform m.R t x e Dv hinf P.d.val J Q)
      (fixedTangentCell m.O m.R m.S m.s P.d.val Dv)
      (Set.pi Set.univ (childIdealSet m.R t x e Dv hinf m.s P.d.val))
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7⟩ :=
    pattern_degree_facts_of_hasPattern (IsLocalRing.ResidueField m.R) m.a m.b m.s m.shape P hP Dv hD
  exact strict_transform_bijOn_child_ideals m.O m.pi m.hpi m.u m.a m.b m.ha m.S ⟨m.hS_t, m.hS_x,
      m.hS_a, m.hS_b⟩ e he
      heZ Dv hinf
    m.s P.d.val h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_child_bijOn
statement:
theorem cell_child_bijOn (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.cellIndex) (D : CellChildData m c) :
    Set.BijOn (fun J j => D.Φ J j) (m.toMeasured.cell c)
        (Set.pi Set.univ fun j => (D.mc j).toMeasured.stateSet)
proof:
:= by
  have hF := divisorStrictTransform_bijOn m m.S.t m.S.x m.hS_t m.hS_x D.e D.he D.heZ D.hinf c.1.1
      c.1.2 c.2.1
      c.2.2
  set d := m.toMeasured.cellDegree c
  let T : (∀ Q, Ideal (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf Q)) →
      ∀ j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c, Ideal (D.mc j).R :=
    fun u j => Ideal.map (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j)
        →+* (D.mc j).R)
      (u (D.point j))
  have hmapmap : ∀ j (I : Ideal (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j))),
      Ideal.map ((D.Eq j).symm : (D.mc j).R →+* divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf
          (D.point j)) (Ideal.map
          (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j) →+* (D.mc j).R)
          I) = I := fun j _ ↦ Ideal.map_of_equiv (D.Eq j)
  have hmapmap' : ∀ j (I : Ideal (D.mc j).R),
      Ideal.map (D.Eq j : divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j) →+*
          (D.mc j).R) (Ideal.map
          ((D.Eq j).symm : (D.mc j).R →+* divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf
          (D.point j)) I) = I := fun j _ ↦ Ideal.map_of_equiv (D.Eq j).symm
  have hsurjpt : ∀ Q : divisorSupport c.2.1, ∃ j, D.point j = Q := by
    intro Q
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (D.asg.supp Q.1).mp Q.2
    exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext hj⟩
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (fun j => D.point j) :=
    ⟨fun i j h => D.asg.inj (congrArg Subtype.val h), hsurjpt⟩
  let σ := Equiv.ofBijective _ hbij
  have hT : Set.BijOn T (Set.pi Set.univ (childIdealSet m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf m.s d))
      (Set.pi Set.univ fun j => (D.mc j).toMeasured.stateSet) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u hu j _
      exact (child_ideal_set_map_iff_stateSet m c D j (u (D.point j))).mp (hu _ (Set.mem_univ _))
    · intro u _ v _ huv
      funext Q
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hsurjpt Q
      have := congrFun huv j
      rw [← hmapmap j (u (D.point j)), ← hmapmap j (v (D.point j))]
      exact congrArg _ this
    · intro w hw
      let v : ∀ j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c, Ideal
          (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j)) :=
        fun j => Ideal.map ((D.Eq j).symm : (D.mc j).R →+* divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e
            c.2.1 D.hinf (D.point j)) (w j)
      let u := Equiv.piCongrLeft (fun Q => Ideal
          (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf Q)) σ v
      have hu : ∀ j, u (D.point j) = v j := fun j => Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply
          (fun Q => Ideal (divisorLocalRing m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf Q)) σ v j
      refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro Q _
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hsurjpt Q
        rw [hu]
        apply (child_ideal_set_map_iff_stateSet m c D j _).mpr
        exact (hmapmap' j (w j)).symm ▸ hw j (Set.mem_univ _)
      · funext j
        change Ideal.map _ (u (D.point j)) = w j
        rw [hu]
        exact hmapmap' j (w j)
  have hcomp : (fun J j => D.Φ J j) =
      T ∘ (fun J Q => divisorStrictTransform m.R m.S.t m.S.x D.e c.2.1 D.hinf d J Q) := by
    funext J j
    exact cell_child_Phi_eq_map m c D J j
  rw [hcomp]
  exact hT.comp hF

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_sum_coeff
statement:
private theorem residue_sum_coeff {R : Type} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → R) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    (∑ j : Fin (d + 1), Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R (c j)) * Polynomial.X ^ j.val).coeff i =
      IsLocalRing.residue R (c i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ if_neg fun h ↦ hj (Fin.ext h.symm)) (by simp)]
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_sum_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem residue_sum_ne_zero (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {(surfaceT O pi u a b), (surfaceX O pi u a b)}) :
    ∑ j : Fin (d + 1), Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue _ (c j)) * Polynomial.X ^ j.val ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
  intro h0
  have := residue_sum_coeff d c i
  rw [h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero, eq_comm, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff,
    concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha] at this
  exact hi this

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_datum_left_multiplicity_pos
statement:
private theorem cell_datum_left_multiplicity_pos (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span
    {(surfaceT O pi u a b), (surfaceX O pi u a b)})
    (e : ((BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ⧸
    chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ≃+*
    Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) r)) =
    Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
    Polynomial.X) (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta)
    (hl : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftData D s = completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (leftPoint D s) (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (c i) *
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))^i.val) ∧
    (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (c i) *
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))^i.val) ∈
    leftPoint D s) (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) :
    0 < leftMultiplicity D s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  obtain ⟨hPmax, -, hPt⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) _ _
    beta D
  have := hPmax s
  obtain ⟨φ, hPφ, hmap, -⟩ := chart_point_eq_directionPoint _ _ _ e he heZ _ (hPt s)
  have hdvd : φ.val ∣ ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue _ (c i)) * Polynomial.X ^ i.val := by
    have hmem := (hl s).2
    rw [hPφ] at hmem
    unfold directionPoint at hmem
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    convert hmem using 1
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, map_sum,
      map_mul, map_pow, heZ]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ congrArg (· * _) (he (c i)).symm
  unfold leftMultiplicity leftLevelIdeal finiteLocalCurveIdeal
  rw [(hl s).1, pow_one, concrete_strict_transform_multiplicity O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne
    (leftPoint D s) (hPt s) e he heZ φ.val φ.property hmap, ENat.toNat_natCast]
  exact Multiset.count_pos.mpr ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.mem_normalizedFactors_iff'
    (residue_sum_ne_zero O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne)).mpr
    ⟨φ.2.2, φ.2.1.normalize_eq_self, hdvd⟩)

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_datum_right_multiplicity_pos
statement:
private theorem cell_datum_right_multiplicity_pos (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span
    {(surfaceT O pi u a b), (surfaceX O pi u a b)})
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta)
    (hr : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, Ideal.span {rightData D s} = Ideal.span
    {completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (rightPoint D s) (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap
    (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b))^(d - i.val))} ∧ (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap
    (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b))^(d - i.val)) ∈ rightPoint D s) (l : D.ιinf) :
    0 < rightMultiplicity D (Sum.inr l)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  set H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (d+1), Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue _ (c i)) * Polynomial.X ^ i.val with hH
  obtain ⟨hPmax, -, hPx⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) _ _
    beta D
  have hW := D.slopeinf l
  
  have hcd : c (Fin.last d) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hmem := (hr (Sum.inr l)).2
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at hmem
    simp only [Fin.val_last, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one] at hmem
    refine (hPmax (Sum.inr l)).ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _
      ((Ideal.add_mem_iff_right _ (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_)).1 hmem)
      ((IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hnot).map _))
    have := i.isLt
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero
      (by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]; omega : d - (Fin.castSucc i).val ≠ 0)
    rw [hk, pow_succ]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hW)
  have hlt : H.natDegree < d := by
    refine (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ ↦
      (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt)).lt_of_ne
      fun h ↦ residue_sum_ne_zero O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne ?_
    rw [← Polynomial.leadingCoeff_eq_zero, Polynomial.leadingCoeff, h]
    simpa [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] using (residue_sum_coeff d c (Fin.last d)).trans
      ((IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hcd)
  unfold rightMultiplicity rightLevelIdeal finiteLocalCurveIdeal
  rw [pow_one, Ideal.span_insert, (hr (Sum.inr l)).1, ← Ideal.span_insert,
    concrete_infinity_strict_transform_multiplicity O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne
      (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) (hPx _) hW, ENat.toNat_natCast, ← hH]
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_index_map_reindexed_of_eq
statement:
private theorem concrete_index_map_reindexed_of_eq (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (t x : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (ht : t = surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (hx : x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x beta) (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (G : GluedGenerators (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x beta (curveDataDegree D))
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x j f =
    (cechInputLattice (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x j).mkQ
    (gluedFunctionPair (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x G j))
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk
    ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)^j)
    (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j) (n : ℕ) (e : Fin n ≃ AllPoints D) (B : Fin n → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)] (eB : ∀ j, B j ≃+*
    (localRing D (e j) ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D (e j)}))
    (hB : ∀ (j : Fin n) (c : O), (eB j) (algebraMap O (B j) c) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {localCurve D (e j)}) (localFromSurface D (e j)
    (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c))) :
    ∃ ψ : ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₐ[O] ∀ j, B j, Function.Injective ψ ∧
        Module.length O ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) =
        (chooseTwo (curveDataDegree D) : ℕ∞) ∧ ∀ (r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (j : Fin n),
        (eB j) (ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) r) j) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Ideal.span {localCurve D (e j)}) (localFromSurface D (e j) r)
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  exact concrete_index_map_reindexed O pi hpi u a b ha beta D f G hf hG n e B eB hB

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_datum_multiplicities_pos_of_eq
statement:
private theorem cell_datum_multiplicities_pos_of_eq (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (t x : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (ht : t = surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (hx : x = surfaceX O pi u a b) [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {t, x})
    (e : ((BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) ⧸ chartExceptional
    (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) ≃+* Polynomial
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) r)) = Polynomial.C
    (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x beta)
    (hl : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftData D s = completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) (leftPoint D s)
    (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) (c i) *
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)^i.val) ∧
    (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) (c i) *
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)^i.val) ∈ leftPoint D s)
    (hr : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, Ideal.span {rightData D s} = Ideal.span
    {completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) (rightPoint D s)
    (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) (c i) *
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)^(d - i.val))} ∧
    (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) (c i) *
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)^(d - i.val)) ∈ rightPoint D s) :
    (∀ i : D.ι, 0 < commonMultiplicity D i) ∧ (∀ k : D.ι0, 0 < leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inr k)) ∧ ∀
        l : D.ιinf, 0 < rightMultiplicity D (Sum.inr l)
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ ?_, fun k ↦ cell_datum_left_multiplicity_pos O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne e he heZ
    beta D hl (Sum.inr k), cell_datum_right_multiplicity_pos O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne beta D hr⟩
  rw [← (two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) _ _ beta D i).1]
  exact cell_datum_left_multiplicity_pos O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne e he heZ beta D hl (Sum.inl i)

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_datum_concrete_instances_of_eq
statement:
private theorem two_chart_datum_concrete_instances_of_eq (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (t x : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (ht : t = surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (hx : x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x beta) :
    (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) (leftPoint D s)) ∧ Function.Injective
        (fun y : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
        (leftPoint D s)) => (completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
        (leftPoint D s)) ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) t) * y)) ∧
        (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) (rightPoint D s)) ∧ Function.Injective
        (fun y : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)
        (rightPoint D s)) => (completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)
        (rightPoint D s)) ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) x) * y)) ∧ ∀ p : AllPoints
        D, IsNoetherianRing (localRing D p) ∧ ∃ _ : IsLocalRing (localRing D p), IsAdicComplete
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)) (localRing D p) ∧ localException D p ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  exact two_chart_datum_concrete_instances O pi hpi u a b ha beta D

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_two_chart_glued_generators_exist_of_eq
statement:
private theorem concrete_two_chart_glued_generators_exist_of_eq (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (t x : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (ht : t = surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (hx : x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x beta) :
    ∃ f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, ∃ G : GluedGenerators (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x beta
        (curveDataDegree D), (∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x j f =
        (cechInputLattice (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x j).mkQ
        (gluedFunctionPair (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x G j)) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span
        {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)^j) (G.left j)} =
        leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk
        ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D
        j
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  exact concrete_two_chart_glued_generators_exist O pi hpi u a b ha beta D

name: SurfaceBlowup.fixed_tangent_cell_curve_datum_of_eq
statement:
private theorem fixed_tangent_cell_curve_datum_of_eq (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (t x : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (ht : t = surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (hx : x = surfaceX O pi u a b) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (hS : S.t = t ∧ S.x = x)
    (e : ((BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) ⧸ chartExceptional
    (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) ≃+* Polynomial
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) r)) = Polynomial.C
    (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) (s : State)
    (d : ℕ) (J : Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hJ : J ∈ fixedTangentCell O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S s d Dv)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) :
    ∃ (f : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (c : Fin (d+1) → (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
        (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x beta), J = Ideal.span {f} ∧ f = ∑ i
        : Fin (d+1), c i * t^(d - i.val) * x^i.val ∧
        (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftData D s = completedPointMap
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) (leftPoint D s)
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) (c i) *
        (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)^i.val) ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x) (c i) *
        (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x)^i.val) ∈ leftPoint D s) ∧
        (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, Ideal.span {rightData D s} = Ideal.span
        {completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) (rightPoint D s)
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) (c i) *
        (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)^(d - i.val))} ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t) (c i) *
        (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t)^(d - i.val)) ∈ rightPoint D s) ∧
        (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) t x (leftPoint D s) d J =
        Ideal.span {leftData D s}) ∧ (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, strictTransformAt
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) x t (rightPoint D s) d J = Ideal.span {rightData D s}) ∧
        MatchesDivisor e D Dv ∧ curveDataDegree D = exceptionalDegree
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) Dv
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  exact fixed_tangent_cell_curve_datum O pi hpi u a b ha S hS e he heZ Dv s d J hJ beta

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_coeff_notMem_span_of_notMem_pow
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hc
  refine h (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_)
  have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hc i) (Ideal.mul_mem_mul
    (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.subset_span (by simp) : t ∈ Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R)) (d - i.val))
    (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.subset_span (by simp) : x ∈ Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R)) i.val))
  rw [← Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt)] at this
  rwa [mul_assoc, Ideal.IsTwoSided.pow_succ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_member_index_map
statement:
theorem cell_member_index_map (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.cellIndex) (D : CellChildData m c)
    (J : Ideal m.R) (hJ : J ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c) (B : m.toMeasured.childIdx c → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra m.O (B j)] (eB : ∀ j, B j ≃+* (D.mc j).R ⧸ D.Φ J j)
    (hB : ∀ (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c) (r : m.O), eB j (algebraMap m.O (B j) r) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (D.Φ J j) (algebraMap m.O (D.mc j).R r)) :
    ∃ ψ : (m.R ⧸ J) →ₐ[m.O] ∀ j, B j, Function.Injective ψ ∧ Module.length m.O
        ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) = (chooseTwo (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) : ℕ∞)
        ∧ ∀ (r : m.R) (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c), eB j (ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J r) j) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (D.Φ J j) (D.alpha j r)
proof:
:= by
  set d := m.toMeasured.cellDegree c
  obtain ⟨beta⟩ := actual_blowup_restriction_exists m.R m.S.t m.S.x
  obtain ⟨f, cf, Df, hJf, hcf, hl, hr, hstl, hstr, hmatch, hdeg⟩ :=
    fixed_tangent_cell_curve_datum_of_eq m.O m.pi m.hpi m.u m.a m.b m.ha m.S.t m.S.x m.hS_t m.hS_x
      m.S ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ D.e D.he D.heZ c.2.1 m.s d J hJ beta
  have hdeg' : curveDataDegree Df = d := hdeg.trans c.2.2.1
  have hreg : RegularParameterPair m.R m.S.t m.S.x := by
    rw [m.hS_t, m.hS_x]
    exact concrete_surface_regular_pair_tx m.O m.pi m.hpi.ne_zero m.u m.a m.b m.ha
  have hregSwap : RegularParameterPair m.R m.S.x m.S.t := by
    rw [m.hS_t, m.hS_x]
