    refine ⟨O, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, pi,
      substUnit O α u * shiftUnit O α hα ^ b, a + b, 0, hpi, by omega, Eq, ?_⟩
    refine residue_series_of_completion_equiv O pi u a b P e he heZ φ hPφ O pi hpi _ (a + b) 0
      (by omega) (RingHom.id O) α Eq (fun s ↦ by rw [MvPowerSeries.map_id]; exact hb s) hs
      κ.toRingHom hκ _ hP2 fun q hq ↦ ?_
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hs, hc, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact constantCoeff_quotient_surfaceX O pi hpi _ _ _ q hq
  · have hθ := unramified_root_isUnit_of_two_le_natDegree O Φ hΦ h2
    obtain ⟨Eq, hb, hs, hc, -, -⟩ :=
      t_chart_nonrational_point_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha Φ hΦ hθ P hP3
    obtain ⟨hdom, hloc, hdvr, -, hirr, hcomp, hfin, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
    let ρ : O →+* AdjoinRoot Φ := algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)
    have : IsLocalHom ρ := by
      refine ⟨fun x hx ↦ by_contra fun hnu ↦ ?_⟩
      have hxm : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O := hnu
      rw [(IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer pi).1 hpi,
        Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hxm
      exact (hirr pi hpi).not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_unit (map_dvd ρ hxm) hx)
    refine ⟨AdjoinRoot Φ, inferInstance, hdom, hdvr, hcomp, hfin, ρ pi, _, a + b, 0, hirr pi hpi,
      by omega, Eq, ?_⟩
    refine residue_series_of_completion_equiv O pi u a b P e he heZ φ hPφ (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ρ pi)
      (hirr pi hpi) _ (a + b) 0 (by omega) ρ (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) Eq hb hs
      ((IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map ρ).comp κ.toRingHom) ?_ _ hP3 ?_
    · exact fun s ↦ by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, hκ, IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
    · intro q hq
      let Ψ : tChart O pi u a b →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ) :=
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff.comp (q.toRingHom.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp
          (Eq.toRingHom.comp (completedPointMap _ P))))
      change Ψ _ = 0
      rw [Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
      have h1 : Ψ.comp ((tBase O pi u a b).comp (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) =
          (IsLocalRing.residue (AdjoinRoot Φ)).comp ρ := by
        ext c
        simp only [Ψ, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, hc]
        exact constantCoeff_quotient_algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ρ pi) (hirr pi hpi) _ _ _ q hq (ρ c)
      have h2 : Ψ (tSlope O pi u a b) = IsLocalRing.residue (AdjoinRoot Φ) (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) := by
        simp only [Ψ, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, hs,
          map_add]
        rw [constantCoeff_quotient_surfaceX (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ρ pi) (hirr pi hpi) _ _ _ q hq,
          constantCoeff_quotient_algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ρ pi) (hirr pi hpi) _ _ _ q hq,
          zero_add]
      rw [h1, h2, ← Polynomial.hom_eval₂, show ρ = AdjoinRoot.of Φ from rfl, AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root,
        map_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_killX
statement:
private theorem coeff_killX (O : Type) [CommRing O] (g : TwoSeries O) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (killX O g) = MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 n) g
proof:
:=
  coeff_substAlgHom_kill O _ (killXFamily_hasSubst O) 1 0 (by decide) rfl rfl g n

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_residueKillX
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_killX]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.residueKillX_apply_ker
statement:
private theorem residueKillX_apply_ker (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) :
    (∀ c : O, residueKillX O (MvPowerSeries.C c) = PowerSeries.C (IsLocalRing.residue O c)) ∧
    residueKillX O (axisT O) = PowerSeries.X ∧ residueKillX O (axisX O) = 0 ∧ Function.Surjective
    (residueKillX O) ∧ RingHom.ker (residueKillX O) = Ideal.span
    {(MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O), axisX O} ∧
    (∀ s : TwoSeries O, killX O (xChartSubst O s) = killT O s) ∧ ∀ s : TwoSeries O, killX O
    (chartSubst O 0 s) = killX O s
proof:
:= by
  have hX : ∀ i, MvPowerSeries.subst (killXFamily O) (MvPowerSeries.X i : TwoSeries O) =
      killXFamily O i := fun i ↦ MvPowerSeries.subst_X (killXFamily_hasSubst O) i
  have hM := fun a b : TwoSeries O ↦ MvPowerSeries.subst_mul (killXFamily_hasSubst O) a b
  refine ⟨fun c ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun s ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  · ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillX]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn; simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
    · simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, PowerSeries.coeff_C, hn]
  · ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillX]
    by_cases hn : n = 1
    · subst hn; simp [axisT, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
    · simp only [Fin.isValue, axisT, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, MonoidWithZeroHom.map_ite_one_zero,
        PowerSeries.coeff_X, hn, ↓reduceIte, ite_eq_right_iff, one_ne_zero, imp_false]
      intro h; have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f 0) h
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this; exact hn this
  · ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillX]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, axisX, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, MonoidWithZeroHom.map_ite_one_zero,
      map_zero, ite_eq_right_iff, one_ne_zero, imp_false]
    intro h; have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f 1) h; simp at this
  · intro h
    let g : TwoSeries O := fun m ↦
      if m 1 = 0 then (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (PowerSeries.coeff (m 0) h)).choose else 0
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillX]
    change IsLocalRing.residue O (if _ then _ else _) = _
    simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne,
      ↓reduceIte, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    exact (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (PowerSeries.coeff n h)).choose_spec
  · ext g
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, axisX, mvPowerSeries_mem_span_C_var_iff]
    have hm (x : O) : IsLocalRing.residue O x = 0 ↔ pi ∣ x := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hpi.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hg m hm0
      have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff (m (0 : Fin 2))) hg
      rw [coeff_residueKillX, map_zero (PowerSeries.coeff _), hm] at this
      have hmeq : Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (m (0 : Fin 2)) = m := by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hm0]
      rwa [hmeq] at this
    · refine fun hg ↦ PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
      rw [coeff_residueKillX, map_zero, hm]
      exact hg _ (by simp)
  · simp only [killX, xChartSubst, killT, MvPowerSeries.coe_substAlgHom]
    rw [MvPowerSeries.subst_comp_subst_apply (xChartFamily_hasSubst O) (killXFamily_hasSubst O)]
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [xChartFamily, axisT, axisX, Fin.zero_eta, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [hM, hX, hX]; simp [killXFamily, killTFamily]
    · simp only [xChartFamily, axisT, axisX, Fin.mk_one, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [hX]; simp [killXFamily, killTFamily]
  · simp only [killX, chartSubst, MvPowerSeries.coe_substAlgHom]
    rw [MvPowerSeries.subst_comp_subst_apply (tChartFamily_hasSubst O 0) (killXFamily_hasSubst O)]
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [tChartFamily, axisT, axisX, Fin.zero_eta, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [hX]
    · simp only [tChartFamily, axisT, axisX, map_zero, add_zero, Fin.mk_one, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [hM, hX, hX]; simp [killXFamily]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_quotient_X_equiv
statement:
private theorem concrete_surface_quotient_X_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ q : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi u a b}) ≃+* PowerSeries
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O), ∀ s : TwoSeries O, q
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi u a b}) (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
    residueKillX O s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hsurj, hker, -⟩ := residueKillX_apply_ker O pi hpi
  set I := surfaceIdeal O pi u a b
  set J : Ideal (TwoSeries O) := Ideal.span {axisX O}
  have h1 : Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi u a b} = J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; rfl
  have hdiff : surfaceRelation O pi u a b - MvPowerSeries.C pi ∈ J := by
    obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ : ∃ b', b = b' + 1 := ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩
    have : surfaceRelation O pi u a (b'+1) - MvPowerSeries.C pi
        = axisX O * (-(u : TwoSeries O) * axisT O ^ a * axisX O ^ b') := by
      unfold surfaceRelation; ring
    rw [this]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have hX : axisX O ∈ J := Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have h2 : I ⊔ J = RingHom.ker (residueKillX O) := by
    rw [hker]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
        rintro _ rfl
        have : surfaceRelation O pi u a b =
            (surfaceRelation O pi u a b - MvPowerSeries.C pi) + MvPowerSeries.C pi := by ring
        change _ ∈ _
        rw [this]
        refine Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
        exact (Ideal.span_mono (by simp) : J ≤ _) hdiff
      · exact Ideal.span_mono (by simp)
    · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
      rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
      · have : (MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O) = surfaceRelation O pi u a b -
          (surfaceRelation O pi u a b - MvPowerSeries.C pi) := by ring
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, this]
        exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span rfl))
            (Ideal.mem_sup_right hdiff)
      · exact Ideal.mem_sup_right hX
  refine ⟨((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq h1).trans (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup I J)).trans
    ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq h2).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj)), fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_quotient_comap_of_surjective
statement:
private theorem length_quotient_comap_of_surjective {S T : Type} [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (φ : S →+* T) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (J : Ideal T) :
    Module.length S (S ⧸ J.comap φ) = Module.length T (T ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  have : RingHomSurjective φ := ⟨hφ⟩
  let g := Ideal.quotientMap J φ le_rfl
  let f : (S ⧸ J.comap φ) →ₛₗ[φ] (T ⧸ J) :=
    { toFun := g
      map_add' := map_add g
      map_smul' := by
        intro s x
        induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
        | h x =>
          change g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (s * x)) = _
          simp only [g, Ideal.quotientMap_mk, map_mul]
          rfl }
  have hb : Function.Bijective f := ⟨Ideal.quotientMap_injective,
      Ideal.quotientMap_surjective (H := le_rfl) hφ⟩
  apply WithBot.coe_injective
  rw [Module.coe_length, Module.coe_length,
    Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (Submodule.orderIsoMapComapOfBijective f hb)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_quotient_sup_eq_order
statement:
private theorem length_quotient_sup_eq_order {S k : Type} [CommRing S] [Field k]
    (φ : S →+* PowerSeries k) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (w g : S)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {w}) :
    Module.length S (S ⧸ (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {w})) = (φ g).order
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {w} = (Ideal.span {φ g}).comap φ := by
    rw [← Set.image_singleton, ← Ideal.map_span, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hφ,
      ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
  rw [h1, length_quotient_comap_of_surjective φ hφ,
      (powerSeries_quotient_length_eq_order k _).1]

name: SurfaceBlowup.surjective_ker_comp_quotient_equiv
statement:
private theorem surjective_ker_comp_quotient_equiv {S T k : Type} [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Field k] (E : S ≃+* T) (y : T) (q : (T ⧸ Ideal.span {y}) ≃+* PowerSeries k) (w : S)
    (hw : E w = y) :
    Function.Surjective (q.toRingHom.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {y})).comp E.toRingHom)) ∧
    RingHom.ker (q.toRingHom.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {y})).comp E.toRingHom)) =
      Ideal.span {w}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨q.surjective.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp E.surjective), ?_⟩
  have hspan : Ideal.span {y} = (Ideal.span {w}).map E.toRingHom := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ hw.symm)
  rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ q.injective, ← RingHom.comap_ker, Ideal.mk_ker, hspan]
  exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective E.toRingHom E.bijective

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_infinity_boundary_contact
statement:
theorem concrete_infinity_boundary_contact (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) (f : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * (surfaceT O pi u a b) ^ (d - i.val) *
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) ^ i.val)
    (Pinf : Ideal (xChart O pi u a b)) [Pinf.IsMaximal] [Pinf.IsPrime]
    (hx : xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b) ∈ Pinf) (hW : xSlope O pi u a b ∈ Pinf) :
    Module.length (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ (Ideal.span {f} ⊔ Ideal.span {(surfaceT O pi u a b)})) =
    (d : ℕ∞) + Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) Pinf)
    (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) Pinf ⧸
      (Ideal.span {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) Pinf
          (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            (xSlope O pi u a b)^(d - i.val))} ⊔
        Ideal.span {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) Pinf (xSlope O pi u a b)}))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (c (Fin.last d))
  change surfaceMk O pi u a b s = _ at hs
  have hvan : ∀ {M : Type} [CommMonoidWithZero M] (i : Fin d), (0 : M) ^
      (d - (Fin.castSucc i).val) = 0 :=
    fun i ↦ zero_pow (by simp; omega)
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_T_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  let φ := q.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b}))
  have hφs : Function.Surjective φ := q.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hφk : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b} := by
    rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ q.injective, Ideal.mk_ker]
  have hφ : ∀ t, φ (surfaceMk O pi u a b t) = residueKillT O t := fun t ↦ hq t
  obtain ⟨hC, hT, hX, -⟩ := residueKillT_apply_ker O pi hpi
  rw [length_quotient_sup_eq_order φ hφs _ f hφk]
  have hf : φ f = residueKillT O s * PowerSeries.X ^ d := by
    rw [hc, map_sum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow, surfaceT, surfaceX, hφ, hT, hX]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ ↦ by rw [hvan i, mul_zero, zero_mul])]
    simp [← hs, hφ]
  
  obtain ⟨hP, -⟩ := concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha Pinf hx hW
  obtain ⟨E, hE1, hE2, -⟩ := x_chart_infinity_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha Pinf hP
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_X_equiv O pi hpi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a ha
  obtain ⟨-, -, hX', -, -, hKX, -⟩ := residueKillX_apply_ker O pi hpi
  let ψ := q'.toRingHom.comp
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a})).comp E.toRingHom)
  obtain ⟨hψs, hψk⟩ := surjective_ker_comp_quotient_equiv E _ q' _ hE2
  rw [length_quotient_sup_eq_order ψ hψs _ _ hψk]
  have hψW : ψ (completedPointMap _ Pinf (xSlope O pi u a b)) = 0 := by
    change q' (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (E _)) = 0
    rw [hE2, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _), map_zero]
  have hψB (t) : ψ (completedPointMap _ Pinf (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceMk O pi u a b t))) =
      residueKillT O t := by
    change q' (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (E _)) = _
    rw [hE1, hq']
    simp only [residueKillX, residueKillT, RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact congrArg _ (hKX t)
  have hg : ψ (completedPointMap _ Pinf (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
      algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
      (xSlope O pi u a b)^(d - i.val))) = residueKillT O s := by
    rw [map_sum, map_sum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow, hψW]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ ↦ by rw [hvan i, mul_zero])]
    simp only [Fin.val_last, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, zero_add, ← hs]
    exact hψB s
  rw [hf, hg, PowerSeries.order_mul, PowerSeries.order_X_pow, add_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_zero_boundary_contact
statement:
theorem concrete_zero_boundary_contact (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (d : ℕ) (f : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * (surfaceT O pi u a b) ^ (d - i.val) *
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) ^ i.val)
    (P : Ideal (tChart O pi u a b)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : P = Ideal.span {tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b), (tSlope O pi u a b)}) :
    Module.length (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    ((ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ⧸ (Ideal.span {f} ⊔ Ideal.span {(surfaceX O pi u a b)})) =
    (d : ℕ∞) + Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P)
    (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P ⧸
      (Ideal.span {completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) P
          (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            (tSlope O pi u a b)^i.val)} ⊔
        Ideal.span {completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) P (tSlope O pi u a b)}))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (c 0)
  change surfaceMk O pi u a b s = _ at hs
  have hvan : ∀ {M : Type} [CommMonoidWithZero M] (i : Fin d), (0 : M) ^ (Fin.succ i).val = 0 :=
    fun i ↦ zero_pow (by simp)
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_X_equiv O pi hpi u a b hb
  let φ := q.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi u a b}))
  have hφs : Function.Surjective φ := q.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hφk : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi u a b} := by
    rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ q.injective, Ideal.mk_ker]
  have hφ : ∀ t, φ (surfaceMk O pi u a b t) = residueKillX O t := fun t ↦ hq t
  obtain ⟨hC, hT, hX, -, -, -, hKX⟩ := residueKillX_apply_ker O pi hpi
  rw [length_quotient_sup_eq_order φ hφs _ f hφk]
  have hf : φ f = residueKillX O s * PowerSeries.X ^ d := by
    rw [hc, map_sum, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow, surfaceT, surfaceX, hφ, hT, hX]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ ↦ by rw [hvan i, mul_zero])]
    simp [← hs, hφ]
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE1, hE2, -⟩ := t_chart_origin_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_X_equiv O pi hpi (substUnit O 0 u) (a + b) b hb
  let ψ := q'.toRingHom.comp
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi (substUnit O 0 u) (a + b) b})).comp E.toRingHom)
  obtain ⟨hψs, hψk⟩ := surjective_ker_comp_quotient_equiv E _ q' _ hE2
  rw [length_quotient_sup_eq_order ψ hψs _ _ hψk]
  have hψW : ψ (completedPointMap _ P (tSlope O pi u a b)) = 0 := by
    change q' (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (E _)) = 0
    rw [hE2, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _), map_zero]
  have hψB (t) : ψ (completedPointMap _ P (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceMk O pi u a b t))) =
      residueKillX O t := by
    change q' (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (E _)) = _
    rw [hE1, hq']
    simp only [residueKillX, RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact congrArg _ (hKX t)
  have hg : ψ (completedPointMap _ P (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
      algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
      (tSlope O pi u a b)^i.val)) = residueKillX O s := by
    rw [map_sum, map_sum, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow, hψW]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ ↦ by rw [hvan i, mul_zero])]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, add_zero, ← hs]
    exact hψB s
  rw [hf, hg, PowerSeries.order_mul, PowerSeries.order_X_pow, add_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.laurent_monomial_shift_trailing_degree
statement:
private theorem laurent_monomial_shift_trailing_degree (k : Type) [Field k] (PA PB : Polynomial k)
    (hA : PA ≠ 0) (hB : PB ≠ 0) (c : k) (m : ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (h : PA.toLaurent = LaurentPolynomial.C c * LaurentPolynomial.T m *
      (LaurentPolynomial.T (d : ℤ) * LaurentPolynomial.invert (R := k) PB.toLaurent)) :
    (PA.natTrailingDegree : ℤ) = m + (d : ℤ) - (PB.natDegree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  set e : ℤ := m + d - PB.natDegree with he
  set a : ℕ := e.toNat
  set b : ℕ := (-e).toNat
  have hab : (a : ℤ) - b = e := by omega
  have hinv : LaurentPolynomial.invert (R := k) PB.toLaurent
      = PB.reverse.toLaurent * LaurentPolynomial.T (-(PB.natDegree : ℤ)) := by
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.toLaurent_reverse, mul_assoc, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
    simp
  have key : PA * Polynomial.X ^ b = Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X ^ a * PB.reverse := by
    apply Polynomial.toLaurent_injective
    simp only [map_mul, Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow, Polynomial.toLaurent_C, h, hinv]
    have : LaurentPolynomial.T (R := k) m * (LaurentPolynomial.T (d : ℤ) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-(PB.natDegree : ℤ))) * LaurentPolynomial.T (b : ℤ)
        = LaurentPolynomial.T (a : ℤ) := by
      simp only [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]; congr 1; omega
    rw [← this]
    ring
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hA (by simpa using key)
  have hR : PB.reverse.natTrailingDegree = 0 := Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_reverse _
  have := congrArg Polynomial.natTrailingDegree key
  rw [Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_mul hA (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero),
    Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_mul (mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.2 hc)
      (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero)) (by simpa using hB),
    Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_mul (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.2 hc)
      (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero), hR] at this
  simp at this
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_sum_fin_C_mul_X_pow
statement:
private theorem coeff_sum_fin_C_mul_X_pow {S : Type} [Semiring S] (N : ℕ)
    (f : Fin (N + 1) → S) (j : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (N + 1), Polynomial.C (f i) * Polynomial.X ^ i.val).coeff j =
      if h : j < N + 1 then f ⟨j, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨j, h⟩ (fun i _ hi ↦ if_neg fun hj ↦ hi (Fin.ext hj.symm))
      (by simp)]
    simp
  · exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ if_neg (by omega)

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_overlap_exceptional_laurent
statement:
private theorem exists_overlap_exceptional_laurent (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ (φ : (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) →+*
        LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
      (ψ : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) →+*
        (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})),
      ψ.comp φ = RingHom.id _ ∧
      (∀ r : R, φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        (chartBase R t x r))) = C (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r)) ∧
      φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        (chartSlope R t x))) = T 1
proof:
:= by
  set I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)
  set E : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) := Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}
  have htI : t ∈ I := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hxI : x ∈ I := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  let zQ : (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ E)ˣ :=
    ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (chartSlope R t x)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk E)).unit
  let fK : (R ⧸ I) →+* (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ E) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift I ((Ideal.Quotient.mk E).comp (algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x)))
      fun a ha ↦ by
        refine (Ideal.span_le.2 (Set.pair_subset ?_ ?_) : I ≤ RingHom.ker _) ha <;>
          simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply,
            Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] <;>
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (BlowupChart R t x)]
        · exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
        · change algebraMap _ _ (chartBase R t x x) ∈ _
          rw [← blowup_chart_relation, map_mul]
          exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  let ψ := eval₂ fK zQ
  let φ₀ : BlowupChart R t x →+* LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift _ (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (C.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) (T 1))
      fun a ha ↦ by
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp ha
        simp [blowupRelation, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr htI,
          Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hxI]
  have hφ₀ : IsUnit (φ₀ (chartSlope R t x)) := by
    simpa [φ₀, chartSlope] using isUnit_T (R := R ⧸ I) 1
  let φ₁ : BlowupOverlap R t x →+* LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift (chartSlope R t x) hφ₀
  let φ : (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ E) →+* LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift E φ₁ fun a ha ↦ by
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp ha
      simp [φ₁, overlapException, φ₀, chartBase, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr htI]
  have hφA : ∀ a : BlowupChart R t x,
      φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk E (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a)) = φ₀ a :=
    fun a ↦ by simp only [φ, φ₁, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  have hφ₀C : ∀ r : R, φ₀ (chartBase R t x r) = C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r) :=
    fun r ↦ by simp [φ₀, chartBase]
  have hφ₀Z : φ₀ (chartSlope R t x) = T 1 := by simp [φ₀, chartSlope]
  have hψC : ∀ r : R, ψ (C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk E
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) := fun r ↦ by
    simp only [ψ, eval₂_C, fK]
    rfl
  have hψφ : ψ.comp φ = RingHom.id _ := by
    refine Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext <|
      IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)) <|
      Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext <| Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) ?_ <;>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply] <;> rw [hφA]
    · have := hφ₀C a
      simp only [chartBase, RingHom.comp_apply] at this hψC
      rw [this]; exact hψC a
    · change ψ (φ₀ (chartSlope R t x)) = _
      rw [hφ₀Z]; simp [ψ, zQ, chartSlope]
  exact ⟨φ, ψ, hψφ, fun r ↦ (hφA _).trans (hφ₀C r), (hφA _).trans hφ₀Z⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.glued_level_one_normalization
statement:
theorem glued_level_one_normalization (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsLocalRing R] (_hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (gA : BlowupChart R t x) (gB : BlowupChart R x t)
    (hoverlap : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) gA)} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) (beta.right gB)})
    (hregB : Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) => Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) (beta.right gB) * c)) (m n : ℕ) (cA : Fin (m+1) → R)
    (cB : Fin (n+1) → R) (hgA : gA - ∑ i : Fin (m+1),
      algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) (cA i) * (chartSlope R t x)^i.val ∈ chartExceptional R t x)
    (hgB : gB - ∑ i : Fin (n+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) (cB i) * (chartSlope R x t)^i.val
      ∈ chartExceptional R x t) (r : ℕ) (hlow : ∀ i : Fin (m+1), i.val < r →
      cA i ∈ Ideal.span {t,x}) (hr : ∀ i : Fin (m+1), i.val = r → cA i ∉ Ideal.span {t,x})
    (hrm : r ≤ m) (htop : cB (Fin.last n) ∉ Ideal.span {t,x}) (hdeg : r + n = d) :
    ∃ u : Rˣ, (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) gA - algebraMap R
    (BlowupOverlap R t x) (u : R) * ((overlapSlope R t x)^d * beta.right gB) ∈
    (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)
  set E : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) := Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}
  have htI : t ∈ I := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hxI : x ∈ I := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  obtain ⟨φ, ψ, hψφ, hφC, hφZ⟩ := exists_overlap_exceptional_laurent R t x
  have hψ : ∀ y, ψ (φ y) = y := RingHom.congr_fun hψφ
  set PA : Polynomial (R ⧸ I) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (m+1), Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (cA i)) * Polynomial.X ^ i.val with hPA
  set PB : Polynomial (R ⧸ I) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (n+1), Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (cB i)) * Polynomial.X ^ i.val with hPB
  have hPAr : PA.coeff r ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPA, coeff_sum_fin_C_mul_X_pow, dif_pos (by omega), Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact hr ⟨r, by omega⟩ rfl
  have hPA0 : PA ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hPAr (by simp [h])
  have hPAtr : PA.natTrailingDegree = r :=
    le_antisymm (Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero hPAr) <|
      Polynomial.le_natTrailingDegree hPA0 fun j hj ↦ by
        rw [hPA, coeff_sum_fin_C_mul_X_pow, dif_pos (by omega)]
        exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hlow ⟨j, by omega⟩ hj)
  have hPBn : PB.coeff n ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPB, coeff_sum_fin_C_mul_X_pow, dif_pos (by omega), Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact htop
  have hPB0 : PB ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hPBn (by simp [h])
  have hPBdeg : PB.natDegree = n :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.2
      fun j hj ↦ by rw [hPB, coeff_sum_fin_C_mul_X_pow, dif_neg (by omega)]) hPBn
  
  let ΦA : BlowupChart R t x →+* LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ I) :=
    φ.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk E).comp (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))
  have hΦAexc : ∀ y ∈ chartExceptional R t x, ΦA y = 0 := fun y hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hy
    rw [map_mul, show ΦA (chartBase R t x t) = _ from hφC t,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr htI, map_zero, mul_zero]
  have hφa : φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk E (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) gA)) =
      PA.toLaurent := by
    change ΦA gA = _
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 ((map_sub ΦA _ _).symm.trans (hΦAexc _ hgA)), hPA, map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_X_pow, show ΦA (chartSlope R t x) = _ from hφZ,
      T_pow, mul_one]
    exact congrArg (· * _) (hφC _)
  let ΦB : BlowupChart R x t →+* LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ I) :=
    φ.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk E).comp beta.right.toRingHom)
  have hΦBC : ∀ c : R,
      ΦB (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) c) = C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I c) := by
    intro c
    simp only [ΦB, RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, AlgHom.commutes]
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)]
    exact hφC c
  have hΦBW : ΦB (chartSlope R x t) = T (-1) := by
    simp only [ΦB, RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, beta.slope]
    have h1 : φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk E (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))) *
        T 1 = 1 := by
      rw [← hφZ, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one,
        map_one]
    have h2 : T (-1) * T (R := R ⧸ I) 1 = 1 := by rw [← T_add]; simp
    exact (isUnit_T (R := R ⧸ I) 1).mul_left_injective (h1.trans h2.symm)
  have hΦBexc : ∀ y ∈ chartExceptional R x t, ΦB y = 0 := fun y hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hy
    rw [map_mul, show chartBase R x t x = algebraMap R _ x from rfl, hΦBC,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hxI, map_zero, mul_zero]
  have hφb : φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk E (beta.right gB)) = invert PB.toLaurent := by
    change ΦB gB = _
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 ((map_sub ΦB _ _).symm.trans (hΦBexc _ hgB)), hPB, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_X_pow, hΦBW, T_pow, hΦBC,
      map_mul, invert_C, invert_T]
    congr 2
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := regular_principal_generators_associated (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ E)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk E (beta.right gB))
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk E (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) gA))
    (fun y₁ y₂ h ↦ hregB (by simpa [mul_comm] using h)) hoverlap.symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc, m', hm'⟩ :=
    (letI := Ideal.Quotient.field I; laurent_isUnit_iff_monomial (R ⧸ I) (φ v)).mp (v.isUnit.map φ)
  have hmain : PA.toLaurent = C c * T m' *
      (T ((0:ℕ):ℤ) * invert (R := R ⧸ I) PB.toLaurent) := by
    rw [← hφa, hv, map_mul, hm', hφb]; simp
  have hdeg' := letI := Ideal.Quotient.field I
    laurent_monomial_shift_trailing_degree (R ⧸ I) PA PB hPA0 hPB0 c m' 0 hmain
  rw [hPAtr, hPBdeg] at hdeg'
  have hm'd : m' = (d : ℤ) := by push_cast at hdeg'; omega
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := units_lift_from_local_quotient R I
    (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top inferInstance))
    (letI := Ideal.Quotient.field I; isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hc).unit
  simp only [IsUnit.unit_spec] at hu
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq, hv, ← hψ v, hm', hm'd, ← hu, show T (d : ℤ) = T 1 ^ d by
    rw [T_pow, mul_one], ← hφC, ← hφZ, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, hψ]
  rw [show algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x) u =
    algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) _ (chartBase R t x u) from rfl]
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, overlapSlope]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.laurent_twist_kernel_coeff_toLaurent
statement:
private theorem laurent_twist_kernel_coeff_toLaurent {k : Type} [CommRing k] (f : Polynomial k)
    (z : ℤ) : f.toLaurent.coeff z = if 0 ≤ z then f.coeff z.toNat else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hz
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hz
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
    have := Finsupp.mapDomain_apply (Nat.castEmbedding (R := ℤ)).injective f.toFinsupp.coeff n
    simp only [Nat.castEmbedding_apply] at this
    simp only [Int.toNat_natCast]; exact this.trans rfl
  · rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
    apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
    rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    simp at hn
    omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.toLaurent_coeff_of_eq_T_mul_invert
statement:
private theorem toLaurent_coeff_of_eq_T_mul_invert {k : Type} [CommRing k] (m : ℕ)
    (P Q : Polynomial k)
    (h : P.toLaurent = LaurentPolynomial.T (m : ℤ) * LaurentPolynomial.invert (R := k) Q.toLaurent)
    (n : ℤ) : P.toLaurent.coeff n = Q.toLaurent.coeff (m - n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply,
    LaurentPolynomial.invert_apply, one_mul]
  congr 1; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.laurent_nonnegative_twist_kernel
statement:
theorem laurent_nonnegative_twist_kernel (k : Type) [CommRing k] (m : ℕ) (P Q : Polynomial k)
    (h : P.toLaurent =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (m : ℤ) * LaurentPolynomial.invert (R := k) Q.toLaurent) :
    P.natDegree ≤ m ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, Q.coeff i = if i ≤ m then P.coeff (m - i) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have key := toLaurent_coeff_of_eq_T_mul_invert m P Q h
  simp only [laurent_twist_kernel_coeff_toLaurent] at key
  refine ⟨?_, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
    intro n hn
    have := key n
    simp only [Nat.cast_nonneg, if_true, Int.toNat_natCast] at this
    rw [this, if_neg]
    have : (m : ℕ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    omega
  · split_ifs with hi
    · have := key ((m - i : ℕ) : ℤ)
      simp only [Nat.cast_nonneg, if_true, Int.toNat_natCast] at this
      rw [this, if_pos (by omega)]
      congr 1; omega
    · have := key ((m : ℤ) - i)
      rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)] at this
      rw [show ((m : ℤ) - ((m : ℤ) - i)).toNat = i by omega] at this
      exact this.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.laurent_split_nonnegative_twist
statement:
theorem laurent_split_nonnegative_twist (k : Type) [CommRing k] (m : ℤ) (hm : -1 ≤ m)
    (F : LaurentPolynomial k) :
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial k, F = P.toLaurent - LaurentPolynomial.T m *
    (LaurentPolynomial.invert (R := k) Q.toLaurent)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨P1, Q1, h1⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨P2, Q2, h2⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨P1 + P2, Q1 + Q2, ?_⟩
    rw [h1, h2]
    simp only [map_add]
    ring
  | C_mul_T n a =>
    rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn | hn
    · refine ⟨Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n.toNat, 0, ?_⟩
      simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, map_mul, Polynomial.toLaurent_C,
        Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow]
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn]
    · refine ⟨0, -(Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ (m - n).toNat), ?_⟩
      simp only [map_zero, map_neg, map_mul, Polynomial.toLaurent_C,
        Polynomial.toLaurent_X_pow, LaurentPolynomial.invert_C, LaurentPolynomial.invert_T,
        zero_sub, mul_neg, neg_neg]
      rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), mul_left_comm, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
      congr 2
      ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_eq_of_surjective_onto_field
statement:
private theorem length_eq_of_surjective_onto_field (R k M : Type) [CommRing R] [Field k]
    [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] [Module k M] (f : R →+* k) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hcompat : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), r • m = f r • m) [Module.Finite k M] :
    Module.length R M = (Module.finrank k M : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have : RingHomSurjective f := ⟨hf⟩
  let g : M →ₛₗ[f] M := ⟨AddHom.id M, fun r m ↦ hcompat r m⟩
  rw [← Module.length_eq_finrank k M]
  rw [Module.length, Module.length, WithBot.unbot_inj,
    Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (Submodule.orderIsoMapComapOfBijective g Function.bijective_id)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial
statement:
theorem blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
      (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R))) (he : ∀ r : R,
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsMaximal] (hP : chartBase R t x t ∈ P) :
    ∃ φ : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)), φ.Monic ∧ Irreducible φ ∧
    (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ} ∧
    (chartSlope R t x ∈ P ↔ φ = Polynomial.X) ∧ Module.length R (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ P) =
    (φ.natDegree : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  let : Field (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  have hIP : chartExceptional R t x ≤ P := by
    rw [show chartExceptional R t x = Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t} from rfl, Ideal.span_le]
    simpa using hP
  set Pb := P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) with hPb
  have hmk : Function.Surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hcomap : Pb.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) = P := by
    rw [hPb, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hmk]
    exact le_antisymm
      (sup_le le_rfl fun a ha ↦ hIP (by simpa [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using ha))
      le_sup_left
  have hPbmax : Pb.IsMaximal :=
    (Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hmk ‹P.IsMaximal›).resolve_left fun h ↦
      Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top ‹_› (by rw [← hcomap, hPb, h, Ideal.comap_top])
  set Q := Pb.map e with hQ
  have hQmax : Q.IsMaximal := (Ideal.isMaximal_map_iff_of_bijective _ e.bijective).2 hPbmax
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ'⟩ := IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal Q
  rw [Ideal.submodule_span_eq] at hψ'
  have hψ0 : ψ ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [hψ', Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.2 rfl] at hQmax
    exact Polynomial.not_isField _ (Ring.isField_iff_maximal_bot.2 hQmax)
  have hψprime : Prime ψ := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hψ0).1 (hψ' ▸ hQmax.isPrime)
  have hu : IsUnit (Polynomial.C ψ.leadingCoeff⁻¹) :=
    Polynomial.isUnit_C.2 (inv_ne_zero (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hψ0)).isUnit
  set φ := ψ * Polynomial.C ψ.leadingCoeff⁻¹ with hφ
  have hmon : φ.Monic := Polynomial.monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv hψ0
  have hirr : Irreducible φ := (associated_mul_unit_right ψ _ hu).irreducible hψprime.irreducible
  have hQφ : Ideal.span {φ} = Q := by rw [hφ, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hu, ← hψ']
  refine ⟨φ, hmon, hirr, hQφ.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hcomap, Ideal.mem_comap, ← Ideal.apply_mem_of_equiv_iff (f := e), heZ, ← hQ, ← hQφ,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated hmon Polynomial.monic_X
      (associated_of_dvd_dvd h (hirr.dvd_symm Polynomial.irreducible_X h)), fun h ↦ h ▸ dvd_rfl⟩
  · let Ψ : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ P) ≃+*
        (Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) ⧸ Ideal.span {φ}) :=
      (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE hIP).symm.trans (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ e hQφ)
    have hΨ : ∀ r : R, Ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk P (chartBase R t x r)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {φ})
          (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r)) := by
      intro r
      simp only [Ψ, RingEquiv.trans_apply, DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE_symm_mk]
      exact congrArg _ (he r)
    let L := (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := R) (f := Ψ) (fun r ↦ hΨ r)).toLinearEquiv
    rw [L.length_eq]
    have : Module.Finite (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R))
        (Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) ⧸ Ideal.span {φ}) :=
      Module.finite_of_finrank_pos
        (by rw [finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree]; exact hirr.natDegree_pos)
    rw [length_eq_of_surjective_onto_field R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) _
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ?_, finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree]
    intro r m
    exact (algebraMap_smul (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r m).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_point_eq_directionPoint
statement:
theorem chart_point_eq_directionPoint (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsMaximal] (hP : chartBase R t x t ∈ P) :
    ∃ φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R), P = directionPoint R t x e φ ∧
    (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ.val} ∧
    (chartSlope R t x ∈ P ↔ φ = zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal ‹_›
  let κ : (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField R :=
    Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hm
  have hκ : ∀ r : R, κ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r) = IsLocalRing.residue R r := fun r ↦ rfl
  let M := Polynomial.mapEquiv κ
  let e₀ := e.trans M.symm
  have he₀ : ∀ r : R, e₀ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r) := by
    intro r
    apply M.injective
    simp only [e₀, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, he]
    simp [M, Polynomial.mapEquiv_apply, hκ]
  have heZ₀ :
      e₀ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X := by
    apply M.injective
    simp only [e₀, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, heZ]
    simp [M, Polynomial.mapEquiv_apply]
  obtain ⟨φ₀, hmon, hirr, himg, hZ, -⟩ :=
    blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial R t x e₀ he₀ heZ₀ P hP
  have hirr' : Irreducible (Polynomial.map κ.toRingHom φ₀) :=
    (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff M.toMulEquiv).2 hirr
  let φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) :=
    ⟨Polynomial.map κ.toRingHom φ₀, hmon.map _, hirr'⟩
  have himg' : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ.val} := by
    have he : e.toRingHom = M.toRingHom.comp e₀.toRingHom := by
      exact RingHom.ext fun a ↦ by simp [e₀]
    change Ideal.map e.toRingHom _ = _
    rw [he, ← Ideal.map_map]
    change Ideal.map M (Ideal.map e₀ _) = _
    rw [himg, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, himg', ?_⟩
  · let ψ := e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))
    have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ :=
      e.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have hmap : P.map ψ = Ideal.span {φ.val} := by
      rw [← himg']
      change _ = Ideal.map e.toRingHom _
      rw [Ideal.map_map]
    change P = (Ideal.span {φ.val}).comap ψ
    rw [← hmap, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hψ]
    have hker : Ideal.comap ψ ⊥ = chartExceptional R t x := by
      rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
      ext a
      simp [ψ, RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    rw [hker, eq_comm, sup_eq_left]
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 hP
  · rw [hZ]
    refine ⟨by rintro rfl; apply Subtype.ext; simp [φ, zeroAffine], fun h ↦ M.injective ?_⟩
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp only [φ, zeroAffine] at this
    simpa [M] using this

name: SurfaceBlowup.direction_point_maximal
statement:
theorem direction_point_maximal (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] (S : SurfaceData O R)
    (e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+* Polynomial
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) (he : ∀ r : R,
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) :
    (directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ).IsMaximal ∧
    chartBase R S.t S.x S.t ∈ directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ ∧
    (chartSlope R S.t S.x ∈ directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ ↔ φ =
      zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) ∧
    ((directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x))).map e =
    Ideal.span {φ.val} ∧ Module.length R (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ) =
    (φ.val.natDegree : ℕ∞) ∧ Function.Injective (directionPoint R S.t S.x e)
proof:
:= by
  set k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  set A := BlowupChart R S.t S.x
  set ψ : A →+* Polynomial k :=
    e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x))
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ :=
    e.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hP : ∀ φ' : AffineDirection k,
      directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ' = (Ideal.span {φ'.val}).comap ψ := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hmap : ∀ φ' : AffineDirection k,
      ((directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ').map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x))).map e
        = Ideal.span {φ'.val} := by
    intro φ'
    change Ideal.map e.toRingHom (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) _) = _
    rw [Ideal.map_map, hP]
    exact Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective ψ hψ _
  have hmon : ∀ φ₁ φ₂ : AffineDirection k, Ideal.span {φ₁.val} = Ideal.span {φ₂.val} → φ₁ = φ₂ := by
    intro φ₁ φ₂ h
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton] at h
    exact Subtype.ext (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated φ₁.2.1 φ₂.2.1 h)
  have hbase : ∀ r : R, ψ (chartBase R S.t S.x r) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r) := he
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hmap φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hP]
    have := PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible φ.2.2
    exact Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective ψ hψ
  · rw [hP, Ideal.mem_comap, hbase]
    have ht : S.t ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [← S.parameters]; exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    rw [(IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 ht, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  · rw [hP, Ideal.mem_comap]
    change e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) ∈ _ ↔ _
    rw [heZ, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact Subtype.ext (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated φ.2.1 Polynomial.monic_X
        (φ.2.2.associated_of_dvd Polynomial.irreducible_X h))
    · rintro rfl; exact dvd_refl _
  · let E : (A ⧸ directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ) ≃+* Polynomial k ⧸ Ideal.span {φ.val} :=
      (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (by rw [← RingHom.comap_ker, Ideal.mk_ker, hP])).trans
        (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (f := (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {φ.val})).comp ψ)
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp hψ))
    let L := (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := R) (f := E)
      fun r ↦ congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (hbase r)).toLinearEquiv
    rw [L.length_eq]
    have : Module.Finite k (Polynomial k ⧸ Ideal.span {φ.val}) := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos
      (by rw [finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree]; exact φ.2.2.natDegree_pos)
    rw [length_eq_of_surjective_onto_field R k _ (IsLocalRing.residue R)
      IsLocalRing.residue_surjective ?_, finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree]
    intro r m
    exact (algebraMap_smul k r m).symm
  · intro φ₁ φ₂ h
    apply hmon
    rw [← hmap φ₁, ← hmap φ₂, h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.direction_point_overlap_maximal
statement:
theorem direction_point_overlap_maximal (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+* Polynomial
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) (he : ∀ r : R,
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (hφ : φ ≠ zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) :
    ((directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)
      (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x))).IsMaximal ∧
    (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x) (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x)) (chartBase R S.t S.x S.t) ∈
    (directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)
      (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x)) ∧ ((directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ).map
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x) (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x))).comap
    (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x) (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x)) =
      directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmax, ht, hZ, -⟩ := direction_point_maximal O R S e he heZ φ
  set P := directionPoint R S.t S.x e φ
  have hZP : chartSlope R S.t S.x ∉ P := fun h ↦ hφ (hZ.mp h)
  have hd : Disjoint ((Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R S.t S.x) : Submonoid _) :
      Set (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)) (P : Set _) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩ hn
    exact hZP (hmax.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem n hn)
  have hcomap : (P.map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x) (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x))).comap
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x) (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x)) = P :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) _
      hmax.isPrime hd
  have hprime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R S.t S.x))
    (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x) P hmax.isPrime hd
  refine ⟨?_, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ht, hcomap⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hprime.ne_top
  have hcM : M.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x) (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x)) = P := by
    refine (hmax.eq_of_le (Ideal.comap_ne_top _ hM.ne_top) ?_).symm
    rw [← hcomap]; exact Ideal.comap_mono hle
  have : M = P.map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R S.t S.x) (BlowupOverlap R S.t S.x)) := by
    rw [← hcM]; exact (IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) _ M).symm
  rw [← this]; exact hM

name: SurfaceBlowup.infinity_point_maximal
statement:
theorem infinity_point_maximal (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] (S : SurfaceData O R) :
    (infinityPoint R S.t S.x).IsMaximal ∧ chartBase R S.x S.t S.x ∈ infinityPoint R S.t S.x ∧
    chartSlope R S.x S.t ∈ infinityPoint R S.t S.x ∧ Module.length R
    (BlowupChart R S.x S.t ⧸ infinityPoint R S.t S.x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hker : ∃ φ : BlowupChart R S.x S.t →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField R,
      (∀ r, φ (chartBase R S.x S.t r) = IsLocalRing.residue R r) ∧
      φ (chartSlope R S.x S.t) = 0 ∧ RingHom.ker φ = infinityPoint R S.t S.x := by
    have hx : IsLocalRing.residue R S.x = 0 := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, ← S.parameters]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    have ht : IsLocalRing.residue R S.t = 0 := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, ← S.parameters]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    let ψ : Polynomial R →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField R :=
      Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (IsLocalRing.residue R) 0
    have hψ : Ideal.span {blowupRelation R S.x S.t} ≤ RingHom.ker ψ := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      simp [ψ, blowupRelation, ht]
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.lift _ ψ fun a ha ↦ hψ ha, fun r ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change ψ (Polynomial.C r) = _
      simp [ψ]
    · change ψ Polynomial.X = _
      simp [ψ]
    · ext b
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
      have hrel := blowup_chart_relation R S.x S.t
      have hI_x : chartBase R S.x S.t S.x ∈ infinityPoint R S.t S.x := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
      have hI_W : chartSlope R S.x S.t ∈ infinityPoint R S.t S.x := Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
      have hI_t : chartBase R S.x S.t S.t ∈ infinityPoint R S.t S.x := by
        rw [← hrel]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hI_x
      have hp := Polynomial.divX_mul_X_add p
      have hmk : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {blowupRelation R S.x S.t}) p =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {blowupRelation R S.x S.t}) (p.divX) * chartSlope R S.x S.t
          + chartBase R S.x S.t (p.coeff 0) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← hp]
        simp [chartSlope, chartBase]
      have hψp : ψ p = IsLocalRing.residue R (p.coeff 0) := by
        simp [ψ, Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero]
      simp only [RingHom.mem_ker]
      change ψ p = 0 ↔ _
      refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
      · rw [hψp, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, ← S.parameters] at h
        rw [hmk]
        refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hI_W) ?_
        have : Ideal.map (chartBase R S.x S.t) (Ideal.span {S.t, S.x}) ≤
            infinityPoint R S.t S.x := by
          rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
          rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          rcases hy with rfl | rfl
          · exact hI_t
          · exact hI_x
        exact this (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ h)
      · have hle : infinityPoint R S.t S.x ≤
            RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.lift _ ψ fun a ha ↦ hψ ha) := by
          rw [infinityPoint, Ideal.span_le]
          rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
          · change ψ (Polynomial.C S.x) = 0
            simpa [ψ] using hx
          · change ψ Polynomial.X = 0
            simp [ψ]
        exact hle h
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ1, hφ2, hφk⟩ := hker
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φ := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
    exact ⟨chartBase R S.x S.t r, hφ1 r⟩
  have hmax : (infinityPoint R S.t S.x).IsMaximal := by
    rw [← hφk]; exact RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective φ hsurj
  refine ⟨hmax, Ideal.subset_span (by simp), Ideal.subset_span (by simp), ?_⟩
  let e0 : (BlowupChart R S.x S.t ⧸ infinityPoint R S.t S.x) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField R :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hφk.symm).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj)
  rw [(AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := R) (f := e0) fun r ↦ hφ1 r).toLinearEquiv.length_eq,
    length_eq_of_surjective_onto_field R _ _ (IsLocalRing.residue R)
      IsLocalRing.residue_surjective fun r m ↦ rfl]
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.principal_layer_map_kernel
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : IsLeftRegular (e ^ j) := IsLeftRegular.pow j he
  ext a
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, principalLayerMap, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,
    Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    exact ⟨b, hinj (show e ^ j * a = e ^ j * (e * b) by linear_combination hb)⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b, by ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.principal_layer_map_range
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    simp only [principalLayerMap, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, principalPowerReduction,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_smul, Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ_apply, Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk]
    rw [(Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem).2 (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self e) j),
      smul_zero]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx
    simp only [principalPowerReduction, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ_apply,
      Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk] at hx
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    simp only [principalLayerMap, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← map_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.principal_layer_quotient_equiv
statement:
theorem principal_layer_quotient_equiv (A : Type) [CommRing A] (e : A) (j : ℕ)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun a : A ↦ e*a)) :
    ∃ L : (A ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) ≃ₗ[A] PrincipalLayer A e j, ∀ a : A,
    (L (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) a)).val = principalLayerMap A e j a
proof:
:= by
  have hk := principal_layer_map_kernel A e j he
  have hr := principal_layer_map_range A e j
  refine ⟨((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hk.symm).trans
    (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange (principalLayerMap A e j))).trans (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hr), ?_⟩
  intro a
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_layer_polynomial_coordinates
statement:
theorem chart_layer_polynomial_coordinates (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer (BlowupChart R t x)
    (chartBase R t x t) j, ∀ r : R, ∀ i : ℕ,
    (L (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) * Polynomial.X^i)).val =
    principalLayerMap (BlowupChart R t x) (chartBase R t x t) j
    (chartBase R t x r * (chartSlope R t x)^i)
proof:
:= by
  have he := blowup_exceptional_parameter_regular R t x hreg
  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ := principal_layer_quotient_equiv (BlowupChart R t x)
    (chartBase R t x t) j he
  obtain ⟨e1, he1b, he1s⟩ := exceptional_chart_is_affine_line R t x
  have hI : exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x 1 = Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t} := by
    simp [exceptionalLevelIdeal]
  let φ : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t}) ≃+*
      Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hI.symm).trans e1
  have hφ : ∀ a : BlowupChart R t x,
      φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = e1 (Ideal.Quotient.mk (exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x 1) a) := by
    intro a; rfl
  have hφb : ∀ r : R, φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) := by
    intro r; rw [hφ]; exact he1b r
  have hφs : φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X := by
    rw [hφ]; exact he1s
  let φl := (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := R) (f := φ) fun r ↦ hφb r).toLinearEquiv
  refine ⟨φl.symm.trans (L1.restrictScalars R), ?_⟩
  intro r i
  have key : φl.symm (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) * Polynomial.X^i)
      = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartBase R t x r * (chartSlope R t x)^i) := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    change _ = φ _
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_mul, map_pow, hφb, hφs]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, key, LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply]
  exact hL1 _

name: SurfaceBlowup.rootMultiplicity_map_eq_count_normalizedFactors
statement:
theorem rootMultiplicity_map_eq_count_normalizedFactors (k k' : Type) [Field k] [Finite k]
    [Field k'] (ι : k →+* k') (G : Polynomial k) (hG : G ≠ 0) (φ : Polynomial k)
    (hφ : φ.Monic ∧ Irreducible φ) (alphaBar : k') (hroot : (φ.map ι).eval alphaBar = 0) :
    Polynomial.rootMultiplicity alphaBar (G.map ι) = Multiset.count φ
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors G)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ ψ : k[X], ψ.Monic → Irreducible ψ →
      rootMultiplicity alphaBar (ψ.map ι) = Multiset.count φ {ψ} := by
    intro ψ hm hi
    rw [Multiset.count_singleton]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      have := PerfectField.ofFinite (K := k)
      have hsep : (φ.map ι).Separable := (PerfectField.separable_of_irreducible hi).map
      have hne : φ.map ι ≠ 0 := Polynomial.map_ne_zero hi.ne_zero
      have h1 := rootMultiplicity_le_one_of_separable hsep alphaBar
      have h2 : 0 < rootMultiplicity alphaBar (φ.map ι) :=
        (rootMultiplicity_pos hne).2 hroot
      omega
    · rw [rootMultiplicity_eq_zero_iff]
      intro hr
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := (EuclideanDomain.dvd_or_coprime φ ψ hφ.2).resolve_left (by
        intro hd
        exact h (eq_of_monic_of_associated hφ.1 hm (hφ.2.associated_of_dvd hi hd)))
        |>.map (mapRingHom ι)
      have := congrArg (eval alphaBar) hab
      simp only [coe_mapRingHom, eval_add, eval_mul, hroot, hr.eq_zero, mul_zero, add_zero,
        eval_one] at this
      exact zero_ne_one this
  induction G using UniqueFactorizationMonoid.induction_on_prime with
  | h₁ => exact absurd rfl hG
  | h₂ x hx =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Polynomial.isUnit_iff.1 hx
    rw [normalizedFactors_of_isUnit hx, Polynomial.map_C, rootMultiplicity_C]
    rfl
  | h₃ a p ha hp ih =>
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hG
    have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne_zero
    rw [normalizedFactors_mul hp0 ha0, Multiset.count_add, Polynomial.map_mul,
      rootMultiplicity_mul (by simpa using hG), ih ha0,
      normalizedFactors_irreducible hp.irreducible]
    congr 1
    rw [← key _ (Polynomial.monic_normalize hp0)
      ((normalize_associated p).symm.irreducible hp.irreducible), normalize_apply,
      Polynomial.map_mul,
      rootMultiplicity_mul (by simpa [Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff ι.injective] using hp0),
      coe_normUnit, Polynomial.map_C, rootMultiplicity_C, add_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_coeffs_of_map_span_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_coeffs_of_map_span_eq {R A : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    {I : Ideal R} [I.IsMaximal] {J : Ideal A} {w : A} (e : (A ⧸ J) ≃+* Polynomial (R ⧸ I))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (algebraMap R A r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r))
    (hw : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk J w) = Polynomial.X) (F : A) (P : Polynomial (R ⧸ I))
    (hker : (Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk J F}).map e = Ideal.span {P}) :
    ∃ c : Fin (P.natDegree + 1) → R,
      F - ∑ i : Fin (P.natDegree + 1), algebraMap R A (c i) * w ^ i.val ∈ J ∧
      ∃ u : R ⧸ I, u ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk I (c i) = P.coeff i * u
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Field (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton] at hker
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hker
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcv⟩ := Polynomial.isUnit_iff.mp v.isUnit
  choose a ha using fun i : Fin (P.natDegree + 1) =>
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := I) (P.coeff i.val * c⁻¹)
  refine ⟨a, ?_, c⁻¹, inv_ne_zero hc.ne_zero, ha⟩
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  apply e.injective
  have heF : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk J F) = P * Polynomial.C c⁻¹ := by
    rw [← hv, ← hcv, mul_assoc, ← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne_zero, Polynomial.C_1,
      mul_one]
  simp only [heF, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, hw, he, ha]
  conv_lhs => rw [P.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun i => Polynomial.C (P.coeff i) * Polynomial.C c⁻¹ * Polynomial.X ^ i)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_level_one_coefficients_left
statement:
private theorem two_chart_level_one_coefficients_left (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    (FA : BlowupChart R t x) (hFA : leftLevelKernel D 1 =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^1) FA}) :
    ∃ (m r : ℕ) (cA : Fin (m+1) → R), FA - ∑ i : Fin (m+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) (cA i)
        * (chartSlope R t x)^i.val ∈ chartExceptional R t x ∧
        (∀ i : Fin (m+1), i.val < r → cA i ∈ Ideal.span {t,x}) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin (m+1), i.val = r → cA i ∉ Ideal.span {t,x}) ∧ r ≤ m ∧ r = ∑ᶠ k : D.ι0,
        leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inr k) ∧ m = ∑ᶠ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftResidueDegree D s *
        leftMultiplicity D s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Field (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  have : Fintype D.ι := @Fintype.ofFinite _ D.fin
  have : Fintype D.ι0 := @Fintype.ofFinite _ D.fin0
  obtain ⟨e, he, heZ⟩ := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional R t x
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, -, hne, hX, hdeg, -, hker⟩ :=
    two_chart_left_level_one_kernel_polynomial R t x beta D e he heZ
  have gen : ∀ J : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x), J = chartExceptional R t x →
      (leftKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk J FA} →
      (leftKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) =
        Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) FA} := by
    rintro J rfl h; exact h
  set Pol := ∏ᶠ s, φ s ^ leftMultiplicity D s with hPol
  set r := ∑ᶠ k : D.ι0, leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inr k) with hr
  set Q := ∏ i : D.ι, φ (Sum.inl i) ^ leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inl i) with hQ
  rw [gen _ (pow_one _) hFA] at hker
  obtain ⟨cA, hgA, u, hu, hcA⟩ := exists_coeffs_of_map_span_eq e he heZ FA _ hker
  have hPolXQ : Pol = Polynomial.X ^ r * Q := by
    rw [hPol, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype, Fintype.prod_sum_type, hr, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype,
      mul_comm]
    congr 1
    simp only [hX]
    exact Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum _ _ _
  have hQ0 : Q.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hQ, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    refine Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Polynomial.eval_pow]
    refine pow_ne_zero _ fun h0 => ?_
    rw [← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, ← Polynomial.X_dvd_iff] at h0
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h0
    obtain ⟨hmon, hirr⟩ := hφ (Sum.inl i)
    rcases hirr.isUnit_or_isUnit hg with h | h
    · exact Polynomial.not_isUnit_X h
    · rw [(Polynomial.monic_X.of_mul_monic_left (hg ▸ hmon)).isUnit_iff] at h
      exact hne i (by rw [hg, h, mul_one])
  have hrP : Pol.coeff r ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPolXQ, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul']; simpa using hQ0
  refine ⟨Pol.natDegree, r, cA, hgA, fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => ?_,
    Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero hrP, hr, ?_⟩
  · have hlow : ∀ j, j < r → Pol.coeff j = 0 := fun j hj => by
      rw [hPolXQ, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow_mul']; simp [Nat.not_le.mpr hj]
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, hcA, hlow _ hi, zero_mul]
  · rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, hcA, hi]
    exact mul_ne_zero hrP hu
  · rw [hPol, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype,
      Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ fun s _ => (hφ s).1.pow _]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
    rw [(hφ s).1.natDegree_pow, hdeg, mul_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_right_level_one_kernel_polynomial
statement:
private theorem two_chart_right_level_one_kernel_polynomial (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)]
    (eB : (BlowupChart R x t ⧸ chartExceptional R x t) ≃+*
    Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (heB : ∀ r : R, eB (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R x t) (chartBase R x t r)) =
    Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r))
    (heW : eB (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R x t) (chartSlope R x t)) = Polynomial.X) :
    ∃ ψ : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf → Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)),
        (∀ s, (ψ s).Monic ∧ Irreducible (ψ s)) ∧ Function.Injective ψ ∧
        (∀ i, ψ (Sum.inl i) ≠ Polynomial.X) ∧ (∀ l, ψ (Sum.inr l) = Polynomial.X) ∧
        (∀ s, (ψ s).natDegree = rightResidueDegree D s) ∧ (∀ l, rightResidueDegree D (Sum.inr l) =
        1) ∧ ((rightKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R x t))).map eB =
        Ideal.span {∏ᶠ s, ψ s ^ rightMultiplicity D s}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmax, hinjP, htP⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D
  obtain ⟨ψ, m, hψ, hinj, hslope, hlen, hm, hker⟩ := level_one_kernel_polynomial R x t _
    Ideal.span_pair_comm eB heB heW (rightPoint D) hinjP htP (rightData D)
    (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 1).2
  have hmult : rightMultiplicity D = m := funext fun s => by
    unfold rightMultiplicity rightLevelIdeal; rw [hm s]; rfl
  have hdeg : ∀ s, (ψ s).natDegree = rightResidueDegree D s := by
    intro s; unfold rightResidueDegree; rw [hlen s]; rfl
  have hX : ∀ l, ψ (Sum.inr l) = Polynomial.X := fun l => (hslope (Sum.inr l)).1 (D.slopeinf l)
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ, hinj, fun i hi => ?_, hX, hdeg, fun l => ?_, by rw [hmult]; exact hker⟩
  · have hQ := D.onE i
    have := D.maximal i
    exact (overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal_right R t x beta (D.Q i) hQ).2.1
      ((hslope (Sum.inl i)).2 hi)
  · rw [← hdeg, hX]; exact Polynomial.natDegree_X

name: SurfaceBlowup.exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional_swap
statement:
private theorem exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional_swap (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ e : (BlowupChart R x t ⧸ chartExceptional R x t) ≃+*
      Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)),
      (∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R x t) (chartBase R x t r)) =
        Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r)) ∧
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R x t) (chartSlope R x t)) = Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  have h := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional R x t
  rwa [Set.pair_comm x t] at h

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_level_one_coefficients_right
statement:
private theorem two_chart_level_one_coefficients_right (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)]
    (FB : BlowupChart R x t) (hFB : rightLevelKernel D 1 =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x})^1) FB}) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (cB : Fin (n+1) → R), FB - ∑ i : Fin (n+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) (cB i) *
        (chartSlope R x t)^i.val ∈ chartExceptional R x t ∧ cB (Fin.last n) ∉ Ideal.span {t,x} ∧ n =
        ∑ᶠ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, rightResidueDegree D s * rightMultiplicity D s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Field (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  have : Fintype D.ι := @Fintype.ofFinite _ D.fin
  have : Fintype D.ιinf := @Fintype.ofFinite _ D.fininf
  obtain ⟨e, he', heW⟩ := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional_swap R t x
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, -, -, -, hdeg, -, hker⟩ :=
    two_chart_right_level_one_kernel_polynomial R t x beta D e he' heW
  have gen : ∀ J : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t), J = chartExceptional R x t →
      (rightKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk J FB} →
      (rightKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R x t)) =
        Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R x t) FB} := by
    rintro J rfl h; exact h
  set Pol := ∏ᶠ s, φ s ^ rightMultiplicity D s with hPol
  rw [gen _ (pow_one _) hFB] at hker
  obtain ⟨cB, hgB, u, hu, hcB⟩ := exists_coeffs_of_map_span_eq e he' heW FB _ hker
  have hPm : Pol.Monic := by
    rw [hPol, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype]
    exact Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun s _ => (hφ s).1.pow _
  refine ⟨Pol.natDegree, cB, hgB, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, hcB, Fin.val_last, show Pol.coeff _ = 1 from hPm, one_mul]
    exact hu
  · rw [hPol, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype,
      Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ fun s _ => (hφ s).1.pow _]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
    rw [(hφ s).1.natDegree_pow, hdeg, mul_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_level_one_normalization
statement:
private theorem two_chart_level_one_normalization (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) (FA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x)
    (hFA : ∀ j : ℕ, leftLevelKernel D j =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^j) (FA j)})
    (FB : ℕ → BlowupChart R x t) (hFB : ∀ j : ℕ, rightLevelKernel D j =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x})^j) (FB j)}) :
    ∃ u : Rˣ, (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (FA 1) - algebraMap
        R (BlowupOverlap R t x) (u : R) * ((overlapSlope R t x)^(curveDataDegree D) *
        beta.right (FB 1)) ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^1 = Ideal.span {overlapException R t x} :=
    pow_one _
  have hoverlap :
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})
        ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (FA 1))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) (beta.right (FB 1))} := by
    have := congrArg (Ideal.map (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hpow).toRingHom)
      (two_chart_level_generators_agree_on_overlap R t x beta D FA hFA FB hFB 1)
    rwa [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Set.image_singleton] at this
  obtain ⟨hmaxR, -, hPe⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D
  have : ∀ s, (rightPoint D s).IsMaximal := hmaxR
  choose L hL using (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 1).2
  have hreg1 := overlap_level_generator_regular R t x hreg hregSwap beta (D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf)
    (rightPoint D) hPe (rightData D) L hL FB hFB 1
  have hregB : Function.Injective
      (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) (beta.right (FB 1)) * c) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hpow).symm.injective
    apply hreg1
    have key : ∀ y : BlowupOverlap R t x,
        Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^1) y =
          (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hpow).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ y) := fun _ ↦ rfl
    simp only [key, ← map_mul]
    exact congrArg _ hab
  obtain ⟨m, r, cA, hgA, hlow, hr, hrm, hrdef, hmdef⟩ :=
    two_chart_level_one_coefficients_left R t x beta D (FA 1) (hFA 1)
  obtain ⟨n, cB, hgB, htop, hndef⟩ :=
    two_chart_level_one_coefficients_right R t x beta D (FB 1) (hFB 1)
  have hdeg : r + n = curveDataDegree D := by
    obtain ⟨e, he, heZ⟩ := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional R t x
    obtain ⟨eB, heB, heW⟩ := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional_swap R t x
    obtain ⟨_, -, -, -, -, -, h0, -⟩ :=
      two_chart_left_level_one_kernel_polynomial R t x beta D e he heZ
    obtain ⟨_, -, -, -, -, -, hinf, -⟩ :=
      two_chart_right_level_one_kernel_polynomial R t x beta D eB heB heW
    have hδ : ∀ i, leftResidueDegree D (Sum.inl i) = rightResidueDegree D (Sum.inl i) := fun i ↦
      congrArg ENat.toNat (overlap_point_residue_field_equiv R t x beta (D.Q i) (D.onE i)).2.2
    have hμ : ∀ i, leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inl i) = rightMultiplicity D (Sum.inl i) := fun i ↦
      (two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq R t x beta D i).1.trans
        (two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq R t x beta D i).2.symm
    have := Fintype.ofFinite D.ι
    have := Fintype.ofFinite D.ι0
    have := Fintype.ofFinite D.ιinf
    unfold curveDataDegree
    rw [hrdef, hndef]
    simp only [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, Fintype.sum_sum_type, h0, hinf, hδ, hμ, one_mul]
    ring
  exact glued_level_one_normalization R t x hreg beta _ (FA 1) (FB 1) hoverlap hregB m n cA cB hgA
      hgB r hlow hr hrm htop hdeg

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_global_function_exists
statement:
theorem two_chart_global_function_exists (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta : BlowupRestriction
    R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)]
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {t,x}) R] (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) :
    ∃ f : R, ∃ G : GluedGenerators R t x beta (curveDataDegree D),
        (∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f = (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R
        t x G j)) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)}
        = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
        Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D
        j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨FA, hFA⟩, ⟨FB, hFB⟩⟩ := two_chart_level_generators_exist R t x beta D
  exact global_function_of_two_chart_curve_data R t x beta D hreg hregSwap
    (curveDataDegree D) FA hFA FB hFB
    (two_chart_level_one_normalization R t x beta D hreg hregSwap FA hFA FB hFB)

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_two_chart_glued_generators_exist
statement:
theorem concrete_two_chart_glued_generators_exist (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        beta) :
    ∃ f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, ∃ G : GluedGenerators (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta (curveDataDegree D),
      (∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
          (surfaceX O pi u a b) j f =
        (cechInputLattice (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
            j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
                (surfaceX O pi u a b) G j)) ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
        Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (xExc O pi u a b^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j
proof:
:= by
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have := concrete_surface_isLocalRing O pi u a b hpi.not_isUnit ha
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b)
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)
  have : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isAdicComplete_parameterIdeal O pi u a b
  exact two_chart_global_function_exists _ _ _ beta D
    (concrete_surface_regular_pair_tx O pi hpi.ne_zero u a b ha)
    (concrete_surface_regular_pair_xt O pi hpi.ne_zero u a b ha)

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_injOn_fixed_tangent_cell
statement:
theorem strict_transform_injOn_fixed_tangent_cell (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
        [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] (S : SurfaceData O
            (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hS : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b ∧ S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b ∧ S.a = a ∧ S.b = b)
    (e : (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)
        (tBase O pi u a b r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
