statement:
private theorem two_chart_layer_correction_zpow (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (beta : BlowupChart R x t →+* BlowupOverlap R t x)
    (hbase : ∀ r : R, beta (chartBase R x t r) =
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x r))
    (hslope : beta (chartSlope R x t) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))
    (j : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (hk : -1 ≤ (j : ℤ) + k) (w : BlowupOverlap R t x)
    (hw : w ∈ (Ideal.span {algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
      (chartBase R t x t)})^j) :
    ∃ a ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^j, ∃ b ∈ (chartExceptional R x t)^j,
      w - (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a -
        selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) k * beta b) ∈
      (Ideal.span {algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        (chartBase R t x t)})^(j+1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := overlap_layer_laurent_coordinates R t x hreg j
  have hP : ∀ P : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t, x}), ∃ a ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^j,
      (L P.toLaurent).val = Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x)
          (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t)})^(j+1))
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a) := by
    intro P
    induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨a1, ha1, h1⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨a2, ha2, h2⟩ := hq
      refine ⟨a1 + a2, add_mem ha1 ha2, ?_⟩
      rw [map_add, map_add, Submodule.coe_add, h1, h2, map_add, map_add]
    | monomial n c =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
      refine ⟨chartBase R t x r * chartSlope R t x ^ n * chartBase R t x t ^ j,
        Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) j), ?_⟩
      rw [Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_T, hL, principalLayerMap_apply']
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, selfZPow_natCast]
  have hQ : ∀ Q : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t, x}), ∃ b ∈ (chartExceptional R x t)^j,
      (L (LaurentPolynomial.T ((j : ℤ) + k) * LaurentPolynomial.invert Q.toLaurent)).val
        = Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x)
          (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t)})^(j+1))
          (selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) k * beta b) := by
    intro Q
    induction Q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨a1, ha1, h1⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨a2, ha2, h2⟩ := hq
      refine ⟨a1 + a2, add_mem ha1 ha2, ?_⟩
      rw [map_add, map_add, mul_add, map_add, Submodule.coe_add, h1, h2, map_add, mul_add, map_add]
    | monomial n c =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
      refine ⟨chartBase R x t r * chartBase R x t x ^ j * chartSlope R x t ^ n,
        Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _
          (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) j)), ?_⟩
      have hT : LaurentPolynomial.T ((j : ℤ) + k) * LaurentPolynomial.invert
          (Polynomial.toLaurent (Polynomial.monomial n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t, x}) r)))
          = LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t, x}) r)
            * LaurentPolynomial.T ((j : ℤ) + k + -(n : ℤ)) := by
        rw [Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_T, map_mul, LaurentPolynomial.invert_C,
          LaurentPolynomial.invert_T, mul_left_comm, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
      rw [hT, hL, principalLayerMap_apply']
      congr 1
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hbase, hbase, hslope,
        ← blowup_chart_relation R t x, map_mul, selfZPow_add, selfZPow_add, selfZPow_natCast,
        invSelf_pow_eq_selfZPow]
      ring
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hF⟩ := laurent_split_nonnegative_twist (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t, x}) ((j : ℤ) + k) hk
    (L.symm ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x)
          (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t)})^(j+1)) w, by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      unfold principalPowerReduction
      rw [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ_apply, Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hw⟩)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hPa⟩ := hP P
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hQb⟩ := hQ Q
  refine ⟨a, ha, b, hb, ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have := congrArg (fun F => (L F).val) hF
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_sub, Submodule.coe_sub] at this
  rw [hPa, hQb] at this
  rw [map_sub, this, map_sub, sub_self]

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_layer_correction
statement:
theorem two_chart_layer_correction (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (beta : (BlowupChart R x t) →+* (BlowupOverlap R t x))
    (hbase : ∀ r : R, beta (chartBase R x t r) =
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x r))
    (hslope : beta (chartSlope R x t) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x)) (j d : ℕ)
    (hd : d ≤ j+1) (w : (BlowupOverlap R t x))
    (hw : w ∈
      (Ideal.span {(algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)})^j) :
    ∃ a : (BlowupChart R t x), ∃ b : (BlowupChart R x t), a ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^j ∧ b ∈
      (chartExceptional R x t)^j ∧ w - ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) a -
      (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))^d * beta b) ∈ (Ideal.span
      {(algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)})^(j+1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩ :=
    two_chart_layer_correction_zpow R t x hreg beta hbase hslope j (-d) (by omega) w hw
  exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, by rwa [← invSelf_pow_eq_selfZPow] at h⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_sections_reduction_surjective
statement:
private theorem curve_sections_reduction_surjective (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (j : ℕ)
    (ρ : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G (j + 1) →ₗ[R] curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j)
    (hρ : ∀ q : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G (j+1), ∀ p : BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t,
      (q : (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G (j+1)) =
      (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G (j+1)).mkQ p → ((ρ q : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j) :
      (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j) =
      (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ p) :
    Function.Surjective ρ
proof:
:= by
  set α := algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) with hα
  set E : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) := Ideal.span {α (chartBase R t x t)} with hE
  have hbase : ∀ r : R, beta.right.toRingHom (chartBase R x t r) = α (chartBase R t x r) :=
    beta_right_chartBase beta
  have hdiff : ∀ p : BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t,
      fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 p = α p.1 - beta.right p.2 := by
    intro p
    change α p.1 - (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))^0 * beta.right p.2 = _
    simp
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hy
  have hp' : α p.1 - beta.right p.2 ∈ overlapCurveIdeal R t x beta G j := by
    rw [← hdiff]; exact hp
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hp'
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hu
  have hEeq : Ideal.span {overlapException R t x} = E := rfl
  rw [hEeq] at hv
  have hcompat : α (G.left j) - α (G.left (j+1)) ∈ E ^ j := by
    have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem α (G.left_compat j)
    rw [chartExceptional, Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at this
    rw [← neg_sub, ← map_sub]
    exact neg_mem this
  set w := α p.1 - beta.right p.2 - c * α (G.left (j+1)) with hw
  have hwmem : w ∈ E ^ j := by
    have : w = c * (α (G.left j) - α (G.left (j+1))) + v := by
      rw [hw, ← huv]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hcompat) hv
  obtain ⟨a₁, b₁, ha₁, hb₁, hres⟩ := two_chart_layer_correction R t x hreg beta.right.toRingHom
    hbase beta.slope j 0 (by omega) w hwmem
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at hres
  set p' : BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t := (p.1 - a₁, p.2 - b₁) with hp'def
  have hp'mem : p' ∈ curveSections R t x beta G (j+1) := by
    change fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 p' ∈ overlapCurveIdeal R t x beta G (j+1)
    rw [hdiff]
    have : α p'.1 - beta.right p'.2 = c * α (G.left (j+1)) +
        (w - (α a₁ - beta.right.toRingHom b₁)) := by
      simp only [hp'def, hw, map_sub]; change _ = _ + (_ - (_ - beta.right b₁))
      ring
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right hres)
  refine ⟨⟨(curveIdealLattice R t x beta G (j+1)).mkQ p', Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hp'mem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hρ _ p' rfl]
  simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply]
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change p.1 - a₁ - p.1 ∈ leftCurveIdeal R t x beta G j
    rw [sub_sub_cancel_left]
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (neg_mem ha₁)
  · change p.2 - b₁ - p.2 ∈ rightCurveIdeal R t x beta G j
    rw [sub_sub_cancel_left]
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (neg_mem hb₁)

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_limit_level_map_surjective
statement:
theorem curve_limit_level_map_surjective (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (J : ℕ)
    (π : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G →ₗ[R] curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G J)
    (hπ : ∀ p : curveThreads R t x beta G,
      ((π (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G J) :
      (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G J) =
      (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G J).mkQ (p.val J)) :
    Function.Surjective π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have key : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ a, a ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j →
      ∃ b, b ∈ curveSections R t x beta G (j+1) ∧ a - b ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j := by
    intro j a ha
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := curve_sections_quot_reduction_exists R t x beta d G j
    have hs := curve_sections_reduction_surjective R t x beta d G hreg j ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := hs ⟨(curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ a, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem ha⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbq⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp q'.2
    refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
    have h1 := hρ q' b hbq.symm
    rw [hq'] at h1
    have h2 : (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ (a - b) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h1
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp h2
  have anti : Antitone (fun j => curveSections R t x beta G j) :=
    antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun j => (curve_lattices_antitone R t x beta d G j).2)
  intro q
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haq⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp q.2
  let f : ℕ → ChartPair R t x := fun n => Nat.rec a (fun n fn =>
    if h : fn ∈ curveSections R t x beta G (J+n) then Classical.choose (key (J+n) fn h) else 0) n
  have f0 : f 0 = a := rfl
  have fmem : ∀ n, f n ∈ curveSections R t x beta G (J+n) ∧
      f n - f (n+1) ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G (J+n) := by
    have hs : ∀ n (h : f n ∈ curveSections R t x beta G (J+n)),
        f (n+1) = Classical.choose (key (J+n) (f n) h) := fun n h => dif_pos h
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨ha, by rw [hs 0 ha]; exact (Classical.choose_spec (key _ _ ha)).2⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      have h : f (n+1) ∈ curveSections R t x beta G (J+(n+1)) := by
        rw [hs n ih.1]; exact (Classical.choose_spec (key _ _ ih.1)).1
      exact ⟨h, by rw [hs (n+1) h]; exact (Classical.choose_spec (key _ _ h)).2⟩
  let p : ℕ → ChartPair R t x := fun j => f (j - J)
  have hp : p ∈ curveThreads R t x beta G := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j _
      exact anti (show j ≤ J + (j - J) by omega) (fmem (j - J)).1
    · intro j _
      change p j - LinearMap.id (p (j+1)) ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j
      simp only [LinearMap.id_apply, p]
      by_cases hj : j < J
      · rw [show j - J = 0 by omega, show j + 1 - J = 0 by omega, sub_self]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · rw [show j + 1 - J = (j - J) + 1 by omega]
        have := (fmem (j - J)).2
        rwa [show J + (j - J) = j by omega] at this
  refine ⟨curveLimitMk R t x beta G ⟨p, hp⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [hπ]
  change (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G J).mkQ (f (J - J)) = _
  rw [Nat.sub_self, f0, haq]

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_additive_approximation
statement:
private theorem two_chart_additive_approximation (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (beta : (BlowupChart R x t) →+* (BlowupOverlap R t x))
    (hbase : ∀ r : R, beta (chartBase R x t r) =
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x r))
    (hslope : beta (chartSlope R x t) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x)) (n : ℕ)
    (w : (BlowupOverlap R t x)) :
    ∃ a : (BlowupChart R t x), ∃ b : (BlowupChart R x t),
      w - ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) a - beta b) ∈
        (Ideal.span {(algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))
          (chartBase R t x t)})^n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨c, d, -, -, hcd⟩ := two_chart_layer_correction R t x hreg beta hbase
      hslope n 0 (Nat.zero_le _) _ hab
    refine ⟨a + c, b + d, ?_⟩
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at hcd
    convert hcd using 1
    rw [map_add, map_add]; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_sections_cover_overlap
statement:
theorem curve_sections_cover_overlap (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (j : ℕ) (c : BlowupOverlap R t x) :
    ∃ p ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j, fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 p -
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j) * c ∈
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := two_chart_additive_approximation R t x hreg
    (beta.right : BlowupChart R x t →+* BlowupOverlap R t x) (beta_right_chartBase beta)
    beta.slope j
    ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j) * c)
  have hdiff : fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 (a, b)
      = (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) a - beta.right b := by
    simp [fullCechDifferential, ringCechDifferential]
  have key : fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 (a, b)
      - (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j) * c
      ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j := by
    rw [hdiff]
    have := (Ideal.neg_mem_iff _).2 hab
    convert this using 1
    · rfl
    · change _ - beta.right b - _ = -(_ - (_ - beta.right b)); ring
  refine ⟨(a, b), ?_, key⟩
  change fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 (a, b) ∈ overlapCurveIdeal R t x beta G j
  have : fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 (a, b)
      = (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j) * c
        + (fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0 (a, b)
          - (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j) * c) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.add_mem _
    (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)))
    (Ideal.mem_sup_right key)

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_layer_correction_positive
statement:
private theorem two_chart_layer_correction_positive (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (j d : ℕ)
    (w : BlowupOverlap R t x) (hw : w ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) ^ j) :
    ∃ a ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^j, ∃ b ∈ (chartExceptional R x t)^j, w -
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) a - (overlapSlope R t x)^d *
      beta.right b) ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^(j+1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩ := two_chart_layer_correction_zpow R t x hreg beta.right
    (beta_right_chartBase beta) beta.slope j d (by omega) w hw
  exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, by rwa [selfZPow_natCast] at h⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.isUnit_mk_map
proof:
:=
  ha.map (Ideal.quotientMap J f h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.injective_unit_mul_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hU
  intro a b hab
  apply hg
  simpa [mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun y => (↑u⁻¹ : Q) * y) hab

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_unit_eq_mul_of_span_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply regular_principal_generators_associated Q g F
  · intro a b hab; apply hg; simpa [mul_comm] using hab
  · exact h.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_generator_step
statement:
private theorem chart_generator_step {A : Type} [CommRing A] (T : A) (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (g g' F : A)
    (hg' : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^j) g'} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^j) g})
    (hreg : Function.Injective (fun c : A ⧸ (Ideal.span {T})^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^j) g * c))
    (hF : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^j) F} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^j) g}) :
    ∃ w : A, IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^(j+1)) w) ∧
      w * g' - F ∈ (Ideal.span {T})^j ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^(j+1)) (w * g')} =
        Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {T})^(j+1)) g'}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u1, hu1⟩ := exists_unit_eq_mul_of_span_eq _ _ hreg hg'
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_unit_eq_mul_of_span_eq _ _ hreg hF
  obtain ⟨w, hwu, hw⟩ := principal_power_unit_lift A T j hj
    ((u * u1⁻¹ : _ˣ) : A ⧸ (Ideal.span {T})^j) (Units.isUnit _)
  refine ⟨w, hwu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq, map_mul, hw, hu1, hu]
    simp only [Units.val_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]
  · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hwu
    rw [map_mul, ← hv]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit v.isUnit _

name: SurfaceBlowup.span_mk_mul_eq_of_mul_one_add
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk I a' * Ideal.Quotient.mk I (1 + a) = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk I), ← map_sub,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact h
  rw [map_mul]
  exact (Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit ⟨⟨_, _, h1, by rw [mul_comm, h1]⟩, rfl⟩ _).trans hF

name: SurfaceBlowup.glued_step_combination
proof:
:= by
  have : X * aF - Y * P = X * (aF - v * P) + P * (-(X * v) * (Y * (1 + β) - 1) +
      Y * (X * (1 + γ) - 1) + X * Y * ((v - 1 - (γ - β)) + (v - 1) * β)) := by ring
  rw [this]
  refine J.add_mem (J.mul_mem_left _ hv) (J.mul_mem_left _ ?_)
  exact J.add_mem (J.add_mem (J.mul_mem_left _ h4) (J.mul_mem_left _ h3))
    (J.mul_mem_left _ (J.add_mem hcd h5))

name: SurfaceBlowup.mul_mem_pow_succ
statement:
private theorem mul_mem_pow_succ {S : Type} [CommRing S] (I : Ideal S) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    {a b : S} (ha : a ∈ I ^ j) (hb : b ∈ I ^ j) : a * b ∈ I ^ (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha hb
  rw [← pow_add] at this
  exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) this

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_inv_one_add
statement:
private theorem exists_inv_one_add {S : Type} [CommRing S] (I : Ideal S) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    {a : S} (ha : a ∈ I ^ j) : ∃ a' : S, a' * (1 + a) - 1 ∈ I ^ (j + 1) ∧ a' - 1 ∈ I ^ j
proof:
:= by
  have hn : IsNilpotent (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (j + 1)) a) :=
    ⟨2, by
      rw [← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, pow_two]; exact mul_mem_pow_succ I hj ha ha⟩
  have hu := hn.isUnit_one_add
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ((hu.unit⁻¹ : (S ⧸ I ^ (j + 1))ˣ) : S ⧸ I ^ (j + 1))
  have h1 : a' * (1 + a) - 1 ∈ I ^ (j + 1) := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, map_mul, ha', map_add, map_one,
      hu.val_inv_mul, sub_self]
  refine ⟨a', h1, ?_⟩
  rw [show a' - 1 = (a' * (1 + a) - 1) - a' * a by ring]
  exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ j) h1) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ha)

name: SurfaceBlowup.injective_mk_mul_of_span_eq
statement:
private theorem injective_mk_mul_of_span_eq {A C : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing C] (f : A →+* C)
    (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal C) (hIJ : ∀ a ∈ I, f a ∈ J) (g F : A) (z : C)
    (hz : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk J z))
    (hreg : Function.Injective (fun c : A ⧸ I => Ideal.Quotient.mk I g * c))
    (hF : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk I F} = Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk I g})
    (hregJ : Function.Injective (fun c : C ⧸ J => Ideal.Quotient.mk J (f g) * c)) :
    Function.Injective (fun c : C ⧸ J => Ideal.Quotient.mk J (z * f F) * c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_unit_eq_mul_of_span_eq _ _ hreg hF
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (u : A ⧸ I)
  have hbu : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (f b)) :=
    isUnit_mk_map f I J hIJ b (by rw [hb]; exact u.isUnit)
  have hdiff : F - b * g ∈ I := by rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq, map_mul, hb, hu]
  have hdiff' := hIJ _ hdiff
  rw [map_sub, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq, map_mul] at hdiff'
  have : Ideal.Quotient.mk J (z * f F) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk J z * Ideal.Quotient.mk J (f b)) * Ideal.Quotient.mk J (f g) := by
    rw [map_mul, hdiff', map_mul, mul_assoc]
  rw [this]
  exact injective_unit_mul_mul _ _ (hz.mul hbu) hregJ

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_mul_sub_mul_mem
statement:
private theorem exists_mul_sub_mul_mem {C : Type} [CommRing C] (J : Ideal C) (a b p q z : C)
    (hb : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk J b)) (hz : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk J z))
    (u : (C ⧸ J)ˣ) (hu : Ideal.Quotient.mk J p = u * Ideal.Quotient.mk J q) :
    ∃ v : C, a * p - v * (z * (b * q)) ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a * (u : C ⧸ J) * ((hb.unit⁻¹ : (C ⧸ J)ˣ) : C ⧸ J) *
      ((hz.unit⁻¹ : (C ⧸ J)ˣ) : C ⧸ J))
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, hu, hv]
  have e1 := hb.mul_val_inv
  have e2 := hz.mul_val_inv
  linear_combination (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a * (u : C ⧸ J) * Ideal.Quotient.mk J q) *
    (-(Ideal.Quotient.mk J z * ((hz.unit⁻¹ : (C ⧸ J)ˣ) : C ⧸ J)) * e1 - e2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.glued_generators_succ
statement:
private theorem glued_generators_succ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (d : ℕ)
    (gA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x) (gB : ℕ → BlowupChart R x t)
    (hA : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA (j+1))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j)})
    (hB : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB (j+1))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j)})
    (hregA : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupChart R t x ⧸ (chartExceptional R t x)^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j) * c))
    (hregBc : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupChart R x t ⧸ (chartExceptional R x t)^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j) * c))
    (hoverlap : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (gA j))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j) (beta.right (gB j))})
    (hregC : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j) (beta.right (gB j)) * c))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (FA : BlowupChart R t x) (FB : BlowupChart R x t)
    (hIA : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) FA} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j)})
    (hIB : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) FB} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j)})
    (hIC : (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) FA - (overlapSlope R t x)^d *
      beta.right FB ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j) :
    ∃ (FA' : BlowupChart R t x) (FB' : BlowupChart R x t), FA' - FA ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^j ∧
      FB' - FB ∈ (chartExceptional R x t)^j ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^(j+1)) FA'} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^(j+1)) (gA (j+1))} ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^(j+1)) FB'} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^(j+1)) (gB (j+1))} ∧
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) FA' - (overlapSlope R t x)^d *
      beta.right FB' ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^(j+1)
proof:
:= by
  set α := algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) with hα
  set E := Ideal.span {overlapException R t x} with hE
  set Z := overlapSlope R t x with hZ
  have TA : ∀ m (a : BlowupChart R t x), a ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^m → α a ∈ E^m :=
    algebraMap_mem_overlap_pow
  have TB : ∀ m (b : BlowupChart R x t), b ∈ (chartExceptional R x t)^m → beta.right b ∈ E^m :=
    beta_right_mem_overlap_pow beta
  have hZu : ∀ m, IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (E^m) (Z^d)) :=
    fun _ => ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _).pow d).map _
  
  obtain ⟨wA, hwAu, hwA, hwAI⟩ := chart_generator_step (chartBase R t x t) j hj (gA j)
    (gA (j+1)) FA (hA j) (hregA j) hIA
  obtain ⟨wB, hwBu, hwB, hwBI⟩ := chart_generator_step (chartBase R x t x) j hj (gB j)
    (gB (j+1)) FB (hB j) (hregBc j) hIB
  
  obtain ⟨u2, hu2⟩ := exists_unit_eq_mul_of_span_eq _ _ (hregC (j+1)) (hoverlap (j+1))
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_mul_sub_mul_mem (E^(j+1)) (α wA) (beta.right wB) (α (gA (j+1)))
    (beta.right (gB (j+1))) (Z^d)
    (isUnit_mk_map beta.right.toRingHom _ _ (fun y hy => TB (j+1) y hy) wB hwBu) (hZu _) u2 hu2
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul] at hv
  have hv1 : v - 1 ∈ E^j := transition_unit_congruent_one R t x beta d j FA _ FB _ hwA hwB hIC
    (injective_mk_mul_of_span_eq beta.right.toRingHom _ _ (fun y hy => TB j y hy) _ FB _
      (hZu j) (hregBc j) hIB (hregC j))
    v (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ j) hv)
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc, d1, hd1, hcd⟩ :=
    two_chart_layer_correction_positive R t x beta hreg j 0 (v - 1) hv1
  rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at hcd
  obtain ⟨c', hc'1, hc'2⟩ := exists_inv_one_add _ hj hc
  obtain ⟨d', hd'1, hd'2⟩ := exists_inv_one_add _ hj hd1
  refine ⟨c' * (wA * gA (j+1)), d' * (wB * gB (j+1)), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show c' * (wA * gA (j+1)) - FA = (c' - 1) * (wA * gA (j+1)) + (wA * gA (j+1) - FA) by
      ring]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hc'2) hwA
  · rw [show d' * (wB * gB (j+1)) - FB = (d' - 1) * (wB * gB (j+1)) + (wB * gB (j+1) - FB) by
      ring]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hd'2) hwB
  · exact span_mk_mul_eq_of_mul_one_add _ c' c _ (gA (j+1)) hc'1 hwAI
  · exact span_mk_mul_eq_of_mul_one_add _ d' d1 _ (gB (j+1)) hd'1 hwBI
  · have h3 := TA (j+1) _ hc'1
    have h4 := TB (j+1) _ hd'1
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_one] at h3 h4
    rw [map_mul α c', map_mul beta.right d', mul_left_comm (Z^d)]
    exact glued_step_combination _ (α c') _ (beta.right d') _ v (α c) (beta.right d1) hv hcd h3 h4
      (mul_mem_pow_succ E hj hv1 (TB j d1 hd1))

name: SurfaceBlowup.glued_generators_exist
statement:
theorem glued_generators_exist (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (d : ℕ)
    (gA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x) (gB : ℕ → BlowupChart R x t)
    (hA : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA (j+1))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j)})
    (hB : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB (j+1))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j)})
    (hregA : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupChart R t x ⧸ (chartExceptional R t x)^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j) * c))
    (hregBc : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupChart R x t ⧸ (chartExceptional R x t)^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j) * c))
    (hoverlap : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (gA j))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j) (beta.right (gB j))})
    (hregC : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j) (beta.right (gB j)) * c))
    (hnorm : ∃ u : Rˣ, (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (gA 1) - algebraMap
      R (BlowupOverlap R t x) (u : R) * ((overlapSlope R t x)^d * beta.right (gB 1)) ∈
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})) :
    ∃ G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d, ∀ j : ℕ,
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j)} ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j)}
proof:
:= by
  let A := BlowupChart R t x
  let B := BlowupChart R x t
  let Inv : ℕ → A × B → Prop := fun j p =>
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) p.1} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (gA j)} ∧
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) p.2} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (gB j)} ∧
    algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) p.1 - (overlapSlope R t x)^d *
      beta.right p.2 ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j
  have hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p : {p : A × B // Inv (n+1) p}, ∃ q : A × B,
      (q.1 - p.1.1 ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^(n+1) ∧
        q.2 - p.1.2 ∈ (chartExceptional R x t)^(n+1)) ∧ Inv (n+2) q := by
    intro n p
    obtain ⟨FA', FB', h1, h2, h3⟩ := glued_generators_succ R t x beta hreg d gA gB hA hB hregA
      hregBc hoverlap hregC (n+1) (by omega) p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2
    exact ⟨(FA', FB'), ⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
  obtain ⟨FA1, FB1, h1⟩ := glued_generators_level_one R t x beta d (gA 1) (gB 1) hnorm
  choose next hnext using hstep
  let seq : ∀ n : ℕ, {p : A × B // Inv (n+1) p} := fun n =>
    Nat.rec ⟨(FA1, FB1), h1⟩ (fun n p => ⟨next n p, (hnext n p).2⟩) n
  let left : ℕ → A := fun j => match j with | 0 => gA 0 | n+1 => (seq n).1.1
  let right : ℕ → B := fun j => match j with | 0 => gB 0 | n+1 => (seq n).1.2
  refine ⟨⟨left, right, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;> rintro (_ | n)
  · simp
  · exact (hnext n (seq n)).1.1
  · simp
  · exact (hnext n (seq n)).1.2
  · simp
  · exact (seq n).2.2.2
  · exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨(seq n).2.1, (seq n).2.2.1⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.injective_mk_mul_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    apply h
    simp only [mul_zero]
    rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact ha
  · intro h a b hab
    induction a using Quotient.inductionOn' with | h a => ?_
    induction b using Quotient.inductionOn' with | h b => ?_
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ e * Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ e * Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b at hab
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq] at hab
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    apply h
    rw [mul_sub]; exact hab

name: SurfaceBlowup.mul_injective_quotient_transport
statement:
theorem mul_injective_quotient_transport (Θ : S ≃+* T) {g e : S} {eT u : T} (hu : IsUnit u)
    (he : Θ e * u = eT)
    (h : Function.Injective
      (fun a : S ⧸ Ideal.span {g} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e * a)) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun a : T ⧸ Ideal.span {Θ g} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {Θ g}) eT * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_mk_mul_iff] at h ⊢
  intro b hb
  rw [← he, mul_assoc, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hb
  have h1 := h (Θ.symm (u * b)) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (by simpa using map_dvd Θ.symm hb))
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← hu.dvd_mul_left]
  simpa using map_dvd Θ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp h1)

name: SurfaceBlowup.sup_pow_le
statement: private theorem sup_pow_le (I J : Ideal S) (j : ℕ) : (I ⊔ J) ^ j ≤ I ⊔ J ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc (I ⊔ J) ^ (n+1) = (I ⊔ J) * (I ⊔ J) ^ n := pow_succ' _ _
      _ ≤ (I ⊔ J) * (I ⊔ J ^ n) := Ideal.mul_mono_right ih
      _ ≤ I ⊔ J ^ (n+1) := by
        rw [Ideal.sup_mul, Ideal.mul_sup, Ideal.mul_sup, pow_succ']
        exact sup_le (sup_le (le_sup_of_le_left Ideal.mul_le_right)
          (le_sup_of_le_left Ideal.mul_le_left))
          (sup_le (le_sup_of_le_left Ideal.mul_le_right) le_sup_right)

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_pow_le_span_pair
statement:
private theorem exists_pow_le_span_pair {M : Ideal S} {g e : S}
    (h : ∃ L, M ^ L ≤ Ideal.span {g, e ^ 1}) (j : ℕ) : ∃ L, M ^ L ≤ Ideal.span {g, e ^ j}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := h
  refine ⟨L * j, ?_⟩
  rw [pow_mul]
  refine (Ideal.pow_right_mono hL j).trans ?_
  rw [Ideal.span_insert, Ideal.span_insert, pow_one, ← Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  exact sup_pow_le _ _ j

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_pow_le_span_pair_transport
statement:
theorem exists_pow_le_span_pair_transport (Θ : S ≃+* T) {g e : S} {eT u : T} (hu : IsUnit u)
    (he : Θ e * u = eT) {MS : Ideal S} {MT : Ideal T} (hM : MT ≤ MS.map Θ)
    (h : ∃ L, MS ^ L ≤ Ideal.span {g, e ^ 1}) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ L, MT ^ L ≤ Ideal.span {Θ g, eT ^ j}
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_pow_le_span_pair ?_ j
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := h
  refine ⟨L, (Ideal.pow_right_mono hM L).trans ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
  refine (Ideal.map_mono hL).trans ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
  · exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hu
    have : Θ e = eT * ↑v⁻¹ := by rw [← he, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
    simp only [this, pow_one]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion {A : Type} [CommRing A] (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
        (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
      P.map (completedPointMap A P)
proof:
:= by
  calc _ = (P.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))).map
          (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)) := by
        rw [Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
    _ = _ := by rw [Ideal.map_map]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_transport
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_transport {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (P : Ideal A) (Q : Ideal B) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime]
    (Θ : CompletedLocalAt B Q ≃+* CompletedLocalAt A P)
    (hΘ : ∀ a, Θ (completedPointMap B Q (f a)) = completedPointMap A P a) :
    ((P.map f).map (completedPointMap B Q)).map (Θ : _ →+* _) =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map (localCompletionMap _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion, Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map]
  exact congrArg (Ideal.map · P) (RingHom.ext hΘ)

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_comap_le
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_comap_le {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (Q : Ideal B) [Q.IsPrime]
    (Θ : CompletedLocalAt B Q ≃+* CompletedLocalAt A (Q.comap f))
    (hΘ : ∀ a, Θ (completedPointMap B Q (f a)) = completedPointMap A (Q.comap f) a) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap f))).map (localCompletionMap _) ≤
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)).map (localCompletionMap _)).map
        (Θ : _ →+* _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_transport f _ Q Θ hΘ, map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion Q]
  exact Ideal.map_mono (Ideal.map_mono Ideal.map_comap_le)

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_equation_of_kernels
statement:
theorem strict_transform_equation_of_kernels {A ι : Type} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Finite ι] (P : ι → Ideal A) [∀ s, (P s).IsMaximal] (hP : Function.Injective P) (z : A)
    (hz : ∀ s, z ∈ P s) (g : ∀ s, CompletedLocalAt A (P s))
    (hfin : ∀ j s, ∃ L, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (P s))).map
      (localCompletionMap _)) ^ L ≤ finiteLocalCurveIdeal A (P s) z (g s) j)
    (F : ℕ → A) (hF : ∀ j, Ideal.span {F j} ⊔ Ideal.span {z} ^ j =
      finiteSupportKernel A ι P (fun s => finiteLocalCurveIdeal A (P s) z (g s) j))
    (d : ℕ) (y : A) (hy : ∀ j, y - z ^ d * F j ∈ Ideal.span {z} ^ j) (s : ι)
    [IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt A (P s))]
    (hereg : Function.Injective
      (fun a : CompletedLocalAt A (P s) => completedPointMap A (P s) z * a))
    (hgreg : Function.Injective (fun a : CompletedLocalAt A (P s) ⧸
      Ideal.span {completedPointMap A (P s) z} =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {completedPointMap A (P s) z}) (g s) * a)) :
    ∃ v : (CompletedLocalAt A (P s))ˣ, completedPointMap A (P s) y =
      completedPointMap A (P s) z ^ d * g s * (v : CompletedLocalAt A (P s))
proof:
:= by
  set φ := completedPointMap A (P s)
  have he : φ z ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt A (P s)) := by
    have h1 : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime (P s)) z ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (P s)) := by
      rw [Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal.symm]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hz s)
    have := AdicCompletion.algebraMap_isLocalHom_of_fg (R := Localization.AtPrime (P s))
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
    have : IsLocalHom (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime (P s))) := this
    exact map_nonunit (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime (P s))) _ h1
  refine strict_transform_equation_from_levels _ (φ z) (g s) he hereg hgreg d (fun j => φ (F j))
    (fun j => ?_) _ (fun j => ?_)
  · have hrec := finite_support_completion_recovers A ι P hP (fun s => (hfin j s).choose) _
      (fun s => (hfin j s).choose_spec) s
    rw [← hF, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, finiteLocalCurveIdeal] at hrec
    rw [← hrec, Ideal.span_insert]
  · have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ (hy j)
    rw [Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at this
    simpa [map_sub, map_mul, map_pow] using this

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite
statement:
theorem two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (j : ℕ) :
    (∀ s, Function.Injective (fun a : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) ⧸
      Ideal.span {leftData D s} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {leftData D s})
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) (chartBase R t x t)) * a)) ∧ ∀ s, ∃ L :
      ℕ, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (leftPoint D s))).map (localCompletionMap
      (Localization.AtPrime (leftPoint D s))))^L ≤ leftLevelIdeal D j s
proof:
:= by
  have he (i : D.ι) : D.leftIso i (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (overlapException R t x)) * 1 =
      completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D (.inl i)) (chartBase R t x t) :=
    (mul_one _).trans (D.leftIso_compat i _)
  constructor
  · rintro (i | k)
    · exact mul_injective_quotient_transport (D.leftIso i) isUnit_one (he i) (D.transverse i)
    · exact D.transverse0 k
  · rintro (i | k)
    · exact exists_pow_le_span_pair_transport (D.leftIso i) isUnit_one (he i)
        (map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_comap_le _ _ _ (D.leftIso_compat i)) (D.finite i) j
    · exact exists_pow_le_span_pair (D.finite0 k) j

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_left_points_maximal
statement:
theorem two_chart_left_points_maximal (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] :
    (∀ s, (leftPoint D s).IsMaximal) ∧ Function.Injective (leftPoint D) ∧ ∀ s, chartBase R t x t ∈
      leftPoint D s
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, ((D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).IsMaximal ∧
      chartSlope R t x ∉ (D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) ∧
      chartBase R t x t ∈ (D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) :=
    fun i => overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal R t x (D.Q i) (D.onE i)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro (i | k)
    · exact (key i).1
    · exact D.maximal0 k
  · rintro (i | i) (j | j) h
    · congr 1
      apply D.inj
      have h' : (D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) =
          (D.Q j).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) := h
      have := congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) h'
      rwa [IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)),
        IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x))] at this
    · exfalso
      have h' : (D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) = D.P0 j := h
      exact (key i).2.1 (h' ▸ D.slope0 j)
    · exfalso
      have h' : D.P0 i = (D.Q j).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) := h
      exact (key j).2.1 (h' ▸ D.slope0 i)
    · congr 1
      exact D.inj0 h
  · rintro (i | k)
    · exact (key i).2.2
    · exact D.onE0 k

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_left_point_equation
statement:
theorem strict_transform_left_point_equation (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} =
      leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)}
      = rightLevelKernel D j)
    (f : R)
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f =
      (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j))
    (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) [IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s))]
    (hereg : Function.Injective (fun a : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) =>
      completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) (chartBase R t x t) * a))
    (hgreg : Function.Injective (fun a : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) ⧸
      Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) (chartBase R t x t)} =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) (chartBase R t x t)})
      (leftData D s) * a)) :
    ∃ v : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s))ˣ, completedPointMap
      (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) f) =
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) (chartBase R t x t))^d * leftData D s *
      (v : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmax, hinj, hmem⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal R t x beta D
  have : ∀ s, (leftPoint D s).IsMaximal := hmax
  exact strict_transform_equation_of_kernels (leftPoint D) hinj _ hmem (leftData D)
    (fun j => (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2) G.left
    (fun j => (curve_ideal_lattice_eq_kernels R t x beta D d G hG j).1) d _
    (glued_function_left_chart R t x beta d G f hf) s hereg hgreg

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite
statement:
theorem two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (j : ℕ) :
    (∀ s, Function.Injective (fun a : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s) ⧸
      Ideal.span {rightData D s} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {rightData D s})
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s) (chartBase R x t x)) * a)) ∧ ∀ s, ∃ L
      : ℕ, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (rightPoint D s))).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime (rightPoint D s))))^L ≤ rightLevelIdeal D j s
proof:
:= by
  
  have hu (i : D.ι) : IsUnit (D.rightIso i (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (overlapSlope R t x))) :=
    ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _).map _).map _
  have he (i : D.ι) : D.rightIso i (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (overlapException R t x)) *
      D.rightIso i (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (overlapSlope R t x)) =
      completedPointMap _ (rightPoint D (.inl i)) (chartBase R x t x) := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← beta_right_chartBase_self]
    exact D.rightIso_compat i _
  constructor
  · rintro (i | l)
    · exact mul_injective_quotient_transport (D.rightIso i) (hu i) (he i) (D.transverse i)
    · exact D.transverseinf l
  · rintro (i | l)
    · exact exists_pow_le_span_pair_transport (D.rightIso i) (hu i) (he i)
        (map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_comap_le _ _ _ (D.rightIso_compat i)) (D.finite i) j
    · exact exists_pow_le_span_pair (D.finiteinf l) j

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_inf_eq_of_isUnit_pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.map_mono inf_le_left) ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
  have h1 : m ^ N * a ∈ I ⊓ K := ⟨I.mul_mem_left _ ha, K.mul_mem_right _ hK⟩
  have h2 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f h1
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hm.pow N
  have : f a = ↑u⁻¹ * f (m ^ N * a) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, ← hu, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h2

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_pow_mem_iInf
statement:
private theorem exists_pow_mem_iInf {A : Type} [CommRing A] {κ : Type} [Finite κ]
    (J : κ → Ideal A) (m : A) (L : κ → ℕ) (hL : ∀ k, m ^ L k ∈ J k) :
    ∃ N, m ^ N ∈ ⨅ k, J k
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  refine ⟨∑ k, L k, ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.mem_iInf]
  intro k
  exact (J k).pow_mem_of_pow_mem (hL k)
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ k))

name: SurfaceBlowup.leftLevelIdeal_map_leftIso_symm
statement:
private theorem leftLevelIdeal_map_leftIso_symm {R : Type} [CommRing R] {t x : R}
    {beta : BlowupRestriction R t x} (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (j : ℕ) (i : D.ι) :
    (finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x)
      ((D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))
      (chartBase R t x t) (D.leftIso i (D.g i)) j).map (D.leftIso i).symm =
      commonLevelIdeal D j i
proof:
:= by
  unfold commonLevelIdeal finiteLocalCurveIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_pow,
    (RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (D.leftIso_compat i (chartBase R t x t)).symm]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.rightLevelIdeal_map_rightIso_symm
statement:
private theorem rightLevelIdeal_map_rightIso_symm {R : Type} [CommRing R] {t x : R}
    {beta : BlowupRestriction R t x} (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (j : ℕ) (i : D.ι) :
    (finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R x t) ((D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom)
      (chartBase R x t x) (D.rightIso i (D.g i)) j).map (D.rightIso i).symm =
      commonLevelIdeal D j i
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : IsUnit (overlapSlope R t x) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  unfold commonLevelIdeal finiteLocalCurveIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_pow,
    (RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (D.rightIso_compat i (chartBase R x t x)).symm,
    beta_right_chartBase_self, map_mul, mul_pow, Ideal.span_insert, Ideal.span_insert,
    Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit ((hZ.map _).pow _)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.finiteSupportKernel_map_away
statement:
private theorem finiteSupportKernel_map_away {A S : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (m : A) [IsLocalization.Away m S] {ι κ : Type} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (P : ι ⊕ κ → Ideal A)
    [∀ s, (P s).IsPrime] (J : ∀ s, Ideal (CompletedLocalAt A (P s))) (Q : ι → Ideal S)
    [∀ i, (Q i).IsPrime] (J' : ∀ i, Ideal (CompletedLocalAt S (Q i)))
    (Φ : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt A (P (Sum.inl i)) ≃+* CompletedLocalAt S (Q i))
    (hΦ : ∀ i a, Φ i (completedPointMap A (P (Sum.inl i)) a) =
      completedPointMap S (Q i) (algebraMap A S a))
    (hJ : ∀ i, (J (Sum.inl i)).map (Φ i) = J' i) (hm : ∀ k, m ∈ P (Sum.inr k))
    (hmax : ∀ s, (P s).IsMaximal) (hJL : ∀ s, ∃ L : ℕ,
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (P s))).map
        (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime (P s)))) ^ L ≤ J s) :
    (finiteSupportKernel A (ι ⊕ κ) P J).map (algebraMap A S) = finiteSupportKernel S ι Q J'
proof:
:= by
  choose L hL' using hJL
  have hL : ∀ s, P s ^ L s ≤ (J s).comap (completedPointMap A (P s)) := fun s =>
    have := hmax s
    completed_point_power_contraction _ _ _ _ (hL' s)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_pow_mem_iInf
    (fun k => (J (Sum.inr k)).comap (completedPointMap A (P (Sum.inr k)))) m
    (fun k => L (Sum.inr k)) (fun k => hL (Sum.inr k) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (hm k) _))
  unfold finiteSupportKernel
  rw [iInf_sum, map_inf_eq_of_isUnit_pow_mem _ _ _ m N
    (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _) hN]
  have key := finite_support_kernel_localize A S (Submonoid.powers m) ι (fun i => P (Sum.inl i))
    (fun i => J (Sum.inl i)) (fun _ => True) (fun i => CompletedLocalAt S (Q i))
    (fun i => completedPointMap S (Q i)) Φ (fun i _ a => hΦ i a) (fun i h => absurd trivial h)
    (fun i => L (Sum.inl i)) (fun i => hL (Sum.inl i))
  unfold finiteSupportKernel at key
  rw [key]
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf fun i => ?_) (le_iInf fun i => ?_)
  · exact (iInf_le _ ⟨i, trivial⟩).trans (by rw [hJ])
  · exact (iInf_le _ i.val).trans (by rw [hJ])

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_kernels_agree_on_overlap
statement:
theorem two_chart_kernels_agree_on_overlap (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (j : ℕ) :
    (leftKernel D j).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) = commonKernel D j ∧
      (rightKernel D j).map beta.right.toRingHom = commonKernel D j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact finiteSupportKernel_map_away (chartSlope R t x) (leftPoint D) (leftLevelIdeal D j) D.Q
      (commonLevelIdeal D j) (fun i => (D.leftIso i).symm)
      (fun i a => (RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (D.leftIso_compat i a).symm)
      (leftLevelIdeal_map_leftIso_symm D j) D.slope0 (two_chart_left_points_maximal R t x beta D).1
      (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2
  · let _ : Algebra (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x) := beta.right.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    have := blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right R t x beta
    exact finiteSupportKernel_map_away (chartSlope R x t) (rightPoint D) (rightLevelIdeal D j) D.Q
      (commonLevelIdeal D j) (fun i => (D.rightIso i).symm)
      (fun i a => (RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (D.rightIso_compat i a).symm)
      (rightLevelIdeal_map_rightIso_symm D j) D.slopeinf
      (fun s => match s with
        | Sum.inl i =>
          (overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal_right R t x beta (D.Q i) (D.onE i)).1
        | Sum.inr l => D.maximalinf l)
      (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2

name: SurfaceBlowup.span_mk_map_eq_map_map
statement:
private theorem span_mk_map_eq_map_map {A C : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing C] (f : A →+* C) (a : A)
    (c : C)
    (h : f a ∈ Ideal.span {c}) (j : ℕ) (K : Ideal A) (F : A)
    (hF : K.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {a}) ^ j)) =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {a})^j) F}) :
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {c})^j) (f F)}
      = (K.map f).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {c})^j))
proof:
:= by
  have cond : ∀ z ∈ (Ideal.span {a})^j,
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {c})^j)).comp f) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have h1 : f z ∈ ((Ideal.span {a})^j).map f := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f hz
    rw [Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h1
    exact Ideal.pow_right_mono ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 h) j h1
  let φ := Ideal.Quotient.lift ((Ideal.span {a})^j)
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {c})^j)).comp f) cond
  have hφ : ∀ z, φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {a})^j) z) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {c})^j) (f z) := fun z => rfl
  have := congrArg (Ideal.map φ) hF
  rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hφ] at this
  rw [← this, Ideal.map_map]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_level_generators_agree_on_overlap
statement:
theorem two_chart_level_generators_agree_on_overlap (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta :
    BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (FA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x) (hFA : ∀ j : ℕ,
    leftLevelKernel D j =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^j) (FA j)}) (FB : ℕ →
    BlowupChart R x t) (hFB : ∀ j : ℕ, rightLevelKernel D j =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x})^j) (FB j)}) (j : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (FA j))} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
        (beta.right (FB j))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := two_chart_kernels_agree_on_overlap R t x beta D j
  have e1 := span_mk_map_eq_map_map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))
    (chartBase R t x t) (overlapException R t x) (by simp [overlapException]) j (leftKernel D j)
    (FA j)
    (by rw [← hFA j]; rfl)
  have hx : beta.right.toRingHom (chartBase R x t x) ∈ Ideal.span {overlapException R t x} := by
    change beta.right _ ∈ _
    rw [beta_right_chartBase_self]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have e2 := span_mk_map_eq_map_map beta.right.toRingHom (chartBase R x t x)
    (overlapException R t x) hx j (rightKernel D j) (FB j)
    (by rw [← hFB j]; rfl)
  rw [e1, h1]
  rw [h2] at e2
  exact e2.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_right_points_maximal
statement:
theorem two_chart_right_points_maximal (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] :
    (∀ s, (rightPoint D s).IsMaximal) ∧ Function.Injective (rightPoint D) ∧ ∀ s, chartBase R x t x ∈
      rightPoint D s
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, ((D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom).IsMaximal ∧
      chartSlope R x t ∉ (D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom ∧
      chartBase R x t x ∈ (D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom :=
    fun i => overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal_right R t x beta (D.Q i) (D.onE i)
  let _ : Algebra (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x) := beta.right.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have := blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right R t x beta
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro (i | k)
    · exact (key i).1
    · exact D.maximalinf k
  · rintro (i | i) (j | j) h
    · congr 1
      apply D.inj
      have h' : (D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) =
          (D.Q j).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) := h
      have := congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) h'
      rwa [IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R x t)),
        IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R x t))] at this
    · exfalso
      have h' : (D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom = D.Pinf j := h
      exact (key i).2.1 (h' ▸ D.slopeinf j)
    · exfalso
      have h' : D.Pinf i = (D.Q j).comap beta.right.toRingHom := h
      exact (key j).2.1 (h' ▸ D.slopeinf i)
    · congr 1
      exact D.injinf h
  · rintro (i | k)
    · exact (key i).2.2
    · exact D.onEinf k

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_commonLevelIdeal_iff_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [← leftLevelIdeal_map_leftIso_symm D j i, Ideal.map_symm]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_commonLevelIdeal_iff_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rightLevelIdeal_map_rightIso_symm D j i, Ideal.map_symm]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_sub_mem_of_finite_support
statement:
private theorem exists_sub_mem_of_finite_support {A : Type} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (P : ι → Ideal A) [∀ i, (P i).IsPrime] (hmax : ∀ i, (P i).IsMaximal)
    (hP : Function.Injective P) (L : ι → ℕ) (J : ∀ i, Ideal (CompletedLocalAt A (P i)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (P i))).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime (P i)))) ^ (L i) ≤ J i)
    (w : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt A (P i)) :
    ∃ a : A, ∀ i, completedPointMap A (P i) a - w i ∈ J i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := finite_support_quotient_surjective_of_isPrime A ι P hmax hP L J hJ
    fun i => Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (w i)
  exact ⟨a, fun i => Ideal.Quotient.eq.1 (congrFun ha i)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.sectionsToProduct_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem sectionsToProduct_eq_zero_iff (p : ChartPair R t x) :
    sectionsToProduct D j p = 0 ↔
      (∀ i, completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        p.1) ∈ commonLevelIdeal D j i) ∧
      (∀ k, completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k)) p.1 ∈ leftLevelIdeal D j (Sum.inr k)) ∧
      ∀ l, completedPointMap _ (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) p.2 ∈
        rightLevelIdeal D j (Sum.inr l)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [funext_iff, Sum.forall, Pi.zero_apply, sectionsToProduct, RingHom.pi_apply,
    RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_left_chart_lift
statement:
private theorem exists_left_chart_lift [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    (y : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i))
    (y0 : ∀ k, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k))) :
    ∃ a : BlowupChart R t x,
      (∀ i, completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a) -
        y i ∈ commonLevelIdeal D j i) ∧
      ∀ k, completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k)) a - y0 k ∈
        leftLevelIdeal D j (Sum.inr k)
proof:
:= by
  choose L hL using (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_sub_mem_of_finite_support (leftPoint D)
    (two_chart_left_points_maximal R t x beta D).1
    (two_chart_left_points_maximal R t x beta D).2.1 L (leftLevelIdeal D j) hL fun s =>
      match s with
      | Sum.inl i => D.leftIso i (y i)
      | Sum.inr k => y0 k
  refine ⟨a, fun i => ?_, fun k => ha (Sum.inr k)⟩
  rw [mem_commonLevelIdeal_iff_left, map_sub, D.leftIso_compat]
  exact ha (Sum.inl i)

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_right_chart_lift
statement:
private theorem exists_right_chart_lift [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)]
    (y : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i))
    (y1 : ∀ l, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))) :
    ∃ b : BlowupChart R x t,
      (∀ i, completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (beta.right b) - y i ∈ commonLevelIdeal D j i) ∧
      ∀ l, completedPointMap _ (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) b - y1 l ∈
        rightLevelIdeal D j (Sum.inr l)
proof:
:= by
  choose L hL using (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_sub_mem_of_finite_support (rightPoint D)
    (two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D).1
    (two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D).2.1 L (rightLevelIdeal D j) hL fun s =>
      match s with
      | Sum.inl i => D.rightIso i (y i)
      | Sum.inr l => y1 l
  refine ⟨b, fun i => ?_, fun l => hb (Sum.inr l)⟩
  rw [mem_commonLevelIdeal_iff_right, map_sub, D.rightIso_compat]
  exact hb (Sum.inl i)

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_sectionsToProduct_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_sectionsToProduct_eq [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (u : curveProduct D j) :
    ∃ p : ChartPair R t x, (∀ i, completedPointMap _ (D.Q i)
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) p.1 - beta.right p.2) ∈
        commonLevelIdeal D j i) ∧ sectionsToProduct D j p = u
proof:
:= by
  choose w hw using fun q => Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (u q)
  obtain ⟨a, hLi, hA⟩ := exists_left_chart_lift D j (fun i => w (Sum.inl i))
    (fun k => w (Sum.inr (Sum.inl k)))
  obtain ⟨b, hRi, hB⟩ := exists_right_chart_lift D j (fun i => w (Sum.inl i))
    (fun l => w (Sum.inr (Sum.inr l)))
  refine ⟨(a, b), fun i => ?_, funext fun s => ?_⟩
  · rw [map_sub, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    exact (Ideal.Quotient.eq.2 (hLi i)).trans (Ideal.Quotient.eq.2 (hRi i)).symm
  rw [← hw s]
  refine Ideal.Quotient.eq.2 ?_
  rcases s with i | k | l
  exacts [hLi i, hA k, hB l]

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_sections_quot_equiv_product
statement:
theorem curve_sections_quot_equiv_product (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R
    t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j)
    (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j ≃+ curveProduct D j, ∀ q : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G
      j, ∀ p : BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t,
      (q : (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j) =
      (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ p → E q = sectionsToProduct D j p
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set α := algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) with hα
  have hmemL := mem_commonLevelIdeal_iff_left D j
  have hmemR := mem_commonLevelIdeal_iff_right D j
  
  have hover : overlapCurveIdeal R t x beta G j = commonKernel D j := by
    rw [← (two_chart_kernels_agree_on_overlap R t x beta D j).1,
      ← (curve_ideal_lattice_eq_kernels R t x beta D d G hG j).1]
    rw [leftCurveIdeal, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, chartExceptional,
      Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  have hlat : ∀ p : BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t, p ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j ↔
      p.1 ∈ leftKernel D j ∧ p.2 ∈ rightKernel D j := by
    intro p
    rw [← (curve_ideal_lattice_eq_kernels R t x beta D d G hG j).1,
      ← (curve_ideal_lattice_eq_kernels R t x beta D d G hG j).2]
    rfl
  have hsec : ∀ p : BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t, p ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j ↔
      α p.1 - beta.right p.2 ∈ commonKernel D j := by
    intro p
    rw [← hover]
    change α p.1 - (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))^0 * beta.right p.2 ∈
      overlapCurveIdeal R t x beta G j ↔ _
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul]
  have hkerL : ∀ a, a ∈ leftKernel D j ↔
      ∀ s, completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D s) a ∈ leftLevelIdeal D j s := fun a => by
    simp only [leftKernel, finiteSupportKernel, Ideal.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_comap]
  have hkerR : ∀ b, b ∈ rightKernel D j ↔
      ∀ s, completedPointMap _ (rightPoint D s) b ∈ rightLevelIdeal D j s := fun b => by
    simp only [rightKernel, finiteSupportKernel, Ideal.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_comap]
  have hkerC : ∀ c, c ∈ commonKernel D j ↔
      ∀ i, completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) c ∈ commonLevelIdeal D j i := fun c => by
    simp only [commonKernel, finiteSupportKernel, Ideal.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_comap]
  
  let φ : (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) →+ curveProduct D j :=
    (sectionsToProduct D j).toAddMonoidHom
  have hN : (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).toAddSubgroup ≤ φ.ker := by
    intro p hp
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hlat p).1 hp
    rw [hkerL] at h1
    rw [hkerR] at h2
    refine (sectionsToProduct_eq_zero_iff D j p).2
      ⟨fun i => ?_, fun k => h1 (Sum.inr k), fun l => h2 (Sum.inr l)⟩
    rw [hmemL, D.leftIso_compat]
    exact h1 (Sum.inl i)
  let Ψ : ((BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j) →+
      curveProduct D j := QuotientAddGroup.lift _ φ hN
  have hΨ : ∀ p, Ψ ((curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ p) = sectionsToProduct D j p :=
    fun p => rfl
  let E₀ : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j →+ curveProduct D j :=
    Ψ.comp (curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j).subtype.toAddMonoidHom
  have hinj : Function.Injective E₀ := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ h0
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hq
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := (sectionsToProduct_eq_zero_iff D j p).1 h0
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ p = 0
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hlat]
    have hA : p.1 ∈ leftKernel D j := by
      rw [hkerL]
      rintro (i | k)
      · have h := hc1 i
        rwa [hmemL, D.leftIso_compat] at h
      · exact hc2 k
    refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
    rw [hkerR]
    rintro (i | l)
    · have hs := (hkerC _).1 ((hsec p).1 hp) i
      have hb : completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (beta.right p.2) ∈ commonLevelIdeal D j i := by
        have := Ideal.sub_mem _ (hc1 i) hs
        rwa [map_sub, sub_sub_cancel] at this
      rw [hmemR, D.rightIso_compat] at hb
      exact hb
    · exact hc3 l
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective E₀ := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := exists_sectionsToProduct_eq D j u
    have hs : p ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j := by
      rw [hsec, hkerC]
      exact hp
    exact ⟨⟨(curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ p, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hs⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨AddEquiv.ofBijective E₀ ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩, ?_⟩
  intro q p hqp
  change Ψ q = _
  rw [hqp]
  exact hΨ p

name: SurfaceBlowup.curveThreads_mkQ_succ
proof:
:= by
  have h := p.2.2 j (Set.mem_univ _)
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  simpa [towerDelta] using h

name: SurfaceBlowup.curveLimitMk_eq_iff
statement:
private theorem curveLimitMk_eq_iff (p p' : curveThreads R t x beta G) :
    curveLimitMk R t x beta G p = curveLimitMk R t x beta G p' ↔
      ∀ j, (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ (p.val j) =
        (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ (p'.val j)
proof:
:= by
  change (Submodule.Quotient.mk p : curveThreads R t x beta G ⧸ curveNullThreads R t x beta G)
    = Submodule.Quotient.mk p' ↔ _
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  simp only [curveNullThreads, Submodule.mem_comap, curveNull, Submodule.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ,
    true_implies, Submodule.coe_subtype]
  refine forall_congr' fun j => ?_
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_limit_equiv_product_threads
statement:
theorem curve_limit_equiv_product_threads (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R
    t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j)
    :
    ∃ E : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G ≃ curveProductThreads D, ∀ p : curveThreads R t x beta G, ∀ j
      : ℕ, (E (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p)).val j = sectionsToProduct D j (p.val j)
proof:
:= by
  choose Ej hEj using fun j => curve_sections_quot_equiv_product R t x beta D d G hG j
  choose ρ hρ using fun j => curve_sections_quot_reduction_exists R t x beta d G j
  
  have key : ∀ j (a b : ChartPair R t x), a ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j →
      (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ a = (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ b →
        sectionsToProduct D j a = sectionsToProduct D j b := by
    intro j a b ha hab
    have hm : (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ a ∈ curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j :=
      ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rw [← hEj j ⟨_, hm⟩ a rfl, ← hEj j ⟨_, hm⟩ b hab]
  have red : ∀ j (q : ChartPair R t x),
      curveProductReduction D j (sectionsToProduct D (j+1) q) = sectionsToProduct D j q := by
    intro j q; rfl
  have secs : ∀ (p : curveThreads R t x beta G) j, p.val j ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j :=
    fun p j => p.2.1 j (Set.mem_univ _)
  let F : curveThreads R t x beta G → curveProductThreads D := fun p =>
    ⟨fun j => sectionsToProduct D j (p.val j), fun j => by
      rw [red]; exact (key j _ _ (secs p j) (curveThreads_mkQ_succ p j)).symm⟩
  let Φ : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G → curveProductThreads D :=
    Quotient.lift F (by
      intro p p' h
      have h' : curveLimitMk R t x beta G p = curveLimitMk R t x beta G p' := Quotient.sound h
      rw [curveLimitMk_eq_iff] at h'
      apply Subtype.ext; funext j
      exact key j _ _ (secs p j) (h' j))
  have hΦ : ∀ p, Φ (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) = F p := fun p => rfl
  have inj : Function.Injective Φ := by
    intro a b hab
    induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ p => ?_
    induction b using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ p' => ?_
    change Φ (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) = Φ (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p') at hab
    change curveLimitMk R t x beta G p = curveLimitMk R t x beta G p'
    rw [hΦ, hΦ] at hab
    rw [curveLimitMk_eq_iff]; intro j
    have hj := congrArg (fun u : curveProductThreads D => u.val j) hab
    simp only [F] at hj
    have e1 := hEj j ⟨_, ⟨p.val j, secs p j, rfl⟩⟩ (p.val j) rfl
    have e2 := hEj j ⟨_, ⟨p'.val j, secs p' j, rfl⟩⟩ (p'.val j) rfl
    have := (Ej j).injective (e1.trans (hj.trans e2.symm))
    exact congrArg Subtype.val this
  have surj : Function.Surjective Φ := by
    intro u
    
    have hrep : ∀ j, ∃ r ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j,
        (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ r =
          (((Ej j).symm (u.val j) : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j) : _) :=
      fun j => ((Ej j).symm (u.val j)).2
    choose r hr hre using hrep
    have hs : ∀ j, sectionsToProduct D j (r j) = u.val j := by
      intro j
      rw [← hEj j ((Ej j).symm (u.val j)) (r j) (hre j).symm, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have mem : r ∈ curveThreads R t x beta G := by
      refine ⟨fun j _ => hr j, ?_⟩
      intro j _
      have e := hρ j ((Ej (j+1)).symm (u.val (j+1))) (r (j+1)) (hre (j+1)).symm
      have e2 := hEj j _ (r (j+1)) e
      rw [← red j (r (j+1)), hs (j+1), u.2 j, ← hs j] at e2
      have e3 := hEj j ((Ej j).symm (u.val j)) (r j) (hre j).symm
      have e4 : ρ j ((Ej (j+1)).symm (u.val (j+1))) = (Ej j).symm (u.val j) :=
        (Ej j).injective (by rw [e2, e3])
      have e5 : (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ (r (j+1)) =
          (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ (r j) := by
        rw [← e, e4, hre]
      rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at e5
      have e6 := (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).neg_mem e5
      rw [neg_sub] at e6
      change r j - r (j+1) ∈ _
      exact e6
    refine ⟨curveLimitMk R t x beta G ⟨r, mem⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hΦ]; apply Subtype.ext; funext j; exact hs j
  refine ⟨Equiv.ofBijective Φ ⟨inj, surj⟩, fun p j => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.sectionsToProduct_surface_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with i | k | l <;> rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.localSection_smul
statement:
private theorem localSection_smul (q : AllPoints D) (r : R) (c : ChartPair R t x) :
    localSection D q (r • c) = localFromSurface D q r * localSection D q c
proof:
:= by
  rw [show r • c = algebraMap R _ r * c from Algebra.smul_def r c, map_mul]
  congr 1
  rcases q with i | k | l <;> rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_order_equiv_linear
statement:
theorem child_order_equiv_linear (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R
    t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j)
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, IsLocalRing (localRing D p)] [∀ p : AllPoints D,
    IsNoetherianRing (localRing D p)] [∀ p : AllPoints D,
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)) (localRing D p)] (he : ∀ p : AllPoints
    D, localException D p ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)) (O : Type) [CommRing O]
    [Algebra O R] [∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p)] (hO : ∀ (p : AllPoints D) (o : O),
    localFromSurface D p (algebraMap O R o) = algebraMap O (localRing D p) o) :
    ∃ E : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G ≃ₗ[O] childOrder D, ∀ (p : curveThreads R t x beta G)
      (r : R), (∀ j : ℕ, p.val j = surfaceToChartPair R t x r) → E (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) =
      childOrderMap D r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E₁, hE₁⟩ := curve_limit_equiv_product_threads R t x beta D d G hG
  choose Φ hΦ using fun p => curve_quotient_complete_equiv_threads _ _ (localCurve D p) (he p)
  let E : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G ≃ childOrder D :=
    E₁.trans ((childThreadsEquiv D).trans (Equiv.piCongrRight fun p => (Φ p).symm))
  have key : ∀ u q j, ((Φ q) (E u q)).val j = (E₁ u).val j q := by
    intro u q j
    change ((Φ q) ((Φ q).symm _)).val j = _
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hmk : ∀ (p : curveThreads R t x beta G) q j,
      ((Φ q) (E (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) q)).val j =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (localSection D q (p.val j)) := by
    intro p q j
    rw [key, hE₁]
    rfl
  have hsurj : ∀ u : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G, ∃ p, curveLimitMk R t x beta G p = u :=
    Submodule.mkQ_surjective _
  have fadd : ∀ q j (y z : localRing D q ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D q}),
      ((Φ q) (y + z)).val j = ((Φ q) y).val j + ((Φ q) z).val j := by
    intro q j y z
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    rw [← map_add, hΦ, hΦ, hΦ, map_add]
  have fsmul : ∀ q j (a : localRing D q) (y : localRing D q ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D q})
      (s' : localRing D q),
      ((Φ q) y).val j = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s' →
      ((Φ q) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a * y)).val j = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (a * s') := by
    intro q j a y s' h
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    rw [← map_mul, hΦ, map_mul, map_mul, ← h, hΦ]
  have hadd : ∀ u v, E (u + v) = E u + E v := by
    intro u v
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hsurj u
    obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ := hsurj v
    funext q
    apply (Φ q).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    change ((Φ q) (E (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p + curveLimitMk R t x beta G p') q)).val j =
      ((Φ q) (E (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) q + E (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p') q)).val j
    rw [fadd, ← map_add, hmk, hmk, hmk, Submodule.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, map_add, map_add]
  have hsmulR : ∀ (r : R) u q,
      E (r • u) q = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (localFromSurface D q r) * E u q := by
    intro r u q
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hsurj u
    apply (Φ q).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    rw [fsmul _ _ _ _ _ (hmk p q j), ← map_smul, hmk, Submodule.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
      localSection_smul]
  refine ⟨{ E with map_add' := hadd, map_smul' := ?_ }, ?_⟩
  · intro o u
    change E (o • u) = o • E u
    rw [← algebraMap_smul R o u]
    funext q
    rw [hsmulR, hO]
    exact (Algebra.smul_def o (E u q)).symm
  · intro p r hp
    funext q
    change (Φ q).symm ((childThreadsEquiv D) (E₁ (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p)) q) = _
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    change (E₁ (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p)).val j q = _
    rw [hE₁, hp, sectionsToProduct_surface_eq]
    change _ = ((Φ q) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (localFromSurface D q r))).val j
    rw [hΦ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.glued_generators_of_two_chart_curve_data
statement:
theorem glued_generators_of_two_chart_curve_data (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta :
    BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (hregSwap :
    RegularParameterPair R x t) (d : ℕ) (FA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x) (hFA : ∀ j : ℕ, leftLevelKernel
    D j = Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^j) (FA j)}) (FB : ℕ →
    BlowupChart R x t) (hFB : ∀ j : ℕ, rightLevelKernel D j =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x})^j) (FB j)}) (hnorm : ∃ u : Rˣ,
    (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (FA 1) - algebraMap
    R (BlowupOverlap R t x) (u : R) * ((overlapSlope R t x)^d * beta.right (FB 1)) ∈
    (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})) :
    ∃ G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d, ∀ j : ℕ,
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} =
        rightLevelKernel D j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hLmax, hLinj, hLe⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal R t x beta D
  obtain ⟨hRmax, hRinj, hRe⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D
  have _ : ∀ s, (leftPoint D s).IsMaximal := hLmax
  have _ : ∀ s, (rightPoint D s).IsMaximal := hRmax
  have _ : (Ideal.span ({x,t} : Set R)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [Set.pair_comm]; infer_instance
  choose LA hLA using (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 1).2
  choose LB hLB using (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 1).2
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := glued_generators_exist R t x beta hreg d FA FB
    (fun j => finite_support_generators_compatible (BlowupChart R t x) _ (leftPoint D) hLinj
      (chartBase R t x t) (leftData D) LA hLA FA hFA j)
    (fun j => finite_support_generators_compatible (BlowupChart R x t) _ (rightPoint D) hRinj
      (chartBase R x t x) (rightData D) LB hLB FB hFB j)
    (fun j => finite_support_level_generator_regular R t x _ (leftPoint D) hLe (leftData D) LA hLA
      hreg FA hFA j)
    (fun j => finite_support_level_generator_regular R x t _ (rightPoint D) hRe (rightData D) LB hLB
      hregSwap FB hFB j)
    (fun j => two_chart_level_generators_agree_on_overlap R t x beta D FA hFA FB hFB j)
    (fun j => overlap_level_generator_regular R t x hreg hregSwap beta _ (rightPoint D) hRe
      (rightData D) LB hLB FB hFB j)
    hnorm
  exact ⟨G, fun j => ⟨(hG j).1.trans (hFA j).symm, (hG j).2.trans (hFB j).symm⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_right_point_equation
statement:
private theorem strict_transform_right_point_equation (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) [(Ideal.span
    ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)] [IsNoetherianRing
    (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (d : ℕ)
    (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk
    ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk
    ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j) (f : R) (hf : ∀ j : ℕ,
    surfaceToCechInput R t x j f = (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j)) (s
    : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf) [IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s))]
    (hereg : Function.Injective (fun a : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) =>
    (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x) * a)) (hgreg :
    Function.Injective (fun a : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) ⧸ Ideal.span
    {(completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x)} =>
    Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {(completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x)})
    (rightData D s) * a)) :
    ∃ v : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s))ˣ,
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) f)
