      = ((completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x))^d * rightData
      D s * (v : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmax, hinj, hmem⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D
  have : ∀ s, (rightPoint D s).IsMaximal := hmax
  exact strict_transform_equation_of_kernels (rightPoint D) hinj _ hmem (rightData D)
    (fun j => (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2) G.right
    (fun j => (curve_ideal_lattice_eq_kernels R t x beta D d G hG j).2) d _
    (glued_function_right_chart R t x beta d G f hf) s hereg hgreg

name: SurfaceBlowup.global_function_strict_transform_at_right_point
statement:
theorem global_function_strict_transform_at_right_point (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R
    t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span
    {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span
    {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j) (f : R) (hf
    : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f = (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t
    x G j)) (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf) [IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t)
    (rightPoint D s))] (hereg : Function.Injective (fun a :
    (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) =>
    (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x) * a)) (hgreg :
    Function.Injective (fun a : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) ⧸ Ideal.span
    {(completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x)} =>
    Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {(completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x)})
    (rightData D s) * a)) :
    strictTransformAt R x t (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {rightData D s}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := strict_transform_right_point_equation R t x beta D d G hG f hf s hereg hgreg
  unfold strictTransformAt
  rw [principal_ideal_image]
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  have hv' : completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s) (chartBase R x t f) =
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s) (chartBase R x t x)) ^ d *
        rightData D s * (v : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) := hv
  clear hv
  generalize completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s) (chartBase R x t x) = c at *
  generalize rightData D s = g at *
  generalize completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s) (chartBase R x t f) = y at *
  have hcd : Function.Injective (fun a => c ^ d * a) := IsLeftRegular.pow d hereg
  subst hv'
  have hu := v.mul_inv
  generalize (v⁻¹ : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s))ˣ).val = vi at hu
  generalize v.val = vv at hu ⊢
  ext u
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton', Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    have h1 : c ^ d * u = c ^ d * (w * vv * g) := by
      have : u * c ^ d = w * (c ^ d * g * vv) := hw.symm
      linear_combination this
    exact ⟨w * vv, (hcd h1).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w * vi, by
      calc _ = (w * g * c ^ d) * (vv * vi) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hu]; ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.injective_mul_of_span_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := regular_principal_generators_associated A f g
    (fun a b hab => hf (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hab)) h
  intro a b hab
  apply hf
  have : (u : A) * (f * a) = (u : A) * (f * b) := by
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← hu]; exact hab
  exact u.isUnit.mul_right_injective this

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_left_generators_regular_on_overlap
statement:
theorem two_chart_left_generators_regular_on_overlap (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R
    t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) (j : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j)) * c)
proof:
:= by
  have h788 := two_chart_level_generators_agree_on_overlap R t x beta D G.left
    (fun j => (hG j).1.symm) G.right (fun j => (hG j).2.symm) j
  obtain ⟨hmax, -, hbase⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D
  have _ : ∀ s, (rightPoint D s).IsMaximal := hmax
  obtain ⟨htr, hfin⟩ := two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 1
  have hreg2 := overlap_level_generator_regular R t x hreg hregSwap beta (D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf)
    (rightPoint D) hbase (rightData D) (fun s => (hfin s).choose) (fun s => (hfin s).choose_spec)
    G.right
    (fun j => (hG j).2.symm) j
  exact injective_mul_of_span_eq _ _ _ hreg2 h788.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_level_generators_exist
statement:
theorem two_chart_level_generators_exist (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] :
    (∃ FA : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x, ∀ j : ℕ, leftLevelKernel D j =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^j) (FA j)}) ∧ (∃ FB : ℕ →
      BlowupChart R x t, ∀ j : ℕ, rightLevelKernel D j =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x})^j) (FB j)})
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨hm, hinj, hte⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal R t x beta D
    have _ : ∀ s, (leftPoint D s).IsMaximal := hm
    exact finite_support_level_kernels_principal R t x (D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) (leftPoint D) hinj hte
      (leftData D)
      (fun s => (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 0).1 s)
      (fun j s => (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2 s)
  · have _ : (Ideal.span ({x,t} : Set R)).IsMaximal := by
      rw [Set.pair_comm]; infer_instance
    obtain ⟨hm, hinj, hte⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal R t x beta D
    have _ : ∀ s, (rightPoint D s).IsMaximal := hm
    exact finite_support_level_kernels_principal R x t (D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf) (rightPoint D) hinj hte
      (rightData D)
      (fun s => (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 0).1 s)
      (fun j s => (two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D j).2 s)

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_term_coker_map_representative
statement:
private theorem two_term_coker_map_representative (O : Type) [CommRing O] (A0 A1 B0 B1 : Type)
    [AddCommGroup A0] [Module O A0] [AddCommGroup A1] [Module O A1] [AddCommGroup B0] [Module O B0]
    [AddCommGroup B1] [Module O B1] (dA : A0 →ₗ[O] A1) (dB : B0 →ₗ[O] B1) (u0 : A0 →ₗ[O] B0)
    (u1 : A1 →ₗ[O] B1) (h : u1.comp dA = dB.comp u0) (a : A1) :
    twoTermCokerMap dA dB u0 u1 h ((LinearMap.range dA).mkQ a) = (LinearMap.range dB).mkQ (u1 a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_xO_eq
statement: private theorem layer_xO_eq : algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x x) = tO * z 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← blowup_chart_relation, map_mul]
  have := selfZPow_natCast (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) 1
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, pow_one] at this
  rw [this]

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_invSelf_pow
statement:
private theorem layer_invSelf_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x) : O) ^ n = z (-n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [selfZPow_neg_natCast, IsLocalization.Away.invSelf, ← IsLocalization.mk'_pow, one_pow]
  congr 1

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_slope_pow
statement: private theorem layer_slope_pow (n : ℕ) : (algebraMap A O (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n = z n
proof:
:=
  (selfZPow_natCast _ _ n).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_z_nat
statement: private theorem layer_z_nat (n : ℕ) : z (n:ℤ) = (z 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [selfZPow_natCast]; have := selfZPow_natCast (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) 1
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, pow_one] at this; rw [this]

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_tO_pow_mem
statement: private theorem layer_tO_pow_mem (j : ℕ) (o : O) : tO ^ j * o ∈ (Ideal.span {tO}) ^ j
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) j)

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_beta_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, beta.slope, layer_invSelf_pow]
  congr 1
  exact beta.right.commutes c

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_map_mem_of_slope_pows
statement:
private theorem layer_map_mem_of_slope_pows {Q : Type} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
    (Φ : O →ₗ[R] Q) (N : Submodule R Q) (z : ℤ → O)
    (hznat : ∀ n : ℕ, (algebraMap A O (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n = z n)
    (hzadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, z (a + b) = z a * z b) (hz0 : z 0 = 1) (hmono : ∀ ℓ : ℤ, Φ (z ℓ) ∈ N)
    (o : O) : Φ o ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj (chartSlope R t x) o
  have ho : o = algebraMap A O a * z (-(n:ℤ)) := by
    rw [← ha, hznat, mul_assoc, ← hzadd]; simp [hz0]
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  rw [ho]
  clear ha ho
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, add_mul, map_add]; exact add_mem hp hq
  | monomial m c =>
    have : algebraMap A O (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Polynomial.monomial m c)) * z (-(n:ℤ)) =
        c • z (m + -(n:ℤ)) := by
      rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul (Ideal.Quotient.mk _),
        map_pow (Ideal.Quotient.mk _), hzadd, ← hznat, Algebra.smul_def]
      change algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x c * chartSlope R t x ^ m) * _ =
        algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x c) * _
      rw [map_mul, map_pow]; ring
    rw [this, map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hmono _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_span_le_ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro c hc
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
  rw [← map_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
  rcases hc with h | h <;> (try rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h) <;> rw [h]
  · exact hΦt e
  · change Φ (algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x x) * e) = 0
    rw [layer_xO_eq, mul_assoc]; exact hΦt _

name: SurfaceBlowup.principalLayerMap_tO_apply
statement:
private theorem principalLayerMap_tO_apply (j : ℕ) (a : O) :
    principalLayerMap O tO j a = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (tO ^ j * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_left_laurent_lift
statement:
private theorem layer_left_laurent_lift (j : ℕ) (z : ℤ → O)
    (hznat : ∀ n : ℕ, (algebraMap A O (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n = z n)
    (L : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer O tO j)
    (hL : ∀ r : R, ∀ ell : ℤ, (L (LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T ell)).val = principalLayerMap O tO j (algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x r) *
        z ell))
    (p : Polynomial R) :
    ∃ F : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}), (∀ ℓ : ℤ, ℓ < 0 → F.coeff ℓ = 0) ∧
      (L F).val = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (tO ^ j * algebraMap A O (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p))
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨F1, h1, e1⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨F2, h2, e2⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨F1 + F2, fun ℓ hℓ => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, h1 ℓ hℓ, h2 ℓ hℓ, add_zero]
    · rw [map_add, Submodule.coe_add, e1, e2, map_add, map_add, mul_add, map_add]
  | monomial m c =>
    refine ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ c) * LaurentPolynomial.T m, fun ℓ hℓ => ?_,
      ?_⟩
    · rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
        Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (by omega)]
    · have hmonoA : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {blowupRelation R t x}) (Polynomial.monomial m c)
          = chartBase R t x c * chartSlope R t x ^ m := by
        rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul, map_pow]; rfl
      rw [hL, principalLayerMap_tO_apply, hmonoA, map_mul (algebraMap _ _),
        map_pow (algebraMap _ _), hznat]

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_right_laurent_lift
statement:
private theorem layer_right_laurent_lift (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) (z : ℤ → O)
    (hzadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, z (a + b) = z a * z b)
    (hbeta : ∀ (c : R) (n : ℕ), beta.right (chartBase R x t c * chartSlope R x t ^ n) =
      algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x c) * z (-(n:ℤ)))
    (L : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer O tO j)
    (hL : ∀ r : R, ∀ ell : ℤ, (L (LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T ell)).val = principalLayerMap O tO j (algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x r) *
        z ell))
    (q : Polynomial R) :
    ∃ F : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}), (∀ ℓ : ℤ, (j:ℤ) - d < ℓ → F.coeff ℓ = 0) ∧
      (L F).val = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (tO ^ j * (z ((j:ℤ) - d) *
        beta.right (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q)))
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨F1, h1, e1⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨F2, h2, e2⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨F1 + F2, fun ℓ hℓ => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, h1 ℓ hℓ, h2 ℓ hℓ, add_zero]
    · rw [map_add, Submodule.coe_add, e1, e2, map_add, map_add, mul_add, mul_add, map_add]
  | monomial m c =>
    refine ⟨LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ c) * LaurentPolynomial.T ((j:ℤ) - d - m),
      fun ℓ hℓ => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
        Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (by omega)]
    · have hmonoB : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {blowupRelation R x t}) (Polynomial.monomial m c)
          = chartBase R x t c * chartSlope R x t ^ m := by
        rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul, map_pow]; rfl
      rw [hL, principalLayerMap_tO_apply, hmonoB, hbeta,
        show (j:ℤ) - d - m = ((j:ℤ) - d) + -(m:ℤ) by ring, hzadd]
      congr 1; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_slope_pow_mem
statement:
private theorem layer_slope_pow_mem (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) {Q : Type}
    [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] (Φ : O →ₗ[R] Q) (N : Submodule R Q) (z : ℤ → O)
    (hznat : ∀ n : ℕ, (algebraMap A O (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n = z n)
    (hzadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, z (a + b) = z a * z b) (hz1 : ∀ n : ℕ, z n = z 1 ^ n)
    (hinv : ∀ n : ℕ, (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x) : O) ^ n = z (-n))
    (hxO : algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x x) = tO * z 1)
    (hbeta : ∀ (c : R) (n : ℕ), beta.right (chartBase R x t c * chartSlope R x t ^ n) =
      algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x c) * z (-(n:ℤ)))
    (hΦD : ∀ (o : O) (w : A × BlowupChart R x t), tO ^ j * o = fullCechDifferential R t x beta d w →
      Φ o = 0)
    (hwin : ∀ a : ℕ, a < d - j - 1 → Φ (z (-(a:ℤ) - 1)) ∈ N) (ℓ : ℤ) : Φ (z ℓ) ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  have hDab : ∀ a b, fullCechDifferential R t x beta d (a, b) = algebraMap A O a -
      (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))^d * beta.right b := fun _ _ => rfl
  by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ ℓ
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le h0
    have : tO ^ j * z n = fullCechDifferential R t x beta d
        ((chartBase R t x t)^j * chartSlope R t x ^ n, 0) := by
      rw [hDab, map_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hznat]
    rw [hΦD _ _ this]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  by_cases h1 : ℓ ≤ (j:ℤ) - d
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (show 0 ≤ (j:ℤ) - d - ℓ by omega)
    have : tO ^ j * z ℓ = fullCechDifferential R t x beta d
        (0, -(chartBase R x t x ^ j * chartSlope R x t ^ s)) := by
      rw [hDab, map_zero, zero_sub, map_neg, mul_neg, neg_neg, ← map_pow (chartBase R x t) x j,
        hbeta, hinv, map_pow, map_pow, hxO]
      rw [show ℓ = -(d:ℤ) + j + -(s:ℤ) by omega, hzadd, hzadd, hz1]
      ring
    rw [hΦD _ _ this]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · push Not at h0 h1
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (show 0 ≤ -ℓ - 1 by omega)
    rw [show ℓ = -(a:ℤ) - 1 by omega]
    exact hwin a (by omega)

name: SurfaceBlowup.laurent_window_coeffs_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem laurent_window_coeffs_eq_zero {K : Type} [CommRing K] (d j : ℕ)
    (FA FB : LaurentPolynomial K) (hFA0 : ∀ ℓ : ℤ, ℓ < 0 → FA.coeff ℓ = 0)
    (hFB0 : ∀ ℓ : ℤ, (j:ℤ) - d < ℓ → FB.coeff ℓ = 0) (v : Fin (d-j-1) → K)
    (hF : FA = FB + ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), LaurentPolynomial.C (v a) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1)) (a : Fin (d-j-1)) : v a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlt := a.isLt
  have := congrArg (fun F : LaurentPolynomial K => F.coeff (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1)) hF
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hFA0 _ (by omega), hFB0 _ (by omega),
    zero_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single a] at this
  · rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
      Finsupp.single_eq_same] at this
    exact this.symm
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
      if_neg]
    intro h; apply hb; ext; omega
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_window_sum_eq
statement:
private theorem layer_window_sum_eq {j : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (z : ℤ → O)
    (L : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer O tO j)
    (hL : ∀ r : R, ∀ ell : ℤ, (L (LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T ell)).val = principalLayerMap O tO j (algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x r) *
        z ell))
    (v' : Fin (d-j-1) → R) :
    (L (∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) (v' a)) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1))).val =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (tO ^ j * ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), v' a • z (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum, Submodule.coe_sum, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [hL, principalLayerMap_tO_apply, Algebra.smul_def]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_window_coeffs_eq_zero_of_layer_eq
statement:
private theorem layer_window_coeffs_eq_zero_of_layer_eq (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ)
    (z : ℤ → O) (hznat : ∀ n : ℕ, (algebraMap A O (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n = z n)
    (hzadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, z (a + b) = z a * z b)
    (hbeta : ∀ (c : R) (n : ℕ), beta.right (chartBase R x t c * chartSlope R x t ^ n) =
      algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x c) * z (-(n:ℤ)))
    (L : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer O tO j)
    (hL : ∀ r : R, ∀ ell : ℤ, (L (LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T ell)).val = principalLayerMap O tO j (algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x r) *
        z ell))
    (v' : Fin (d-j-1) → R) (p q : Polynomial R)
    (hq : tO ^ j * (algebraMap A O (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) -
        z ((j:ℤ) - d) * beta.right (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q)) -
      tO ^ j * ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), v' a • z (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1) ∈ (Ideal.span {tO}) ^ (j+1))
    (a : Fin (d-j-1)) : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) (v' a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨FA, hFA0, hFA⟩ := layer_left_laurent_lift j z hznat L hL p
  obtain ⟨FB, hFB0, hFB⟩ := layer_right_laurent_lift beta d j z hzadd hbeta L hL q
  have hFG := layer_window_sum_eq d z L hL v'
  set FG := ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) (v' a)) *
    LaurentPolynomial.T (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1)
  have heq : L FA = L (FB + FG) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [map_add, Submodule.coe_add, hFA, hFB, hFG, ← map_add, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    convert hq using 1; ring
  exact laurent_window_coeffs_eq_zero d j FA FB hFA0 hFB0 _ (L.injective heq) a

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_window_coeffs_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
private theorem layer_window_coeffs_eq_zero_of_mem (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) (d j : ℕ) (hj : j < d)
    (hnow : cechInputLattice R t x j ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (z : ℤ → O) (hznat : ∀ n : ℕ, (algebraMap A O (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n = z n)
    (hzadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, z (a + b) = z a * z b) (hz1 : ∀ n : ℕ, z n = z 1 ^ n)
    (hinv : ∀ n : ℕ, (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x) : O) ^ n = z (-n))
    (hxO : algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x x) = tO * z 1)
    (hbeta : ∀ (c : R) (n : ℕ), beta.right (chartBase R x t c * chartSlope R x t ^ n) =
      algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x c) * z (-(n:ℤ)))
    (L : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer O tO j)
    (hL : ∀ r : R, ∀ ell : ℤ, (L (LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T ell)).val = principalLayerMap O tO j (algebraMap A O (chartBase R t x r) *
        z ell))
    (v' : Fin (d-j-1) → R) (w : A × BlowupChart R x t)
    (hq : fullCechDifferential R t x beta d w -
      tO ^ j * ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), v' a • z (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1) ∈ (Ideal.span {tO}) ^ (j+1))
    (a : Fin (d-j-1)) : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) (v' a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set G := ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), v' a • z (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1)
  have hw0 : finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow (Submodule.Quotient.mk w) = 0 := by
    change Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := cechOutputLattice R t x j)
      (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d w) = 0
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    change _ ∈ (Ideal.span {tO}) ^ j
    rw [← sub_add_cancel (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d w) (tO ^ j * G)]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ j) hq) (layer_tO_pow_mem R t x j G)
  have hw : Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := cechInputLattice R t x j) w = 0 :=
    actual_negative_twist_kernel_zero R t x hreg beta hregSwap d j hj.le hnow
      (hw0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hw
  obtain ⟨w1, w2⟩ := w
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hw
  change w1 ∈ (Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t}) ^ j at h1
  change w2 ∈ (Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x}) ^ j at h2
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at h1 h2
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := h2
  have hDab : ∀ a b, fullCechDifferential R t x beta d (a, b) = algebraMap A O a -
      (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))^d * beta.right b := fun _ _ => rfl
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a'
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b'
  have hbx : beta.right (chartBase R x t x) = tO * z 1 := (beta.right.commutes x).trans hxO
  have hDw : fullCechDifferential R t x beta d
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p * chartBase R t x t ^ j,
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q * chartBase R x t x ^ j) =
      tO ^ j * (algebraMap A O (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) -
        z ((j:ℤ) - d) * beta.right (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q)) := by
    rw [hDab, map_mul, map_mul beta.right, map_pow beta.right, hbx, hinv, map_pow,
      show (j:ℤ) - d = -(d:ℤ) + j by ring, hzadd, hz1]
    ring
  rw [hDw] at hq
  exact layer_window_coeffs_eq_zero_of_layer_eq beta d j z hznat hzadd hbeta L hL v' p q hq a

name: SurfaceBlowup.window_mem_range
statement:
private theorem window_mem_range {R M Q : Type} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] {I : Ideal R} {n : ℕ} (i : (Fin n → R ⧸ I) →ₗ[R] Q)
    (Φ : M →ₗ[R] Q) (w : Fin n → M)
    (hi : ∀ v : Fin n → R, i (fun a => Ideal.Quotient.mk I (v a)) = Φ (∑ a, v a • w a))
    (a : Fin n) : Φ (w a) ∈ LinearMap.range i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun b => Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((Pi.single a (1:R) : Fin n → R) b), ?_⟩
  rw [hi, Finset.sum_eq_single a]
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_same, one_smul]
  · intro b _ hb; rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hb, zero_smul]
  · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_layer_window_map
statement:
private theorem exists_layer_window_map (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) (hnext : cechInputLattice R t x (j + 1) ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)) :
    ∃ i : (Fin (d-j-1) → (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x})) →ₗ[R] (CechLevelOutput R t x (j+1) ⧸
      LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext)),
      (∀ v : Fin (d-j-1) → R, i (fun a => Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (v a)) =
        (LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext)).mkQ
          ((cechOutputLattice R t x (j+1)).mkQ
            (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ^ j *
              ∑ a, v a • selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (-((a:ℕ):ℤ)-1)))) ∧
      ∀ o : BlowupOverlap R t x,
        (LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext)).mkQ
          ((cechOutputLattice R t x (j+1)).mkQ
            (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ^ j * o)) ∈
          LinearMap.range i
proof:
:= by
  set D := fullCechDifferential R t x beta d with hD
  set D1 := finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext with hD1
  set tO := algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) with htO
  have hxO := layer_xO_eq R t x
  have hinv := layer_invSelf_pow R t x
  have hznat : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n =
      selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) n := layer_slope_pow R t x
  have hz1 := layer_z_nat R t x
  have hzadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (a + b) =
      selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a *
        selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) b :=
    fun a b => selfZPow_add _ _
  have hz0 := selfZPow_zero (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
  have hbeta := layer_beta_right R t x beta
  set z := selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
  clear_value z
  set Q := CechLevelOutput R t x (j+1) ⧸ LinearMap.range D1
  let ψ := layerCokerProj R t x beta d j hnext
  let Φ := ψ ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft R (tO ^ j)
  have hΦ : ∀ o, Φ o = ψ (tO ^ j * o) := fun o => rfl
  have hψD : ∀ w, ψ (D w) = 0 := by
    intro w
    change (LinearMap.range D1).mkQ (D1 (Submodule.Quotient.mk w)) = 0
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦt : ∀ o, Φ (tO * o) = 0 := by
    intro o
    rw [hΦ]
    change (LinearMap.range D1).mkQ (Submodule.Quotient.mk _) = 0
    rw [(Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2, map_zero]
    change _ ∈ (Ideal.span {tO}) ^ (j+1)
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
    exact layer_tO_pow_mem R t x (j+1) o
  have hI := layer_span_le_ker Φ hΦt
  let i : (Fin (d-j-1) → (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x})) →ₗ[R] Q :=
    ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), (Submodule.liftQ (Ideal.span {t,x})
      (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R Q (Φ (z (-((a:ℕ):ℤ)-1)))) (hI _)) ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj a
  have hi : ∀ v : Fin (d-j-1) → R, i (fun a => Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (v a)) =
      Φ (∑ a, v a • z (-((a:ℕ):ℤ)-1)) := by
    intro v
    simp only [i, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, map_sum,
      map_smul]
    rfl
  have hmono : ∀ ℓ : ℤ, Φ (z ℓ) ∈ LinearMap.range i := by
    refine layer_slope_pow_mem beta d j Φ _ z hznat hzadd hz1 hinv hxO hbeta
      (fun o w h => by rw [hΦ, h, hψD]) fun a har =>
        window_mem_range i Φ (fun b : Fin (d-j-1) => z (-((b:ℕ):ℤ)-1)) hi ⟨a, har⟩
  exact ⟨i, hi, layer_map_mem_of_slope_pows Φ _ z hznat hzadd hz0 hmono⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.layer_coker_exact_of_range
statement:
private theorem layer_coker_exact_of_range (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) (hnext : cechInputLattice R t x (j + 1) ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (hnow : cechInputLattice R t x j ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (hcomm : (cechOutputReduction R t x j).comp
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext) =
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow).comp (cechInputReduction R t x j))
    {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (i : M →ₗ[R] (CechLevelOutput R t x (j + 1) ⧸
      LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext)))
    (hall : ∀ o : BlowupOverlap R t x,
      (LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext)).mkQ
        ((cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).mkQ
          (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ^ j * o)) ∈
        LinearMap.range i)
    (hi0 : ∀ v, ∃ o : BlowupOverlap R t x,
      i v = (LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext)).mkQ
        ((cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).mkQ
          (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ^ j * o))) :
    Function.Exact i (twoTermCokerMap (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext)
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow) (cechInputReduction R t x j)
      (cechOutputReduction R t x j) hcomm)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨fun hy => ?_, ?_⟩
  swap
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := hi0 v
    rw [ho]
    refine (two_term_coker_map_representative R _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hcomm _).trans ?_
    change (LinearMap.range _).mkQ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := cechOutputLattice R t x j)
      (_ ^ j * o)) = 0
    rw [(Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2, map_zero]
    exact layer_tO_pow_mem R t x j o
  let ψ := layerCokerProj R t x beta d j hnext
  have hψD : ∀ w, ψ (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d w) = 0 := fun w =>
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk w, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y1, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  obtain ⟨y0, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y1
  have hred : twoTermCokerMap (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext)
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow) (cechInputReduction R t x j)
      (cechOutputReduction R t x j) hcomm (ψ y0) =
      (LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow)).mkQ
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk y0) :=
    two_term_coker_map_representative R _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hcomm _
  change twoTermCokerMap _ _ _ _ hcomm (ψ y0) = 0 at hy
  rw [hred, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hy
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d w) =
    Submodule.Quotient.mk y0 at hq
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq] at hq
  change _ ∈ (Ideal.span {algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
    (chartBase R t x t)}) ^ j at hq
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hq
  obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := hq
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hall (-o)
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  rw [hv]
  change ψ (_ ^ j * -o) = ψ y0
  rw [show y0 = fullCechDifferential R t x beta d w +
    (-o) * algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ^ j by
      linear_combination ho, map_add, hψD, zero_add, mul_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.actual_negative_layer_coker_exact
statement:
theorem actual_negative_layer_coker_exact (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (hreg :
    RegularParameterPair R t x) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R
    x t) (d j : ℕ) (hj : j < d) (hnext : cechInputLattice R t x (j + 1) ≤
    (cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)) (hnow :
    cechInputLattice R t x j ≤
    (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)) (hcomm :
    (cechOutputReduction R t x j).comp (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext) =
    (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow).comp (cechInputReduction R t x j)) :
    ∃ i : (Fin (d-j-1) → (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x})) →ₗ[R] (CechLevelOutput R t x (j+1) ⧸
      LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext)), Function.Injective i ∧
      Function.Exact i (twoTermCokerMap (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext)
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow) (cechInputReduction R t x j)
      (cechOutputReduction R t x j) hcomm)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set D := fullCechDifferential R t x beta d with hD
  set D1 := finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext with hD1
  set D0 := finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow with hD0
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hall⟩ := exists_layer_window_map R t x beta d j hnext
  set tO := algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) with htO
  have hxO := layer_xO_eq R t x
  have hinv := layer_invSelf_pow R t x
  have hznat : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) ^ n =
      selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) n := layer_slope_pow R t x
  have hz1 := layer_z_nat R t x
  have hzadd : ∀ a b : ℤ, selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (a + b) =
      selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a *
        selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) b :=
    fun a b => selfZPow_add _ _
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := overlap_layer_laurent_coordinates R t x hreg j
  have hbeta := layer_beta_right R t x beta
  set z := selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
  clear_value z
  have hmemO : ∀ (n : ℕ) (o : BlowupOverlap R t x),
      o ∈ cechOutputLattice R t x n ↔ o ∈ (Ideal.span {tO}) ^ n :=
    fun _ _ => Iff.rfl
  have hlift : ∀ v : Fin (d-j-1) → (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}), ∃ v' : Fin (d-j-1) → R,
      (fun a => Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (v' a)) = v :=
    fun v => ⟨fun a => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (v a)).choose,
      funext fun a => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (v a)).choose_spec⟩
  refine ⟨i, ?_, layer_coker_exact_of_range R t x beta d j hnext hnow hcomm i hall fun v => ?_⟩
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨v', rfl⟩ := hlift v
    rw [hi] at hv
    set G := ∑ a : Fin (d-j-1), v' a • z (-((a:ℕ):ℤ) - 1) with hG
    change (LinearMap.range D1).mkQ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (tO ^ j * G)) = 0 at hv
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hv
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hv
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
    change Submodule.Quotient.mk (D w) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (tO ^ j * G) at hq
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, hmemO] at hq
    funext a
    exact layer_window_coeffs_eq_zero_of_mem hreg beta hregSwap d j hj hnow z hznat hzadd hz1 hinv
      hxO hbeta L hL v' w hq a
  · obtain ⟨v', rfl⟩ := hlift v
    exact ⟨_, hi v'⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_term_coker_map_surjective
statement:
theorem two_term_coker_map_surjective (O : Type) [CommRing O] (A0 A1 B0 B1 : Type) [AddCommGroup A0]
    [Module O A0] [AddCommGroup A1] [Module O A1] [AddCommGroup B0] [Module O B0] [AddCommGroup B1]
    [Module O B1] (dA : A0 →ₗ[O] A1) (dB : B0 →ₗ[O] B1) (u0 : A0 →ₗ[O] B0) (u1 : A1 →ₗ[O] B1)
    (h : u1.comp dA = dB.comp u0) (hu1 : Function.Surjective u1) :
    Function.Surjective (twoTermCokerMap dA dB u0 u1 h)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.range dB) y
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hu1 b
  exact ⟨(LinearMap.range dA).mkQ a, rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.count_normalizedFactors_divisorAffinePolynomial
statement:
theorem count_normalizedFactors_divisorAffinePolynomial (k : Type) [Field k]
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k) (lc : k) (hlc : lc ≠ 0) (φ : AffineDirection k) :
    Multiset.count φ.val (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
        (Polynomial.C lc * divisorAffinePolynomial k Dv)) = Dv (some φ) ∧
        (φ.val ∣ divisorAffinePolynomial k Dv ↔ 0 < Dv (some φ))
proof:
:= by
  set g : ClosedDirection k → ℕ → Polynomial k :=
    fun P r => match P with | none => 1 | some phi => phi.val ^ r with hg
  have hg0 : ∀ P, g P 0 = 1 := by intro P; cases P <;> simp [hg]
  set r := Dv (some φ) with hr
  set Q := (Dv.erase (some φ)).prod g with hQ
  have hG : divisorAffinePolynomial k Dv = φ.val ^ r * Q :=
    (Finsupp.mul_prod_erase' Dv (some φ) g hg0).symm
  have hirr : Irreducible φ.val := φ.2.2
  have hprime : Prime φ.val := hirr.prime
  have hnQ : ¬ φ.val ∣ Q := by
    intro h
    rw [hQ, Finsupp.prod, hprime.dvd_finsetProd_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hd⟩ := h
    have hPne : P ≠ some φ := by rintro rfl; simp at hP
    cases P with
    | none => exact hirr.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_unit hd isUnit_one)
    | some ψ =>
      exact hPne (congrArg some (Subtype.ext (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated φ.2.1 ψ.2.1
        (hirr.associated_of_dvd ψ.2.2 (hprime.dvd_of_dvd_pow hd)))).symm)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply UniqueFactorizationMonoid.count_normalizedFactors_eq hirr (φ.2.1.normalize_eq_self)
    · rw [hG]; exact Dvd.intro (Polynomial.C lc * Q) (by ring)
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      rw [hG, pow_succ, mul_assoc] at hc
      have h3 : φ.val ∣ Polynomial.C lc * Q :=
        ⟨c, mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero r hirr.ne_zero) (by rw [← hc]; ring)⟩
      rcases hprime.dvd_or_dvd h3 with h | h
      · exact hirr.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_unit h (Polynomial.isUnit_C.mpr
          (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hlc)))
      · exact hnQ h
  · refine ⟨fun h ↦ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 ↦ hnQ ?_,
      fun h ↦ hG ▸ dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_pow_self _ h.ne') _⟩
    rwa [hG, h0, pow_zero, one_mul] at h

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_strict_transform_reduction_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem concrete_strict_transform_reduction_ne_zero (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (FA : (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b))) (hne : Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) FA ≠
    0) (P : Ideal (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b))) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : (chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P) : ∃ (O' : Type) (_ : CommRing O') (_ : IsDomain O')
    (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing O') (_ : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O') O')
    (_ : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O')) (pi' : O') (u' : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) (a' b' : ℕ),
    Irreducible pi' ∧ 0 < a' ∧ ∃ (Eq : CompletedLocalAt
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ≃+*
    ConcreteSurface O' pi' u' a' b') (q : (ConcreteSurface O' pi' u' a' b' ⧸ Ideal.span
    {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) ≃+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O')), Eq
    (completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (surfaceT O pi u a b))) = surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b' ∧ q
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'})
    (Eq (completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P FA))) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isLocalRing O pi u a b hpi.not_isUnit ha
  have hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) =
      Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set _) :=
    concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set _)).IsMaximal :=
    hm ▸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _
  obtain ⟨e0, he0, he0Z⟩ := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
  let iso : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} :
      Set _)) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hm.symm
  let e := e0.trans (Polynomial.mapEquiv iso)
  have he : ∀ r, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartBase _ _ _ r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r) := fun r ↦ by
    simp only [e, RingEquiv.trans_apply, he0, Polynomial.mapEquiv_apply, Polynomial.map_C]
    rfl
  have heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartSlope _ _ _)) = Polynomial.X := by simp [e, he0Z]
  obtain ⟨φ, hmon, hirr, hPφ, -, -⟩ :=
    blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b) e0 he0 he0Z P hP
  have hφ' : (φ.map iso.toRingHom).Monic ∧ Irreducible (φ.map iso.toRingHom) :=
    ⟨hmon.map _, (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff (Polynomial.mapEquiv iso)).mpr hirr⟩
  have hPφ' : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)).map e = Ideal.span {φ.map iso.toRingHom} := by
    have h1 : ∀ J : Ideal _, Ideal.map e J =
        Ideal.map (Polynomial.mapEquiv iso) (Ideal.map e0 J) := fun J ↦ by
      change Ideal.map e.toRingHom J =
        Ideal.map (Polynomial.mapEquiv iso).toRingHom (Ideal.map e0.toRingHom J)
      rw [Ideal.map_map]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hPφ, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨O', i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', Eq, q, ι, alphaBar, hT, -, hF⟩ :=
    concrete_strict_transform_residue_series O pi hpi u a b ha P hP e he heZ _ hφ' hPφ'
  refine ⟨O', i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', Eq, q, hT, ?_⟩
  rw [hF FA, Ne, Polynomial.coe_eq_zero_iff, ← Polynomial.taylor_apply]
  simpa [Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff ι.injective] using hne

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_strict_transform_transverse_finite
statement:
theorem concrete_strict_transform_transverse_finite (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (FA : (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b))) (hne : Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) FA ≠
    0) (P : Ideal (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b))) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : (chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P) : Function.Injective
    (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ⧸ Ideal.span {completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P FA} =>
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P FA})
    (completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (surfaceT O pi u a b))) * w) ∧ Function.Injective
    (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ⧸ Ideal.span {completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (surfaceT O pi u a b))} => Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (surfaceT O pi u a b))})
    (completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P FA) * w) ∧ ∃ L : ℕ,
    ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
    (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)))^L ≤ finiteLocalCurveIdeal
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (surfaceT O pi u a b)) (completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P FA)
    1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hN, hD, hL, hC⟩ := concrete_left_point_completion_instances O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  have hreg := concrete_left_point_exceptional_regular O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  obtain ⟨O', c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', Eq, q, hEq, hq⟩ :=
    concrete_strict_transform_reduction_ne_zero O pi hpi u a b ha FA hne P hP
  let e1 := Ideal.quotientEquiv (Ideal.span {completedPointMap _ P
    (chartBase _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))})
    (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) Eq (by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; exact congrArg (Ideal.span {·}) hEq.symm)
  obtain ⟨k1, k2, L, hL'⟩ := transverse_of_reduction_ne_zero _ _ _ hreg
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') (e1.trans q) hq
  refine ⟨k1, k2, L, ?_⟩
  rw [finiteLocalCurveIdeal, pow_one]
  convert hL' using 2
  all_goals exact (AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map (R := Localization.AtPrime P)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.order_coe_polynomial
statement:
private theorem order_coe_polynomial {K : Type} [Field K] (H : Polynomial K) (hH : H ≠ 0) :
    (H : PowerSeries K).order = (H.natTrailingDegree : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.order_eq_nat]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe]
    exact mt Polynomial.trailingCoeff_eq_zero.mp hH
  · intro i hi
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe]
    exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_natTrailingDegree hi

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_strict_transform_multiplicity
statement:
theorem concrete_strict_transform_multiplicity (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (d + 1) → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {(surfaceT O pi u a b), (surfaceX O pi u a b)})
    [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b))) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : (chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P) (e : ((BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ⧸ chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b))) = Polynomial.X) (φ : Polynomial
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) (hφ : φ.Monic ∧ Irreducible φ)
    (hPφ : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)))).map e = Ideal.span {φ}) : Module.length
    (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P) (CompletedLocalAt
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ⧸
    Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (c i) *
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))^i.val),
    completedPointMap (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) P ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (surfaceT O pi u a b))}) =
    (Multiset.count φ (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
    (∑ i : Fin (d+1), Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (c i)) *
    Polynomial.X^i.val : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))) :
    ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have h461 := concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha
  obtain ⟨e0, -⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  let κ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField O :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq h461).trans e0
  have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) :=
    Finite.of_equiv _ κ.symm.toEquiv
  obtain ⟨O', i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', Eq, q, ι, alphaBar, hT, hroot, hF⟩ :=
    concrete_strict_transform_residue_series O pi hpi u a b ha P hP e he heZ φ hφ hPφ
  set FA := (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
      (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) (c i) *
      (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))^i.val)
  set Fbar :=
      (∑ i : Fin (d+1), Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (c i)) *
      Polynomial.X^i.val : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
  have hred : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ FA) = Fbar := by
    simp only [FA, Fbar, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, heZ]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [← he (c i)]; rfl
  have hFne : Fbar ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
    intro h0
    have hc := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p i.val) h0
    simp only [Fbar, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj => if_neg fun hji => hj (Fin.ext hji.symm))
      (by simp)] at hc
    exact hi (by rw [← h461, ← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]; simpa using hc :
      c i ∈ surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b)
  have hL := (concrete_surface_equiv_curve_length_and_regular _ O' pi' u' a' b' Eq q
    (completedPointMap _ P FA)).1
  rw [show Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b') = completedPointMap _ P (chartBase _ _ _
    (surfaceT O pi u a b)) by rw [← hT, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]] at hL
  rw [hL, hF FA, hred]
  have hH : (Fbar.map ι).comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C alphaBar) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Polynomial.taylor_apply]
    simpa [Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff ι.injective] using hFne
  rw [order_coe_polynomial _ hH, ← Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree,
    rootMultiplicity_map_eq_count_normalizedFactors _ _ ι Fbar hFne φ hφ alphaBar hroot]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_mapsTo_child_ideals
statement:
theorem strict_transform_mapsTo_child_ideals (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hS : S.t = (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∧ S.x = (surfaceX O pi u a b) ∧ S.a = a ∧ S.b = b)
    (e : ((BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ⧸
    chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ≃+*
    Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) r)) =
    Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
    Polynomial.X) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (hinf : (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsPrime) (s : State) (d : ℕ) :
    Set.MapsTo (fun J Q => divisorStrictTransform (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf d J Q)
      (fixedTangentCell O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S s d Dv)
      (Set.pi Set.univ
      (childIdealSet (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv
      hinf s d))
proof:
:= by
  intro J hJ
  obtain ⟨f, c, H, hJf, hc, hH, hcH, hne⟩ :=
    fixed_tangent_cell_generator_coefficients O _ S s d Dv J hJ
  obtain ⟨hSt, hSx, -, hSb⟩ := hS
  rw [hSt, hSx] at hc hne
  have hstate := hJ.1
  subst hJf
  have hHBAR := reduced_form_eq_of_residue_coeff _ d c H hH.2.1 hcH
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set _)).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hinfmax := infinity_point_maximal O _ S
  rw [hSt, hSx] at hinfmax
  have : (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsMaximal := hinfmax.1
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ℓ : ℕ∞), (n : ℕ∞) = d + ℓ → ℓ = ((n - d : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    intro n ℓ h
    lift ℓ to ℕ using (by rintro rfl; simp at h)
    norm_cast at h ⊢
    omega
  have hT : Module.length (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸
      (Ideal.span {f} ⊔ Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b})) = (stateContactT s : ℕ∞) := by
    obtain ⟨_, _, hm⟩ := hstate
    cases s with
    | single a' c' => rw [← hSt]; exact hm.2.2
    | crossing a' b' c' h' => rw [← hSt]; exact hm.2.2.1
  have hdir := directionPoint_properties _ _ _ e he heZ
  rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
  rintro ⟨_ | φ, hQ⟩
  · have := (hdir.1 (zeroAffine _)).1
    have hmul := concrete_infinity_strict_transform_multiplicity O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne _
      hinfmax.2.1 hinfmax.2.2.1
    rw [hHBAR, Ideal.span_insert, ← hH.2.2.1] at hmul
    simp only [childIdealSet, divisorStrictTransform]
    rw [(concrete_strict_transform_generators O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hc _
      (hdir.1 (zeroAffine _)).2.1 _ hinfmax.2.1 hinfmax.2.2.1).2]
    exact ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hmul, fun _ ↦ key _ _ (hT.symm.trans (concrete_infinity_boundary_contact
      O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hc _ hinfmax.2.1 hinfmax.2.2.1)),
      fun h ↦ absurd h (by simp [zeroDirection])⟩
  · have := (hdir.1 φ).1
    have hmul := concrete_strict_transform_multiplicity O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne _
      (hdir.1 φ).2.1 e he heZ φ.val φ.property (hdir.1 φ).2.2.2
    rw [hHBAR, hH.2.2.2, (count_normalizedFactors_divisorAffinePolynomial _ Dv _
      (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hH.1) φ).1, Ideal.span_insert] at hmul
    simp only [childIdealSet, divisorStrictTransform]
    rw [(concrete_strict_transform_generators O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hc _ (hdir.1 φ).2.1 _
      hinfmax.2.1 hinfmax.2.2.1).1]
    refine ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hmul, fun h ↦ absurd h (by simp), fun hz h hsh ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : φ = zeroAffine _ := Option.some.inj hz
    obtain ⟨_, hv, hm⟩ := hstate
    cases s with
    | single a' c' => simp [stateContactX] at hsh
    | crossing a' b' c' h' =>
      simp only [stateContactX, Option.some.injEq] at hsh
      subst hsh
      have hb : 0 < b := by rw [← hSb, hm.2.1]; exact hv.2.1
      exact key _ _ ((hSx ▸ hm.2.2.2).symm.trans
        (concrete_zero_boundary_contact O pi hpi u a b ha hb d f c hc _ hdir.2.2))

name: SurfaceBlowup.scalar_normalizer_raises_order
statement:
private theorem scalar_normalizer_raises_order (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ)
    (I : Ideal O) (rho : O) (hrho : rho ∈ I) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) :
    RaisesAdicOrder I (coordinateRemainder rho b E)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hlin : ∀ {M N : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module O N]
      (L : M →ₗ[O] N) (j : ℕ) (m : M), m ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O M) →
      L m ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O N) := by
    intro M N _ _ _ _ L j m hm
    have : L m ∈ Submodule.map L (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O M) := ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    rw [Submodule.map_smul''] at this
    exact Submodule.smul_mono le_rfl le_top this
  
  have hmul : ∀ (j : ℕ) (c u : R), u ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) →
      c * u ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) := fun j c u hu => hlin (LinearMap.mulLeft O c) j u hu
  
  have hsmul : ∀ {M : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] (j : ℕ) (m : M),
      m ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O M) → rho • m ∈ (I ^ (j+1) • ⊤ : Submodule O M) := by
    intro M _ _ j m hm
    rw [pow_succ', Submodule.mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul hrho hm
  let Lb : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R := ∑ i, (LinearMap.proj i).smulRight (b i)
  have hLb : ∀ z, coordinateLift b z = Lb z := fun z => by simp [Lb, coordinateLift]
  intro j x y hxy
  unfold adicCongr at hxy ⊢
  have h1 : x.1 - y.1 ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O (Fin n → O)) := by
    simpa using hlin (LinearMap.fst O (Fin n → O) R) j _ hxy
  have h2 : x.2 - y.2 ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) := by
    simpa using hlin (LinearMap.snd O (Fin n → O) R) j _ hxy
  have h3 : coordinateLift b x.1 - coordinateLift b y.1 ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) := by
    simpa [hLb] using hlin Lb j _ h1
  have h4 : x.2 * coordinateLift b x.1 - y.2 * coordinateLift b y.1
      ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) := by
    have : x.2 * coordinateLift b x.1 - y.2 * coordinateLift b y.1
        = x.2 * (coordinateLift b x.1 - coordinateLift b y.1)
          + coordinateLift b y.1 * (x.2 - y.2) := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (hmul _ _ _ h3) (hmul _ _ _ h2)
  have h5 := hsmul j _ (hlin E.toLinearMap j _ h4)
  unfold coordinateRemainder
  rw [← smul_sub]
  simpa using h5

name: SurfaceBlowup.power_normalizer_inverse_equation
statement:
private theorem power_normalizer_inverse_equation (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (ha : 0 < a) (h : R) :
    adicPerturb (coordinateRemainder (pi^a) b E) (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E h) = E h
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : pi ^ a ∈ Ideal.span {pi} :=
    Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self pi) a ha
  have hr := scalar_normalizer_raises_order O R n (Ideal.span {pi}) (pi ^ a) hmem b E
  have hbij := adic_perturb_bijective O ((Fin n → O) × R) (Ideal.span {pi}) _ hr
  exact Function.rightInverse_invFun hbij.2 (E h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalized_coordinate_equation
statement:
private theorem normalized_coordinate_equation (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : Fin n → O) :
    (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H z)).1 + (pi^a) • normalizationQuadratic b E
      (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H z)) = normalizationLinearPart E H z
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Prod.fst
    (power_normalizer_inverse_equation O R n pi a b E ha (H z))
  simpa [adicPerturb, coordinateRemainder, normalizationQuadratic,
    normalizationLinearPart] using h

name: SurfaceBlowup.power_normalizer_preserves_congruence
statement:
private theorem power_normalizer_preserves_congruence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (ha : 0 < a) (j : ℕ) (h h2 : R)
    (hh : adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j h h2) :
    adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E h)
      (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E h2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O R ((Fin n → O) × R)
    (Ideal.span {pi}) E.toLinearMap j h h2 hh
  have hmem : pi ^ a ∈ Ideal.span {pi} :=
    Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self pi) a ha
  have hr := scalar_normalizer_raises_order O R n (Ideal.span {pi}) (pi ^ a) hmem b E
  rwa [(adic_perturb_congruence_iff O ((Fin n → O) × R) (Ideal.span {pi}) _ hr j _ _).symm,
    power_normalizer_inverse_equation O R n pi a b E ha h,
    power_normalizer_inverse_equation O R n pi a b E ha h2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalized_quadratic_preserves_congruence
statement:
private theorem normalized_quadratic_preserves_congruence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) (ha : 0 < a)
    (j : ℕ) (z w : Fin n → O) (hzw : adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j z w) :
    adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j
      (normalizationQuadratic b E (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H z)))
      (normalizationQuadratic b E (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H w)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ _ H j z w hzw
  have h2 := power_normalizer_preserves_congruence O R n pi a b E ha j _ _ h1
  set s := generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H z)
  set t := generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H w)
  have hs1 := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ _
    (LinearMap.fst O (Fin n → O) R) j s t h2
  have hs2 := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ _
    (LinearMap.snd O (Fin n → O) R) j s t h2
  let L : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R :=
    { toFun := coordinateLift b
      map_add' := by
        intro x y; simp [coordinateLift, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x; simp [coordinateLift, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul] }
  have hL := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ _ L j _ _ hs1
  have hp := algebra_product_congruence O R _ j _ _ _ _ hs2 hL
  exact linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ _
    ((LinearMap.fst O (Fin n → O) R).comp E.toLinearMap) j _ _ hp

name: SurfaceBlowup.scaled_inverse_from_image_containment
statement:
theorem scaled_inverse_from_image_containment (O V W : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module O V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module O W] (pi : O) (k : ℕ) (D : V →ₗ[O] W)
    (hD : Function.Injective D) (himage : ∀ w : W, (pi^k) • w ∈ D.range) :
    ∃ Q : W →ₗ[O] V, (∀ w, D (Q w) = (pi^k) • w) ∧ ∀ v, Q (D v) = (pi^k) • v

name: SurfaceBlowup.scaled_linear_image_index
statement:
theorem scaled_linear_image_index (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n a k : ℕ)
    (D : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O))
    (hk : Module.length O ((Fin n → O) ⧸ LinearMap.range D) = k) :
    (LinearMap.range ((pi^a) • D)).toAddSubgroup.index =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))^(a*n + k)
proof:
:= by
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  have hpi0 : pi ^ a ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hpi.ne_zero
  set g : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O) := (pi ^ a) • LinearMap.id with hg_def
  have hcomp : (pi ^ a) • D = g.comp D := by
    ext x i; simp [g]
  have hg : Function.Injective g := by
    intro x y h
    funext i
    have := congrFun h i
    simp [g] at this
    exact this.resolve_right (fun h => hpi.ne_zero h.1)
  have hD' : (LinearMap.range D).toAddSubgroup.index = q ^ k :=
    finite_length_module_card O ((Fin n → O) ⧸ LinearMap.range D) k hk
  have hrange : LinearMap.range g = Submodule.pi Set.univ
      (fun _ : Fin n => (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ a) := by
    have hm : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ a = Ideal.span {pi ^ a} := by
      rw [hpi.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    rw [hm]
    ext x
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton', g]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩ i
      exact ⟨y i, by simp [mul_comm]⟩
    · intro h
      choose y hy using h
      exact ⟨y, by funext i; simp [← hy i, mul_comm]⟩
  have hg' : (LinearMap.range g).toAddSubgroup.index = q ^ (a * n) := by
    change Nat.card ((Fin n → O) ⧸ LinearMap.range g) = _
    rw [hrange, Nat.card_congr (Submodule.quotientPi _).toEquiv, Nat.card_pi]
    simp [residue_quotient_card, q, pow_mul]
  rw [hcomp, linear_composition_index _ _ _ _ D g hg, hD', hg', ← pow_add, add_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_scale_measure
statement:
theorem coordinate_scale_measure (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n m : ℕ)
    (S : Set (Fin n → O)) :
    coefficientMeasure O n (coordinateScale pi m '' S) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(m*n) * coefficientMeasure O n S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hHaar, hProb, -, -⟩ :=
    coefficient_space_strict_instances O htop pi hpi n
  let L : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O) := (pi^m) • LinearMap.id
  have hidx := scaled_linear_image_index O pi hpi n m 0 LinearMap.id (by
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, Module.length_eq_zero_iff, LinearMap.range_id]
      infer_instance)
  have hpm : pi ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hpi.ne_zero
  have hinj : Function.Injective L.toAddMonoidHom := fun _ _ hxy => smul_right_injective _ hpm hxy
  have hcont : Continuous L.toAddMonoidHom :=
    finite_coordinate_linear_continuous O n n L
  have hrange : L.toAddMonoidHom.range = (LinearMap.range L).toAddSubgroup := rfl
  have hq : 0 < Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := Nat.card_pos
  have hne : L.toAddMonoidHom.range.index ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hrange, hidx]; positivity
  have : L.toAddMonoidHom.range.FiniteIndex := ⟨hne⟩
  have key := compact_injective_image_measure (Fin n → O) (Fin n → O)
    L.toAddMonoidHom hcont hinj (coefficientMeasure O n) (coefficientMeasure O n) S
  have himg : coordinateScale pi m '' S = L.toAddMonoidHom '' S := rfl
  rw [himg, key, hrange, hidx]
  simp [ENNReal.inv_pow, Nat.cast_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.not_mem_axis_of_contact
statement:
private theorem not_mem_axis_of_contact (k : Type) [Field k] (a b c : ℕ) (s t : Fin 2) (hst : s ≠ t)
    (F : TwoSeries k)
  (hle : monomialIdeal k a b ≤ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)})
  (hmem : F ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)})
  (hf : contact (Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) F)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) (MvPowerSeries.X s)) = c) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) F,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) (MvPowerSeries.X s)}
      = (Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)}).map
          (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    have h2 : Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b) (MvPowerSeries.X s)
      = Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) (MvPowerSeries.X s) := rfl
    rw [h2]
    refine Submodule.span_insert_eq_span ?_
    rw [← h2]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
        (map_dvd (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b))
        (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem))
  have e := (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLEₐ (TwoSeries k) hle).toLinearEquiv
  have h1 := e.length_eq
  rw [axis_quotient_length_top k s t hst] at h1
  rw [contact, hspan] at hf
  rw [← Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := TwoSeries k) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at hf
  exact ENat.top_ne_natCast c (h1.symm.trans hf)

name: SurfaceBlowup.axis_X_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem axis_X_ne_zero (k : Type) [Field k] (s : Fin 2) :
    (MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h0 => by
  simpa [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X] using congrArg (MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single s 1)) h0

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_axis_pow_of_mul_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hprime := axis_span_isPrime k s
  have hT0 := axis_X_ne_zero k s
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro W _; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro W hW
    have hW1 : F * W ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)} := by
      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hW ⊢
      exact (dvd_pow_self _ n.succ_ne_zero).trans hW
    have hWT : W ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)} :=
      (hprime.mem_or_mem hW1).resolve_left hF
    obtain ⟨W', rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hWT
    have h' : F * W' ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ^ n} := by
      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hW ⊢
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hW
      refine ⟨q, mul_left_cancel₀ hT0 ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ] at hq
      linear_combination hq
    have := ih W' h'
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at this ⊢
    rw [pow_succ']
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ this

name: SurfaceBlowup.special_fiber_crossing_contact_regular
statement:
theorem special_fiber_crossing_contact_regular (k : Type) [Field k] (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hb : 0 < b) (f : SpecialFiber k a b) (ht : contact f (fiberT k a b) = c)
    (hx : contact f (fiberX k a b) = h) :
    Function.Injective (fun w : SpecialFiber k a b => f * w)
proof:
:= by
  have hI : monomialIdeal k a b = Ideal.span
      {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k) ^ a * (MvPowerSeries.X 1 : TwoSeries k) ^ b} := rfl
  have hle0 : monomialIdeal k a b ≤ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k)} := by
    rw [hI, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (Dvd.dvd.mul_right (dvd_pow_self _ ha.ne') _)
  have hle1 : monomialIdeal k a b ≤ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 1 : TwoSeries k)} := by
    rw [hI, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (Dvd.dvd.mul_left (dvd_pow_self _ hb.ne') _)
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  have hF0 : F ∉ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k)} := fun hmem =>
    not_mem_axis_of_contact k a b c 0 1 (by decide) F hle0 hmem ht
  have hF1 : F ∉ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 1 : TwoSeries k)} := fun hmem =>
    not_mem_axis_of_contact k a b h 1 0 (by decide) F hle1 hmem hx
  have hTa : (MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k) ^ a ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (axis_X_ne_zero k 0)
  intro w₁ w₂ hw
  obtain ⟨W₁, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective w₁
  obtain ⟨W₂, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective w₂
  simp only [← map_mul] at hw
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq] at hw ⊢
  rw [hI] at hw ⊢
  rw [← mul_sub] at hw
  generalize W₁ - W₂ = W at hw ⊢
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hw
  have hWa : F * W ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k) ^ a} :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨(MvPowerSeries.X 1 : TwoSeries k) ^ b * q, by rw [hq]; ring⟩
  obtain ⟨W', rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (mem_axis_pow_of_mul_mem k 0 F hF0 a W hWa)
  have hW'b : F * W' ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 1 : TwoSeries k) ^ b} :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨q, mul_left_cancel₀ hTa (by linear_combination hq)⟩
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (mem_axis_pow_of_mul_mem k 1 F hF1 b W' hW'b)
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨r, by ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.special_fiber_single_contact_regular
statement:
theorem special_fiber_single_contact_regular (k : Type) [Field k] (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : SpecialFiber k a 0) (hf : contact f (fiberT k a 0) = c) :
    Function.Injective (fun w : SpecialFiber k a 0 => f * w)
proof:
:= by
  have hI : monomialIdeal k a 0 = Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k) ^ a} := by
    simp [monomialIdeal, axisT]
  have hle : monomialIdeal k a 0 ≤ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k)} := by
    rw [hI, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (dvd_pow_self _ ha.ne')
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  have hF : F ∉ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : TwoSeries k)} := fun hmem =>
    not_mem_axis_of_contact k a 0 c 0 1 (by decide) F hle hmem hf
  intro w₁ w₂ h
  obtain ⟨W₁, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective w₁
  obtain ⟨W₂, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective w₂
  simp only [← map_mul] at h
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq] at h ⊢
  rw [hI] at h ⊢
  exact mem_axis_pow_of_mul_mem k 0 F hF a _ (by rwa [mul_sub])

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_single_curve_free
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_single_curve_free (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0 ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})
    ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0) (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcontact : contact
    (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi}) f))
    (fiberT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0) = c) :
    Module.Free O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0 ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ∧ Module.Finite O
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0 ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ∧ Module.finrank O
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0 ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) = a*c
proof:
:= by
  have hreg := special_fiber_single_contact_regular _ a c ha _ hcontact
  have hreg' := concrete_surface_residue_regular_of_special_fiber O pi u a 0 f e hreg
  have hlen := single_special_fiber_length _ a c ha _ hcontact
  have hN := (concrete_surface_special_fiber_length_transport O pi u a 0 f e).trans hlen
  have hfu : ¬ IsUnit f := by
    intro hu
    have hu' :=
        (hu.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi}))).map
        e
    have htop : Ideal.span
      {e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi}) f), fiberT
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0} = ⊤ := by
      exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)) hu'
    rw [contact, htop] at hcontact
    have : Subsingleton
        (SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0 ⧸
        (⊤ : Ideal (SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0))) :=
        Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr rfl
    rw [Module.length_eq_zero] at hcontact
    exact absurd hcontact.symm (by exact_mod_cast hc.ne')
  exact concrete_surface_curve_free_of_length O pi hpi u a 0 ha f hreg' (a*c)
      (by exact_mod_cast hN)

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_correction_raises_order
statement:
theorem strict_correction_raises_order (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) (k : ℕ)
    (ha : k < a) (Q : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O)) :
    RaisesAdicOrder (Ideal.span {pi}) (normalizationCorrection pi a k b E H Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro j x y hxy
  have h1 := normalized_quadratic_preserves_congruence O R n pi a b E H
    (by omega) j x y hxy
  have h2 := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ _ Q j _ _ h1
  unfold adicCongr at h2 ⊢
  unfold normalizationCorrection
  rw [← smul_sub]
  have hmem : -(pi ^ (a - k)) ∈ Ideal.span {pi} := (Submodule.neg_mem_iff _).mpr
    (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self pi) _ (by omega))
  have := Submodule.smul_mem_smul hmem h2
  rwa [← Submodule.smul_assoc, smul_eq_mul, ← pow_succ'] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_normalizer_factors_through_linear
statement:
theorem strict_normalizer_factors_through_linear (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) (k : ℕ)
    (ha : k < a) (Q : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O))
    (hQ : ∀ w, normalizationLinearPart E H (Q w) = (pi ^ k) • w) (z : Fin n → O) :
    scaledStrictMap pi a b E H z = (pi^a) • normalizationLinearPart E H
      (adicPerturb (normalizationCorrection pi a k b E H Q) z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := normalized_coordinate_equation O R n pi a b E H (by omega) z
  have hpow : pi ^ (a - k) * pi ^ k = pi ^ a := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel ha.le]
  unfold scaledStrictMap adicPerturb normalizationCorrection
  rw [map_add, neg_smul, map_neg, map_smul, hQ, smul_smul, hpow, ← h]
  congr 1
  abel

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_normalizer_ideal_jacobson
statement:
private theorem strict_normalizer_ideal_jacobson (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hpi : algebraMap O R pi ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R)) (g : R)
    (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g b w) (z : Fin n → O) :
    Ideal.span {g + (pi^a) • H z} = normalizedIdeal g b (scaledStrictMap pi a b E H z)
proof:
:= by
  set s := generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H z) with hs
  have h1 := scaled_normalization_identity O R n (pi^a) g b E hE s
  rw [power_normalizer_inverse_equation O R n pi a b E ha (H z),
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h1
  have hu : IsUnit (1 + pi^a • s.2) := by
    apply Ideal.isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Algebra.smul_def, map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ hpi a ha)
  rw [← h1, ← hu.unit_spec, principal_ideal_unit_invariance]
  unfold normalizedIdeal normalizedGenerator scaledStrictMap coordinateLift
  congr 3
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_normalizer_lattice_image
statement:
theorem strict_normalizer_lattice_image (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) (k : ℕ)
    (ha : k < a) (Q : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O))
    (hQ : ∀ w, normalizationLinearPart E H (Q w) = (pi ^ k) • w)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O)] :
    Set.range (scaledStrictMap pi a b E H) = Set.range
      (fun z : Fin n → O => (pi^a) • normalizationLinearPart E H z)
proof:
:= by
  have hbij := adic_perturb_bijective O (Fin n → O) (Ideal.span {pi}) _
    (strict_correction_raises_order O R n pi a b E H k ha Q)
  have hf := strict_normalizer_factors_through_linear O R n pi a b E H k ha Q hQ
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (hf z).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hbij.2 w
    exact ⟨z, by rw [hf z, hz]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_pullback_perturbation_identity
statement:
private theorem strict_pullback_perturbation_identity (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (s a d : ℕ) (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C)
    (b : Fin n → R) (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (z : Fin n → O) :
    alpha (f + (pi^(s+a)) • coordinateLift b z) = e^d *
      (g + (pi^a) • pulledVariation alpha c b z)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : coordinateLinear (O := O) b z = coordinateLift b z := by
    simp [coordinateLinear, coordinateLift, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hP : pulledVariation alpha c b z = c * alpha (coordinateLift b z) := by
    simp [pulledVariation, hL]
  rw [hP, map_add, map_smul, hf, Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_pow, map_pow, pow_add, hpi]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_pullback_colon_perturbation
statement:
private theorem strict_pullback_colon_perturbation (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (s a d : ℕ) (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C)
