    (b : Fin n → R) (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun z : C => e*z)) (z : Fin n → O) :
    ((Ideal.span {f + (pi^(s+a)) • coordinateLift b z}).map alpha.toRingHom).colon {e^d} =
      Ideal.span {g + (pi^a) • pulledVariation alpha c b z}
proof:
:= by
  have hid := strict_pullback_perturbation_identity O R C n pi s a d alpha f g e c b hf hpi z
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  change (Ideal.span {alpha (f + (pi^(s+a)) • coordinateLift b z)}).colon {e^d} = _
  rw [hid]
  have hinj : IsLeftRegular (e ^ d) := IsLeftRegular.pow d he
  ext u
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton', Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    refine ⟨v, hinj ?_⟩
    rw [smul_eq_mul] at hv
    linear_combination hv
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨v, by rw [smul_eq_mul]; ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.actual_strict_map_is_scaled_normalizer
statement:
private theorem actual_strict_map_is_scaled_normalizer (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (s a d : ℕ) (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C)
    (b : Fin n → R) (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun z : C => e*z)) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hjac : algebraMap O C pi ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal C)) (bc : Fin n → C)
    (E : C ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × C)) (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × C)] (z : Fin n → O) :
    ((Ideal.span {f + (pi^(s+a)) • coordinateLift b z}).map alpha.toRingHom).colon {e^d} =
      normalizedIdeal g bc (scaledStrictMap pi a bc E (pulledVariation alpha c b) z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [strict_pullback_colon_perturbation O R C n pi s a d alpha f g e c b hf hpi he z]
  exact strict_normalizer_ideal_jacobson O C n pi a bc E (pulledVariation alpha c b) ha hjac g hE z

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_chart_coordinates_commute
statement:
theorem strict_chart_coordinates_commute (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (s a d : ℕ) (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C)
    (b : Fin n → R) (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun z : C => e*z)) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hjac : algebraMap O C pi ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal C)) (bc : Fin n → C)
    (E : C ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × C)) (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × C)] (z : Fin n → O) :
    strictTransformIdeal alpha e d (coordinateIdeal pi f b (coordinateScale pi (s+a-1) z)) =
      coordinateIdeal pi g bc (childCoordinateMap pi a bc E (pulledVariation alpha c b) z)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : coordinateIdeal pi f b (coordinateScale pi (s+a-1) z)
      = Ideal.span {f + (pi^(s+a)) • coordinateLift b z} := by
    have h2 : pi * pi^(s+a-1) = pi^(s+a) := by
      rw [← pow_succ' pi]; congr 1; omega
    have : coordinateLift b (pi • coordinateScale pi (s+a-1) z) = (pi^(s+a)) • coordinateLift b
      z := by
      simp only [coordinateLift, coordinateScale, Finset.smul_sum, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          smul_smul, ← mul_assoc, h2]
    simp only [coordinateIdeal, normalizedIdeal, normalizedGenerator, this]
  have h3 : pi • childCoordinateMap pi a bc E (pulledVariation alpha c b) z
      = scaledStrictMap pi a bc E (pulledVariation alpha c b) z := by
    have h2 : pi * pi^(a-1) = pi^a := by
      rw [← pow_succ' pi]; congr 1; omega
    simp only [childCoordinateMap, scaledStrictMap, smul_smul, h2]
  rw [h1, strictTransformIdeal,
    actual_strict_map_is_scaled_normalizer O R C n pi s a d alpha f g e c b hf hpi he ha hjac bc E
        hE z,
    coordinateIdeal, ← h3]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_chart_preimage_set_identity
statement:
theorem strict_chart_preimage_set_identity (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (s a d : ℕ) (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C)
    (b : Fin n → R) (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun z : C => e*z)) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hjac : algebraMap O C pi ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal C)) (bc : Fin n → C)
    (E : C ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × C)) (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × C)]
    (hΨ : Function.Injective (coordinateIdeal pi g bc)) (T : Set (Fin n → O)) :
    coordinateIdeal pi f b ⁻¹' (strictTransformIdeal alpha e d ⁻¹' (coordinateIdeal pi g bc '' T)) ∩
      Set.range (coordinateScale pi (s+a-1)) = coordinateScale pi (s+a-1) ''
      (childCoordinateMap pi a bc E (pulledVariation alpha c b) ⁻¹' T)
proof:
:= by
  have key := fun z => strict_chart_coordinates_commute O R C n pi s a d alpha f g e c b hf hpi he
      ha hjac bc E hE z
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw2⟩ := hx
    rw [key] at hw2
    change _ ∈ T; rwa [← hΨ hw2]
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, z, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage]
    rw [key]
    exact ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_coker_comp
statement:
private theorem length_coker_comp (O : Type) [CommRing O] {M N P : Type} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module O M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module O N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module O P]
    (u : M →ₗ[O] N) (v : N →ₗ[O] P) (hv : Function.Injective v) :
    Module.length O (P ⧸ LinearMap.range (v.comp u)) =
      Module.length O (N ⧸ LinearMap.range u) + Module.length O (P ⧸ LinearMap.range v)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : LinearMap.range u ≤ (LinearMap.range (v.comp u)).comap v := by
    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
  have h2 : LinearMap.range (v.comp u) ≤ (LinearMap.range v).comap LinearMap.id := by
    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨u m, rfl⟩
  refine Module.length_eq_add_of_exact (Submodule.mapQ _ _ v h1)
    (Submodule.mapQ _ _ LinearMap.id h2) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mapQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact ⟨m, hv hm⟩
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk p, rfl⟩
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
    rw [Submodule.mapQ_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk n, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
      rw [Submodule.mapQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at hx
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨n - u m, ?_⟩
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hm
      rw [map_sub, hm]; abel

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_coker_pow
statement:
private theorem length_coker_pow (O : Type) [CommRing O] {P : Type} [AddCommGroup P] [Module O P]
    (w : Module.End O P) (hw : Function.Injective w) (k : ℕ) :
    Module.length O (P ⧸ LinearMap.range (w ^ k)) = k * Module.length O
      (P ⧸ LinearMap.range w)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Module.length_eq_zero_iff, pow_zero, Module.End.one_eq_id,
      LinearMap.range_id]
    infer_instance
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_eq_comp, length_coker_comp O _ _ hw, ih]
    push_cast; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.tri_eq_chooseTwo_add
statement: private theorem tri_eq_chooseTwo_add (d : ℕ) : tri d = chooseTwo d + d
proof:
:= by
  unfold tri chooseTwo
  cases d with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n =>
    have : (n+1)*(n+1+1) = (n+1)*(n+1-1) + (n+1)*2 := by
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]; ring
    rw [this, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (by norm_num)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_quotient_cokernel_length
statement:
theorem strict_quotient_cokernel_length (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C) (d : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (s : ℕ) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c) (N : ℕ)
    (phi iota : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}))
    (hphi : ∀ h : R, phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    (c * alpha h))
    (hiota : ∀ h : R, iota (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {g}) (alpha h))
    (hindex : Module.length O ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range iota) = (chooseTwo d : ℕ∞))
    (hereg : Function.Injective
    (fun y : C ⧸ Ideal.span {g} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e * y))
    (hechild : Module.length O
    ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range
    (LinearMap.mulLeft O (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e))) = (d : ℕ∞))
    (hpireg : Function.Injective (fun y : C ⧸ Ideal.span {g} => (pi : O) • y))
    (hpiquot : Module.length O
    ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range
    ((pi : O) • (LinearMap.id : (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g})))) = (N : ℕ∞))
    (hsmall : tri d ≤ s*N) :
    Module.length O ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range phi) = ((s*N - tri d : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  set me : Module.End O (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) := LinearMap.mulLeft O
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e)
  set mp : Module.End O (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) := (pi : O) •
      (LinearMap.id : (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}))
  have hrel : (me ^ d).comp phi = (mp ^ s).comp iota := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro u
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective u
    have hme' : ∀ k y, (me ^ k) y = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (e ^ k) * y := fun k y ↦ by
      simp [me]
    have hmp' : ∀ k y, (mp ^ k) y = (pi ^ k) • y := fun k ↦ by
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih => intro y; simp [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, mp, mul_smul]
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hme', hmp', hphi, hiota,
      Algebra.smul_def, ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, map_pow, hpi,
      mul_assoc]
  have hme : Function.Injective me := hereg
  have hmp : Function.Injective mp := hpireg
  have key := congrArg (fun F => Module.length O ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range F)) hrel
  rw [length_coker_comp O _ _ (hme.iterate d |> fun h => by simpa [Module.End.coe_pow] using h),
    length_coker_comp O _ _ (hmp.iterate s |> fun h => by simpa [Module.End.coe_pow] using h),
    length_coker_pow O _ hme, length_coker_pow O _ hmp, hindex, hechild, hpiquot] at key
  have ht := tri_eq_chooseTwo_add d
  have h2 : 2 * tri d = d * d + d := by
    unfold tri
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.even_mul_succ_self d).two_dvd]; ring
  have hdd : d * d = chooseTwo d + tri d := by omega
  have hL : Module.length O ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range phi) ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ by
    rw [h, top_add] at key
    exact ENat.natCast_ne_top (chooseTwo d + s * N) (by rw [key]; push_cast; rfl)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hL
  rw [← hn] at key ⊢
  norm_cast at key ⊢
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_quotient_inclusion_exists
statement:
theorem strict_quotient_inclusion_exists (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e : C) (d : ℕ)
    (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) :
    ∃ iota : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}), ∀ h : R, iota
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (alpha h)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Ideal.span {f} ≤ (Ideal.span {g}).comap alpha :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr <| by
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, hf]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g)
  exact ⟨(Ideal.quotientMapₐ (Ideal.span {g}) alpha hle).toLinearMap, fun h => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_quotient_map_exists
statement:
theorem strict_quotient_map_exists (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C) (d : ℕ)
    (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) :
    ∃ phi : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}), ∀ h : R, phi
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
          (c * alpha h)
proof:
:= by
  let L : R →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ O (Ideal.span {g})).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.mulLeft O c) ∘ₗ
        alpha.toLinearMap
  have hL : (Ideal.span {f}).restrictScalars O ≤ LinearMap.ker L := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hx
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, L, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, map_mul, hf,
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g)]
    simp
  exact ⟨((Ideal.span {f}).restrictScalars O).liftQ L hL, fun h => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_quotient_maps_relation
statement:
private theorem strict_quotient_maps_relation (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C) (d : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (s : ℕ) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (phi iota : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}))
    (hphi : ∀ h : R, phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    (c * alpha h))
    (hiota : ∀ h : R, iota (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {g}) (alpha h)) (u : R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (e^d) * phi u = (pi^s) • iota u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective u
  rw [hphi, hiota, Algebra.smul_def, ← map_mul, ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap, ← map_mul,
    map_pow, hpi, mul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_quotient_map_injective
statement:
theorem strict_quotient_map_injective (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C) (d : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (s : ℕ) (hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (phi iota : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}))
    (hphi : ∀ h : R, phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    (c * alpha h))
    (hiota : ∀ h : R, iota (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {g}) (alpha h)) (hiota_inj : Function.Injective iota)
    (hpireg : Function.Injective (fun y : C ⧸ Ideal.span {g} => (pi : O) • y)) :
    Function.Injective phi
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x : C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}, (pi ^ s) • x = 0 → x = 0 := fun x h =>
    IsSMulRegular.pow s hpireg (h.trans (smul_zero _).symm)
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro u hu
  have h := strict_quotient_maps_relation O R C alpha f g e c d pi s hpi phi iota hphi hiota u
  rw [hu, mul_zero] at h
  apply hiota_inj
  rw [map_zero]
  exact key _ h.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.colon_map_ringEquiv
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv, Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv, Ideal.mem_comap,
    Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Ideal.mem_comap]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: SurfaceBlowup.colon_singleton_mul_unit
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
    ← mul_assoc, Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ hv]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strictTransformAt_map_of_compat
statement:
private theorem strictTransformAt_map_of_compat (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (PA : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [PA.IsPrime]
    (PB : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t)) [PB.IsPrime]
    (Ψ : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) PA ≃+* CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) PB)
    (u : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) PB) (hu : IsUnit u)
    (hbase : ∀ r : R, Ψ (completedPointMap _ PA (chartBase R t x r)) = completedPointMap _ PB
        (chartBase R x t r))
    (hx : completedPointMap _ PB (chartBase R x t x) = Ψ
        (completedPointMap _ PA (chartBase R t x t)) * u)
    (d : ℕ) (J : Ideal R) :
    (strictTransformAt R t x PA d J).map Ψ.toRingHom = strictTransformAt R x t PB d J
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : (J.map ((completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) PA).comp (chartBase R t x))).map
      (Ψ : _ →+* _) =
      J.map ((completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) PB).comp (chartBase R x t)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
    exact RingHom.ext hbase
  unfold strictTransformAt
  have := colon_map_ringEquiv Ψ
      (J.map ((completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) PA).comp (chartBase R t x)))
    ((completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) PA (chartBase R t x t))^d)
  refine this.trans ?_
  rw [hJ, map_pow, hx, mul_pow, colon_singleton_mul_unit _ _ _ (hu.pow d)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_common_point_transport
statement:
theorem strict_transform_common_point_transport (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (i : D.ι) (d : ℕ)
    (J : Ideal R) :
    (strictTransformAt R t x (leftPoint D (Sum.inl i)) d J).map
      ((D.rightIso i).toRingHom.comp (D.leftIso i).symm.toRingHom) = strictTransformAt R x t
      (rightPoint D (Sum.inl i)) d J
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a : BlowupChart R t x, ((D.leftIso i).symm.trans (D.rightIso i))
      (completedPointMap _ ((D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) a)
          =
      D.rightIso i
          (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i)
              (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a)) := by
    intro a
    rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, ← D.leftIso_compat i a, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hR : ∀ r : R, algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x r) =
      beta.right (chartBase R x t r) := by
    intro r
    have h1 : chartBase R x t r = algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) r := rfl
    have h2 : chartBase R t x r = algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) r := rfl
    rw [h1, h2, beta.right.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  have hbase : ∀ r : R, ((D.leftIso i).symm.trans (D.rightIso i))
      (completedPointMap _ ((D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))
          (chartBase R t x r)) =
      completedPointMap _ ((D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom) (chartBase R x t r) := by
    intro r
    rw [key, hR]
    exact D.rightIso_compat i _
  have hrel : chartBase R t x t * chartSlope R t x = chartBase R t x x := by
    unfold chartBase chartSlope
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hx : completedPointMap _ ((D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom) (chartBase R x t x) =
      ((D.leftIso i).symm.trans (D.rightIso i))
        (completedPointMap _ ((D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))
            (chartBase R t x t)) *
      D.rightIso i
          (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i)
          (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x))) := by
    rw [← hbase, ← hrel, key, key, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
  have hunit : IsUnit
      (D.rightIso i
      (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i)
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)))) := by
    exact ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (chartSlope R t x)).map _).map _
  exact strictTransformAt_map_of_compat R t x _ _ ((D.leftIso i).symm.trans (D.rightIso i)) _ hunit
      hbase hx d J

name: SurfaceBlowup.span_eq_top_of_length_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem span_eq_top_of_length_eq_zero {A : Type} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (y : A) (hy : y ∈ P) (F : CompletedLocalAt A P)
    (h : Module.length (CompletedLocalAt A P)
        (CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸ Ideal.span {F, completedPointMap A P y}) = 0) :
    Ideal.span {F} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime P) := IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl _
      inferInstance
  rw [Module.length_eq_zero_iff, Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff] at h
  have hy' : completedPointMap A P y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt A P) := by
    have h1 : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
      (Localization.AtPrime P) := by
      rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hy
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal] at h1 ⊢
    exact fun hu ↦ h1 ((isUnit_map_iff (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) _) _).mp hu)
  by_contra hF
  have hF' : F ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt A P) :=
    fun hu ↦ hF (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hu)
  have : Ideal.span {F, completedPointMap A P y} ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
    Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.pair_subset hF' hy')
  exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top (top_le_iff.mp (h ▸ this))

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_strictTransformAt_eq_top
statement:
private theorem cell_strictTransformAt_eq_top (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hS : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b ∧ S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b)
    (e : ((BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ⧸
    chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ≃+*
    Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) r)) =
    Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
    Polynomial.X)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (hinf : (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsPrime) (s : State) (d : ℕ) (J : Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hJ : J ∈ fixedTangentCell O _ S s d Dv) :
    (∀ φ, Dv (some φ) = 0 → strictTransformAt _ _ _
      (directionPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e φ) d J = ⊤) ∧
    (Dv none = 0 → strictTransformAt _ (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (infinityPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) d J = ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  rcases S with ⟨pi', hpi', t', x', v', a', b', ha', hpar, hdim, hcomp, hinj, hres, hrc, hvert⟩
  simp only at hS
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hS
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set _)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [hpar]; infer_instance
  have hdp := directionPoint_properties (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) _ _ e he heZ
  have hinfP := infinity_point_maximal O _ ⟨pi', hpi', surfaceT O pi u a b,
    surfaceX O pi u a b, v', a', b', ha', hpar, hdim, hcomp, hinj, hres, hrc, hvert⟩
  have : (infinityPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsMaximal := hinfP.1
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b)
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)
  obtain ⟨f, c, H, rfl, hf, hH, hc, hne⟩ :=
    fixed_tangent_cell_generator_coefficients O _ _ s d Dv J hJ
  have hred := reduced_form_eq_of_residue_coeff _ d c H hH.2.1 hc
  refine ⟨fun φ hz ↦ ?_, fun hz ↦ ?_⟩
  · have : (directionPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e φ).IsMaximal :=
      (hdp.1 φ).1
    have hP := (hdp.1 φ).2.1
    rw [(concrete_strict_transform_generators O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hf _ hP _ hinfP.2.1
      hinfP.2.2.1).1]
    refine span_eq_top_of_length_eq_zero _ _ hP _ ?_
    rw [concrete_strict_transform_multiplicity O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne _ hP e he heZ φ.val
      φ.property (hdp.1 φ).2.2.2, hred, hH.2.2.2, (count_normalizedFactors_divisorAffinePolynomial
      _ Dv _ (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hH.1) φ).1, hz]
    rfl
  · have : (directionPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e
        (zeroAffine _)).IsMaximal := (hdp.1 _).1
    rw [(concrete_strict_transform_generators O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hf _
      (hdp.1 (zeroAffine _)).2.1 _ hinfP.2.1 hinfP.2.2.1).2]
    refine span_eq_top_of_length_eq_zero _ _ hinfP.2.1 _ ?_
    rw [concrete_infinity_strict_transform_multiplicity O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne _ hinfP.2.1
      hinfP.2.2.1, hred, ← hH.2.2.1, hz]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_strict_transforms_agree_at_datum_points
statement:
theorem cell_strict_transforms_agree_at_datum_points (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hS : S.t = (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∧ S.x = (surfaceX O pi u a b) ∧ S.a = a ∧ S.b = b)
    (e : ((BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ⧸
    chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) ≃+*
    Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    ((chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) r)) =
    Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
    Polynomial.X) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (hinf : (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsPrime) (s : State) (d : ℕ) (J₁ J₂ : Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (h₁ : J₁ ∈ (fixedTangentCell O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S s d Dv))
    (h₂ : J₂ ∈ (fixedTangentCell O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S s d Dv))
    (heq : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, divisorStrictTransform (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf d J₁ Q = divisorStrictTransform
    (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf d J₂ Q)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    beta) (hm : MatchesDivisor e D Dv)
    (hst₁ : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s) d J₁ = Ideal.span {leftData D s})
    (hst₁r : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s) d J₁ = Ideal.span {rightData D s})
    :
    (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s) d J₂ = Ideal.span {leftData D s}) ∧ ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
      strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (rightPoint D s) d J₂ = Ideal.span {rightData D s}
proof:
:= by
  rcases S with ⟨pi', hpi', t', x', v', a', b', ha', hpar, hdim, hcomp, hinj, hres, hrc, hvert⟩
  simp only at hS
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -, -⟩ := hS
  set S₀ : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) := ⟨pi', hpi', surfaceT O pi u a b,
    surfaceX O pi u a b, v', a', b', ha', hpar, hdim, hcomp, hinj, hres, hrc, hvert⟩
  have htop := fun J (hJ : J ∈ fixedTangentCell O _ S₀ s d Dv) ↦
    cell_strictTransformAt_eq_top O pi hpi u a b ha S₀ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ e he heZ Dv hinf s d J hJ
  have left_eq : ∀ φ, strictTransformAt _ _ _
      (directionPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e φ) d J₂ =
      strictTransformAt _ _ _ (directionPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e φ) d
        J₁ := fun φ ↦ by
    by_cases hpos : 0 < Dv (some φ)
    · exact (heq ⟨some φ, hpos⟩).symm
    · rw [(htop J₂ h₂).1 φ (by omega), (htop J₁ h₁).1 φ (by omega)]
  have right_eq : strictTransformAt _ (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (infinityPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) d J₂ =
      strictTransformAt _ (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (infinityPoint _ (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)) d J₁ := by
    by_cases hpos : 0 < Dv none
    · exact (heq ⟨none, hpos⟩).symm
    · rw [(htop J₂ h₂).2 (by omega), (htop J₁ h₁).2 (by omega)]
  
  have key : ∀ {T X : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b} (P P' : Ideal (BlowupChart _ T X)) [P.IsPrime]
      [P'.IsPrime], P = P' → strictTransformAt _ T X P' d J₂ = strictTransformAt _ T X P' d J₁ →
      strictTransformAt _ T X P d J₂ = strictTransformAt _ T X P d J₁ := by
    intro T X P P' _ _ h; subst h; exact id
  have hleft : ∀ s, strictTransformAt _ _ _ (leftPoint D s) d J₂ = strictTransformAt _ _ _
      (leftPoint D s) d J₁ := by
    rintro (i | k)
    · obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hQ, -⟩ := hm.common i
      refine key _ (directionPoint _ _ _ e φ) ?_ (left_eq φ)
      change (D.Q i).comap _ = _
      rw [hQ]
      exact (direction_point_overlap_maximal O _ S₀ e he heZ φ hφ).2.2
    · exact key _ _ (hm.zero k).1 (left_eq _)
  refine ⟨fun s ↦ (hleft s).trans (hst₁ s), ?_⟩
  rintro (i | l)
  · rw [← strict_transform_common_point_transport, hleft, strict_transform_common_point_transport]
    exact hst₁r _
  · rw [key (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) _ (hm.inf l).1 right_eq]
    exact hst₁r _

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_equation_from_levels
statement:
theorem strict_transform_equation_from_levels (S : Type) [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing S] (e g : S) (he : e ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
    (hereg : Function.Injective (fun a : S => e * a))
    (hg : Function.Injective
    (fun a : S ⧸ Ideal.span {e} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) g * a)) (d : ℕ) (F : ℕ → S)
    (hFideal : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {F j, e^j} = Ideal.span {g, e^j}) (φ : S)
    (hφ : ∀ j : ℕ, φ - e^d * F j ∈ Ideal.span {e^j}) :
    ∃ v : Sˣ, φ = e^d * g * (v : S)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a b : S, e ^ n * a = e ^ n * b → a = b := fun n _ _ h =>
    IsLeftRegular.pow n hereg h
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hφ d)
  set ψ := F d + t with hψ
  have hφψ : φ = e ^ d * ψ := by rw [hψ]; linear_combination -ht
  
  have hB : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ s : S, ψ = F (d + k) + e ^ k * s := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hφ (d + k))
    refine ⟨s, hpow d _ _ ?_⟩
    rw [← hφψ]
    linear_combination -hs
  
  have hC : ψ ∈ Ideal.span {g} := by
    have key := Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (I := Ideal.span {e})
      (M := S ⧸ Ideal.span {g})
      (by rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]; exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal e).mp he)
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) ψ) ∈
        (⨅ i : ℕ, (Ideal.span {e}) ^ i • ⊤ : Submodule S (S ⧸ Ideal.span {g})) := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
      intro k
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hB k
      have hF : F (d + k) ∈ Ideal.span {g, e ^ (d + k)} := by
        rw [← hFideal]; exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp hF
      have : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) ψ =
          e ^ k • Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (b * e ^ d + s) := by
        rw [Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← map_mul,
          Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        rw [hs, ← hab]; ring
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self e) k)
        Submodule.mem_top
    rw [key] at this
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hC
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hB 1
  have hg1 : g ∈ Ideal.span {F (d + 1), e ^ (d + 1)} := by
    rw [hFideal]; exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp hg1
  have hmem : 1 - a * v₀ ∈ Ideal.span {e} := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    apply hg
    simp only [mul_zero]
    rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨b * e ^ d - a * s, ?_⟩
    have : F (d + 1) = v₀ * g - e * s := by rw [hv₀]; linear_combination -hs
    rw [this] at hab
    linear_combination hab
  have hv : IsUnit v₀ := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right <|
    (IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self (a * v₀)).resolve_right
      ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 he hmem))
  refine ⟨hv.unit, ?_⟩
  rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, hφψ, ← hv₀]; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_strictTransform_of_mem_pow
statement:
private theorem mem_strictTransform_of_mem_pow (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (d : ℕ) (f' : R) (hd : f' ∈ (Ideal.span {t,x}) ^ d)
    (g : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) P)
    (h : strictTransformAt R t x P d (Ideal.span {f'}) = Ideal.span {g}) :
    completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) P (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) f') ∈ Ideal.span
      {g}
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).map (chartBase R t x) ≤ Ideal.span
      {chartBase R t x t} := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl
    · exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    · rw [← blowup_chart_relation]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have h1 : chartBase R t x f' ∈ Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t ^ d} := by
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact Ideal.pow_right_mono hmap d
        (Ideal.map_pow (chartBase R t x) _ d ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hd)
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h1
  have halg : algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) f' = chartBase R t x f' := rfl
  set ψ := completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) P
  have hcol : ψ F ∈ strictTransformAt R t x P d (Ideal.span {f'}) := by
    unfold strictTransformAt
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, one_mul]
    rw [← hF, map_mul, map_pow]
  rw [h] at hcol
  rw [halg, ← hF, map_mul]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hcol

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transforms_give_level_lattice_membership
statement:
theorem strict_transforms_give_level_lattice_membership (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} =
    leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} =
    rightLevelKernel D j) (f' : R) (hd : f' ∈ (Ideal.span {t,x})^d)
    (hleft : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, strictTransformAt R t x (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f'}) =
    Ideal.span {leftData D s})
    (hright : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, strictTransformAt R x t (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f'}) =
    Ideal.span {rightData D s}) (j : ℕ) :
    surfaceToChartPair R t x f' ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := curve_ideal_lattice_eq_kernels R t x beta D d G hG j
  have hd' : f' ∈ (Ideal.span {x,t})^d := by rwa [Set.pair_comm]
  unfold curveIdealLattice
  rw [Submodule.mem_prod]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) f' ∈ leftCurveIdeal R t x beta G j
    rw [hl, leftKernel, finiteSupportKernel, Ideal.mem_iInf]
    intro s
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, leftLevelIdeal, finiteLocalCurveIdeal]
    exact Ideal.span_mono (by simp) (mem_strictTransform_of_mem_pow R t x _ d f' hd _ (hleft s))
  · change algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) f' ∈ rightCurveIdeal R t x beta G j
    rw [hr, rightKernel, finiteSupportKernel, Ideal.mem_iInf]
    intro s
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, rightLevelIdeal, finiteLocalCurveIdeal]
    exact Ideal.span_mono (by simp) (mem_strictTransform_of_mem_pow R x t _ d f' hd' _ (hright s))

name: SurfaceBlowup.transverse_of_concreteSurface_equiv
statement:
private theorem transverse_of_concreteSurface_equiv (S : Type) [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing S] (O' : Type) [CommRing O'] [IsDomain O'] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O']
    (pi' : O') (hpi' : Irreducible pi') (u' : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) (a' b' : ℕ) (ha' : 0 < a')
    (ψ : S ≃+* ConcreteSurface O' pi' u' a' b') (e g : S) (he : ψ e = surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')
    (n : ℕ) (hlen : Module.length S (S ⧸ (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {e})) = (n : ℕ∞))
    (hreg : Function.Injective (fun y : S ↦ e * y)) :
    Function.Injective (fun w : S ⧸ Ideal.span {g} ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e * w) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun w : S ⧸ Ideal.span {e} ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) g * w) ∧
    ∃ L : ℕ, (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)^L ≤ Ideal.span {g, e}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, -⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_T_equiv O' pi' hpi' u' a' b' ha'
  have hE : ψ.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b') = e := by rw [← he]; simp
  obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ :=
    concrete_surface_equiv_curve_length_and_regular S O' pi' u' a' b' ψ q g
  rw [hE, Ideal.span_insert, hlen] at h1
  have hne : q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) (ψ g)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, PowerSeries.order_zero] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by simp)
  let Q : (S ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) ≃+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') :=
    (Ideal.quotientEquiv (Ideal.span {e}) (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) ψ
      (by rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; simp [he])).trans q
  have hQ : Q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) g) =
      q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) (ψ g)) := by
    simp [Q]
  exact transverse_of_reduction_ne_zero S e g hreg _ Q (by rw [hQ]; exact hne)

name: SurfaceBlowup.order_reflected_sum
statement:
private theorem order_reflected_sum {k K : Type} [Field k] [Field K] (κ : k →+* K) (d : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (d + 1) → k) (hne : ∃ i, r i ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin (d+1), PowerSeries.C (κ (r i)) * PowerSeries.X ^ (d - i.val) : PowerSeries K).order =
    ((d - (∑ i : Fin (d+1), Polynomial.C (r i) * Polynomial.X^i.val :
      Polynomial k).natDegree : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  set H : Polynomial k := ∑ i : Fin (d+1), Polynomial.C (r i) * Polynomial.X^i.val with hH
  have hcoeff : ∀ i : Fin (d+1), H.coeff i.val = r i := by
    intro i
    rw [hH, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_neg]
      intro h; exact hj (Fin.ext h.symm)
    · simp
  have hdeg : H.natDegree ≤ d := by
    rw [hH]
    refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ (fun i _ ↦ ?_)
    exact (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (by omega)
  have hH0 : H ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
    intro h; apply hi; rw [← hcoeff i, h, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
  have hF : ∀ m, m ≤ d → PowerSeries.coeff m (∑ i : Fin (d+1), PowerSeries.C (κ (r i)) *
      PowerSeries.X ^ (d - i.val) : PowerSeries K) = κ (H.coeff (d - m)) := by
    intro m hm
    have := hcoeff ⟨d - m, by omega⟩
    simp only at this
    rw [this, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨d - m, by omega⟩ : Fin (d+1))]
    · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_pos (by simp; omega)]
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_neg]
      intro h; apply hj; ext; simp; omega
    · simp
  rw [PowerSeries.order_eq_nat]
  refine ⟨?_, fun m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [hF _ (by omega), show d - (d - H.natDegree) = H.natDegree by omega,
      Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
    simpa using hH0
  · rw [hF _ (by omega), Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega), map_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.linear_composition_index
statement:
theorem linear_composition_index (R M N P : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    (g.comp f).range.toAddSubgroup.index = f.range.toAddSubgroup.index * g.range.toAddSubgroup.index
proof:
:= by
  have h : (g.comp f).range.toAddSubgroup = f.range.toAddSubgroup.map g.toAddMonoidHom := by
    ext y
    simp [LinearMap.mem_range]
  have h2 : g.range.toAddSubgroup = g.toAddMonoidHom.range := by
    ext y
    simp [LinearMap.mem_range]
  rw [h, h2]
  exact AddSubgroup.index_map_of_injective _ (f := g.toAddMonoidHom) hg

name: SurfaceBlowup.local_completion_transport_factorPow_evalₐ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := AdicCompletion.mk_surjective I R x
  simp only [evalₐ_mk]
  have := AdicCauchySequence.mk_eq_mk h s
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq] at this
  simp only [Ideal.Quotient.factorPow, Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk]
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  simpa using this

name: SurfaceBlowup.local_completion_transport_lift
statement:
private theorem local_completion_transport_lift {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (I : Ideal A)
    (J : Ideal B) (ψ : A ≃+* B) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, J ^ n = (I ^ n).map ψ) :
    ∃ F : AdicCompletion I A →+* AdicCompletion J B, ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : AdicCompletion I A),
      evalₐ J n (F x) = Ideal.quotientEquiv (I ^ n) (J ^ n) ψ (h n) (evalₐ I n x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨liftRingHom J (fun n ↦ (Ideal.quotientEquiv (I ^ n) (J ^ n) ψ (h n)).toRingHom.comp
    (evalₐ I n).toRingHom) ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m n hle
    ext x
    simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
    rw [← local_completion_transport_factorPow_evalₐ I hle x]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (evalₐ I n x)
    rw [← ha]
    rfl
  · intro n x
    rw [evalₐ_liftRingHom]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.local_completion_transport
statement:
private theorem local_completion_transport (S S' : Type) [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsLocalRing S'] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S'] (φ : S ≃+* S') :
    ∃ Φ : LocalCompletion S ≃+* LocalCompletion S', ∀ s : S, Φ
    (localCompletionMap S s) = localCompletionMap S' (φ s)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).map φ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S' := by
    rw [← Ideal.comap_symm]
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (φ.symm : S' →+* S)
  have hm' : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S').map φ.symm = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S := by
    rw [Ideal.map_symm]
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (φ : S →+* S')
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := local_completion_transport_lift (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S') φ (fun n ↦ by rw [Ideal.map_pow, hm])
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := local_completion_transport_lift (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S')
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) φ.symm (fun n ↦ by rw [Ideal.map_pow, hm'])
  refine ⟨RingEquiv.ofRingHom F G ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext1 x
    refine AdicCompletion.ext_evalₐ fun n ↦ ?_
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, hF, hG]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (AdicCompletion.evalₐ _ n x)
    rw [← ha]
    exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ a)
  · ext1 x
    refine AdicCompletion.ext_evalₐ fun n ↦ ?_
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, hF, hG]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (AdicCompletion.evalₐ _ n x)
    rw [← ha]
    exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ a)
  · intro s
    refine AdicCompletion.ext_evalₐ fun n ↦ ?_
    simp only [RingEquiv.ofRingHom_apply, hF, localCompletionMap]
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.localization_map_comap_comp
statement:
private theorem localization_map_comap_comp (A S : Type) [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M S] (T : Type) [CommRing T] (ψ : S →+* T) (J : Ideal T) :
    (J.comap (ψ.comp (algebraMap A S))).map (algebraMap A S) = J.comap ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.comap_comap]
  exact IsLocalization.map_under M S (J.comap ψ)

name: SurfaceBlowup.localization_map_finite_iInf
statement:
private theorem localization_map_finite_iInf (A S : Type) [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M S] (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (I : ι → Ideal A) :
    (⨅ i, I i).map (algebraMap A S) = ⨅ i, (I i).map (algebraMap A S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  simp only [← Finset.inf_univ_eq_iInf]
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.inf_empty]; exact Ideal.map_top _
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.inf_insert, Finset.inf_insert, IsLocalization.map_inf M, ih]

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_support_kernel_localize
statement:
theorem finite_support_kernel_localize (A S : Type) [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M S] (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (P : ι → Ideal A)
    [∀ i, (P i).IsPrime] (J : ∀ i, Ideal (CompletedLocalAt A (P i))) (σ : ι → Prop)
    (T : ι → Type) [∀ i, CommRing (T i)] (ψ : ∀ i, S →+* T i)
    (Φ : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt A (P i) ≃+* T i)
    (hΦ : ∀ i, σ i → ∀ a : A, Φ i (completedPointMap A (P i) a) = ψ i (algebraMap A S a))
    (hcollapse : ∀ i, ¬ σ i → ∃ m ∈ M, m ∈ P i) (L : ι → ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ i, (P i)^(L i) ≤ (J i).comap (completedPointMap A (P i))) :
    (finiteSupportKernel A ι P J).map (algebraMap A S) = ⨅ i : {i // σ i},
    ((J i.val).map (Φ i.val)).comap (ψ i.val)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, σ i → ((J i).comap (completedPointMap A (P i))).map (algebraMap A S)
      = ((J i).map (Φ i)).comap (ψ i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hc : (J i).comap (completedPointMap A (P i))
        = ((J i).map (Φ i)).comap ((ψ i).comp (algebraMap A S)) := by
      ext x
      rw [← Ideal.comap_symm, Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap,
        RingHom.comp_apply, ← hΦ i hi]
      simp
    rw [hc]
    exact localization_map_comap_comp A S M (T i) (ψ i) _
  have top : ∀ i, ¬ σ i → ((J i).comap (completedPointMap A (P i))).map (algebraMap A S) = ⊤ := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmP⟩ := hcollapse i hi
    exact contracted_ideal_map_localization_top A S M (P i) _ (L i) (hL i) m hm hmP
  unfold finiteSupportKernel
  rw [localization_map_finite_iInf A S M ι]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_iInf fun i ↦ iInf_le_of_le i.val (by rw [key i.val i.property])
  · refine le_iInf fun i ↦ ?_
    by_cases h : σ i
    · exact iInf_le_of_le ⟨i, h⟩ (by rw [key i h])
    · rw [top i h]; exact le_top

name: SurfaceBlowup.localization_principal_quotient_commute
statement:
theorem localization_principal_quotient_commute (A : Type) [CommRing A] (e z : A) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : PrincipalPowerQuotient (Localization.Away z)
    (algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) e) j ≃+* Localization.Away
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) z), ∀ a : A, L
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) e})^j)
      (algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) a)) = algebraMap (PrincipalPowerQuotient A e j)
    (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) z))
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) a)
proof:
:= by
  let φ0 : A →+* Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) z) :=
    (algebraMap (A ⧸ (Ideal.span {e})^j) _).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j))
  have hφ0 : IsUnit (φ0 z) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) z)
  let φ : Localization.Away z →+* Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) z) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift z hφ0
  have hφ : ∀ a : A, φ (algebraMap A _ a) = φ0 a := fun a ↦ IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq z hφ0 a
  have hker : ∀ x ∈ (Ideal.span {algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) e})^j, φ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    have : (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) e) ^ j = 0 := by
      rw [← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, hφ]
    simp only [φ0, RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [← map_pow, this, map_zero, zero_mul]
  let f := Ideal.Quotient.lift _ φ hker
  have hf : ∀ a : A, f (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A _ a)) =
      algebraMap (A ⧸ (Ideal.span {e})^j) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) := hφ
  let ψ0 : A →+* Localization.Away z ⧸ (Ideal.span {algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) e})^j :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (algebraMap A _)
  have hψ0 : ∀ x ∈ (Ideal.span {e})^j, ψ0 x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [ψ0, RingHom.comp_apply, map_mul, map_pow]
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr, zero_mul]
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  let ψ := Ideal.Quotient.lift _ ψ0 hψ0
  have hψu : IsUnit (ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ z)) := by
    simp only [ψ, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk, ψ0, RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit z).map _
  let g : Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) z) →+* _ :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ z) hψu
  have hg : ∀ a : A, g (algebraMap (A ⧸ (Ideal.span {e})^j) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) a) :=
    fun a ↦ IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq _ hψu _
  have hgf : g.comp f = RingHom.id _ :=
    Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext <| IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers z) <|
      RingHom.ext fun a ↦ by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, hf, hg]
  have hfg : f.comp g = RingHom.id _ :=
    IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j) z)) <|
      Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext <|
        RingHom.ext fun a ↦ by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, hf, hg]
  exact ⟨RingEquiv.ofRingHom f g hfg hgf, hf⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.monomial_span_pow
statement:
theorem monomial_span_pow (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (j : ℕ) (r : R)
    (hr : r ∈ (Ideal.span {t,x}) ^ j) :
    ∃ c : Fin (j+1) → R, r = ∑ i : Fin (j+1), c i * t^(j - i.val) * x^i.val
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, (Ideal.span {t,x})^n ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : Fin (n+1) ↦ t^(n - i.val) * x^i.val) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ']
      refine (Ideal.mul_mono_right ih).trans ?_
      rw [Ideal.span_mul_span', Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · apply Ideal.subset_span
        refine ⟨⟨i.val, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        have hi := i.isLt
        simp only
        rw [show n + 1 - i.val = (n - i.val) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
        ring
      · apply Ideal.subset_span
        refine ⟨⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        have hi := i.isLt
        simp only
        rw [show n + 1 - (i.val + 1) = n - i.val by omega, pow_succ]
        ring
  have h := key j hr
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at h
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨c, by rw [← hc]; simp [mul_assoc]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.fixed_tangent_cell_generator_coefficients
statement:
theorem fixed_tangent_cell_generator_coefficients (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (s : State) (d : ℕ) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ∈ fixedTangentCell O R S s d Dv) :
    ∃ (f : R) (c : Fin (d+1) → R) (H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)), J = Ideal.span
    {f} ∧ f = ∑ i : Fin (d+1), c i * S.t^(d - i.val) * S.x^i.val ∧ HasHomogeneousDivisor
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) d H Dv ∧ (∀ i : Fin (d+1), IsLocalRing.residue R (c i) =
      H.coeff i.val) ∧ ∃ i : Fin (d+1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {S.t, S.x}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, f, H, hJf, hH, hδ⟩ := hJ
  rw [← S.parameters] at hδ
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := monomial_span_pow R S.t S.x (d+1) _ hδ
  have htm : S.t ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := S.parameters ▸ Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hxm : S.x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := S.parameters ▸ Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hrep : ∀ y, IsLocalRing.residue R (residueRepresentative R y) = y := fun y ↦
    Function.rightInverse_invFun IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
  let c : Fin (d+1) → R := fun i ↦ residueRepresentative R (H.coeff i.val) + S.t * c' i.castSucc
    + (if i = Fin.last d then S.x * c' (Fin.last (d+1)) else 0)
  have hres : ∀ i : Fin (d+1), IsLocalRing.residue R (c i) = H.coeff i.val := by
    intro i
    have ht : IsLocalRing.residue R S.t = 0 := (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 htm
    have hx : IsLocalRing.residue R S.x = 0 := (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hxm
    simp only [c]
    split_ifs <;> simp [map_add, map_mul, ht, hx, hrep]
  refine ⟨f, c, H, hJf, ?_, hH, hres, ?_⟩
  · have hf : f = tangentLift O R S d H + (f - tangentLift O R S d H) := by ring
    rw [hf, hc', Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, tangentLift]
    simp only [c, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have h1 : (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        c' i.castSucc * S.t ^ (d + 1 - (i.castSucc : ℕ)) * S.x ^ (i.castSucc : ℕ))
        = ∑ i : Fin (d+1), S.t * c' i.castSucc * S.t ^ (d - (i : ℕ)) * S.x ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
      have : d + 1 - i.val = (d - i.val) + 1 := by omega
      rw [this, pow_succ]; ring
    have h2 : (∑ i : Fin (d+1), (if i = Fin.last d then S.x * c' (Fin.last (d + 1)) else 0)
        * S.t ^ (d - (i : ℕ)) * S.x ^ (i : ℕ))
        = c' (Fin.last (d + 1)) * S.t ^ (d + 1 - ((Fin.last (d + 1) : Fin (d+2)) : ℕ))
          * S.x ^ ((Fin.last (d + 1) : Fin (d+2)) : ℕ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last d)]
      · simp [pow_succ]; ring
      · intro b _ hb; simp [hb]
      · simp
    rw [h1, h2]; ring
  · refine ⟨⟨H.natDegree, by have := hH.2.1; omega⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [S.parameters, ← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hres]
    simp only
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
    exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hH.1

name: SurfaceBlowup.negative_laurent_twist_has_no_kernel
statement:
theorem negative_laurent_twist_has_no_kernel (k : Type) [CommRing k] (m : ℤ) (hm : m < 0)
    (P Q : Polynomial k) (h : P.toLaurent - LaurentPolynomial.T m *
      (LaurentPolynomial.invert (R := k) Q.toLaurent) = 0) : P = 0 ∧ Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ n : ℤ, P.toLaurent.coeff n = Q.toLaurent.coeff (m - n) := by
    intro n
    have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.coeff n) (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
    simp only [LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul,
      LaurentPolynomial.invert_apply] at this
    rw [this]; congr 1; ring
  have hL : ∀ (f : Polynomial k) (i : ℕ), f.toLaurent.coeff (i : ℤ) = f.coeff i := by
    intro f i
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Nat.castEmbedding.injective _ i
  have hN : ∀ (f : Polynomial k) (n : ℤ), n < 0 → f.toLaurent.coeff n = 0 := by
    intro f n hn
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.coeff_toLaurent]
    apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
    rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simp at hn
    omega
  constructor
  · ext i
    rw [← hL, hc, hN _ _ (by omega)]; simp
  · ext i
    have := hc (m - i)
    rw [hN _ _ (by omega), sub_sub_cancel, hL] at this
    simp [← this]

name: SurfaceBlowup.nonzerodivisor_survives_localization
statement:
theorem nonzerodivisor_survives_localization (A : Type) [CommRing A] (e z : A)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun a : A ↦ e*a)) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun a : Localization.Away z ↦ algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) e * a)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ w : Localization.Away z, algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) e * w = 0 → w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers z) w
    simp only at hs
    have h1 : algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) (e * a) = 0 := by
      rw [map_mul, ← hs, ← mul_assoc, hw, zero_mul]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers z) _ _).1 h1
    have h2 : (m : A) * a = 0 := by
      apply he
      simp only [mul_zero]
      rw [← hm]; ring
    have h3 : algebraMap A (Localization.Away z) a = 0 :=
      (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers z) _ _).2 ⟨m, h2⟩
    rw [h3] at hs
    exact (IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away z) s).mul_left_eq_zero.1 hs
  exact fun x y hxy ↦ sub_eq_zero.1 (key (x - y) (by simp only at hxy; rw [mul_sub, hxy, sub_self]))

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalization_linear_part_is_quotient_matrix
statement:
private theorem normalization_linear_part_is_quotient_matrix (O R C : Type) [CommRing O]
    [CommRing R]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g c : C) (n : ℕ)
    (b : Fin n → R) (bc : Fin n → C) (E : C ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × C))
    (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w)
    (phi : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}))
    (hphi : ∀ h : R, phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (c * alpha h)) (z : Fin n → O) (w : C)
    (hw : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) w =
      phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (coordinateLift b z))) :
    normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation alpha c b) z = (E w).1
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : coordinateLinear b z = coordinateLift b z := by
    simp [coordinateLinear, coordinateLift]
  have hH : pulledVariation alpha c b z = c * alpha (coordinateLift b z) := by
    simp [pulledVariation, hlin]
  rw [hphi, Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hw
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hw
  have hw' : w = c * alpha (coordinateLift b z) + g * v := by rw [mul_comm g, hv]; ring
  have hgv : E (g * v) = (0, v) := by
    apply E.symm.injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hE]
    simp [divisionMap, coordinateLift]
  simp only [normalizationLinearPart, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.fst_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, hH, hw', map_add, hgv, Prod.fst_add, add_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalization_linear_part_cokernel_length_eq
statement:
theorem normalization_linear_part_cokernel_length_eq (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (f : R) (g e c : C) (d : ℕ)
    (_hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (s : ℕ)
    (_hpi : (algebraMap O C pi) ^ s = e ^ d * c)
    (b : Fin n → R) (bc : Fin n → C) (E : C ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × C))
    (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w)
    (phi : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}))
    (hphi : ∀ h : R, phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (c * alpha h))
    (EB : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) ≃ₗ[O] (Fin n → O))
    (hEB : ∀ z : Fin n → O, EB.symm z = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (coordinateLift b z)) :
    Module.length O ((Fin n → O) ⧸ LinearMap.range
      (normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation alpha c b))) = Module.length O
    ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range phi) ∧
    (Function.Injective phi → Function.Injective
      (normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation alpha c b)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨EC, hEC⟩ := division_equiv_child_coordinates O C n g bc E hE
  have hD : ∀ z, normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation alpha c b) z
      = EC (phi (EB.symm z)) := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (coordinateLift b z)))
    rw [normalization_linear_part_is_quotient_matrix O R C alpha f g c n
      b bc E hE phi hphi z w hw, ← hEC, hw, hEB]
  have hcomp : normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation alpha c b)
      = (EC.toLinearMap ∘ₗ phi) ∘ₗ EB.symm.toLinearMap := by
    ext z; simp [hD]
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation alpha c b))
      = (LinearMap.range phi).map EC.toLinearMap := by
    rw [hcomp, LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ (LinearEquiv.range EB.symm),
      LinearMap.range_comp]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact (Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ EC.symm.symm hrange.symm).length_eq.symm
  · rw [hcomp]
    exact (EC.injective.comp h).comp EB.symm.injective

name: SurfaceBlowup.opposite_untruncated_chart_restriction
statement:
private theorem opposite_untruncated_chart_restriction (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ beta : (BlowupChart R x t) →+* (BlowupOverlap R t x),
    (∀ r : R, beta (chartBase R x t r) = (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))
      (chartBase R t x r)) ∧ beta (chartSlope R x t) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf
    (chartSlope R t x)
proof:
:= by
  set a : R →+* BlowupOverlap R t x :=
    (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)).comp (chartBase R t x) with ha
  have hrel := blowup_chart_relation R t x
  have hinv := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (S := BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)
  have hz : a x * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x) = a t := by
    simp only [ha, RingHom.comp_apply, ← hrel, map_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc, hinv, mul_one]
  obtain ⟨psi, h1, h2⟩ := blowup_chart_universal R (BlowupOverlap R t x) x t a
    (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x)) hz
  exact ⟨psi, fun r ↦ by rw [h1]; rfl, h2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.actual_blowup_restriction_exists
statement:
theorem actual_blowup_restriction_exists (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    Nonempty (BlowupRestriction R t x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨beta, hbase, hslope⟩ := opposite_untruncated_chart_restriction R t x
  have hc : ∀ r : R, beta (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) r) =
      algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x) r := by
    intro r
    have h1 : algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) r = chartBase R x t r := rfl
    have h2 : algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x) r =
        algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x r) := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)]
      rfl
    rw [h1, h2, hbase]
  exact ⟨{ right := { beta with commutes' := hc }, slope := hslope }⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.blowup_overlap_symmetry
statement:
private theorem blowup_overlap_symmetry (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ e : BlowupOverlap R x t ≃+* BlowupOverlap R t x,
    (∀ r : R, e ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R x t)) (chartBase R x t r)) =
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x r)) ∧ e
    ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R x t)) (chartSlope R x t)) =
    IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hs1⟩ := opposite_untruncated_chart_restriction R t x
  obtain ⟨b2, hb2, hs2⟩ := opposite_untruncated_chart_restriction R x t
  have u1 : IsUnit (b1 (chartSlope R x t)) := by
    rw [hs1]
    exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one_right _ (IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (chartSlope R t x))
  have u2 : IsUnit (b2 (chartSlope R t x)) := by
    rw [hs2]
    exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one_right _ (IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (chartSlope R x t))
  let e1 : BlowupOverlap R x t →+* BlowupOverlap R t x :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift (chartSlope R x t) u1
  let e2 : BlowupOverlap R t x →+* BlowupOverlap R x t :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift (chartSlope R t x) u2
  have he1 : ∀ a, e1 (algebraMap _ _ a) = b1 a := fun a ↦
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (chartSlope R x t) u1 a
  have he2 : ∀ a, e2 (algebraMap _ _ a) = b2 a := fun a ↦
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (chartSlope R t x) u2 a
  have inv_map : ∀ {S T : Type} [CommRing S] [CommRing T] (s : S)
      (f : Localization.Away s →+* T) (w : T),
      f (algebraMap S _ s) * w = 1 →
      f (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf s) = w := by
    intro S T _ _ s f w hw
    have h1 : f (algebraMap S _ s) * f (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf s) = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]
    linear_combination w * h1 - f (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf s) * hw
  have h21 : e2.comp e1 = RingHom.id _ := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R x t))
    apply blowup_chart_ringHom_ext
    · exact fun r ↦ by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, he1, hb1, he2, hb2]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, he1, hs1]
      exact inv_map _ _ _ (by rw [he2, hs2, mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf])
  have h12 : e1.comp e2 = RingHom.id _ := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x))
    apply blowup_chart_ringHom_ext
    · exact fun r ↦ by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, he1, hb1, he2, hb2]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, he2, hs2]
      exact inv_map _ _ _ (by rw [he1, hs1, mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf])
  exact ⟨RingEquiv.ofRingHom e1 e2 h12 h21, fun r ↦ (he1 _).trans (hb1 r), (he1 _).trans hs1⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right
statement:
theorem blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) :
    @IsLocalization.Away (BlowupChart R x t) _ (chartSlope R x t)
    (BlowupOverlap R t x) _ beta.right.toRingHom.toAlgebra
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he1, he2⟩ := blowup_overlap_symmetry R t x
  have h : e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R x t)) =
      beta.right.toRingHom := by
    apply blowup_chart_ringHom_ext R (BlowupOverlap R t x) x t
    · intro r
      have h1 : e ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R x t)) (chartBase R x t r)) =
          algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x) r := by
        rw [he1]
        exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) r).symm
      have h2 : beta.right (chartBase R x t r) = algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x) r :=
        beta.right.commutes r
      exact h1.trans h2.symm
    · exact he2.trans beta.slope.symm
  have key :=
    (IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R x t)) e).mp
    (inferInstance : IsLocalization.Away (chartSlope R x t) (BlowupOverlap R x t))
  rw [← h]
  exact key

name: SurfaceBlowup.comap_isMaximal_of_exceptional
statement:
private theorem comap_isMaximal_of_exceptional (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra (BlowupChart R t x) B]
    [IsLocalization.Away (chartSlope R t x) B] (Q : Ideal B) [Q.IsMaximal]
    (htP : chartBase R t x t ∈ Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) B)) :
    (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) B)).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  set P := Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) B)
  let _ : Field (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  obtain ⟨e0, hC, hX⟩ := exceptional_chart_is_affine_line R t x
  let ψ : BlowupChart R t x →+* Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) :=
    e0.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x 1))
  have hψs : Function.Surjective ψ :=
    e0.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hψZ : ψ (chartSlope R t x) = Polynomial.X := hX
  have hker : RingHom.ker ψ ≤ P := fun a ha ↦ by
    have h1 : e0 (Ideal.Quotient.mk (exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x 1) a) = 0 := ha
    rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ e0.injective, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, exceptionalLevelIdeal,
      pow_one] at h1
    exact (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using htP)) h1
  have hmapP : (P.map ψ).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hψs hker
  rw [← sup_eq_left.mpr hker, ← Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' ψ hψs P]
  have key : ∃ f ∈ P.map ψ, f ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases h1 : chartSlope R t x - 1 ∈ P
    · refine ⟨ψ (chartSlope R t x - 1), Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ h1, ?_⟩
      rw [map_sub, map_one, hψZ]
      exact Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero 1
    · obtain ⟨y, i, hi, hy⟩ := Ideal.IsMaximal.exists_inv (inferInstance : Q.IsMaximal) h1
      obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)) y
      have hg : a * (chartSlope R t x - 1) - (s : BlowupChart R t x) ∈ P := by
        change algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) B _ ∈ Q
        have hs := IsLocalization.mk'_spec B a s
        have : algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) B
            (a * (chartSlope R t x - 1) - (s : BlowupChart R t x))
            = - (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) B s * i) := by
          rw [map_sub, map_mul, ← hs]
          linear_combination (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) B s) * hy
        rw [this]
        exact Q.neg_mem_iff.mpr (Q.mul_mem_left _ hi)
      refine ⟨_, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := s.2
      intro h0
      have := congrArg (Polynomial.eval 1) h0
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, ← hn, map_pow, map_sub, map_one, hψZ] at this
      simp at this
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hf0⟩ := key
  have : (P.map ψ).IsMaximal :=
    IsPrime.to_maximal_ideal fun hbot ↦ hf0 (by rwa [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] at hf)
  exact Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hψs

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal
statement:
theorem overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [Q.IsMaximal]
    (hQ : (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t) ∈ Q) :
    (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).IsMaximal ∧
    chartSlope R t x ∉ Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) ∧
    chartBase R t x t ∈ Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨comap_isMaximal_of_exceptional R t x _ Q hQ, fun h ↦ Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top ‹_›
    (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem Q h (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _)), hQ⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal_right
statement:
theorem overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal_right (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [Q.IsMaximal]
    (hQ : (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t) ∈ Q) :
    (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom).IsMaximal ∧ chartSlope R x t ∉ Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom ∧
    chartBase R x t x ∈ Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  set P := Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom with hPdef
  have htP : chartBase R x t x ∈ P := by
    change beta.right (chartBase R x t x) ∈ Q
    rw [show beta.right (chartBase R x t x) = algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x) x from
      beta.right.commutes x, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (BlowupChart R t x),
      show algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) x = chartBase R t x t * chartSlope R t x from
      (blowup_chart_relation R t x).symm, map_mul]
    exact Q.mul_mem_right _ hQ
  have hZP : chartSlope R x t ∉ P := fun h ↦ by
    have h' : beta.right (chartSlope R x t) ∈ Q := h
    rw [beta.slope] at h'
    exact Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top ‹_› (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem Q h'
      (.of_mul_eq_one_right _ (IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (chartSlope R t x))))
  refine ⟨?_, hZP, htP⟩
  let _ := beta.right.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have := blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right R t x beta
  have : (Ideal.span ({x,t} : Set R)).IsMaximal := by rw [Set.pair_comm]; infer_instance
  exact comap_isMaximal_of_exceptional R x t (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q htP

name: SurfaceBlowup.localizationAway_quotient_congr
statement:
private theorem localizationAway_quotient_congr {S : Type} [CommRing S] (I J : Ideal S) (h : I = J)
    (z : S) :
    ∃ F : Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk I z) ≃+* Localization.Away
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk J z), ∀ a : S, F (algebraMap _ _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a)) = algebraMap _ _
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk J a)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact ⟨RingEquiv.refl _, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_exceptional_quotient_equiv_laurent
statement:
private theorem overlap_exceptional_quotient_equiv_laurent (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ E : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ Ideal.span {overlapException R t x} ≃+*
      LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)),
      (∀ r : R, E (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        (chartBase R t x r))) = LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r)) ∧
      E (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        (chartSlope R t x))) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1
proof:
:= by
  set A := BlowupChart R t x
  set C := BlowupOverlap R t x
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ :=
    localization_principal_quotient_commute A (chartBase R t x t) (chartSlope R t x) 1
  have hI : (Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^1 = exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x 1 := by
    simp [exceptionalLevelIdeal]
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := localizationAway_quotient_congr _ _ hI (chartSlope R t x)
  obtain ⟨E0, hE0C, hE0T⟩ := exceptional_overlap_is_laurent_line R t x
  have hJ : Ideal.span {overlapException R t x} =
      (Ideal.span {algebraMap A C (chartBase R t x t)})^1 := by
    simp [overlapException, A, C]
  let E := ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hJ).trans L).trans (F.trans E0)
  have hE : ∀ a : A, E (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A C a)) =
      E0 (levelOverlapMap R t x 1 (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) := by
    intro a
    simp only [E, RingEquiv.trans_apply, Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
    rw [hL]; exact congrArg E0 (hF a)
  exact ⟨E, fun r ↦ (hE _).trans (hE0C r), (hE _).trans hE0T⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_exceptional_quotient_domain
statement:
theorem overlap_exceptional_quotient_domain (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] (_hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) :
    IsDomain (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) ∧ ∀ b : BlowupChart R x t,
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x}) (beta.right b) = 0 → b ∈ Ideal.span
    {chartBase R x t x}
proof:
:= by
  
  
  set A := BlowupChart R t x
  set C := BlowupOverlap R t x
  set k := R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)
  set e' := overlapException R t x
  obtain ⟨E, hEC, hET⟩ := overlap_exceptional_quotient_equiv_laurent R t x
  refine ⟨MulEquiv.isDomain _ E.toMulEquiv, fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hPC, hPX⟩ := exceptional_chart_is_affine_line R x t
  have hK : Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R) = Ideal.span ({x,t} : Set R) := by rw [Set.pair_comm]
  let κ : k ≃+* (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x,t} : Set R)) := Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hK
  have hbase : ∀ r : R, beta.right (chartBase R x t r) = algebraMap A C (chartBase R t x r) := by
    intro r
    have h1 : chartBase R x t r = algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) r := rfl
    rw [h1, beta.right.commutes, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A C]; rfl
  have hx : beta.right (chartBase R x t x) ∈ Ideal.span {e'} := by
    rw [hbase, ← blowup_chart_relation, map_mul, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  let f0 : BlowupChart R x t →+* C ⧸ Ideal.span {e'} :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e'})).comp beta.right.toRingHom
  have hlift : ∀ a ∈ exceptionalLevelIdeal R x t 1, f0 a = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    simp only [exceptionalLevelIdeal, pow_one, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at ha
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
    simp only [f0, RingHom.comp_apply, map_mul, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx, zero_mul]
  let g : ExceptionalChartLevel R x t 1 →+* LaurentPolynomial k :=
    E.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.lift _ f0 hlift)
  have key : (g.comp P.symm.toRingHom).comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom κ.toRingHom) =
      (LaurentPolynomial.invert :
        LaurentPolynomial k ≃ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial k).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        Polynomial.toLaurent := by
    have hg : ∀ a : BlowupChart R x t,
        g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = E (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (beta.right a)) := fun a ↦ rfl
    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
      have h1 : P.symm (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({x,t} : Set R)) r)) =
          levelBase R x t 1 r := by
        rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, hPC]
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C,
        RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, κ,
        Polynomial.toLaurent_C, AlgEquiv.coe_ringEquiv, LaurentPolynomial.invert_C]
      have h2 : levelBase R x t 1 r = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartBase R x t r) := rfl
      rw [Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk, h1, h2, hg, hbase]
      exact hEC r
    · have h1 : P.symm Polynomial.X = levelSlope R x t 1 := by
        rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, hPX]
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X,
        RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, h1,
        Polynomial.toLaurent_X, AlgEquiv.coe_ringEquiv, LaurentPolynomial.invert_T]
      have h2 : levelSlope R x t 1 = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartSlope R x t) := rfl
      rw [h2, hg, beta.slope]
      have hm : LaurentPolynomial.T 1 *
          E (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x) : C)) = 1 := by
        rw [← hET, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one, map_one]
      exact (left_inv_eq_right_inv (by rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]; simp) hm).symm
  have hb0 : g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) = 0 := by
    simp only [g, f0, RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
      RingHom.coe_coe, hb, map_zero]
  set p := Polynomial.mapRingHom κ.symm.toRingHom (P (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b))
  have hmm : (Polynomial.mapRingHom κ.toRingHom) p = P (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) := by
    simp only [p, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_map]
    convert Polynomial.map_id
    ext a; simp
  have hp : p = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (fun h ↦ h p) key
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at this
    rw [hmm] at this
    simp only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
      hb0] at this
    rwa [eq_comm, map_eq_zero_iff _ (LaurentPolynomial.invert.toRingEquiv).injective,
      map_eq_zero_iff _ Polynomial.toLaurent_injective] at this
  have hq : Ideal.Quotient.mk (exceptionalLevelIdeal R x t 1) b = 0 :=
    P.injective (by rw [map_zero, ← hmm, hp, map_zero])
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hq
  simpa [exceptionalLevelIdeal] using hq

name: SurfaceBlowup.quotientMap_surjective_of_away
statement:
private theorem quotientMap_surjective_of_away {A C : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing C] (f : A →+* C)
    (s : A) (hsurj : ∀ c : C, ∃ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, c * f s ^ n = f a) (Q : Ideal C)
    (hP : (Q.comap f).IsMaximal) (hs : s ∉ Q.comap f) :
    Function.Surjective (Ideal.quotientMap Q f le_rfl)
proof:
:= by
  intro c'
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c'
  obtain ⟨a, n, hc⟩ := hsurj c
  have hs' : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q.comap f) (s ^ n) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact fun h ↦ hs (hP.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem n h)
  let _ := Ideal.Quotient.field (Q.comap f)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q.comap f) (s ^ n))⁻¹
  have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q.comap f) (u * s ^ n) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, hu, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs']
  have h2 : u * s ^ n - 1 ∈ Q.comap f := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, h1, map_one, sub_self]
  refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (a * u), ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.quotientMap_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  have : f (a * u) - c = c * f (u * s ^ n - 1) := by
