    rw [map_mul, ← hc, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_one]; ring
  rw [this]
  exact Q.mul_mem_left _ h2

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_point_residue_field_equiv
statement:
theorem overlap_point_residue_field_equiv (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [Q.IsMaximal]
    (hQ : (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t) ∈ Q) :
    (∃ φ : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) ≃+*
      (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ Q), ∀ a : BlowupChart R t x,
      φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) a) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk Q ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) a)) ∧
    (∃ ψ : (BlowupChart R x t ⧸ Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom) ≃+* (BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ Q),
      ∀ b : BlowupChart R x t, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom) b) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (beta.right b)) ∧ Module.length R
    (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) =
    Module.length R (BlowupChart R x t ⧸ Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hPl, hsl, -⟩ := overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal R t x Q hQ
  obtain ⟨hPr, hsr, -⟩ :=
    overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal_right R t x beta Q hQ
  set fl := algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) with hfl
  set fr := beta.right.toRingHom with hfr
  have surjl : ∀ c : BlowupOverlap R t x, ∃ a, ∃ n : ℕ, c * fl (chartSlope R t x) ^ n = fl a := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, h⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)) c
    exact ⟨a, n, by simpa [map_pow] using h⟩
  have surjr : ∀ c : BlowupOverlap R t x, ∃ a, ∃ n : ℕ, c * fr (chartSlope R x t) ^ n = fr a := by
    intro c
    let _ := fr.toAlgebra
    have := blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right R t x beta
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, h⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R x t)) c
    exact ⟨a, n, by simpa [map_pow, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using h⟩
  let φ := RingEquiv.ofBijective (Ideal.quotientMap Q fl le_rfl)
    ⟨Ideal.quotientMap_injective, quotientMap_surjective_of_away fl _ surjl Q hPl hsl⟩
  let ψ := RingEquiv.ofBijective (Ideal.quotientMap Q fr le_rfl)
    ⟨Ideal.quotientMap_injective, quotientMap_surjective_of_away fr _ surjr Q hPr hsr⟩
  have hφ : ∀ a, φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (fl a) := fun a ↦ rfl
  have hψ : ∀ b, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) = Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (fr b) := fun b ↦ rfl
  refine ⟨⟨φ, hφ⟩, ⟨ψ, hψ⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [(AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := R) (f := φ) fun r ↦ congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R _ _ r).symm).toLinearEquiv.length_eq,
    (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := R) (f := ψ) fun r ↦ congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)
      (beta.right.commutes r)).toLinearEquiv.length_eq]

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_prime_localization_left
statement:
private theorem overlap_prime_localization_left (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    ∃ φ : Localization.AtPrime Q ≃+* Localization.AtPrime
    (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))), ∀ a : BlowupChart R t x, φ
    (algebraMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) a)) = algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x)
    (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))) a
proof:
:= by
  let e := IsLocalization.localizationLocalizationAtPrimeIsoLocalization
    (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)) Q
  refine ⟨e.symm.toRingEquiv, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := e.symm.commutes a
  simp [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply] at h ⊢

name: SurfaceBlowup.completed_point_transport_left
statement:
theorem completed_point_transport_left (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)] (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    ∃ Φ : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q ≃+* CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x)
    (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))), ∀ a : BlowupChart R t x, Φ
    (completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) a)) = completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart R t x) (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := overlap_prime_localization_left R t x Q
  have : IsNoetherianRing (BlowupOverlap R t x) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)) _ inferInstance
  have : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing Q.primeCompl _ inferInstance
  have : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime
      (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing
      (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).primeCompl _ inferInstance
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ := local_completion_transport (Localization.AtPrime Q)
    (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))) φ
  refine ⟨Φ, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [completedPointMap, RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [hΦ, hφ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_prime_localization_right
statement:
private theorem overlap_prime_localization_right (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    ∃ ψ : Localization.AtPrime Q ≃+* Localization.AtPrime
    (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom), ∀ b : BlowupChart R x t, ψ
    (algebraMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Localization.AtPrime Q) (beta.right b)) = algebraMap
    (BlowupChart R x t) (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom)) b
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x) := beta.right.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have _ := blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right R t x beta
  have _ : IsScalarTower (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    inferInstance
  have hL : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R x t)) (Localization.AtPrime Q) Q
  let e := IsLocalization.algEquiv
    (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).primeCompl
    (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom)) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
  refine ⟨e.symm.toRingEquiv, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  exact e.symm.commutes b

name: SurfaceBlowup.completed_point_transport_right
statement:
theorem completed_point_transport_right (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    ∃ Ψ : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q ≃+* CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t)
    (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom), ∀ b : BlowupChart R x t, Ψ
    (completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q (beta.right b)) = completedPointMap
    (BlowupChart R x t) (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom) b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := overlap_prime_localization_right R t x beta Q
  have hloc := blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right R t x beta
  have : IsNoetherianRing (BlowupOverlap R t x) := by
    let : Algebra (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x) := beta.right.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    exact IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R x t)) _ inferInstance
  have : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing Q.primeCompl _ inferInstance
  have : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom)) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom).primeCompl _ inferInstance
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ :=
    local_completion_transport (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom)) φ
  refine ⟨Φ, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [completedPointMap, RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [hΦ, hφ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pairwise_distinct_irreducible_pow_iInf

    (hinj : Function.Injective φ) (r : ι → ℕ) :
    (⨅ i, Ideal.span {φ i ^ r i}) = Ideal.span {∏ i, φ i ^ r i}
proof:

  intro i j hij

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_ideal_of_irreducible_pow_le
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Prime φ := hφ.prime
  have hmem : φ ^ L ∈ J := hL (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have hd : Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator J ∣ φ ^ L :=
    (Submodule.IsPrincipal.mem_iff_generator_dvd J).1 hmem
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hass⟩ := (dvd_prime_pow hp L).1 hd

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_quotient_irreducible_pow_length
statement:
theorem polynomial_quotient_irreducible_pow_length (k : Type) [Field k] (φ : Polynomial k)
    (hφ : Irreducible φ) (r : ℕ) :
    Module.length (Polynomial k) (Polynomial k ⧸ Ideal.span {φ^r}) = (r : ℕ∞) ∧ Module.finrank k
    (Polynomial k ⧸ Ideal.span {φ^r}) = r * φ.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, by rw [finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree, Polynomial.natDegree_pow]⟩
  have hmax : (Ideal.span {φ}).IsMaximal := PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible hφ
  have h1 : Module.length (Polynomial k) (Polynomial k ⧸ Ideal.span {φ}) = 1 := by
    have : IsSimpleModule (Polynomial k) (Polynomial k ⧸ Ideal.span {φ}) :=
      isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mpr ⟨_, hmax, ⟨LinearEquiv.refl _ _⟩⟩
    exact Module.length_eq_one _ _
  have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := hφ.ne_zero
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    have : Subsingleton (Polynomial k ⧸ Ideal.span {φ ^ 0}) := by
      rw [pow_zero, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr rfl
    exact Module.length_eq_zero
  | succ r ih =>
    let P := Polynomial k
    let I : Submodule P P := Ideal.span {φ ^ r}
    let J : Submodule P P := Ideal.span {φ ^ (r + 1)}
    let S : Submodule P P := Ideal.span {φ}
    have hJI : J ≤ I := Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (pow_dvd_pow φ (Nat.le_succ r))
    let m : P →ₗ[P] P ⧸ J := J.mkQ ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft P (φ ^ r)
    have hm : S ≤ LinearMap.ker m := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp ha
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, m, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
        LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨b, by ring⟩
    let f : P ⧸ S →ₗ[P] P ⧸ J := S.liftQ m hm
    let g : P ⧸ J →ₗ[P] P ⧸ I := Submodule.factor hJI
    have hf : Function.Injective f := by
      rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective S x
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, f, Submodule.liftQ_apply, m, LinearMap.coe_comp,
        Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, J] at hx
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hx
      have : a = φ * c := by
        have h' : φ ^ r * a = φ ^ r * (φ * c) := by rw [hc]; ring
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero r hφ0) h'
      simp only [Submodule.mem_bot, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨c, this⟩
    have hg : Function.Surjective g := Submodule.factor_surjective hJI
    have H : Function.Exact f g := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective J y
      change (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : P ⧸ I) = 0 ↔ _
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Set.mem_range]
      constructor
      · intro ha
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp ha
        exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk b, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective S x
        simp only [f, Submodule.liftQ_apply, m, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply] at hx
        rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx
        have := I.sub_mem (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨b, rfl⟩ : φ ^ r * b ∈ I) (hJI hx)
        simpa using this
    rw [Module.length_eq_add_of_exact f g hf hg H, h1, ih]
    push_cast; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.principal_ideal_image
statement:
theorem principal_ideal_image (R A : Type) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (phi : R →+* A) (f : R) :
    (Ideal.span {f}).map phi = Ideal.span {phi f}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_span_colon_pow
proof:
:= by
  have injd : IsLeftRegular (e ^ d) := IsLeftRegular.pow d inj
  rw [principal_ideal_image, h]
  ext u
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton', Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    refine ⟨w, injd ?_⟩
    have : w * (e ^ d * F) = u * e ^ d := hw
    change e ^ d * (w * F) = e ^ d * u
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (e ^ d) w, mul_assoc, this]; ring
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    exact ⟨w, by change w * (e ^ d * F) = u • e ^ d; rw [smul_eq_mul, ← hw]; ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartBase_eq_pow_mul
statement:
private theorem chartBase_eq_pow_mul (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (d : ℕ) (f : R)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → R) (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * t ^ (d - i.val) * x ^ i.val) :
    chartBase R t x f = chartBase R t x t ^ d * ∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x)
    (c i) * (chartSlope R t x)^i.val
proof:
:= by
  subst hc
  rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have hi : i.val ≤ d := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt
  have hx : chartBase R t x x = chartBase R t x t * chartSlope R t x :=
    (blowup_chart_relation R t x).symm
  have hd : chartBase R t x t ^ d =
      chartBase R t x t ^ (d - i.val) * chartBase R t x t ^ i.val := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, hx, mul_pow, hd]
  change _ = _ * (chartBase R t x (c i) * _)
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartBase_eq_pow_mul_opposite
statement:
private theorem chartBase_eq_pow_mul_opposite (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (d : ℕ) (f : R)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → R) (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * t ^ (d - i.val) * x ^ i.val) :
    chartBase R x t f = chartBase R x t x ^ d * ∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t)
    (c i) * (chartSlope R x t)^(d - i.val)
proof:
:= by
  subst hc
  rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have hi : i.val ≤ d := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt
  have ht : chartBase R x t t = chartBase R x t x * chartSlope R x t :=
    (blowup_chart_relation R x t).symm
  have hd : chartBase R x t x ^ d =
      chartBase R x t x ^ (d - i.val) * chartBase R x t x ^ i.val := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, ht, mul_pow, hd]
  change _ = _ * (chartBase R x t (c i) * _)
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.maximalIdeal_completedLocalAt

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_ideal_generator_transverse_finite
statement:
theorem child_ideal_generator_transverse_finite (P : Ideal (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳)) [P.IsMaximal]
    [P.IsPrime] (hP : chartBase 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 𝒯 ∈ P) (g : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P)
    (n : ℕ) (hg : Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P)
      (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P ⧸ (Ideal.span {g} ⊔
        Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P (chartBase 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 𝒯)})) = (n : ℕ∞))
    (Pinf : Ideal (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯)) [Pinf.IsMaximal] [Pinf.IsPrime]
    (hx : chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳 ∈ Pinf) (hW : chartSlope 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 ∈ Pinf)
    (ginf : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf) (m : ℕ)
    (hginf : Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf)
      (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf ⧸ (Ideal.span {ginf} ⊔
        Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf (chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳)})) =
        (m : ℕ∞)) :
    (Function.Injective (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P ⧸ Ideal.span {g} =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
          (completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P (chartBase 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 𝒯)) * w) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P ⧸
          Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P (chartBase 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 𝒯)} =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P (chartBase 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 𝒯)}) g * w) ∧
      ∃ L : ℕ, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
          (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)))^L ≤
        finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P (chartBase 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 𝒯) g 1) ∧
    (Function.Injective (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf ⧸ Ideal.span {ginf} =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {ginf})
          (completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf (chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳)) * w) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf ⧸
          Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf (chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳)} =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf (chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳)}) ginf * w) ∧
      ∃ L : ℕ, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Pinf)).map
          (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime Pinf)))^L ≤
        finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf (chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳) ginf 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b 𝒯 𝒳
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b 𝒳 𝒯
  obtain ⟨O', _, _, _, _, _, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', ψ, hψ⟩ :=
    concrete_left_point_completion_is_surface O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  obtain ⟨_, -, _, -⟩ := concrete_left_point_completion_instances O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨ψi, hψi⟩, _, ⟨_, -⟩, hregi⟩ :=
    concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha Pinf hx hW
  have key := transverse_of_concreteSurface_equiv _ O' pi' hpi' u' a' b' ha' ψ _ g hψ n hg
    (concrete_left_point_exceptional_regular O pi hpi u a b ha P hP)
  have keyi := transverse_of_concreteSurface_equiv _ O pi hpi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a
    (Nat.add_pos_left ha b) ψi _ ginf hψi m hginf hregi
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := key.2.2
  obtain ⟨Li, hLi⟩ := keyi.2.2
  exact ⟨⟨key.1, key.2.1, L, by simpa [← maximalIdeal_completedLocalAt _ P, finiteLocalCurveIdeal]
      using hL⟩,
    ⟨keyi.1, keyi.2.1, Li, by
      simpa [← maximalIdeal_completedLocalAt _ Pinf, finiteLocalCurveIdeal] using hLi⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_infinity_strict_transform_multiplicity
statement:
theorem concrete_infinity_strict_transform_multiplicity (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (d + 1) → 𝒮)
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {𝒯, 𝒳}) [IsLocalRing 𝒮]
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯)) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hx : chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳 ∈ P) (hW : chartSlope 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 ∈ P) :
    Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) P)
      (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) P ⧸
        Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) P
          (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
            algebraMap 𝒮 (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) (c i) * chartSlope 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 ^ (d - i.val)),
        completedPointMap (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) P (chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳)}) =
    ((d - (∑ i : Fin (d+1), Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue 𝒮 (c i)) * Polynomial.X^i.val :
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField 𝒮)).natDegree : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := (concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha P hx hW).1
  obtain ⟨ψ, hb, hs, -⟩ := x_chart_infinity_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_T_equiv O pi hpi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a (by omega)
  obtain ⟨e0, he0⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hmax := concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha
  let κ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField 𝒮 ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField O :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hmax).trans e0
  have hκ : ∀ s : TwoSeries O, κ (IsLocalRing.residue _ (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
      IsLocalRing.residue O (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s) := fun s ↦ by
    change e0 (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hmax (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (surfaceMk O pi u a b s))) = _
    rw [Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
    exact he0 s
  have hxT : ψ (completedPointMap _ P (chartBase _ _ _ 𝒳)) =
      surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a := by
    have h := hb (axisX O)
    rwa [(chartSubst_apply_generators O 0).2.2.2.2.2.1] at h
  rw [← RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply ψ (completedPointMap _ P (chartBase _ _ _ 𝒳)), hxT,
    (concrete_surface_equiv_curve_length_and_regular _ O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a ψ q _).1]
  let Ψ : BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 →+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :=
    q.toRingHom.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (ψ.toRingHom.comp (completedPointMap _ P)))
  have hΨc : ∀ r : 𝒮, Ψ (algebraMap _ _ r) = PowerSeries.C (κ (IsLocalRing.residue _ r)) :=
      fun r ↦ by
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
    change q (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (ψ (completedPointMap _ P (chartBase _ _ _
      (surfaceMk O pi u a b s))))) = _
    rw [hb, hq, residueKillT_xChartSubst O pi hpi]; exact congrArg _ (hκ s).symm
  have hΨW : Ψ (chartSlope _ _ _) = PowerSeries.X := by
    change q (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (ψ (completedPointMap _ P _))) = _
    rw [hs, show surfaceX O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a = surfaceMk _ _ _ _ _ (axisX O) from rfl,
      hq, (residueKillT_apply_ker O pi hpi).2.2.1]
  rw [show ∀ y, q (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (ψ (completedPointMap _ P y))) = Ψ y from fun _ ↦ rfl]
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, hΨc, hΨW]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
  refine order_reflected_sum κ.toRingHom d _ ⟨i, ?_⟩
  rwa [Ne, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hmax]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_strict_transform_generators
statement:
theorem concrete_strict_transform_generators (d : ℕ) (f : 𝒮) (c : Fin (d + 1) → 𝒮)
    (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * 𝒯 ^ (d - i.val) * 𝒳 ^ i.val) (P : Ideal (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳))
    [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime] (hP : chartBase 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 𝒯 ∈ P) (Pinf : Ideal (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯))
    [Pinf.IsMaximal] [Pinf.IsPrime] (hx : chartBase 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 𝒳 ∈ Pinf)
    (hW : chartSlope 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 ∈ Pinf) :
    strictTransformAt 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 P d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {completedPointMap
      (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) P
      (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap 𝒮 (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳) (c i) * chartSlope 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 ^ i.val)} ∧
    strictTransformAt 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 Pinf d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {completedPointMap
      (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) Pinf
      (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        algebraMap 𝒮 (BlowupChart 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯) (c i) * chartSlope 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯 ^ (d - i.val))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, inj⟩ :=
    (concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha Pinf hx hW).2
  refine ⟨map_span_colon_pow _ _ _ d f ?_
    (concrete_left_point_exceptional_regular O pi hpi u a b ha P hP),
    map_span_colon_pow _ _ _ d f ?_ inj⟩ <;> simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] <;>
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_mul]
  exacts [congrArg _ (chartBase_eq_pow_mul _ _ _ d f c hc),
    congrArg _ (chartBase_eq_pow_mul_opposite _ _ _ d f c hc)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.principal_ideal_unit_invariance
statement:
theorem principal_ideal_unit_invariance (R : Type) [CommRing R] (f : R) (u : Rˣ) :
    Ideal.span {(u : R)*f} = Ideal.span {f}
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit u.isUnit f

name: SurfaceBlowup.span_sup_eq_sup_span
statement:
private theorem span_sup_eq_sup_span {A : Type} [CommRing A] {I : Ideal A} {f g : A}
    (h : f - g ∈ I) : Ideal.span {f} ⊔ I = I ⊔ Ideal.span {g}
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (sup_le ?_ le_sup_left) (sup_le le_sup_right ?_) <;>
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  · rw [← sub_add_cancel f g]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left h) (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g))
  · rw [← sub_sub_cancel f g]
    exact sub_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self f)) (Ideal.mem_sup_right h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.boundary_contact_of_twisted_generator
statement:
theorem boundary_contact_of_twisted_generator (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (d : ℕ) (f : R)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → R) (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * t ^ (d - i.val) * x ^ i.val) :
    algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) f = (chartBase R x t x)^d *
        ∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) (c i) * (chartSlope R x t)^(d - i.val) ∧
      Module.length R (R ⧸ (Ideal.span {f} ⊔ Ideal.span {t})) = (d : ℕ∞) +
        Module.length (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupChart R x t ⧸
          (Ideal.span {∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) (c i) *
            (chartSlope R x t)^(d - i.val)} ⊔ Ideal.span {chartSlope R x t}))
proof:
:= by
  have hal : ∀ r : R, algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) r = chartBase R x t r := fun _ ↦ rfl
  set B := BlowupChart R x t
  set W := chartSlope R x t
  set g : B := ∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R B (c i) * W^(d - i.val) with hg
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hc, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow, hal, ← blowup_chart_relation R x t]
    rw [← pow_mul_pow_sub _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt), hal]
    ring
  set I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {t}
  have hfI : f - c (Fin.last d) * x ^ d ∈ I := by
    rw [hc, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_last, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
      (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self t) _ (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.isLt)))
  have hx (y) (hy : x * y ∈ I) : y ∈ I := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hy ⊢
    apply hreg.2
    simpa using hy
  have hxd (n : ℕ) : ∀ y, x ^ n * y ∈ I → y ∈ I := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih => exact fun y hy ↦ hx _ (ih _ (by rwa [pow_succ, mul_assoc] at hy))
  have hone : Module.length R (R ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {x})) = 1 := by
    rw [← Ideal.span_insert t {x}]
    have : IsSimpleModule R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R)) :=
      isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mpr ⟨_, inferInstance, ⟨LinearEquiv.refl _ _⟩⟩
    exact Module.length_eq_one R _
  rw [span_sup_eq_sup_span hfI, length_quotient_sup_mul_eq_add R I (x ^ d) (c (Fin.last d)) (hxd d),
    length_quotient_sup_pow_eq_mul R I x hx d, hone, mul_one, add_comm]
  congr 1
  have hgW : g - algebraMap R B (c (Fin.last d)) ∈ Ideal.span {W} := by
    rw [hg, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_last, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
      (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self W) _ (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.isLt))
  rw [span_sup_eq_sup_span hgW]
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, -⟩ := boundary_chart_quotient_equiv R t x
  symm
  apply quotient_ring_length_intrinsic
  refine (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup _ _).symm.trans
    ((Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ ρ ?_).trans (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup _ _))
  simp only [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  congr 2
  exact (hρ _).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.contracted_level_one_ideal_is_irreducible_power
statement:
private theorem contracted_level_one_ideal_is_irreducible_power (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+*
      Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsMaximal]
    (φ : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (hφ : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ})
    (hirr : Irreducible φ) (g : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) P) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P))) ^ L ≤ finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x)
      P (chartBase R t x t) g 1) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ L ∧
        ((contractedLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) P (chartBase R t x t) g 1).map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ^r} ∧
        Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) P) (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x)
        P ⧸ finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) P (chartBase R t x t) g 1) = (r : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  set A := BlowupChart R t x
  set I := finiteLocalCurveIdeal A P (chartBase R t x t) g 1 with hIdef
  set J := contractedLocalCurveIdeal A P (chartBase R t x t) g 1 with hJdef
  have hPL : P ^ L ≤ J := completed_point_power_contraction A P L I hL
  have hTJ : chartExceptional R t x ≤ J := by
    rw [show chartExceptional R t x = Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t} from rfl, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    change completedPointMap A P (chartBase R t x t) ∈ I
    rw [hIdef, finiteLocalCurveIdeal, pow_one]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hle : Ideal.span {φ ^ L} ≤ (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e := by
    have h1 := Ideal.map_pow e (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) P) L
    have h0 := Ideal.map_pow (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) P L
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow, ← hφ, ← h1, ← h0]
    exact Ideal.map_mono (Ideal.map_mono hPL)
  have hK : RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I).comp (completedPointMap A P)) = J := by
    rw [← RingHom.comap_ker, Ideal.mk_ker]; rfl
  have E1 : (A ⧸ J) ≃+* (CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸ I) :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hK.symm).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective
      (finite_completed_point_quotient_surjective A P L I hL))
  have hlen := quotient_ring_length_intrinsic _ _ _ _ E1
  obtain ⟨r, hrL, hr⟩ : ∃ r ≤ L,
      (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ ^ r} := by
    let _ := Ideal.Quotient.field (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R))
    exact polynomial_ideal_of_irreducible_pow_le _ φ hirr _ L hle
  have hφ : Module.length (Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
      (Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) ⧸ Ideal.span {φ ^ r}) = r := by
    let _ := Ideal.Quotient.field (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R))
    exact (polynomial_quotient_irreducible_pow_length _ φ hirr r).1
  refine ⟨r, hrL, hr, ?_⟩
  rw [← hlen, ← hφ]
  exact quotient_ring_length_intrinsic _ _ _ _
    ((DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE hTJ).symm.trans (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ e hr.symm))

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_quot_span_pair_toNat_eq
statement:
private theorem length_quot_span_pair_toNat_eq {S S' : Type} [CommRing S] [CommRing S']
    (Φ : S ≃+* S') (g e : S) (g' e' : S')
    (hg : Φ g = g') (he : Ideal.span {Φ e} = Ideal.span {e'}) :
    (Module.length S (S ⧸ Ideal.span {g, e ^ 1})).toNat =
      (Module.length S' (S' ⧸ Ideal.span {g', e' ^ 1})).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_one, pow_one]
  have h : Ideal.span {g', e'} = (Ideal.span {g, e}).map Φ := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, hg, Ideal.span_insert, Ideal.span_insert, he]
  rw [quotient_ring_length_intrinsic S S' (Ideal.span {g, e}) (Ideal.span {g', e'})
    (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ Φ h)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (i : D.ι) :
    leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inl i) = commonMultiplicity D i ∧
      rightMultiplicity D (Sum.inl i) = commonMultiplicity D i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold leftMultiplicity commonMultiplicity leftLevelIdeal commonLevelIdeal finiteLocalCurveIdeal
    symm
    refine length_quot_span_pair_toNat_eq (D.leftIso i) _ _ _ _ rfl ?_
    have := D.leftIso_compat i (chartBase R t x t)
    unfold overlapException
    rw [this]; rfl
  · unfold rightMultiplicity commonMultiplicity rightLevelIdeal commonLevelIdeal
      finiteLocalCurveIdeal
    symm
    refine length_quot_span_pair_toNat_eq (D.rightIso i) _ _ _ _ rfl ?_
    have hx := D.rightIso_compat i (chartBase R x t x)
    have hrel : beta.right (chartBase R x t x) = overlapException R t x * overlapSlope R t x := by
      have h1 : beta.right (chartBase R x t x) = algebraMap R (BlowupOverlap R t x) x :=
        beta.right.commutes x
      have h2 := congrArg (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))
        (blowup_chart_relation R t x)
      rw [h1]
      unfold overlapException overlapSlope
      rw [← map_mul, h2]
      exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) x).symm
    have hu : IsUnit (overlapSlope R t x) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
    have hu' : IsUnit (D.rightIso i
        (completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i) (overlapSlope R t x))) :=
      (hu.map _).map _
    rw [hrel, map_mul, map_mul] at hx
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg _ hx))
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hu' _ |>.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.completedLocalCast_completedPointMap
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_finiteLocalCurveIdeal_transport
statement:
private theorem length_finiteLocalCurveIdeal_transport {A S : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing S]
    {P' P : Ideal A} [P'.IsPrime] [P.IsPrime]
    (Φ : S ≃+* CompletedLocalAt A P') (h : P' = P) (gC : CompletedLocalAt A P) (e0 : A) (n : ℕ∞)
    (hl : Module.length (CompletedLocalAt A P) (CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸
      (Ideal.span {gC} ⊔ Ideal.span {completedPointMap A P e0})) = n) :
    Module.length (CompletedLocalAt A P') (CompletedLocalAt A P' ⧸
      finiteLocalCurveIdeal A P' e0 (Φ ((Φ.trans (completedLocalCast h)).symm gC)) 1) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_trans_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  subst h
  rw [finiteLocalCurveIdeal, pow_one, Ideal.span_insert]
  exact hl

name: SurfaceBlowup.strictTransformAt_transport
statement:
private theorem strictTransformAt_transport (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    {S : Type} [CommRing S]
    {P' P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)} [P'.IsPrime] [P.IsPrime]
    (Φ : S ≃+* CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) P') (h : P' = P)
    (gC : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) P) (d : ℕ) (J : Ideal R)
    (hs : strictTransformAt R t x P' d J =
        Ideal.span {Φ ((Φ.trans (completedLocalCast h)).symm gC)}) :
    strictTransformAt R t x P d J = Ideal.span {gC}
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_trans_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hs
  subst h
  exact hs

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_finiteLocalCurveIdeal_toNat
statement:
private theorem length_finiteLocalCurveIdeal_toNat {A : Type} [CommRing A] {P : Ideal A} [P.IsPrime]
    (g : CompletedLocalAt A P) (e0 : A) (n : ℕ)
    (hl : Module.length (CompletedLocalAt A P) (CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸
      (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {completedPointMap A P e0})) = n) :
    n = (Module.length (CompletedLocalAt A P) (CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸
      finiteLocalCurveIdeal A P e0 g 1)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteLocalCurveIdeal, pow_one, Ideal.span_insert, hl, ENat.toNat_natCast]

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_ideals_curve_datum_of_points
statement:
private theorem child_ideals_curve_datum_of_points (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t x : R)
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) (hinf : (infinityPoint R t x).IsPrime)
    (s : State) (d : ℕ) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (I : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, Ideal (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q))
    (hI : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, I Q ∈ childIdealSet R t x e Dv hinf s d Q)
    (hdir : ∀ φ, (directionPoint R t x e φ).IsMaximal ∧
      chartBase R t x t ∈ directionPoint R t x e φ ∧
      (chartSlope R t x ∈ directionPoint R t x e φ ↔ φ = zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (directionPoint R t x e))
    (hover : ∀ φ, φ ≠ zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) →
      ((directionPoint R t x e φ).map
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).IsMaximal ∧
      ((directionPoint R t x e φ).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).comap
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) = directionPoint R t x e φ)
    (hinfmax : (infinityPoint R t x).IsMaximal ∧ chartBase R x t x ∈ infinityPoint R t x ∧
      chartSlope R x t ∈ infinityPoint R t x)
    (htrL : ∀ (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsMaximal], chartBase R t x t ∈ P →
      TransverseFiniteAt (BlowupChart R t x) P (chartBase R t x t))
    (htrR : ∀ (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t)) [P.IsMaximal], chartBase R x t x ∈ P →
      chartSlope R x t ∈ P → TransverseFiniteAt (BlowupChart R x t) P (chartBase R x t x)) :
    ∃ D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta, MatchesDivisor e D Dv ∧ ∀ f : R,
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, strictTransformAt R t x (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
          Ideal.span {leftData D s}) →
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, strictTransformAt R x t (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
          Ideal.span {rightData D s}) →
      ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, divisorStrictTransform R t x e Dv hinf
          d (Ideal.span {f}) Q = I Q
proof:
:= by
  set k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  set alpha := algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
  choose gen hgen using fun Q ↦ (hI Q).1
  have hlen : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, Module.length (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q)
      (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q ⧸ (Ideal.span {gen Q} ⊔
        Ideal.span {divisorException R t x e Dv hinf Q})) = (Dv Q.val : ℕ∞) :=
    fun Q ↦ hgen Q ▸ (hI Q).2.1
  have hQmax : ∀ i : CommonDirections Dv, (commonPoint R t x e i).IsMaximal :=
    fun i ↦ (hover i.1 i.2.1).1
  have hcomap (i : CommonDirections Dv) : (commonPoint R t x e i).comap alpha =
      directionPoint R t x e i.1 := (hover i.1 i.2.1).2
  have hinfM : (infinityPoint R t x).IsMaximal := hinfmax.1
  have hdirM : ∀ φ, (directionPoint R t x e φ).IsMaximal := fun φ ↦ (hdir φ).1
  have := divisorSupport_finite Dv
  choose Φ hΦ using fun i : CommonDirections Dv ↦
    completed_point_transport_left R t x (commonPoint R t x e i)
  choose Ψ hΨ using fun i : CommonDirections Dv ↦
    completed_point_transport_right R t x beta (commonPoint R t x e i)
  
  let Θ (i : CommonDirections Dv) := (Φ i).trans (completedLocalCast (hcomap i))
  have hΘ (i : CommonDirections Dv) (a) : Θ i (completedPointMap _ _ (alpha a)) =
      completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (directionPoint R t x e i.1) a := by
    rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, hΦ i a, completedLocalCast_completedPointMap]
  let gC (i : CommonDirections Dv) : CompletedLocalAt _ (directionPoint R t x e i.1) :=
    gen ⟨some i.1, i.2.2⟩
  have htrC (i : CommonDirections Dv) := @htrL (directionPoint R t x e i.1) (hdirM _)
    (hdir i.1).2.1 (gC i) _ (hlen ⟨some i.1, i.2.2⟩)
  have htr0 (l : {_u : Unit // 0 < Dv (zeroDirection k)}) := @htrL _ (hdirM (zeroAffine k))
    (hdir _).2.1 (gen ⟨zeroDirection k, l.2⟩) _ (hlen ⟨zeroDirection k, l.2⟩)
  have htrI (l : {_u : Unit // 0 < Dv none}) := @htrR (infinityPoint R t x) hinfM hinfmax.2.1
    hinfmax.2.2 (gen ⟨none, l.2⟩) _ (hlen ⟨none, l.2⟩)
  have he (i : CommonDirections Dv) : (Θ i).symm (completedPointMap _ _ (chartBase R t x t)) * 1 =
      completedPointMap _ (commonPoint R t x e i) (overlapException R t x) := by
    rw [mul_one, RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]; exact (hΘ i _).symm
  have hM (i : CommonDirections Dv) :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (commonPoint R t x e i))).map
        (localCompletionMap _) ≤
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (directionPoint R t x e i.1))).map
        (localCompletionMap _)).map (Θ i).symm := by
    rw [Ideal.map_symm, ← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap,
      map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion (commonPoint R t x e i)]
    exact (map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_transport alpha _ _ (Θ i) (hΘ i)).le
  let D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta :=
    { ι := CommonDirections Dv
      fin := Finite.of_injective (β := divisorSupport Dv) (fun i ↦ ⟨some i.1, i.2.2⟩)
          fun i j h ↦ Subtype.ext (Option.some_injective _ (congrArg Subtype.val h))
      Q := commonPoint R t x e
      maximal := hQmax
      inj := fun i j h ↦ Subtype.ext <| hinj <|
        (hcomap i).symm.trans <| (congrArg (Ideal.comap alpha) h).trans (hcomap j)
      onE := fun i ↦ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hdir i.1).2.1
      g := fun i ↦ (Θ i).symm (gC i)
      transverse := fun i ↦ mul_injective_quotient_transport _ isUnit_one (he i) (htrC i).1
      finite := fun i ↦ exists_pow_le_span_pair_transport _ isUnit_one (he i) (hM i) (htrC i).2 1
      leftIso := Φ
      leftIso_compat := hΦ
      rightIso := Ψ
      rightIso_compat := hΨ
      ι0 := {_u : Unit // 0 < Dv (zeroDirection k)}
      P0 := fun _ ↦ directionPoint R t x e (zeroAffine k)
      maximal0 := fun _ ↦ hdirM _
      inj0 := fun a b _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim a b
      slope0 := fun _ ↦ ((hdir _).2.2).2 rfl
      onE0 := fun _ ↦ (hdir _).2.1
      g0 := fun l ↦ gen ⟨zeroDirection k, l.2⟩
      transverse0 := fun l ↦ (htr0 l).1
      finite0 := fun l ↦ (htr0 l).2
      ιinf := {_u : Unit // 0 < Dv none}
      Pinf := fun _ ↦ infinityPoint R t x
      maximalinf := fun _ ↦ hinfM
      injinf := fun a b _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim a b
      slopeinf := fun _ ↦ hinfmax.2.2
      onEinf := fun _ ↦ hinfmax.2.1
      ginf := fun l ↦ gen ⟨none, l.2⟩
      transverseinf := fun l ↦ (htrI l).1
      finiteinf := fun l ↦ (htrI l).2 }
  refine ⟨D, ⟨fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, i.2.1, rfl, ?_⟩, fun φ hφ hpos ↦ ⟨⟨φ, hφ, hpos⟩, rfl⟩,
    fun l ↦ ⟨rfl, length_finiteLocalCurveIdeal_toNat (P := directionPoint R t x e (zeroAffine k))
      _ _ _ (hlen ⟨zeroDirection k, l.2⟩)⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨⟨(), h⟩⟩,
    fun l ↦ ⟨rfl, length_finiteLocalCurveIdeal_toNat (P := infinityPoint R t x) _ _ _
      (hlen ⟨none, l.2⟩)⟩, fun h ↦ ⟨⟨(), h⟩⟩⟩, fun f hL hR ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← (two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq R t x beta D i).1]
    exact ((congrArg ENat.toNat (length_finiteLocalCurveIdeal_transport (Φ i) (hcomap i) (gC i)
      (chartBase R t x t) _ (hlen ⟨some i.1, i.2.2⟩))).trans (ENat.toNat_natCast _)).symm
  rintro ⟨_ | φ, hQ⟩
  · exact (hR (Sum.inr ⟨(), hQ⟩)).trans (hgen _).symm
  by_cases hφ : φ = zeroAffine k
  · subst hφ
    exact (hL (Sum.inr ⟨(), hQ⟩)).trans (hgen _).symm
  · exact (strictTransformAt_transport R t x (Φ ⟨φ, hφ, hQ⟩) (hcomap ⟨φ, hφ, hQ⟩) (gC ⟨φ, hφ, hQ⟩)
      d _ (hL (Sum.inl ⟨φ, hφ, hQ⟩))).trans (hgen _).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.directionPoint_overlap_facts
statement:
private theorem directionPoint_overlap_facts (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (t x : R) (ht : S.t = t) (hx : S.x = x)
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (hφ : φ ≠ zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) :
    ((directionPoint R t x e φ).map
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).IsMaximal ∧
      ((directionPoint R t x e φ).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).comap
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) = directionPoint R t x e φ
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  obtain ⟨h1, -, h2⟩ := direction_point_overlap_maximal O R S e he heZ φ hφ
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.infinityPoint_facts
statement:
private theorem infinityPoint_facts (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (t x : R) (ht : S.t = t) (hx : S.x = x) :
    (infinityPoint R t x).IsMaximal ∧ chartBase R x t x ∈ infinityPoint R t x ∧
      chartSlope R x t ∈ infinityPoint R t x
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := infinity_point_maximal O R S
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_quot_span_one_sup
statement:
private theorem length_quot_span_one_sup {A : Type} [CommRing A] (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (y : CompletedLocalAt A P) :
    Module.length (CompletedLocalAt A P) (CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸
      (Ideal.span {(1 : CompletedLocalAt A P)} ⊔ Ideal.span {y})) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_one, top_sup_eq, Nat.cast_zero, Module.length_eq_zero_iff]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_ideals_curve_datum
statement:
theorem child_ideals_curve_datum (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
        [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (e : (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)
        (tBase O pi u a b r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b) (tSlope O pi u a b)) = Polynomial.X)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (hinf : (infinityPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsPrime) (s : State) (d : ℕ)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (I : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, Ideal (divisorLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf Q))
    (hI : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, I Q ∈ childIdealSet (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf s d Q) :
    ∃ D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        beta, MatchesDivisor e D Dv ∧ ∀ f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b,
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
            (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {leftData D s}) →
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
          (surfaceT O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
        Ideal.span {rightData D s}) →
      ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, divisorStrictTransform (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
          (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf d (Ideal.span {f}) Q =
        I Q
proof:
:= by
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b)
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)
  obtain ⟨hDom, hReg, S, -, hSt, hSx, -⟩ :=
    concrete_surface_data_exists_unconditional O pi hpi u a b ha
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  obtain ⟨hdir, hinj, -⟩ := directionPoint_properties _ _ _ e he heZ
  have hinfmax := infinityPoint_facts O _ S _ _ hSt hSx
  refine child_ideals_curve_datum_of_points _ _ _ e Dv hinf s d beta I hI
    (fun φ ↦ ⟨(hdir φ).1, (hdir φ).2.1, (hdir φ).2.2.1⟩) hinj
    (directionPoint_overlap_facts O _ S _ _ hSt hSx e he heZ) hinfmax
    (fun P _ hP g n hg ↦ ?_) (fun P _ hP hW g n hg ↦ ?_)
  · have := @child_ideal_generator_transverse_finite O _ _ _ _ _ pi hpi u a b ha P _ _ hP g n hg
      (infinityPoint _ _ _) hinfmax.1 hinfmax.1.isPrime hinfmax.2.1 hinfmax.2.2 1
      0 (length_quot_span_one_sup _ _)
    exact ⟨this.1.1, this.1.2.2⟩
  · have := @child_ideal_generator_transverse_finite O _ _ _ _ _ pi hpi u a b ha
      (directionPoint _ _ _ e (zeroAffine _)) (hdir _).1 (hdir _).1.isPrime (hdir _).2.1 1 0
      (length_quot_span_one_sup _ _) P _ _ hP hW g n hg
    exact ⟨this.2.1, this.2.2.2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_datum_common_and_zero_clauses
statement:
private theorem curve_datum_common_and_zero_clauses (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (d + 1) → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (hH : HasHomogeneousDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) d H Dv)
    (hcH : ∀ i : Fin (d+1), IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (c i) = H.coeff i.val)
    (e : (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+*
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)
      (tBase O pi u a b r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b) (tSlope O pi u a b)) = Polynomial.X)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      beta)
    (hleft : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
      leftData D s = completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
          tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∈ leftPoint D s) :
    (∀ i : D.ι, ∃ φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)),
      φ ≠ zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) ∧
      D.Q i = (directionPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
          (surfaceX O pi u a b) e φ).map (algebraMap (tChart O pi u a b) (tOverlap O pi u a b)) ∧
      Dv (some φ) = commonMultiplicity D i) ∧
    ∀ k : D.ι0, D.P0 k = directionPoint (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b) e
          (zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) ∧
      Dv (zeroDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) =
        leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inr k)
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hne : ∃ i : Fin (d+1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, H.coeff j ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h; exact hH.1 (Polynomial.ext h)
    have hjd : j < d + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero hj).trans hH.2.1)
    refine ⟨⟨j, hjd⟩, fun hmem ↦ hj ?_⟩
    rw [← hcH ⟨j, hjd⟩]
    exact (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hmax.ne_top hmem)
  have hHBAR := reduced_form_eq_of_residue_coeff (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) d c H hH.2.1 hcH
  have hlc : H.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hH.1
  obtain ⟨hlm, -, hlt⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal _ _ _ beta D
  have : ∀ s, (leftPoint D s).IsMaximal := hlm
  have mult (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) (φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
      (hPφ : ((leftPoint D s).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b))).map e = Ideal.span
          {φ.val}) :
      Dv (some φ) = leftMultiplicity D s := by
    unfold leftMultiplicity leftLevelIdeal finiteLocalCurveIdeal
    rw [(hleft s).1, pow_one, concrete_strict_transform_multiplicity O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne
      (leftPoint D s) (hlt s) e he heZ φ.val φ.property hPφ, hHBAR, ENat.toNat_natCast]
    conv_rhs => rw [hH.2.2.2]
    exact ((count_normalizedFactors_divisorAffinePolynomial _ Dv _ hlc φ).1).symm
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ ?_, fun k ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨φ, hφ, himg, hslope⟩ :=
      chart_point_eq_directionPoint _ _ _ e he heZ (leftPoint D (Sum.inl i)) (hlt (Sum.inl i))
    have hZ := (overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal _ _ _ (D.Q i) (D.onE i)).2.1
    refine ⟨φ, fun h0 ↦ hZ (hslope.2 h0), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← show leftPoint D (Sum.inl i) = _ from hφ]
      exact (IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (tSlope O pi u a b)) _ (D.Q i)).symm
    · rw [mult (Sum.inl i) φ himg]
      exact (two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq _ _ _ beta D i).1
  · obtain ⟨φ, hφ, himg, hslope⟩ :=
      chart_point_eq_directionPoint _ _ _ e he heZ (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k)) (hlt (Sum.inr k))
    obtain rfl : φ = zeroAffine _ := hslope.1 (D.slope0 k)
    exact ⟨hφ, mult (Sum.inr k) _ himg⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_datum_matches_divisor
statement:
private theorem curve_datum_matches_divisor (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * surfaceT O pi u a b ^ (d - i.val) *
      surfaceX O pi u a b ^ i.val)
    [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (hH : HasHomogeneousDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) d H Dv)
    (hcH : ∀ i : Fin (d+1), IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (c i) = H.coeff i.val)
    (e : (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+*
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)
      (tBase O pi u a b r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b) (tSlope O pi u a b)) = Polynomial.X)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      beta)
    (hleft : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftData D s = completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)
      (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
        tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∧ (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
          (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) * tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∈ leftPoint D s)
    (hleftsurj : ∀ P : Ideal (tChart O pi u a b), P.IsMaximal →
      tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P → (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) * tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∈ P →
      ∃ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftPoint D s = P)
    (hright : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, Ideal.span {rightData D s} = Ideal.span {completedPointMap
      (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s) (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) * xSlope O pi u a b^(d - i.val))} ∧ (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap
          (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) * xSlope O pi u a b^(d - i.val)) ∈
        rightPoint D s)
    (hrightsurj : ∀ P : Ideal (xChart O pi u a b), P.IsMaximal →
      xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b) ∈ P → (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) * xSlope O pi u a b^(d - i.val)) ∈
          P → ∃ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, rightPoint D s = P) :
    MatchesDivisor e D Dv
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := curve_datum_common_and_zero_clauses O pi hpi u a b ha d c H Dv hH hcH e he heZ beta D
    hleft
  have h2 := curve_datum_surj_and_inf_clauses O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hc H Dv hH hcH e he heZ beta D
    hleft hleftsurj hright hrightsurj
  exact ⟨h1.1, h2.1, h1.2, h2.2.1, h2.2.2.1, h2.2.2.2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.matches_divisor_degree
statement:
theorem matches_divisor_degree (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] (S : SurfaceData O R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R S.t S.x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R S.t S.x beta)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+*
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (hm : MatchesDivisor e D Dv) [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R S.x S.t)] :
    exceptionalDegree (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) Dv = curveDataDegree D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set F := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  have hP := direction_point_maximal O R S e he heZ
  have hO := direction_point_overlap_maximal O R S e he heZ
  have hinjdir : Function.Injective (directionPoint R S.t S.x e) := (hP (zeroAffine F)).2.2.2.2.2
  choose φ hφ0 hφQ hφm using hm.common
  have hleft (i) : leftPoint D (Sum.inl i) = directionPoint R S.t S.x e (φ i) := by
    change (D.Q i).comap _ = _
    rw [hφQ i]; exact (hO (φ i) (hφ0 i)).2.2
  have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := fun i j h ↦ D.inj (by rw [hφQ i, hφQ j, h])
  have hsurj : ∀ ψ : AffineDirection F, ψ ≠ zeroAffine F → 0 < Dv (some ψ) → ∃ i, φ i = ψ := by
    intro ψ hψ hpos
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hm.common_surj ψ hψ hpos
    refine ⟨i, hinjdir ?_⟩
    rw [← hleft i]
    change (D.Q i).comap _ = _
    rw [hi]; exact (hO ψ hψ).2.2
  have hdeg (ψ : AffineDirection F) :
      (Module.length R (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ directionPoint R S.t S.x e ψ)).toNat =
        ψ.val.natDegree := by
    rw [(hP ψ).2.2.2.2.1]; rfl
  have : Fintype D.ι := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have : Fintype D.ι0 := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have : Fintype D.ιinf := Fintype.ofFinite _
  unfold curveDataDegree
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  have hc : ∀ i, leftResidueDegree D (Sum.inl i) * leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inl i) =
      directionDegree F (some (φ i)) * Dv (some (φ i)) := by
    intro i
    unfold leftResidueDegree
    rw [hleft i, hdeg, (two_chart_common_multiplicity_eq R _ _ beta D i).1, hφm i]
    rfl
  have hz : ∑ k : D.ι0, leftResidueDegree D (Sum.inr k) * leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inr k) =
      directionDegree F (zeroDirection F) * Dv (zeroDirection F) := by
    by_cases hne : Nonempty D.ι0
    · obtain ⟨k⟩ := hne
      have : Subsingleton D.ι0 := ⟨fun a b => D.inj0 ((hm.zero a).1.trans (hm.zero b).1.symm)⟩
      rw [Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ k]
      unfold leftResidueDegree
      change (Module.length R (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ D.P0 k)).toNat * _ = _
      rw [(hm.zero k).1, hdeg, ← (hm.zero k).2]
      rfl
    · have h0 : Dv (zeroDirection F) = 0 := by
        by_contra h; exact hne (hm.zero_surj (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h))
      rw [h0, mul_zero]
      have : IsEmpty D.ι0 := not_nonempty_iff.mp hne
      simp
  have hi : ∑ l : D.ιinf, rightMultiplicity D (Sum.inr l) =
      directionDegree F none * Dv none := by
    by_cases hne : Nonempty D.ιinf
    · obtain ⟨l⟩ := hne
      have : Subsingleton D.ιinf := ⟨fun a b => D.injinf ((hm.inf a).1.trans (hm.inf b).1.symm)⟩
      rw [Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ l, ← (hm.inf l).2]
      change _ = 1 * _
      rw [one_mul]
    · have h0 : Dv none = 0 := by
        by_contra h; exact hne (hm.inf_surj (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h))
      rw [h0, mul_zero]
      have : IsEmpty D.ιinf := not_nonempty_iff.mp hne
      simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hc i), hz, hi]
  have hz1 : ∀ i, (some (φ i) : ClosedDirection F) ≠ zeroDirection F := by
    intro i h
    exact hφ0 i (Option.some_injective _ h)
  unfold exceptionalDegree
  rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset Dv (s := insert none (insert (zeroDirection F)
      (Finset.univ.image (fun i => (some (φ i) : ClosedDirection F))))) ?_ _ (by simp)]
  · rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp [zeroDirection]), Finset.sum_insert (by simpa using hz1),
      Finset.sum_image (fun a _ b _ h => hφinj (Option.some_injective _ h))]
    ring
  · intro P hPm
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hPm
    rcases P with _ | ψ
    · simp
    · by_cases hψ : ψ = zeroAffine F
      · subst hψ; simp [zeroDirection, zeroAffine]
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hsurj ψ hψ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hPm)
        simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.fixed_tangent_cell_curve_datum
statement:
theorem fixed_tangent_cell_curve_datum (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
        [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] (S : SurfaceData O
            (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hS : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b ∧ S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (e :
        (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
            (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)
        (tBase O pi u a b r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b) (tSlope O pi u a b)) = Polynomial.X)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) (s : State)
        (d : ℕ) (J : Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hJ : J ∈ fixedTangentCell O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S s d Dv)
        (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
            (surfaceX O pi u a b)) :
    ∃ (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (c : Fin (d+1) → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
            (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta), J = Ideal.span {f} ∧
      f = ∑ i : Fin (d+1), c i * surfaceT O pi u a b^(d - i.val) * surfaceX O pi u a b^i.val ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        leftData D s = completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)
          (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
              tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∈ leftPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
        Ideal.span {rightData D s} = Ideal.span {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b)
            (rightPoint D s)
          (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
              xSlope O pi u a b^(d - i.val))} ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            xSlope O pi u a b^(d - i.val)) ∈ rightPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
            (leftPoint D s) d J = Ideal.span {leftData D s}) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
            (rightPoint D s) d J = Ideal.span {rightData D s}) ∧
      MatchesDivisor e D Dv ∧
      curveDataDegree D = exceptionalDegree (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
          Dv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ht, hx⟩ := hS
  cases S with | mk a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 a8 a9 a10 a11 a12 a13 a14 a15
  dsimp only at ht hx
  subst ht hx
  obtain ⟨f, c, H, hJf, hf, hH, hcH, hne⟩ :=
    fixed_tangent_cell_generator_coefficients O _ _ s d Dv J hJ
  obtain ⟨D, hl, hls, hr, hrs, hst1, hst2⟩ :=
    curve_datum_of_parent_function O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hf hne beta
  have hm : MatchesDivisor e D Dv :=
    curve_datum_matches_divisor O pi hpi u a b ha d f c hf H Dv hH hcH e he heZ beta D hl hls hr hrs
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b)
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)
  have hd := matches_divisor_degree O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    ⟨a1, a2, surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b, a5, a6, a7, a8, a9, a10, a11, a12, a13, a14,
        a15⟩ beta D Dv e he heZ hm
  subst hJf
  exact ⟨f, c, D, rfl, hf, hl, hr, hst1, hst2, hm, hd.symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.level_one_kernel_polynomial
statement:
theorem level_one_kernel_polynomial (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (I : Ideal R) [I.IsMaximal]
    (hI : Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R) = I) [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial (R ⧸ I))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (P : ι → Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [∀ s, (P s).IsMaximal]
    (hinjP : Function.Injective P) (htP : ∀ s, chartBase R t x t ∈ P s)
    (g : ∀ s, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (P s))
    (hfin : ∀ s, ∃ L : ℕ, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (P s))).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime (P s))))^L ≤
      finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) (chartBase R t x t) (g s) 1) :
    ∃ (φ : ι → Polynomial (R ⧸ I)) (m : ι → ℕ), (∀ s, (φ s).Monic ∧ Irreducible (φ s)) ∧
      Function.Injective φ ∧ (∀ s, chartSlope R t x ∈ P s ↔ φ s = Polynomial.X) ∧
      (∀ s, Module.length R (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ P s) = ((φ s).natDegree : ℕ∞)) ∧
      (∀ s, Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (P s))
        (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) ⧸
          finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) (chartBase R t x t) (g s) 1) =
        (m s : ℕ∞)) ∧
      ((⨅ s, contractedLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) (chartBase R t x t) (g s) 1).map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {∏ᶠ s, φ s ^ m s}
proof:
:= by
  subst hI
  choose φ hmon hirr hφ hslope hlen using fun s ↦
    blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial R t x e he heZ (P s) (htP s)
  
  have hker_le (J : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) (hJ : chartBase R t x t ∈ J) :
      (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).comap
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) = J := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      Ideal.mk_ker]
    refine sup_eq_left.mpr ?_
    unfold chartExceptional
    rw [Ideal.span_le]; simpa using hJ
  have hemap_inj (J J' : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x))
      (h : J.map e = J'.map e) : J = J' := by
    rw [← Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective e e.bijective (I := J),
      ← Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective e e.bijective (I := J'), h]
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ := fun s s' h ↦ hinjP <| by
    rw [← hker_le _ (htP s), ← hker_le _ (htP s'), hemap_inj _ _ ((hφ s).trans (h ▸ (hφ s').symm))]
  
  have hpow : ∀ s, ∃ r : ℕ, ((contractedLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) (P s)
      (chartBase R t x t) (g s) 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e =
        Ideal.span {φ s ^ r} ∧
      Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (P s))
        (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) ⧸
          finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) (chartBase R t x t) (g s) 1) =
        (r : ℕ∞) := fun s => by
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hfin s
    obtain ⟨r, -, hr, hrlen⟩ := contracted_level_one_ideal_is_irreducible_power R t x e
      (P s) (φ s) (hφ s) (hirr s) (g s) L hL
    exact ⟨r, hr, hrlen⟩
  choose m hmult hm using hpow
  refine ⟨φ, m, fun s => ⟨hmon s, hirr s⟩, hinj, hslope, hlen, hm, ?_⟩
  set J : ι → Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) := fun s =>
    contractedLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) (chartBase R t x t) (g s) 1
  have hJt : ∀ s, chartBase R t x t ∈ J s := by
    intro s
    change completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) (chartBase R t x t) ∈
      finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupChart R t x) (P s) (chartBase R t x t) (g s) 1
    unfold finiteLocalCurveIdeal
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have h1 : (⨅ s, J s).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) =
      ⨅ s, (J s).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) := by
    rw [show (⨅ s, J s) = ⨅ s, ((J s).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).comap
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)) from
        iInf_congr (fun s => (hker_le _ (hJt s)).symm)]
    exact Ideal.map_iInf_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective _
  have h2 (K : ι → Ideal (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x)) :
      (⨅ s, K s).map e = ⨅ s, (K s).map e := by
    rw [show (⨅ s, K s) = ⨅ s, ((K s).map e).comap e from
        iInf_congr (fun s => (Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective e e.bijective).symm)]
    exact Ideal.map_iInf_comap_of_surjective _ e.surjective _
  let _ : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [h1, h2, iInf_congr hmult, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype]
  let _ := Ideal.Quotient.field (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R))
  exact pairwise_distinct_irreducible_pow_iInf (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) ι φ hmon hirr hinj m

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_left_level_one_kernel_polynomial
statement:
theorem two_chart_left_level_one_kernel_polynomial (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+*
      Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X) :
    ∃ φ : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0 → Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)),
        (∀ s, (φ s).Monic ∧ Irreducible (φ s)) ∧ Function.Injective φ ∧
        (∀ i, φ (Sum.inl i) ≠ Polynomial.X) ∧ (∀ k, φ (Sum.inr k) = Polynomial.X) ∧
        (∀ s, (φ s).natDegree = leftResidueDegree D s) ∧ (∀ k, leftResidueDegree D (Sum.inr k) = 1)
        ∧ ((leftKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e =
        Ideal.span {∏ᶠ s, φ s ^ leftMultiplicity D s}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmax, hinjP, htP⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal R t x beta D
  obtain ⟨φ, m, hφ, hinj, hslope, hlen, hm, hker⟩ := level_one_kernel_polynomial R t x _ rfl e he
    heZ (leftPoint D) hinjP htP (leftData D)
    (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R t x beta D 1).2
  have hmult : leftMultiplicity D = m := funext fun s => by
    unfold leftMultiplicity leftLevelIdeal; rw [hm s]; rfl
  have hdeg : ∀ s, (φ s).natDegree = leftResidueDegree D s := by
    intro s; unfold leftResidueDegree; rw [hlen s]; rfl
  have hX : ∀ k, φ (Sum.inr k) = Polynomial.X := fun k => (hslope (Sum.inr k)).1 (D.slope0 k)
  refine ⟨φ, hφ, hinj, fun i hi => ?_, hX, hdeg, fun k => ?_, by rw [hmult]; exact hker⟩
  · have hQ := D.onE i
    have := D.maximal i
    exact (overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal R t x (D.Q i) hQ).2.1 ((hslope (Sum.inl i)).2 hi)
  · rw [← hdeg, hX]; exact Polynomial.natDegree_X

name: SurfaceBlowup.leftKernel_le_restrictLeftData
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftKernel finiteSupportKernel
  refine le_iInf ?_
  rintro (i | k)
  exacts [iInf_le _ (Sum.inl i.1), iInf_le _ (Sum.inr k.1)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.left_kernel_polynomial_residueField
statement:
private theorem left_kernel_polynomial_residueField (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (beta : BlowupRestriction R S.t S.x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R S.t S.x
      beta) (e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+*
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X)
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)] :
    ∃ ψ : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0 → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R),
        (∀ s, (ψ s).Monic ∧ Irreducible (ψ s)) ∧ (∀ s, (ψ s).natDegree = leftResidueDegree D s) ∧
      ((leftKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x))).map e =
          Ideal.span {∏ᶠ s, ψ s ^ leftMultiplicity D s}
proof:
:= by
  have : (Ideal.span ({S.t, S.x} : Set R)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [S.parameters]; exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  let κ : (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({S.t, S.x} : Set R)) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField R :=
    Ideal.quotEquivOfEq S.parameters
  let e₀ := e.trans (Polynomial.mapEquiv κ).symm
  have he₀ : ∀ r : R, e₀ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({S.t,S.x} : Set R)) r) := by
    intro r
    simp only [e₀, RingEquiv.trans_apply, he]
    rw [Polynomial.mapEquiv_symm_apply, Polynomial.map_C]
    congr 1
  have heZ₀ : e₀ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) =
      Polynomial.X := by
    simp only [e₀, RingEquiv.trans_apply, heZ]
    rw [Polynomial.mapEquiv_symm_apply, Polynomial.map_X]
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, -, -, -, hdeg, -, hK⟩ :=
    two_chart_left_level_one_kernel_polynomial R S.t S.x beta D e₀ he₀ heZ₀
  refine ⟨fun s => (φ s).map (κ : _ →+* _), fun s => ⟨(hφ s).1.map _, ?_⟩, fun s => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff (Polynomial.mapEquiv κ).toMulEquiv).2 (hφ s).2
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective κ.injective, hdeg]
  · have hmap : ∀ I : Ideal (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x),
        I.map e = (I.map e₀).map (Polynomial.mapEquiv κ) := by
      intro I
      rw [← Ideal.map_coe e, ← Ideal.map_coe e₀, ← Ideal.map_coe (Polynomial.mapEquiv κ),
          Ideal.map_map]
      congr 1
      exact RingHom.ext fun a => by
        simp only [e₀, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
          RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [hmap, hK, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    congr 2
    have : Fintype (D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    rw [finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype, finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype, map_prod]
    simp [Polynomial.mapEquiv_apply, Polynomial.map_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pow_le_comap_completedPointMap
statement:
private theorem pow_le_comap_completedPointMap (A : Type) [CommRing A] (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (J : Ideal (CompletedLocalAt A P)) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
        (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P))) ^ L ≤ J) :
    P^L ≤ J.comap (completedPointMap A P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.map_pow]
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hL
  congr 1
  unfold completedPointMap
  rw [← Ideal.map_map, Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]

name: SurfaceBlowup.left_kernel_map_le_span_direction_pow
statement:
private theorem left_kernel_map_le_span_direction_pow (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (beta : BlowupRestriction R S.t S.x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData R S.t S.x beta)
    (e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+*
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X)
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)] (s₀ : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0)
    (ψ₀ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (hP : leftPoint D s₀ = directionPoint R S.t S.x e ψ₀) :
    ((leftKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x))).map e ≤
      Ideal.span {ψ₀.val ^ leftMultiplicity D s₀}
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : (Ideal.span ({S.t, S.x} : Set R)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [S.parameters]; exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  set q := Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x)
  let D' := restrictLeftData D (fun i ↦ Sum.inl i = s₀) (fun j ↦ Sum.inr j = s₀)
  have hsub : ∀ s s' : D'.ι ⊕ D'.ι0, s = s' := by
    rintro (⟨i, hi⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩) (⟨i', hi'⟩ | ⟨j', hj'⟩) <;>
      first
      | (cases hi.trans hi'.symm; rfl) | cases hi.trans hj'.symm
      | cases hj.trans hi'.symm | (cases hj.trans hj'.symm; rfl)
  obtain ⟨s₁, hm₁⟩ : ∃ s₁ : D'.ι ⊕ D'.ι0, leftMultiplicity D' s₁ = leftMultiplicity D s₀ := by
    rcases s₀ with i | j
    exacts [⟨.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩]
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, -, hK'⟩ := left_kernel_polynomial_residueField O R S beta D' e he heZ
  rw [finprod_eq_single _ s₁ (fun s hs ↦ absurd (hsub s s₁) hs), hm₁] at hK'
  have hmono : ((leftKernel D 1).map q).map e ≤ ((leftKernel D' 1).map q).map e :=
    Ideal.map_mono (Ideal.map_mono (leftKernel_le_restrictLeftData D _ _))
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (leftMultiplicity D s₀) with h0 | hpos
  · rw [h0, pow_zero, Ideal.span_singleton_one]; exact le_top
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite R S.t S.x beta D 1).2 s₀
  have hPL : (leftPoint D s₀)^L ≤ leftKernel D' 1 := by
    unfold leftKernel finiteSupportKernel
    have h := pow_le_comap_completedPointMap _ _ _ L hL
    refine le_iInf fun s ↦ ?_
    rcases s with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩ <;> exact h
  have hmemP : ψ₀.val ∈ ((leftPoint D s₀).map q).map e := by
    rw [hP, (direction_point_maximal O R S e he heZ ψ₀).2.2.2.1]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (fun a ↦ e (q a)) :=
    e.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  rw [← Ideal.map_coe e, Ideal.map_map] at hmemP
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hae⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ hsurj).1 hmemP
  have h1 : Ideal.span {ψ₀.val ^ L} ≤ Ideal.span {ψ s₁ ^ leftMultiplicity D s₀} := by
    rw [← hK', Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, ← hae, ← map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hPL (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha L)))
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton] at h1
  have h4 : ψ s₁ = ψ₀.val := Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated (hψ s₁).1 ψ₀.2.1
    ((hψ s₁).2.associated_of_dvd ψ₀.2.2
      ((hψ s₁).2.prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow ((dvd_pow_self _ hpos.ne').trans h1)))
  rw [← h4, ← hK']
  exact hmono

name: SurfaceBlowup.matches_divisor_level_one_polynomial
statement:
theorem matches_divisor_level_one_polynomial (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (beta : BlowupRestriction R S.t S.x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData R S.t S.x beta) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+*
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (hm : MatchesDivisor e D Dv) [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)] :
    ((leftKernel D 1).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x))).map e =
      Ideal.span {divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) Dv}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmax : (Ideal.span ({S.t, S.x} : Set R)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [S.parameters]; exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  set k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  set q := Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x)
  have hdp := direction_point_maximal O R S e he heZ
  have hQ {i : D.ι} {ψ : AffineDirection k} (hψ : ψ ≠ zeroAffine k)
      (h : D.Q i = (directionPoint R S.t S.x e ψ).map
