    · simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]; ring
  | crossing a b c h =>
    obtain ⟨hdc, hdh, hrt, hrx⟩ := hrest
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W, patternWeight P.other = W := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    simp only [children, List.map_append, List.sum_append, otherChildren_degree_sum, hW]
    rw [hW] at hsum
    simp only [State.degree]
    generalize P.d.val = D at *
    generalize P.rt.val = R at *
    generalize P.rx.val = X at *
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, c = D + k := ⟨c - D, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, h = D + l := ⟨h - D, by omega⟩
    subst hsum
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    have e1 : R = 0 → k = 0 := by omega
    have e2 : X = 0 → l = 0 := by omega
    split_ifs <;>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil] <;>
      (try (obtain rfl := e1 ‹R = 0›; subst ‹R = 0›)) <;>
      (try (obtain rfl := e2 ‹X = 0›; subst ‹X = 0›)) <;> ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.children_residue_degree_pos
statement:
theorem children_residue_degree_pos (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (z : ℕ × State)
    (hz : z ∈ children s P) :
    0 < z.1
proof:
:= by
  have hO : ∀ (a : ℕ) (m : Pattern s.degree), z ∈ otherChildren a m → 0 < z.1 := by
    intro a m h
    simp only [otherChildren, List.mem_flatMap] at h
    obtain ⟨ij, _, h⟩ := h
    simp [List.eq_of_mem_replicate h]
  cases s <;> simp only [children, List.mem_append] at hz
  · exact hz.elim (fun hz ↦ by split_ifs at hz <;> simp_all) (hO _ _)
  · exact hz.elim (fun hz ↦ by rcases hz with hz | hz <;> split_ifs at hz <;> simp_all) (hO _ _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_degree_le
statement:
theorem child_degree_le (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (hP : Allowed s P) (z : ℕ × State) (hz : z ∈ children s P) :
    z.2.degree ≤ s.degree
proof:
:= by
  calc z.2.degree ≤ z.1*z.2.degree :=
        Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (children_residue_degree_pos s P z hz)
    _ ≤ ((children s P).map fun z ↦ z.1*z.2.degree).sum :=
        List.single_le_sum (by simp) _ (List.mem_map.2 ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)
    _ = _ := children_degree_identity s hs P hP

name: SurfaceBlowup.children_valid
statement:
theorem children_valid (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (hP : Allowed s P) (z : ℕ × State) (hz : z ∈ children s P) :
    z.2.Valid
proof:
:= by
  have other : ∀ (a : ℕ) (m : Pattern s.degree), 0 < a → z ∈ otherChildren a m → z.2.Valid := by
    intro a m ha h
    simp only [otherChildren, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_replicate] at h
    obtain ⟨ij, _, _, rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨ha, Nat.succ_pos _⟩
  obtain ⟨hd, hsum, hrest⟩ := hP
  cases s with
  | single a c =>
    obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨hdc, hrx, hrt⟩ := hrest
    simp only [children, List.mem_append] at hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · split_ifs at hz with h0
      · simp at hz
      · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.1 hz
        exact ⟨ha, ha, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0, by have := hrt.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0); omega⟩
    · exact other a _ ha hz
  | crossing a b c h =>
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hh⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨hdc, hdh, hrt, hrx⟩ := hrest
    simp only [children, List.mem_append] at hz
    rcases hz with (hz | hz) | hz
    · split_ifs at hz with h0
      · simp at hz
      · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.1 hz
        have := hrt.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0)
        exact ⟨by omega, ha, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0, by omega⟩
    · split_ifs at hz with h0
      · simp at hz
      · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.1 hz
        have := hrx.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0)
        exact ⟨by omega, hb, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0, by omega⟩
    · exact other (a+b) _ (by omega) hz

name: SurfaceBlowup.other_children_count
statement:
theorem other_children_count (n : ℕ) (m : Pattern n) (δ r : ℕ) :
    List.count (δ, State.single 1 r) (otherChildren 1 m) =
        (if h : 1 ≤ δ ∧ δ ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ n then
          (m (⟨δ - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_le h.1 h.2.1⟩,
            ⟨r - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_le h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2⟩)).val else 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ otherChildren 1 m,
        ∃ ij : Fin n × Fin n, z = (ij.1.val + 1, State.single 1 (ij.2.val + 1))) ∧
      (otherChildren 1 m).length = ∑ ij : Fin n × Fin n, (m ij).val
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun z hz ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold otherChildren
    rw [List.count_flatMap]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, List.count_replicate, beq_iff_eq]
    rw [Finset.sum_map_toList (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n))
      (fun ij ↦ if ((ij.1.val + 1, State.single 1 (ij.2.val + 1)) : ℕ × State) =
        (δ, State.single 1 r) then (m ij).val else 0)]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨δ - 1, by omega⟩, ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩)]
      · rw [if_pos]
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, State.single.injEq]
        exact ⟨by omega, trivial, by omega⟩
      · intro b _ hb
        rw [if_neg]
        simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, State.single.injEq]
        rintro ⟨h1, -, h2⟩
        apply hb
        ext <;> simp <;> omega
      · simp
    · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ij _ ↦ if_neg ?_
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, State.single.injEq]
      have := ij.1.isLt
      have := ij.2.isLt
      omega
  · simp only [otherChildren, List.mem_flatMap] at hz
    obtain ⟨ij, _, h⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨ij, (List.mem_replicate.mp h).2⟩
  · simp [otherChildren, List.length_flatMap, Finset.sum_map_toList]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rank_lt_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem rank_lt_of_degree_lt (s u : State) (hu : u.Valid)
    (h : u.degree < s.degree) :
    u.rank < s.rank
proof:
:= by
  have ht : u.tag ≤ 1 := by cases u <;> simp [State.tag]
  have h1 : u.degree - u.weight ≤ u.degree := Nat.sub_le _ _
  unfold State.rank
  have h3 : (u.degree + 1) * (u.degree + 1) ≤ s.degree * s.degree := Nat.mul_le_mul h h
  nlinarith

name: SurfaceBlowup.density_value_arith
statement:
theorem density_value_arith (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (x y : Expr) (hx : 0 ≤ x.eval q)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y.eval q) (n : ℕ) (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) :
    densityValue (.mul x y) q = densityValue x q * densityValue y q ∧
      densityValue (.add x y) q = densityValue x q + densityValue y q ∧
      densityValue (.inv (.pow .var n)) q = (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n ∧
      densityValue (.const 1) q = 1 ∧ densityValue x q ≠ ⊤ ∧
      (0 < x.eval q → densityValue x q ≠ 0) ∧ 0 < (stateVolume s).eval q ∧
      (stateVolume s).eval q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hqpos : (0 : ℚ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
  have hvol : 0 < (stateVolume s).eval (q : ℚ) := by
    cases s with
    | single a c =>
      simp only [stateVolume, Expr.eval, expression_pow_eval]
      positivity
    | crossing a b c h =>
      have h1 : (1 : ℚ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < q)
      simp only [stateVolume, Expr.eval, expression_pow_eval, eminusOne, Expr.sub, Expr.neg]
      exact mul_pos (by linarith) (inv_pos.2 (pow_pos hqpos _))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
    fun h ↦ (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast h)).ne', hvol, hvol.ne'⟩
  · simp only [densityValue, Expr.eval]
    push_cast
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  · simp only [densityValue, Expr.eval]
    push_cast
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_add (by exact_mod_cast hx) (by exact_mod_cast hy)
  · simp only [densityValue, Expr.eval, expression_pow_eval]
    push_cast
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity),
      ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ENNReal.inv_pow]
  · simp [densityValue, Expr.eval]

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisor_count_safe
statement:
theorem divisor_count_safe (n : ℕ) (offset : ℤ) (m : Pattern n) :
    (divisorCount offset m).allSafe
proof:
:= by
  intro q _
  have hav : ∀ δ, (availablePoints offset δ).safe q := by
    intro δ
    unfold availablePoints
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨trivial, trivial⟩
    · refine ⟨trivial, expression_sum_safe _ _ ?_⟩
      simp only [List.mem_map]
      rintro _ ⟨j, _, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨trivial, expression_pow_safe _ _ _ trivial⟩
  refine expression_prod_safe _ _ ?_
  simp only [List.mem_map]
  rintro _ ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨expression_prod_safe _ _ ?_, trivial⟩
  simp only [List.mem_map]
  rintro _ ⟨j, _, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨hav _, trivial, trivial⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisor_probability_safe
statement:
theorem divisor_probability_safe (s : State) (d : ℕ) :
    (divisorProbability s d).allSafe
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hq' : (2:ℚ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hE : eminusOne.safe q := by
    simp [eminusOne, Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.safe]
  have hEv : eminusOne.eval q = (q:ℚ) - 1 := by
    simp [eminusOne, Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval]; ring
  have hV : ∀ n : ℕ, ((Expr.var).pow n).safe q ∧ ((Expr.var).pow n).eval q ≠ 0 := fun n ↦
    ⟨expression_pow_safe _ _ _ trivial, by
      simpa [expression_pow_eval, Expr.eval] using pow_ne_zero n (by linarith : (q:ℚ) ≠ 0)⟩
  have hP : ∀ n : ℕ, (eminusOne.pow n).safe q := fun n ↦ expression_pow_safe _ _ _ hE
  cases s with
  | single a c => exact ⟨hV _, hP _⟩
  | crossing a b c h =>
    simp only [divisorProbability, Expr.safe]
    refine ⟨hV _, ?_⟩
    split_ifs
    all_goals first
      | exact hP _
      | exact ⟨hE, by rw [hEv]; linarith⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.scaleType_injective
statement: private theorem scaleType_injective {δ : ℕ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : Function.Injective (scaleType δ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.map_injective
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨c, d⟩ h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h ⊢
  exact ⟨h.1, Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hδ h.2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoeff_eval
statement:
private theorem lawCoeff_eval (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff L σ).eval q = (L.map fun z ↦ if z.1 = σ then z.2.eval q else 0).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lawCoeff, expression_sum_eval, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left fun z _ ↦ ?_
  split_ifs <;> simp [Expr.eval, *]

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_descend
statement:
theorem law_coeff_descend (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (L : Law) (τ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff (lawDescend δ L) (scaleType δ τ)).eval q = (lawCoeff L τ).eval (q ^ δ) ∧
      ∀ σ : FactorType, (∀ τ' : FactorType, σ ≠ scaleType δ τ') →
        (lawCoeff (lawDescend δ L) σ).eval q = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun σ hσ ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp only [lawCoeff_eval, lawDescend, List.map_map]
    congr 1
    refine List.map_congr_left fun z _ ↦ ?_
    simp [(scaleType_injective hδ).eq_iff, expression_subst_eval, expression_pow_eval, Expr.eval]
  · rw [lawCoeff_eval]
    refine List.sum_eq_zero fun x hx ↦ ?_
    simp only [lawDescend, List.map_map, List.mem_map, Function.comp_def] at hx
    obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact if_neg fun e ↦ hσ z.1 e.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_nil
statement: theorem lawInterp_nil : lawInterp v [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_append
statement: theorem lawInterp_append (L M : Law) : lawInterp v (L ++ M) = lawInterp v L + lawInterp v M
proof:
:= by
  simp [lawInterp]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_flatMap
statement:
theorem lawInterp_flatMap {α : Type} (xs : List α) (g : α → Law) :
    lawInterp v (xs.flatMap g) = (xs.map fun u ↦ lawInterp v (g u)).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp [lawInterp, List.flatMap_def, List.map_flatten, List.sum_flatten, List.map_map,
    Function.comp_def]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_lawMul
statement:
theorem lawInterp_lawMul (hv : ∀ x y, v (.mul x y) = v x * v y) (L M : Law) :
    lawInterp v (lawMul L M) = lawInterp v L * lawInterp v M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lawInterp, lawMul, List.flatMap_def, List.map_flatten, List.sum_flatten,
    List.map_map, Function.comp_def, ← List.sum_map_mul_right]
  simp [← List.sum_map_mul_left, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, hv]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_lawScale
statement:
theorem lawInterp_lawScale (hv : ∀ x y, v (.mul x y) = v x * v y) (x : Expr) (L : Law) :
    lawInterp v (lawScale x L) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (v x) * lawInterp v L
proof:
:= by
  simp [lawInterp, lawScale, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, ← List.sum_map_mul_left,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, hv]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_lawProd
statement:
theorem lawInterp_lawProd (hv : ∀ x y, v (.mul x y) = v x * v y) (h1 : v (.const 1) = 1)
    (Ls : List Law) : lawInterp v (lawProd Ls) = (Ls.map (lawInterp v)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction Ls with
  | nil => simp [lawProd, lawOne, lawInterp, h1, AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]
  | cons L Ls ih => rw [lawProd, List.foldr_cons, ← lawProd, lawInterp_lawMul v hv, ih]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_coeff
statement:
theorem lawInterp_coeff (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) :
    (lawInterp v L).coeff σ = (L.map fun z ↦ if z.1 = σ then v z.2 else 0).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [lawInterp, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffAddEquiv_apply, map_list_sum,
    ← Finsupp.applyAddHom_apply, map_list_sum]
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawInterp_coeff_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem lawInterp_coeff_eq_zero (L : Law) (τ : FactorType)
    (h : τ ∉ (L.map Prod.fst).toFinset) : (lawInterp v L).coeff τ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lawInterp_coeff]
  refine List.sum_eq_zero fun x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  exact if_neg fun e ↦ h (List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.mem_map.2 ⟨z, hz, e⟩))

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawCoeff_eval_interp
statement:
private theorem lawCoeff_eval_interp (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff L σ).eval q = (lawInterp (fun x ↦ x.eval q) L).coeff σ
proof:
:=
  (lawCoeff_eval L σ q).trans (lawInterp_coeff _ L σ).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_flatMap
statement:
theorem law_coeff_flatMap (α : Type) (xs : List α) (f : α → Law) (L M : Law) (σ : FactorType)
    (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff (L ++ M) σ).eval q = (lawCoeff L σ).eval q + (lawCoeff M σ).eval q ∧
      (lawCoeff ([] : Law) σ).eval q = 0 ∧
      (lawCoeff (xs.flatMap f) σ).eval q = (xs.map fun x ↦ (lawCoeff (f x) σ).eval q).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lawCoeff_eval_interp, lawInterp_append, lawInterp_nil, lawInterp_flatMap,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply,
    Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, true_and]
  rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffAddEquiv_apply, map_list_sum, ← Finsupp.applyAddHom_apply,
    map_list_sum, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_mul
statement:
theorem law_coeff_mul (L M : Law) (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff (lawMul L M) σ).eval q = ∑ τ ∈ (L.map Prod.fst).toFinset,
      (if τ ≤ σ then (lawCoeff L τ).eval q * (lawCoeff M (σ - τ)).eval q else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lawCoeff_eval_interp]
  set f := lawInterp (fun x ↦ x.eval q) L with hf0
  have hf : f = ∑ τ ∈ (L.map Prod.fst).toFinset, AddMonoidAlgebra.single τ (f.coeff τ) := by
    ext τ
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
      Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs with h
    exacts [rfl, lawInterp_coeff_eq_zero _ L τ h]
  rw [lawInterp_lawMul (fun x ↦ x.eval q) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl), ← hf0]
  conv_lhs => rw [hf, Finset.sum_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun τ _ ↦ ?_
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le h
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_add, add_tsub_cancel_left]
  · exact AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_of_forall_add_ne _ _ fun d e ↦ h (e ▸ le_self_add)

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_piFinset_succ
statement:
private theorem sum_piFinset_succ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → Finset FactorType)
    (F : (Fin (n + 1) → FactorType) → ℚ) :
    ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, F τ
      = ∑ τ₀ ∈ t 0, ∑ τ' ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ t i.succ), F (Fin.cons τ₀ τ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_product']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun τ ↦ (τ 0, Fin.tail τ)) (fun p ↦ Fin.cons p.1 p.2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro τ hτ
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hτ ⊢
    exact ⟨hτ 0, fun i ↦ hτ i.succ⟩
  · intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hp ⊢
    exact fun i ↦ Fin.cases (by simpa using hp.1) (fun j ↦ by simpa using hp.2 j) i
  all_goals intros; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_prod_descend
statement:
theorem law_coeff_prod_descend (Ls : List (ℕ × Law)) (hδ : ∀ z ∈ Ls, 0 < z.1)
    (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff (lawProd (Ls.map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 z.2)) σ).eval q =
      ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j : Fin Ls.length ↦ ((Ls.get j).2.map Prod.fst).toFinset),
        (if σ = ∑ j, scaleType (Ls.get j).1 (τ j) then
          ∏ j, (lawCoeff (Ls.get j).2 (τ j)).eval (q ^ (Ls.get j).1) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction Ls generalizing σ with
  | nil =>
    simp [lawProd, lawOne, lawCoeff, expression_sum_eval, Fintype.piFinset_of_isEmpty,
      eq_comm, apply_ite, Expr.eval]
  | cons z Ls ih =>
    obtain ⟨δ, L⟩ := z
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδ _ List.mem_cons_self
    have ih' := fun σ ↦ ih (fun w hw ↦ hδ w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)) σ
    rw [List.map_cons, lawProd, List.foldr_cons, ← lawProd, law_coeff_mul]
    have hmap : ((lawDescend δ L).map Prod.fst).toFinset
        = (L.map Prod.fst).toFinset.image (scaleType δ) := by
      ext x; simp [lawDescend]
    rw [hmap, Finset.sum_image fun x _ y _ h ↦ scaleType_injective hδ0 h]
    change _ = ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j : Fin (Ls.length + 1) ↦
      (((δ, L) :: Ls).get j).2.map Prod.fst |>.toFinset), _
    rw [sum_piFinset_succ]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ρ _ ↦ ?_
    rw [(law_coeff_descend δ hδ0 L ρ q).1]
    
    have hs : ∀ f : Fin (Ls.length + 1) → FactorType,
        ∑ j, f j = f 0 + ∑ j : Fin Ls.length, f j.succ := Fin.sum_univ_succ
    have hp : ∀ f : Fin (Ls.length + 1) → ℚ, ∏ j, f j = f 0 * ∏ j : Fin Ls.length, f j.succ :=
      Fin.prod_univ_succ
    have hg : ∀ i : Fin Ls.length, ((δ, L) :: Ls).get i.succ = Ls.get i := fun i ↦ rfl
    split_ifs with hle
    · rw [ih', Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun τ' _ ↦ ?_
      erw [hs, hp]
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, List.get_cons_zero, hg,
        tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le hle, mul_ite, mul_zero, add_comm]
    · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun τ' _ ↦ if_neg fun h ↦ ?_).symm
      erw [hs] at h
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero, List.get_cons_zero] at h
      exact hle (h ▸ le_self_add)

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_prod_formula
statement:
theorem law_coeff_prod_formula (L : ℕ) (Dl : Fin L → Law) (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    ((lawCoeff (lawProd (List.ofFn Dl)) σ).eval q =
        ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j ↦ ((Dl j).map Prod.fst).toFinset),
          (if σ = ∑ j, τ j then ∏ j, (lawCoeff (Dl j) (τ j)).eval q else 0)) ∧
      ∀ (M : Law) (τ : FactorType), τ ∉ (M.map Prod.fst).toFinset →
        (lawCoeff M τ).eval q = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun M τ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · induction L generalizing σ with
    | zero =>
      simp [lawProd, lawOne, lawCoeff, expression_sum_eval, Fintype.piFinset_of_isEmpty,
        eq_comm, apply_ite, Expr.eval]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, lawProd, List.foldr_cons, ← lawProd, law_coeff_mul, sum_piFinset_succ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun τ₀ _ ↦ ?_
      rw [ih (fun i ↦ Dl i.succ)]
      split_ifs with hle
      · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun τ' _ ↦ ?_
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
        simp only [tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le hle, mul_ite, mul_zero, add_comm]
      · refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun τ' _ ↦ if_neg fun h ↦ hle ?_).symm
        rw [h, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero]
        exact le_self_add
  · rw [lawCoeff_eval_interp]
    exact lawInterp_coeff_eq_zero _ M τ h

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_scale
statement:
theorem law_coeff_scale (x : Expr) (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) (q : ℚ) :
    (lawCoeff (lawScale x L) σ).eval q = x.eval q * (lawCoeff L σ).eval q
proof:
:= by
  rw [lawCoeff_eval_interp, lawCoeff_eval_interp,
    lawInterp_lawScale (fun x ↦ x.eval q) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl), AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_zero_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_nonneg_closure
statement:
theorem law_coeff_nonneg_closure (q : ℚ) :
    (∀ (x : Expr) (L : Law), 0 ≤ x.eval q → (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval q) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawScale x L) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ L M : Law, (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval q) →
      (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff M σ).eval q) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawMul L M) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ Ls : List Law, (∀ L ∈ Ls, (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval q)) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawProd Ls) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ (α : Type) (xs : List α) (f : α → Law),
      (∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (f x) σ).eval q) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (xs.flatMap f) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ (δ : ℕ), 0 < δ → ∀ L : Law, (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval (q ^ δ)) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawDescend δ L) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ (a f : ℕ) (σ : FactorType), 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawAtom a f) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff lawOne σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ σ : FactorType, (lawCoeff ([] : Law) σ).eval q = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : ∀ L M : Law, (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval q) →
      (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff M σ).eval q) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawMul L M) σ).eval q := by
    intro L M hL hM σ
    rw [law_coeff_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun τ _ ↦ ?_
    split_ifs
    · exact mul_nonneg (hL _) (hM _)
    · exact le_rfl
  have hone : ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff lawOne σ).eval q := by
    intro σ
    simp only [lawCoeff_eval, lawOne, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    split_ifs <;> simp [Expr.eval]
  refine ⟨fun x L hx hL σ ↦ by rw [law_coeff_scale]; exact mul_nonneg hx (hL σ), hmul, ?_, ?_,
    ?_, ?_, hone, fun σ ↦ by simp [lawCoeff_eval]⟩
  · intro Ls
    induction Ls with
    | nil => exact fun _ ↦ hone
    | cons L Ls ih =>
      exact fun h ↦ hmul _ _ (h L (by simp)) (ih fun L' hL' ↦ h L' (by simp [hL']))
  · intro α xs f h σ
    rw [(law_coeff_flatMap α xs f [] [] σ q).2.2]
    refine List.sum_nonneg fun y hy ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
    exact h x hx σ
  · intro δ hδ L h σ
    by_cases hs : ∃ τ, σ = scaleType δ τ
    · obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hs
      rw [(law_coeff_descend δ hδ L τ q).1]
      exact h τ
    · push Not at hs
      rw [(law_coeff_descend δ hδ L 0 q).2 σ hs]
  · intro a f σ
    simp only [lawCoeff_eval, lawAtom, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    split_ifs <;> simp [Expr.eval]

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_safe_descend
statement:
theorem law_safe_descend (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (L : Law) (hL : LawSafe L) :
    LawSafe (lawDescend δ L)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  simp only [lawDescend, List.mem_map] at hz
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
  intro q hq
  refine expression_subst_safe _ _ _ (expression_pow_safe _ _ _ trivial) ?_
  rw [expression_pow_eval]
  have : ((q:ℚ))^δ = ((q^δ : ℕ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; rfl
  change w.2.safe _
  simp only [Expr.eval]
  rw [this]
  exact hL w hw _ (hq.trans (Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) q))

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_safe_mul
statement:
theorem law_safe_mul (L M : Law) (hL : LawSafe L) (hM : LawSafe M) :
    LawSafe (lawMul L M)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  simp only [lawMul, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map] at hz
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hz
  exact fun q hq ↦ ⟨hL a ha q hq, hM b hb q hq⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_safe_scale
statement:
theorem law_safe_scale (x : Expr) (L : Law) (hx : x.allSafe) (hL : LawSafe L) :
    LawSafe (lawScale x L)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  simp only [lawScale, List.mem_map] at hz
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
  exact fun q hq ↦ ⟨hx q hq, hL w hw q hq⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_cylinder_clopen
statement:
theorem coordinate_cylinder_clopen (O : Type) [CommRing O] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] (I : Ideal O) (htop : IsAdic I) (L : ℕ) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → O), IsOpen {b : Fin n → O | ∀ j, b j - a j ∈ I ^ L} ∧
        IsClosed {b : Fin n → O | ∀ j, b j - a j ∈ I ^ L}) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → O), CompactSpace O →
        IsCompact {b : Fin n → O | ∀ j, b j - a j ∈ I ^ L}) ∧
      (∀ (ι : Type) (d : ι → ℕ) (c : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O),
        IsClosed (Set.pi Set.univ fun i ↦ {b : Fin (d i) → O | ∀ j, b j - c i j ∈ I ^ L}))
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen (((I ^ L : Ideal O).toAddSubgroup : AddSubgroup O) : Set O) :=
    AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds _ ((htop.hasBasis_nhds_zero).mem_of_mem (i := L) trivial)
  have hclosed := AddSubgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen _ hopen
  have hcyl : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → O), IsOpen {b : Fin n → O | ∀ j, b j - a j ∈ I ^ L} ∧
      IsClosed {b : Fin n → O | ∀ j, b j - a j ∈ I ^ L} := by
    intro n a
    have e : {b : Fin n → O | ∀ j, b j - a j ∈ I ^ L} = ⋂ j, (fun b : Fin n → O ↦ b j - a j) ⁻¹'
        (((I ^ L : Ideal O).toAddSubgroup : AddSubgroup O) : Set O) := by
      ext b; simp
    have hc : ∀ j, Continuous fun b : Fin n → O ↦ b j - a j := fun j ↦
      (continuous_apply j).sub continuous_const
    rw [e]
    exact ⟨isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun j ↦ hopen.preimage (hc j),
      isClosed_iInter fun j ↦ hclosed.preimage (hc j)⟩
  exact ⟨hcyl, fun n a _ ↦ (hcyl n a).2.isCompact,
    fun ι d c ↦ isClosed_set_pi fun i _ ↦ (hcyl (d i) (c i)).2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.coprime_of_monic_reduction_one
statement:
theorem coprime_of_monic_reduction_one (R K : Type) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (A B : Polynomial R)
    (hA : A.Monic) (hB : B.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) = 1) :
    IsCoprime (A.map (algebraMap R K)) (B.map (algebraMap R K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj := IsFractionRing.injective R K
  by_contra hnc
  set A' := A.map (algebraMap R K)
  set B' := B.map (algebraMap R K)
  have hd : ¬ IsUnit (EuclideanDomain.gcd A' B') := by
    rwa [EuclideanDomain.gcd_isUnit_iff]
  have hd0 : EuclideanDomain.gcd A' B' ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    (hA.map _).ne_zero (EuclideanDomain.gcd_eq_zero_iff.mp h).1
  obtain ⟨h, hirr, hdvd⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor hd hd0
  set g := C (h.leadingCoeff)⁻¹ * h
  have hlc : h.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hirr.ne_zero
  have hgm : g.Monic := monic_C_mul_of_mul_leadingCoeff_eq_one (inv_mul_cancel₀ hlc)
  have hgh : g ∣ h := ⟨C h.leadingCoeff, by
    rw [mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hlc, C_1, one_mul]⟩
  have hgA : g ∣ A' := hgh.trans (hdvd.trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _))
  have hgB : g ∣ B' := hgh.trans (hdvd.trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
  have hgdeg : 0 < g.natDegree := by
    rw [natDegree_C_mul (inv_ne_zero hlc), natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos]
    exact degree_pos_of_irreducible hirr
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.eq_map_mul_C_of_dvd K hA hgA
  rw [hgm.leadingCoeff, C_1, mul_one] at hh₀
  have hh₀m : h₀.Monic := monic_of_injective hinj (hh₀ ▸ hgm)
  have hdeg : h₀.natDegree = g.natDegree := by
    rw [← hh₀, natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj]
  have hh₀B : h₀ ∣ B := by
    rw [← map_dvd_map (algebraMap R K) hinj hh₀m, hh₀]; exact hgB
  have hu : IsUnit (h₀.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) :=
    isUnit_of_dvd_one (hB ▸ Polynomial.map_dvd (IsLocalRing.residue R) hh₀B)
  rw [(hh₀m.map _).isUnit_iff] at hu
  have := congrArg natDegree hu
  rw [hh₀m.natDegree_map, natDegree_one] at this
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_local_extension_unique_prime
statement:
theorem integral_local_extension_unique_prime (O B : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Algebra O B] [Algebra.IsIntegral O B] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).comap (algebraMap O B) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ∧
      ∀ Q : Ideal B, Q.IsPrime → Q.comap (algebraMap O B) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O →
        Q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal _),
    fun Q hQ hc ↦ ?_⟩
  have hm : (Q.comap (algebraMap O B)).IsMaximal := by rw [hc]; infer_instance
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap Q hm)

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_flat_local_ramification_degree
statement:
theorem finite_flat_local_ramification_degree (O B : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsLocalRing O] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Algebra O B] [Module.Finite O B]
    [Module.Flat O B] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx O * (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).inertiaDeg O =
      Module.finrank O B
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite O B
  obtain ⟨hcomap, huniq⟩ := integral_local_extension_unique_prime O B
  let m : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).primesOver B :=
    ⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B, inferInstance, ⟨(Ideal.under_def _ _).trans hcomap |>.symm⟩⟩
  let : Unique ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).primesOver B) :=
    { default := m
      uniq := fun q ↦ Subtype.ext (huniq q.1 q.2.1 (q.2.2.over.symm)) }
  have := Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia_eq_finrank (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (S := B)
  rwa [Fintype.sum_unique,
    show (default : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).primesOver B) = m from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_types_of_degree
statement:
theorem finite_types_of_degree (n : ℕ) :
    Set.Finite {σ : FactorType | ValidType σ ∧ typeDegree σ = n}
proof:
:= by
  set s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) := Finset.range (n+1) ×ˢ Finset.range (n+1)
  refine Set.Finite.subset ((n • s.val).powerset.toFinset.finite_toSet) ?_
  rintro σ ⟨hv, hd⟩
  simp only [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Multiset.mem_powerset, Finset.mem_coe]
  have hmem : ∀ z ∈ σ, z.1 * z.2 ≤ n := fun z hz ↦ hd ▸
    Multiset.le_sum_of_mem (Multiset.mem_map_of_mem (fun z : ℕ × ℕ ↦ z.1 * z.2) hz)
  have hcard : Multiset.card σ ≤ n := by
    rw [← hd, typeDegree]
    have : Multiset.card (σ.map fun z ↦ z.1 * z.2) • 1 ≤ (σ.map fun z ↦ z.1 * z.2).sum :=
      Multiset.card_nsmul_le_sum fun x hx ↦ by
        obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 hx
        exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (hv z hz).1.ne' (hv z hz).2.ne')
    simpa using this
  refine Multiset.le_iff_count.2 fun z ↦ ?_
  rw [Multiset.count_nsmul]
  by_cases hz : z ∈ σ
  · have h1 := hv z hz
    have h2 := hmem z hz
    have hzs : z ∈ s := by
      have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right z.1 h1.2
      have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left z.2 h1.1
      simp only [s, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
      omega
    rw [Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem s.nodup hzs, mul_one]
    exact (Multiset.count_le_card _ _).trans hcard
  · simp [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hz]

name: SurfaceBlowup.geometric_exit_sum
statement:
theorem geometric_exit_sum (lam G : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℕ ↦ lam^j * G) (G / (1 - lam))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ‖lam‖ < 1 := by rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hlam]
  rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  exact (hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one h).mul_right G

name: SurfaceBlowup.image_measurable_of_continuousOn_injOn_compact
statement:
theorem image_measurable_of_continuousOn_injOn_compact (X Y : Type) [TopologicalSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (C : Set X) (hC : IsClosed C)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f C) (hinj : Set.InjOn f C) (U : Set X) (hU : MeasurableSet U) :
    MeasurableSet (f '' (U ∩ C))
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace C := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hC.isCompact
  have hemb := (hf.domRestrict.isClosedEmbedding
    (Set.injOn_iff_injective.mp hinj)).measurableEmbedding
  have h := hemb.measurableSet_image.mpr (measurable_subtype_coe hU)
  rwa [Set.domRestrict_eq, Set.image_comp, Subtype.image_preimage_coe, Set.inter_comm] at h

name: SurfaceBlowup.list_get_fiber_card
statement:
theorem list_get_fiber_card (α : Type) [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) :
    Nat.card {j : Fin l.length // l.get j = x} = l.count x
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    have e : {j : Fin (a :: l).length // (a :: l).get j = x} ≃
        {_u : Unit // a = x} ⊕ {j : Fin l.length // l.get j = x} :=
      { toFun := fun j ↦ Fin.cases (motive := fun i ↦ (a :: l).get i = x → _)
          (fun h ↦ Sum.inl ⟨(), h⟩) (fun i h ↦ Sum.inr ⟨i, h⟩) j.1 j.2
        invFun := fun
          | Sum.inl h => ⟨0, h.2⟩
          | Sum.inr h => ⟨Fin.succ h.1, h.2⟩
        left_inv := by
          rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
          induction j using Fin.cases <;> rfl
        right_inv := by
          rintro (h | h) <;> rfl }
    rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_sum, ih, List.count_cons]
    by_cases h : a = x
    · subst h
      simp [Nat.add_comm]
    · have : IsEmpty {_u : Unit // a = x} := ⟨fun u ↦ h u.2⟩
      simp [h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_polynomial_degree
statement:
theorem monic_polynomial_degree (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → O) :
    (monicPolynomial O a).Monic ∧ (monicPolynomial O a).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : (∑ i : Fin n, Polynomial.C (algebraMap O (BaseField O) (a i)) *
      Polynomial.X^i.val).degree < (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
    refine (Polynomial.degree_sum_le _ _).trans_lt ((Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe n)).2
      fun i _ ↦ (Polynomial.degree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans_lt (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.2 i.isLt))
  refine ⟨Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add hdeg, ?_⟩
  unfold monicPolynomial
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt (by simpa using hdeg)]
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.nonboundary_direction_count
statement:
theorem nonboundary_direction_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State) (δ : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ((Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
        directionDegree k Q = δ} : ℕ) : ℚ) =
      (availablePoints
        (match s with | State.single _ _ => (0 : ℤ) | State.crossing _ _ _ _ => (-1 : ℤ))
        δ).eval (Nat.card k)
proof:
:= by
  have hN := finite_field_irreducible_count k δ hδ
  have hp1 : (pointCount 1).eval (Nat.card k) = (Nat.card k : ℚ) := by
    simp [pointCount, Expr.sum, Expr.eval, Expr.pow]
  set C : Prop := ((s matches State.crossing _ _ _ _) = true) with hC
  set T : Set (Polynomial k) :=
    {g | (g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g ∧ g.natDegree = δ) ∧ (C → g ≠ Polynomial.X)} with hT
  have hcard : Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k //
      Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧ directionDegree k Q = δ} = Set.ncard T := by
    rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    let f : T → {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧ directionDegree k Q = δ} :=
      fun g ↦ ⟨some ⟨g.1, g.2.1.1, g.2.1.2.1⟩, by
        obtain ⟨g, ⟨hm, hi, hd⟩, hx⟩ := g
        refine ⟨?_, hd⟩
        cases s <;> simp_all [boundaryDirections, infinityDirection, zeroDirection, C]⟩
    refine (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨?_, ?_⟩)).symm
    · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩ ⟨g', hg'⟩ h
      simp only [f, Subtype.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at h
      exact Subtype.ext h
    · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, hd⟩
      cases Q with
      | none => cases s <;> simp [boundaryDirections, infinityDirection] at hQ
      | some φ =>
        refine ⟨⟨φ.1, ⟨φ.2.1, φ.2.2, hd⟩, fun hc h ↦ hQ ?_⟩, rfl⟩
        cases s
        · simp [C] at hc
        · exact Or.inr (congrArg some (Subtype.ext h))
  rw [hcard]
  set A : Set (Polynomial k) := {g | g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g ∧ g.natDegree = δ} with hA
  have hNA : ((Set.ncard A : ℕ) : ℚ) = (pointCount δ).eval (Nat.card k) := by
    rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]; exact hN
  by_cases h1 : δ = 1
  · subst h1
    have hq : ((Set.ncard A : ℕ) : ℚ) = Nat.card k := by rw [hNA, hp1]
    cases s with
    | single a c =>
      have : T = A := by ext g; simp [T, A, C]
      rw [this, hq]; simp [availablePoints, Expr.eval]
    | crossing a b c h =>
      have hTA : T = A \ {Polynomial.X} := by ext g; simp [T, A, C]
      have hXA : Polynomial.X ∈ A :=
        ⟨Polynomial.monic_X, Polynomial.irreducible_X, Polynomial.natDegree_X⟩
      have hfin : A.Finite := Set.finite_of_ncard_pos (by
        have : (0 : ℚ) < (Set.ncard A : ℕ) := by rw [hq]; exact_mod_cast Nat.card_pos
        exact_mod_cast this)
      have := Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hXA hfin
      have h2 : ((Set.ncard (A \ {Polynomial.X}) : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 = Nat.card k := by
        rw [← hq]; exact_mod_cast this
      rw [hTA]
      simp [availablePoints, Expr.eval]; linarith
  · have : T = A := by
      ext g
      simp only [T, A, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
      rintro ⟨-, -, hd⟩ - rfl
      exact h1 (hd ▸ Polynomial.natDegree_X)
    rw [this, hNA]; simp [availablePoints, h1]

name: SurfaceBlowup.directionDegree_pos
statement: theorem directionDegree_pos (Q : ClosedDirection k) : 0 < directionDegree k Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q with
  | none => simp [directionDegree]
  | some φ => exact φ.property.2.natDegree_pos

name: SurfaceBlowup.inf_mem_bdry
statement: private theorem inf_mem_bdry (s : State) : infinityDirection k ∈ boundaryDirections k s
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp [boundaryDirections]

name: SurfaceBlowup.zero_ne_inf
statement: private theorem zero_ne_inf : zeroDirection k ≠ infinityDirection k
proof:
:= by
  simp [zeroDirection, infinityDirection]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_bdry_single
statement:
private theorem mem_bdry_single (a c : ℕ) (Q : ClosedDirection k) :
    Q ∈ boundaryDirections k (State.single a c) ↔ Q = infinityDirection k
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundaryDirections]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_bdry_crossing
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundaryDirections]

name: SurfaceBlowup.deg_of_mem_bdry
statement:
private theorem deg_of_mem_bdry (s : State) (Q : ClosedDirection k)
    (hQ : Q ∈ boundaryDirections k s) : directionDegree k Q = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | single a c =>
    rw [mem_bdry_single] at hQ
    subst hQ; rfl
  | crossing a b c h =>
    rcases (mem_bdry_crossing k a b c h Q).1 hQ with rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · simp [directionDegree, zeroDirection]

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_directionDegree_le
statement:
private theorem finite_directionDegree_le [Finite k] (n : ℕ) :
    Finite {Q : ClosedDirection k // directionDegree k Q ≤ n}
proof:
:= by
  let f : {Q : ClosedDirection k // directionDegree k Q ≤ n} → Option (Fin (n+1) → k) :=
    fun Q ↦ Option.map (fun φ : AffineDirection k ↦ fun i : Fin (n+1) ↦ φ.val.coeff i) Q.1
  refine Finite.of_injective f ?_
  rintro ⟨Q, hQ⟩ ⟨Q', hQ'⟩ h
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [f] at h
  cases Q with
  | none =>
    cases Q' with
    | none => rfl
    | some _ => simp at h
  | some φ =>
    cases Q' with
    | none => simp at h
    | some ψ =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h
      refine congrArg some (Subtype.ext (Polynomial.ext fun i ↦ ?_))
      by_cases hi : i < n + 1
      · exact congrFun h ⟨i, hi⟩
      · have h1 : φ.val.natDegree < i := by simp [directionDegree] at hQ; omega
        have h2 : ψ.val.natDegree < i := by simp [directionDegree] at hQ'; omega
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt h1,
          Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt h2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_fiber_eq
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr
    { toFun := fun Q ↦ ⟨Q.1.1, Q.1.2.1, Q.1.2.2, (hf Q.1).1 Q.2⟩
      invFun := fun Q ↦ ⟨⟨Q.1, Q.2.1, Q.2.2.1⟩, (hf _).2 Q.2.2.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }

name: SurfaceBlowup.deg_mul_mult_le
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : exceptionalDegree k D.1 = P.d.val := D.2.1
  have h3 : P.d.val ≤ s.degree := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp P.d.isLt
  by_cases hQ : D.1 Q = 0
  · simp [hQ]
  · have h1 : directionDegree k Q * D.1 Q ≤ exceptionalDegree k D.1 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun P ↦ directionDegree k P * D.1 P)
        (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hQ)
    omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.mult_le
statement:
private theorem mult_le (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (D : patternDivisors k s P)
    (Q : ClosedDirection k) : D.1 Q ≤ s.degree
proof:
:=
  (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (directionDegree_pos k Q)).trans (deg_mul_mult_le k s P D Q)

name: SurfaceBlowup.toColFun_eq_some_iff
proof:
:= by
  unfold toColFun
  split_ifs with h
  · simp only [false_iff]; omega
  · simp only [Option.some.injEq, Fin.ext_iff]; omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.coloring_congr
statement:
private theorem coloring_congr (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (F : ∀ i : Fin s.degree, Col k s P i) (i i' : Fin s.degree) (hii : i = i')
    (Q : ClosedDirection k) (hb : Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s)
    (h1 : directionDegree k Q = i.val + 1) (h2 : directionDegree k Q = i'.val + 1) :
    (F i).1 ⟨Q, hb, h1⟩ = (F i').1 ⟨Q, hb, h2⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst hii; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.elim_le
statement:
private theorem elim_le (n : ℕ) (o : Option (Fin n)) :
    Option.elim o 0 (fun j ↦ j.val + 1) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | some j => exact j.isLt

name: SurfaceBlowup.mult_inf
proof:
:= by
  unfold mult; rw [if_pos rfl]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mult_zero_crossing
statement:
private theorem mult_zero_crossing (a b c h : ℕ)
    (P : TangentPattern (State.crossing a b c h).degree)
    (F : ∀ i : Fin (State.crossing a b c h).degree, Col k (State.crossing a b c h) P i) :
    mult k (State.crossing a b c h) P F (zeroDirection k) = P.rx.val
proof:
:= by
  unfold mult
  rw [if_neg (zero_ne_inf k), dif_pos ((mem_bdry_crossing k a b c h _).2 (Or.inr rfl))]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mult_nonbdry
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hb, hQ⟩ := Q
  have hinf : Q ≠ infinityDirection k := fun h ↦ hb (h ▸ inf_mem_bdry k s)
  have hle : directionDegree k Q ≤ s.degree := by omega
  have hpos := directionDegree_pos k Q
  change mult k s P F Q = Option.elim ((F i).1 ⟨Q, hb, hQ⟩) 0 (fun j ↦ j.val + 1)
  unfold mult
  rw [if_neg hinf, dif_neg hb, dif_pos hle]
  congr 1
  exact coloring_congr k s P F ⟨directionDegree k Q - 1, by omega⟩ i
    (Fin.ext (by change directionDegree k Q - 1 = i.val; omega)) Q hb
    (by omega : directionDegree k Q = directionDegree k Q - 1 + 1) hQ

name: SurfaceBlowup.mult_support_finite
statement:
private theorem mult_support_finite [Finite k] (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (F : ∀ i : Fin s.degree, Col k s P i) : (Function.support (mult k s P F)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Set.Finite {Q : ClosedDirection k | directionDegree k Q ≤ max 1 s.degree} :=
    Set.finite_coe_iff.mp (finite_directionDegree_le k (max 1 s.degree))
  refine hfin.subset fun Q hQ ↦ ?_
  rw [Function.mem_support] at hQ
  change directionDegree k Q ≤ max 1 s.degree
  unfold mult at hQ
  split_ifs at hQ with h1 h2 h3
  · subst h1; exact le_max_left _ _
  · rw [deg_of_mem_bdry k s Q h2]; exact le_max_left _ _
  · exact le_trans h3 (le_max_right _ _)
  · exact absurd rfl hQ

name: SurfaceBlowup.toDiv_apply
proof: := rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.toDiv_some_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [toDiv_apply, mult_nonbdry k s P F i Q]
  cases (F i).1 Q with
  | none => simp
  | some j' => simp [Fin.ext_iff]

name: SurfaceBlowup.toDiv_card
statement:
private theorem toDiv_card [Finite k] (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (F : ∀ i : Fin s.degree, Col k s P i) (ij : Fin s.degree × Fin s.degree) :
    Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
      directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧ toDiv k s P F Q = ij.2.val + 1} =
        (P.other ij).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_fiber_eq k s (toDiv k s P F) ij.1 ij.2 (F ij.1).1 (toDiv_some_iff k s P F ij.1 ij.2)]
  exact (F ij.1).2 ij.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.degree_formula
statement:
private theorem degree_formula [Finite k] (s : State) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k) (n : ℕ)
    (hdeg : ∀ Q, 0 < Dv Q → directionDegree k Q ≤ n) (hmult : ∀ Q, Dv Q ≤ n) :
    exceptionalDegree k Dv = Dv (infinityDirection k) + (match s with
      | State.single _ _ => (0 : ℕ) | State.crossing _ _ _ _ => Dv (zeroDirection k)) +
      ∑ ij : Fin n × Fin n, (ij.1.val + 1) * (ij.2.val + 1) *
        Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
          directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧ Dv Q = ij.2.val + 1}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBsum⟩ : ∃ B : Finset (ClosedDirection k),
      (∀ Q, Q ∈ boundaryDirections k s ↔ Q ∈ B) ∧
      ∑ Q ∈ B, directionDegree k Q * Dv Q = Dv (infinityDirection k) +
        (match s with
          | State.single _ _ => (0 : ℕ) | State.crossing _ _ _ _ => Dv (zeroDirection k)) := by
    cases s with
    | single _ _ =>
      exact ⟨{infinityDirection k}, fun Q ↦ by simp [boundaryDirections],
        by simp [infinityDirection, directionDegree]⟩
    | crossing _ _ _ _ =>
      refine ⟨{infinityDirection k, zeroDirection k}, fun Q ↦ by simp [boundaryDirections], ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_pair (by simp [infinityDirection, zeroDirection])]
      simp [infinityDirection, zeroDirection, directionDegree]
  set f : ClosedDirection k → ℕ := fun Q ↦ directionDegree k Q * Dv Q with hf
  change ∑ Q ∈ Dv.support, f Q = _
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Dv.support (fun Q ↦ Q ∈ B)]
  congr 1
  · rw [← hBsum]
    refine Finset.sum_subset (fun Q hQ ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.1 hQ).2) fun Q hQB hQ ↦ ?_
    have : Dv Q = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hQ (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h, hQB⟩)
    simp [f, this]
  · rcases n with _ | m
    · simp [fun Q ↦ Nat.le_zero.1 (hmult Q)]
    · set g : ClosedDirection k → Fin (m+1) × Fin (m+1) :=
        fun Q ↦ (⟨(directionDegree k Q - 1) % (m+1), Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos _)⟩,
          ⟨(Dv Q - 1) % (m+1), Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos _)⟩)
      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := Dv.support.filter (fun Q ↦ Q ∉ B))
        (t := Finset.univ) (g := g) (fun _ _ ↦ Finset.mem_univ _)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ij _ ↦ ?_
      have hmem : ∀ Q, Q ∈ (Dv.support.filter (fun Q ↦ Q ∉ B)).filter (fun Q ↦ g Q = ij) ↔
          (Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧ directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧
            Dv Q = ij.2.val + 1) := by
        intro Q
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hB, g, Prod.ext_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
        have h1 := directionDegree_pos k Q
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hne, hnb⟩, ha, hb⟩
          have hd := hdeg Q (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne)
          have hm := hmult Q
          rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at ha hb
          exact ⟨hnb, by omega, by omega⟩
        · rintro ⟨hnb, ha, hb⟩
          refine ⟨⟨by omega, hnb⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [ha, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ij.1.2]
          · rw [hb, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ij.2.2]
      rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun Q ↦ (hmem Q).symm)),
        Nat.card_eq_finsetCard,
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ ↦ (ij.1.val + 1) * (ij.2.val + 1)),
        Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      intro Q hQ
      obtain ⟨_, ha, hb⟩ := (hmem Q).1 hQ
      simp [f, ha, hb]

name: SurfaceBlowup.toDiv_hasPattern
statement:
private theorem toDiv_hasPattern [Finite k] (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (hP : P.rt.val + P.rx.val + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val)
    (hrx : ∀ a c, s = State.single a c → P.rx.val = 0)
    (F : ∀ i : Fin s.degree, Col k s P i) : HasPattern k s (toDiv k s P F) P
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : ∀ Q, 0 < toDiv k s P F Q → directionDegree k Q ≤ s.degree := by
    intro Q hQ
    rw [toDiv_apply] at hQ
    unfold mult at hQ
    split_ifs at hQ with h1 h2 h3
    · subst h1
      change 1 ≤ s.degree
      have := P.rt.isLt; omega
    · rw [deg_of_mem_bdry k s Q h2]; have := P.rx.isLt; omega
    · exact h3
    · exact absurd hQ (lt_irrefl 0)
  have hmult : ∀ Q, toDiv k s P F Q ≤ s.degree := by
    intro Q
    rw [toDiv_apply]
    unfold mult
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp P.rt.isLt
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp P.rx.isLt
    · exact elim_le _ _
    · exact Nat.zero_le _
  have hsum : ∑ ij : Fin s.degree × Fin s.degree, (ij.1.val + 1) * (ij.2.val + 1) *
      Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
        directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧ toDiv k s P F Q = ij.2.val + 1} =
      patternWeight P.other :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ij _ ↦ by rw [toDiv_card k s P F ij]
  refine ⟨?_, mult_inf k s P F, ?_, toDiv_card k s P F⟩
  · rw [degree_formula k s (toDiv k s P F) s.degree hdeg hmult, hsum, toDiv_apply, mult_inf]
    cases s with
    | single a c =>
      have := hrx a c rfl
      change P.rt.val + 0 + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val
      omega
    | crossing a b c h =>
      change P.rt.val + toDiv k _ P F (zeroDirection k) + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val
      rwa [toDiv_apply, mult_zero_crossing]
  · cases s with
    | single a c => trivial
    | crossing a b c h =>
      change toDiv k _ P F (zeroDirection k) = P.rx.val
      rw [toDiv_apply, mult_zero_crossing]

name: SurfaceBlowup.toDiv_toCol
statement:
private theorem toDiv_toCol [Finite k] (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (D : patternDivisors k s P) : toDiv k s P (toCol k s P D) = D.1
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  rw [toDiv_apply]
  by_cases h1 : Q = infinityDirection k
  · subst h1; rw [mult_inf]; exact D.2.2.1.symm
  by_cases h2 : Q ∈ boundaryDirections k s
  · cases s with
    | single a c => exact absurd ((mem_bdry_single k a c Q).1 h2) h1
    | crossing a b c h =>
      rcases (mem_bdry_crossing k a b c h Q).1 h2 with rfl | rfl
      · exact absurd rfl h1
      · rw [mult_zero_crossing]
        exact D.2.2.2.1.symm
  by_cases h3 : directionDegree k Q ≤ s.degree
  · have hpos := directionDegree_pos k Q
    rw [mult_nonbdry k s P (toCol k s P D) ⟨directionDegree k Q - 1, by omega⟩
      ⟨Q, h2, (by omega : directionDegree k Q = directionDegree k Q - 1 + 1)⟩]
    unfold toCol toColFun
    dsimp only
    split_ifs with hz
    · simp only [Option.elim]; omega
    · simp only [Option.elim]
      change D.1 Q - 1 + 1 = D.1 Q
      omega
  · unfold mult
    rw [if_neg h1, dif_neg h2, dif_neg h3]
    by_contra hne
    have h4 := deg_mul_mult_le k s P D Q
    have h5 : directionDegree k Q ≤ directionDegree k Q * D.1 Q :=
      Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Ne.symm hne))
    omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.toCol_toDiv
statement:
private theorem toCol_toDiv [Finite k] (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (hP : P.rt.val + P.rx.val + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val)
    (hrx : ∀ a c, s = State.single a c → P.rx.val = 0)
    (F : ∀ i : Fin s.degree, Col k s P i) :
    toCol k s P ⟨toDiv k s P F, toDiv_hasPattern k s P hP hrx F⟩ = F
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun Q ↦ ?_)
  change toColFun k s P ⟨toDiv k s P F, toDiv_hasPattern k s P hP hrx F⟩ i Q = (F i).1 Q
  have hm : toDiv k s P F Q.1 = Option.elim ((F i).1 Q) 0 (fun j ↦ j.val + 1) :=
    mult_nonbdry k s P F i Q
  unfold toColFun
  cases hFQ : (F i).1 Q with
  | none =>
    rw [hFQ] at hm
    exact if_pos hm
  | some j =>
    rw [hFQ] at hm
    simp only [Option.elim] at hm
    rw [if_neg (by change toDiv k s P F Q.1 ≠ 0; omega)]
    exact congrArg some (Fin.ext (by change toDiv k s P F Q.1 - 1 = j.val; omega))

name: SurfaceBlowup.patternDivisors_equiv_colorings
statement:
theorem patternDivisors_equiv_colorings (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State)
    (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (hP : P.rt.val + P.rx.val + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val)
    (hrx : ∀ a c, s = State.single a c → P.rx.val = 0) :
    Nonempty (patternDivisors k s P ≃ ∀ i : Fin s.degree,
      {f : {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
          directionDegree k Q = i.val + 1} → Option (Fin s.degree) //
        ∀ j : Fin s.degree, Nat.card {Q // f Q = some j} = (P.other (i, j)).val})
proof:
:=
  ⟨{ toFun := toCol k s P
     invFun := fun F ↦ ⟨toDiv k s P F, toDiv_hasPattern k s P hP hrx F⟩
     left_inv := fun D ↦ Subtype.ext (toDiv_toCol k s P D)
     right_inv := fun F ↦ toCol_toDiv k s P hP hrx F }⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_colorings
statement:
private theorem card_colorings (T : Type) [Finite T] (r : ℕ) (m : Fin r → ℕ) :
    ((Nat.card {f : T → Option (Fin r) // ∀ j : Fin r, Nat.card {x // f x = some j} = m j} :
        ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ((List.range (∑ i : Fin r, m i)).map fun j ↦ (Nat.card T : ℚ) - j).prod
          / ∏ i : Fin r, (Nat.factorial (m i) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain e := Finite.equivFin T
  have hequiv : {f : T → Option (Fin r) // ∀ j : Fin r, Nat.card {x // f x = some j} = m j} ≃
      {f : Fin (Nat.card T) → Option (Fin r) //
        ∀ i : Fin r, Nat.card {x : Fin (Nat.card T) // f x = some i} = m i} := by
    refine Equiv.subtypeEquiv (Equiv.arrowCongr e (Equiv.refl _)) fun f ↦ forall_congr' fun j ↦ ?_
    rw [Nat.card_congr (e.subtypeEquiv (p := fun x ↦ f x = some j)
      (q := fun x ↦ (Equiv.arrowCongr e (Equiv.refl _) f) x = some j)
      fun x ↦ by simp [Equiv.arrowCongr_apply])]
  rw [Nat.card_congr hequiv, colored_subset_count]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pattern_divisor_count
statement:
theorem pattern_divisor_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (s : State)
    (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (hP : Allowed s P) :
    Finite (patternDivisors k s P) ∧
      ((Nat.card (patternDivisors k s P) : ℕ) : ℚ) = (tangentCount s P).eval (Nat.card k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := patternDivisors_equiv_colorings k s P hP.2.1
    (fun a c hs ↦ by subst hs; exact hP.2.2.2.1)
  have hfin : ∀ i : Fin s.degree, Finite
      {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧ directionDegree k Q = i.val + 1} :=
    fun i ↦ have := finite_directionDegree_le k (i.val + 1)
      Finite.of_injective (fun Q ↦ (⟨Q.1, Q.2.2.le⟩ : {Q // directionDegree k Q ≤ i.val + 1}))
        fun _ _ h ↦ Subtype.ext (Subtype.mk.inj h)
  refine ⟨Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_pi, Nat.cast_prod]
  unfold tangentCount divisorCount
  rw [expression_prod_eval, List.map_map, Finset.prod_map_toList]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have := hfin i
  rw [card_colorings]
  simp only [Function.comp, Expr.eval, falling, expression_prod_eval, List.map_map]
  rw [nonboundary_direction_count k s (i.val + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _), div_eq_mul_one_div]
  congr 2
  refine List.map_congr_left fun j _ ↦ ?_
  cases s <;> simp [Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.tangent_count_nonneg
statement:
theorem tangent_count_nonneg (Q : ℕ) (hQ : PrimePower Q) (s : State)
    (P : TangentPattern s.degree) (hP : Allowed s P) :
    0 ≤ (tangentCount s P).eval Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, e, hp, he, rfl⟩ := hQ
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have : Finite (GaloisField p e) := Module.finite_of_finite (ZMod p)
  have h := (pattern_divisor_count (GaloisField p e) s P hP).2
  rw [GaloisField.card p e he.ne'] at h
  exact h ▸ Nat.cast_nonneg _

name: SurfaceBlowup.primePower_pow
statement:
private theorem primePower_pow (Q : ℕ) (hQ : PrimePower Q) (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    PrimePower (Q ^ δ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, r, hp, hr, rfl⟩ := hQ
  exact ⟨p, r * δ, hp, Nat.mul_pos hr hδ, (pow_mul p r δ).symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.stateLawFuel_coeff_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro s _ Q _ σ
    simp only [stateLawFuel]
    exact le_of_eq ((law_coeff_nonneg_closure (Q : ℚ)).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 σ).symm
  | succ k ih =>
    intro s hs Q hQ σ
    obtain ⟨hScale, -, hProd, hFlat, hDesc, hAtom, -, hNil⟩ := law_coeff_nonneg_closure (Q : ℚ)
    have hQ2 : 2 ≤ Q := prime_power_ge_two Q hQ
    have hterms : ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff ((allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
        if SelfPattern s P then [] else
          lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
            (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel k z.2)))) σ).eval
              Q := by
      refine hFlat _ _ _ fun P hPmem σ ↦ ?_
      have hP : Allowed s P := by
        rw [Finset.mem_toList, allowedPatterns, Finset.mem_filter] at hPmem
        exact hPmem.2
      split_ifs
      · exact le_of_eq (hNil σ).symm
      · refine hScale _ _ (by
          simpa only [Expr.eval] using mul_nonneg (tangent_count_nonneg Q hQ s P hP)
            (divisor_probability_pos Q hQ2 s P.d.val 2 le_rfl).1.le) (hProd _ ?_) σ
        simp only [List.mem_map]
        rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        have hz1 := children_residue_degree_pos s P z hz
        refine hDesc z.1 hz1 _ fun σ ↦ ?_
        exact_mod_cast ih z.2 (children_valid s hs P hP z hz) (Q ^ z.1)
          (primePower_pow Q hQ z.1 hz1) σ
    cases s with
    | single a c =>
      rcases c with _ | _ | c
      · exact absurd hs.2 (lt_irrefl 0)
      · exact hAtom a 1 σ
      · exact hScale _ _
          (divisor_probability_pos Q hQ2 (State.single a 0) 0 (c + 2) (by omega)).2.le hterms σ
    | crossing a b c h => exact hterms σ

name: SurfaceBlowup.state_law_coeff_nonneg
statement:
theorem state_law_coeff_nonneg (Q : ℕ) (hQ : PrimePower Q) (s : State) (hs : s.Valid)
    (σ : FactorType) :
    0 ≤ (lawCoeff (stateLaw s) σ).eval Q ∧
      ∀ δ : ℕ, 0 < δ → 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawDescend δ (stateLaw s)) σ).eval Q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨stateLawFuel_coeff_nonneg _ s hs Q hQ σ, fun δ hδ ↦ ?_⟩
  refine (law_coeff_nonneg_closure (Q : ℚ)).2.2.2.2.1 δ hδ _ (fun σ ↦ ?_) σ
  exact_mod_cast stateLawFuel_coeff_nonneg (s.rank + 1) s hs (Q ^ δ) (primePower_pow Q hQ δ hδ) σ

name: SurfaceBlowup.continuousOn_of_congruence_compatible
statement:
theorem continuousOn_of_congruence_compatible (O₁ O₂ : Type) [CommRing O₁] [TopologicalSpace O₁]
    [IsTopologicalRing O₁] (I₁ : Ideal O₁) (h₁ : IsAdic I₁) [CommRing O₂] [TopologicalSpace O₂]
    [IsTopologicalRing O₂] (I₂ : Ideal O₂) (h₂ : IsAdic I₂) (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (n₂ : ℕ) (C : Set (∀ i, Fin (d i) → O₁)) (f : (∀ i, Fin (d i) → O₁) → (Fin n₂ → O₂))
    (hf : ∀ (L : ℕ), ∀ a ∈ C, ∀ a' ∈ C, (∀ i j, a i j - a' i j ∈ I₁ ^ L) →
      ∀ j, f a j - f a' j ∈ I₂ ^ L) :
    ContinuousOn f C
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  intro a ha s hs
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hat, hts⟩ := ((finite_coordinate_cylinder_basis O₂ I₂ h₂ n₂).mem_nhds_iff).1 hs
  rcases ht with rfl | ⟨L, x, rfl⟩
  · exact absurd hat (Set.notMem_empty _)
  have hU : {a' : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O₁ | ∀ i j, a' i j - a i j ∈ I₁ ^ L} ∈ nhds a := by
    have : {a' : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O₁ | ∀ i j, a' i j - a i j ∈ I₁ ^ L}
        = ⋂ i, (fun a' ↦ a' i) ⁻¹' {b : Fin (d i) → O₁ | ∀ j, b j - a i j ∈ I₁ ^ L} := by
      ext a'; simp
    refine IsOpen.mem_nhds ?_ (by simp)
    rw [this]
    exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i ↦
      ((coordinate_cylinder_clopen O₁ I₁ h₁ L).1 (d i) (a i)).1.preimage (continuous_apply i)
  have hmem : {a' | ∀ i j, a' i j - a i j ∈ I₁ ^ L} ∩ C ∈ nhdsWithin a C :=
    Filter.inter_mem (mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds hU) self_mem_nhdsWithin
  rw [Filter.mem_map]
  refine Filter.mem_of_superset hmem fun a' ⟨h1, h2'⟩ ↦ hts ?_
  change adicCongr I₂ L (f a') x
  have hc : adicCongr I₂ L (f a') (f a) := by
    rw [finite_coordinate_adic_congruence]
    intro j
    have := (I₂ ^ L).neg_mem (hf L a ha a' h2' (fun i j ↦ by
      simpa using (Ideal.neg_mem_iff _).2 (h1 i j)) j)
    simpa using this
  exact (adic_congruence_rules O₂ (Fin n₂ → O₂) I₂).2.2.1 L _ _ _ hc hat

name: SurfaceBlowup.count_otherChildren
statement:
private theorem count_otherChildren {n : ℕ} (a : ℕ) (m : Pattern n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (otherChildren a m).count (i.val + 1, State.single a (j.val + 1)) = (m (i, j)).val
proof:
:= by
  unfold otherChildren
  rw [List.count_flatMap, Finset.sum_map_toList]
  simp only [Function.comp, List.count_replicate]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (i,j)]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    refine if_neg fun h ↦ hb ?_
    simp only [beq_iff_eq, Prod.mk.injEq, State.single.injEq, add_left_inj, true_and] at h
    exact Prod.ext (Fin.ext h.1) (Fin.ext h.2)
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_selfOther
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_eq_single _ (fun b _ hb ↦ hf b fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦ hb ?_) (by simp)
  exact Prod.ext (Fin.ext h1) (Fin.ext (by simp; omega))

name: SurfaceBlowup.weight_selfOther
statement:
private theorem weight_selfOther {n : ℕ} (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hcn : c ≤ n) (m : Pattern n)
    (hm : IsSelfOther c m) : patternWeight m = c
proof:
:= by
  unfold patternWeight
  rw [sum_selfOther c hc hcn _ fun ij h ↦ by rw [hm, if_neg h, mul_zero], hm,
    if_pos ⟨rfl, show c - 1 + 1 = c by omega⟩]
  change (0+1)*((c-1)+1)*1 = c; omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.otherChildren_selfOther
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (otherChildren a m).length = 1 := by
    rw [otherChildren, List.length_flatMap, Finset.sum_map_toList]
    simp only [List.length_replicate]
    rw [sum_selfOther c hc hcn _ fun ij h ↦ by rw [hm, if_neg h], hm,
      if_pos ⟨rfl, show c - 1 + 1 = c by omega⟩]
  have h2 := count_otherChildren a m ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨c-1, by omega⟩
  rw [hm, if_pos ⟨rfl, show c - 1 + 1 = c by omega⟩] at h2
  simp only [show c - 1 + 1 = c by omega] at h2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.1 h1
  rw [hy] at h2 ⊢
  by_cases e : y = (1, State.single a c)
  · rw [e]
  · simp [e] at h2

name: SurfaceBlowup.selfPattern_other
statement:
private theorem selfPattern_other (a c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hca : c ≤ a * c) :
    IsSelfOther c (selfPattern a c hc hca).other
proof:
:= fun ij ↦ by
  simp only [selfPattern]; split_ifs <;> rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.eq_selfPattern
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', c', hs, hch⟩ := hS
  cases hs
  have hrt : P.rt.val = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    simp [children, h] at hch
  simp only [children, hrt, if_true, List.nil_append] at hch
  have hm : IsSelfOther c P.other := by
    intro ij
    rw [← count_otherChildren a P.other ij.1 ij.2, hch]
    simp [List.count_cons]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have hw := weight_selfOther (n := (State.single a c).degree) c hc hca _ hm
  obtain ⟨hd0, hsum, hdc, hrx, hiff⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨d, rt, rx, other⟩ := P
  simp only at hrt hrx hsum hm hw hd0 hdc hiff
  unfold selfPattern
  congr 1
  · ext; change d.val = c; omega
  · ext; change rt.val = 0; omega
  · ext; change rx.val = 0; omega
  · funext ij; ext; rw [hm]; split_ifs <;> rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.filter_selfPattern_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : selfPattern a c hc hca ∈
      (allowedPatterns (.single a c)).toList.filter (SelfPattern (.single a c)) := by
    simp only [List.mem_filter, Finset.mem_toList, allowedPatterns, Finset.mem_filter,
      Finset.mem_univ, true_and, decide_eq_true_eq]
    have hw := weight_selfOther (n := (State.single a c).degree) c hc hca _
      (selfPattern_other a c hc hca)
    have ho := otherChildren_selfOther (n := (State.single a c).degree) a c hc hca _
      (selfPattern_other a c hc hca)
    refine ⟨⟨hc, ?_, ?_⟩, a, c, rfl, by simp only [children, ho]; rfl⟩
    · rw [hw]; change 0 + 0 + c = c; omega
    · change c ≤ c ∧ 0 = 0 ∧ (0 < 0 ↔ c < c); omega
  refine ((List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup ((Finset.nodup_toList _).filter _)
    (List.nodup_singleton _)).2 fun b ↦ ⟨fun hb ↦ ?_, fun hb ↦ ?_⟩).eq_singleton
  · simp only [List.mem_filter, Finset.mem_toList, allowedPatterns, Finset.mem_filter,
      decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 (eq_selfPattern a c hc hca b hb.1.2 hb.2)
  · exact List.mem_singleton.1 hb ▸ hmem

name: SurfaceBlowup.tangentCount_selfPattern_eval
statement:
private theorem tangentCount_selfPattern_eval (a c q : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hca : c ≤ a * c) :
    (tangentCount (.single a c) (selfPattern a c hc hca)).eval (q:ℚ) = q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tangentCount, divisorCount]
  rw [expression_prod_eval, List.map_map, Finset.prod_map_toList,
    Finset.prod_eq_single (⟨0, by change 0 < a*c; omega⟩ : Fin (State.single a c).degree)]
  · simp only [Function.comp, Expr.eval, selfPattern_other, true_and]
    have hs : (∑ x : Fin (State.single a c).degree, if x.val + 1 = c then 1 else 0) = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨c-1, by change c-1 < a*c; omega⟩ :
        Fin (State.single a c).degree)]
      · simp; omega
      · exact fun b _ hb ↦ if_neg fun h ↦ hb (Fin.ext (by simp; omega))
      · simp
    have hp : (∏ x : Fin (State.single a c).degree,
        (((if x.val + 1 = c then 1 else 0 : ℕ)).factorial : ℚ)) = 1 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ ↦ by split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [hs, hp]
    simp [falling, expression_prod_eval, availablePoints, Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval]
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [selfPattern_other, Fin.val_ne_iff.2 hb, falling, expression_prod_eval, Expr.eval]
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.self_patterns_of_single_state
statement:
theorem self_patterns_of_single_state (a c q : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    (∀ P : TangentPattern (State.single a c).degree, Allowed (State.single a c) P →
        SelfPattern (State.single a c) P →
          P.d.val = c ∧ children (State.single a c) P = [(1, State.single a c)]) ∧
      (((allowedPatterns (State.single a c)).toList.filter (SelfPattern (State.single a c))).map
        fun P ↦ (tangentCount (State.single a c) P).eval q).sum = q
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < c := by omega
  have hca : c ≤ a*c := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left c ha
  refine ⟨fun P hA hS ↦ ⟨by rw [eq_selfPattern a c hc hca P hA hS]; rfl,
    hS.choose_spec.choose_spec.2⟩, ?_⟩
  simpa [filter_selfPattern_eq a c hc hca] using tangentCount_selfPattern_eval a c q hc hca

name: SurfaceBlowup.state_degree_pos
statement:
private theorem state_degree_pos (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) :
    0 < s.degree
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | single a c => exact Nat.mul_pos hs.1 hs.2
  | crossing a b c h =>
    have := Nat.mul_pos hs.1 hs.2.2.1
    change 0 < a*c+b*h
    omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.equal_degree_child_is_unique
statement:
private theorem equal_degree_child_is_unique (s : State) (hs : s.Valid)
    (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (hP : Allowed s P) (z : ℕ × State) (hz : z ∈ children s P) (heq : z.2.degree = s.degree) :
    children s P = [z] ∧ z.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := children_degree_identity s hs P hP
  have hD := state_degree_pos s hs
  have hpos : ∀ w ∈ children s P, 0 < w.1 * w.2.degree := fun w hw ↦
    Nat.mul_pos (children_residue_degree_pos s P w hw)
      (state_degree_pos _ (children_valid s hs P hP w hw))
  have hz1 := children_residue_degree_pos s P z hz
  obtain ⟨l1, l2, hL⟩ := List.append_of_mem hz
  have empty : ∀ l : List (ℕ × State), (∀ w ∈ l, w ∈ children s P) →
      (l.map fun z ↦ z.1*z.2.degree).sum = 0 → l = [] := by
    rintro (_ | ⟨a, t⟩) hl h0
    · rfl
    · have := hpos a (hl a (by simp))
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at h0
      omega
  rw [hL] at hsum
  simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_append, List.sum_cons, heq] at hsum
  have hge : s.degree ≤ z.1 * s.degree := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hz1
  obtain rfl := empty l1 (fun w hw ↦ by rw [hL]; simp [hw]) (by omega)
  obtain rfl := empty l2 (fun w hw ↦ by rw [hL]; simp [hw]) (by omega)
  refine ⟨by simpa using hL, Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hD ?_⟩
  simp at hsum
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.state_weight_le_degree
statement:
private theorem state_weight_le_degree (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) :
    s.weight ≤ s.degree
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | single a c => exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right a hs.2
  | crossing a b c h =>
    exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right a hs.2.2.1) (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right b hs.2.2.2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.rank_lt_of_weight_gt
statement:
private theorem rank_lt_of_weight_gt (s u : State) (hs : s.Valid) (hu : u.Valid)
    (hN : u.degree = s.degree)
    (hw : s.weight < u.weight) :
    u.rank < s.rank
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := state_weight_le_degree s hs
  have h2 := state_weight_le_degree u hu
  have ht : u.tag ≤ 1 := by cases u <;> simp [State.tag]
  unfold State.rank
  rw [hN] at h2 ⊢
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.nonself_child_rank_lt
statement:
theorem nonself_child_rank_lt (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (hP : Allowed s P) (hself : ¬ SelfPattern s P) (z : ℕ × State) (hz : z ∈ children s P) :
    z.2.rank < s.rank
proof:
:= by
  have hv := children_valid s hs P hP z hz
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (child_degree_le s hs P hP z hz) with hlt | heq
  · exact rank_lt_of_degree_lt s z.2 hv hlt
  obtain ⟨hch, hz1⟩ := equal_degree_child_is_unique s hs P hP z hz heq
  have hw : s.weight < z.2.weight → z.2.rank < s.rank :=
    rank_lt_of_weight_gt s z.2 hs hv heq
  cases s with
  | single a c =>
    obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := hs
    simp only [children, otherChildren, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap,
      List.mem_replicate] at hz
    rcases hz with hz | ⟨ij, -, -, rfl⟩
    · split_ifs at hz
      · simp at hz
      · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.1 hz
        exact hw (by simp [State.weight]; omega)
    · refine absurd ⟨a, c, rfl, ?_⟩ hself
      have hj : ij.2.val + 1 = c :=
        Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left ha (by simpa [State.degree] using heq)
      rw [hch]
      simp only at hz1
      rw [hz1, hj]
  | crossing a b c h =>
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hh⟩ := hs
    simp only [children, otherChildren, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap,
      List.mem_replicate] at hz
    rcases hz with (hz | hz) | ⟨ij, -, -, rfl⟩
    pick_goal 3
    · simp only [State.rank, State.weight, State.tag] at heq ⊢
      rw [heq]
      omega
    all_goals
      split_ifs at hz
      · simp at hz
      · obtain rfl := List.mem_singleton.1 hz
        exact hw (by simp [State.weight]; omega)

name: SurfaceBlowup.stateLawFuel_stable
statement:
private theorem stateLawFuel_stable (n : ℕ) : ∀ (s : State), s.Valid → s.rank < n →
    ∀ k1 k2 : ℕ, s.rank < k1 → s.rank < k2 → stateLawFuel k1 s = stateLawFuel k2 s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => intro s _ h; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s hs hn k1 k2 h1 h2
    obtain ⟨j1, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k1 = j + 1 := ⟨k1 - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨j2, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k2 = j + 1 := ⟨k2 - 1, by omega⟩
    have hterms : ((allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
        if SelfPattern s P then [] else
          lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
            (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel j1 z.2)))) =
        ((allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
        if SelfPattern s P then [] else
          lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
            (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel j2 z.2)))) := by
      simp only [List.flatMap]
      congr 1
      refine List.map_congr_left fun P hP ↦ ?_
      have hA : Allowed s P := by simpa [allowedPatterns] using hP
      split_ifs with hself
      · rfl
      · congr 2
        refine List.map_congr_left fun z hz ↦ ?_
        have hlt := nonself_child_rank_lt s hs P hA hself z hz
        rw [ih z.2 (children_valid s hs P hA z hz) (by omega) j1 j2 (by omega) (by omega)]
    cases s with
    | single a c =>
      rcases c with _ | _ | c
      · simp only [stateLawFuel]; rw [hterms]
      · simp only [stateLawFuel]
      · simp only [stateLawFuel]; rw [hterms]
    | crossing a b c h =>
      simp only [stateLawFuel]; rw [hterms]

name: SurfaceBlowup.state_fuel_stable
statement:
theorem state_fuel_stable (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (k : ℕ) (hk : s.rank < k) :
    stateLawFuel k s = stateLaw s
proof:
:=
  stateLawFuel_stable (s.rank + 1) s hs (by omega) k (s.rank + 1) hk (by omega)

name: SurfaceBlowup.flatMap_terms_eq_exitLaw
statement:
private theorem flatMap_terms_eq_exitLaw (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) :
    ((allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
        if SelfPattern s P then [] else
          lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
            (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel s.rank z.2))))
      = exitLaw s
proof:
:= by
  unfold exitLaw
  refine List.flatMap_congr fun P hP ↦ ?_
  have hA : Allowed s P := by simpa [allowedPatterns] using hP
  split_ifs with hself
  · rfl
  · congr 2
    refine List.map_congr_left fun z hz ↦ ?_
    rw [state_fuel_stable z.2 (children_valid s hs P hA z hz) s.rank
      (nonself_child_rank_lt s hs P hA hself z hz)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.state_law_unfold
statement:
theorem state_law_unfold (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (hnt : s.terminal = false) :
    (∀ a c : ℕ, s = State.single a c → stateLaw s =
      lawScale (.inv (.sub (.const 1) (returnWeight c))) (exitLaw s)) ∧
      (∀ a b c h : ℕ, s = State.crossing a b c h → stateLaw s = exitLaw s)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro a c rfl
    obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := id hs
    obtain _ | _ | c := c
    · omega
    · simp [State.terminal] at hnt
    · rw [← flatMap_terms_eq_exitLaw _ hs]
      rfl
  · rintro a b c h rfl
    rw [← flatMap_terms_eq_exitLaw _ hs]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.tangent_weight_safe
statement:
private theorem tangent_weight_safe (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) :
    (Expr.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val)).allSafe
proof:
:= fun q hq ↦
  ⟨divisor_count_safe s.degree _ P.other q hq, divisor_probability_safe s P.d.val q hq⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.terminal_law
statement:
theorem terminal_law (a : ℕ) :
    stateLaw (State.single a 1) = lawAtom a 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [stateLaw, State.rank, stateLawFuel]

name: SurfaceBlowup.tri_chooseTwo
statement:
theorem tri_chooseTwo (d : ℕ) :
    tri d = chooseTwo d + d
proof:
:= by
  cases d with
  | zero => simp [tri, chooseTwo]
  | succ n =>
    unfold tri chooseTwo
    have h : (n+1)*(n+1+1) = (n+1)*(n+1-1) + 2*(n+1) := by
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]; ring
    rw [h, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by norm_num : 0 < 2)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.tri_ge_three
statement:
private theorem tri_ge_three (c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    3 ≤ tri c
proof:
:= by
  unfold tri
  have : 6 ≤ c*(c+1) := by nlinarith
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.return_weight_bounds
statement:
theorem return_weight_bounds (q c : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    0 < (returnWeight c).eval q ∧ (returnWeight c).eval q ≤ (q : ℚ)⁻¹^2 ∧
      (returnWeight c).eval q < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hev : (returnWeight c).eval (q:ℚ) = (q:ℚ) * ((q:ℚ)^(tri c))⁻¹ := by
    simp [returnWeight, Expr.eval, expression_pow_eval]
  rw [hev]
  have hq2 : (2:ℚ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqpos : (0:ℚ) < q := by linarith
  have hp3 : (q:ℚ)^3 ≤ (q:ℚ)^(tri c) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (tri_ge_three c hc)
  have hle : (q:ℚ) * ((q:ℚ)^(tri c))⁻¹ ≤ (q:ℚ)⁻¹^2 := by
    calc (q:ℚ) * ((q:ℚ)^(tri c))⁻¹ ≤ (q:ℚ) * ((q:ℚ)^3)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hp3) hqpos.le
      _ = (q:ℚ)⁻¹^2 := by field_simp
  refine ⟨by positivity, hle, lt_of_le_of_lt hle ?_⟩
  have : (q:ℚ)⁻¹ ≤ 1/2 := by
    rw [one_div]; exact inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hq2
  have h0 : (0:ℚ) ≤ (q:ℚ)⁻¹ := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: SurfaceBlowup.divisor_probability_pos
statement:
theorem divisor_probability_pos (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (s : State) (d c : ℕ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    0 < (divisorProbability s d).eval q ∧
      0 < (Expr.inv (.sub (.const 1) (returnWeight c))).eval q
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (2:ℚ) ≤ (q:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hE : (eminusOne).eval q = (q:ℚ) - 1 := by
    simp [eminusOne, Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval]; ring
  have hE0 : 0 < (q:ℚ) - 1 := by linarith
  have hP : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ((Expr.pow .var n).eval q) := fun n ↦ by
    rw [expression_pow_eval]; simp only [Expr.eval]; positivity
  have hEp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ((Expr.pow eminusOne n).eval q) := fun n ↦ by
    rw [expression_pow_eval, hE]; exact pow_pos hE0 _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · cases s with
    | single a c' => exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hP _)) (hEp _)
    | crossing a b c' h =>
      simp only [divisorProbability, Expr.eval]
      refine mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hP _)) ?_
      split_ifs
      all_goals first
        | exact hEp _
        | (simp only [Expr.eval]; rw [hE]; exact inv_pos.mpr hE0)
  · have := (return_weight_bounds q c hq hc).2.2
    simp only [Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval]
    exact inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)

name: SurfaceBlowup.lawProd_safe
statement:
private theorem lawProd_safe (Ls : List Law) (h : ∀ L ∈ Ls, LawSafe L) :
    LawSafe (lawProd Ls)
proof:
:= by
  induction Ls with
  | nil =>
    intro z hz q _
    simp only [lawProd, lawOne, List.foldr_nil, List.mem_singleton] at hz
    subst hz
    trivial
  | cons L Ls ih =>
    exact law_safe_mul _ _ (h L (by simp)) (ih fun M hM ↦ h M (by simp [hM]))

name: SurfaceBlowup.stateLaw_terms_safe
statement:
private theorem stateLaw_terms_safe (s : State) (hs : s.Valid)
    (ih : ∀ t : State, t.rank < s.rank → t.Valid → LawSafe (stateLaw t)) :
    LawSafe ((allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
        if SelfPattern s P then [] else
          lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
            (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel s.rank z.2))))
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [List.mem_flatMap] at hz
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hz⟩ := hz
  have hA : Allowed s P := by simpa [allowedPatterns] using hP
  by_cases hself : SelfPattern s P
  · simp [hself] at hz
  · rw [if_neg hself] at hz
    refine law_safe_scale _ _ (tangent_weight_safe s P) (lawProd_safe _ ?_) z hz
    simp only [List.mem_map]
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have hv := children_valid s hs P hA w hw
    have hr := nonself_child_rank_lt s hs P hA hself w hw
    rw [state_fuel_stable w.2 hv _ hr]
    exact law_safe_descend _ (children_residue_degree_pos s P w hw) _ (ih _ hr hv)

name: SurfaceBlowup.local_law_safe
statement:
theorem local_law_safe (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) :
    LawSafe (stateLaw s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hn : s.rank using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing s with
  | _ n IH =>
  have hT := stateLaw_terms_safe s hs fun t ht htv ↦ IH t.rank (hn ▸ ht) t htv rfl
  unfold stateLaw
  cases s with
  | single a c =>
    by_cases hc : c = 1
    · subst hc
      intro z hz q _
      simp only [stateLawFuel, lawAtom, List.mem_singleton] at hz
      subst hz
      trivial
    · have hc2 : 2 ≤ c := by have := hs.2; omega
      have hfuel : stateLawFuel ((State.single a c).rank + 1) (State.single a c) =
          lawScale (.inv (.sub (.const 1) (returnWeight c)))
            ((allowedPatterns (State.single a c)).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
              if SelfPattern (State.single a c) P then [] else
                lawScale (.mul (tangentCount (State.single a c) P)
                    (divisorProbability (State.single a c) P.d.val))
                  (lawProd ((children (State.single a c) P).map fun z ↦
                    lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel (State.single a c).rank z.2)))) := by
        rw [stateLawFuel]
        all_goals first | rfl | (intro a1 h; cases h; exact hc rfl)
      rw [hfuel]
      refine law_safe_scale _ _ (fun q hq ↦ ?_) hT
      obtain ⟨hpos, -, hlt⟩ := return_weight_bounds q c hq hc2
      have hne : (Expr.pow .var (tri c)).eval (q : ℚ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
        simp [returnWeight, Expr.eval, h0] at hpos
      refine ⟨⟨trivial, trivial, ⟨trivial, expression_pow_safe _ _ _ trivial, hne⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Expr.sub, Expr.neg, Expr.eval]
      intro h0
      linarith
  | crossing a b c h =>
    rw [stateLawFuel]
    exact hT

name: SurfaceBlowup.global_law_safe
statement:
theorem global_law_safe (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    LawSafe (globalLaw ε n)
proof:
:= by
  have normSafe : (Expr.inv (if ε then projectiveNormalizer n else .pow .var n)).allSafe := by
    intro q hq
    cases ε with
    | true =>
      refine ⟨?_, ne_of_gt (projective_normalizer_positive n q (by positivity))⟩
      refine expression_sum_safe _ _ ?_
      simp only [List.mem_map]
      rintro _ ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
      exact expression_pow_safe _ _ _ trivial
    | false =>
      refine ⟨expression_pow_safe _ _ _ trivial, ?_⟩
      have : (2:ℚ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
      simpa [expression_pow_eval, Expr.eval] using pow_ne_zero n (by linarith : (q:ℚ) ≠ 0)
  refine law_safe_scale _ _ normSafe fun z hz ↦ ?_
  simp only [List.mem_flatMap] at hz
  obtain ⟨m, _, hz⟩ := hz
  refine law_safe_scale _ _ (divisor_count_safe _ _ m) (lawProd_safe _ ?_) z hz
  simp only [List.mem_map, otherChildren, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_replicate]
  rintro _ ⟨w, ⟨ij, _, _, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact law_safe_descend _ (Nat.succ_pos _) _ (local_law_safe _ ⟨Nat.one_pos, Nat.succ_pos _⟩)

name: SurfaceBlowup.global_coefficients_safe
statement:
theorem global_coefficients_safe (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    (monicExpr n σ).allSafe ∧ (projectiveExpr n σ).allSafe
proof:
:= by
  have hsafe : ∀ L : Law, LawSafe L → (lawCoeff L σ).allSafe := by
    intro L hL q hq
    refine expression_sum_safe _ _ fun x hx ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    by_cases h : z.1 = σ
    · simp only [h, if_true]; exact hL z hz q hq
    · simp [h, Expr.safe]
  exact ⟨hsafe _ (global_law_safe n false), hsafe _ (global_law_safe n true)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.global_formula_regular
statement:
theorem global_formula_regular (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
