    FormulaRegular n σ
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have h2 := prime_power_ge_two q hq
  obtain ⟨h1, h3⟩ := global_coefficients_safe n σ
  exact ⟨expression_regular _ _ (h1 q h2), expression_regular _ _ (h3 q h2)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.type_degree_scale
statement:
private theorem type_degree_scale (δ : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    typeDegree (scaleType δ σ) = δ * typeDegree σ
proof:
:= by
  unfold typeDegree scaleType
  rw [Multiset.map_map, ← Multiset.sum_map_mul_left]
  congr 1
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl fun z _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [Function.comp]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.scale_type_valid_degree_iff
statement:
theorem scale_type_valid_degree_iff (δ r : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (τ : FactorType) :
    ((ValidType (scaleType δ τ) ∧ typeDegree (scaleType δ τ) = δ * r) ↔
      (ValidType τ ∧ typeDegree τ = r)) ∧ Function.Injective (scaleType δ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hv : ValidType (scaleType δ τ) ↔ ValidType τ := by
      unfold ValidType scaleType
      simp only [Multiset.mem_map, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
      exact forall₂_congr fun z _ ↦ by simp [hδ]
    rw [hv, type_degree_scale, Nat.mul_left_cancel_iff hδ]
  · apply Multiset.map_injective
    intro a b h
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    exact Prod.ext h.1 (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hδ h.2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.block_translation_type_iff
statement:
theorem block_translation_type_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (F : Polynomial O) (hF : F.Monic) (θ : O)
    (σ : FactorType) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O (F.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))) σ ↔
      HasPolynomialTypeF O ((Polynomial.taylor θ F).map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))) σ
proof:
:= by
  set K := BaseField O
  have h1 : (Polynomial.taylor θ F).map (algebraMap O K)
      = (Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC (algebraMap O K θ)) (F.map (algebraMap O K)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.taylor_apply, Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC_apply, ← Polynomial.comp_eq_aeval,
      Polynomial.map_comp]
    simp
  have hm : (Polynomial.taylor θ F).Monic := by
    rw [Polynomial.Monic, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_taylor]; exact hF
  have hI : (Ideal.span {F.map (algebraMap O K)}).map
      (Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC (algebraMap O K θ)).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
      = Ideal.span {(Polynomial.taylor θ F).map (algebraMap O K)} := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, h1]; rfl
  exact polynomial_type_algEquiv_iff O _ _ (hF.map _) (hm.map _)
    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ _ (Polynomial.algEquivAevalXAddC (algebraMap O K θ)) hI.symm) σ

name: SurfaceBlowup.coprime_family_type_iff
statement:
theorem coprime_family_type_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (F : ι → Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hF : ∀ i, (F i).Monic)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (F i) (F j)) (σ : FactorType) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O (∏ i, F i) σ ↔
      ∃ τ : ι → FactorType, (∀ i, HasPolynomialTypeF O (F i) (τ i)) ∧ σ = ∑ i, τ i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ τ : ι → FactorType, (∀ i, HasPolynomialTypeF O (F i) (τ i)) →
      ∀ s : Finset ι, HasPolynomialTypeF O (∏ i ∈ s, F i) (∑ i ∈ s, τ i) := by
    intro τ hτ s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨[], by simp⟩
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      exact polynomial_type_mul_coprime O _ _ _ _ (hτ a) ih
        (IsCoprime.prod_right fun i hi ↦ hc a i fun h ↦ ha (h ▸ hi))
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨τ, hτ, hσ⟩ ↦ hσ ▸ key τ hτ Finset.univ⟩
  choose τ hτ using fun i ↦
    polynomial_type_dvd O _ (F i) σ h (hF i) (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i))
  exact ⟨τ, hτ, polynomial_type_unique O _ _ _ h (key τ hτ Finset.univ)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_unramified_lift
statement:
theorem exists_unramified_lift (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    (φ : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hφ : φ.Monic) (hirr : Irreducible φ) :
    ∃ Φ : Polynomial O,
      IsUnramifiedLift O Φ ∧ residuePoly O Φ = φ ∧ Φ.natDegree = φ.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (residue_cell_cylinder O φ.natDegree φ).2.1 hφ rfl
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := monic_poly_reconstruct O φ.natDegree a
  have ha' : residuePoly O (monicPolyO a) = φ := ha
  exact ⟨monicPolyO a, ⟨h1, ha'.symm ▸ hirr⟩, ha', h2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.cellMeasure_apply_of_measurableSet
statement:
theorem cellMeasure_apply_of_measurableSet (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n → O))
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (s : Set (Fin n → O)) :
    cellMeasure O n S s = (coefficientMeasure O n S)⁻¹ * coefficientMeasure O n (s ∩ S)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' hS]

name: SurfaceBlowup.cellMeasure_cell_inter
statement:
theorem cellMeasure_cell_inter {O : Type} [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] {n : ℕ} {S : Set (Fin n → O)} (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (T : Set (Fin n → O)) : cellMeasure O n S (S ∩ T) = cellMeasure O n S T
proof:
:= by
  simp [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' hS, Set.inter_comm S T,
    Set.inter_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.cellMeasure_univ
statement:
private theorem cellMeasure_univ (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n → O))
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) (h : coefficientMeasure O n S ≠ 0) :
    cellMeasure O n S Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop n
  rw [cellMeasure_apply_of_measurableSet O n S hS, Set.univ_inter]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel h (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.cell_transport_preimage
statement:
theorem cell_transport_preimage (O₁ : Type) [CommRing O₁] [IsDomain O₁]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O₁] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₁) O₁]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O₁)] [TopologicalSpace O₁] [IsTopologicalRing O₁]
    [CompactSpace O₁] [T2Space O₁] [SecondCountableTopology O₁] [MeasurableSpace O₁]
    [BorelSpace O₁] (htop₁ : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₁)) (O₂ : Type) [CommRing O₂]
    [IsDomain O₂] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O₂] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₂) O₂]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O₂)] [TopologicalSpace O₂] [IsTopologicalRing O₂]
    [CompactSpace O₂] [T2Space O₂] [SecondCountableTopology O₂] [MeasurableSpace O₂]
    [BorelSpace O₂] (htop₂ : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₂)) (n₁ n₂ : ℕ)
    (S₁ : Set (Fin n₁ → O₁)) (S₂ : Set (Fin n₂ → O₂)) (hS₁ : MeasurableSet S₁)
    (hS₂ : MeasurableSet S₂) (h₁ : coefficientMeasure O₁ n₁ S₁ ≠ 0)
    (h₂ : coefficientMeasure O₂ n₂ S₂ ≠ 0) (f : (Fin n₁ → O₁) → (Fin n₂ → O₂))
    (hf : Set.BijOn f S₁ S₂)
    (hcong : ∀ (L : ℕ), ∀ a ∈ S₁, ∀ a' ∈ S₁, (∀ j, a j - a' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₁) ^ L)
      ↔ ∀ j, f a j - f a' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₂) ^ L)
    (hmass : ∀ (L : ℕ), 1 ≤ L → ∀ a ∈ S₁,
      cellMeasure O₁ n₁ S₁ {a' | ∀ j, a' j - a j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₁) ^ L} =
        cellMeasure O₂ n₂ S₂ {b | ∀ j, b j - f a j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₂) ^ L}) :
    ∀ T : Set (Fin n₂ → O₂), MeasurableSet T →
      MeasurableSet (S₁ ∩ f ⁻¹' T) ∧ cellMeasure O₁ n₁ S₁ (f ⁻¹' T) = cellMeasure O₂ n₂ S₂ T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m₁ := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₁
  set m₂ := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O₂
  have hgen₂ := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O₂ m₂ htop₂ n₂
  have ht : ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : Fin n₂ → O₂),
      {y | adicCongr m₂ L y x} = {y : Fin n₂ → O₂ | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m₂ ^ L} := fun L x ↦ by
    ext y; simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, finite_coordinate_adic_congruence]
  
  have htrace : ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : Fin n₂ → O₂),
      (∃ a₀ ∈ S₁, S₁ ∩ f ⁻¹' {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m₂ ^ L} = S₁ ∩ {y | ∀ j, y j - a₀ j ∈ m₁ ^ L}
        ∧ {y : Fin n₂ → O₂ | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m₂ ^ L} = {y | ∀ j, y j - f a₀ j ∈ m₂ ^ L}) ∨
      (S₁ ∩ f ⁻¹' {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m₂ ^ L} = ∅ ∧
        {y : Fin n₂ → O₂ | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m₂ ^ L} ∩ S₂ = ∅) := by
    intro L x
    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty ({y : Fin n₂ → O₂ | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m₂ ^ L} ∩ S₂) with
      hne | ⟨b, hbB, hbS⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun a ⟨ha, hB⟩ ↦
        hne.subset ⟨hB, hf.mapsTo ha⟩, hne⟩
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, rfl⟩ := hf.surjOn hbS
    have hB : {y : Fin n₂ → O₂ | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m₂ ^ L} = {y | ∀ j, y j - f a₀ j ∈ m₂ ^ L} :=
      Set.ext fun y ↦ ⟨fun hy j ↦ by simpa using (m₂ ^ L).sub_mem (hy j) (hbB j),
        fun hy j ↦ by simpa using (m₂ ^ L).add_mem (hy j) (hbB j)⟩
    refine Or.inl ⟨a₀, ha₀, Set.ext fun a ↦ ?_, hB⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, hB]
    exact and_congr_right fun ha ↦ (hcong L a ha a₀ ha₀).symm
  
  obtain ⟨b₀, -⟩ : S₂.Nonempty := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun h ↦ h₂ (h ▸ by simp)
  let g : (Fin n₁ → O₁) → (Fin n₂ → O₂) := fun a ↦ if a ∈ S₁ then f a else b₀
  have hgS : ∀ T : Set (Fin n₂ → O₂), S₁ ∩ g ⁻¹' T = S₁ ∩ f ⁻¹' T := fun T ↦
    Set.ext fun a ↦ by by_cases ha : a ∈ S₁ <;> simp [g, ha]
  have hgmeas : Measurable g := by
    have : @Measurable _ _ _ (adicCylinderSpace m₂ (Fin n₂ → O₂)) g := by
      refine measurable_generateFrom ?_
      rintro t (rfl | ⟨L, x, rfl⟩)
      · simp
      have hg : g ⁻¹' {y | adicCongr m₂ L y x} =
          (S₁ ∩ g ⁻¹' {y | adicCongr m₂ L y x}) ∪ (S₁ᶜ ∩ {_a | b₀ ∈ {y | adicCongr m₂ L y x}}) :=
        Set.ext fun a ↦ by by_cases ha : a ∈ S₁ <;> simp [g, ha]
      rw [hg, hgS, ht]
      refine MeasurableSet.union ?_ (hS₁.compl.inter (MeasurableSet.const _))
      rcases htrace L x with ⟨a₀, -, h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ <;> rw [h]
      exacts [hS₁.inter ((coordinate_cylinder_clopen O₁ m₁ htop₁ L).1 n₁ a₀).2.measurableSet,
        .empty]
    rwa [← hgen₂] at this
  have hρ₁ := cellMeasure_apply_of_measurableSet O₁ n₁ S₁ hS₁
  have hρ₂ := cellMeasure_apply_of_measurableSet O₂ n₂ S₂ hS₂
  have hone₁ := cellMeasure_univ O₁ htop₁ n₁ S₁ hS₁ h₁
  have hone₂ := cellMeasure_univ O₂ htop₂ n₂ S₂ hS₂ h₂
  have : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (cellMeasure O₂ n₂ S₂) := ⟨by simp [hone₂]⟩
  have hpush : ∀ T : Set (Fin n₂ → O₂), MeasurableSet T →
      (cellMeasure O₁ n₁ S₁).map g T = cellMeasure O₁ n₁ S₁ (f ⁻¹' T) := fun T hT ↦ by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply hgmeas hT, hρ₁, hρ₁, Set.inter_comm, hgS, Set.inter_comm]
  have hEq : cellMeasure O₂ n₂ S₂ = (cellMeasure O₁ n₁ S₁).map g := by
    refine finite_measures_from_cylinders O₂ (Fin n₂ → O₂) m₂ _ _ hgen₂ fun L x ↦ ?_
    rw [ht, hpush _ ((coordinate_cylinder_clopen O₂ m₂ htop₂ L).1 n₂ x).2.measurableSet]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos L with rfl | hL
    · simp only [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, Submodule.mem_top, implies_true, Set.ofPred_true,
        Set.preimage_univ, hone₁, hone₂]
    rcases htrace L x with ⟨a₀, ha₀, h, hB⟩ | ⟨h, hB⟩
    · rw [hρ₁, Set.inter_comm, h, Set.inter_comm, ← hρ₁, hmass L hL a₀ ha₀, hB]
    · rw [hρ₁, hρ₂, hB, Set.inter_comm (f ⁻¹' _), h]; simp
  exact fun T hT ↦ ⟨hgS T ▸ hS₁.inter (hgmeas hT), by rw [← hpush T hT, ← hEq]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_hyperplane_null
statement:
theorem coordinate_hyperplane_null (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    MeasurableSet {b : Fin n → O | b j = 0} ∧
      coefficientMeasure O n {b : Fin n → O | b j = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : IsClosed {b : Fin n → O | b j = 0} :=
    isClosed_eq (continuous_apply j) continuous_const
  refine ⟨hcl.measurableSet, ?_⟩
  have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop n
  have : MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant (coefficientMeasure O n) := by
    unfold coefficientMeasure; infer_instance
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  have hq1 : 1 < q := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.2 inferInstance
  have key : ∀ L : ℕ, coefficientMeasure O n {b : Fin n → O | b j = 0} ≤ ((q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ L := by
    intro L
    have hcard : Nat.card (O ⧸ m ^ L) = q ^ L := residue_quotient_card O L
    have : Finite (O ⧸ m ^ L) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hcard]; positivity)
    let π : (Fin n → O) →+ (O ⧸ m ^ L) :=
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ L)).toAddMonoidHom.comp (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom (fun _ ↦ O) j)
    have hπ : ∀ b, π b = Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ L) (b j) := fun b ↦ rfl
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := fun c ↦ by
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
      exact ⟨fun _ ↦ y, rfl⟩
    have hm : ∀ a, MeasurableSet {x | π x = a} := by
      intro a
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
      have h1 := (coordinate_cylinder_clopen O m htop L).1 1 (fun _ ↦ y)
      have : {x : Fin n → O | π x = Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ L) y}
          = (fun b : Fin n → O ↦ fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ b j) ⁻¹'
            {b : Fin 1 → O | ∀ i, b i - (fun _ ↦ y) i ∈ m ^ L} := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage, hπ, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
        exact ⟨fun h _ ↦ h, fun h ↦ h 0⟩
      rw [this]
      exact (h1.1.preimage (continuous_pi fun _ ↦ continuous_apply j)).measurableSet
    have hmass := finite_quotient_event_mass (Fin n → O) (O ⧸ m ^ L)
      (coefficientMeasure O n) π hsurj hm {0}
    have hpre : π ⁻¹' {0} = {b : Fin n → O | b j ∈ m ^ L} := by
      ext b
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, hπ, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [hpre] at hmass
    have hsub : {b : Fin n → O | b j = 0} ⊆ {b : Fin n → O | b j ∈ m ^ L} := fun b hb ↦ by
      simp_all
    calc _ ≤ _ := MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub
      _ = _ := hmass
      _ = ((q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ L := by simp [hcard, ENNReal.inv_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hlt : (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ < 1 := by rw [ENNReal.inv_lt_one]; exact_mod_cast hq1
  exact le_antisymm (le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' tendsto_const_nhds
    (ENNReal.tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hlt) key) zero_le

name: SurfaceBlowup.scaling_image_borel_mass
statement:
theorem scaling_image_borel_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (r : ℕ)
    (T : Set (Fin r → O)) (hT : MeasurableSet T) :
    MeasurableSet ((fun z : Fin r → O ↦ pi • z) '' T) ∧
      coefficientMeasure O r ((fun z : Fin r → O ↦ pi • z) '' T) =
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ r * coefficientMeasure O r T
proof:
:= by
  have e : (fun z : Fin r → O ↦ pi • z) = coordinateScale pi 1 := by
    funext z; simp [coordinateScale]
  refine ⟨?_, by simpa [e] using coordinate_scale_measure O htop pi hpi r 1 T⟩
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : Fin r → O ↦ pi • z) :=
    continuous_pi fun j ↦ continuous_const.mul (continuous_apply j)
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun z : Fin r → O ↦ pi • z) := fun z z' h ↦
    funext fun j ↦ mul_left_cancel₀ hpi.ne_zero (congrFun h j)
  exact (hc.isClosedEmbedding hi).measurableEmbedding.measurableSet_image.2 hT

name: SurfaceBlowup.expression_rational_eval
statement:
private theorem expression_rational_eval (x : Expr) (q : ℚ) (hx : x.safe q) :
    RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q x.rational = x.eval q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hQ, hval⟩ := expression_fraction x q hx
  have hrat : x.rational = algebraMap _ _ x.fraction.1 / algebraMap _ _ x.fraction.2 := rfl
  have hQ0 : x.fraction.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hQ; rw [h]; simp
  have hQ0' : algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) x.fraction.2 ≠ 0 :=
    RatFunc.algebraMap_ne_zero hQ0
  have hden : (RatFunc.denom x.rational).eval₂ (RingHom.id ℚ) q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hd : RatFunc.denom x.rational ∣ x.fraction.2 := by
      rw [hrat]; exact RatFunc.denom_div_dvd _ _
    exact hQ (Polynomial.eval₂_eq_zero_of_dvd_of_eval₂_eq_zero _ _ hd h)
  have h2 : x.rational * algebraMap _ _ x.fraction.2 = algebraMap _ _ x.fraction.1 := by
    rw [hrat]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hQ0'
  have h3 := RatFunc.eval_mul (f := RingHom.id ℚ) (a := q) (x := x.rational)
    (y := algebraMap _ _ x.fraction.2) hden
    (by rw [RatFunc.denom_algebraMap]; simp)
  rw [h2] at h3
  have eP : RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q (algebraMap _ _ x.fraction.1) = x.fraction.1.eval q := by
    rw [RatFunc.eval_algebraMap]; simp [Polynomial.eval₂_id]
  have eQ : RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q (algebraMap _ _ x.fraction.2) = x.fraction.2.eval q := by
    rw [RatFunc.eval_algebraMap]; simp [Polynomial.eval₂_id]
  rw [eP, eQ] at h3
  rw [hval, eq_div_iff hQ]
  exact h3.symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.global_rational_eval
statement:
theorem global_rational_eval (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    ∀ q : ℕ, PrimePower q → RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q (monicExpr n σ).rational =
        (monicExpr n σ).eval q ∧ RatFunc.eval (RingHom.id ℚ) q (projectiveExpr n σ).rational =
        (projectiveExpr n σ).eval q
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have h2 := prime_power_ge_two q hq
  obtain ⟨h1, h3⟩ := global_coefficients_safe n σ
  exact ⟨expression_rational_eval _ _ (h1 q h2),
    expression_rational_eval _ _ (h3 q h2)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_field_irreducible_count
statement:
theorem finite_field_irreducible_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ((Nat.card {g : Polynomial k // g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g
      ∧ g.natDegree = δ} : ℕ) : ℚ) = (pointCount δ).eval (Nat.card k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointCount_eval, ← irreducible_count_moebius k δ hδ]
  have : (δ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hδ.ne'
  field_simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_field_card_primePower
statement:
theorem finite_field_card_primePower (K : Type) [Field K] [Finite K] :
    PrimePower (Nat.card K)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype K := Fintype.ofFinite K
  obtain ⟨p, -, n, hp, hcard⟩ := FiniteField.card' K
  exact ⟨p, n, hp, n.pos, by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_length_module_card
statement:
theorem finite_length_module_card (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] (ℓ : ℕ)
    (hℓ : Module.length O M = ℓ) :
    Nat.card M = (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))^ℓ
proof:
:= by
  induction ℓ generalizing M with
  | zero =>
    have : Subsingleton M := Module.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hℓ)
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hfin : IsFiniteLength O M := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp
        (by rw [hℓ]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top _)
    have hA : IsArtinian O M := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfin).2
    have hnt : Nontrivial M := Module.length_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hℓ]; exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n)
    have : IsAtomic (Submodule O M) := isAtomic_of_orderBot_wellFounded_lt wellFounded_lt
    obtain ⟨N, hN, -⟩ := (eq_bot_or_exists_atom_le (⊤ : Submodule O M)).resolve_left top_ne_bot
    have hS : IsSimpleModule O N := isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mpr hN
    obtain ⟨I, hI, ⟨e⟩⟩ := isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mp hS
    have hIm : I = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O := IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hI
    subst hIm
    have hcardN : Nat.card N = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := Nat.card_congr e.toEquiv
    have hlen := Module.length_eq_add_of_exact N.subtype N.mkQ N.injective_subtype
      N.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ N)
    rw [Module.length_eq_one O N, hℓ] at hlen
    have hQ : Module.length O (M ⧸ N) = n := by
      have : ((n : ℕ∞) + 1) = 1 + Module.length O (M ⧸ N) := by exact_mod_cast hlen
      have h2 : ((n : ℕ∞) + 1) = Module.length O (M ⧸ N) + 1 := by rw [this, add_comm]
      exact (ENat.add_left_injective_of_ne_top ENat.one_ne_top h2).symm
    have := ih (M ⧸ N) hQ
    rw [AddSubgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_addSubgroup N.toAddSubgroup]
    change Nat.card (M ⧸ N) * Nat.card N = _
    rw [this, hcardN, pow_succ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → R) (a : O) (z : Fin n → O) :
    coordinateLift b (a • z) = algebraMap O R a * coordinateLift b z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateLift, Finset.mul_sum, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul,
    mul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.IdealChart.isDivisionChart
statement:
theorem IdealChart.isDivisionChart {pi : O} {n : ℕ} (C : IdealChart O R pi n) :
    IsDivisionChart O R pi C.f C.b
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨C.E, C.division⟩, C.regular⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPolynomial_zero_null
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_zero_null {R : Type} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R] [T2Space R] [SecondCountableTopology R]
    [MeasurableSpace R] [BorelSpace R]
    (ν : Measure R) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [NullSingletonClass ν] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R), P ≠ 0 →
      Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => ν) {x | MvPolynomial.eval x P = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro P hP
    rw [MvPolynomial.eq_C_of_isEmpty P] at hP ⊢
    simp_all
  | succ n ih =>
    intro P hP
    set Q := MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n P
    have hQ : Q ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff _ (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).injective).2 hP
    have hZ : MeasurableSet {x : Fin (n+1) → R | MvPolynomial.eval x P = 0} :=
      (isClosed_eq (MvPolynomial.continuous_eval P) continuous_const).measurableSet
    let e := MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => R) 0
    set T : Set (R × (Fin n → R)) := e.symm ⁻¹' {x | MvPolynomial.eval x P = 0} with hT
    rw [← (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => ν) 0).symm.measure_preimage
      hZ.nullMeasurableSet, Measure.prod_apply_symm (e.symm.measurable hZ)]
    have hae := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.1 (ih _ (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hQ))
    have hzero : (fun s : Fin n → R => ν ((fun y => (y, s)) ⁻¹' T))
        =ᵐ[Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => ν] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hae] with s hs
      have hne : Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval s) Q ≠ 0 := fun h => hs <| by
        simpa using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · Q.natDegree) h
      refine measure_mono_null (fun y hy => ?_) ((Finset.finite_toSet
        (Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval s) Q).roots.toFinset).measure_zero ν)
      simp only [hT, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hy
      have key : e.symm (y, s) = Fin.cons y s := by
        ext i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply,
          Fin.insertNthEquiv]
      rw [key, MvPolynomial.eval_eq_eval_mv_eval'] at hy
      simpa using (Polynomial.mem_roots hne).2 hy
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae hzero]; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_product_congruence
statement:
theorem algebra_product_congruence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (I : Ideal O) (j : ℕ) (x x2 y y2 : R) (hx : adicCongr I j x x2) (hy : adicCongr I j y y2) :
    adicCongr I j (x*y) (x2*y2)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ r : R, ∀ z ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R), r * z ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) :=
    fun r z hz => Submodule.smul_induction_on hz
      (fun a ha m _ => mul_smul_comm a r m ▸ Submodule.smul_mem_smul ha Submodule.mem_top)
      (fun u v hu hv => (mul_add r u v).symm ▸ add_mem hu hv)
  unfold adicCongr at *
  rw [show x * y - x2 * y2 = y * (x - x2) + x2 * (y - y2) by ring]
  exact add_mem (key _ _ hx) (key _ _ hy)

name: SurfaceBlowup.expr_eval_pow
statement:
private lemma expr_eval_pow (x : ℚ) (e : Expr) (n : ℕ) :
    (Expr.pow e n).eval x = (e.eval x)^n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Expr.pow, Expr.eval]
  | succ n ih => simp [Expr.pow, Expr.eval, ih, pow_succ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.otherChildren_volume_prod
proof:
:= by
  unfold otherChildren patternWeight
  rw [List.map_flatMap, List.flatMap_def, List.prod_flatten, List.map_map]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate, stateVolume,
    Expr.eval, expr_eval_pow]
  rw [Finset.prod_map_toList, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun ij _ => ?_
  rw [inv_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_volume_ratio
statement:
theorem child_volume_ratio (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (P : TangentPattern s.degree)
    (hP : Allowed s P) (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    ((q:ℚ)⁻¹^(tri P.d.val))
        * (((children s P).map fun z => (stateVolume z.2).eval ((q:ℚ)^z.1)).prod)
      / (stateVolume s).eval q = (divisorProbability s P.d.val).eval q
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2:ℚ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq0 : (q:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hq1 : (q:ℚ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hq1' : -1 + (q:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hq1'' : (q:ℚ) + -1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hd0, hsum, hP⟩ := hP
  cases s with
  | single a c =>
    obtain ⟨hdc, hrx, hrt⟩ := hP
    simp only [children, List.map_append, List.prod_append]
    rw [otherChildren_volume_prod]
    simp only [stateVolume, divisorProbability, Expr.eval, expr_eval_pow, eminusOne, Expr.sub,
      Expr.neg]
    by_cases h0 : P.rt.val = 0
    · have hdc' : ¬ P.d.val < c := fun h => by have := hrt.2 h; omega
      have hc : c = P.d.val := by omega
      have hw : patternWeight P.other = P.d.val := by omega
      simp only [h0, if_true, hdc', if_false, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, hw, inv_pow]
      rw [show (q:ℚ)^c = (q:ℚ)^P.d.val from congrArg _ hc]
      field_simp
    · have hdc' : P.d.val < c := hrt.1 (by omega)
      have hc : (q:ℚ)^c = (q:ℚ)^(P.rt.val + (c - P.d.val)) * (q:ℚ)^(patternWeight P.other) := by
        rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
      simp only [h0, if_false, hdc', if_true, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.prod_cons,
        List.prod_nil, Expr.eval, expr_eval_pow, hc, pow_one, inv_pow]
      field_simp
  | crossing a b c h =>
    obtain ⟨hdc, hdh, hrt, hrx⟩ := hP
    simp only [children, List.map_append, List.prod_append]
    rw [otherChildren_volume_prod]
    simp only [stateVolume, divisorProbability, Expr.eval, expr_eval_pow, eminusOne, Expr.sub,
      Expr.neg]
    have htri : tri P.d.val = chooseTwo P.d.val + P.d.val := by
      unfold tri chooseTwo
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, P.d.val = n+1 := ⟨_, (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hd0).symm⟩
      rw [hn, Nat.add_sub_cancel, show (n+1)*(n+1+1) = (n+1)*n + (n+1)*2 by ring,
        Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ two_pos]
    have hch : (q:ℚ)^(c+h) = (q:ℚ)^(P.rt.val + (c - P.d.val)) * (q:ℚ)^(P.rx.val + (h - P.d.val))
        * (q:ℚ)^(patternWeight P.other) * (q:ℚ)^P.d.val := by
      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    rw [htri, hch]
    have hc' : P.d.val < c ↔ P.rt.val ≠ 0 := ⟨fun h => by have := hrt.2 h; omega, hrt.1 ∘ by omega⟩
    have hh' : P.d.val < h ↔ P.rx.val ≠ 0 := ⟨fun h => by have := hrx.2 h; omega, hrx.1 ∘ by omega⟩
    have e1 : P.rt.val = 0 → c - P.d.val = 0 := fun h => by have := hrt.2; omega
    have e2 : P.rx.val = 0 → h - P.d.val = 0 := fun h => by have := hrx.2; omega
    by_cases h0 : P.rt.val = 0 <;> by_cases h1 : P.rx.val = 0 <;>
    · simp only [h0, h1, hc', hh', e1, e2, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, not_false_eq_true, if_true,
        if_false, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, Expr.eval, inv_pow, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
        expr_eval_pow]
      norm_num [Expr.eval, expr_eval_pow, pow_add]
      field_simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_fiber_succ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.card_filter, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.coloredCount_succ
proof:
:= by
  unfold coloredCount
  rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv
    (fun f : {f : Fin (n+1) → Option (Fin r) // ∀ i : Fin r,
      Nat.card {x : Fin (n+1) // f x = some i} = m i} => f.1 0)).symm, Nat.card_sigma]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Nat.card_congr
    { toFun := fun p => ⟨Fin.tail p.1.1, fun i => by rw [← p.1.2 i, card_fiber_succ, p.2]; rfl⟩
      invFun := fun g => ⟨⟨Fin.cons c g.1, fun i => by rw [← g.2 i, card_fiber_succ]; simp⟩,
        by simp⟩
      left_inv := fun ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, hc⟩ => by subst hc; simp [Fin.cons_self_tail]
      right_inv := fun g => by simp }

name: SurfaceBlowup.coloredCount_term
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Nat.card_eq_zero]; left
    constructor; rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have := hg i; simp at this; omega
  · refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun g => forall_congr' fun j => ?_)
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj; simp; omega
    · simp [Ne.symm hj, hj]

name: SurfaceBlowup.descFactorial_succ_left
statement:
private theorem descFactorial_succ_left (n M : ℕ) :
    (n+1).descFactorial M = n.descFactorial M + M * n.descFactorial (M-1)
proof:
:= by
  cases M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k =>
    rw [Nat.succ_descFactorial_succ, Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ n
    · rw [show n + 1 = (n - k) + (k + 1) by omega, add_mul]
    · simp [Nat.descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr (show n < k by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coloredCount_eq
statement:
private theorem coloredCount_eq (r n : ℕ) : ∀ m : Fin r → ℕ,
    (coloredCount r n m : ℚ) = (n.descFactorial (∑ i, m i) : ℚ) / ∏ i, ((m i).factorial : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro m
    by_cases h : ∀ i, m i = 0
    · have hP : ∀ f : Fin 0 → Option (Fin r),
          ∀ i : Fin r, Nat.card {x : Fin 0 // f x = some i} = m i := by
        intro f i; simp [h]
      unfold coloredCount
      rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeUnivEquiv hP)]
      simp [h]
    · push Not at h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
      have hC : coloredCount r 0 m = 0 := by
        unfold coloredCount
        rw [Nat.card_eq_zero]; left
        constructor; rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
        have := hg i; simp at this; omega
      have hle : m i ≤ ∑ j, m j :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      rw [hC, Nat.descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr (show 0 < ∑ j, m j by omega)]; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro m
    have hnone : Nat.card {g : Fin n → Option (Fin r) // ∀ i, Nat.card {x : Fin n // g x = some i}
        + (if (none : Option (Fin r)) = some i then 1 else 0) = m i} = coloredCount r n m := by
      simp [coloredCount]
    have key : ∀ i, ((if m i = 0 then 0 else coloredCount r n (Function.update m i (m i - 1)) : ℕ)
        : ℚ) = (m i : ℚ) * n.descFactorial (∑ j, m j - 1) / ∏ j, ((m j).factorial : ℚ) := by
      intro i
      split_ifs with h
      · simp [h]
      rw [ih]
      have hs : ∑ j, Function.update m i (m i - 1) j = ∑ j, m j - 1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase,
          ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
        omega
      have hp : (∏ j, ((Function.update m i (m i - 1) j).factorial : ℚ)) * m i
          = ∏ j, ((m j).factorial : ℚ) := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i),
          ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ (fun j => ((m j).factorial : ℚ)) (Finset.mem_univ i),
          Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun j hj => by
            rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)])]
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        rw [← Nat.mul_factorial_pred h]; push_cast; ring
      have hmi : (m i : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
      rw [hs, ← hp]
      have : (∏ j, ((Function.update m i (m i - 1) j).factorial : ℚ)) ≠ 0 :=
        Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j _ => by positivity
      field_simp
    rw [coloredCount_succ, Fintype.sum_option, hnone]
    simp only [coloredCount_term]
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sum, ih]
    simp only [key]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum, descFactorial_succ_left]
    push_cast; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.prod_range_sub_eq_descFactorial
statement:
private theorem prod_range_sub_eq_descFactorial (Q M : ℕ) :
    ((List.range M).map fun j => (Q:ℚ)-j).prod = (Q.descFactorial M : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.pure_def, List.bind_eq_flatMap, List.flatMap_append,
      List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, List.map_append, List.map_cons,
      List.map_nil, List.prod_append, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one,
      Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul] at ih ⊢
    rw [ih]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ Q
    · rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]; ring
    · simp [Nat.descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr (show Q < k by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.colored_subset_count
statement:
theorem colored_subset_count (Q r : ℕ) (m : Fin r → ℕ) :
    ((Nat.card {f : Fin Q→Option (Fin r) //
      ∀ i : Fin r, Nat.card {x : Fin Q // f x=some i}=m i} : ℕ) : ℚ) =
      ((List.range (∑ i : Fin r, m i)).map fun j => (Q:ℚ)-j).prod
        / ∏ i : Fin r, (Nat.factorial (m i):ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_range_sub_eq_descFactorial]
  exact coloredCount_eq r Q m

name: SurfaceBlowup.common_vertical_exponent
statement:
theorem common_vertical_exponent (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (C : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (C j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (C j)] (pi : O) (e : ∀ j, C j) (d : ℕ)
    (hvert : ∀ j, ∃ (s : ℕ) (cj : C j), algebraMap O (C j) pi ^ s = e j ^ d * cj) (s₀ : ℕ) :
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (cc : ∀ j, C j), s₀ ≤ s ∧ (algebraMap O (∀ j, C j) pi) ^ s = e ^ d * cc
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  choose sj cj h using hvert
  refine ⟨s₀ + ∑ i, sj i, fun j => cj j * algebraMap O (C j) pi ^ (s₀ + ∑ i, sj i - sj j),
    Nat.le_add_right _ _, funext fun j => ?_⟩
  have : sj j ≤ s₀ + ∑ i, sj i :=
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (sj i)) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
      (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  simp only [Pi.algebraMap_apply, Pi.pow_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' this, pow_add, h j]
  rw [mul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.congruence_bijection_measurable
statement:
theorem congruence_bijection_measurable (O V : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup V] [Module O V]
    (I : Ideal O) [MeasurableSpace V] (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace V› = adicCylinderSpace I V)
    (F : V → V) (honto : Function.Surjective F)
    (hcong : ∀ j x y, adicCongr I j (F x) (F y) ↔ adicCongr I j x y) :
    Measurable F
proof:
:= by
  rw [hgen]
  let _ : MeasurableSpace V := adicCylinderSpace I V
  refine measurable_generateFrom fun s hs => ?_
  rcases hs with rfl | ⟨j, a, rfl⟩
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := honto a
    have : F ⁻¹' {y | adicCongr I j y (F b)} = {y | adicCongr I j y b} := by
      ext y; simp [hcong]
    exact this ▸ MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (Or.inr ⟨j, b, rfl⟩)

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_constraint_count
statement:
theorem coordinate_constraint_count (k ι : Type) [Field k] [Fintype k] [Fintype ι]
    (A B : Finset ι) (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    Nat.card {f : ι→k // (∀ i∈A, f i=0) ∧ (∀ i∈B, f i≠0)}
      = (Fintype.card k-1)^B.card * (Fintype.card k)^(Fintype.card ι-A.card-B.card)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : ι → Finset k := fun i =>
    if i ∈ A then {0} else if i ∈ B then Finset.univ.erase 0 else Finset.univ
  have hset : (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun f : ι → k => (∀ i∈A, f i=0) ∧ (∀ i∈B, f i≠0))) = Fintype.piFinset S := by
    ext f
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset, S]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ i
      by_cases hA : i ∈ A
      · simp [hA, h1 i hA]
      · by_cases hB : i ∈ B
        · simp [hA, hB, h2 i hB]
        · simp [hA, hB]
    · intro h
      refine ⟨fun i hi => by simpa [hi] using h i, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      simpa [Finset.disjoint_right.mp hAB hi, hi] using h i
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, hset, Fintype.card_piFinset]
  have hcard : ∀ i, (S i).card =
      if i ∈ A then 1 else if i ∈ B then Fintype.card k - 1 else Fintype.card k := by
    intro i
    by_cases hA : i ∈ A
    · simp [S, hA]
    · by_cases hB : i ∈ B <;> simp [S, hA, hB, Finset.card_erase_of_mem]
  simp only [hcard]
  rw [Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const_one, one_mul, Finset.prod_ite,
    Finset.prod_const, Finset.prod_const, Finset.filter_filter, Finset.filter_filter]
  have h1 : Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i ∉ A ∧ i ∈ B) = B := by
    ext i
    simpa using fun h => Finset.disjoint_right.mp hAB h
  have h2 : Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i ∉ A ∧ i ∉ B) = (A ∪ B)ᶜ := by
    ext i; simp
  rw [h1, h2, Finset.card_compl, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hAB, Nat.sub_sub]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_ideal_in_residue_cell
statement:
theorem coordinate_ideal_in_residue_cell (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (f : R) (z : Fin n → O) :
    coordinateIdeal pi f b z ∈ residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  unfold coordinateIdeal normalizedIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  congr 2
  rw [normalizedGenerator, map_add, add_eq_left, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
    coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_module_pi_quotient_length
statement:
theorem coordinate_module_pi_quotient_length (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (V : Type) [AddCommGroup V] [Module O V]
    (EV : V ≃ₗ[O] (Fin n → O)) :
    Function.Injective (fun v : V => pi • v) ∧
      Module.length O (V ⧸ LinearMap.range (pi • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[O] V))) = (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun v w h => EV.injective <| funext fun i => mul_left_cancel₀ hpi.ne_zero ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using congrArg (fun x => EV x i) h
  set I : Ideal O := Ideal.span {pi} with hI
  have hsimple : IsSimpleModule O (O ⧸ I) := by
    have hImax : I.IsMaximal := by
      rw [hI, hpi.maximalIdeal_eq.symm]; exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal O
    rw [Ideal.isMaximal_def] at hImax
    exact isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr hImax
  let f : V →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O ⧸ I) :=
    LinearMap.pi (fun i => I.mkQ ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj i ∘ₗ EV.toLinearMap)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro y
    choose x hx using fun i => Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (y i)
    exact ⟨EV.symm x, funext fun i => by simp [f, hx]⟩
  have hker : LinearMap.ker f = LinearMap.range (pi • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[O] V)) := by
    ext v
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range, f]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : ∀ i, EV v i ∈ I := fun i => by
        simpa [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using congrFun h i
      choose y hy using fun i => Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (h' i)
      exact ⟨EV.symm y, EV.injective <| funext fun i => by simp [← hy i, mul_comm]⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
      funext i
      simp only [LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
        LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.coe_proj,
        Function.eval, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, hI, smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨EV w i, mul_comm _ _⟩
  let e := (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker).symm.trans (f.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj)
  rw [e.length_eq, Module.length_pi, Module.length_eq_one]
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_remainder_raises_order
statement:
theorem coordinate_remainder_raises_order (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) :
    RaisesAdicOrder (Ideal.span {pi}) (coordinateRemainder pi b E)
proof:
:= by
  set I : Ideal O := Ideal.span {pi}
  have key : ∀ (j : ℕ) {M N : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module O N]
      (f : M →ₗ[O] N) (x : M), x ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O M) →
        f x ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O N) := by
    intro j M N _ _ _ _ f x hx
    have hle : (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O M) ≤ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O N).comap f := by
      rw [Submodule.smul_le]
      intro r hr m _
      simpa using Submodule.smul_mem_smul hr Submodule.mem_top
    exact hle hx
  intro j x y hxy
  unfold adicCongr at hxy ⊢
  have h2 : x.2 - y.2 ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) := by
    simpa using key j (LinearMap.snd O (Fin n → O) R) _ hxy
  have hL : coordinateLift b x.1 - coordinateLift b y.1 ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) := by
    simpa [coordinateLift, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      using key j ((Fintype.linearCombination O b).comp (LinearMap.fst O (Fin n → O) R)) _ hxy
  have hprod : x.2 * coordinateLift b x.1 - y.2 * coordinateLift b y.1
      ∈ (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule O R) := by
    rw [show x.2 * coordinateLift b x.1 - y.2 * coordinateLift b y.1
        = x.2 * (coordinateLift b x.1 - coordinateLift b y.1)
          + (x.2 - y.2) * coordinateLift b y.1 by ring]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (key j (LinearMap.mulLeft O x.2) _ hL)
      (key j (LinearMap.mulRight O (coordinateLift b y.1)) _ h2)
  have hE := key j E.toLinearMap _ hprod
  simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, map_sub] at hE
  unfold coordinateRemainder
  rw [← smul_sub, pow_succ', Submodule.mul_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self pi) hE

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_quot_eq_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := J)
  let s := Function.surjInv hs
  have hmk : ∀ x, Ideal.Quotient.mk J (s x) = x := Function.surjInv_eq hs
  refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective (fun x => φ (s x)) ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun m => ?_⟩)
  · rwa [← hmk x, ← hmk y, Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← hker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hφ m
    have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk J (s (Ideal.Quotient.mk J r)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J r := hmk _
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← hker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h1
    exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk J r, h1⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_quot_divisionChart
statement:
private theorem card_quot_divisionChart (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ)
    (f : R) (b : Fin n → R) (hb : IsDivisionChart O R pi f b) :
    Nat.card (R ⧸ Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}))
      (Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f})) =
      Nat.card (Fin n → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := hb.1
  have hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O = Ideal.span {pi} := hpi.maximalIdeal_eq
  let φ : R →+ (Fin n → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :=
    { toFun := fun r i => IsLocalRing.residue O ((E r).1 i)
      map_zero' := by ext i; simp
      map_add' := by intro x y; ext i; simp }
  apply card_quot_eq_of_surjective R _ _ φ
  · intro m
    choose z hz using fun i => IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := O) (m i)
    exact ⟨E.symm (z, 0), by ext i; simp [φ, hz]⟩
  · intro r
    have hEf : ∀ a : R, E (f * a) = (0, a) := fun a => E.symm.injective <| by
      rw [E.symm_apply_apply, hE]
      simp [divisionMap, coordinateLift]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hi : ∀ i, ∃ y, pi * y = (E r).1 i := fun i ↦ by
        have : IsLocalRing.residue O ((E r).1 i) = 0 := congrFun h i
        rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hmax, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at this
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := this
        exact ⟨y, by rw [← hy, mul_comm]⟩
      choose z hz using hi
      have hr : r = algebraMap O R pi * coordinateLift b z + f * (E r).2 := by
        have := hE (E r)
        rw [E.symm_apply_apply] at this
        refine this.trans ?_
        rw [divisionMap, ← coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul]
        congr 2; ext i; exact (hz i).symm
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
      refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (E r).2, ?_⟩
      rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
      exact ⟨-coordinateLift b z, by linear_combination hr⟩
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (Ideal.mem_comap.1 h)
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
      rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at ha
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := ha
      have hr : r = f * a + pi • (-t) := by
        rw [Algebra.smul_def]; linear_combination ht
      ext i
      simp only [φ, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [hr, map_add, map_smul, hEf]
      simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
        zero_add, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hmax]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_chart_rank_eq_of_residue_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem division_chart_rank_eq_of_residue_ideal_eq (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n n' : ℕ) (f g : R) (b : Fin n → R) (c : Fin n' → R)
    (hb : IsDivisionChart O R pi f b) (hc : IsDivisionChart O R pi g c)
    (hres : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) g}) :
    n = n'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := card_quot_divisionChart O R pi hpi n f b hb
  rw [hres, card_quot_divisionChart O R pi hpi n' g c hc] at h1
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  simp only [Nat.card_pi, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
  exact (Nat.pow_right_injective (Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mpr inferInstance) h1).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_coordinates_injective
statement:
private theorem division_coordinates_injective (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ)
    (f : R) (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) O (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) (b : Fin n → R)
    (hb : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (b i) = B i) [IsDomain R] (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (divisionMap (O := O) f b)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ z : Fin n → O,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (coordinateLift b z) = ∑ i, z i • B i := by
    intro z
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk O, coordinateLift, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, hb]
  rintro ⟨z, v⟩ ⟨z', v'⟩ h
  simp only [divisionMap] at h
  have hq := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f})) h
  have hf0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) f = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self f)
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, hf0, zero_mul, add_zero, key] at hq
  obtain rfl : z = z' := funext fun i => by
    simpa [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply] using congrArg (fun x => B.repr x i) hq
  rw [mul_left_cancel₀ hf (add_left_cancel h)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_coordinates_surjective
statement:
private theorem division_coordinates_surjective (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (f : R) (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) O (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) (b : Fin n → R)
    (hb : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (b i) = B i) :
    Function.Surjective (divisionMap (O := O) f b)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  set z : Fin n → O := fun i => B.repr (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) i
  have hz : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (coordinateLift b z)
      = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h := by
    unfold coordinateLift
    rw [map_sum]
    conv_rhs => rw [← B.sum_repr (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, hb i, Algebra.smul_def]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (Ideal.Quotient.eq.1 hz.symm)
  exact ⟨(z, v), by simp only [divisionMap]; rw [mul_comm, hv]; ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_data_same_cell_recenter
statement:
theorem division_data_same_cell_recenter (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [IsLocalRing R] (pi : O) (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ)
    (f g : R) (c : Fin n → R)
    (hf : Function.Injective (fun y : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} =>
      y * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f))
    (Ec : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (hEc : ∀ s, Ec.symm s = divisionMap g c s)
    (hres : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) g}) :
    ∃ (g' : R) (c' : Fin n → R) (F : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (h₀ : R),
      (∀ s, F.symm s = divisionMap g' c' s) ∧ f = g' + pi • h₀ ∧
      Function.Injective (fun y : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} =>
        y * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) g') ∧
      ∀ z : Fin n → O, coordinateIdeal pi g c z = coordinateIdeal pi g' c' z
proof:
:= by
  set I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} with hI
  set mk := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hIm : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [hI, Ideal.span_le]; simpa using hpm
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (hres ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (mk g))
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (hres ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (mk f))
  have hba : b * a = 1 := hf <| by simp only; rw [one_mul, mul_assoc, ha, hb]
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
  have hunit : IsUnit a' := by
    by_contra hna
    have h2 : b' * a' - 1 ∈ I := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, map_mul, map_one]
      exact sub_eq_zero.2 hba
    have := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).sub_mem ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).mul_mem_left b'
      ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hna)) (hIm h2)
    simp at this
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hunit
  
  let M : R ≃ₗ[O] R :=
    { toFun := fun x => (u : R) * x
      invFun := fun x => ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * x
      map_add' := fun x y => mul_add _ _ _
      map_smul' := fun r x => by simp [Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
      left_inv := fun x => Units.inv_mul_cancel_left u x
      right_inv := fun x => Units.mul_inv_cancel_left u x }
  have hlift : ∀ (w : R) (z : Fin n → O),
      w * coordinateLift c z = coordinateLift (fun i => w * c i) z := by
    intro w z
    simp only [coordinateLift, Finset.mul_sum, mul_smul_comm]
  have hg' : mk (((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * g) = mk f := by
    rw [map_mul, ← ha, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one, one_mul]
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (Ideal.Quotient.eq.1 hg')
  refine ⟨((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * g, fun i => ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * c i, M.trans Ec, -h, fun s => ?_, ?_,
    ?_, fun z => ?_⟩
  · rw [LinearEquiv.trans_symm, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, hEc]
    change ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * divisionMap g c s = _
    simp only [divisionMap, mul_add, hlift, mul_assoc]
  · rw [smul_neg, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm (algebraMap O R pi), hh]; ring
  · simpa only [show mk (((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * g) = mk f from hg'] using hf
  · simp only [coordinateIdeal, normalizedIdeal, normalizedGenerator]
    rw [← hlift, ← mul_add, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit (Units.isUnit _)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_chart_same_cell_recenter
statement:
theorem division_chart_same_cell_recenter (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [IsLocalRing R] (pi : O) (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ)
    (f g : R) (b c : Fin n → R) (hb : IsDivisionChart O R pi f b) (hc : IsDivisionChart O R pi g c)
    (hres : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) g}) :
    ∃ (g' : R) (c' : Fin n → R) (F : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (h₀ : R),
      (∀ s, F.symm s = divisionMap g' c' s) ∧ f = g' + pi • h₀ ∧
      Function.Injective (fun y : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} =>
        y * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) g') ∧
      ∀ z : Fin n → O, coordinateIdeal pi g c z = coordinateIdeal pi g' c' z
proof:
:=
  let ⟨Ec, hEc⟩ := hc.1
  division_data_same_cell_recenter O R pi hpm n f g c hb.2 Ec hEc hres

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_linear_equivalence
statement:
theorem division_linear_equivalence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (f : R) (B : Module.Basis (Fin n) O (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) (b : Fin n → R)
    (hb : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) (b i) = B i) [IsDomain R] (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R), ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s
proof:
:= by
  let L : ((Fin n → O) × R) →ₗ[O] R :=
    { toFun := divisionMap f b
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        simp only [divisionMap, coordinateLift, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Pi.add_apply,
          add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
        ring
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        simp only [divisionMap, coordinateLift, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Pi.smul_apply,
          smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, smul_add, Finset.smul_sum, mul_smul]
        rw [mul_smul_comm] }
  exact ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofBijective L ⟨division_coordinates_injective O R n f B b hb hf,
    division_coordinates_surjective O R n f B b hb⟩).symm, fun _ => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_coordinate_adic_congruence
statement:
theorem finite_coordinate_adic_congruence (O : Type) [CommRing O] (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal O) (j : ℕ)
    (x y : Fin n → O) :
    adicCongr I j x y ↔ ∀ i, x i - y i ∈ I^j
proof:
:= by
  unfold adicCongr
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : ∀ i, (x - y) i ∈ I ^ j :=
      Submodule.smul_induction_on h
        (fun r hr m _ i => by simpa using Ideal.mul_mem_right (m i) _ hr)
        (fun a b ha hb i => by simpa using Ideal.add_mem _ (ha i) (hb i))
    simpa using this
  · intro h
    have hv : x - y = ∑ i, (x i - y i) • (Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → O) := by
      funext k
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [hv]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem_smul (h i) Submodule.mem_top

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_coordinate_cylinder_basis
statement:
theorem finite_coordinate_cylinder_basis (O : Type) [CommRing O] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] (I : Ideal O) (htop : IsAdic I) (n : ℕ) :
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis (adicCylinders I (Fin n → O))
proof:
:= by
  have hball : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Fin n → O),
      {y : Fin n → O | adicCongr I j y x} = {y | ∀ i, y i - x i ∈ I ^ j} := fun j x =>
    Set.ext fun y => finite_coordinate_adic_congruence O n I j y x
  have hring : ∀ (j : ℕ) (a b : O), b - a ∈ I ^ j → {t : O | t - a ∈ I ^ j} ∈ nhds b := by
    intro j a b hb
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset ((htop.hasBasis_nhds b).mem_of_mem (i := j) trivial) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    change b + k - a ∈ I ^ j
    rw [show b + k - a = (b - a) + k by ring]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hb hk
  refine TopologicalSpace.isTopologicalBasis_of_isOpen_of_nhds ?_ ?_
  · rintro s (rfl | ⟨j, x, rfl⟩)
    · exact isOpen_empty
    rw [hball, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro y hy
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset (Filter.iInter_mem.2 fun i =>
      (continuous_apply i).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hring j (x i) (y i) (hy i))) ?_
    intro z hz
    simpa only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hz
  · intro x U hxU hU
    obtain ⟨F, u, hu, hFU⟩ := isOpen_pi_iff.1 hU x hxU
    have hj : ∀ i ∈ F, ∃ j : ℕ, ∀ t : O, t - x i ∈ I ^ j → t ∈ u i := by
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := (htop.hasBasis_nhds (x i)).mem_iff.1
        ((hu i hi).1.mem_nhds (hu i hi).2)
      exact ⟨j, fun t ht => hj ⟨t - x i, ht, by simp⟩⟩
    choose! J hJ using hj
    refine ⟨{y | adicCongr I (F.sup J) y x}, Or.inr ⟨F.sup J, x, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hball]; intro i; simp
    · rw [hball]
      exact fun y hy => hFU fun i hi =>
        hJ i hi (y i) (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Finset.le_sup hi) (hy i))

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders
statement:
theorem finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders (O : Type) [CommRing O] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] (I : Ideal O) (htop : IsAdic I) (n : ℕ) [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] :
    (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)) = adicCylinderSpace I (Fin n → O)
proof:
:= by
  rw [BorelSpace.measurable_eq (α := Fin n → O)]
  exact (finite_coordinate_cylinder_basis O I htop n).borel_eq_generateFrom

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_coordinate_linear_continuous
statement:
theorem finite_coordinate_linear_continuous (O : Type) [CommRing O] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] (m n : ℕ) (L : (Fin m → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O)) :
    Continuous L
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.continuous_on_pi L

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_transform_ideal_of_generator
statement:
theorem strict_transform_ideal_of_generator (O R C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra O R] [Algebra O C] (alpha : R →ₐ[O] C) (e g : C) (d : ℕ) (f : R)
    (hf : alpha f = e ^ d * g) (he : Function.Injective (fun z : C => e * z)) :
    strictTransformIdeal alpha e d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {g}
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a b : C, e ^ n * a = e ^ n * b → a = b := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro a b h; simpa using h
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a b h
      apply ih
      apply he
      simp only [pow_succ] at h
      simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h
  have hmap : (Ideal.span {f}).map alpha.toRingHom = Ideal.span {e ^ d * g} := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    simp [hf]
  ext u
  unfold strictTransformIdeal
  rw [hmap, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton', Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    refine ⟨v, hinj d _ _ ?_⟩
    calc e ^ d * (v * g) = v * (e ^ d * g) := by ring
      _ = u • e ^ d := hv
      _ = e ^ d * u := by simp [mul_comm]
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    calc v * (e ^ d * g) = e ^ d * (v * g) := by ring
      _ = u • e ^ d := by rw [hv]; simp [mul_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.power_coordinates_isAdic
statement:
private theorem power_coordinates_isAdic (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hm : Φ.Monic)
    [TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hτ : ‹TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedTopology O Φ hm) [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) :
    IsAdic (baseIdeal O Φ)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ) := unramifiedMeasurableSpace O Φ hm
  obtain ⟨hTR, -, -, -, -, hcont, -⟩ :=
    power_coordinates_transport O Φ hm hτ rfl
  set e := powerCoordinates O Φ hm with he
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  have hB := finite_coordinate_cylinder_basis O m htop Φ.natDegree
  
  have hpre : ∀ L : ℕ, ((baseIdeal O Φ ^ L : Ideal _) : Set (AdjoinRoot Φ)) =
      e ⁻¹' {v | adicCongr m L v 0} := by
    intro L
    ext x
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
      finite_coordinate_adic_congruence, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero]
    rw [base_ideal_coordinates O Φ hm L x]
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hopenB : ∀ L : ℕ, IsOpen {v : Fin Φ.natDegree → O | adicCongr m L v 0} := fun L =>
    hB.isOpen (Or.inr ⟨L, 0, rfl⟩)
  rw [isAdic_iff]
  refine ⟨fun L => ?_, fun s hs => ?_⟩
  · rw [hpre L]; exact (hopenB L).preimage hcont
  · have hs' : s ∈ Filter.comap e (nhds (e 0)) := by
      subst hτ
      rw [← nhds_induced]; exact hs
    rw [map_zero] at hs'
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVs⟩ := Filter.mem_comap.1 hs'
    obtain ⟨W, hW, h0W, hWV⟩ := hB.mem_nhds_iff.1 hV
    rcases hW with rfl | ⟨L, x, rfl⟩
    · exact absurd h0W (Set.notMem_empty _)
    refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
    rw [hpre L]
    intro y hy
    apply hVs
    apply hWV
    have R := adic_congruence_rules O (Fin Φ.natDegree → O) m
    exact R.2.2.1 L _ _ _ hy h0W

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_extension_measure_package
statement:
theorem unramified_extension_measure_package (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    [TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hτ : ‹TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedTopology O Φ hΦ.1)
    (hmeas : ‹MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedMeasurableSpace O Φ hΦ.1) :
    ∃ (_ : IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (_ : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)), True ∧
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) ∧
      Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = residueCard O ^ Φ.natDegree ∧
      IsTopologicalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧ CompactSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧ T2Space (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      SecondCountableTopology (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧ BorelSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, l, hdvr, hmax, -, hcomp, hfin, hcard⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, -⟩ := power_coordinates_transport O Φ hΦ.1 hτ hmeas
  have hadic := power_coordinates_isAdic O Φ hΦ.1 hτ htop
  have hdeg : 0 < Φ.natDegree := by
    have := (unramified_free_module O Φ hΦ.1).2.2
    have hf : Module.finrank O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≠ 0 := by
      have : Nontrivial (AdjoinRoot Φ) := d.toNontrivial
      have := (unramified_free_module O Φ hΦ.1).1
      have := (unramified_free_module O Φ hΦ.1).2.1
      exact Module.finrank_pos.ne'
    omega
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro c hc
    have hm : ∀ L : ℕ, c ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L := fun L =>
      (base_ideal_pure O Φ hΦ.1 hdeg L c).1 (by rw [hc]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _)
    have := Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isDomain (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal O).ne_top)
    rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← this]
    exact Ideal.mem_iInf.2 hm
  exact ⟨d, l, trivial, hdvr, hcomp, hfin, hcard, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, by rw [hmax]; exact hadic⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_coefficient_measure_pi
statement:
theorem unramified_coefficient_measure_pi (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    [TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hτ : ‹TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedTopology O Φ hΦ.1)
    (hmeas : ‹MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedMeasurableSpace O Φ hΦ.1)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [IsTopologicalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [CompactSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    [T2Space (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [SecondCountableTopology (AdjoinRoot Φ)] [BorelSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hΦ.1)] (r : ℕ) :
    coefficientMeasure (AdjoinRoot Φ) r =
      MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin r => unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hΦ.1) ∧
      ∀ (L : ℕ) (a : Fin r → AdjoinRoot Φ),
      coefficientMeasure (AdjoinRoot Φ) r {b | ∀ j, b j - a j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L} =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (Φ.natDegree * r * L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hcard, _, _, _, _, _, hadic⟩ :=
    unramified_extension_measure_package O htop Φ hΦ hτ hmeas
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hmax, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨hH, hP, -⟩ :=
    unramified_coefficient_measure_haar O Φ hΦ.1 hτ hmeas htop
  have hprob := coefficient_measure_probability (AdjoinRoot Φ) hadic r
  have hμ : MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (coefficientMeasure (AdjoinRoot Φ) r) := by
    unfold coefficientMeasure
    apply MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure.smul
    · exact ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)
    · exact ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.IsOpenPosMeasure.open_pos _ isOpen_univ Set.univ_nonempty)
  refine ⟨MeasureTheory.Measure.isAddHaarMeasure_eq_of_isProbabilityMeasure _ _, ?_⟩
  intro L a
  have h := coefficient_cylinder_mass (AdjoinRoot Φ) hadic r L a
  rw [hmax, hcard] at h
  rw [h, Nat.cast_pow, ← ENNReal.inv_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.strict_normalizer_pushforward_linear
statement:
theorem strict_normalizer_pushforward_linear (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) (k : ℕ)
    (ha : k < a) (Q : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O))
    (hQ : ∀ w, normalizationLinearPart E H (Q w) = (pi ^ k) • w)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O)] [MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)]
    [MeasurableAdd (Fin n → O)]
    (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)› = adicCylinderSpace (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O))
    (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin n → O)) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant mu]
    (hfinite : ∀ j, Finite (AdicQuotient (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O) j))
    (hL : Measurable (fun z : Fin n → O => (pi^a) • normalizationLinearPart E H z)) :
    mu.map (scaledStrictMap pi a b E H) =
      mu.map (fun z : Fin n → O => (pi^a) • normalizationLinearPart E H z)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := strict_correction_raises_order O R n pi a b E H k ha Q
  have hP := adic_perturb_measure_preserving O (Fin n → O) (Ideal.span {pi})
    _ hr mu hgen hfinite
  have hfun : scaledStrictMap pi a b E H =
      (fun z : Fin n → O => (pi^a) • normalizationLinearPart E H z) ∘
        adicPerturb (normalizationCorrection pi a k b E H Q) := by
    funext z
    exact strict_normalizer_factors_through_linear O R n pi a b E H k ha Q hQ z
  rw [hfun, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_map hL hP.measurable, hP.map_eq]

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_quotient_mul_parameter_injective
statement:
private theorem child_quotient_mul_parameter_injective (m : ConcreteMember)
    (c : m.toMeasured.cellIndex) (mc : m.toMeasured.childIdx c → ConcreteMember)
    (e g : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) (he : ∀ j, e j = (mc j).toMeasured.S.t)
    (hgj : ∀ j, Ideal.span {g j} ∈ (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet) :
    Function.Injective (fun y : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ⧸ Ideal.span {g} =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e * y)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ x : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R, x ∈ Ideal.span {g} ↔ ∀ j, x j ∈ Ideal.span {g j} :=
    fun x ↦ by rw [← Ideal.pi_span, Ideal.mem_pi]
  intro x y hxy
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with | h x => ?_
  induction y using Quotient.inductionOn' with | h y => ?_
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ e * Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ e *
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ y at hxy
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ y
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← mul_sub] at hxy
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, hmem]
  intro j
  have h0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g j}) (mc j).toMeasured.S.t *
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((x - y) j) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (mc j).toMeasured.S.t * 0 := by
    rw [mul_zero, ← map_mul, ← he j, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    simpa using (hmem _).1 hxy j
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact (concrete_member_state_generator_transverse (mc j) (g j) (hgj j)).2 h0

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_center_linear_part
statement:
theorem member_center_linear_part (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.toMeasured.cellIndex)
    (mc : m.toMeasured.childIdx c → ConcreteMember)
    [∀ j, Algebra m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O]
    [∀ j, Algebra m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R]
    [∀ j, IsScalarTower m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R]
    (hcard : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.q = m.toMeasured.q ^ m.toMeasured.childDelta c j)
    (alpha : ∀ j, m.toMeasured.R →ₐ[m.toMeasured.O] (mc j).toMeasured.R)
    (e : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) (he : ∀ j, e j = (mc j).toMeasured.S.t)
    (hbij : Set.BijOn
      (fun (J : Ideal m.toMeasured.R) (j : m.toMeasured.childIdx c) => strictTransformIdeal
      (alpha j) (e j) (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) J) (m.toMeasured.cell c)
      (Set.pi Set.univ fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet))
    (hindex : ∀ f : m.toMeasured.R, Ideal.span {f} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c →
      ∀ g : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R), (∀ j, alpha j f = e j ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * g j) →
      ∀ iota : (m.toMeasured.R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) →ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      ((∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}),
      (∀ h : m.toMeasured.R, iota (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}) h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (fun j => alpha j h)) → Function.Injective iota ∧
      Module.length m.toMeasured.O
      (((∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range iota) =
      (chooseTwo (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) : ℕ∞))
    (hsum : ∑ j, m.toMeasured.childDelta c j * (mc j).toMeasured.s.firstContact =
      m.toMeasured.cellDegree c)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : tri (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) ≤ s) (cc : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R))
    (hcc : (algebraMap m.toMeasured.O (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) m.toMeasured.S.pi) ^ s =
      e ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * cc)
    (f : m.toMeasured.R) (b : Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.R)
    (E₀ : m.toMeasured.R ≃ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      ((Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O) × m.toMeasured.R))
    (hE₀ : ∀ w, E₀.symm w = divisionMap f b w) (hf : Ideal.span {f} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c)
    (g : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R)) (hg : ∀ j, alpha j f = e j ^ m.toMeasured.cellDegree c * g j)
    (bc : Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R)) :
    (letI : Module m.toMeasured.O (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) := Algebra.toModule;
      ∀ (E : (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ≃ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      ((Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O) × (∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R))),
      (∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w) →
      ∃ Q : (Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O) →ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      (Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O),
      (∀ w, normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b) (Q w) =
      (m.toMeasured.S.pi ^ (s * m.toMeasured.s.degree - tri (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c))) • w) ∧
      Function.Injective (normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b)) ∧
      Module.length m.toMeasured.O
      ((Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O) ⧸ LinearMap.range
      (normalizationLinearPart E (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b))) =
      ((s * m.toMeasured.s.degree - tri (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
proof:
:= by
  intro E hE
  
  
  have hpiO : Irreducible m.toMeasured.S.pi := m.toMeasured.S.pi_irreducible
  have hf' : AlgHom.pi alpha f = e ^ (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) * g := by
    funext j; simp [AlgHom.pi_apply, hg j]
  have hgj : ∀ j, Ideal.span {g j} ∈ (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet := fun j => by
    simpa [strict_transform_ideal_of_generator _ _ _ (alpha j) (e j) (g j) _ f (hg j)
      (concrete_member_mul_t_injective (he j))] using hbij.mapsTo hf j (Set.mem_univ _)
  obtain ⟨phi, hphi⟩ := strict_quotient_map_exists m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.R _ _ f g e cc _ hf'
  obtain ⟨iota, hiota⟩ :=
    strict_quotient_inclusion_exists m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.R _ _ f g e _ hf'
  obtain ⟨hiota_inj, hindex'⟩ := hindex f hf g hg iota hiota
  have hereg := child_quotient_mul_parameter_injective m c mc e g he hgj
  have hechild : Module.length m.toMeasured.O
      (((∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸ LinearMap.range
      (LinearMap.mulLeft m.toMeasured.O (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e))) =
      ((m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [pi_mul_cokernel_length m.toMeasured.O _ _ g e
      (fun j => m.toMeasured.childDelta c j * (mc j).toMeasured.s.firstContact) fun j => by
      apply length_scaling_of_residue_card m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O _ (hcard j)
      rw [he j]
      exact concrete_member_state_generator_contact_length (mc j) (g j) (hgj j), hsum]
  obtain ⟨EC, -⟩ := division_equiv_child_coordinates m.toMeasured.O _ _ g bc E hE
  obtain ⟨hpireg, hpiquot⟩ := coordinate_module_pi_quotient_length m.toMeasured.O _ hpiO _ _ EC
  have hlen := strict_quotient_cokernel_length m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.R _ _ f g e cc _ _ s hcc
    _ phi iota hphi hiota hindex' hereg hechild hpireg hpiquot
    (le_trans hs (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right s (concrete_member_one_le_degree m)))
  have hphi_inj := strict_quotient_map_injective m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.R _ _ f g e cc _ _ s
    hcc phi iota hphi hiota hiota_inj hpireg
  obtain ⟨EB, hEB⟩ := division_quotient_basis_equiv m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.R _ f b E₀ hE₀
  obtain ⟨hL, hI⟩ := normalization_linear_part_cokernel_length_eq m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.R _ _
    f g e cc _ hf' _ _ s hcc b bc E hE phi hphi EB hEB
  have hDinj := hI hphi_inj
  have hkl := hL.trans hlen
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, -⟩ := scaled_inverse_from_image_containment m.toMeasured.O _ _ _ _ _ hDinj
    (linear_image_bound_from_cokernel_length m.toMeasured.O _ _ _ hpiO.maximalIdeal_eq _ _ hkl)
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, hDinj, hkl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_pi_factor
statement:
private theorem algebra_type_pi_factor (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (A : Type) [CommRing A]
    [Algebra O A] (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)]
    (e : TensorProduct O (BaseField O) A ≃ₐ[BaseField O] TensorProduct O (BaseField O) (∀ j, B j))
    (σ : FactorType) (hσ : HasAlgebraType O A σ) :
    ∀ j, ∃ τ : FactorType, HasAlgebraType O (B j) τ
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, L, hF, hK, hO, hT, hD, e₀, -, hsepL⟩ := hσ
  let p := Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight O (BaseField O) (BaseField O) B
  let π := Pi.evalAlgHom (BaseField O) (fun j => TensorProduct O (BaseField O) (B j)) j
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := fun y => ⟨Pi.single j y, by simp [π]⟩
  let q := Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hπ
  let g := p.symm.trans (e.symm.trans e₀)
  let I := (RingHom.ker π).map
      (g : ((i : Fin n) → TensorProduct O (BaseField O) (B i)) →+* ((i : ι) → L i))
  obtain ⟨S, e₁, -⟩ := pi_field_quotient_equiv (BaseField O) ι L I
  let E := q.symm.trans ((Ideal.quotientEquivAlg (RingHom.ker π) I g rfl).trans e₁)
  exact ⟨_, S, inferInstance, fun i => L i.1, fun i => hF i.1, fun i => hK i.1, fun i => hO i.1,
    fun i => hT i.1, fun i => hD i.1, E, rfl, fun i => hsepL i.1⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_children_exists
statement:
theorem algebra_type_children_exists (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (A : Type) [CommRing A] [Algebra O A] (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)] (ψ : A →ₐ[O] ∀ j, B j)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ψ) (ℓ : ℕ)
    (hℓ : Module.length O ((∀ j, B j) ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ.toLinearMap) = ℓ) (σ : FactorType)
    (hσ : HasAlgebraType O A σ) :
    ∀ j, ∃ τ : FactorType, HasAlgebraType O (B j) τ
proof:
:= by
  have hb := baseChange_bijective_of_finite_cokernel O A (∀ j, B j) ψ.toLinearMap hinj ℓ hℓ
  have hfun : ∀ x, (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (BaseField O) (BaseField O)) ψ) x
      = LinearMap.baseChange (BaseField O) ψ.toLinearMap x := by
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul k a => simp
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  have hΨ : Function.Bijective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (BaseField O) (BaseField O)) ψ) := by
    have : ⇑(Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (BaseField O) (BaseField O)) ψ)
        = ⇑(LinearMap.baseChange (BaseField O) ψ.toLinearMap) := funext hfun
    rw [this]; exact hb
  exact algebra_type_pi_factor O A n B (AlgEquiv.ofBijective _ hΨ) σ hσ

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_strict_transform_map_eval
statement:
theorem pi_strict_transform_map_eval (O : Type) [CommRing O] (R : Type) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (C : ι → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (C j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (C j)]
    (alpha : ∀ j, R →ₐ[O] C j) (e g : ∀ j, C j) (d : ℕ) (J : Ideal R) :
    (∀ x : ∀ j, C j, x ∈ Ideal.span {g} ↔ ∀ j, x j ∈ Ideal.span {g j}) ∧
      (∀ j, (Ideal.span {g}).map (Pi.evalRingHom C j) = Ideal.span {g j}) ∧
      (∀ x : ∀ j, C j, x ∈ strictTransformIdeal (AlgHom.pi alpha) e d J ↔ ∀ j,
      x j ∈ strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) d J) ∧ ∀ j,
      (strictTransformIdeal (AlgHom.pi alpha) e d J).map (Pi.evalRingHom C j) =
      strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) d J
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  classical
  have hmap : ∀ j, (J.map (AlgHom.pi alpha).toRingHom).map (Pi.evalRingHom C j)
      = J.map (alpha j).toRingHom := fun j ↦ by rw [Ideal.map_map]; rfl
  have hpi := (pi_ideal_mem_iff_map_eval ι C (J.map (AlgHom.pi alpha).toRingHom)).1
  have key : ∀ x : ∀ j, C j, x ∈ strictTransformIdeal (AlgHom.pi alpha) e d J ↔
      ∀ j, x j ∈ strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) d J := by
    intro x
    simp only [strictTransformIdeal, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Algebra.smul_def]
    rw [hpi]
    exact forall_congr' fun j ↦ by rw [hmap j]; simp
  refine ⟨fun x ↦ by rw [← Ideal.pi_span, Ideal.mem_pi], fun j ↦ by rw [principal_ideal_image]; rfl,
    key, fun j ↦ le_antisymm (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun x hx ↦ (key x).1 hx j) fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  have : (Pi.single j y : ∀ j, C j) ∈ strictTransformIdeal (AlgHom.pi alpha) e d J :=
    (key _).2 fun k ↦ by
      by_cases h : k = j
      · subst h; simpa using hy
      · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne h]
  simpa using Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Pi.evalRingHom C j) this

name: SurfaceBlowup.product_chart_projection
statement:
theorem product_chart_projection (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (Oj : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (Oj j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (Oj j)] (R : ι → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (R j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra O (R j)] [∀ j, Algebra (Oj j) (R j)] [∀ j, IsScalarTower O (Oj j) (R j)]
    (nn : ι → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (ρ : (Fin n → O) ≃ₗ[O] (∀ j, Fin (nn j) → Oj j))
    (bc' : ∀ j, Fin (nn j) → R j) (bc : Fin n → ∀ j, R j)
    (hcompat : ∀ (w : Fin n → O) (j : ι), coordinateLift bc w j = coordinateLift (bc' j) (ρ w j))
    (g : ∀ j, R j) (pi : O) (pij : ∀ j, Oj j) (hpi : ∀ j, algebraMap O (Oj j) pi = pij j) :
    (∀ (w : Fin n → O) (j : ι), (coordinateIdeal pi g bc w).map (Pi.evalRingHom R j) =
      coordinateIdeal (pij j) (g j) (bc' j) (ρ w j)) ∧
      (∀ (w : Fin n → O) (x : ∀ j, R j), x ∈ coordinateIdeal pi g bc w ↔ ∀ j,
      x j ∈ coordinateIdeal (pij j) (g j) (bc' j) (ρ w j)) ∧
      ((∀ j, Function.Injective (coordinateIdeal (pij j) (g j) (bc' j))) →
      Function.Injective (coordinateIdeal pi g bc))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (w : Fin n → O) (j : ι),
      (g + coordinateLift bc (pi • w)) j = g j + coordinateLift (bc' j) (pij j • ρ w j) := by
    intro w j
    simp only [coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    rw [← hpi, algebraMap_smul, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, hcompat]
  have proj : ∀ (w : Fin n → O) (j : ι), (coordinateIdeal pi g bc w).map (Pi.evalRingHom R j) =
      coordinateIdeal (pij j) (g j) (bc' j) (ρ w j) := fun w j ↦
    (principal_ideal_image _ _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun y ↦ Ideal.span {y}) (key w j))
  refine ⟨proj, fun w x ↦ ?_, fun hinj w w' h ↦ ρ.injective <| funext fun j ↦
    hinj j <| by rw [← proj, ← proj, h]⟩
  refine ((pi_strict_transform_map_eval O O ι R (fun j ↦ Algebra.ofId O (R j)) 0
    (g + coordinateLift bc (pi • w)) 0 ⊥).1 x).trans (forall_congr' fun j ↦ ?_)
  rw [key]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_ideal_surjective
statement:
