private theorem coordinate_ideal_surjective (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (f : R)
    (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s)
    (hf : Function.Injective
      (fun x : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} => x *
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f))
    (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ∈ residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) f) :
    ∃ z : Fin n → O, coordinateIdeal pi f b z = J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := residue_ideal_has_fixed_generator_lift R
    (algebraMap O R pi) f hpm hf J hJ
  refine ⟨(generatorNormalForm pi b E h).1, ?_⟩
  have key := normalizer_generator_equation O R n pi b E f hE h
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := normalizing_factor_is_unit O R pi hpm
    (generatorNormalForm pi b E h).2
  unfold coordinateIdeal normalizedIdeal normalizedGenerator
  simp only [coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul, ← Algebra.smul_def]
  rw [← key, ← hu, principal_ideal_unit_invariance]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_ideal_cell_bijection
statement:
theorem coordinate_ideal_cell_bijection (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hp0 : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0) (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (f : R)
    (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s)
    (hf : Function.Injective
      (fun x : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} => x *
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f))
    :
    Function.Injective (coordinateIdeal pi f b) ∧ Set.range (coordinateIdeal pi f b) =
      residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨coordinate_ideal_injective O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hf, Set.ext fun J ↦
    ⟨?_, coordinate_ideal_surjective O R n pi b E hpm f hE hf J⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
  exact coordinate_ideal_in_residue_cell O R n pi b f z

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_transition_ideal_identity
statement:
private theorem coordinate_transition_ideal_identity (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (f g : R) (c : Fin n → R)
    (F : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (hF : ∀ s, F.symm s = divisionMap g c s) (h0 : R)
    (hfg : f = g + pi • h0) (z : Fin n → O) :
    coordinateIdeal pi g c (idealTransition pi b c F h0 z) = coordinateIdeal pi f b z
proof:
:= by
  have key := normalizer_generator_equation O R n pi c F g hF
    (h0 + coordinateLift b z)
  have hu := normalizing_factor_is_unit O R pi hpm
    (generatorNormalForm pi c F (h0 + coordinateLift b z)).2
  have hinv := principal_ideal_unit_invariance R
    (g + pi • coordinateLift c (generatorNormalForm pi c F (h0 + coordinateLift b z)).1) hu.unit
  simp only [coordinateIdeal, normalizedIdeal, normalizedGenerator, idealTransition,
    coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul, ← Algebra.smul_def]
  rw [← hinv, IsUnit.unit_spec, key, hfg, smul_add, add_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_transition_inverse
proof:
:= by
  have hgf : g = f + pi • (-h0) := by rw [hfg, smul_neg]; abel
  have hfg' := coordinate_transition_ideal_identity O R n pi b hpm f g c F hF h0 hfg
  have hgf' := coordinate_transition_ideal_identity O R n pi c hpm g f b E hE (-h0) hgf
  exact ⟨fun z ↦ coordinate_ideal_injective O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hf (by rw [hgf', hfg']),
    fun z ↦ coordinate_ideal_injective O R n pi c F hp0 hpm g hF hg (by rw [hfg', hgf'])⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_transition_congruence_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, coordinate_transition_congruence O R n pi b c F h0 j z w⟩
  have hinv := (coordinate_transition_inverse O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hf g c F hF hg h0 hfg).1
  simpa only [hinv z, hinv w] using coordinate_transition_congruence O R n pi c b E (-h0) j _ _ h

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_transition_measure_preserving
statement:
private theorem coordinate_transition_measure_preserving [MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)]
    (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)› = adicCylinderSpace (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O))
    (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin n → O)) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hball : ∀ j (x y : Fin n → O), mu {z | adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j z x} =
      mu {z | adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j z y}) :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (idealTransition pi b c F h0) mu mu
proof:
:=
  congruence_bijection_measure_preserving O (Fin n → O) (Ideal.span {pi}) hgen _
    (coordinate_transition_inverse O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hf g c F hF hg h0 hfg).2.surjective
    (coordinate_transition_congruence_iff O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hf g c F hF hg h0 hfg) mu hball

name: SurfaceBlowup.ideal_chart_transition_haar
statement:
theorem ideal_chart_transition_haar (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O))
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (idealTransition pi b c F h0) (coefficientMeasure O n)
      (coefficientMeasure O n)
proof:
:= by
  have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop n
  have hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O = Ideal.span {pi} :=
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer pi).mp hpi
  exact coordinate_transition_measure_preserving O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hf g c F hF hg h0 hfg
    (finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O (Ideal.span {pi}) (hm ▸ htop) n) _ fun j x y ↦ by
      rw [coefficient_uniformizer_cylinder_mass O htop n pi hpi j x,
        coefficient_uniformizer_cylinder_mass O htop n pi hpi j y]

name: SurfaceBlowup.ideal_chart_pushforward_independent
statement:
theorem ideal_chart_pushforward_independent (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O))
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) [MeasurableSpace (Ideal R)] (hc : Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi g c)) :
    (coefficientMeasure O n).map (coordinateIdeal pi f b) =
      (coefficientMeasure O n).map (coordinateIdeal pi g c)
proof:
:= by
  have hT := ideal_chart_transition_haar O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hf g c F hF hg h0 hfg htop hpi
  have hfun : coordinateIdeal pi f b = coordinateIdeal pi g c ∘ idealTransition pi b c F h0 :=
    funext fun z ↦ (coordinate_transition_ideal_identity O R n pi b hpm f g c F hF h0 hfg z).symm
  rw [hfun, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_map hc hT.measurable, hT.map_eq]

name: SurfaceBlowup.division_chart_preimage_image_measurable
statement:
theorem division_chart_preimage_image_measurable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (R : Type) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsLocalRing R] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hp0 : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0)
    (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (n n' : ℕ)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (f g : R) (b : Fin n → R) (c : Fin n' → R)
    (hb : IsDivisionChart O R pi f b) (hc : IsDivisionChart O R pi g c) (S : Set (Fin n' → O))
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    MeasurableSet (coordinateIdeal pi f b ⁻¹' (coordinateIdeal pi g c '' S))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := hb.1
  by_cases hres : Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f} =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) g}
  · obtain rfl := division_chart_rank_eq_of_residue_ideal_eq O R pi hpi n n' f g b c hb hc hres
    obtain ⟨g', c', F, h₀, hF, hfg, hg', hΨ⟩ :=
      division_chart_same_cell_recenter O R pi hpm n f g b c hb hc hres
    have himg : coordinateIdeal pi g c '' S = coordinateIdeal pi g' c' '' S :=
      Set.image_congr fun z _ ↦ hΨ z
    have hT := (ideal_chart_transition_haar O R n pi b E hp0 hpm f hE hb.2 g' c' F hF hg' h₀
      hfg htop hpi).measurable
    have hfun : coordinateIdeal pi f b = coordinateIdeal pi g' c' ∘ idealTransition pi b c' F h₀ :=
      funext fun z ↦
        (coordinate_transition_ideal_identity O R n pi b hpm f g' c' F hF h₀ hfg z).symm
    rw [himg, hfun, Set.preimage_comp,
      (coordinate_ideal_injective O R n pi c' F hp0 hpm g' hF hg').preimage_image]
    exact hT hS
  · convert MeasurableSet.empty
    rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro z ⟨s, _, hs⟩
    have h2 := coordinate_ideal_in_residue_cell O R n' pi c g s
    rw [hs] at h2
    exact hres ((coordinate_ideal_in_residue_cell O R n pi b f z).2.symm.trans h2.2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.state_measure_atlas_independent
statement:
theorem state_measure_atlas_independent (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [MeasurableSpace (Ideal R)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (X : Set (Ideal R))
    (A B : IdealAtlas O R pi n X)
    (hB : ∀ j, Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi (B.chart j).f (B.chart j).b)) (e : A.ι ≃ B.ι)
    (hcell : ∀ i, residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (A.chart i).f =
      residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) (B.chart (e i)).f)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hp0 : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0) (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    stateMeasure O R pi n (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A =
      stateMeasure O R pi n (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) B
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, chartMeasure O R pi n (A.chart i) = chartMeasure O R pi n (B.chart (e i)) := by
    intro i
    set f := (A.chart i).f
    set g := (B.chart (e i)).f
    have hmem : Ideal.span {f} ∈ residueIdealCell (algebraMap O R pi) f :=
      ⟨⟨f, rfl⟩, by rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]⟩
    rw [hcell i] at hmem
    have hres := hmem.2
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hres
    obtain ⟨g', c', F, h₀, hF, hfg, hg', hΨ⟩ :=
      division_data_same_cell_recenter O R pi hpm n f g (B.chart (e i)).b (A.chart i).regular
        (B.chart (e i)).E (B.chart (e i)).division hres
    have hfun : coordinateIdeal pi g (B.chart (e i)).b = coordinateIdeal pi g' c' := funext hΨ
    have hc : Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi g' c') := hfun ▸ hB (e i)
    unfold chartMeasure
    rw [show (B.chart (e i)).f = g from rfl, hfun]
    exact ideal_chart_pushforward_independent O R n pi (A.chart i).b (A.chart i).E hp0 hpm f
      (A.chart i).division (A.chart i).regular g' c' F hF hg' h₀ hfg htop hpi hc
  unfold stateMeasure
  congr 1
  rw [← e.sum_comp]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ key i

name: SurfaceBlowup.measurableSet_coordinateScale_image
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_coordinateScale_image {O : Type} [CommRing O] {n : ℕ} (pi : O)
    [MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)]
    (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)› = adicCylinderSpace (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O))
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun w : Fin n → O => pi • w)) (k : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n → O))
    (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    MeasurableSet (coordinateScale pi k '' S)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : (coordinateScale pi 0 : (Fin n → O) → (Fin n → O)) = id := by
      funext w; simp [coordinateScale]
    rwa [h0, Set.image_id]
  | succ k ih =>
    have : coordinateScale pi (k+1) '' S =
        (fun w : Fin n → O => pi • w) '' (coordinateScale pi k '' S) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]; congr 1; funext w; simp [coordinateScale, pow_succ', mul_smul]
    rw [this]; exact measurableSet_smul_image pi hgen hinj _ ih

name: SurfaceBlowup.concreteMember_q_pow_mul_inv_pow

private theorem concreteMember_q_pow_mul_inv_pow (m : ConcreteMember) (n : ℕ) :

proof:

    (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _), one_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.preimage_inter_eq_biUnion_translate
statement:
private theorem preimage_inter_eq_biUnion_translate {V I : Type} [Add V] (φ : V → I)
    (ψ : V → V → I) (C Z : Set I) (D : Set V) (F : Finset V) (Cos : V → Set V)
    (htr : ∀ z₀ w, φ (z₀ + w) = ψ z₀ w) (hcos : ∀ z₀, Cos z₀ = (fun w => z₀ + w) '' D)
    (hdec : φ ⁻¹' C = ⋃ z₀ ∈ F, Cos z₀) :
    φ ⁻¹' (C ∩ Z) = ⋃ z₀ ∈ F, (fun w => z₀ + w) '' (ψ z₀ ⁻¹' Z ∩ D)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzC, hzZ⟩
    have hz : z ∈ φ ⁻¹' C := hzC
    rw [hdec] at hz
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hzc⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hz
    rw [hcos] at hzc
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hzc
    exact ⟨z₀, hz₀, w, ⟨by rw [Set.mem_preimage, ← htr]; exact hzZ, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨z₀, hz₀, w, ⟨hwZ, hw⟩, rfl⟩
    have hzC : z₀ + w ∈ φ ⁻¹' C := by
      rw [hdec]; exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨z₀, hz₀, by rw [hcos]; exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨hzC, ?_⟩
    beta_reduce
    rw [htr]
    exact hwZ

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_measure_inter_image_of_partition
statement:
private theorem sum_measure_inter_image_of_partition {α β ι : Type} [MeasurableSpace β]
    (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure β) {Φ : α → β} {C : Set α} {S : Set β} (hbij : Set.BijOn Φ C S)
    (T : Finset ι) (P : ι → Set α) (hsub : ∀ p ∈ T, P p ⊆ C) (hcov : C ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ T, P p)
    (hdisj : (T : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint P) (Y : Set β)
    (hmeas : ∀ p ∈ T, MeasurableSet (Y ∩ Φ '' P p)) :
    ∑ p ∈ T, ν (Y ∩ Φ '' P p) = ν (Y ∩ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset _ hmeas]
  · congr 1
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff, exists_prop]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hyY, J, hJ, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hyY, hbij.mapsTo (hsub p hp hJ)⟩
    · rintro ⟨hyY, hyS⟩
      obtain ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ := hbij.surjOn hyS
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hJP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcov hJ)
      exact ⟨p, hp, hyY, J, hJP, rfl⟩
  · intro p hp p' hp' hne
    refine Disjoint.mono Set.inter_subset_right Set.inter_subset_right ?_
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro y ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ ⟨J', hJ', hJJ⟩
    obtain rfl := hbij.injOn (hsub _ hp' hJ') (hsub _ hp hJ) hJJ
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj hp hp' hne) hJ hJ'

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_childCoordinateMap_measurable
statement:
private theorem member_childCoordinateMap_measurable {R : Type} [CommRing R] [Algebra 𝒪 R] (a : ℕ)
    (b : Fin 𝔫 → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[𝒪] (𝒱 × R)) [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {ϖ}) (𝒱 × R)]
    (H : 𝒱 →ₗ[𝒪] R) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < a) (Q : 𝒱 →ₗ[𝒪] 𝒱)
    (hQ : ∀ w, normalizationLinearPart E H (Q w) = (ϖ ^ k) • w) :
    MeasurableSet (Set.range (childCoordinateMap ϖ a b E H)) ∧
      ∀ T, MeasurableSet T → MeasurableSet (childCoordinateMap ϖ a b E H ⁻¹' T)
proof:
:= by
  have hpiIrr : Irreducible ϖ := m.toMeasured.S.pi_irreducible
  have hOc : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {ϖ}) 𝒪 := dvr_isAdicComplete_span_uniformizer _ _ hpiIrr
  have hOn : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {ϖ}) 𝒱 := finite_free_adic_complete _ _ _
  obtain ⟨hgen, -, -, -, hcontall⟩ :=
    coefficient_space_strict_instances 𝒪 m.toMeasured.htop ϖ hpiIrr 𝔫
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun w : 𝒱 => ϖ • w) := smul_right_injective _ hpiIrr.ne_zero
  obtain ⟨-, hrange, hpre⟩ := child_coordinate_map_scaled _ _ _ _ a b E H (by omega) hinj
  refine ⟨?_, fun T hT ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← Set.preimage_image_eq (Set.range _) hinj, ← hrange,
      strict_normalizer_lattice_image _ _ _ _ a b E _ _ hk Q hQ]
    exact (continuous_const_smul _).measurable
      (isCompact_range (hcontall a _)).isClosed.measurableSet
  · rw [← hpre]
    exact scaled_strict_map_measurable _ _ _ _ a b E _ _ hk Q hQ hgen (hcontall a _)
      (measurableSet_smul_image _ hgen hinj T hT)

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_children_isAdicComplete
statement: private theorem member_children_isAdicComplete : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {ϖ}) 𝒞

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_chart_map_measurable
statement:
private theorem child_chart_map_measurable (g : 𝒞)
    (hgj : ∀ j, Ideal.span {g j} ∈ (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet)
    (bc' : ∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.R)
    (E' : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R ≃ₗ[(mc j).toMeasured.O]
      ((Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O) × (mc j).toMeasured.R))
    (hE' : ∀ j w, (E' j).symm w = divisionMap (g j) (bc' j) w)
    (ρ : 𝒱 ≃ₗ[𝒪] (∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O))
    (hρ : Measurable ρ) :
    Measurable fun (w : 𝒱) (j : 𝒥) =>
      coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (ρ w j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro j
  have := concrete_member_division_module_isAdicComplete (mc j)
  obtain ⟨hp0, hpm⟩ :=
    surface_vertical_parameter (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.R (mc j).toMeasured.S
  exact (coordinate_ideal_measurable_chart_sigma _ (mc j).toMeasured.htop _ _
    (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi_irreducible hp0 hpm _ (g j) (bc' j)
    ⟨⟨E' j, hE' j⟩, (concrete_member_state_generator_regular (mc j) (g j) (hgj j)).2.2⟩).comp
    ((measurable_pi_apply j).comp hρ)

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_center_translate_measure_data
statement:
private theorem member_center_translate_measure_data
    (s : ℕ) (hs : tri 𝔡 ≤ s) (cc : 𝒞) (hcc : (algebraMap 𝒪 𝒞 ϖ) ^ s = e ^ 𝔡 * cc)
    (f : ℛ) (b : Fin 𝔫 → ℛ) (E₀ : ℛ ≃ₗ[𝒪] (𝒱 × ℛ)) (hE₀ : ∀ w, E₀.symm w = divisionMap f b w)
    (hf : Ideal.span {f} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c)
    (g : 𝒞) (hg : ∀ j, alpha j f = e j ^ 𝔡 * g j)
    (hgj : ∀ j, Ideal.span {g j} ∈ (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet)
    (bc' : ∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.R)
    (E' : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R ≃ₗ[(mc j).toMeasured.O]
      ((Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O) × (mc j).toMeasured.R))
    (hE' : ∀ j w, (E' j).symm w = divisionMap (g j) (bc' j) w)
    (ρ : 𝒱 ≃ₗ[𝒪] (∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O))
    (hρ : Measurable ρ) (bc : Fin 𝔫 → 𝒞)
    (hcompat : ∀ (w : 𝒱) (j : 𝒥), coordinateLift bc w j = coordinateLift (bc' j) (ρ w j))
    (a : ℕ) (ha : a = s * 𝔫 - tri 𝔡 + 1) :
    letI : Module 𝒪 𝒞
proof:
:= Algebra.toModule
    ∀ (E : 𝒞 ≃ₗ[𝒪] (𝒱 × 𝒞)), (∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w) →
      ∀ (G : ∀ j, Set (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (G j)) →
      MeasurableSet (Set.range (childCoordinateMap ϖ a bc E
        (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b))) ∧
      MeasurableSet (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b ⁻¹' (cellStrict ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G) ∩
        centerBox (s + a - 1)) ∧
      cellStrict '' (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b '' centerBox (s + a - 1)) =
        (fun (w : 𝒱) (j : 𝒥) => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (ρ w j)) ''
          Set.range (childCoordinateMap ϖ a bc E (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b)) ∧
      coefficientMeasure 𝒪 𝔫
        (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b ⁻¹' (cellStrict ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G) ∩ centerBox (s + a - 1)) =
        𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * coefficientMeasure 𝒪 𝔫
          ((fun (w : 𝒱) (j : 𝒥) => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (ρ w j))
            ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G ∩
            Set.range (childCoordinateMap ϖ a bc E (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b))) := by
  
  
  intro E hE G hG
  set Φ := fun (J : Ideal ℛ) (j : 𝒥) => strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) 𝔡 J
  set Ψ := fun (w : 𝒱) (j : 𝒥) => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (ρ w j)
  set ch := childCoordinateMap ϖ a bc E (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b)
  set sc := coordinateScale (n := 𝔫) ϖ (s + a - 1)
  have hpiIrr : Irreducible ϖ := m.toMeasured.S.pi_irreducible
  have hf' : AlgHom.pi alpha f = e ^ 𝔡 * g := by
    funext j; simp [AlgHom.pi_apply, hg j]
  obtain ⟨hjac, heC⟩ := member_children_jacobson_regular m c mc hpiO e he
  
  have hOc : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {ϖ}) 𝒪 := dvr_isAdicComplete_span_uniformizer _ _ hpiIrr
  have hOn : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {ϖ}) 𝒱 := finite_free_adic_complete _ _ _
  have hC := member_children_isAdicComplete m c mc hpiO
  have hprod : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {ϖ}) (𝒱 × 𝒞) := isAdicComplete_prod _ _ _ _
  
  obtain ⟨hproj, -, hinjP⟩ := product_chart_projection 𝒪 𝒥 (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.O)
    (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.R) (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) _ ρ bc' bc hcompat g _ _
    hpiO
  have hΨ : Function.Injective (coordinateIdeal ϖ g bc) := hinjP fun j =>
    (concrete_member_division_chart_measure (mc j) (g j) (hgj j) (bc' j) (E' j) (hE' j)).1
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hD, hkl⟩ := member_center_linear_part m c mc hcard alpha e he hbij hindex hsum
    s hs cc hcc f b E₀ hE₀ hf g hg bc E hE
  have htri : tri 𝔡 ≤ s * 𝔫 :=
    le_trans hs (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right s (concrete_member_one_le_degree m))
  obtain ⟨hgen, hHaar, hProb, hfinite, hcontall⟩ :=
    coefficient_space_strict_instances 𝒪 m.toMeasured.htop ϖ hpiIrr 𝔫
  have hk : s * 𝔫 - tri 𝔡 < a := by omega
  have hΨm : Measurable Ψ := child_chart_map_measurable m c mc g hgj bc' E' hE' ρ hρ
  set T := Ψ ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G
  have hT : MeasurableSet T := hΨm (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hG)
  
  have hcomm : ∀ z, strictTransformIdeal (AlgHom.pi alpha) e 𝔡 (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b (sc z)) =
      coordinateIdeal ϖ g bc (ch z) :=
    strict_chart_coordinates_commute _ _ _ _ _ s a _ _ f g e cc b hf' hcc heC (by omega) hjac bc E
      hE
  have hcommC : ∀ z, Φ (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b (sc z)) = Ψ (ch z) := fun z => by
    funext j; simp only [Φ, Ψ]
    rw [← (pi_strict_transform_map_eval _ _ _ _ alpha e g _ _).2.2.2 j, hcomm z, hproj]
  have hL : coordinateIdeal ϖ f b ⁻¹' (Φ ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G) ∩ Set.range sc =
      sc '' (ch ⁻¹' T) := by
    ext x; constructor
    · rintro ⟨hx, z, rfl⟩; exact ⟨z, (hcommC z ▸ hx : Ψ (ch z) ∈ Set.pi Set.univ G), rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; exact ⟨(hcommC z ▸ hz : Φ _ ∈ Set.pi Set.univ G), z, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hrangeM, hpreM⟩ := member_childCoordinateMap_measurable m a bc E
    (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b) _ hk Q hQ
  have himgS : strictTransformIdeal (AlgHom.pi alpha) e 𝔡 '' (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b '' Set.range sc)
      = coordinateIdeal ϖ g bc '' Set.range ch := by
    rw [Set.image_image, ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp]
    exact congrArg Set.range (funext hcomm)
  refine ⟨hrangeM, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hL]
    exact measurableSet_coordinateScale_image _ hgen (smul_right_injective _ hpiIrr.ne_zero) _ _
      (hpreM T hT)
  · rw [Set.image_image, ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp]
    exact congrArg Set.range (funext hcommC)
  · rw [hL, ← strict_chart_preimage_set_identity _ _ _ _ _ s a _ _ f g e cc b hf' hcc heC
      (by omega) hjac bc E hE hΨ T, strict_transform_translate_measure _ _ _ _ _ s a _ _ f g e cc b
      hf' hcc heC (by omega) hjac bc E hE hΨ _ hk Q hQ hD hpiIrr hkl hgen _ hfinite (hcontall a _)
      (fun k S _ => coordinate_scale_measure _ m.toMeasured.htop _ hpiIrr _ k S) htri rfl T hT,
      himgS, ← Set.image_inter hΨ, Set.preimage_image_eq _ hΨ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_center_box_measure
statement:
private theorem member_center_box_measure
    (s : ℕ) (hs : tri 𝔡 ≤ s) (cc : 𝒞) (hcc : (algebraMap 𝒪 𝒞 ϖ) ^ s = e ^ 𝔡 * cc)
    (f : ℛ) (b : Fin 𝔫 → ℛ) (E₀ : ℛ ≃ₗ[𝒪] (𝒱 × ℛ)) (hE₀ : ∀ w, E₀.symm w = divisionMap f b w)
    (hf : Ideal.span {f} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c) (a : ℕ) (ha : a = s * 𝔫 - tri 𝔡 + 1)
    (G : ∀ j, Set (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R)) (hG : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (G j)) :
    MeasurableSet (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b ⁻¹' (cellStrict ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G) ∩
      centerBox (s + a - 1)) ∧
    MeasurableSet (cellStrict '' (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b '' centerBox (s + a - 1))) ∧
    coefficientMeasure 𝒪 𝔫
      (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b ⁻¹' (cellStrict ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G) ∩ centerBox (s + a - 1)) =
      𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * 𝐪 ^ 𝔫 * Measure.pi (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ)
        (Set.pi Set.univ G ∩ cellStrict '' (coordinateIdeal ϖ f b '' centerBox (s + a - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hstrict f hf
  have hgj : ∀ j, Ideal.span {g j} ∈ (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet := fun j => by
    simpa [strict_transform_ideal_of_generator _ _ _ (alpha j) (e j) (g j) _ f (hg j)
      (concrete_member_mul_t_injective (he j))] using hbij.mapsTo hf j (Set.mem_univ _)
  choose bc' E' hE' using fun j => concrete_member_state_generator_division (mc j) (g j) (hgj j)
  obtain ⟨ρ, bc, hρ, hρ', hcompat⟩ := product_coordinates_exist 𝒪 𝒥 (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.O)
    (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.R) (m.toMeasured.childDelta c) (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree)
    pc hpc hpc' 𝔫 hdeg bc'
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := product_division_equiv 𝒪 𝒥 (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.O)
    (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.R) (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) 𝔫 ρ bc' bc hcompat g E' hE'
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := member_center_translate_measure_data m c mc hcard hpiO alpha e he
    hbij hindex hsum s hs cc hcc f b E₀ hE₀ hf g hg hgj bc' E' hE' ρ hρ bc hcompat a ha E hE G hG
  obtain ⟨hemb, hpush⟩ := member_product_chart_pushforward 𝒥 mc g hgj bc' E' hE'
  set T := Set.range (childCoordinateMap ϖ a bc E (pulledVariation (AlgHom.pi alpha) cc b))
  set Ψ := fun (w : ∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O) (j : 𝒥) =>
    coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (w j)
  have hρT : MeasurableSet (ρ '' T) := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.image_eq_preimage_symm]; exact hρ' h1
  have himg : (fun (w : 𝒱) (j : 𝒥) => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j)
      (ρ w j)) '' T = Ψ '' (ρ '' T) := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
  refine ⟨h2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h3, himg]; exact hemb.measurableSet_image' hρT
  · rw [h4, h3, himg]
    set Y := ρ '' T ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G
    have hYm : MeasurableSet Y := hρT.inter (hemb.measurable (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hG))
    have hpre : (fun (w : 𝒱) (j : 𝒥) => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j)
        (ρ w j)) ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G ∩ T = ρ ⁻¹' Y := by
      rw [Set.preimage_inter, Set.preimage_image_eq _ ρ.injective, Set.inter_comm]; rfl
    have hC : (∏ j, ((mc j).toMeasured.q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) = 𝐪⁻¹ ^ 𝔫 := by
      simp_rw [hcard, Nat.cast_pow, ENNReal.inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
      rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, hdeg]
    rw [hpre, ← Measure.map_apply hρ hYm,
      member_coefficient_measure_map_product_coordinates m c mc ρ hρ,
      ← Set.inter_comm, ← Set.image_inter_preimage, hpush Y hYm, hC, mul_assoc,
      ← mul_assoc (𝐪 ^ _), concreteMember_q_pow_mul_inv_pow, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_cell_chart_box
statement:
private theorem member_cell_chart_box (s : ℕ) (hs : tri 𝔡 ≤ s) (cc : 𝒞)
    (hcc : (algebraMap 𝒪 𝒞 ϖ) ^ s = e ^ 𝔡 * cc) (a : ℕ) (ha : a = s * 𝔫 - tri 𝔡 + 1)
    (reps : Finset 𝒱) (hrdisj : (reps : Set 𝒱).PairwiseDisjoint (coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1)))
    (i : m.atlas.ι)
    (hdec : memberChart m i ⁻¹' m.toMeasured.cell c =
      ⋃ z₀ ∈ reps.filter (fun z₀ => memberChart m i z₀ ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c),
        coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1) z₀)
    (G : ∀ j, Set (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R)) (hG : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (G j)) :
    MeasurableSet (memberChart m i ⁻¹' (m.toMeasured.cell c ∩ cellStrict ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G)) ∧
    coefficientMeasure 𝒪 𝔫
        (memberChart m i ⁻¹' (m.toMeasured.cell c ∩ cellStrict ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G)) =
      𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * 𝐪 ^ 𝔫 *
        ∑ z₀ ∈ reps.filter (fun z₀ => memberChart m i z₀ ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c),
        Measure.pi (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ) (Set.pi Set.univ G ∩
          cellStrict '' (memberChart m i '' coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1) z₀)) ∧
    ∀ z₀ ∈ reps.filter (fun z₀ => memberChart m i z₀ ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c),
      MeasurableSet (cellStrict '' (memberChart m i '' coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1) z₀))
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := fun (J : Ideal ℛ) (j : 𝒥) => strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) 𝔡 J
  have := concrete_member_division_module_isAdicComplete m
  
  
  let fi : ℛ := (m.atlas.chart i).f
  let bi : Fin 𝔫 → ℛ := (m.atlas.chart i).b
  set Φi := memberChart m i
  set F := reps.filter (fun z₀ => Φi z₀ ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c)
  let Φp (z₀ : 𝒱) : 𝒱 → Ideal ℛ := coordinateIdeal ϖ (fi + ϖ • coordinateLift bi z₀) bi
  have Tr := fun z₀ => member_chart_translate m fi bi (s + a - 1) z₀
  set Y := Set.pi Set.univ G
  set Rg := Set.range (coordinateScale (n := 𝔫) ϖ (s + a - 1))
  let A (z₀ : 𝒱) : Set 𝒱 := (fun z => z₀ + z) '' (Φp z₀ ⁻¹' (Φ ⁻¹' Y) ∩ Rg)
  
  have hC : ∀ z₀ ∈ F, MeasurableSet (Φp z₀ ⁻¹' (Φ ⁻¹' Y) ∩ Rg) ∧
      MeasurableSet (Φ '' (Φp z₀ '' Rg)) ∧
      coefficientMeasure 𝒪 𝔫 (Φp z₀ ⁻¹' (Φ ⁻¹' Y) ∩ Rg) =
        𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * 𝐪 ^ 𝔫 *
          Measure.pi (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ) (Y ∩ Φ '' (Φp z₀ '' Rg)) := by
    intro z₀ hz₀
    have hf : Ideal.span {fi + ϖ • coordinateLift bi z₀} ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c := by
      have h0 := (Tr z₀).1 0
      rw [add_zero] at h0
      have : coordinateIdeal ϖ fi bi z₀ = Ideal.span {fi + ϖ • coordinateLift bi z₀} := by
        rw [h0]
        simp [coordinateIdeal, normalizedIdeal, normalizedGenerator, coordinateLift]
      rw [← this]; exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz₀).2
    obtain ⟨E₀, hE₀⟩ := @division_data_vertical_perturbation 𝒪 ℛ _ _ _ 𝔫 ϖ fi bi
      (m.atlas.chart i).E (m.atlas.chart i).division this (coordinateLift bi z₀)
    exact member_center_box_measure m c mc pc hpc hpc' hcard hpiO hdeg alpha e he hbij
      hstrict hindex hsum s hs cc hcc _ bi E₀ hE₀ hf a ha G hG
  have hPeq (z₀) : Φp z₀ '' Rg = Φi '' coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1) z₀ := by
    rw [(Tr z₀).2.1, Set.image_image]
    exact congrArg (· '' Rg) (funext fun w => ((Tr z₀).1 w).symm)
  have hXi : Φi ⁻¹' (m.toMeasured.cell c ∩ Φ ⁻¹' Y) = ⋃ z₀ ∈ F, A z₀ :=
    preimage_inter_eq_biUnion_translate Φi Φp _ _ Rg F _ (fun z₀ => (Tr z₀).1)
      (fun z₀ => (Tr z₀).2.1) hdec
  have hAdisj : (F : Set _).PairwiseDisjoint A := by
    intro z₀ hz z₀' hz' hne
    have hsub : ∀ z₁, A z₁ ⊆ coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1) z₁ := fun z₁ => by
      rw [(Tr z₁).2.1]; exact Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_right
    exact (hrdisj (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz').1 hne).mono (hsub z₀)
      (hsub z₀')
  have hAmeas : ∀ z₀ ∈ F, MeasurableSet (A z₀) := fun z₀ hz => ((Tr z₀).2.2 _).2 (hC z₀ hz).1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun z₀ hz => hPeq z₀ ▸ (hC z₀ hz).2.1⟩
  · rw [hXi]; exact Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ hAmeas
  · rw [hXi, measure_biUnion_finset hAdisj hAmeas, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z₀ hz => ?_
    rw [← hPeq]
    exact ((Tr z₀).2.2 _).1.trans (hC z₀ hz).2.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_cell_box_measurable
statement:
theorem member_cell_box_measurable :
    (letI : ∀ j, MeasurableSpace (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R) :=
      fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal;
      letI : MeasurableSpace (Ideal ℛ) := m.toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal;
      ∀ (G : ∀ j, Set (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (G j)) →
      MeasurableSet (m.toMeasured.cell c ∩ (fun (J : Ideal ℛ) (j : 𝒥) =>
        strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) 𝔡 J) ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G))
proof:
:= by
  intro G hG
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, cc, hs, hcc⟩ := common_vertical_exponent 𝒪 𝒥 (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.R) ϖ e 𝔡
    hvert (tri 𝔡)
  set a := s * 𝔫 - tri 𝔡 + 1 with ha
  have htri := tri_chooseTwo 𝔡
  obtain ⟨reps, -, -, hrdisj, hdec⟩ :=
    member_cell_chart_coset_decomposition m c (s + a - 1) (by omega)
  set X := m.toMeasured.cell c ∩ cellStrict ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G
  
  have hX : X = ⋃ i, memberChart m i '' (memberChart m i ⁻¹' X) := by
    ext J
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := member_cell_mem_chart_range m c J h.1; exact ⟨i, h, hi⟩
    · rintro ⟨-, h, -⟩; exact h
  rw [hX]
  exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun i => chart_image_measurable_chart_sigma _ _ _ _ _ _
    (m.atlas.chart i).isDivisionChart _
    (member_cell_chart_box m c mc pc hpc hpc' hcard hpiO hdeg alpha e he hbij hstrict hindex hsum
      s hs cc hcc a ha reps hrdisj i (hdec i) G hG).1

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_cell_box_measure
statement:
theorem member_cell_box_measure :
    (letI : ∀ j, MeasurableSpace (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R) :=
      fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal;
      letI : MeasurableSpace (Ideal ℛ) := m.toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal;
      ∀ (G : ∀ j, Set (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R)), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (G j)) →
      m.toMeasured.μ (m.toMeasured.cell c ∩ (fun (J : Ideal ℛ) (j : 𝒥) =>
        strictTransformIdeal (alpha j) (e j) 𝔡 J) ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ G) =
      𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * ∏ j, (mc j).toMeasured.μ (G j))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  intro G hG
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, cc, hs, hcc⟩ := common_vertical_exponent 𝒪 𝒥 (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.R) ϖ e _
    hvert (tri 𝔡)
  set a := s * 𝔫 - tri 𝔡 + 1 with ha
  have htri := tri_chooseTwo 𝔡
  obtain ⟨reps, -, -, hrdisj, hdec⟩ :=
    member_cell_chart_coset_decomposition m c (s + a - 1) (by omega)
  have hbox := fun i => member_cell_chart_box m c mc pc hpc hpc' hcard hpiO hdeg alpha e he hbij
    hstrict hindex hsum s hs cc hcc a ha reps hrdisj i (hdec i) G hG
  
  let F (i : m.atlas.ι) := reps.filter (fun z₀ => memberChart m i z₀ ∈ m.toMeasured.cell c)
  let P (p : Σ _ : m.atlas.ι, 𝒱) := memberChart m p.1 '' coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1) p.2
  have hdec' (i) : memberChart m i ⁻¹' m.toMeasured.cell c =
      ⋃ z₀ ∈ F i, coordinateCoset ϖ (s + a - 1) z₀ := hdec i
  have hPcell : ∀ p ∈ Finset.univ.sigma F, P p ⊆ m.toMeasured.cell c := by
    rintro ⟨i, z₀⟩ hp J ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have : z ∈ memberChart m i ⁻¹' m.toMeasured.cell c := by
      rw [hdec']; exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hp).2 hz
    exact this
  have hPunion : m.toMeasured.cell c ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ Finset.univ.sigma F, P p := by
    intro J hJc
    obtain ⟨i, z, rfl⟩ := member_cell_mem_chart_range m c J hJc
    have hz : z ∈ memberChart m i ⁻¹' m.toMeasured.cell c := hJc
    rw [hdec'] at hz
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hzc⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hz
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨⟨i, z₀⟩, Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hz₀⟩, z, hzc, rfl⟩
  have hPdisj : ((Finset.univ.sigma F : Finset _) : Set _).PairwiseDisjoint P := by
    rintro ⟨i, z₀⟩ hp ⟨i', z₀'⟩ hp' hne
    have hz := (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hp).2
    have hz' := (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hp').2
    by_cases hii : i = i'
    · subst hii
      have hne' : z₀ ≠ z₀' := fun h => hne (h ▸ rfl)
      exact (Set.disjoint_image_iff (concrete_member_charts m i).1).mpr
        (hrdisj (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz').1 hne')
    · have h := m.atlas.disjoint hii
      simp only at h
      rw [← (concrete_member_charts m i).2.1, ← (concrete_member_charts m i').2.1] at h
      exact h.mono (Set.image_subset_range _ _) (Set.image_subset_range _ _)
  have : ∀ j, IsFiniteMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.μ := fun j =>
    (concrete_member_measure_finite_support (mc j)).1
  have hparts := sum_measure_inter_image_of_partition (Measure.pi fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ)
    hbij _ P hPcell hPunion hPdisj (Set.pi Set.univ G) fun p hp => (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hG).inter
      ((hbox p.1).2.2 p.2 (Finset.mem_sigma.mp hp).2)
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma, ← Set.pi_inter_distrib, Measure.pi_pi] at hparts
  
  rw [MeasuredSurface.μ, stateMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.finsetSum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hmeas := member_cell_box_measurable m c mc pc hpc hpc' hcard hpiO hdeg alpha e he hvert hbij
    hstrict hindex hsum G hG
  calc _ = 𝐪⁻¹ ^ 𝔫 * ∑ i, 𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * 𝐪 ^ 𝔫 *
        ∑ z₀ ∈ F i, Measure.pi (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ)
          (Set.pi Set.univ G ∩ cellStrict '' P ⟨i, z₀⟩) := by
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [chartMeasure]
        exact (Measure.map_apply (concrete_member_charts m i).2.2 hmeas).trans (hbox i).2.1
    _ = (𝐪 ^ 𝔫 * 𝐪⁻¹ ^ 𝔫) * (𝐪⁻¹ ^ tri 𝔡 * ∏ j, (mc j).toMeasured.μ (G j)) := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hparts, Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ =>
          ((concrete_member_measure_finite_support (mc j)).2 (G j)).symm]
        ring
    _ = _ := by rw [concreteMember_q_pow_mul_inv_pow, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_congruence_rules
statement:
theorem adic_congruence_rules (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (I : Ideal R)
    :
    (∀ j (x : M), adicCongr I j x x) ∧ (∀ j (x y : M), adicCongr I j x y → adicCongr I j y x) ∧
        (∀ j (x y z : M), adicCongr I j x y → adicCongr I j y z → adicCongr I j x z) ∧
        (∀ i j (x y : M), i ≤ j → adicCongr I j x y → adicCongr I i x y) ∧
        (∀ x y : M, adicCongr I 0 x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold adicCongr
  exact ⟨fun _ _ => by simp, fun _ _ _ h => by simpa using neg_mem h,
    fun _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => by simpa using add_mem h1 h2,
    fun _ _ _ _ hij h => Submodule.smul_mono_left (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hij) h, fun _ _ => by
        simp⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_cylinders_intersection
statement:
theorem adic_cylinders_intersection (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R) :
    IsPiSystem (adicCylinders I M)
proof:
:= by
  have mono : ∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ j → (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule R M) ≤ I ^ i • ⊤ :=
    fun i j h => Submodule.smul_mono_left (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right h)
  have key : ∀ (i j : ℕ) (x x' z : M), i ≤ j → adicCongr I i z x → adicCongr I j z x' →
      {y | adicCongr I i y x} ∩ {y | adicCongr I j y x'} = {y | adicCongr I j y z} := by
    intro i j x x' z hij hx hx'
    unfold adicCongr at *
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨_, h2⟩ => by simpa using sub_mem h2 hx',
      fun h => ⟨by simpa using add_mem (mono i j hij h) hx, by simpa using add_mem h hx'⟩⟩
  rintro s hs t ht ⟨z, hzs, hzt⟩
  rcases hs with rfl | ⟨i, x, rfl⟩
  · simp at hzs
  rcases ht with rfl | ⟨j, x', rfl⟩
  · simp at hzt
  right
  rcases le_total i j with h | h
  · exact ⟨j, z, key i j x x' z h hzs hzt⟩
  · refine ⟨i, z, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact key j i x' x z h hzt hzs

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_perturb_congruence_iff
statement:
theorem adic_perturb_congruence_iff (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R) (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) (j : ℕ) (x y : M) :
    adicCongr I j (adicPerturb r x) (adicPerturb r y) ↔ adicCongr I j x y
proof:
:= by
  have mono : ∀ k, (I ^ (k+1) • ⊤ : Submodule R M) ≤ I ^ k • ⊤ := fun k =>
    Submodule.smul_mono_left (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ k))
  have eq : adicPerturb r x - adicPerturb r y = (x - y) + (r x - r y) := by
    simp only [adicPerturb]; abel
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction j with
    | zero => simp [adicCongr]
    | succ k ih =>
      have h' : adicCongr I k (adicPerturb r x) (adicPerturb r y) := mono k h
      have hk := hr k x y (ih h')
      unfold adicCongr at h hk ⊢
      rw [eq] at h
      simpa using sub_mem h hk
  · intro h
    have hk := mono j (hr j x y h)
    unfold adicCongr at h hk ⊢
    rw [eq]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ h hk

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_image_measurable_chart_sigma
statement:
theorem chart_image_measurable_chart_sigma (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [MeasurableSpace O] (pi : O) (n : ℕ) (f : R) (b : Fin n → R)
    (hchart : IsDivisionChart O R pi f b) (S : Set (Fin n → O)) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    @MeasurableSet (Ideal R) (idealChartSigma O R pi) (coordinateIdeal pi f b '' S)
proof:
:=
  MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨n, f, b, S, hchart, hS, rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.digit_iter_successive
statement:
private theorem digit_iter_successive (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R)
    (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) (y : M) :
    ∀ j, adicCongr I j (digitIter r y (j+1)) (digitIter r y j)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [adicCongr]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := hr n _ _ ih
    unfold adicCongr at h ⊢
    have e : digitIter r y (n + 1 + 1) - digitIter r y (n + 1)
        = -(r (digitIter r y (n + 1)) - r (digitIter r y n)) := by
      change (y - r (digitIter r y (n + 1))) - (y - r (digitIter r y n)) = _
      abel
    rw [e]
    exact neg_mem h

name: SurfaceBlowup.digit_iter_cauchy
statement:
private theorem digit_iter_cauchy (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R)
    (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) (y : M) :
    ∀ i j, i ≤ j → adicCongr I i (digitIter r y i) (digitIter r y j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hrefl, hsymm, htrans, hmono, -⟩ := adic_congruence_rules R M I
  intro i j hij
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact hrefl _ _
  | succ j hij ih =>
    exact htrans _ _ _ _ ih
      (hsymm _ _ _ (hmono _ _ _ _ hij
        (digit_iter_successive R M I r hr y j)))

name: SurfaceBlowup.digit_iter_limit
statement:
private theorem digit_iter_limit (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R)
    (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) [IsAdicComplete I M] (y : M) :
    ∃ x : M, ∀ j, adicCongr I j (digitIter r y j) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec (I := I) (M := M) (f := digitIter r y) inferInstance
    (fun {m n} hmn => SModEq.sub_mem.mpr
      (digit_iter_cauchy R M I r hr y m n hmn))
  exact ⟨L, fun j => SModEq.sub_mem.mp (hL j)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.digit_limit_solves
statement:
private theorem digit_limit_solves (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R)
    (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) [IsAdicComplete I M] (y x : M)
    (hx : ∀ j, adicCongr I j (digitIter r y j) x) :
    adicPerturb r x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHausdorff.eq_iff_smodEq (I := I)]
  intro j
  rw [SModEq.sub_mem]
  have hmono : (I ^ (j+1) • ⊤ : Submodule R M) ≤ I ^ j • ⊤ :=
    Submodule.smul_mono_left (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ j))
  have h1 := hmono (hx (j+1))
  have h2 := hmono (hr j _ _ (hx j))
  unfold adicCongr at *
  have key : adicPerturb r x - y
      = -((digitIter r y (j+1) - x) + (r (digitIter r y j) - r x)) := by
    simp only [adicPerturb, digitIter]; abel
  rw [key]
  exact neg_mem (add_mem h1 h2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_perturb_bijective
statement:
theorem adic_perturb_bijective (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (I : Ideal R)
    (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) [IsAdicComplete I M] :
    Function.Bijective (adicPerturb r)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · have h : ∀ j, adicCongr I j x y := fun j =>
      (adic_perturb_congruence_iff R M I r hr j x y).1 (by
        rw [hxy]; simp [adicCongr])
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 <| IsHausdorff.haus (IsAdicComplete.toIsHausdorff (I := I) (M := M))
      (x - y) fun n => by rw [SModEq.sub_mem, sub_zero]; exact h n
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := digit_iter_limit R M I r hr y
    exact ⟨x, digit_limit_solves R M I r hr y x hx⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_perturb_cylinder_preimage
statement:
private theorem adic_perturb_cylinder_preimage (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R) (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) [IsAdicComplete I M] (j : ℕ) (z : M) :
    ∃ x : M, adicPerturb r x = z ∧ (adicPerturb r) ⁻¹' {w | adicCongr I j w z} =
        {y | adicCongr I j y x}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (adic_perturb_bijective R M I r hr).2 z
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  rw [← hx]
  exact adic_perturb_congruence_iff R M I r hr j y x

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_perturb_measurable
statement:
theorem adic_perturb_measurable (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R) (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) [IsAdicComplete I M] [MeasurableSpace M]
    (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace M› = adicCylinderSpace I M) :
    Measurable (adicPerturb r)
proof:
:= by
  subst hgen
  let : MeasurableSpace M := adicCylinderSpace I M
  apply measurable_generateFrom
  rintro s (rfl | ⟨j, z, rfl⟩)
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ :=
      adic_perturb_cylinder_preimage R M I r hr j z
    rw [hx]
    exact MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (Or.inr ⟨j, x, rfl⟩)

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_measures_from_cylinders
statement:
theorem finite_measures_from_cylinders (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R) [MeasurableSpace M] (mu nu : MeasureTheory.Measure M)
    [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure mu] (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace M› = adicCylinderSpace I M)
    (heq : ∀ j x, mu {y | adicCongr I j y x} = nu {y | adicCongr I j y x}) :
    mu = nu
proof:
:= by
  refine MeasureTheory.ext_of_generate_finite (adicCylinders I M) hgen
    (adic_cylinders_intersection R M I) ?_ ?_
  · rintro s (rfl | ⟨j, x, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · exact heq j x
  · have h : {y : M | adicCongr I 0 y 0} = Set.univ := by ext; simp [adicCongr]
    exact h ▸ heq 0 0

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_quotient_fiber_mass
statement:
theorem finite_quotient_fiber_mass (G Q : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup Q] [Finite Q]
    [MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableAdd G] (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure G)
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant mu]
    (pi : G →+ Q) (hpi : Function.Surjective pi) (hm : ∀ a, MeasurableSet {x | pi x = a}) (a : Q) :
    mu {x | pi x = a} = (Nat.card Q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hfib : ∀ b, mu {x | pi x = b} = mu {x | pi x = a} := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hpi (a - b)
    have : {x | pi x = b} = (fun h => t + h) ⁻¹' {x | pi x = a} := by
      ext x; simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage, map_add, ht]
      constructor
      · intro h; rw [h]; abel
      · intro h
        have h2 : pi x = a - (a - b) := eq_sub_of_add_eq' h
        rw [h2]; abel
    rw [this, MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add]
  have := Fintype.ofFinite Q
  have hU : (⋃ b : Q, {x | pi x = b}) = Set.univ := by
    ext x; simp
  have hsum : mu Set.univ = ∑ b : Q, mu {x | pi x = b} := by
    rw [← hU, MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion _ hm, tsum_fintype]
    intro i j hij
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hi hj => hij (hi.symm.trans hj)
  simp only [hfib, MeasureTheory.measure_univ, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hpos : (Fintype.card Q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  rw [← one_mul (mu _), ← ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hpos (by simp), mul_assoc, ← hsum, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_perturb_measure_preserving
statement:
theorem adic_perturb_measure_preserving (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R) (r : M → M) (hr : RaisesAdicOrder I r) [IsAdicComplete I M] [MeasurableSpace M]
    [MeasurableAdd M] (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure M) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant mu] (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace M› = adicCylinderSpace I
    M) (hfinite : ∀ j, Finite (AdicQuotient I M j)) :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (adicPerturb r) mu mu
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : Measurable (adicPerturb r) :=
    adic_perturb_measurable R M I r hr hgen
  have hball : ∀ j (x : M), MeasurableSet {y | adicCongr I j y x} := by
    intro j x
    rw [hgen]
    exact MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (Or.inr ⟨j, x, rfl⟩)
  have hfib : ∀ j (x : M),
      {y | (adicReduce I j : M →ₗ[R] AdicQuotient I M j).toAddMonoidHom y
        = (adicReduce I j : M →ₗ[R] AdicQuotient I M j) x} = {y | adicCongr I j y x} := by
    intro j x
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, adicReduce, adicCongr, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe,
      Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    exact Submodule.Quotient.eq _
  have hmass : ∀ j (x : M), mu {y | adicCongr I j y x}
      = (Nat.card (AdicQuotient I M j) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    intro j x
    have := hfinite j
    rw [← hfib j x]
    refine finite_quotient_fiber_mass M (AdicQuotient I M j) mu
      (adicReduce I j : M →ₗ[R] AdicQuotient I M j).toAddMonoidHom
      (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) ?_ _
    intro a
    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective (I ^ j • ⊤ : Submodule R M) a
    have := hfib j x'
    simp only [adicReduce] at this ⊢
    rw [this]
    exact hball j x'
  refine ⟨hmeas, finite_measures_from_cylinders R M I _ _ hgen fun j z => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := adic_perturb_cylinder_preimage R M I r hr j z
  rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply hmeas (hball j z), hx, hmass, hmass]

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_quotient_event_mass
statement:
theorem finite_quotient_event_mass (G Q : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup Q] [Finite Q]
    [MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableAdd G] (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure G)
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant mu]
    (pi : G →+ Q) (hpi : Function.Surjective pi) (hm : ∀ a, MeasurableSet {x | pi x = a})
    (S : Set Q) :
    mu (pi ⁻¹' S) = (Nat.card S : ℝ≥0∞) / Nat.card Q
proof:
:= by
  have hS : S.Finite := Set.toFinite S
  have hU : pi ⁻¹' S = ⋃ a ∈ hS.toFinset, {x | pi x = a} := by
    ext x; simp
  rw [hU, MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset]
  · simp_rw [finite_quotient_fiber_mass G Q mu pi hpi hm]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset hS]
  · intro a _ b _ hab
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun x hx hy => hab (hx.symm.trans hy))
  · intro a _; exact hm a

name: SurfaceBlowup.primitive_locus_mass
statement:
theorem primitive_locus_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientMeasure O (n+1) {a | primitive O a} =
      1-(Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(n+1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop (n+1) 1 0
  have h0 := coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop (n+1) 0 0
  simp only [pow_zero, mul_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, Submodule.mem_top, implies_true,
    Set.ofPred_true, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero, mul_one, pow_one] at h1 h0
  have hS : {a : Fin (n+1) → O | primitive O a} =
      {b : Fin (n+1) → O | ∀ i, b i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O}ᶜ := by
    ext a
    simp [primitive, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  have hopen : IsOpen ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O : Ideal O) : Set O) := by
    simpa using (isAdic_iff.mp htop).1 1
  have hm : MeasurableSet {b : Fin (n+1) → O | ∀ i, b i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O} := by
    have : {b : Fin (n+1) → O | ∀ i, b i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O} =
        Set.univ.pi fun _ ↦ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O : Ideal O) : Set O) := by
      ext; simp
    rw [this]
    exact MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun _ ↦ hopen.measurableSet
  rw [hS]
  have hne : (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.pow_ne_top <| ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr <|
      Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (Nat.card_pos (α := IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)).ne'
  have hadd := measure_add_measure_compl (μ := coefficientMeasure O (n+1)) hm
  rw [h1, h0, add_comm] at hadd
  exact ENNReal.eq_sub_of_add_eq hne hadd

name: SurfaceBlowup.scaled_normalization_identity
statement:
theorem scaled_normalization_identity (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (f : R) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s) (s : (Fin n → O) × R) :
    (1 + pi • s.2) * (f + pi • coordinateLift b s.1) =
      f + pi • E.symm (adicPerturb (coordinateRemainder pi b E) s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adicPerturb, coordinateRemainder, map_add, map_smul, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hE, divisionMap]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.state_measure_total_mass
statement:
theorem state_measure_total_mass (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [MeasurableSpace (Ideal R)] (pi : O) (n : ℕ) (X : Set (Ideal R))
    (A : IdealAtlas O R pi n X)
    (hA : ∀ i, Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi (A.chart i).f (A.chart i).b)) :
    stateMeasure O R pi n (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A Set.univ =
      (Fintype.card A.ι : ℝ≥0∞) * (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^n
proof:
:= by
  unfold stateMeasure
  rw [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.finsetSum_apply]
  have h : ∀ i : A.ι, chartMeasure O R pi n (A.chart i) Set.univ = 1 := fun i =>
    chart_measure_total_mass O R htop pi n (A.chart i) (hA i)
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [mul_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.units_lift_from_local_quotient
statement:
theorem units_lift_from_local_quotient (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (hI : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (v : (R ⧸ I)ˣ) :
    ∃ u : Rˣ, Ideal.Quotient.mk I (u : R) = (v : R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (v : R ⧸ I)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ((v⁻¹ : (R ⧸ I)ˣ) : R ⧸ I)
  have hab : a * b - 1 ∈ I := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, map_mul, ha, hb, map_one]
    simp
  have hunit : IsUnit a := by
    by_contra h
    have ham : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal a).2 h
    have h1 : a * b - (a * b - 1) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right b _ ham) (hI hab)
    simp at h1
  exact ⟨hunit.unit, by simpa using ha⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_ideal_has_fixed_generator_lift
statement:
theorem residue_ideal_has_fixed_generator_lift (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (pi f : R)
    (hp : pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hf : Function.Injective
      (fun x : R ⧸ Ideal.span {pi} => x * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {pi}) f))
    (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ∈ residueIdealCell pi f) :
    ∃ h : R, J = Ideal.span {f + pi*h}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, hmap⟩ := hJ
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hmap
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := regular_principal_generators_associated _ _ _ hf hmap.symm
  have hle : Ideal.span {pi} ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 hp
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := units_lift_from_local_quotient R _ hle v
  have hmem : g - (u : R) * f ∈ Ideal.span {pi} := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, map_mul, hu, ← hv, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hmem
  refine ⟨(↑u⁻¹ : R) * k, ?_⟩
  have : f + pi * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * k) = (↑u⁻¹ : R) * g := by
    have hg : g = (u : R) * f + k * pi := by rw [hk]; ring
    rw [hg, mul_add, ← mul_assoc (↑u⁻¹ : R), Units.inv_mul, one_mul]; ring
  rw [this, eq_comm]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit (Units.isUnit _) _

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_coefficient_measure_haar
statement:
theorem unramified_coefficient_measure_haar (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hm : Φ.Monic)
    [TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hτ : ‹TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedTopology O Φ hm)
    [MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hmeas : ‹MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedMeasurableSpace O Φ hm)
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) :
    Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hm) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure (unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hm) ∧ ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ),
      unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hm {y | y - x ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L} =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (Φ.natDegree * L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hTR, hC, hT2, hSC, hB, hce, hces, hme, hmes⟩ :=
    power_coordinates_transport O Φ hm hτ hmeas
  set e := powerCoordinates O Φ hm
  have hprob := coefficient_measure_probability O htop Φ.natDegree
  have hμ : Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (coefficientMeasure O Φ.natDegree) := by
    unfold coefficientMeasure
    apply Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure.smul
    · exact ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (measure_ne_top _ _)
    · exact ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr
        (Measure.IsOpenPosMeasure.open_pos _ isOpen_univ Set.univ_nonempty)
  refine ⟨Measure.isAddHaarMeasure_map_of_isFiniteMeasure (coefficientMeasure O Φ.natDegree)
      e.symm.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom hces e.symm.surjective,
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hmes.aemeasurable, fun L x ↦ ?_⟩
  let E : AdjoinRoot Φ ≃ᵐ (Fin Φ.natDegree → O) :=
    { toEquiv := e.toEquiv, measurable_toFun := hme, measurable_invFun := hmes }
  rw [show unramifiedCoefficientMeasure O Φ hm =
    Measure.map E.symm (coefficientMeasure O Φ.natDegree) from rfl, MeasurableEquiv.map_apply]
  have hset : E.symm ⁻¹' {y | y - x ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L} =
      {b | ∀ i, b i - e x i ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L} := by
    ext v
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [base_ideal_coordinates O Φ hm L]
    have key : ∀ z i, (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hm).basis.repr z i = e z i := fun z i => rfl
    have hEv : E.symm v = e.symm v := rfl
    simp only [map_sub, Finsupp.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, key, hEv, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hset]
  exact coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop Φ.natDegree L (e x)

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_adic_complete
statement:
private theorem integral_closure_adic_complete (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] :
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := integral_closure_finite_free O K L
  exact finite_free_adic_complete O (integralClosure O L) _

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_finite_reduction
statement:
private theorem integral_closure_finite_reduction (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] :
    Finite (integralClosure O L ⧸
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).map (algebraMap O (integralClosure O L)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := integral_closure_finite_free O K L
  have : Finite (O ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) := ‹Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)›
  have hfin := finite_free_residue_quotient O (integralClosure O L)
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)
  rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map] at hfin
  exact Finite.of_equiv _ (Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv O _).toEquiv

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_is_local
statement:
theorem integral_closure_is_local (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] :
    IsLocalRing (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := integral_closure_adic_complete O K L
  have h2 := integral_closure_finite_reduction O K L
  have : IsAdicComplete ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).map
      (algebraMap O (integralClosure O L))) (integralClosure O L) :=
    (IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff _ _).mpr h1
  exact complete_domain_finite_quotient_local (integralClosure O L)
    ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).map (algebraMap O (integralClosure O L)))

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_is_dvr
statement:
theorem integral_closure_is_dvr (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra O L]
    [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:= by
  have := integral_closure_is_local O K L
  have hD := integral_closure_is_dedekind O K L
  have hN : IsNoetherianRing (integralClosure O L) := inferInstance
  exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE (R := integralClosure O L)
    (integral_closure_not_field O K L)).out 0 2).mpr hD

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_own_adic_complete
statement:
theorem integral_closure_own_adic_complete (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (hlocal : IsLocalRing (integralClosure O L)) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:= hlocal
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure O L)) (integralClosure O L) := by
  have : IsLocalRing (integralClosure O L) := hlocal
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing (integralClosure O L) :=
    integral_closure_is_dvr O K L
  have hc := integral_closure_adic_complete O K L
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap O (integralClosure O L)) := by
    intro a b h
    have h2 : algebraMap O L a = algebraMap O L b := by
      simpa using congrArg (fun x : integralClosure O L => (x : L)) h
    simp only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O K L] at h2
    exact IsFractionRing.injective O K ((algebraMap K L).injective h2)
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O (integralClosure O L) := integralClosure.AlgebraIsIntegral
  have : FaithfulSMul O (integralClosure O L) := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).2 hinj
  have h512 := dvr_extension_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow O (integralClosure O L) hinj
  have hI : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).map (algebraMap O (integralClosure O L)) ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure O L) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Ideal.mem_comap]
    by_contra hn
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap O (integralClosure O L) x) := by
      simpa [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] using hn
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal x).1 hx ((isUnit_map_iff _ x).1 hu)
  have h1 := (IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff (S := integralClosure O L)
    (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (M := integralClosure O L)).2 hc
  exact (adic_complete_iff_of_pow_le (integralClosure O L) (integralClosure O L) _ _
    _ (le_of_eq h512.symm) hI).1 h1

name: SurfaceBlowup.irreducible_factor_invariant_degree
statement:
private theorem irreducible_factor_invariant_degree (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (g : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hg : g.Monic)
    (hirr : Irreducible g) (hfin : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))) :
    0 < (factorInvariant O g).1 ∧ 0 < (factorInvariant O g).2 ∧
      (factorInvariant O g).1 * (factorInvariant O g).2 = g.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hirr⟩
  have : Module.Finite (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot g) := hg.finite_adjoinRoot
  have hloc := integral_closure_is_local O (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot g)
  have h := integral_closure_invariants_degree O (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot g) hloc
  have hdeg : Module.finrank (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot g) = g.natDegree :=
    finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree
  unfold factorInvariant
  rw [dif_pos hloc]
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.trans hdeg⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_degree
statement:
theorem polynomial_type_degree (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType) (hF : HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ) :
    ValidType σ ∧ typeDegree σ=F.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gs, hgs, -, rfl, rfl, hfin⟩ := hF
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    rw [Multiset.mem_coe, List.mem_map] at hz
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hz
    have := irreducible_factor_invariant_degree O g (hgs g hg).1 (hgs g hg).2 (hfin g hg)
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.1⟩
  · induction gs with
    | nil => simp [typeDegree]
    | cons g gs ih =>
      have hg := hgs g (by simp)
      have ht : ∀ h ∈ gs, h.Monic ∧ Irreducible h := fun h hh => hgs h (by simp [hh])
      have hm : gs.prod.Monic := by
        simpa using Polynomial.monic_multiset_prod_of_monic (gs : Multiset _) id
          (fun h hh => (ht h (by simpa using hh)).1)
      have := irreducible_factor_invariant_degree O g hg.1 hg.2 (hfin g (by simp))
      have ih' := ih ht (fun h hh => hfin h (by simp [hh]))
      simp only [typeDegree, List.map_cons, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.map_cons,
        Multiset.sum_cons, List.prod_cons] at ih' ⊢
      rw [Polynomial.Monic.natDegree_mul hg.1 hm, ih', this.2.2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.padicIntegers_isDVR
statement:
theorem padicIntegers_isDVR (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ_[p] K]
    [Algebra ℤ_[p] K] [IsScalarTower ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] K] :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (padicIntegers p K)
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsSeparable ℚ_[p] K :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSeparable_of_perfectField
  have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ℤ_[p]) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (ZMod p) (PadicInt.residueField (p := p)).toEquiv.symm
  have : Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K)
  exact integral_closure_is_dvr ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K

name: SurfaceBlowup.padicIntegers_maximal_adic_complete
statement:
theorem padicIntegers_maximal_adic_complete (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type) [Field K]
    [Algebra ℚ_[p] K] [Algebra ℤ_[p] K] [IsScalarTower ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] K]
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (padicIntegers p K)) :
    letI
proof:
:= hdvr
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (padicIntegers p K)) (padicIntegers p K) := by
  have := hdvr
  have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ℤ_[p]) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (ZMod p) PadicInt.residueField.toEquiv.symm
  have : Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K)
  exact integral_closure_own_adic_complete ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K inferInstance

name: SurfaceBlowup.padicIntegers_residueField_finite
statement:
theorem padicIntegers_residueField_finite (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type) [Field K]
    [Algebra ℚ_[p] K] [Algebra ℤ_[p] K] [IsScalarTower ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[p] K]
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (padicIntegers p K)) :
    letI
proof:
:= hdvr; Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (padicIntegers p K)) := by
  have := hdvr
  have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ℤ_[p]) :=
    Finite.of_equiv _ PadicInt.residueField.symm.toEquiv
  have : Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K)
  have h1 : Finite (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K ⧸
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[p]).map (algebraMap ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] K))) :=
    integral_closure_finite_reduction ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] K
  have h2 := (integral_local_extension_unique_prime ℤ_[p] (padicIntegers p K)).1
  have hle : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[p]).map (algebraMap ℤ_[p] (padicIntegers p K)) ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (padicIntegers p K) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, h2]
  exact Finite.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.factor hle) (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hle)

name: SurfaceBlowup.quotient_ring_length_intrinsic
statement:
theorem quotient_ring_length_intrinsic (S S' : Type) [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] (I : Ideal S)
    (J : Ideal S') (e : (S ⧸ I) ≃+* (S' ⧸ J)) :
    Module.length S (S ⧸ I) = Module.length S' (S' ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective (R := S ⧸ I) (M := S ⧸ I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    Module.length_eq_of_surjective (R := S' ⧸ J) (M := S' ⧸ J) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
  have : RingHomSurjective (e : (S ⧸ I) →+* (S' ⧸ J)) := ⟨e.surjective⟩
  let f : (S ⧸ I) →ₛₗ[(e : (S ⧸ I) →+* (S' ⧸ J))] (S' ⧸ J) :=
    ⟨(e : (S ⧸ I) →+* (S' ⧸ J)).toAddMonoidHom, by intro c x; simp⟩
  rw [Module.length, Module.length, WithBot.unbot_inj,
    Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (Submodule.orderIsoMapComapOfBijective f e.bijective)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_chart_translate
statement:
theorem member_chart_translate (m : ConcreteMember) (f : m.toMeasured.R)
    (b : Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.R) (Mlev : ℕ)
    (z₀ : Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O) :
    (∀ z, coordinateIdeal m.toMeasured.S.pi f b (z₀ + z) =
      coordinateIdeal m.toMeasured.S.pi (f + m.toMeasured.S.pi • coordinateLift b z₀) b z) ∧
      coordinateCoset m.toMeasured.S.pi Mlev z₀ =
      (fun z => z₀ + z) '' Set.range (coordinateScale m.toMeasured.S.pi Mlev) ∧
        ∀ A : Set (Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O),
        coefficientMeasure m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.s.degree ((fun z => z₀ + z) '' A) =
        coefficientMeasure m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.s.degree A ∧
        (MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet ((fun z => z₀ + z) '' A))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    unfold coordinateIdeal normalizedIdeal normalizedGenerator coordinateLift
    congr 2
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.smul_sum, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, ← add_assoc]
  · ext z
    rw [Set.mem_image]
    simp only [coordinateCoset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range, coordinateScale]
    rw [finite_coordinate_adic_congruence]
    constructor
    · intro h
      choose y hy using fun i ↦ Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1
        (by simpa only [Ideal.span_singleton_pow] using h i)
      refine ⟨(m.toMeasured.S.pi ^ Mlev) • y, ⟨y, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      ext i
      simp [mul_comm _ (y i), hy i]
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ i
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
      exact ⟨y i, by simp [mul_comm]⟩
  · intro A
    have := (coefficient_space_strict_instances m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.htop
      m.toMeasured.S.pi m.toMeasured.S.pi_irreducible m.toMeasured.s.degree).2.1
    rw [Set.image_add_left]
    exact ⟨MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add _ _ _, fun hA ↦ measurable_const_add _ hA⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_children_degree_sum
statement:
theorem member_children_degree_sum (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.toMeasured.cellIndex) :
    ∑ j, m.toMeasured.childDelta c j * (m.toMeasured.childState c j).degree =
      m.toMeasured.s.degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← children_degree_identity m.toMeasured.s (m.shape.valid m.ha) c.1.1 c.1.2]
  exact Fin.sum_univ_fun_getElem _ fun z : ℕ × State ↦ z.1 * z.2.degree

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_coefficient_measure_map_product_coordinates
statement:
theorem member_coefficient_measure_map_product_coordinates (m : ConcreteMember)
    (c : m.toMeasured.cellIndex) (mc : m.toMeasured.childIdx c → ConcreteMember)
    [∀ j, Algebra m.toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.O]
    (ρ : (Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O) ≃ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      (∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O))
    (hρ : Measurable ρ) :
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map ρ (coefficientMeasure m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.s.degree) =
      MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
      (fun j => coefficientMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm := coefficient_space_strict_instances m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.htop
    m.pi m.hpi m.toMeasured.s.degree
  have hc := fun j => coefficient_space_strict_instances (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.htop
    (mc j).pi (mc j).hpi (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree
  have := hm.2.1
  have := hm.2.2.1
  have : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure
      (coefficientMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) := fun j => (hc j).2.1
  have : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
      (coefficientMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) := fun j => (hc j).2.2.1
  set ν := MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
      (fun j => coefficientMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree)
  set μ' := MeasureTheory.Measure.map ρ (coefficientMeasure m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.s.degree)
  have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ' :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hρ.aemeasurable
  have : μ'.IsAddLeftInvariant :=
    MeasureTheory.isAddLeftInvariant_map (ρ.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom.toAddHom) hρ ρ.surjective
  have key := MeasureTheory.Measure.isAddInvariant_eq_smul_of_compactSpace μ' ν
  have h1 := congrArg (fun μ => μ Set.univ) key
  simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.measure_univ] at h1
  rw [ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, eq_comm, ENNReal.coe_eq_one] at h1
  rw [key, h1, one_smul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.resultant_deriv_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (derivative f).natDegree ≤ n - 1 := hn ▸ natDegree_derivative_le f
  have := resultant_add_right_deg (f := f) (g := derivative f) (m := n)
    (n := (derivative f).natDegree) (n - 1 - (derivative f).natDegree) le_rfl
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hd] at this
  rw [this, ← hn]

name: SurfaceBlowup.separable_of_resultant
statement:
theorem separable_of_resultant (f : K[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : f.natDegree = n) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (h : resultant f (derivative f) n (n - 1) ≠ 0) : f.Separable
proof:
:= by
  rw [resultant_deriv_eq f n hn] at h
  have h2 : resultant f (derivative f) ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h
  rw [Ne, resultant_eq_zero_iff] at h2
  push Not at h2
  exact h2 (Or.inl hf)

name: SurfaceBlowup.resultant_ne_zero_of_separable
statement:
theorem resultant_ne_zero_of_separable (f : K[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : f.natDegree = n) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hs : f.Separable) : resultant f (derivative f) n (n-1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [resultant_deriv_eq f n hn]
  refine mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ ?_) (resultant_ne_zero f _ hs)
  rw [← hn]; exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hf

name: SurfaceBlowup.monicPolynomial_eq_map
statement:

name: SurfaceBlowup.specHom_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction D using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C z => simp [specHom]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_X, map_mul, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_X, ← hp]

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_resultant_eq
statement:
private theorem monic_resultant_eq {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → O) :
    resultant (monicPolynomial O a) (derivative (monicPolynomial O a)) n (n-1) =
      algebraMap O (BaseField O)
        (MvPolynomial.eval a (MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom O) (discMonic n)))
proof:

statement:
theorem affine_resultant_eq {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) :
    resultant (affinePolynomial O a) (derivative (affinePolynomial O a)) n (n-1) =
      algebraMap O (BaseField O)
        (MvPolynomial.eval a (MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom O) (discAffine n)))

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_separable_monic
statement: theorem exists_separable_monic (n : ℕ) : ∃ a : Fin n → O, (monicPolynomial O a).Separable
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | k
  · exact ⟨Fin.elim0, by simp [monicPolynomial]⟩
  by_cases h : ((k+1 : ℕ) : BaseField O) = 0
  · rcases k with _ | k
    · simp at h
    refine ⟨Pi.single 1 (-1), ?_⟩
    have he : monicPolynomial O (Pi.single (1 : Fin (k+2)) (-1 : O)) = X ^ (k+2) - X := by
      simp [monicPolynomial, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Pi.single_apply, sub_eq_add_neg,
        Fin.succ_succ_ne_one]
      ring
    rw [he]
    have hd : derivative (X ^ (k+2) - X : Polynomial (BaseField O)) = -1 := by
      simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_X_pow, derivative_X]
      rw [show ((k+2 : ℕ) : BaseField O) = 0 by exact_mod_cast h]
      simp
    rw [Polynomial.Separable, hd]
    exact isCoprime_one_right.neg_right
  · refine ⟨Pi.single 0 (-1), ?_⟩
    have he : monicPolynomial O (Pi.single (0 : Fin (k+1)) (-1 : O)) = X ^ (k+1) - 1 := by
      simp [monicPolynomial, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Pi.single_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [he]
    exact (X_pow_sub_one_separable_iff).2 h

name: SurfaceBlowup.coefficientMeasure_zero_null
statement:
theorem coefficientMeasure_zero_null (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (m : ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) O) (a₀ : Fin m → O) (h₀ : MvPolynomial.eval a₀ P ≠ 0) :
    coefficientMeasure O m {a | MvPolynomial.eval a P = 0} = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop 1
  set ν := (coefficientMeasure O 1).map (LinearEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) O O) with hν
  have h := coefficient_measure_pi_one O htop pi hpi m
  rw [h.1]
  have : MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant (coefficientMeasure O 1) := by
    unfold coefficientMeasure
    infer_instance
  have : NullSingletonClass ν := ⟨fun x => by
    rw [hν, Measure.map_apply h.2.2.2.2.1 (measurableSet_singleton x)]
    have hpre : (LinearEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) O O) ⁻¹' {x} =
        (fun b : Fin 1 → O => (fun _ => -x) + b) ⁻¹' {b : Fin 1 → O | b 0 = 0} := by
      ext b
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, LinearEquiv.funUnique_apply,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.add_apply]
      rw [show (default : Fin 1) = 0 from rfl, neg_add_eq_zero, eq_comm]
    rw [hpre, measure_preimage_add]
    exact (coordinate_hyperplane_null O htop 1 0).2⟩
  exact mvPolynomial_zero_null ν m P (fun hP => h₀ (by rw [hP, map_zero]))

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_inseparable_null
statement:
theorem monic_inseparable_null (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientMeasure O n {a | ¬ (monicPolynomial O a).Separable} = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₀, h₀⟩ := exists_separable_monic O n
  have hdeg := fun a => monic_polynomial_degree O n a
  refine measure_mono_null (fun a ha => ?_) (coefficientMeasure_zero_null O htop n
    (MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom O) (discMonic n)) a₀ ?_)
  · simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ha ⊢
    by_contra hne
    apply ha
    refine separable_of_resultant _ n (hdeg a).2 (hdeg a).1.ne_zero ?_
    rw [monic_resultant_eq]
    exact fun h => hne ((IsFractionRing.injective O (BaseField O)) (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  · have := resultant_ne_zero_of_separable _ n (hdeg a₀).2 (hdeg a₀).1.ne_zero h₀
    rw [monic_resultant_eq] at this
    exact fun h => this (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_cell_chart_coset_decomposition
statement:
theorem member_cell_chart_coset_decomposition (m : ConcreteMember) (c : m.toMeasured.cellIndex)
    (Mlev : ℕ) (hM : m.toMeasured.cellDegree c ≤ Mlev) :
    ∃ reps : Finset (Fin m.s.degree → m.O),
      (∀ z : Fin m.s.degree → m.O, ∃! z₀, z₀ ∈ reps ∧ adicCongr (Ideal.span {m.S.pi}) Mlev z z₀) ∧
      (∀ z₀ : Fin m.s.degree → m.O, MeasurableSet (coordinateCoset m.S.pi Mlev z₀)) ∧
      (reps : Set (Fin m.s.degree → m.O)).PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun z₀ => coordinateCoset m.S.pi Mlev z₀) ∧ ∀ i : m.atlas.ι,
        coordinateIdeal m.S.pi (m.atlas.chart i).f (m.atlas.chart i).b ⁻¹' m.toMeasured.cell c =
        ⋃ z₀ ∈ reps.filter
        (fun z₀ => coordinateIdeal m.S.pi (m.atlas.chart i).f (m.atlas.chart i).b z₀ ∈
        m.toMeasured.cell c), coordinateCoset m.S.pi Mlev z₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨reps, hreps⟩ :=
      coordinate_coset_representatives_exist m.O m.S.pi
      (by rw [m.hS_pi]; exact m.hpi) m.s.degree Mlev
  have hmax : Ideal.span {m.S.pi} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal m.O := by
    rw [m.hS_pi]; exact ((m.hpi).maximalIdeal_eq).symm
  have hmeas : ∀ z₀ : Fin m.s.degree → m.O, MeasurableSet (coordinateCoset m.S.pi Mlev z₀) := by
    intro z₀
    have h := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders m.O (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal m.O) m.htop m.s.degree
    have : @MeasurableSet _
        (adicCylinderSpace (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal m.O) (Fin m.s.degree → m.O))
        (coordinateCoset m.S.pi Mlev z₀) := MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom
      (.inr ⟨Mlev, z₀, by unfold coordinateCoset; rw [hmax]⟩)
    rwa [← h] at this
  refine ⟨reps, hreps, hmeas, fun z₁ h₁ z₂ h₂ hne ↦ Set.disjoint_left.2 fun z hz1 hz2 ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
