  · obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := hreps z
    exact hne ((hw z₁ ⟨h₁, hz1⟩).trans (hw z₂ ⟨h₂, hz2⟩).symm)
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hinj, -, -⟩ := concrete_member_charts m i
  have hf : Ideal.span {(m.atlas.chart i).f} ∈ surfaceStateSet m.O m.R m.S m.s :=
    m.atlas.cover.symm.subset <| Set.mem_iUnion.2
      ⟨i, ⟨_, rfl⟩, by rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]⟩
  obtain ⟨hpart, -⟩ := fixed_tangent_cell_chart_partition m.O m.R m.S m.s m.s.degree
    (m.atlas.chart i).b (m.atlas.chart i).f hf hinj (m.toMeasured.cellDegree c) Mlev hM c.2.1 reps
    hreps
  have hstate : ∀ z₀, coordinateIdeal m.S.pi (m.atlas.chart i).f (m.atlas.chart i).b z₀ ∈
      surfaceStateSet m.O m.R m.S m.s := fun z₀ ↦ by
    change Ideal.span {_ + coordinateLift _ _} ∈ _
    rw [coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul]
    exact surface_state_vertical_perturbation m.O m.R m.S m.s (m.atlas.chart i).f _ hf
  rw [Finset.filter_congr fun z₀ _ ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨hstate z₀, h⟩⟩]
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun T ↦ coordinateIdeal m.S.pi (m.atlas.chart i).f (m.atlas.chart i).b ⁻¹' T) hpart
  simp only [Set.preimage_inter_range] at h2
  refine h2.trans ?_
  simp only [Set.preimage_iUnion₂, Set.preimage_image_eq _ hinj]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_chart_measurableEmbedding
statement:
private theorem member_chart_measurableEmbedding (m : ConcreteMember) (g : m.toMeasured.R)
    (hg : Ideal.span {g} ∈ m.toMeasured.stateSet)
    (bc : Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.R)
    (E : m.toMeasured.R ≃ₗ[m.toMeasured.O]
      ((Fin m.toMeasured.s.degree → m.toMeasured.O) × m.toMeasured.R))
    (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w) :
    @MeasurableEmbedding _ _ inferInstance m.toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal
      (coordinateIdeal m.toMeasured.S.pi g bc)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg := (concrete_member_state_generator_regular m g hg).2.2
  have hvp := surface_vertical_parameter m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.R m.toMeasured.S
  have hpi' : Irreducible m.toMeasured.S.pi := by
    change Irreducible m.S.pi
    rw [m.hS_pi]; exact m.hpi
  have := concrete_member_division_module_isAdicComplete m
  exact coordinate_ideal_measurableEmbedding m.toMeasured.O m.toMeasured.htop m.toMeasured.R
    m.toMeasured.S.pi hpi' hvp.1 hvp.2 _ g bc ⟨⟨E, hE⟩, hreg⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.member_product_chart_pushforward
statement:
theorem member_product_chart_pushforward (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (mc : ι → ConcreteMember)
    (g : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R) (hg : ∀ j, Ideal.span {g j} ∈ (mc j).toMeasured.stateSet)
    (bc' : ∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.R)
    (E' : ∀ j, (mc j).toMeasured.R ≃ₗ[(mc j).toMeasured.O]
      ((Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O) × (mc j).toMeasured.R))
    (hE' : ∀ j w, (E' j).symm w = divisionMap (g j) (bc' j) w) :
    (letI : ∀ j, MeasurableSpace (Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R) :=
      fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.measurableSpaceIdeal; MeasurableEmbedding
        (fun (w : ∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O) (j : ι)
        => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (w j)) ∧
        ∀ Y : Set (∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O), MeasurableSet Y →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ)
        ((fun (w : ∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O) (j : ι)
        => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (w j)) '' Y) =
        (∏ j, ((mc j).toMeasured.q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) *
        MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun j => coefficientMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) Y)
proof:
:= by
  set Ψ : (∀ j, Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O) → ∀ j,
      Ideal (mc j).toMeasured.R :=
    fun w j ↦ coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) (w j)
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding Ψ :=
    measurableEmbedding_pi ι _ _ _
      (fun j => member_chart_measurableEmbedding (mc j) (g j) (hg j) (bc' j) (E' j) (hE' j))
  refine ⟨hemb, fun Y hY ↦ ?_⟩
  have : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.μ :=
    fun j => (concrete_member_measure_finite_support (mc j)).1
  have : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
      (coefficientMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree) :=
    fun j => coefficient_measure_probability _ (mc j).toMeasured.htop _
  set C : ℝ≥0∞ := ∏ j, ((mc j).toMeasured.q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree
  have hC0 : C ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j _ ↦
    pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.2 (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _))
  have hCt : C ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.prod_ne_top fun j _ ↦ ENNReal.pow_ne_top <| ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 <|
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.2
      (Finite.one_lt_card (α := IsLocalRing.ResidueField (mc j).toMeasured.O)).ne_bot
  set κ := MeasureTheory.Measure.comap Ψ
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ))
  have hκapp : ∀ Z, MeasurableSet Z → κ Z =
      MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (fun j => (mc j).toMeasured.μ) (Ψ '' Z) :=
    fun Z hZ => MeasureTheory.Measure.comap_apply Ψ hemb.injective
      (fun s hs => hemb.measurableSet_image' hs) _ hZ
  have hbox : ∀ s : ∀ j, Set (Fin (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree → (mc j).toMeasured.O),
      Ψ '' Set.pi Set.univ s =
        Set.pi Set.univ (fun j => coordinateIdeal (mc j).toMeasured.S.pi (g j) (bc' j) '' s j) := by
    intro s
    ext y
    refine ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, hwy⟩ j _ ↦ hwy ▸ ⟨w j, hw j trivial, rfl⟩, fun hy ↦ ?_⟩
    choose w hw using fun j ↦ hy j trivial
    exact ⟨w, fun j _ ↦ (hw j).1, funext fun j ↦ (hw j).2⟩
  have hpi : MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
      (fun j => coefficientMeasure (mc j).toMeasured.O (mc j).toMeasured.s.degree)
      = C⁻¹ • κ := by
    apply MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_eq
    intro s hs
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hκapp _ (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs), hbox,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_pi, Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ ↦
        (concrete_member_division_chart_measure (mc j) (g j) (hg j) (bc' j) (E' j) (hE' j)).2.2 _
          (hs j), Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hC0 hCt, one_mul]
  rw [← hκapp _ hY, hpi, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hC0 hCt, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_order_limit_cokernel_length
statement:
private theorem curve_order_limit_cokernel_length (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hregF : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective
      (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
          ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j)) * c))
    (f : R)
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f =
      (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j))
    (σ : R →ₗ[R] CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G)
    (hσ : ∀ r : R, ∃ p : curveThreads R t x beta G, σ r = curveLimitMk R t x beta G p ∧ ∀ j : ℕ,
      p.val j = surfaceToChartPair R t x r) :
    Module.length O (CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G ⧸ LinearMap.range (σ.restrictScalars O)) =
      (chooseTwo d : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  set J := max (d - 1) 1
  have hJ : d - 1 ≤ J := le_max_left _ _
  have hpres := fun j ↦ actual_cech_preserves_exceptional_lattices R t x beta d j
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := curve_limit_level_map_exists R t x beta d G J
  obtain ⟨δ, -, hδs, hδk⟩ := curve_sections_connecting_map_exists O R t x hreg beta hregSwap d G J
    (hpres J) (hregF J)
  let Θ := δ ∘ₗ (π.restrictScalars O)
  have hker : LinearMap.ker Θ = LinearMap.range (σ.restrictScalars O) := by
    ext u
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply]
    constructor
    · intro hu
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ u
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (hδk _).1 (show δ (π (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p)) = 0 from hu)
      rw [hπ p] at hr
      exact curve_limit_range_of_stable_level R t x beta d G hreg hregSwap hregF f hf J hJ σ hσ p
        ⟨r, (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).1 hr⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2⟩ := hσ r
      change δ (π (σ r)) = 0
      exact (hδk _).2 ⟨r, by rw [hp1, hπ p, hp2]⟩
  rw [((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker.symm).trans (LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective Θ
    (hδs.comp (curve_limit_level_map_surjective R t x beta d G hreg J π hπ)))).length_eq]
  exact actual_finite_cech_coefficient_triangular O R t x hreg beta hregSwap hres d J hJ hpres

name: SurfaceBlowup.child_order_index_and_kernel
statement:
theorem child_order_index_and_kernel [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (d : ℕ)
    (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hregF : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective
      (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
          ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j)) * c))
    (f : R)
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f =
      (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j))
    (hclosed : (⨅ j : ℕ, (Ideal.span {f} ⊔ (Ideal.span {t,x})^j)) = Ideal.span {f})
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, IsLocalRing (localRing D p)]
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, IsNoetherianRing (localRing D p)]
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)) (localRing D p)]
    [∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p)]
    (E : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G ≃ₗ[O] childOrder D) (σ : R →ₗ[R] CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G)
    (hσ : ∀ r : R, ∃ p : curveThreads R t x beta G, σ r = curveLimitMk R t x beta G p ∧ ∀ j : ℕ,
      p.val j = surfaceToChartPair R t x r)
    (hE : ∀ (p : curveThreads R t x beta G) (r : R),
      (∀ j : ℕ, p.val j = surfaceToChartPair R t x r) → E (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) =
      childOrderMap D r)
    (φ : R →ₗ[O] childOrder D) (hφ : ∀ r : R, φ r = childOrderMap D r) :
    RingHom.ker (childOrderMap D) = Ideal.span {f} ∧
      Module.length O ((childOrder D) ⧸ LinearMap.range φ) = (chooseTwo d : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ r : R, childOrderMap D r = E (σ r) := fun r ↦ by
    obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2⟩ := hσ r
    rw [hp1, hE p r hp2]
  have hker := surface_to_curve_limit_kernel R t x beta d G hreg hregSwap hregF f hf hclosed σ hσ
  refine ⟨Ideal.ext fun r ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [RingHom.mem_ker, key, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff, ← LinearMap.mem_ker, hker]
  · have hrange : (LinearMap.range (σ.restrictScalars O)).map
        (E : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G →ₗ[O] childOrder D) = LinearMap.range φ := by
      ext y
      simp only [Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨r, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨r, by rw [hφ, key]; rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨σ r, ⟨r, rfl⟩, by rw [hφ, key]; rfl⟩
    rw [← curve_order_limit_cokernel_length O R t x hreg beta hregSwap hres d G hregF f hf σ hσ]
    exact (LinearEquiv.length_eq (Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ E hrange)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_curve_order_index
statement:
theorem concrete_curve_order_index (beta : BlowupRestriction 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 beta) (f : 𝒮) (G : GluedGenerators 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 beta (curveDataDegree D))
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 j f =
      (cechInputLattice 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 G j))
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳)^j) (G.left j)} =
        leftLevelKernel D j ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional 𝒮 𝒳 𝒯)^j) (G.right j)} =
        rightLevelKernel D j) :
    (letI : ∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p) :=
      fun p => ((localFromSurface D p).comp (algebraMap O 𝒮)).toAlgebra;
        ∃ φ : 𝒮 →ₗ[O] childOrder D, (∀ r : 𝒮, φ r = childOrderMap D r) ∧
        RingHom.ker (childOrderMap D) = Ideal.span {f} ∧
        Module.length O (childOrder D ⧸ LinearMap.range φ) =
        (chooseTwo (curveDataDegree D) : ℕ∞))
proof:
:= by
  let _ : ∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p) := fun p ↦
    ((localFromSurface D p).comp (algebraMap O 𝒮)).toAlgebra
  have hreg := concrete_surface_regular_pair_tx O pi hpi.ne_zero u a b ha
  have hregSwap := concrete_surface_regular_pair_xt O pi hpi.ne_zero u a b ha
  have : (Ideal.span ({𝒯, 𝒳} : Set 𝒮)).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span ({𝒯, 𝒳} : Set 𝒮)) 𝒮 :=
    concrete_surface_isAdicComplete_parameterIdeal O pi u a b
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b 𝒯 𝒳
  have := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b 𝒳 𝒯
  have := concrete_surface_isLocalRing O pi u a b hpi.not_isUnit ha
  have := concrete_surface_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b
  have hclosed : (⨅ j : ℕ, (Ideal.span {f} ⊔ (Ideal.span ({𝒯, 𝒳} : Set 𝒮))^j)) =
      Ideal.span {f} := by
    have := ideal_closed_noetherian_local 𝒮 (Ideal.span {f})
    rwa [concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha] at this
  have h3 := (two_chart_datum_concrete_instances O pi hpi u a b ha beta D).2.2
  have : ∀ p : AllPoints D, IsNoetherianRing (localRing D p) := fun p ↦ (h3 p).1
  have : ∀ p : AllPoints D, IsLocalRing (localRing D p) := fun p ↦ (h3 p).2.choose
  have : ∀ p : AllPoints D,
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)) (localRing D p) :=
    fun p ↦ (h3 p).2.choose_spec.1
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := surface_to_curve_limit_exists 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 beta _ G
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := child_order_equiv_linear 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 beta D _ G hG
    (fun p ↦ (h3 p).2.choose_spec.2) O fun p o ↦ rfl
  let φ : 𝒮 →ₗ[O] childOrder D :=
    { toFun := fun r ↦ childOrderMap D r
      map_add' := fun r s ↦ map_add _ r s
      map_smul' := fun o r ↦ by
        rw [RingHom.id_apply, Algebra.smul_def o r, map_mul, Algebra.smul_def]
        congr 1 }
  refine ⟨φ, fun r ↦ rfl, child_order_index_and_kernel O 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 hreg beta hregSwap ?_ D _ G
    (two_chart_left_generators_regular_on_overlap 𝒮 𝒯 𝒳 beta D _ G hG hreg hregSwap) f hf hclosed
    E σ hσ hE φ fun r ↦ rfl⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨e, he'⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
  refine ⟨MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s, e.injective ?_⟩
  have h2 := he' (MvPowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s))
  simp only [MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_C] at h2
  exact h2.trans (he' s).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.single_residue_ideal_count
statement:
theorem single_residue_ideal_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Nat.card (singleResidueIdeals k a c) = (Nat.card k)^(a*c-c)
proof:
:= by
  have hcN : c ≤ a * c := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left c ha
  have hlen : ∀ F : TwoSeries k, axisQuotientLength k 0 F = c →
      Module.length (TwoSeries k) (TwoSeries k ⧸ (monomialIdeal k a 0 ⊔ Ideal.span {F})) =
        ((a*c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    intro F hF
    have h5 := length_double_quotient_eq (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a 0) (Ideal.span {F})
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h5
    rw [← h5, single_special_fiber_length k a c ha _
      (by rw [contact_fiberT_eq_axisQuotientLength k a 0 ha, hF]), Nat.cast_mul]
  have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (TwoSeries k)) :=
    .of_equiv _ (twoSeriesResidueEquiv k).toEquiv.symm
  have hmem : ∀ j < a*c+1, ((0:ℕ), j) ∈ truncIndex a 0 (a*c+1) := by
    intro j hj; simp [truncIndex]; omega
  have hE : ∀ j, truncExponent ((0:ℕ), j) = Finsupp.single 1 j := by simp [truncExponent]
  let A : Finset (truncIndex a 0 (a*c+1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun s => s.1.1 = 0 ∧ s.1.2 < c)
  let B : Finset (truncIndex a 0 (a*c+1)) := {⟨(0, c), hmem c (by omega)⟩}
  have hA : A.card = c := card_truncIndex_axis_segment a 0 _ c Prod.fst Prod.snd ((0, ·))
    (fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) (fun x h => Prod.ext h.symm rfl) fun j hj => hmem j (by omega)
  have key := principal_residue_ideal_count k a 0 (a*c) ha (axisQuotientLength k 0 · = c)
    (contact · (fiberT k a 0) = c) (fun F => by rw [contact_fiberT_eq_axisQuotientLength k a 0 ha])
    (fun U F hU hF => by rwa [axisQuotientLength, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hU])
    hlen (fun F hF => by
      rw [finite_length_module_card (TwoSeries k) _ _ (hlen F hF),
        Nat.card_congr (twoSeriesResidueEquiv k).toEquiv])
    A B (by simp [A, B]) (Finset.singleton_nonempty _) (fun F => by
      rw [axisQuotientLength_eq_iff k (s := 0) (t := 1) (by decide)]
      simp only [A, B, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton,
        forall_eq, truncCoeffs_apply, hE]
      refine and_congr_left' ⟨fun h ⟨⟨i, j⟩, _⟩ ⟨hi, hj⟩ => ?_,
        fun h j hj => by simpa [hE] using h ⟨_, hmem j (by omega)⟩ ⟨rfl, hj⟩⟩
      obtain rfl : i = 0 := hi
      rw [hE]; exact h j hj)
  rw [hA, Finset.card_singleton, pow_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
    show a * c = c + (a * c - c) by omega, pow_add] at key
  have hpos : 0 < (Nat.card k - 1) * Nat.card k ^ c :=
    Nat.mul_pos (by have := Finite.one_lt_card (α := k); omega) (pow_pos Nat.card_pos _)
  unfold singleResidueIdeals
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpos (by linarith [key])

name: SurfaceBlowup.single_state_volume
statement:
theorem single_state_volume (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [MeasurableSpace (Ideal R)] (pi : O) (X : Set (Ideal R))
    (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (A : IdealAtlas O R pi (a * c) X)
    (hA : ∀ i, Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi (A.chart i).f (A.chart i).b))
    (hcount : Nonempty (A.ι ≃ singleResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a c)) :
    stateMeasure O R pi (a*c) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A Set.univ =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^c
proof:
:= by
  rw [state_measure_total_mass O R htop pi (a*c) X A hA]
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hcount
  have hcard : Fintype.card A.ι = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ (a*c-c) := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_congr e,
      single_residue_ideal_count _ a c ha]
  rw [hcard]
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.card_pos
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hqt : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.natCast_ne_top q
  have hle : c ≤ a * c := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left c ha
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, a * c = m + c := ⟨a*c - c, (Nat.sub_add_cancel hle).symm⟩
  rw [hm, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_add]
  push_cast
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hq0 hqt, one_pow, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.congruence_bijection_measure_preserving
statement:
theorem congruence_bijection_measure_preserving (O V : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module O V] (I : Ideal O) [MeasurableSpace V]
    (hgen : ‹MeasurableSpace V› = adicCylinderSpace I V) (F : V → V) (honto : Function.Surjective F)
    (hcong : ∀ j x y, adicCongr I j (F x) (F y) ↔ adicCongr I j x y) (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure V)
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hball : ∀ j (x y : V), mu {z | adicCongr I j z x} = mu {z | adicCongr I j z y}) :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving F mu mu
proof:
:= by
  have hF : Measurable F := congruence_bijection_measurable O V I hgen F honto hcong
  refine ⟨hF, ?_⟩
  have : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (mu.map F) := inferInstance
  refine finite_measures_from_cylinders O V I (mu.map F) mu hgen ?_
  intro j x
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {y | adicCongr I j y x} := by
    rw [hgen]
    exact MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (Or.inr ⟨j, x, rfl⟩)
  rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply hF hmeas]
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := honto x
  have : F ⁻¹' {y | adicCongr I j y (F w)} = {z | adicCongr I j z w} := by
    ext z; simp [hcong]
  rw [this]
  exact hball j w (F w)

name: SurfaceBlowup.compact_image_index_mass
statement:
private theorem compact_image_index_mass (G H : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H]
    [TopologicalSpace G]
    [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
    [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalAddGroup H] [T2Space H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H]
    (f : G →+ H) (hf : Continuous f) [Finite (H ⧸ f.range)] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure H)
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant nu] :
    nu (Set.range f) = (f.range.index : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range f) := (isCompact_range hf).isClosed
  have hm : ∀ a : H ⧸ f.range, MeasurableSet {x | QuotientAddGroup.mk' f.range x = a} := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective f.range a
    have : {x | QuotientAddGroup.mk' f.range x = QuotientAddGroup.mk' f.range y}
        = (fun x => -y + x) ⁻¹' Set.range f := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply]
      rw [eq_comm, QuotientAddGroup.eq]
      change _ ↔ _ ∈ (f.range : Set H)
      simp
    rw [this]
    exact (hcl.preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).measurableSet
  have h := finite_quotient_fiber_mass H (H ⧸ f.range) nu
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk' f.range) (QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective f.range) hm 0
  have e : {x | QuotientAddGroup.mk' f.range x = 0} = Set.range f := by
    ext x
    simp [QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
  rw [e] at h
  rw [h, AddSubgroup.index]

name: SurfaceBlowup.compact_injective_comap_measure
statement:
private theorem compact_injective_comap_measure (G H : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H]
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
    [BorelSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalAddGroup H] [T2Space H] [MeasurableSpace H]
    [BorelSpace H] (f : G →+ H) (hf : Continuous f) [Finite (H ⧸ f.range)]
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure G)
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure mu]
    (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure H) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant nu] :
    nu.comap f = (f.range.index : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • mu
proof:
:= by
  have hce : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding f := hf.isClosedEmbedding hinj
  have hme : MeasurableEmbedding f := hce.measurableEmbedding
  have : (nu.comap f).IsAddLeftInvariant :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant.comap nu (f := f) hme
  have huniv : nu.comap f Set.univ = nu (Set.range f) := by
    rw [hme.comap_apply, Set.image_univ]
  have : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (nu.comap f) :=
    ⟨by rw [huniv]; exact MeasureTheory.measure_lt_top _ _⟩
  have key := MeasureTheory.Measure.isAddInvariant_eq_smul_of_compactSpace (nu.comap f) mu
  have hc : (MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (nu.comap f) mu : ℝ≥0∞)
      = (f.range.index : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    have := congrArg (fun m : MeasureTheory.Measure G => m Set.univ) key
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.measure_univ] at this
    rw [← compact_image_index_mass G H f hf nu, ← huniv]
    rw [this, ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [key]
  ext s hs
  simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← hc, ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.compact_injective_image_measure
statement:
theorem compact_injective_image_measure (G H : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H]
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G]
    [BorelSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalAddGroup H] [T2Space H] [MeasurableSpace H]
    [BorelSpace H] (f : G →+ H) (hf : Continuous f) [Finite (H ⧸ f.range)]
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure G)
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure mu]
    (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure H) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant nu] (S : Set G) :
    nu (f '' S) = (f.range.index : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * mu S
proof:
:= by
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding f :=
    (hf.isClosedEmbedding hinj).measurableEmbedding
  have h := compact_injective_comap_measure G H f hf hinj mu nu
  have h2 := congrArg (fun m => m S) h
  rw [hemb.comap_apply] at h2
  rw [h2]
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalizer_inverse_equation
statement:
private theorem normalizer_inverse_equation (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (h : R) :
    adicPerturb (coordinateRemainder pi b E) (generatorNormalForm pi b E h) = E h
proof:
:= by
  have hb := adic_perturb_bijective O ((Fin n → O) × R) (Ideal.span {pi})
    (coordinateRemainder pi b E)
    (coordinate_remainder_raises_order O R n pi b E)
  exact Function.rightInverse_invFun hb.2 (E h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalizer_generator_equation
statement:
theorem normalizer_generator_equation (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (f : R)
    (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s) (h : R) :
    (1 + pi • (generatorNormalForm pi b E h).2) *
      (f + pi • coordinateLift b (generatorNormalForm pi b E h).1) = f + pi • h
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaled_normalization_identity O R n pi f b E hE,
    normalizer_inverse_equation O R n pi b E h, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalizer_preserves_adic_congruence
statement:
private theorem normalizer_preserves_adic_congruence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (j : ℕ) (h k : R)
    (hhk : adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j h k) :
    adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j (generatorNormalForm pi b E h)
      (generatorNormalForm pi b E k)
proof:
:= by
  have hE := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O R ((Fin n → O) × R)
    (Ideal.span {pi}) E.toLinearMap j h k hhk
  simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hE
  rw [← normalizer_inverse_equation O R n pi b E h,
    ← normalizer_inverse_equation O R n pi b E k] at hE
  exact (adic_perturb_congruence_iff O ((Fin n → O) × R) (Ideal.span {pi})
    (coordinateRemainder pi b E)
    (coordinate_remainder_raises_order O R n pi b E) j _ _).mp hE

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_transition_congruence
statement:
theorem coordinate_transition_congruence (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (c : Fin n → R)
    (F : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (h0 : R) (j : ℕ) (z w : Fin n → O)
    (hzw : adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j z w) :
    adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j (idealTransition pi b c F h0 z)
      (idealTransition pi b c F h0 w)
proof:
:= by
  let L : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R :=
    { toFun := fun z => coordinateLift b z
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        simp [coordinateLift, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := by
        intro r x
        simp [coordinateLift, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul] }
  have h1 := linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ (Ideal.span {pi}) L j z w hzw
  have h2 : adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j (h0 + coordinateLift b z) (h0 + coordinateLift b w) := by
    unfold adicCongr at h1 ⊢
    have : h0 + coordinateLift b z - (h0 + coordinateLift b w) = L z - L w := by
      simp only [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]; rfl
    rw [this]; exact h1
  have h3 := normalizer_preserves_adic_congruence O R n pi c F j _ _ h2
  exact linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence O _ _ (Ideal.span {pi})
    (LinearMap.fst O (Fin n → O) R) j _ _ h3

name: SurfaceBlowup.unique_scaled_generator_normalization
statement:
theorem unique_scaled_generator_normalization (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    (n : ℕ) [IsDomain R] (pi : O) (hpi : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0) (f : R) (b : Fin n → R)
    (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] (h : R) :
    ∃! s : (Fin n → O) × R, (1 + pi • s.2) * (f + pi • coordinateLift b s.1) = f + pi • h
proof:
:= by
  have hbij := adic_perturb_bijective O _ (Ideal.span {pi})
    (coordinateRemainder pi b E)
    (coordinate_remainder_raises_order O R n pi b E)
  have key : ∀ s : (Fin n → O) × R,
      (1 + pi • s.2) * (f + pi • coordinateLift b s.1) = f + pi • h ↔
        adicPerturb (coordinateRemainder pi b E) s = E h := by
    intro s
    rw [scaled_normalization_identity O R n pi f b E hE s]
    constructor
    · intro hs
      have h1 := add_left_cancel hs
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] at h1
      have h2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hpi h1
      rw [← h2]; simp
    · intro hs
      rw [hs]; simp
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hbij.2 (E h)
  refine ⟨s, (key s).2 hs, fun t ht => hbij.1 (((key t).1 ht).trans hs.symm)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.coordinate_ideal_injective
statement:
theorem coordinate_ideal_injective (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) ((Fin n → O) × R)] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hp0 : algebraMap O R pi ≠ 0) (hpm : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (f : R)
    (hE : ∀ s, E.symm s = divisionMap f b s)
    (hf : Function.Injective (fun x : R ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} =>
      x * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi}) f))
    :
    Function.Injective (coordinateIdeal pi f b)
proof:
:= by
  set I := Ideal.span {algebraMap O R pi} with hI
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [hI, Ideal.span_le]; simpa using hpm
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R |>.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp (h ▸ this))
  have : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  have hfbar : Ideal.Quotient.mk I f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := @hf 0 1 (by simp [h0])
    exact zero_ne_one this
  have hmk : ∀ z : Fin n → O,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (f + pi • coordinateLift b z) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I f := by
    intro z
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  intro z1 z2 hz
  simp only [coordinateIdeal, normalizedIdeal, normalizedGenerator, coordinateLift_smul_eq_mul,
    ← Algebra.smul_def] at hz
  have hg1 : f + pi • coordinateLift b z1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hfbar
    rw [← hmk z1, h0, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := regular_principal_generators_associated R _ _
    (fun x y hxy => mul_right_cancel₀ hg1 hxy) hz
  have hubar : Ideal.Quotient.mk I (u : R) = 1 := by
    apply hf
    have := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) hu
    rw [map_mul, hmk, hmk] at this
    simpa using this.symm
  have : (u : R) - 1 ∈ I := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq, hubar, map_one]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp this
  obtain ⟨s, _, huniq⟩ := unique_scaled_generator_normalization O R n pi hp0 f b E hE
    (coordinateLift b z2)
  have e1 := huniq (z1, v) (by
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def] at hu ⊢
    rw [hu]; congr 1; linear_combination hv)
  have e2 := huniq (z2, 0) (by simp)
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (e1.trans e2.symm)

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossing_residue_ideal_count
statement:
theorem crossing_residue_ideal_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hh : 0 < h) :
    Nat.card (crossingResidueIdeals k a b c h) = (Nat.card k-1)*(Nat.card k)^(a*c+b*h-c-h)
proof:
:= by
  have hcN : c ≤ a * c := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left c ha
  have hhN : h ≤ b * h := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left h hb
  set N := a*c+b*h with hNdef
  let P : TwoSeries k → Prop := fun F => axisQuotientLength k 0 F = c ∧ axisQuotientLength k 1 F = h
  have hlen : ∀ F, P F →
      Module.length (TwoSeries k) (TwoSeries k ⧸ (monomialIdeal k a b ⊔ Ideal.span {F})) = N := by
    intro F hF
    have h5 := length_double_quotient_eq (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b) (Ideal.span {F})
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h5
    rw [← h5, crossing_special_fiber_length k a b c h ha hb _
      (by rw [contact_fiberT_eq_axisQuotientLength k a b ha, hF.1])
      (by rw [contact_fiberX_eq_axisQuotientLength k a b hb, hF.2]), hNdef]
    push_cast; rfl
  have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (TwoSeries k)) :=
    .of_equiv _ (twoSeriesResidueEquiv k).toEquiv.symm
  have hmemS : ∀ j < N+1, ((0:ℕ), j) ∈ truncIndex a b (N+1) := by
    intro j hj; simp [truncIndex]; omega
  have hmemS' : ∀ i < N+1, (i, (0:ℕ)) ∈ truncIndex a b (N+1) := by
    intro i hi; simp [truncIndex]; omega
  have hEj : ∀ j, truncExponent ((0:ℕ), j) = Finsupp.single 1 j := by simp [truncExponent]
  have hEi : ∀ i, truncExponent (i, (0:ℕ)) = Finsupp.single 0 i := by simp [truncExponent]
  let A1 : Finset (truncIndex a b (N+1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun s => s.1.1 = 0 ∧ s.1.2 < c)
  let A2 : Finset (truncIndex a b (N+1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun s => s.1.2 = 0 ∧ s.1.1 < h)
  let B : Finset (truncIndex a b (N+1)) :=
    {⟨(0,c), hmemS c (by omega)⟩, ⟨(h,0), hmemS' h (by omega)⟩}
  have hA1 : A1.card = c := card_truncIndex_axis_segment a b _ c Prod.fst Prod.snd ((0, ·))
    (fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) (fun x h => Prod.ext h.symm rfl) fun j hj => hmemS j (by omega)
  have hA2 : A2.card = h := card_truncIndex_axis_segment a b _ h Prod.snd Prod.fst ((·, 0))
    (fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) (fun x h => Prod.ext rfl h.symm) fun i hi => hmemS' i (by omega)
  have hA12 : (A1 ∩ A2).card = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_eq_one]; refine ⟨⟨(0,0), hmemS 0 (by omega)⟩, ?_⟩
    ext ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij⟩
    simp only [A1, A2, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_singleton, Subtype.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq]
    omega
  have hA := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter A1 A2
  have hB : B.card = 2 := by
    rw [Finset.card_pair]
    simp only [ne_eq, Subtype.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq]
    omega
  have hAB : Disjoint (A1 ∪ A2) B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij⟩ hs hs'
    simp only [A1, A2, B, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, Subtype.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hs hs'
    omega
  have hcrit : ∀ F, P F ↔ (∀ s ∈ A1 ∪ A2, truncCoeffs k a b (N+1) F s = 0) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ B, truncCoeffs k a b (N+1) F s ≠ 0) := by
    intro F
    change axisQuotientLength k 0 F = c ∧ axisQuotientLength k 1 F = h ↔ _
    rw [axisQuotientLength_eq_iff k (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1),
      axisQuotientLength_eq_iff k (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0)]
    simp only [B, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq,
      truncCoeffs_apply, hEj, hEi]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ⟨h1', h2'⟩⟩
      refine ⟨fun ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij⟩ hs => ?_, h2, h2'⟩
      simp only [A1, A2, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hs
      rcases hs with ⟨rfl, hj⟩ | ⟨rfl, hi⟩
      · rw [hEj]; exact h1 j hj
      · rw [hEi]; exact h1' i hi
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h2'⟩
      refine ⟨⟨fun j hj => ?_, h2⟩, ⟨fun i hi => ?_, h2'⟩⟩
      · simpa [hEj] using h1 ⟨(0, j), hmemS j (by omega)⟩ (by simp [A1, hj])
      · simpa [hEi] using h1 ⟨(i, 0), hmemS' i (by omega)⟩ (by simp [A2, hi])
  have key := principal_residue_ideal_count k a b N ha P
    (fun f => contact f (fiberT k a b) = c ∧ contact f (fiberX k a b) = h)
    (fun F => by
      rw [contact_fiberT_eq_axisQuotientLength k a b ha,
        contact_fiberX_eq_axisQuotientLength k a b hb])
    (fun U F hU hF => by
      change axisQuotientLength k 0 _ = c ∧ axisQuotientLength k 1 _ = h
      rwa [axisQuotientLength, axisQuotientLength, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hU])
    hlen (fun F hF => by
      rw [finite_length_module_card (TwoSeries k) _ _ (hlen F hF),
        Nat.card_congr (twoSeriesResidueEquiv k).toEquiv])
    (A1 ∪ A2) B hAB (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _) hcrit
  rw [show (A1 ∪ A2).card + B.card - 1 = c + h by omega, hB,
    show N = c + h + (N - c - h) by omega, pow_add _ (c + h)] at key
  have hp : 0 < Nat.card k - 1 := by have := Finite.one_lt_card (α := k); omega
  have hpos : 0 < (Nat.card k - 1) * Nat.card k ^ (c + h) :=
    Nat.mul_pos hp (pow_pos Nat.card_pos _)
  unfold crossingResidueIdeals
  refine Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpos ?_
  rw [sq] at key
  linarith [key]

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossing_state_volume
statement:
theorem crossing_state_volume (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [MeasurableSpace (Ideal R)] (pi : O) (X : Set (Ideal R))
    (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hh : 0 < h)
    (A : IdealAtlas O R pi (a * c + b * h) X)
    (hA : ∀ i, Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi (A.chart i).f (A.chart i).b))
    (hcount : Nonempty (A.ι ≃ crossingResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b c h)) :
    stateMeasure O R pi (a*c+b*h) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A Set.univ =
      ((Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) *
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(c+h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [state_measure_total_mass O R htop pi (a*c+b*h) X A hA]
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hcount
  have hcard : Fintype.card A.ι = (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) - 1) *
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) ^ (a*c+b*h-c-h) := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_congr e]
    exact crossing_residue_ideal_count _ a b c h ha hb hc hh
  rw [hcard]
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  have hq : 1 ≤ q := Nat.card_pos
  have hN : a*c+b*h = (a*c+b*h-c-h) + (c+h) := by
    have : c ≤ a*c := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left c ha
    have : h ≤ b*h := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left h hb
    omega
  have hq0 : (q:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  have hqt : (q:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.natCast_ne_top q
  set m := a*c+b*h-c-h
  rw [hN, pow_add, Nat.cast_mul, ENNReal.natCast_sub, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one]
  have : (q:ℝ≥0∞)^m * (q:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^m = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hq0 hqt, one_pow]
  calc ((q:ℝ≥0∞) - 1) * (q:ℝ≥0∞)^m * ((q:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^m * (q:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(c+h))
      = ((q:ℝ≥0∞) - 1) * ((q:ℝ≥0∞)^m * (q:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^m) * (q:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(c+h) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [this, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_module_length_card
statement:
theorem finite_module_length_card (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] [Finite M] :
    ∃ ℓ : ℕ, Module.length O M = ℓ ∧ Nat.card M = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IsNoetherian O M := isNoetherian_of_finite O M
  have hA : IsArtinian O M := isArtinian_of_finite
  have hF : IsFiniteLength O M := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr ⟨hN, hA⟩
  have hne : Module.length O M ≠ ⊤ := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr hF
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hne
  exact ⟨ℓ, hℓ.symm, finite_length_module_card O M ℓ hℓ.symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_scaling_of_residue_card
statement:
theorem length_scaling_of_residue_card (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (O' : Type) [CommRing O'] [IsLocalRing O']
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O')] (δ : ℕ)
    (hδ : Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ δ)
    (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] [Module O' M] (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : Module.length O' M = ℓ) :
    Module.length O M = ((δ * ℓ : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := finite_length_module_card O' M ℓ hℓ
  have hq : 2 ≤ Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := by
    have := Finite.one_lt_card (α := IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    omega
  have hne : Nat.card M ≠ 0 := by
    rw [h1, hδ, ← pow_mul]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (by omega)
  have : Finite M := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hc⟩ := finite_module_length_card O M
  rw [hl]
  congr 1
  rw [h1, hδ, ← pow_mul] at hc
  exact (Nat.pow_right_injective hq hc).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_module_length_sum
statement:
private theorem pi_module_length_sum (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (M : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, AddCommGroup (M j)] [∀ j, Module O (M j)] (ℓ : ι → ℕ)
    (hℓ : ∀ j, Module.length O (M j) = ℓ j) :
    Module.length O (∀ j, M j) = ((∑ j, ℓ j : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := fun j => finite_length_module_card O (M j) (ℓ j) (hℓ j)
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) with hq
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := by
    have : Nontrivial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := inferInstance
    have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := inferInstance
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finite.one_lt_card)
  have hfin : ∀ j, Finite (M j) := fun j =>
    Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hc j]; positivity)
  have : Finite (∀ j, M j) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hcard⟩ := finite_module_length_card O (∀ j, M j)
  have h2 : Nat.card (∀ j, M j) = q ^ (∑ j, ℓ j) := by
    rw [Nat.card_pi, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun j _ => hc j)
  rw [hl]
  have : l = ∑ j, ℓ j := Nat.pow_right_injective hq2 (hcard.symm.trans h2)
  rw [this]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_mul_cokernel_length
statement:
theorem pi_mul_cokernel_length (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (C : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (C j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (C j)] (g e : ∀ j, C j) (ℓ : ι → ℕ)
    (hℓ : ∀ j, Module.length O (C j ⧸ (Ideal.span {g j} ⊔ Ideal.span {e j})) = ℓ j) :
    Module.length O (((∀ j, C j) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ⧸
      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mulLeft O (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e))) =
      ((∑ j, ℓ j : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, -⟩ := quotient_mul_range_equiv O (∀ j, C j) (Ideal.span {g}) e
  obtain ⟨-, ψ', -⟩ := pi_quotient_span_linearEquiv O ι C g e
  rw [φ.length_eq, ψ'.length_eq]
  exact pi_module_length_sum O ι _ ℓ hℓ

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.mem_coeffIdeal
statement:
private theorem mem_coeffIdeal {J : Ideal R} {p : Polynomial R} :
    p ∈ coeffIdeal J ↔ ∀ i, p.coeff i ∈ J
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_map_C_iff

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.coeffIdeal_mono
statement: private theorem coeffIdeal_mono {J J' : Ideal R} (h : J ≤ J') : coeffIdeal J ≤ coeffIdeal J'
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [mem_coeffIdeal] at hp ⊢
  exact fun i => h (hp i)

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.C_mem_coeffIdeal
statement:
private theorem C_mem_coeffIdeal {J : Ideal R} {a : R} (ha : a ∈ J) :
    Polynomial.C a ∈ coeffIdeal J
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.mul_mem_coeffIdeal_mul
statement:
private theorem mul_mem_coeffIdeal_mul {J J' : Ideal R} {p q : Polynomial R}
    (hp : p ∈ coeffIdeal J) (hq : q ∈ coeffIdeal J') : p * q ∈ coeffIdeal (J * J')
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeffIdeal, Ideal.map_mul]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hp hq

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.map_mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem map_mk_eq_zero_iff {J : Ideal R} {p : Polynomial R} :
    p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = 0 ↔ p ∈ coeffIdeal J
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_coeffIdeal, Polynomial.ext_iff]
  simp [coeff_map, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.map_residue_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem map_residue_eq_zero_iff {p : Polynomial R} :
    p.map (residue R) = 0 ↔ p ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R)
proof:
:=
  map_mk_eq_zero_iff

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.sub_mem_coeffIdeal_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
private theorem sub_mem_coeffIdeal_maximalIdeal_iff {p q : Polynomial R} :
    p - q ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R) ↔ p.map (residue R) = q.map (residue R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_residue_eq_zero_iff, Polynomial.map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_solve_field
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hcop
  have hg₀deg : g₀.degree = (g₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := degree_eq_natDegree hg₀.ne_zero
  have hh₀deg : h₀.degree = (h₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := degree_eq_natDegree hh₀.ne_zero
  set u : Polynomial k := (b * w) %ₘ g₀ with hu_def
  set v : Polynomial k := a * w + h₀ * ((b * w) /ₘ g₀) with hv_def
  have hu : u.degree < (g₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [hu_def, ← hg₀deg]; exact degree_modByMonic_lt (b * w) hg₀
  have key : w = h₀ * u + g₀ * v := by
    have hdiv : u + g₀ * ((b * w) /ₘ g₀) = b * w := modByMonic_add_div (b * w) g₀
    have expand : h₀ * u + g₀ * v = h₀ * (u + g₀ * ((b * w) /ₘ g₀)) + a * g₀ * w := by
      rw [hv_def]; ring
    rw [expand, hdiv]
    calc w = (a * g₀ + b * h₀) * w := by rw [hab, one_mul]
    _ = h₀ * (b * w) + a * g₀ * w := by ring
  refine ⟨u, v, hu, ?_, key⟩
  
  have h1 : (g₀ * v).degree = (g₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) + v.degree := by
    rw [degree_mul, hg₀deg]
  have h2 : (h₀ * u).degree < (g₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) + (h₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [degree_mul, hh₀deg, add_comm ((g₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ))]
    exact WithBot.add_lt_add_left (by simp) hu
  have h3 : (g₀ * v).degree < (g₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) + (h₀.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := by
    have hgv : g₀ * v = w - h₀ * u := by rw [key]; ring
    rw [hgv]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sub_le _ _) (max_lt ?_ h2)
    simpa [Nat.cast_add] using hw
  rw [h1] at h3
  exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_left (by simp)).mp h3

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.coeff_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow
statement:
private theorem coeff_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow (c : ℕ → R) (d j : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, Polynomial.C (c i) * X ^ i).coeff j = if j < d then c j else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [finsetSum_coeff]
  simp only [coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range d) j c]
  simp [Finset.mem_range]

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.degree_C_mul_le_degree
statement:
private theorem degree_C_mul_le_degree (a : R) (p : Polynomial R) :
    (Polynomial.C a * p).degree ≤ p.degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul]
  exact degree_smul_le a p

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.sum_C_mul_solve_expand
statement:
private theorem sum_C_mul_solve_expand (c : ℕ → R) (A B : ℕ → Polynomial R) (g h : Polynomial R)
    (d : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, Polynomial.C (c i) * ((X : Polynomial R) ^ i - (h * A i + g * B i))
      = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, Polynomial.C (c i) * X ^ i)
        - (h * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, Polynomial.C (c i) * A i)
          + g * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, Polynomial.C (c i) * B i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.eq_sum_range_of_degree_lt
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [coeff_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow]
  by_cases hj : j < d
  · rw [if_pos hj]
  · rw [if_neg hj]
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hp (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_not_lt hj))

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.degree_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow_lt
statement:
private theorem degree_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow_lt (c : ℕ → R) (d : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, Polynomial.C (c i) * X ^ i).degree < (d : WithBot ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sum_le _ _) ?_
  rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (by simp : (⊥ : WithBot ℕ) < (d : WithBot ℕ))]
  intro i hi
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_C_mul_X_pow_le i (c i)) (by exact_mod_cast Finset.mem_range.mp hi)

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_solve_mod
statement:
private theorem exists_solve_mod {g h : Polynomial R} {g₀ h₀ : Polynomial (ResidueField R)}
    (hg₀ : g₀.Monic) (hh₀ : h₀.Monic) (hcop : IsCoprime g₀ h₀)
    (hgr : g.map (residue R) = g₀) (hhr : h.map (residue R) = h₀)
    {w : Polynomial R} (hw : w.degree < (g₀.natDegree + h₀.natDegree : ℕ)) :
    ∃ u v : Polynomial R, u.degree < (g₀.natDegree : ℕ) ∧ v.degree < (h₀.natDegree : ℕ) ∧
      w - (h * u + g * v) ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R)
proof:
:= by
  have hwmap : (w.map (residue R)).degree < (g₀.natDegree + h₀.natDegree : ℕ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_map_le) hw
  obtain ⟨u₀, v₀, hu₀, hv₀, hkey⟩ := exists_solve_field hg₀ hh₀ hcop hwmap
  obtain ⟨u, humap, hudeg⟩ := Polynomial.exists_degree_eq_of_mem_lifts
    (Polynomial.mem_lifts_of_surjective (residue_surjective (R := R)) u₀)
  obtain ⟨v, hvmap, hvdeg⟩ := Polynomial.exists_degree_eq_of_mem_lifts
    (Polynomial.mem_lifts_of_surjective (residue_surjective (R := R)) v₀)
  refine ⟨u, v, hudeg ▸ hu₀, hvdeg ▸ hv₀, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_residue_eq_zero_iff, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul,
    Polynomial.map_mul, hgr, hhr, humap, hvmap, sub_eq_zero]
  exact hkey

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_solve_step
statement:
private theorem exists_solve_step {g h : Polynomial R} {g₀ h₀ : Polynomial (ResidueField R)}
    (hg₀ : g₀.Monic) (hh₀ : h₀.Monic) (hcop : IsCoprime g₀ h₀)
    (hgr : g.map (residue R) = g₀) (hhr : h.map (residue R) = h₀)
    (j : ℕ) {e : Polynomial R} (he : e ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ j))
    (hdeg : e.degree < (g₀.natDegree + h₀.natDegree : ℕ)) :
    ∃ u v : Polynomial R, u.degree < (g₀.natDegree : ℕ) ∧ v.degree < (h₀.natDegree : ℕ) ∧
      u ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ j) ∧ v ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ j) ∧
      e - (h * u + g * v) ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m := g₀.natDegree with hm
  set l := h₀.natDegree with hl
  have key : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ uv : Polynomial R × Polynomial R,
      uv.1.degree < (m : WithBot ℕ) ∧ uv.2.degree < (l : WithBot ℕ) ∧
      (i < m + l → (X : Polynomial R) ^ i - (h * uv.1 + g * uv.2)
        ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R)) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < m + l
    · obtain ⟨u, v, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_solve_mod hg₀ hh₀ hcop hgr hhr
        (w := (X : Polynomial R) ^ i) (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast hi)
      exact ⟨(u, v), h1, h2, fun _ => h3⟩
    · exact ⟨(0, 0), by simp, by simp, fun hc => absurd hc hi⟩
  choose UV hU hV hr using key
  set u : Polynomial R := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + l), Polynomial.C (e.coeff i) * (UV i).1 with hu
  set v : Polynomial R := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + l), Polynomial.C (e.coeff i) * (UV i).2 with hv
  have hudeg : u.degree < (m : WithBot ℕ) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sum_le _ _) ?_
    rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (by simp : (⊥ : WithBot ℕ) < (m : WithBot ℕ))]
    exact fun i _ => lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_C_mul_le_degree _ _) (hU i)
  have hvdeg : v.degree < (l : WithBot ℕ) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sum_le _ _) ?_
    rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (by simp : (⊥ : WithBot ℕ) < (l : WithBot ℕ))]
    exact fun i _ => lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_C_mul_le_degree _ _) (hV i)
  refine ⟨u, v, hudeg, hvdeg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
      Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (C_mem_coeffIdeal ((mem_coeffIdeal.mp he) i))
  · exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
      Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (C_mem_coeffIdeal ((mem_coeffIdeal.mp he) i))
  · have hexp : e - (h * u + g * v)
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + l), Polynomial.C (e.coeff i) *
            ((X : Polynomial R) ^ i - (h * (UV i).1 + g * (UV i).2)) := by
      rw [sum_C_mul_solve_expand (fun i => e.coeff i) (fun i => (UV i).1) (fun i => (UV i).2)
        g h (m + l), hu, hv]
      congr 1
      exact eq_sum_range_of_degree_lt hdeg
    rw [hexp]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_
    have := mul_mem_coeffIdeal_mul (C_mem_coeffIdeal ((mem_coeffIdeal.mp he) i))
      (hr i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
    rwa [← pow_succ] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_adicLimit_of_degree_lt
statement:
private theorem exists_adicLimit_of_degree_lt (d : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Polynomial R)
    (hdeg : ∀ k, (p k).degree < (d : WithBot ℕ))
    (hstep : ∀ k, p (k + 1) - p k ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ k)) :
    ∃ P : Polynomial R, P.degree < (d : WithBot ℕ) ∧
      ∀ k, P - p k ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hCauchy : ∀ (i a b : ℕ), a ≤ b →
      (p a).coeff i - (p b).coeff i ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a := by
    intro i a b hab
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hab
    clear hab
    induction c with
    | zero => simp
    | succ c ih =>
      have h2 : (p (a + c)).coeff i - (p (a + c + 1)).coeff i ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a :=
        Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_add_right a c)
          (by simpa using neg_mem ((mem_coeffIdeal.mp (hstep (a + c))) i))
      rw [show (p a).coeff i - (p (a + (c + 1))).coeff i
          = ((p a).coeff i - (p (a + c)).coeff i)
            + ((p (a + c)).coeff i - (p (a + c + 1)).coeff i) by rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; ring]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ ih h2
  have hprec : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ L : R,
      ∀ k, (p k).coeff i ≡ L [SMOD (maximalIdeal R ^ k • ⊤ : Ideal R)] := by
    refine fun i => IsPrecomplete.prec' (fun k => (p k).coeff i) fun hab => ?_
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact hCauchy i _ _ hab
  choose L hL using hprec
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, Polynomial.C (L i) * X ^ i,
    degree_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow_lt L d, ?_⟩
  refine fun k => mem_coeffIdeal.2 fun i => ?_
  rw [coeff_sub, coeff_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow]
  by_cases hi : i < d
  · have := hL i k
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
    simpa [hi] using neg_mem this
  · simp [hi, coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (hdeg k) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_not_lt hi))]

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_monic_lift
statement:
private theorem exists_monic_lift {p₀ : Polynomial (ResidueField R)} (hp₀ : p₀.Monic) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial R, p.Monic ∧ p.map (residue R) = p₀ ∧ p.natDegree = p₀.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hmap, hdeg, hmonic⟩ := Polynomial.lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic
    (Polynomial.mem_lifts_of_surjective (residue_surjective (R := R)) p₀) hp₀
  exact ⟨p, hmonic, hmap, natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq hdeg⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.natDegree_eq_of_map_eq
statement:
private theorem natDegree_eq_of_map_eq {p : Polynomial R} {p₀ : Polynomial (ResidueField R)}
    (hp : p.Monic) (hmap : p.map (residue R) = p₀) : p.natDegree = p₀.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hmap, hp.natDegree_map]

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.degree_sub_lt_of_monic_of_natDegree_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hdd : p.degree = q.degree := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp.ne_zero, degree_eq_natDegree hq.ne_zero, hd]
  have := degree_sub_lt_left hdd hp.ne_zero (by rw [hp.leadingCoeff, hq.leadingCoeff])
  rwa [degree_eq_natDegree hp.ne_zero] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_hensel_newton_step
statement:
private theorem exists_hensel_newton_step {f : Polynomial R} (hf : f.Monic)
    {g₀ h₀ : Polynomial (ResidueField R)} (hg₀ : g₀.Monic) (hh₀ : h₀.Monic)
    (hcop : IsCoprime g₀ h₀) (hfgh : f.map (residue R) = g₀ * h₀) {G₁ H₁ : Polynomial R}
    (hG₁map : G₁.map (residue R) = g₀) (hH₁map : H₁.map (residue R) = h₀) (k : ℕ)
    {x : Polynomial R × Polynomial R}
    (hx : x.1.Monic ∧ x.2.Monic ∧ x.1.map (residue R) = g₀ ∧ x.2.map (residue R) = h₀ ∧
      f - x.1 * x.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1))) :
    ∃ y : Polynomial R × Polynomial R,
      (y.1.Monic ∧ y.2.Monic ∧ y.1.map (residue R) = g₀ ∧ y.2.map (residue R) = h₀ ∧
        f - y.1 * y.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1 + 1))) ∧
      y.1 - x.1 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1)) ∧
      y.2 - x.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx1, hx3, hx5, hx6, hx7⟩ := hx
  
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = g₀.natDegree + h₀.natDegree := by
    rw [← hf.natDegree_map (residue R), hfgh, hg₀.natDegree_mul hh₀]
  have hdeglt : (f - x.1 * x.2).degree < ((g₀.natDegree + h₀.natDegree : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    have := degree_sub_lt_of_monic_of_natDegree_eq hf (hx1.mul hx3) (by
      rw [hfdeg, hx1.natDegree_mul hx3, natDegree_eq_of_map_eq hx1 hx5,
        natDegree_eq_of_map_eq hx3 hx6])
    rwa [hfdeg] at this
  obtain ⟨δG, δH, hδGdeg, hδHdeg, hδGmem, hδHmem, herr⟩ :=
    exists_solve_step hg₀ hh₀ hcop hG₁map hH₁map (k + 1) hx7 hdeglt
  have hmle : maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1) ≤ maximalIdeal R := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega)
  have hδGm : δG ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R) := coeffIdeal_mono hmle hδGmem
  have hδHm : δH ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R) := coeffIdeal_mono hmle hδHmem
  have hmul : ∀ {a b : Polynomial R}, a ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1)) →
      b ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R) → a * b ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1 + 1)) :=
    fun ha hb => by have := mul_mem_coeffIdeal_mul ha hb; rwa [← pow_succ] at this
  refine ⟨(x.1 + δG, x.2 + δH), ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hx1.add_of_left (by
      rwa [degree_eq_natDegree hx1.ne_zero, natDegree_eq_of_map_eq hx1 hx5])
  · exact hx3.add_of_left (by
      rwa [degree_eq_natDegree hx3.ne_zero, natDegree_eq_of_map_eq hx3 hx6])
  · simp [map_residue_eq_zero_iff.mpr hδGm, hx5]
  · simp [map_residue_eq_zero_iff.mpr hδHm, hx6]
  · 
    have hH₁x : H₁ - x.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R) :=
      sub_mem_coeffIdeal_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr (by rw [hH₁map, hx6])
    have hG₁x : G₁ - x.1 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R) :=
      sub_mem_coeffIdeal_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr (by rw [hG₁map, hx5])
    rw [show f - (x.1 + δG) * (x.2 + δH) = ((f - x.1 * x.2) - (H₁ * δG + G₁ * δH))
      + δG * (H₁ - x.2) + δH * (G₁ - x.1) - δG * δH by ring]
    exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.add_mem _ herr (hmul hδGmem hH₁x))
      (hmul hδHmem hG₁x)) (hmul hδGmem hδHm)
  · simpa using hδGmem
  · simpa using hδHmem

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_monic_limit
statement:
private theorem exists_monic_limit {p₀ : Polynomial (ResidueField R)} (B : ℕ → Polynomial R)
    (hB : ∀ k, (B k).Monic) (hBmap : ∀ k, (B k).map (residue R) = p₀)
    (hstep : ∀ k, B (k + 1) - B k ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ k)) :
    ∃ G : Polynomial R, G.Monic ∧ G.map (residue R) = p₀ ∧ G.natDegree = p₀.natDegree ∧
      ∀ k, G - B k ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  set n := p₀.natDegree
  have htail : ∀ k, (B k - X ^ n).degree < (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
    intro k
    have h2 : (B k).natDegree = n := natDegree_eq_of_map_eq (hB k) (hBmap k)
    have := degree_sub_lt_of_monic_of_natDegree_eq (hB k) (monic_X_pow (R := R) n)
      (by rw [h2, natDegree_X_pow])
    rwa [h2] at this
  obtain ⟨T, hTdeg, hTlim⟩ := exists_adicLimit_of_degree_lt n (fun k => B k - X ^ n) htail
    (by intro k; simpa using hstep k)
  have hlt : T.degree < (X ^ n : Polynomial R).degree := by rwa [degree_X_pow]
  have hlim : ∀ k, X ^ n + T - B k ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ k) := fun k => by
    rw [show X ^ n + T - B k = T - (B k - X ^ n) by ring]
    exact hTlim k
  refine ⟨X ^ n + T, (monic_X_pow _).add_of_left hlt, ?_, natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some ?_, hlim⟩
  · exact (sub_mem_coeffIdeal_maximalIdeal_iff.1 (by simpa using hlim 1)).trans (hBmap 1)
  · rw [degree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt hlt, degree_X_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.Hensel.exists_monic_factorization
statement:
private theorem exists_monic_factorization {f : Polynomial R} (hf : f.Monic)
    {g₀ h₀ : Polynomial (ResidueField R)} (hg₀ : g₀.Monic) (hh₀ : h₀.Monic)
    (hcop : IsCoprime g₀ h₀) (hfgh : f.map (residue R) = g₀ * h₀) :
    ∃ g h : Polynomial R, g.Monic ∧ h.Monic ∧ f = g * h ∧
      g.map (residue R) = g₀ ∧ h.map (residue R) = h₀ ∧
      g.natDegree = g₀.natDegree ∧ h.natDegree = h₀.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  obtain ⟨G₁, hG₁mon, hG₁map, -⟩ := exists_monic_lift (R := R) hg₀
  obtain ⟨H₁, hH₁mon, hH₁map, -⟩ := exists_monic_lift (R := R) hh₀
  have hbase : f - G₁ * H₁ ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (0 + 1)) := by
    rw [zero_add, pow_one, ← map_residue_eq_zero_iff, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul,
      hG₁map, hH₁map, hfgh, sub_self]
  
  have step : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Polynomial R × Polynomial R),
      ∃ y : Polynomial R × Polynomial R,
        (x.1.Monic ∧ x.2.Monic ∧ x.1.map (residue R) = g₀ ∧ x.2.map (residue R) = h₀ ∧
            f - x.1 * x.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1))) →
          (y.1.Monic ∧ y.2.Monic ∧ y.1.map (residue R) = g₀ ∧ y.2.map (residue R) = h₀ ∧
            f - y.1 * y.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1 + 1))) ∧
          y.1 - x.1 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1)) ∧
          y.2 - x.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1)) := by
    intro k x
    by_cases hx : x.1.Monic ∧ x.2.Monic ∧ x.1.map (residue R) = g₀ ∧
        x.2.map (residue R) = h₀ ∧ f - x.1 * x.2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1))
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
        exists_hensel_newton_step hf hg₀ hh₀ hcop hfgh hG₁map hH₁map k hx
      exact ⟨y, fun _ => hy⟩
    · exact ⟨x, fun hc => absurd hc hx⟩
  choose next hnext using step
  obtain ⟨A, hA0, hAsucc⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ → Polynomial R × Polynomial R,
      A 0 = (G₁, H₁) ∧ ∀ k, A (k + 1) = next k (A k) :=
    ⟨fun k => Nat.rec (G₁, H₁) (fun j acc => next j acc) k, rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hInvA : ∀ k, (A k).1.Monic ∧ (A k).2.Monic ∧ (A k).1.map (residue R) = g₀ ∧
      (A k).2.map (residue R) = h₀ ∧
      f - (A k).1 * (A k).2 ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ (k + 1)) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rw [hA0]; exact ⟨hG₁mon, hH₁mon, hG₁map, hH₁map, hbase⟩
    | succ k ih => rw [hAsucc k]; exact (hnext k (A k) ih).1
  
  obtain ⟨G, hGmon, hGmap, hGdeg, hGlim⟩ := exists_monic_limit (fun k => (A k).1)
    (fun k => (hInvA k).1) (fun k => (hInvA k).2.2.1) fun k =>
      coeffIdeal_mono (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ k))
        (hAsucc k ▸ (hnext k (A k) (hInvA k)).2.1)
  obtain ⟨H, hHmon, hHmap, hHdeg, hHlim⟩ := exists_monic_limit (fun k => (A k).2)
    (fun k => (hInvA k).2.1) (fun k => (hInvA k).2.2.2.1) fun k =>
      coeffIdeal_mono (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ k))
        (hAsucc k ▸ (hnext k (A k) (hInvA k)).2.2)
  have hzero : f - G * H = 0 := by
    have hall : ∀ k, f - G * H ∈ coeffIdeal (maximalIdeal R ^ k) := by
      intro k
      rw [show f - G * H
          = (f - (A k).1 * (A k).2) - (G - (A k).1) * H - (A k).1 * (H - (A k).2) by ring]
      exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.sub_mem _
        (coeffIdeal_mono (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ k)) (hInvA k).2.2.2.2)
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hGlim k))) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hHlim k))
    ext i
    rw [coeff_zero]
    refine IsHausdorff.haus' (I := maximalIdeal R) ((f - G * H).coeff i) fun n => ?_
    rw [SModEq.zero, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact (mem_coeffIdeal.mp (hall n)) i
  exact ⟨G, H, hGmon, hHmon, sub_eq_zero.mp hzero, hGmap, hHmap, hGdeg, hHdeg⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.hensel_pair_exists
statement:
theorem hensel_pair_exists (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (F : Polynomial O) (hF : F.Monic)
    (g h : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hg : g.Monic) (hh : h.Monic)
    (hc : IsCoprime g h) (hred : F.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = g * h) :
    ∃ G H : Polynomial O, G.Monic ∧ H.Monic ∧ F=G*H ∧ G.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)=g ∧
      H.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)=h ∧ G.natDegree=g.natDegree ∧ H.natDegree=h.natDegree
proof:
:=
  Hensel.exists_monic_factorization hF hg hh hc hred

name: SurfaceBlowup.hensel_family_exists
statement:
theorem hensel_family_exists (O ι : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Fintype ι] (F : Polynomial O) (hF : F.Monic)
    (g : ι → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hg : ∀ i, (g i).Monic)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) (hred : F.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = ∏ i, g i) :
    ∃ G : ι→Polynomial O, (∀ i, (G i).Monic) ∧ F=∏ i, G i ∧
      (∀ i, (G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O)=g i) ∧ (∀ i, (G i).natDegree=(g i).natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∀ F : Polynomial O, F.Monic →
      F.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = ∏ i ∈ s, g i →
      ∃ G : ι → Polynomial O, (∀ i ∈ s, (G i).Monic) ∧ F = ∏ i ∈ s, G i ∧
        (∀ i ∈ s, (G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = g i) ∧
        (∀ i ∈ s, (G i).natDegree = (g i).natDegree) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro F hF hr
      refine ⟨fun _ => 1, by simp, ?_, by simp, by simp⟩
      rw [Finset.prod_empty] at hr
      simpa using hF.eq_one_of_map_eq_one (IsLocalRing.residue O) hr
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      intro F hF hr
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha] at hr
      have hcop : IsCoprime (g a) (∏ i ∈ s, g i) :=
        IsCoprime.prod_right (fun i hi => hc a i (fun (h : a = i) => ha (h ▸ hi)))
      obtain ⟨G0, H, hG0, hH, hFe, hG0r, hHr, hG0d, hHd⟩ :=
        hensel_pair_exists O F hF (g a) (∏ i ∈ s, g i) (hg a)
          (Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hg i)) hcop hr
      obtain ⟨G', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ih H hH hHr
      have hs : ∏ i ∈ s, (if i = a then G0 else G' i) = ∏ i ∈ s, G' i :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => if_neg (fun (h : i = a) => ha (h ▸ hi)))
      refine ⟨fun i => if i = a then G0 else G' i, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      rotate_left
      · rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, hs, if_pos rfl, hFe, h2]
      all_goals
        intro i hi
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
        · simpa
        · simp [show i ≠ a from fun h => ha (h ▸ hi), *]
  obtain ⟨G, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := key Finset.univ F hF hred
  exact ⟨G, fun i => h1 i (Finset.mem_univ i), h2, fun i => h3 i (Finset.mem_univ i),
    fun i => h4 i (Finset.mem_univ i)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.isCoprime_of_isCoprime_map_residue
statement:
theorem isCoprime_of_isCoprime_map_residue {O : Type*} [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    {A B : Polynomial O} (hA : A.Monic) (hB : B.Monic)
    (h : IsCoprime (A.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) (B.map (IsLocalRing.residue O))) :
    IsCoprime A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime hA]
  have h' := (Polynomial.isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime (hA.map (IsLocalRing.residue O))).2 h
  rw [hA.natDegree_map, hB.natDegree_map, Polynomial.resultant_map_map] at h'
  exact (isUnit_map_iff (IsLocalRing.residue O) _).1 h'

name: SurfaceBlowup.hensel_pair_unique
statement:
theorem hensel_pair_unique (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    (G H G₁ H₁ : Polynomial O) (hG : G.Monic) (hH : H.Monic) (hG₁ : G₁.Monic) (hH₁ : H₁.Monic)
    (hg : G.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = G₁.map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
    (hh : H.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = H₁.map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
    (hc : IsCoprime (G.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) (H.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)))
    (hp : G * H = G₁ * H₁) :
    G=G₁ ∧ H=H₁
proof:
:= by
  have deg : ∀ A B : Polynomial O, A.Monic → B.Monic →
      A.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = B.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) →
        A.natDegree = B.natDegree := by
    intro A B hA hB h
    rw [← hA.natDegree_map (IsLocalRing.residue O), ← hB.natDegree_map (IsLocalRing.residue O), h]
  have c1 : IsCoprime G H₁ := isCoprime_of_isCoprime_map_residue hG hH₁ (by rw [← hh]; exact hc)
  have c2 : IsCoprime G₁ H := isCoprime_of_isCoprime_map_residue hG₁ hH (by rw [← hg]; exact hc)
  have d1 : G ∣ G₁ := c1.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ⟨H, hp.symm⟩
  have d2 : H ∣ H₁ := c2.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left ⟨G, by rw [hp.symm, mul_comm]⟩
  exact ⟨(Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hG hG₁ d1 (deg _ _ hG₁ hG hg.symm).le).symm,
    (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hH hH₁ d2 (deg _ _ hH₁ hH hh.symm).le).symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.isAdicComplete_pi
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_pi (O : Type) [CommRing O] (I : Ideal O) (ι : Type) [Finite ι]
    (M : ι → Type) [∀ j, AddCommGroup (M j)] [∀ j, Module O (M j)] [∀ j, IsAdicComplete I (M j)] :
    IsAdicComplete I (∀ j, M j)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  classical
  have mem : ∀ (J : Ideal O) (x : ∀ j, M j),
      x ∈ J • (⊤ : Submodule O (∀ j, M j)) ↔ ∀ j, x j ∈ J • (⊤ : Submodule O (M j)) := by
    intro J x
    constructor
    · intro hx j
      have h1 : LinearMap.proj (R := O) (φ := M) j x ∈
          (J • (⊤ : Submodule O (∀ j, M j))).map (LinearMap.proj j) :=
        Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx
      rw [Submodule.map_smul''] at h1
      exact Submodule.smul_mono le_rfl le_top h1
    · intro hx
      rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single x]
      refine Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun j _ => ?_)
      have h1 : LinearMap.single O M j (x j) ∈
          (J • (⊤ : Submodule O (M j))).map (LinearMap.single O M j) :=
        Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (hx j)
      rw [Submodule.map_smul''] at h1
      exact Submodule.smul_mono le_rfl le_top h1
  have H1 : IsHausdorff I (∀ j, M j) := by
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_⟩
    funext j
    refine IsHausdorff.haus (IsAdicComplete.toIsHausdorff (I := I)) (x j) (fun n => ?_)
    have := (mem _ _).1 (SModEq.sub_mem.1 (hx n)) j
    simpa [SModEq.sub_mem] using this
  have H2 : IsPrecomplete I (∀ j, M j) := by
    refine ⟨fun {f} hf => ?_⟩
    have hj : ∀ j, ∃ L : M j, ∀ n, f n j ≡ L [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O (M j))] := by
      intro j
      refine IsPrecomplete.prec (IsAdicComplete.toIsPrecomplete (I := I)) (fun {m n} hmn => ?_)
      have := (mem _ _).1 (SModEq.sub_mem.1 (hf hmn)) j
      simpa [SModEq.sub_mem] using this
    choose L hL using hj
    refine ⟨L, fun n => ?_⟩
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, mem]
    intro j
    simpa [SModEq.sub_mem] using hL j n
  exact { toIsHausdorff := H1, toIsPrecomplete := H2 }

name: SurfaceBlowup.linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence
statement:
theorem linear_map_preserves_adic_congruence (O M N : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module O M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module O N] (I : Ideal O) (L : M →ₗ[O] N) (j : ℕ) (x y : M)
    (h : adicCongr I j x y) :
    adicCongr I j (L x) (L y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold adicCongr at h ⊢
  rw [← map_sub]
  exact Submodule.smul_top_le_comap_smul_top (I ^ j) L h

name: SurfaceBlowup.maximal_ideal_power_kills
statement:
theorem maximal_ideal_power_kills (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] (N : ℕ) (hN : Module.length R M = N) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)^N • (⊤ : Submodule R M)=⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hNoeth, hArt⟩ := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
    (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp (by rw [hN]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top N))
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → m ^ k • (⊤ : Submodule R M) = ⊥ ∨
      Order.height (m ^ k • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) + k ≤ N := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      right
      rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, Submodule.top_smul, ← Module.length_eq_height, hN]
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      rcases ih (by omega) with h | h
      · left
        rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, h, Submodule.smul_bot]
      · by_cases heq : m ^ (k+1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M) = m ^ k • ⊤
        · left
          apply Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot m _ (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
          · conv_lhs => rw [pow_succ', mul_smul]
            rw [heq]
          · exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _
        · right
          have hlt : m ^ (k+1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < m ^ k • ⊤ := by
            refine lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ heq
            rw [pow_succ', mul_smul]
            exact Submodule.smul_le_right
          have h2 := Order.height_strictMono hlt (Submodule.height_lt_top _)
          have h3 : Order.height (m ^ (k+1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) + 1 ≤
              Order.height (m ^ k • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) := Order.add_one_le_of_lt h2
          calc Order.height (m ^ (k+1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) + ((k+1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
              = (Order.height (m ^ (k+1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) + 1) + k := by
                push_cast; ring
            _ ≤ Order.height (m ^ k • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) + k := by gcongr
            _ ≤ N := h
  rcases key N le_rfl with h | h
  · exact h
  · have : Order.height (m ^ N • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) = 0 := by
      have hlt := Submodule.height_lt_top (m ^ N • (⊤ : Submodule R M))
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hlt.ne
      rw [← ha] at h ⊢
      norm_cast at h ⊢
      omega
    rw [Order.height_eq_zero] at this
    exact this.eq_bot

name: SurfaceBlowup.linear_image_bound_from_cokernel_length
statement:
theorem linear_image_bound_from_cokernel_length (O V W : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module O V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module O W] (pi : O)
    (hpi : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O = Ideal.span {pi}) (D : V →ₗ[O] W) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : Module.length O (W ⧸ D.range) = k) :
    ∀ w : W, (pi^k) • w ∈ D.range
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  have h := maximal_ideal_power_kills O (W ⧸ D.range) k hk
  have hmem : pi ^ k ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ k := by
    rw [hpi]
    exact Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self pi) k
  have h2 : (pi ^ k) • (Submodule.Quotient.mk w : W ⧸ D.range) ∈
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ k • (⊤ : Submodule O (W ⧸ D.range)) :=
    Submodule.smul_mem_smul hmem Submodule.mem_top
  rw [h, Submodule.mem_bot, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h2
  exact h2

name: SurfaceBlowup.measurableEmbedding_pi
statement:
theorem measurableEmbedding_pi (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (X Y : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, MeasurableSpace (X j)] [∀ j, MeasurableSpace (Y j)] (f : ∀ j, X j → Y j)
    (hf : ∀ j, MeasurableEmbedding (f j)) :
    MeasurableEmbedding (fun (x : ∀ j, X j) (j : ι) => f j (x j))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun (x : ∀ j, X j) (j : ι) => f j (x j)) := by
    intro a b h
    funext j
    exact (hf j).injective (congrFun h j)
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun (x : ∀ j, X j) (j : ι) => f j (x j)) :=
    measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => (hf j).measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply j)
  refine ⟨hinj, hmeas, ?_⟩
  intro S hS
  by_cases hne : Nonempty (∀ j, X j)
  · obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hne
    choose r hr hrf using fun j => (hf j).exists_measurable_extend (g := id)
      (hne := fun _ => ⟨x₀ j⟩) measurable_id
    have hrm : Measurable (fun (y : ∀ j, Y j) (j : ι) => r j (y j)) :=
      measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => (hr j).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)
    have : (fun (x : ∀ j, X j) (j : ι) => f j (x j)) '' S =
        (Set.pi Set.univ fun j => Set.range (f j)) ∩ (fun y j => r j (y j)) ⁻¹' S := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨fun j _ => ⟨x j, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        have : (fun j => r j (f j (x j))) = x := funext fun j => congrFun (hrf j) (x j)
        simpa [this] using hx
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        choose x hx using fun j => h1 j (Set.mem_univ j)
        have : (fun j => r j (y j)) = x := funext fun j => by
          rw [← hx j]; exact congrFun (hrf j) (x j)
        refine ⟨x, ?_, funext hx⟩
        rw [← this]; exact h2
    rw [this]
    refine MeasurableSet.inter (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun j => ?_) (hrm hS)
    rw [← Set.image_univ]
    exact (hf j).measurableSet_image.2 MeasurableSet.univ
  · rw [not_nonempty_iff] at hne
    have : S = ∅ := Set.eq_empty_of_isEmpty S
    rw [this]; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_residue_polynomial_count
statement:
theorem monic_residue_polynomial_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {F : Polynomial k // F.Monic ∧ F.natDegree=n}=(Nat.card k)^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr ((Polynomial.monicEquivDegreeLT n).trans
    (Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv k n).toEquiv), Nat.card_fun]
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalizing_factor_is_unit
statement:
theorem normalizing_factor_is_unit (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [IsLocalRing R] (pi : O) (hpi : algebraMap O R pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (v : R) :
    IsUnit (1 + pi • v)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : -(pi • v) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    neg_mem (by rw [Algebra.smul_def]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hpi)
  simpa using IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits _ hm

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_algebraMap_mem_jacobson_bot
statement:
theorem pi_algebraMap_mem_jacobson_bot (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type) (C : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (C j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (C j)] [∀ j, IsLocalRing (C j)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : ∀ j, algebraMap O (C j) pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (C j)) (e : ∀ j, C j)
    (he : ∀ j, Function.Injective (fun z : C j => e j * z)) :
    algebraMap O (∀ j, C j) pi ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal (∀ j, C j)) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun z : ∀ j, C j => e * z)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Ideal.mem_jacobson_bot.2 fun y => Pi.isUnit_iff.2 fun j => ?_,
    fun z z' h => funext fun j => he j (congrFun h j)⟩
  simpa [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm, add_comm] using
    normalizing_factor_is_unit O (C j) pi (hpi j) (y j)

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_ideal_mem_iff_map_eval
statement:
theorem pi_ideal_mem_iff_map_eval (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (R : ι → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (R j)]
    (I : Ideal (∀ j, R j)) :
    (∀ x : ∀ j, R j, x ∈ I ↔ ∀ j, x j ∈ I.map (Pi.evalRingHom R j)) ∧ ∀ J : Ideal (∀ j, R j),
      (∀ j, I.map (Pi.evalRingHom R j) = J.map (Pi.evalRingHom R j)) → I = J
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  classical
  have key : ∀ I : Ideal (∀ j, R j), ∀ x : ∀ j, R j,
      x ∈ I ↔ ∀ j, x j ∈ I.map (Pi.evalRingHom R j) := by
    refine fun I x => ⟨fun hx j => Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Pi.evalRingHom R j) hx, fun h => ?_⟩
    choose y hy e using fun j => (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective (Pi.evalRingHom R j)
      (Function.surjective_eval j)).1 (h j)
    rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single x]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => ?_
    have : Pi.single j (x j) = Pi.single j (1 : R j) * y j := by
      funext k
      by_cases hk : k = j
      · subst hk; simpa using (e k).symm
      · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk]
    exact this ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hy j)
  refine ⟨key I, fun J h => ?_⟩
  ext x
  rw [key I, key J]
  simp [h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_quotient_linearEquiv_of_mem_iff
statement:
private theorem pi_quotient_linearEquiv_of_mem_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type)
    (C : ι → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (C j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (C j)] (I : Ideal (∀ j, C j))
    (J : ∀ j, Ideal (C j))
    (hI : ∀ x : ∀ j, C j, x ∈ I ↔ ∀ j, x j ∈ J j) :
    ∃ ψ : ((∀ j, C j) ⧸ I) ≃ₗ[O] (∀ j, C j ⧸ J j), ∀ x : ∀ j, C j,
      ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk (J j) (x j)
proof:
:= by
  let Θ : (∀ j, C j) →ₐ[O] ∀ j, C j ⧸ J j :=
    AlgHom.pi (fun j => (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ O (J j)).comp (Pi.evalAlgHom O C j))
  have hΘ : ∀ x, Θ x = fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk (J j) (x j) := fun x => rfl
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective Θ := fun y =>
    ⟨fun j => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (y j)).choose,
      funext fun j => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (y j)).choose_spec⟩
  have hker : I = RingHom.ker Θ := by
    ext x
    rw [hI, RingHom.mem_ker, hΘ, funext_iff]
    simp [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact ⟨((Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq O hker).trans
    (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hsurj)).toLinearEquiv, fun x => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_quotient_span_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem pi_quotient_span_linearEquiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type) (C : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (C j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (C j)] (g e : ∀ j, C j) :
    (∃ ψ : ((∀ j, C j) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ≃ₗ[O] (∀ j, C j ⧸ Ideal.span {g j}),
      ∀ x : ∀ j, C j, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) x) =
        fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g j}) (x j)) ∧
      ∃ ψ' : ((∀ j, C j) ⧸ (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {e})) ≃ₗ[O]
        (∀ j, C j ⧸ (Ideal.span {g j} ⊔ Ideal.span {e j})),
      ∀ x : ∀ j, C j, ψ' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {e}) x) =
      fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g j} ⊔ Ideal.span {e j}) (x j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨pi_quotient_linearEquiv_of_mem_iff O ι C _ _ ?_,
    pi_quotient_linearEquiv_of_mem_iff O ι C _ _ ?_⟩
  · intro x
    simp only [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩ j; exact ⟨a j, rfl⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun j => Classical.choose (h j), funext fun j => Classical.choose_spec (h j)⟩
  · intro x
    simp only [Submodule.mem_sup, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, _, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ j
      exact ⟨_, ⟨a j, rfl⟩, _, ⟨b j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro h
      choose y hy z hz hyz using h
      choose a ha using hy
      choose b hb using hz
      refine ⟨fun j => a j * g j, ⟨a, rfl⟩, fun j => b j * e j, ⟨b, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      funext j
      simp [ha, hb, hyz]

name: SurfaceBlowup.power_coordinates_transport
statement:
