theorem power_coordinates_transport (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hm : Φ.Monic)
    [TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hτ : ‹TopologicalSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedTopology O Φ hm)
    [MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hmeas : ‹MeasurableSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ)› = unramifiedMeasurableSpace O Φ hm) :
    IsTopologicalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧ CompactSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧ T2Space (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      SecondCountableTopology (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧ BorelSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      Continuous (powerCoordinates O Φ hm) ∧ Continuous (powerCoordinates O Φ hm).symm ∧
      Measurable (powerCoordinates O Φ hm) ∧ Measurable (powerCoordinates O Φ hm).symm
proof:
:= by
  set e := powerCoordinates O Φ hm with he
  have hind : Topology.IsInducing e := ⟨by rw [hτ]; rfl⟩
  let h : AdjoinRoot Φ ≃ₜ (Fin Φ.natDegree → O) := e.toEquiv.toHomeomorphOfIsInducing hind
  have hc : Continuous e := h.continuous
  have hcs : Continuous e.symm := h.symm.continuous
  have hborel : BorelSpace (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [hmeas]; unfold unramifiedMeasurableSpace
    rw [BorelSpace.measurable_eq (α := Fin Φ.natDegree → O), ← borel_comap, hτ]
    rfl
  have hadd : IsTopologicalAddGroup (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    subst hτ
    exact topologicalAddGroup_induced e.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom
  have hmul : ContinuousMul (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [hind.continuous_iff]
    let b := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hm).basis
    have key : ∀ x y : AdjoinRoot Φ, e (x * y) =
        ∑ j, ∑ l, (e x j * e y l) • e (b j * b l) := by
      intro x y
      have hx : x = ∑ j, e x j • b j := (b.sum_equivFun x).symm
      have hy : y = ∑ j, e y j • b j := (b.sum_equivFun y).symm
      conv_lhs => rw [hx, hy]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm, map_sum, map_smul]
    have : (fun p : AdjoinRoot Φ × AdjoinRoot Φ => e (p.1 * p.2)) =
        fun p => ∑ j, ∑ l, (e p.1 j * e p.2 l) • e (b j * b l) := by
      funext p; exact key p.1 p.2
    change Continuous (fun p : AdjoinRoot Φ × AdjoinRoot Φ => e (p.1 * p.2))
    rw [this]
    refine continuous_finsetSum _ fun j _ => continuous_finsetSum _ fun l _ => ?_
    exact (((continuous_apply j).comp (hc.comp continuous_fst)).mul
      ((continuous_apply l).comp (hc.comp continuous_snd))).smul continuous_const
  have := h.secondCountableTopology
  refine ⟨{ }, h.symm.compactSpace, h.symm.t2Space, h.secondCountableTopology, hborel,
    hc, hcs, h.measurable, h.symm.measurable⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.principal_generator_orbit_count
statement:
theorem principal_generator_orbit_count (B : Type) [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Finite B] (f : B)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {g : B // Ideal.span {g}=Ideal.span {f}} * Nat.card {a : B // a*f=0} =
      Nat.card Bˣ
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite B
  classical
  
  have hnu : ∀ a : B, a * f = 0 → IsUnit (1 + a) := by
    intro a ha
    have : -a ∈ nonunits B := by
      intro hu
      apply hf
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (IsUnit.neg_iff a).mp hu |>.exists_left_inv
      calc f = (v * a) * f := by rw [hv, one_mul]
        _ = 0 := by rw [mul_assoc, ha, mul_zero]
    simpa [sub_neg_eq_add] using IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits _ this
  let G := {g : B // Ideal.span {g}=Ideal.span {f}}
  let φ : Bˣ → G := fun u => ⟨u*f, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit u.isUnit f⟩
  have hsurj : ∀ g : G, ∃ u : Bˣ, φ u = g := by
    rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have h1 : g ∈ Ideal.span {f} := hg ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g
    have h2 : f ∈ Ideal.span {g} := hg ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self f
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h1
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h2
    have ha : IsUnit a := by
      by_contra hna
      have hba : b * a ∈ nonunits B := fun h => hna (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right h)
      have hu := IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits _ hba
      apply hf
      have : (1 - b * a) * f = 0 := by
        rw [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, hb, sub_self]
      exact (hu.mul_right_eq_zero).mp this
    exact ⟨ha.unit, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
  have hfib : ∀ g : G, Nat.card {u : Bˣ // φ u = g} = Nat.card {a : B // a*f=0} := by
    intro g
    obtain ⟨u₀, rfl⟩ := hsurj g
    apply Nat.card_congr
    refine
      { toFun := fun u => ⟨((u₀⁻¹ * u.1 : Bˣ) : B) - 1, ?_⟩
        invFun := fun a => ⟨u₀ * (hnu a.1 a.2).unit, ?_⟩
        left_inv := ?_
        right_inv := ?_ }
    · have hu := congrArg Subtype.val u.2
      simp only [φ] at hu
      rw [sub_mul, one_mul, Units.val_mul, mul_assoc, hu, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul,
        sub_self]
    · apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [φ, Units.val_mul, IsUnit.unit_spec]
      rw [mul_assoc, add_mul, a.2, one_mul, add_zero]
    · intro u
      apply Subtype.ext; apply Units.ext
      simp
    · intro a
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp
  have := Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv φ)
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma] at this
  simp only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at this
  rw [← this, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => hfib g), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    smul_eq_mul, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: SurfaceBlowup.product_coordinates_exist
statement:
theorem product_coordinates_exist (O : Type) [CommRing O] [MeasurableSpace O] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (Oj : ι → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (Oj j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (Oj j)] [∀ j, MeasurableSpace (Oj j)]
    (R : ι → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (R j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (R j)] [∀ j, Algebra (Oj j) (R j)]
    [∀ j, IsScalarTower O (Oj j) (R j)] (δ nn : ι → ℕ) (pc : ∀ j, Oj j ≃ₗ[O] (Fin (δ j) → O))
    (hpc : ∀ j, Measurable (pc j)) (hpc' : ∀ j, Measurable (pc j).symm) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ∑ j, δ j * nn j = n) (bc' : ∀ j, Fin (nn j) → R j) :
    ∃ (ρ : (Fin n → O) ≃ₗ[O] (∀ j, Fin (nn j) → Oj j)) (bc : Fin n → ∀ j, R j), Measurable ρ ∧
      Measurable ρ.symm ∧ ∀ (w : Fin n → O) (j : ι), coordinateLift bc w j =
      coordinateLift (bc' j) (ρ w j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Σ j : ι, Σ _ : Fin (nn j), Fin (δ j)) = n := by
    simp [Fintype.card_sigma, ← hn, mul_comm]
  let κ := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard
  let ρ : (Fin n → O) ≃ₗ[O] (∀ j, Fin (nn j) → Oj j) :=
    (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft O O κ).trans <|
      (LinearEquiv.piCurry O (fun _ _ => O)).trans <|
        (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun j => LinearEquiv.piCurry O (fun _ _ => O)).trans <|
          LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun j => LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun _ => (pc j).symm
  have hρ : ∀ w j i, ρ w j i = (pc j).symm (fun l => w (κ ⟨j, i, l⟩)) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hρs : ∀ v j i l, ρ.symm v (κ ⟨j, i, l⟩) = pc j (v j i) l := by
    intro v j i l
    simp [ρ, LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft_symm, LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft_apply]; rfl
  let bc : Fin n → ∀ j, R j := fun m =>
    (fun s : (Σ j : ι, Σ _ : Fin (nn j), Fin (δ j)) =>
      Pi.single s.1
        (algebraMap (Oj s.1) (R s.1) ((pc s.1).symm (Pi.single s.2.2 1)) * bc' s.1 s.2.1))
      (κ.symm m)
  refine ⟨ρ, bc, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro j
    rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro i
    have : (fun w => ρ w j i) = fun w => (pc j).symm (fun l => w (κ ⟨j, i, l⟩)) := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (hpc' j).comp (measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun l => measurable_pi_apply _)
  · rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro m
    obtain ⟨⟨j, i, l⟩, rfl⟩ := κ.surjective m
    simp only [hρs]
    exact (measurable_pi_apply l).comp
      ((hpc j).comp ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)))
  · intro w j
    have hbc : ∀ s, bc (κ s) = Pi.single s.1
        (algebraMap (Oj s.1) (R s.1) ((pc s.1).symm (Pi.single s.2.2 1)) * bc' s.1 s.2.1) := by
      intro s
      change (fun s : (Σ j : ι, Σ _ : Fin (nn j), Fin (δ j)) => Pi.single s.1
        (algebraMap (Oj s.1) (R s.1) ((pc s.1).symm (Pi.single s.2.2 1)) * bc' s.1 s.2.1))
          (κ.symm (κ s)) = _
      rw [κ.symm_apply_apply]
    have hθ : ∀ i, ρ w j i = ∑ l, w (κ ⟨j, i, l⟩) • (pc j).symm (Pi.single l 1) := by
      intro i
      simp_rw [hρ, ← map_smul, ← map_sum]
      congr 1
      ext l'
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    unfold coordinateLift
    rw [Finset.sum_apply, ← κ.sum_comp]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, hbc]
    rw [Fintype.sum_sigma, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [hθ, Finset.sum_smul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, mul_assoc]
    · intro j' _ hj'
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x _ => ?_
      rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hj'), smul_zero]
    · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.product_division_equiv
statement:
theorem product_division_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] (ι : Type) (Oj : ι → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (Oj j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (Oj j)] (R : ι → Type) [∀ j, CommRing (R j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra O (R j)] [∀ j, Algebra (Oj j) (R j)] [∀ j, IsScalarTower O (Oj j) (R j)]
    (nn : ι → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (ρ : (Fin n → O) ≃ₗ[O] (∀ j, Fin (nn j) → Oj j))
    (bc' : ∀ j, Fin (nn j) → R j) (bc : Fin n → ∀ j, R j)
    (hcompat : ∀ (w : Fin n → O) (j : ι), coordinateLift bc w j = coordinateLift (bc' j) (ρ w j))
    (g : ∀ j, R j) (E' : ∀ j, R j ≃ₗ[Oj j] ((Fin (nn j) → Oj j) × R j))
    (hE' : ∀ j w, (E' j).symm w = divisionMap (g j) (bc' j) w) :
    (letI : Module O (∀ j, R j) := Algebra.toModule;
      ∃ E : (∀ j, R j) ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × ∀ j, R j), ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Module O (∀ j, R j) := Algebra.toModule
  have hcl : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → ∀ j, R j) (z : Fin m → O) (j : ι),
      coordinateLift b z j = ∑ i, z i • b i j := by
    intro m b z j
    simp [coordinateLift, Finset.sum_apply]
  have hadd : ∀ (w w' : Fin n → O),
      coordinateLift bc (w + w') = coordinateLift bc w + coordinateLift bc w' := by
    intro w w'; funext j; simp [hcl, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hsm : ∀ (c : O) (w : Fin n → O), coordinateLift bc (c • w) = c • coordinateLift bc w := by
    intro c w; funext j; simp [hcl, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  let L : ((Fin n → O) × ∀ j, R j) →ₗ[O] ∀ j, R j :=
    { toFun := fun s => divisionMap g bc s
      map_add' := by
        intro a b
        simp only [divisionMap, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, hadd, mul_add]
        abel
      map_smul' := by
        intro c a
        simp only [divisionMap, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, hsm, RingHom.id_apply, smul_add,
          Algebra.mul_smul_comm] }
  have hL : ∀ s j, L s j = (E' j).symm (ρ s.1 j, s.2 j) := by
    intro s j
    rw [hE']
    change (divisionMap g bc s) j = _
    simp only [divisionMap, Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply, hcompat]
  have hinj : Function.Injective L := by
    intro a b h
    have h1 : ∀ j, (ρ a.1 j, a.2 j) = (ρ b.1 j, b.2 j) := fun j =>
      (E' j).symm.injective (by rw [← hL, ← hL, h])
    have h2 : ρ a.1 = ρ b.1 := funext fun j => congrArg Prod.fst (h1 j)
    have h3 : a.2 = b.2 := funext fun j => congrArg Prod.snd (h1 j)
    exact Prod.ext (ρ.injective h2) h3
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective L := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨(ρ.symm (fun j => (E' j (x j)).1), fun j => (E' j (x j)).2), ?_⟩
    funext j
    rw [hL]
    simp
  exact ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofBijective L ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩).symm, fun w => rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.quotient_mul_range_equiv
statement:
theorem quotient_mul_range_equiv (O C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing C] [Algebra O C] (I : Ideal C)
    (e : C) :
    ∃ φ : ((C ⧸ I) ⧸ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mulLeft O (Ideal.Quotient.mk I e))) ≃ₗ[O]
      (C ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {e})),
      ∀ x : C, φ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊔ Ideal.span {e}) x
proof:
:= by
  set S : Submodule O C := I.restrictScalars O with hS
  set T : Submodule O C := (I ⊔ Ideal.span {e}).restrictScalars O with hT
  have h : S ≤ T := fun x hx => Ideal.mem_sup_left hx
  let f : (C ⧸ S) ≃ₗ[O] (C ⧸ I) := Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv O I
  let g : (C ⧸ T) ≃ₗ[O] (C ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {e})) :=
    Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv O (I ⊔ Ideal.span {e})
  have hmap : (T.map S.mkQ).map (f : (C ⧸ S) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ I)) =
      LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mulLeft O (Ideal.Quotient.mk I e)) := by
    ext y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    simp only [Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, hzy⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hi, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hw
      refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I c, ?_⟩
      have : (f : (C ⧸ S) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ I)) (S.mkQ (i + c * e)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk I (i + c * e) := rfl
      rw [← hzy, this, map_add, (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem).2 hi, zero_add, map_mul, mul_comm]
    · rintro ⟨c', hc'⟩
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c'
      refine ⟨S.mkQ (e * c), ⟨e * c, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self e))
      · have : (f : (C ⧸ S) →ₗ[O] (C ⧸ I)) (S.mkQ (e * c)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (e * c) := rfl
        rw [this, map_mul]; exact hc'
  let E : ((C ⧸ S) ⧸ T.map S.mkQ) ≃ₗ[O]
      ((C ⧸ I) ⧸ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.mulLeft O (Ideal.Quotient.mk I e))) :=
    Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ f hmap
  refine ⟨E.symm.trans ((Submodule.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient S T h).trans g), fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [show Submodule.Quotient.mk (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = E (Submodule.Quotient.mk (S.mkQ x))
    from rfl]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.regular_principal_generators_associated
statement:
theorem regular_principal_generators_associated (A : Type) [CommRing A] (f g : A)
    (hf : Function.Injective (fun x : A => x*f)) (hfg : Ideal.span {f} = Ideal.span {g}) :
    ∃ u : Aˣ, g = (u : A)*f
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g ∈ Ideal.span {f} := hfg ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hf' : f ∈ Ideal.span {g} := hfg ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hg
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hf'
  have hab : a * b = 1 := by
    apply hf
    simp only [one_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc, hb, ha]
  refine ⟨⟨b, a, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hab, hab⟩, hb.symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_quotient_card
statement:
theorem residue_quotient_card (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (L : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (O ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L)=(Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))^L
proof:
:= by
  have h := cardQuot_pow_of_prime (S := O) (P := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field O) (i := L)
  rwa [Submodule.cardQuot_apply, Submodule.cardQuot_apply] at h

name: SurfaceBlowup.coefficient_cylinder_mass
statement:
theorem coefficient_cylinder_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n L : ℕ) (a : Fin n → O) :
    coefficientMeasure O n {b | ∀ i, b i-a i∈(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L} =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(n*L)
proof:
:= by
  set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L with hI
  set μ := coefficientMeasure O n with hμ
  have hopen : IsOpen (I : Set O) := (isAdic_iff.mp htop).1 L
  let C0 : Set (Fin n → O) := {b | ∀ i, b i ∈ I}
  have hC0 : MeasurableSet C0 := by
    have : C0 = Set.univ.pi (fun _ => (I : Set O)) := by ext b; simp [C0]
    rw [this]; exact (isOpen_set_pi Set.finite_univ (fun _ _ => hopen)).measurableSet
  have : μ.IsAddLeftInvariant := by rw [hμ, coefficientMeasure]; infer_instance
  have hprob : μ Set.univ = 1 := by
    rw [hμ, coefficientMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (Measure.measure_univ_pos.mpr (NeZero.ne _)).ne'
      (measure_ne_top _ _)
  
  have htrans : ∀ x : Fin n → O, μ {b | ∀ i, b i - x i ∈ I} = μ C0 := by
    intro x
    have : {b : Fin n → O | ∀ i, b i - x i ∈ I} = (fun b => -x + b) ⁻¹' C0 := by
      ext b; simp [C0, sub_eq_neg_add]
    rw [this, measure_preimage_add]
  rw [htrans a]
  let π : (Fin n → O) → (Fin n → O ⧸ I) := fun b i => Ideal.Quotient.mk I (b i)
  have hfib : ∀ x : Fin n → O, π ⁻¹' {π x} = {b | ∀ i, b i - x i ∈ I} := by
    intro x; ext b; simp [π, funext_iff, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := by
    intro c; exact ⟨fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (c i)).choose,
      funext fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (c i)).choose_spec⟩
  have : Finite (O ⧸ I) := by
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    rw [hI, residue_quotient_card]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ Nat.card_pos.ne'
  have : Fintype (Fin n → O ⧸ I) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hsum : μ Set.univ = ∑ c : Fin n → O ⧸ I, μ (π ⁻¹' {c}) := by
    rw [← measure_biUnion_finset]
    · congr 1; ext b; simp
    · intro c _ d _ hcd; exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun b h1 h2 => hcd (h1.symm.trans h2)
    · intro c _
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hsurj c
      rw [hfib]
      have : {b : Fin n → O | ∀ i, b i - x i ∈ I} = (fun b => -x + b) ⁻¹' C0 := by
        ext b; simp [C0, sub_eq_neg_add]
      rw [this]; exact hC0.preimage (measurable_const_add _)
  have hconst : ∀ c, μ (π ⁻¹' {c}) = μ C0 := by
    intro c; obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hsurj c; rw [hfib, htrans]
  simp only [hconst, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, hprob] at hsum
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (Fin n → O ⧸ I) : ℝ≥0∞) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)^(n*L) := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Fin n),
      Fintype.card_fin,
      hI, residue_quotient_card]
    push_cast; ring
  rw [hcard] at hsum
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_pow]
  exact ENNReal.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hsum.symm)

name: SurfaceBlowup.coefficient_measure_probability
statement:
theorem coefficient_measure_probability (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) :
    MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (coefficientMeasure O n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simpa using coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop n 0 0⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_measure_total_mass
statement:
theorem chart_measure_total_mass (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) [CommRing R] [Algebra O R]
    [MeasurableSpace (Ideal R)] (pi : O) (n : ℕ) (c : IdealChart O R pi n)
    (hc : Measurable (coordinateIdeal pi c.f c.b)) :
    chartMeasure O R pi n c Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop n
  rw [chartMeasure, Measure.map_apply hc MeasurableSet.univ, Set.preimage_univ, measure_univ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.coefficient_uniformizer_cylinder_mass
statement:
theorem coefficient_uniformizer_cylinder_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (pi : O) (hp : Irreducible pi) (j : ℕ)
    (x : Fin n → O) :
    coefficientMeasure O n {z | adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j z x} =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(n*j)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O = Ideal.span {pi} :=
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer pi).mp hp
  have hset : {z : Fin n → O | adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) j z x} =
      {b | ∀ i, b i - x i ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^j} := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [finite_coordinate_adic_congruence, hm]
  rw [hset]
  exact coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop n j x

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_axisIdeal_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_axisIdeal_iff (k : Type) [Field k] (φ : TwoSeries k) :
    φ ∈ Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k} ↔ MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff φ = 0
proof:
:=
  mvPowerSeries_fin_two_mem_variableIdeal_iff k φ

name: SurfaceBlowup.axisIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
private theorem axisIdeal_isMaximal (k : Type) [Field k] :
    (Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k}).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  have : Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k} =
      RingHom.ker (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin 2) (R := k)) := by
    ext φ; rw [mem_axisIdeal_iff, RingHom.mem_ker]
  rw [this]
  exact RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective _ (fun x => ⟨MvPowerSeries.C x, by simp⟩)

name: SurfaceBlowup.maximalIdeal_twoSeries
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_twoSeries (k : Type) [Field k] :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (TwoSeries k) = Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k}
proof:
:=
  (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (axisIdeal_isMaximal k)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.fin_two_eq_or
statement: private theorem fin_two_eq_or {s t : Fin 2} (hst : s ≠ t) (i : Fin 2) : i = s ∨ i = t
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.eq_single_of_apply_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem eq_single_of_apply_eq_zero {s t : Fin 2} (hst : s ≠ t) {m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ}
    (hm : m s = 0) : m = Finsupp.single t (m t)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; rcases fin_two_eq_or hst i with rfl | rfl <;> simp [hm, hst]

name: SurfaceBlowup.axisQuotientLength_eq_top
statement:
theorem axisQuotientLength_eq_top (k : Type) [Field k] {s t : Fin 2} (hst : s ≠ t)
    (F : TwoSeries k)
    (h : ∀ j, MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t j) F = 0) : axisQuotientLength k s F = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : MvPowerSeries.X s ∣ F := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff]
    intro m hm
    rw [eq_single_of_apply_eq_zero hst hm]; exact h _
  rw [axisQuotientLength, sup_eq_right.mpr (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr hdvd)]
  exact axis_quotient_length_top k s t hst

name: SurfaceBlowup.axisQuotientLength_eq
statement:
theorem axisQuotientLength_eq (k : Type) [Field k] {s t : Fin 2} (hst : s ≠ t)
    (F : TwoSeries k)
    (d : ℕ) (hlow : ∀ j < d, MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t j) F = 0)
    (hd : MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t d) F ≠ 0) : axisQuotientLength k s F = d
proof:
:= by
  set Xs : TwoSeries k := MvPowerSeries.X s
  set Xt : TwoSeries k := MvPowerSeries.X t
  let F0 : TwoSeries k := fun m => if m s = 0 then MvPowerSeries.coeff m F else 0
  have hF0 : ∀ m, MvPowerSeries.coeff m F0 = if m s = 0 then MvPowerSeries.coeff m F else 0 :=
    fun m => rfl
  have hT : Xs ∣ F - F0 := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff]
    intro m hm
    rw [map_sub, hF0, if_pos hm, sub_self]
  have hX : Xt ^ d ∣ F0 := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff]
    intro m hm
    rw [hF0]
    split_ifs with h0
    · rw [eq_single_of_apply_eq_zero hst h0]; exact hlow _ hm
    · rfl
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := hT
  have hU0 : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff U ≠ 0 := by
    have := congrArg (MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t d)) hU
    rw [hF0, if_pos (by simp [hst]), MvPowerSeries.X_pow_eq,
      MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial_mul, if_pos le_rfl, one_mul, tsub_self,
      MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at this
    rw [← this]; exact hd
  have hUu : IsUnit U := MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hU0)
  have hFe : F = Xs * G + Xt ^ d * U := by
    rw [← hG, ← hU]; ring
  have hid : Ideal.span {F} ⊔ Ideal.span {Xs} = Ideal.span {Xs} ⊔ Ideal.span {Xt ^ d} := by
    have hXs := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self Xs
    simp only [le_antisymm_iff, sup_le_iff, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, Ideal.mem_sup_left hXs⟩, Ideal.mem_sup_right hXs, ?_⟩
    · rw [hFe]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left hXs))
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)))
    · obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := hUu.exists_right_inv
      rw [show Xt ^ d = (F - Xs * G) * V by rw [hFe, add_sub_cancel_left, mul_assoc, hV, mul_one]]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.sub_mem _
        (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_sup_right hXs)))
  have hcancel : ∀ x, Xt * x ∈ Ideal.span {Xs} → x ∈ Ideal.span {Xs} := by
    intro x hx
    refine axis_pow_mul_mem_span_cancel k t Xs ?_ 1 x (by rwa [pow_one])
    intro hmem
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff] at hmem
    simpa [Xs, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X] using hmem (Finsupp.single s 1) (by simp [hst])
  have h1 :
      Module.length (TwoSeries k) (TwoSeries k ⧸ (Ideal.span {Xs} ⊔ Ideal.span {Xt})) = 1 := by
    have : Ideal.span {Xs} ⊔ Ideal.span {Xt} = Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k} := by
      rw [Ideal.span_insert]
      fin_cases s <;> fin_cases t <;> first | exact absurd rfl hst | rfl | exact sup_comm _ _
    rw [this, Module.length_eq_one_iff, isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom]
    exact (axisIdeal_isMaximal k).out
  rw [axisQuotientLength, hid, length_quotient_sup_pow_eq_mul _ _ _ hcancel d, h1, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.axisQuotientLength_eq_iff
statement:
theorem axisQuotientLength_eq_iff (k : Type) [Field k] {s t : Fin 2} (hst : s ≠ t) (F : TwoSeries k)
    (c : ℕ) : axisQuotientLength k s F = c ↔
      (∀ j < c, MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t j) F = 0) ∧
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t c) F ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => axisQuotientLength_eq k hst F c h1 h2⟩
  by_cases hex : ∃ j, MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t j) F ≠ 0
  · have hmin : ∀ j < Nat.find hex, MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t j) F = 0 :=
      fun j hj => not_not.mp (Nat.find_min hex hj)
    have hc : Nat.find hex = c := by
      exact_mod_cast (axisQuotientLength_eq k hst F _ hmin (Nat.find_spec hex)).symm.trans h
    exact hc ▸ ⟨hmin, Nat.find_spec hex⟩
  · push Not at hex
    exact absurd (h.symm.trans (axisQuotientLength_eq_top k hst F hex)) (ENat.natCast_ne_top c)

name: SurfaceBlowup.contact_fiberT_eq_axisQuotientLength
statement:
theorem contact_fiberT_eq_axisQuotientLength (k : Type) [Field k] (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (F : TwoSeries k) :
    contact (Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) F) (fiberT k a b) =
      axisQuotientLength k 0 F
proof:
:= by
  have hJT : monomialIdeal k a b ≤ Ideal.span {F, axisT k} := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (Ideal.span_mono (Set.subset_insert F {axisT k}))
    rw [monomialIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_right (dvd_pow_self _ ha.ne') _
  have h1 := length_double_quotient_eq (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b) (Ideal.span {F, axisT k})
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, sup_eq_right.mpr hJT] at h1
  rw [contact, fiberT, h1, axisQuotientLength, ← Ideal.span_insert]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.contact_fiberX_eq_axisQuotientLength
statement:
theorem contact_fiberX_eq_axisQuotientLength (k : Type) [Field k] (a b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : TwoSeries k) :
    contact (Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) F) (fiberX k a b) =
      axisQuotientLength k 1 F
proof:
:= by
  have hJT : monomialIdeal k a b ≤ Ideal.span {F, axisX k} := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (Ideal.span_mono (Set.subset_insert F {axisX k}))
    rw [monomialIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_pow_self _ hb.ne') _
  have h1 := length_double_quotient_eq (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b) (Ideal.span {F, axisX k})
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, sup_eq_right.mpr hJT] at h1
  rw [contact, fiberX, h1, axisQuotientLength, ← Ideal.span_insert]; rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_truncIndex_axis_segment
statement:
theorem card_truncIndex_axis_segment (a b L c : ℕ) (f g : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ)
    (hfe : ∀ j, f (e j) = 0 ∧ g (e j) = j) (hef : ∀ x, f x = 0 → e (g x) = x)
    (hmem : ∀ j < c, e j ∈ truncIndex a b L) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s : truncIndex a b L => f s.1 = 0 ∧ g s.1 < c).card = c
proof:
:= by
  refine (Finset.card_bij (t := Finset.range c) (fun s _ => g s.1) ?_ ?_ ?_).trans
    (Finset.card_range c)
  · intro s hs
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hs
    simpa using hs.2
  · intro s₁ h₁ s₂ h₂ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h₁ h₂
    exact Subtype.ext (by rw [← hef _ h₁.1, ← hef _ h₂.1, h])
  · intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    exact ⟨⟨e j, hmem j hj⟩, by simp [hfe, hj], (hfe j).2⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.truncCoeffs_apply
statement:
theorem truncCoeffs_apply (k : Type) [Field k] (a b L : ℕ) (F : TwoSeries k)
    (s : truncIndex a b L) :
    truncCoeffs k a b L F s = MvPowerSeries.coeff (truncExponent s.1) F
proof: := rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.truncCoeffs_surjective_and_ker
proof:
:= by
  let e : ℕ × ℕ → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) := truncExponent
  have e0 : ∀ ij, e ij 0 = ij.1 := fun ij => by simp [e, truncExponent]
  have e1 : ∀ ij, e ij 1 = ij.2 := fun ij => by simp [e, truncExponent]
  have eeq : ∀ m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, e (m 0, m 1) = m := fun m => by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e0, e1]
  have einj : Function.Injective e := fun p q h => by
    have h0 := congrArg (fun m => m 0) h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun m => m 1) h
    simp only [e0, e1] at h0 h1
    exact Prod.ext h0 h1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    refine ⟨∑ s, MvPowerSeries.monomial (e s.1) (v s), ?_⟩
    funext s₀
    simp only [truncCoeffs, LinearMap.pi_apply, map_sum, MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single s₀]
    · simp [e]
    · intro s _ hs
      rw [if_neg]
      intro h
      exact hs (Subtype.ext (einj h.symm))
    · simp
  · intro φ
    constructor
    · intro hφ
      have hz : ∀ s : truncIndex a b L, MvPowerSeries.coeff (e s.1) φ = 0 :=
        fun s => congrFun hφ s
      let x : TwoSeries k := fun m => if a ≤ m 0 ∧ b ≤ m 1 then MvPowerSeries.coeff m φ else 0
      have hx : ∀ m, MvPowerSeries.coeff m x =
          if a ≤ m 0 ∧ b ≤ m 1 then MvPowerSeries.coeff m φ else 0 :=
        fun m => rfl
      rw [show φ = x + (φ - x) by ring]
      refine Submodule.add_mem_sup ?_ ?_
      · rw [monomialIdeal_mem_iff]
        intro m hm
        rw [hx, if_neg hm]
      · rw [axis_ideal_pow_mem_iff]
        intro m hm
        rw [map_sub, hx]
        split_ifs with h
        · simp
        · have := hz ⟨(m 0, m 1), by
            simp only [truncIndex, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
            exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hm, h⟩⟩
          simp only [eeq] at this
          simp [this]
    · intro hφ
      obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hφ
      rw [monomialIdeal_mem_iff] at hx
      rw [axis_ideal_pow_mem_iff] at hy
      funext s
      obtain ⟨ij, hij⟩ := s
      simp only [truncIndex, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range] at hij
      simp only [truncCoeffs, LinearMap.pi_apply, map_add, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [hx _ (by rw [e0, e1]; exact hij.2.2), hy _ (by rw [e0, e1]; exact hij.2.1), add_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.truncEval_mk
statement:
private theorem truncEval_mk (k : Type) [Field k] (a b L : ℕ) (F : TwoSeries k) :
    truncEval k a b L (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ F) = truncCoeffs k a b L F
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.truncIdeal_le_axisIdeal
statement:
private theorem truncIdeal_le_axisIdeal (k : Type) [Field k] (a b L : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hL : 0 < L) :
    truncIdeal k a b L ≤ Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k}
proof:
:= by
  apply sup_le
  · rw [monomialIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)) _ ha)
  · exact Ideal.pow_le_self hL.ne'

name: SurfaceBlowup.isUnit_mk_truncIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_mk_truncIdeal_iff (k : Type) [Field k] (a b L : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hL : 0 < L)
    (F : TwoSeries k) :
    IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (truncIdeal k a b L) F) ↔ MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff F ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hF
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h.exists_right_inv
    obtain ⟨Y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk (truncIdeal k a b L)), Ideal.Quotient.eq] at hy
    have := (mem_axisIdeal_iff k _).mp (truncIdeal_le_axisIdeal k a b L ha hL hy)
    simp [hF] at this
  · intro h
    exact (MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h)).map _

name: SurfaceBlowup.truncIdeal_ne_top
statement:
private theorem truncIdeal_ne_top (k : Type) [Field k] (a b L : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hL : 0 < L) :
    truncIdeal k a b L ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= fun h =>
  (axisIdeal_isMaximal k).ne_top (top_le_iff.mp (h ▸ truncIdeal_le_axisIdeal k a b L ha hL))

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_mul_eq_zero_eq_card_quotient
statement:
theorem card_mul_eq_zero_eq_card_quotient (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Finite B] (x : B) :
    Nat.card {r : B // r * x = 0} = Nat.card (B ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:= by
  let μ := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton B B x
  have hker : Nat.card {r : B // r * x = 0} = Nat.card (LinearMap.ker μ) := by
    apply Nat.card_congr
    exact Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun r => by simp [μ, LinearMap.mem_ker])
  have hrange : LinearMap.range μ = Ideal.span {x} := (LinearMap.span_singleton_eq_range B B x).symm
  have h1 := Submodule.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card (LinearMap.ker μ)
  have h2 := Submodule.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card (Ideal.span {x} : Submodule B B)
  have h3 : Nat.card (B ⧸ LinearMap.ker μ) = Nat.card (Ideal.span {x} : Submodule B B) := by
    rw [← hrange]; exact Nat.card_congr μ.quotKerEquivRange.toEquiv
  rw [h3] at h1
  have hpos : 0 < Nat.card (Ideal.span {x} : Submodule B B) := Nat.card_pos
  rw [hker]
  have : Nat.card (LinearMap.ker μ) * Nat.card (Ideal.span {x} : Submodule B B) =
      Nat.card (B ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) * Nat.card (Ideal.span {x} : Submodule B B) := by
    rw [← h1, mul_comm, ← h2]
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hpos this

name: SurfaceBlowup.truncIdeal_le_of_length
proof:
:= by
  have h65 := maximal_ideal_power_kills (TwoSeries k) _ N hlen
  refine sup_le le_sup_left ?_
  rw [← maximalIdeal_twoSeries]
  refine (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right N.le_succ).trans fun x hx => ?_
  have := Submodule.smul_mem_smul hx
    (Submodule.mem_top (x := Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b ⊔ Ideal.span {F}) 1))
  rw [h65, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using this

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_units_truncQuotient
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype k := Fintype.ofFinite k
  have h00 : ((0 : ℕ), (0 : ℕ)) ∈ truncIndex a b L := by simp [truncIndex]; omega
  have h61 := coordinate_constraint_count k (truncIndex a b L) ∅ {⟨_, h00⟩}
    (Finset.disjoint_empty_left _)
  rw [Finset.card_singleton, Finset.card_empty, pow_one, Nat.sub_zero,
    ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at h61
  rw [← h61]
  have hunit : ∀ x : TwoSeries k ⧸ truncIdeal k a b L, IsUnit x ↔
      (∀ s ∈ (∅ : Finset (truncIndex a b L)), truncEval k a b L x s = 0) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ ({⟨_, h00⟩} : Finset (truncIndex a b L)), truncEval k a b L x s ≠ 0 := by
    intro x; obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    rw [isUnit_mk_truncIdeal_iff k a b _ ha hL, truncEval_mk]
    simp [truncCoeffs_apply, truncExponent, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  refine Nat.card_congr (.ofBijective (fun u => ⟨truncEval k a b L u, (hunit u).mp u.isUnit⟩)
    ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
  · exact fun u v h => Units.ext ((truncEval k a b L).injective (by simpa using h))
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (truncEval k a b L).surjective g
    exact ⟨((hunit x).mpr hg).unit, rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_mul_eq_card_principal_mul
statement:
private theorem card_mul_eq_card_principal_mul {B : Type} [CommRing B] [Finite B] (G : Set B)
    (c u : ℕ) (hfib : ∀ x ∈ G, Nat.card {g : B // Ideal.span {g} = Ideal.span {x}} * c = u)
    (hclos : ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ y : B, Ideal.span {y} = Ideal.span {x} → y ∈ G) :
    Nat.card G * c = Nat.card {I : Ideal B // ∃ x ∈ G, I = Ideal.span {x}} * u
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype B := Fintype.ofFinite B
  let Pr := {I : Ideal B // ∃ x ∈ G, I = Ideal.span {x}}
  let π : G → Pr := fun x => ⟨Ideal.span {x.1}, x.1, x.2, rfl⟩
  have : Finite Pr := Finite.of_surjective π fun ⟨_, x, hx, h⟩ => ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext h.symm⟩
  have : Fintype Pr := Fintype.ofFinite Pr
  have hfib' : ∀ I : Pr, Nat.card {z : G // π z = I} * c = u := by
    rintro ⟨I, x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [← hfib x hx]
    congr 1
    exact Nat.card_congr
      { toFun := fun z => ⟨z.1.1, congrArg Subtype.val z.2⟩
        invFun := fun g => ⟨⟨g.1, hclos x hx g.1 g.2⟩, Subtype.ext g.2⟩
        left_inv := fun _ => rfl
        right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  rw [← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv π), Nat.card_sigma, Finset.sum_mul,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun I _ => hfib' I), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul,
    Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Pr)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_isUnit_mul_eq_of_span_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_isUnit_mul_eq_of_span_eq {B : Type} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] {x y : B}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : Ideal.span {y} = Ideal.span {x}) : ∃ r, IsUnit r ∧ r * x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hy ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self y)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hy.symm ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x)
  refine ⟨r, ?_, hr⟩
  by_contra hnu
  have h1 := IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits _
    (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ s ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal r).mpr hnu))
  refine hx (h1.mul_right_eq_zero.mp ?_)
  rw [sub_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, hr, hs, sub_self]

name: SurfaceBlowup.comap_factor_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk h, ← Set.image_singleton, ← Ideal.map_span,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective h), sup_eq_left]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨Z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hz
  obtain ⟨M, hM, Y, hY, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hJ hz)
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hY
  rw [map_add, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hM, zero_add, map_mul]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.principal_residue_ideal_count
statement:
theorem principal_residue_ideal_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (a b N : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (P : TwoSeries k → Prop) (Q : SpecialFiber k a b → Prop)
    (hQ : ∀ F, Q (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ F) ↔ P F) (hunit : ∀ U F, IsUnit U → P F → P (U * F))
    (hlen : ∀ F, P F → Module.length (TwoSeries k)
      (TwoSeries k ⧸ (monomialIdeal k a b ⊔ Ideal.span {F})) = N)
    (hcard : ∀ F, P F →
      Nat.card (TwoSeries k ⧸ (monomialIdeal k a b ⊔ Ideal.span {F})) = Nat.card k ^ N)
    (A B : Finset (truncIndex a b (N + 1))) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hcrit : ∀ F, P F ↔ (∀ s ∈ A, truncCoeffs k a b (N + 1) F s = 0) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ B, truncCoeffs k a b (N + 1) F s ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {I : Ideal (SpecialFiber k a b) // ∃ f, I = Ideal.span {f} ∧ Q f} *
        ((Nat.card k - 1) * Nat.card k ^ (A.card + B.card - 1)) =
      (Nat.card k - 1) ^ B.card * Nat.card k ^ N
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have : Fintype k := Fintype.ofFinite k
  have hL0 : 0 < N + 1 := N.succ_pos
  let J := truncIdeal k a b (N + 1)
  let R' := TwoSeries k ⧸ J
  let mk' : TwoSeries k →+* R' := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  have hmk' : Function.Surjective mk' := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have : Nontrivial R' := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (truncIdeal_ne_top k a b _ ha hL0)
  have : IsLocalRing R' := .of_surjective' mk' hmk'
  let ev := truncEval k a b (N + 1)
  have hev : ∀ F, ev (mk' F) = truncCoeffs k a b (N + 1) F := truncEval_mk k a b (N + 1)
  let eqv : R' ≃ (truncIndex a b (N + 1) → k) := ev.toEquiv
  have : Fintype R' := .ofEquiv _ eqv.symm
  have hmonJ : monomialIdeal k a b ≤ J := le_sup_left
  have hkill : ∀ F, P F → J ≤ monomialIdeal k a b ⊔ Ideal.span {F} := fun F hF ↦
    truncIdeal_le_of_length k a b N F (hlen F hF)
  have hcardq : ∀ F, P F → Nat.card (R' ⧸ Ideal.span {mk' F}) = Nat.card k ^ N := by
    intro F hF
    have e := DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup J (Ideal.span {F})
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, le_antisymm (sup_le (hkill F hF) le_sup_right)
      (sup_le_sup_right hmonJ _)] at e
    rw [Nat.card_congr e.toEquiv, hcard F hF]
  
  let G : Set R' := {x | (∀ s ∈ A, ev x s = 0) ∧ ∀ s ∈ B, ev x s ≠ 0}
  have hPG : ∀ F, mk' F ∈ G ↔ P F := fun F => by rw [hcrit]; simp only [G, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hev]
  have hcardG : Nat.card G =
      (Nat.card k - 1) ^ B.card * Nat.card k ^ (Fintype.card (truncIndex a b (N + 1)) -
        A.card - B.card) := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := k), ← coordinate_constraint_count k _ A B hAB]
    exact Nat.card_congr (eqv.subtypeEquiv fun _ => Iff.rfl)
  have hne0 : ∀ x ∈ G, x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro x ⟨-, h⟩ rfl
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hB
    exact h s hs (by rw [← map_zero mk', hev, map_zero]; rfl)
  have hfib : ∀ x ∈ G,
      Nat.card {g : R' // Ideal.span {g} = Ideal.span {x}} * Nat.card k ^ N = Nat.card R'ˣ := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := hmk' x
    rw [← hcardq F ((hPG F).1 hx), ← card_mul_eq_zero_eq_card_quotient]
    exact principal_generator_orbit_count R' _ (hne0 _ hx)
  have hclos : ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ y : R', Ideal.span {y} = Ideal.span {x} → y ∈ G := by
    intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := hmk' x
    obtain ⟨r, hru, hr⟩ := exists_isUnit_mul_eq_of_span_eq (hne0 _ hx) hy
    obtain ⟨Gr, rfl⟩ := hmk' r
    have hGu : IsUnit Gr := MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr
      (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ((isUnit_mk_truncIdeal_iff k a b _ ha hL0 Gr).mp hru))
    rw [← hr, ← map_mul, hPG]
    exact hunit _ _ hGu ((hPG F).1 hx)
  have hU := card_units_truncQuotient k a b (N + 1) ha hL0
  
  have hGP := card_mul_eq_card_principal_mul G _ _ hfib hclos
  
  let ψ := Ideal.Quotient.factor hmonJ
  have hmapI : ∀ F, Ideal.map ψ (Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) F}) =
      Ideal.span {mk' F} := fun F => by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk]
  let Φ : {I : Ideal (SpecialFiber k a b) // ∃ f, I = Ideal.span {f} ∧ Q f} →
      {I : Ideal R' // ∃ x ∈ G, I = Ideal.span {x}} :=
    fun I => ⟨Ideal.map ψ I.1, by
      obtain ⟨_, f, rfl, hf⟩ := I
      obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
      exact ⟨mk' F, (hPG F).2 ((hQ F).1 hf), hmapI F⟩⟩
  have hΦ : Function.Bijective Φ := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, f₁, rfl, hf₁⟩ ⟨_, f₂, rfl, hf₂⟩ h
      obtain ⟨F₁, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f₁
      obtain ⟨F₂, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f₂
      have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
      simp only [Φ, hmapI] at h'
      apply Subtype.ext
      change Ideal.span {_} = Ideal.span {_}
      rw [← comap_factor_span_singleton hmonJ (hkill F₁ ((hQ F₁).1 hf₁)),
        ← comap_factor_span_singleton hmonJ (hkill F₂ ((hQ F₂).1 hf₂))]
      exact congrArg _ h'
    · rintro ⟨_, x, hx, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := hmk' x
      exact ⟨⟨_, _, rfl, (hQ F).2 ((hPG F).1 hx)⟩, Subtype.ext (hmapI F)⟩
  rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective Φ hΦ)]
  rw [hcardG, hU] at hGP
  have hℓ : A.card + B.card ≤ Fintype.card (truncIndex a b (N + 1)) :=
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hAB ▸ Finset.card_le_univ _
  have hB1 := hB.card_pos
  set m := Fintype.card (truncIndex a b (N + 1)) - A.card - B.card
  have hpos : 0 < Nat.card k ^ m := pow_pos Nat.card_pos _
  refine Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpos ?_
  rw [show Fintype.card (truncIndex a b (N + 1)) - 1 = m + (A.card + B.card - 1) by omega,
    pow_add] at hGP
  linarith

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_point_eq_span_of_lift
statement:
private theorem chart_point_eq_span_of_lift (O : Type) [CommRing O] (R : Type) [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R] (t x : R) [(Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
      (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsMaximal] (hP : chartBase R t x t ∈ P)
    (φ : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R))) (hirr : Irreducible φ)
    (hmap : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ})
    (Φ₀ : Polynomial O)
    (hΦ₀ : Φ₀.map ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R))).comp (algebraMap O R)) = φ) :
    P = Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t,
      Polynomial.eval₂ ((chartBase R t x).comp (algebraMap O R)) (chartSlope R t x) Φ₀}
proof:
:= by
  set ρ : O →+* R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R) :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R))).comp (algebraMap O R) with hρdef
  set F := Polynomial.eval₂ ((chartBase R t x).comp (algebraMap O R)) (chartSlope R t x) Φ₀
  have hF : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) F) = φ := by
    rw [← hΦ₀]
    have : ((e : _ →+* _).comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)).comp
        (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom ((chartBase R t x).comp (algebraMap O R)) (chartSlope R t x))))
        = Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ := by
      apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext
      · intro c; simp [he, ρ]
      · simp [heZ]
    exact congrArg (fun g => g Φ₀) this
  have hFP : F ∈ P := by
    have h1 : φ ∈ (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e := by
      rw [hmap]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    rw [← hF] at h1
    rw [Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv] at h1
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hye⟩ := h1
    rw [e.injective hye] at hy
    rwa [Ideal.mem_quotient_iff_mem] at hy
    rw [chartExceptional, Ideal.span_le]
    simpa using hP
  have hirr' : Irreducible ((Φ₀.map (algebraMap O R)).map
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R)))) := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, ← hρdef, hΦ₀]; exact hirr
  let _ : Field (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ P) := Ideal.Quotient.field P
  obtain ⟨-, hspan⟩ := chart_nonrational_point_span_eq_comap R t x (Φ₀.map (algebraMap O R)) hirr'
    (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ P) (Ideal.Quotient.mk P)
    (by rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot, Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
        exact hP)
    (by
      rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot, Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
        Polynomial.eval₂_map]; exact hFP)
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_map] at hspan
  rw [hspan, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_point_trichotomy
statement:
private theorem chart_point_trichotomy (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (R : Type)
    [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (t x : R) [(Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (ψ : (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R)) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (hψρ : ∀ c : O, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap O R c)) = IsLocalRing.residue O c)
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsMaximal] (hP : chartBase R t x t ∈ P) :
    P = Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t, chartSlope R t x} ∨
    (∃ α : O, IsUnit α ∧ P = Ideal.span
        {chartBase R t x t, chartSlope R t x - chartBase R t x (algebraMap O R α)}) ∨
    (∃ Φ : Polynomial O, IsUnramifiedLift O Φ ∧ 2 ≤ Φ.natDegree ∧ P = Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t,
      Polynomial.eval₂ ((chartBase R t x).comp (algebraMap O R)) (chartSlope R t x) Φ})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, heZ⟩ := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional R t x
  obtain ⟨φ, hmon, hirr, hmap, -, -⟩ :=
    blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial R t x e he heZ P hP
  set ρ : O →+* R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R) :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t, x} : Set R))).comp (algebraMap O R) with hρdef
  have hρ : ∀ c : O, ρ c = ψ.symm (IsLocalRing.residue O c) := fun c => by
    rw [← hψρ, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]; rfl
  have hρsurj : Function.Surjective ρ := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (ψ y)
    exact ⟨c, by rw [hρ, hc, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩
  have key (Φ₀ : Polynomial O) (hΦ₀ : Φ₀.map ρ = φ) :=
    chart_point_eq_span_of_lift O R t x e he heZ P hP φ hirr hmap Φ₀ hΦ₀
  have hdeg : φ.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [hmon.natDegree_eq_zero] at h
    exact hirr.not_isUnit (h ▸ isUnit_one)
  by_cases hX : φ = Polynomial.X
  · left
    simpa using key Polynomial.X (by simp [hX])
  by_cases h1 : φ.natDegree = 1
  · right; left
    have hφ := hmon.eq_X_add_C h1
    set c := φ.coeff 0
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := fun hc => hX (by rw [hφ, hc]; simp)
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hρsurj (-c)
    refine ⟨α, ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra hu
      have : IsLocalRing.residue O α = 0 := (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff α).2
        ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal α).2 hu)
      apply hc
      rw [← neg_eq_zero, ← hα, hρ, this, map_zero]
    · have := key (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C α) (by rw [hφ]; simp [hα, sub_eq_add_neg])
      simpa using this
  · right; right
    obtain ⟨Φ₀, hmapΦ, hdegΦ, hmonΦ⟩ :=
      Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic (Polynomial.mem_lifts_of_surjective hρsurj φ) hmon
    refine ⟨Φ₀, ⟨hmonΦ, ?_⟩, by omega, key Φ₀ hmapΦ⟩
    have hres : residuePoly O Φ₀ = (Polynomial.mapEquiv ψ) φ := by
      rw [← hmapΦ]
      simp only [residuePoly, Polynomial.mapEquiv_apply, Polynomial.map_map]
      congr 1
      ext c
      simp [hρ]
    rw [hres]
    exact (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff (Polynomial.mapEquiv ψ).toMulEquiv).2 hirr

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_chart_point_span_form
statement:
theorem concrete_chart_point_span_form (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (P : Ideal (tChart O pi u a b)) [P.IsMaximal]
    (hP : tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P) :
    P = Ideal.span {tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b), tSlope O pi u a b} ∨
      (∃ α : O, IsUnit α ∧ P = Ideal.span {tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b),
        tSlope O pi u a b - tBase O pi u a b (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) α)}) ∨
      (∃ Φ : Polynomial O, IsUnramifiedLift O Φ ∧ 2 ≤ Φ.natDegree ∧
        P = Ideal.span {tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b),
          Polynomial.eval₂ ((tBase O pi u a b).comp (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
            (tSlope O pi u a b) Φ})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} :
      Set (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  exact chart_point_trichotomy O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) _ _ ψ
    (fun c ↦ hψ (MvPowerSeries.C c)) P hP

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_left_point_completion_is_surface
statement:
theorem concrete_left_point_completion_is_surface (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (P : Ideal (tChart O pi u a b)) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P) :
    ∃ (O' : Type) (_ : CommRing O') (_ : IsDomain O') (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing O')
      (_ : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O') O')
      (_ : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O')) (pi' : O') (u' : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) (a' b' : ℕ),
      Irreducible pi' ∧ 0 < a' ∧
      ∃ Eq : CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P ≃+* ConcreteSurface O' pi' u' a' b',
      Eq (completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) P (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b))) =
          surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (α : R), chartSubst R α (axisT R) = axisT R :=
    fun R _ α => (chartSubst_apply_generators R α).2.1
  rcases concrete_chart_point_span_form O pi hpi u a b ha P hP with h | ⟨α, hα, h⟩ | ⟨Φ, hΦ, h2, h⟩
  · obtain ⟨E, hE, -⟩ := t_chart_origin_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha P h
    refine ⟨O, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, pi,
          substUnit O 0 u, a + b, b, hpi, by omega, E, (hE _).trans (congrArg _ (hT O 0))⟩
  · obtain ⟨E, hE, -⟩ := t_chart_unit_point_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha α hα P h
    refine ⟨O, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, pi, _,
          a + b, 0, hpi, by omega, E, (hE _).trans (congrArg _ (hT O α))⟩
  · have hθ := unramified_root_isUnit_of_two_le_natDegree O Φ hΦ h2
    obtain ⟨E, hE, -⟩ := t_chart_nonrational_point_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha Φ hΦ hθ P h
    obtain ⟨hd, hl, hdvr, -, hirr, hc, hf, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
    refine ⟨AdjoinRoot Φ, inferInstance, hd, hdvr, hc, hf, algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) pi, _, a + b,
          0, hirr pi hpi, by omega, E, ?_⟩
    have hm : MvPowerSeries.map (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (axisT O) = axisT (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
      simp [axisT, MvPowerSeries.map_X]
    exact (hE _).trans (congrArg _ (by rw [hm, hT]))

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_left_point_completion_instances
statement:
theorem concrete_left_point_completion_instances (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (P : Ideal (tChart O pi u a b)) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P) :
    IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P) ∧
      IsDomain (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P) ∧
      ∃ _ : IsLocalRing (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P),
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P))
      (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O', c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', Eq, -⟩ :=
    concrete_left_point_completion_is_surface O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  exact concrete_surface_equiv_instances _ O' pi' hpi' u' a' b' ha' Eq

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_left_point_exceptional_regular
statement:
theorem concrete_left_point_exceptional_regular (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (P : Ideal (tChart O pi u a b)) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun y : CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) P => completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) P
        (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O', c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', Eq, hEq⟩ :=
    concrete_left_point_completion_is_surface O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  have e : Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b') = completedPointMap _ P
      (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) := by
    rw [← hEq]; simp
  exact e ▸ (concrete_surface_equiv_regular_pair _ O' pi' hpi' u' a' b' ha' Eq).2.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_infinity_point_completion
statement:
theorem concrete_infinity_point_completion (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (P : Ideal (xChart O pi u a b)) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hx : xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b) ∈ P) (hW : xSlope O pi u a b ∈ P) :
    P = Ideal.span {xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b), xSlope O pi u a b} ∧
      (∃ Eq : CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P ≃+*
          ConcreteSurface O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a,
        Eq (completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
          surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a) ∧
      IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P) ∧
      (∃ _ : IsLocalRing (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P),
        IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P))
        (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P)) ∧ Function.Injective
      (fun y : CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P => completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P
        (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)) * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hr, D, hpi', ht, hx', h5, h6, h7⟩ :=
      concrete_surface_data_exists_unconditional O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hmax := (infinity_point_maximal O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) D).1
  rw [ht, hx'] at hmax
  have hPeq : P = Ideal.span {xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b), xSlope O pi u a b} := by
    symm
    apply Ideal.IsMaximal.eq_of_le hmax (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance)
    unfold infinityPoint
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [hx, hW]
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEs, hEc⟩ := x_chart_infinity_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha P hPeq
  have hT : E (completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
      surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a :=
    (hE _).trans (congrArg _ (chartSubst_apply_generators O 0).2.2.2.2.2.1)
  have hinst := concrete_surface_equiv_instances _ O pi hpi (xSubstUnit O u) (a+b) a (by omega) E
  refine ⟨hPeq, ⟨E, hT⟩, hinst.1, hinst.2.2, ?_⟩
  have hreg :=
      (concrete_surface_equiv_regular_pair _ O pi hpi (xSubstUnit O u) (a+b) a (by omega) E).2.2
  have : completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)) =
      E.symm (surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a) := by
    rw [← hT]; simp
  rw [this]; exact hreg

name: SurfaceBlowup.residueKillT_xChartSubst
statement:
theorem residueKillT_xChartSubst (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (s : TwoSeries O) :
    residueKillT O (xChartSubst O s) = PowerSeries.C
      (IsLocalRing.residue O (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hC, hT, hX, -⟩ := chartSubst_apply_generators O 0
  obtain ⟨kC, kT, kX, -, -⟩ := residueKillT_apply_ker O pi hpi
  let L : TwoSeries O →+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :=
    (residueKillT O).comp (xChartSubst O : TwoSeries O →+* TwoSeries O)
  let R : TwoSeries O →+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :=
    (PowerSeries.C).comp ((IsLocalRing.residue O).comp MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff)
  have LT : L (axisT O) = 0 := by
    change residueKillT O (xChartSubst O (axisT O)) = 0
    rw [hT, map_mul, kT, zero_mul]
  have LX : L (axisX O) = 0 := by
    change residueKillT O (xChartSubst O (axisX O)) = 0
    rw [hX, kT]
  have RT : R (axisT O) = 0 := by simp [R, axisT]
  have RX : R (axisX O) = 0 := by simp [R, axisX]
  have h : L = R := by
    apply twoSeries_ringHom_ext_of_isNilpotent O _ L R
    · intro c
      change residueKillT O (xChartSubst O (MvPowerSeries.C c)) = _
      simp [R, hC, kC]
    · rw [LT, RT]
    · rw [LX, RX]
    · exact LT ▸ IsNilpotent.zero
    · exact LX ▸ IsNilpotent.zero
  exact congrArg (fun f => f s) h

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_C_mul_X_pow_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
  intro h
  apply hi
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff (d - i.val)) h
  rw [map_zero, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single i] at this
  · rwa [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_pos rfl] at this
  · intro j _ hj
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_neg]
    intro h'; apply hj; ext; have := j.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_infinity_strict_transform_transverse_finite
statement:
theorem concrete_infinity_strict_transform_transverse_finite (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {(surfaceT O pi u a b), (surfaceX O pi u a b)})
    (P : Ideal (xChart O pi u a b)) [P.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime]
    (hx : xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b) ∈ P) (hW : xSlope O pi u a b ∈ P) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P ⧸ Ideal.span
          {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
            algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
              xSlope O pi u a b ^ (d - i.val))} =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
            algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
              xSlope O pi u a b ^ (d - i.val))})
          (completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))) * w) ∧
    Function.Injective
      (fun w : CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P ⧸ Ideal.span
          {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))} =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span
            {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))})
          (completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
            algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
              xSlope O pi u a b ^ (d - i.val))) * w) ∧
    ∃ L : ℕ, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
        (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)))^L ≤
      finiteLocalCurveIdeal (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))
        (completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
          algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            xSlope O pi u a b ^ (d - i.val))) 1
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isLocalRing O pi u a b hpi.not_isUnit ha
  obtain ⟨hP, -, hN, ⟨hLoc, -⟩, hreg⟩ :=
      concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha P hx hW
  obtain ⟨Eq, hb, hs, -⟩ := x_chart_infinity_completion_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha P hP
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_T_equiv O pi hpi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a (by omega)
  obtain ⟨e0, he0⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  have h461 := concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha
  let κ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField O :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq h461).trans e0
  have hκ : ∀ s : TwoSeries O,
      κ (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
      IsLocalRing.residue O (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s) := fun s => by
    change e0 (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq h461 (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (surfaceMk O pi u a b s))) = _
    rw [Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
    exact he0 s
  have hxT : Eq (completedPointMap _ P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
      surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a := by
    have h := hb (axisX O)
    rwa [(chartSubst_apply_generators O 0).2.2.2.2.2.1] at h
  let Ψ : xChart O pi u a b →+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :=
    q.toRingHom.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (Eq.toRingHom.comp (completedPointMap _ P)))
  have hΨc : ∀ r, Ψ (algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) r) =
      PowerSeries.C (κ (IsLocalRing.residue _ r)) := fun r => by
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
    change q (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Eq (completedPointMap _ P (xBase O pi u a b
        (surfaceMk O pi u a b s))))) = _
    rw [hb, hq, residueKillT_xChartSubst O pi hpi]; exact congrArg _ (hκ s).symm
  have hΨW : Ψ (xSlope O pi u a b) = PowerSeries.X := by
    change q (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Eq (completedPointMap _ P _))) = _
    rw [hs, show surfaceX O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a = surfaceMk _ _ _ _ _ (axisX O) from rfl,
      hq, (residueKillT_apply_ker O pi hpi).2.2.1]
  set S := CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) P
  set e := completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))
  set g := completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) P
      (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
          xSlope O pi u a b ^ (d - i.val))
  have hmap : Ideal.map Eq (Ideal.span {e}) = Ideal.span
      {surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a} := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hxT]
  let e1 : (S ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) ≃+*
      (ConcreteSurface O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a ⧸ Ideal.span
        {surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a}) :=
    Ideal.quotientEquiv (Ideal.span {e})
        (Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a}) Eq hmap.symm
  obtain ⟨k1, k2, L, hL'⟩ := transverse_of_reduction_ne_zero S e g hreg
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (e1.trans q) (by
      change Ψ (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
        xSlope O pi u a b ^ (d - i.val)) ≠ 0
      simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, hΨc, hΨW]
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hne
      refine sum_C_mul_X_pow_ne_zero d _ ⟨i, ?_⟩
      rwa [Ne, map_eq_zero_iff κ κ.injective, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, h461])
  refine ⟨k1, k2, L, ?_⟩
  unfold finiteLocalCurveIdeal
  rw [pow_one]
  convert hL' using 2
  all_goals exact (AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map (R := Localization.AtPrime P)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_X_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mvPowerSeries_X_ne_zero {σ A : Type} [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A] (s : σ) :
    (MvPowerSeries.X s : MvPowerSeries σ A) ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  simpa [h] using MvPowerSeries.coeff_index_single_self_X (R := A) s

name: SurfaceBlowup.monomialIdeal_mem_iff
statement:
theorem monomialIdeal_mem_iff (k : Type) [CommRing k] (a b : ℕ) (φ : TwoSeries k) :
    φ ∈ monomialIdeal k a b ↔ ∀ m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, ¬(a ≤ m 0 ∧ b ≤ m 1) →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff m φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  set n₀ : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 a + Finsupp.single 1 b with hn₀
  have hgen : axisT k ^ a * axisX k ^ b = MvPowerSeries.monomial n₀ (1 : k) := by
    simp only [axisT, axisX, MvPowerSeries.X_pow_eq, MvPowerSeries.monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul,
      hn₀]
  have hle : ∀ m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, n₀ ≤ m ↔ (a ≤ m 0 ∧ b ≤ m 1) := by
    intro m
    rw [Finsupp.le_def, Fin.forall_fin_two]
    simp [hn₀]
  unfold monomialIdeal
  rw [hgen, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩ m hm
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial_mul, if_neg (by rwa [hle])]
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) k,
        ∀ m, MvPowerSeries.coeff m ψ = MvPowerSeries.coeff (m + n₀) φ :=
      ⟨fun m ↦ MvPowerSeries.coeff (m + n₀) φ, fun m ↦ rfl⟩
    refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
    ext m
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial_mul, one_mul]
    split_ifs with hm
    · rw [hψ, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hm]
    · exact h m (by rwa [hle] at hm)

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_fin_two_mem_variableIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mvPowerSeries_fin_two_mem_variableIdeal_iff (A : Type) [CommRing A]
    (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A) :
    g ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A), MvPowerSeries.X 1} ↔
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (pow_one (Ideal.span {axisT A, axisX A}) ▸ axis_ideal_pow_mem_iff A 1 g).trans
    ⟨fun h ↦ h 0 (by simp), fun h m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain rfl : m = 0 := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp <;> omega
  exact h

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_fin_two_split_of_constantCoeff_zero
statement:
private theorem mvPowerSeries_fin_two_split_of_constantCoeff_zero (A : Type) [CommRing A]
    (s t : Fin 2)
    (hst : s ≠ t) (h : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A) (h0 : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff h = 0) :
    ∃ h₁ q : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A, h = MvPowerSeries.X t * h₁ + MvPowerSeries.X s * q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ :=
    Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp ((mvPowerSeries_fin_two_mem_variableIdeal_iff A h).2 h0)
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : s = 0 ∧ t = 1 ∨ s = 1 ∧ t = 0 := by omega
  exacts [⟨b, a, by ring⟩, ⟨a, b, by ring⟩]

name: SurfaceBlowup.constantCoeff_residue_ker
statement:
private theorem constantCoeff_residue_ker (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) :
    RingHom.ker ((IsLocalRing.residue O).comp (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : TwoSeries O →+* O)) =
    Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O), axisT O, axisX O}
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ g : TwoSeries O,
      g ∈ RingHom.ker
          ((IsLocalRing.residue O).comp (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : TwoSeries O →+* O)) ↔
        pi ∣ MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff g := by
    intro g
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hpi.maximalIdeal_eq,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  ext g
  rw [key]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    have h2 : g - MvPowerSeries.C (pi * c) ∈
        Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) O), MvPowerSeries.X 1} := by
      rw [mvPowerSeries_fin_two_mem_variableIdeal_iff]
      simp [hc]
    have h3 : g = MvPowerSeries.C pi * MvPowerSeries.C c + (g - MvPowerSeries.C (pi * c)) := by
      rw [map_mul]; ring
    rw [h3]
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))) ?_
    refine Ideal.span_mono (fun y hy ↦ ?_) h2
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl <;> simp [axisT, axisX]
  · intro h
    have : Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O), axisT O, axisX O} ≤
        RingHom.ker ((IsLocalRing.residue O).comp
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : TwoSeries O →+* O)) := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      intro y hy
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, key]
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [axisT, axisX]
    exact (key g).1 (this h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_var_dvd_of_var_dvd_mul
statement:
private theorem mvPowerSeries_var_dvd_of_var_dvd_mul (σ A : Type) [CommRing A] (s : σ)
    (P h : MvPowerSeries σ A) (hP : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff P ∈ nonZeroDivisors A)
    (hdvd : (MvPowerSeries.X s : MvPowerSeries σ A) ∣ P * h) :
    (MvPowerSeries.X s : MvPowerSeries σ A) ∣ h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff] at hdvd ⊢
  intro m
  induction m using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | _ e he =>
  intro hes
  have key := hdvd e hes
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (0, e),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff] at key
  · exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left.mp hP) _ key
  · rintro ⟨u, v⟩ huv hne
    have hsum : u + v = e := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp huv
    have hu : u ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp_all
    have hlt : v < e := lt_of_le_of_ne (hsum ▸ le_add_self) fun hve ↦
      hu (add_eq_right.mp (hsum.trans hve.symm))
    have hvs : v s = 0 := by
      have := DFunLike.congr_fun hsum s
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at this
      omega
    simp [he v hlt hvs]
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_quotient_var_regular
statement:
theorem mvPowerSeries_quotient_var_regular (σ A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (s : σ)
    (P : MvPowerSeries σ A) (hP : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff P ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective
    (fun g : MvPowerSeries σ A ⧸ Ideal.span {P} ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P})
      (MvPowerSeries.X s) * g)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  obtain ⟨g', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
  simp only [← map_mul] at hab
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← mul_sub] at hab
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hab
  have hX : (MvPowerSeries.X s : MvPowerSeries σ A) ∣ P * h := ⟨g - g', hh.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, rfl⟩ := mvPowerSeries_var_dvd_of_var_dvd_mul σ A s P h
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hP) hX
  exact ⟨h1, mul_left_cancel₀ (mvPowerSeries_X_ne_zero s) (by rw [hh]; ring)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_var_dvd_of_var_dvd_other_var_mul
statement:
private theorem mvPowerSeries_var_dvd_of_var_dvd_other_var_mul (σ A : Type) [CommRing A] (s t : σ)
    (hst : s ≠ t) (w : MvPowerSeries σ A)
    (hdvd : (MvPowerSeries.X t : MvPowerSeries σ A) ∣ MvPowerSeries.X s * w) :
    (MvPowerSeries.X t : MvPowerSeries σ A) ∣ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff] at hdvd ⊢
  intro m hm
  have h := hdvd (m + Finsupp.single s 1) (by simp [hm, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hst.symm])
  rw [MvPowerSeries.X, MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial_mul] at h
  simpa using h

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_fin_two_quotient_var_regular_mod_var
statement:
theorem mvPowerSeries_fin_two_quotient_var_regular_mod_var (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (s t : Fin 2) (hst : s ≠ t) (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A)
    (hP : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff P ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective
    (fun g : (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A ⧸ Ideal.span {P}) ⧸ Ideal.span
      {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P}) (MvPowerSeries.X s)} => Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P}) (MvPowerSeries.X s)})
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P}) (MvPowerSeries.X t)) * g)
proof:
:= by
  set I := Ideal.span {P}
  set J := Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPowerSeries.X s)}
  
  have key : ∀ g : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk J (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPowerSeries.X t * g)) = 0 →
      Ideal.Quotient.mk J (Ideal.Quotient.mk I g) = 0 := by
    intro g hg
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hg
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := hg
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r'
    rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hr'
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hr'
    
    have h0 : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff h = 0 := by
      simpa [MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_X, hP] using congrArg MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff hh
    obtain ⟨h₁, q, rfl⟩ :=
      mvPowerSeries_fin_two_split_of_constantCoeff_zero A s t hst h h0
    have hdvd : (MvPowerSeries.X t : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A) ∣
        MvPowerSeries.X s * (P * q - r) :=
      ⟨-(g + P * h₁), by linear_combination hh⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
      mvPowerSeries_var_dvd_of_var_dvd_other_var_mul (Fin 2) A s t hst _ hdvd
    have hg : g = P * (-h₁) + MvPowerSeries.X s * (-w) := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (mvPowerSeries_X_ne_zero t)
      linear_combination hh - MvPowerSeries.X s * hw
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I (-w), ?_⟩
    rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    exact ⟨h₁, by rw [hg]; ring⟩
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a'
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b'
  simp only at hab
  rw [← sub_eq_zero] at hab ⊢
  rw [← map_sub, ← map_sub]
  apply key
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_sub, map_sub]
  linear_combination hab

name: SurfaceBlowup.nilpotentEval_apply_generators
statement:
theorem nilpotentEval_apply_generators (O S : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing S] (φ : O →+* S)
    (e z : S) (he : IsNilpotent e) (hz : IsNilpotent z) :
    (∀ c : O, nilpotentEval φ e z he hz (MvPowerSeries.C c) = φ c) ∧
    nilpotentEval φ e z he hz (axisT O) = e ∧ nilpotentEval φ e z he hz (axisX O) = z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun c ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [nilpotentEval, MvPowerSeries.map_C]
  · simp only [nilpotentEval, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, axisT, RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe,
      MvPowerSeries.coe_substAlgHom, Function.comp_apply, MvPowerSeries.map_X]
    rw [MvPowerSeries.subst_X (nilpotentFamily_hasSubst e z he hz)]
    simp [nilpotentFamily]
  · simp only [nilpotentEval, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, axisX, RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe,
      MvPowerSeries.coe_substAlgHom, Function.comp_apply, MvPowerSeries.map_X]
    rw [MvPowerSeries.subst_X (nilpotentFamily_hasSubst e z he hz)]
    simp [nilpotentFamily]

name: SurfaceBlowup.residueSeries_ker
statement:
private theorem residueSeries_ker (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) :
    RingHom.ker (residueSeries O) = Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O)}
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ g : TwoSeries O, residueSeries O g = 0 ↔ ∀ m, pi ∣ MvPowerSeries.coeff m g := by
    intro g
    unfold residueSeries
    rw [MvPowerSeries.ext_iff]
    refine forall_congr' fun m ↦ ?_
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_map, map_zero, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff,
      hpi.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  ext g
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, key, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro h
    choose q hq using h
    let Q : TwoSeries O := q
    refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
    ext m
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, hq m]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩ m
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
    exact dvd_mul_right _ _

name: SurfaceBlowup.residueSeries_surjective
statement:
private theorem residueSeries_surjective (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] :
    Function.Surjective (residueSeries O)
proof:
:= by
  intro ψ
  refine ⟨fun m ↦
    Classical.choose (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := O) (MvPowerSeries.coeff m ψ)), ?_⟩
  ext m
  have := Classical.choose_spec (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := O) (MvPowerSeries.coeff m ψ))
  exact (MvPowerSeries.coeff_map (IsLocalRing.residue O) m _).trans this

name: SurfaceBlowup.residueSeries_comp_monomial_ker
statement:
private theorem residueSeries_comp_monomial_ker (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (a b : ℕ) :
    RingHom.ker
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)).comp (residueSeries O)) =
    Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O), axisT O ^ a * axisX O ^ b}
proof:
:= by
  have hker := residueSeries_ker O pi hpi
  have hmono : residueSeries O (axisT O ^ a * axisX O ^ b) =
      axisT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ a * axisX (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ b := by
    simp [residueSeries, axisT, axisX, MvPowerSeries.map_X]
  ext g
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, monomialIdeal,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton', Ideal.mem_span_pair]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := residueSeries_surjective O ψ
    have h0 : g - q * (axisT O ^ a * axisX O ^ b) ∈ RingHom.ker (residueSeries O) := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_mul, hq, hmono, ← hψ, mul_comm, sub_self]
    rw [hker, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at h0
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h0
    exact ⟨c, q, by rw [hc]; ring⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, q, hcq⟩
    refine ⟨residueSeries O q, ?_⟩
    have h1 : residueSeries O (MvPowerSeries.C pi) = 0 := by
      rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    rw [← hcq, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, h1, hmono]; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_killT
statement:
private theorem coeff_killT (O : Type) [CommRing O] (g : TwoSeries O) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (killT O g) = MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 n) g
proof:
:=
  coeff_substAlgHom_kill O _ (killTFamily_hasSubst O) 0 1 (by decide) rfl rfl g n

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_residueKillT
statement:
private theorem coeff_residueKillT (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (g : TwoSeries O)
    (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (residueKillT O g) =
      IsLocalRing.residue O (MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 n) g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_killT]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.residueKillT_apply_ker
statement:
theorem residueKillT_apply_ker (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) :
    (∀ c : O, residueKillT O (MvPowerSeries.C c) = PowerSeries.C (IsLocalRing.residue O c)) ∧
    residueKillT O (axisT O) = 0 ∧ residueKillT O (axisX O) = PowerSeries.X ∧
