    Function.Surjective (residueKillT O) ∧
    RingHom.ker (residueKillT O) = Ideal.span {MvPowerSeries.C pi, axisT O}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun c ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillT]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn; simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
    · simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, PowerSeries.coeff_C, hn]
  · ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillT]
    simp [axisT, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, Finsupp.single_eq_single_iff]
  · ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillT]
    by_cases hn : n = 1
    · subst hn; simp [axisX, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
    · simp [axisX, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, PowerSeries.coeff_X, hn, Finsupp.single_eq_single_iff]
  · intro h
    let g : TwoSeries O := fun m ↦
      if m 0 = 0 then (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (PowerSeries.coeff (m 1) h)).choose else 0
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    ext n
    rw [coeff_residueKillT]
    change IsLocalRing.residue O (if _ then _ else _) = _
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    exact (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (PowerSeries.coeff n h)).choose_spec
  · ext g
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, axisT, mvPowerSeries_mem_span_C_var_iff]
    have hm : ∀ x : O, IsLocalRing.residue O x = 0 ↔ pi ∣ x := by
      intro x
      rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hpi.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hg m hm0
      have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff (m 1)) hg
      rw [coeff_residueKillT, map_zero, hm] at this
      have hmeq : Finsupp.single 1 (m 1) = m := by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hm0]
      rwa [hmeq] at this
    · intro hg
      ext n
      rw [coeff_residueKillT, map_zero, hm]
      exact hg _ (by simp)

name: SurfaceBlowup.pointCount_eval
statement:
theorem pointCount_eval (δ : ℕ) (q : ℚ) :
    (pointCount δ).eval q = (1/(δ:ℚ)) * ∑ j ∈ δ.divisors, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ) *
    q ^ (δ / j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pointCount
  rw [Expr.eval, Expr.eval, expression_sum_eval, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_map_toList]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro j _
  simp [Expr.eval, expression_pow_eval]

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_root_unique_of_derivative_isUnit
statement:
theorem polynomial_root_unique_of_derivative_isUnit (S : Type) [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    (f : Polynomial S) (x y : S) (hx : Polynomial.eval x f = 0) (hy : Polynomial.eval y f = 0)
    (hxy : y - x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
    (hd : IsUnit (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.derivative f))) :
    y = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Polynomial.binomExpansion f x (y - x)
  have hy' : x + (y - x) = y := by ring
  rw [hy', hy, hx] at hk
  have h0 : (y - x) * (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.derivative f) + k * (y - x)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination -hk
  have hw : IsUnit (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.derivative f) + k * (y - x)) := by
    by_contra hn
    have h := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).sub_mem ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hn)
      (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ k hxy)
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp (by rwa [add_sub_cancel_right] at h) hd
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hw.mul_left_eq_zero.mp h0)

name: SurfaceBlowup.powerSeries_quotient_X_pow_length
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow, ← PowerSeries.maximalIdeal_eq_span_X]
  exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.length_quotient_pow_maximalIdeal _ r

name: SurfaceBlowup.powerSeries_quotient_length_eq_order
statement:
theorem powerSeries_quotient_length_eq_order (k : Type) [Field k] (g : PowerSeries k) :
    Module.length (PowerSeries k) (PowerSeries k ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) = g.order ∧
    (Function.Injective (fun w : PowerSeries k ↦ g * w) ↔ g ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hg : g = 0
    · subst hg
      rw [PowerSeries.order_zero]
      refine ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge.mpr (fun r ↦ ?_)
      have hle : Ideal.span {(0 : PowerSeries k)} ≤
          Ideal.span {(PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ r} := by
        rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]; exact dvd_zero _
      rw [← powerSeries_quotient_X_pow_length k r]
      exact Module.length_le_of_surjective (Submodule.factor hle) (Submodule.factor_surjective hle)
    · have hu : IsUnit (PowerSeries.divXPowOrder g) := by
        rw [PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
        exact PowerSeries.constantCoeff_divXPowOrder_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr hg
      have hspan : Ideal.span {g} =
          Ideal.span {(PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ g.order.toNat} := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← PowerSeries.X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder (f := g)]
        exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hu _
      rw [hspan, powerSeries_quotient_X_pow_length k,
        ENat.natCast_toNat (PowerSeries.order_eq_top.not.mpr hg)]
  · refine ⟨fun h hg ↦ ?_, mul_right_injective₀⟩
    subst hg
    exact one_ne_zero (h (show (0 : PowerSeries k) * 1 = 0 * 0 by simp))

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_basis_family_lift_along_reduction
statement:
theorem residue_basis_family_lift_along_reduction (O M Q : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module O M] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module O Q] (pi : O) (q : M →ₗ[O] Q) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hkq : ∀ m : M, q m = 0 ↔ ∃ w : M, m = pi • w) {N : ℕ} (γ : Fin N → Q)
    (hγ : ResidueBasisFamily pi γ) :
    ∃ β : Fin N → M, (∀ i, q (β i) = γ i) ∧ ResidueBasisFamily pi β
proof:
:= by
  choose β hβ using fun i ↦ hq (γ i)
  refine ⟨β, hβ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨z, m', h⟩ := hγ.1 (q m)
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hq m'
    have h0 : q (m - ((∑ i, z i • β i) + pi • m₀)) = 0 := by
      simp [map_sum, hβ, hm₀, ← h]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hkq _).1 h0
    refine ⟨z, m₀ + w, ?_⟩
    rw [smul_add, ← add_assoc, ← hw]
    abel
  · intro z ⟨w, hw⟩
    apply hγ.2 z
    refine ⟨q w, ?_⟩
    have := congrArg q hw
    simpa [map_sum, hβ] using this

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_basis_family_linearIndependent
statement:
private theorem residue_basis_family_linearIndependent (O M : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module O M] (pi : O) [IsHausdorff (Ideal.span {pi}) O] (hreg : ∀ m : M, pi • m = 0 → m = 0)
    {N : ℕ} (β : Fin N → M) (hβ : ResidueBasisFamily pi β) :
    LinearIndependent O β
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  have hregk : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ m : M, pi ^ k • m = 0 → m = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro m h; simpa using h
    | succ k ih =>
      intro m h
      rw [pow_succ, mul_smul] at h
      exact hreg m (ih _ h)
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i, pi ^ k ∣ g i := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro i; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      choose y hy using ih
      have hsum : ∑ i, y i • β i = 0 := by
        apply hregk k
        rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        simp_rw [smul_smul, ← hy]
        exact hg
      have hdiv := hβ.2 y ⟨0, by rw [hsum, smul_zero]⟩
      intro i
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdiv i
      exact ⟨c, by rw [hy i, hc, pow_succ, mul_assoc]⟩
  intro i
  apply IsHausdorff.haus (I := Ideal.span {pi}) (M := O) inferInstance
  intro n
  rw [SModEq.zero, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact key n i

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_basis_family_of_simple_quotient
statement:
private theorem residue_basis_family_of_simple_quotient (O B M : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing B]
    [IsLocalRing B] [Algebra O B] [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module O M] [IsScalarTower O B M]
    (pi : O) (hsurj : ∀ b : B, ∃ c : O, b - algebraMap O B c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
    (hker : ∀ c : O, algebraMap O B c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B → pi ∣ c)
    (hpiM : ∀ m : M, pi • m = 0) (M₁ : Submodule B M) [IsSimpleModule B (M ⧸ M₁)] {N : ℕ}
    (β : Fin N → M) (hβM₁ : ∀ i, β i ∈ M₁)
    (hβ : ResidueBasisFamily pi (fun i ↦ (⟨β i, hβM₁ i⟩ : M₁))) :
    ∃ γ : Fin (N+1) → M, ResidueBasisFamily pi γ
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (M ⧸ M₁) := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial B _
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M ⧸ M₁)
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective M₁ x
  have hspan := IsSimpleModule.toSpanSingleton_surjective B hx
  
  have hann (b : B) :
      b • (Submodule.Quotient.mk v : M ⧸ M₁) = 0 ↔ b ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (IsSimpleModule.ker_toSpanSingleton_isMaximal B hx),
      LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
  have hOsmul (c : O) (m : M) : c • m = algebraMap O B c • m := (algebraMap_smul B c m).symm
  refine ⟨Fin.snoc β v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hspan (Submodule.Quotient.mk m)
    rw [LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] at hb
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsurj b
    have hmem : m - c • v ∈ M₁ := by
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.eq, ← hb, hOsmul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← sub_eq_zero,
        ← sub_smul]
      exact (hann _).2 hc
    obtain ⟨z, m', hz⟩ := hβ.1 ⟨m - c • v, hmem⟩
    refine ⟨Fin.snoc z c, 0, ?_⟩
    have hz' := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower] at hz'
    rw [hpiM, add_zero] at hz'
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last, hpiM, ← hz']
  · intro z ⟨m', hm'⟩
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, hpiM] at hm'
    simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last] at hm'
    have hSmem : (∑ i : Fin N, z (Fin.castSucc i) • β i) ∈ M₁ :=
      Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (hβM₁ i))
    have hlast : pi ∣ z (Fin.last N) := by
      refine hker _ ((hann _).1 ?_)
      have h := congrArg (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := M₁)) hm'
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero M₁).mpr hSmem, zero_add,
        hOsmul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul] at h
      simpa using h
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hlast
    have hv0 : z (Fin.last N) • v = 0 := by
      rw [hy, mul_comm, mul_smul, hpiM, smul_zero]
    rw [hv0, add_zero] at hm'
    have hcast := hβ.2 (fun i ↦ z (Fin.castSucc i)) ⟨0, by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, smul_zero,
        Submodule.coe_zero]
      exact hm'⟩
    exact fun i ↦ Fin.lastCases ⟨y, hy⟩ hcast i

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_basis_family_of_length
statement:
theorem residue_basis_family_of_length (O B M : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    [Algebra O B] [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module O M] [IsScalarTower O B M] (pi : O)
    (hsurj : ∀ b : B, ∃ c : O, b - algebraMap O B c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
    (hker : ∀ c : O, algebraMap O B c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B → pi ∣ c)
    (hpiM : ∀ m : M, pi • m = 0) (N : ℕ) (hN : Module.length B M = N) :
    ∃ β : Fin N → M, ResidueBasisFamily pi β
proof:
:= by
  induction N generalizing M with
  | zero =>
    have hs : Subsingleton M := Module.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hN)
    refine ⟨Fin.elim0, fun m ↦ ⟨Fin.elim0, 0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, fun z _ i ↦ i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have hfin : IsFiniteLength B M :=
      Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp (by rw [hN]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top _)
    have hNoeth : IsNoetherian B M := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfin).1
    have hnt : Nontrivial M := Module.length_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hN]; exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n)
    obtain ⟨M₁, hco, -⟩ := (eq_top_or_exists_le_coatom (⊥ : Submodule B M)).resolve_left bot_ne_top
    have : IsSimpleModule B (M ⧸ M₁) := (isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom).mpr hco
    have hadd := Module.length_eq_add_of_exact M₁.subtype M₁.mkQ M₁.injective_subtype
      M₁.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ M₁)
    rw [Module.length_eq_one B (M ⧸ M₁), hN] at hadd
    have hM₁ : Module.length B M₁ = n := by
      have : Module.length B M₁ ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hadd; simp at hadd
      lift Module.length B M₁ to ℕ using this with k hk
      norm_cast at hadd ⊢
      omega
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := ih M₁ (fun m ↦ Subtype.ext (by simpa using hpiM m)) hM₁
    exact residue_basis_family_of_simple_quotient O B M pi hsurj hker hpiM M₁
      (fun i ↦ (β i : M)) (fun i ↦ (β i).2) (by simpa using hβ)

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_basis_family_spans
statement:
private theorem residue_basis_family_spans (O M : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M]
    (pi : O)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) O] [IsHausdorff (Ideal.span {pi}) M] {N : ℕ} (β : Fin N → M)
    (hβ : ResidueBasisFamily pi β) :
    Submodule.span O (Set.range β) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set I : Ideal O := Ideal.span {pi} with hI
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, pi ^ n ∈ I ^ n := fun n ↦
    Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self pi) n
  have memO : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : O), pi ^ n * y ∈ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O O) := fun n y ↦
    Submodule.smul_mem_smul (hpow n) Submodule.mem_top
  choose zf mf hf using hβ.1
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun m _ ↦ ?_
  let seq : ℕ → M := fun n ↦ Nat.rec m (fun _ x ↦ mf x) n
  have seq_succ : ∀ n, seq (n + 1) = mf (seq n) := fun n ↦ rfl
  let z : ℕ → Fin N → O := fun n ↦ zf (seq n)
  let c : ℕ → Fin N → O := fun n i ↦ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, pi ^ j * z j i
  have inv : ∀ n, m = (∑ i, c n i • β i) + pi ^ n • seq n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [c, seq]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [ih, hf (seq n), seq_succ]
      simp only [c, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, smul_add,
        Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, pow_succ, add_assoc]
      rfl
  have cauchy : ∀ i, ∃ L : O, ∀ n, c n i ≡ L [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O O)] := by
    intro i
    refine IsPrecomplete.prec inferInstance ?_
    intro a b hab
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, ← neg_mem_iff, neg_sub]
    change ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, pi ^ j * z j i - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, pi ^ j * z j i ∈ _
    rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub _ hab]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj).1
    rw [pow_add, mul_assoc]
    exact memO a _
  choose L hL using cauchy
  have key : m = ∑ i, L i • β i := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    refine IsHausdorff.haus (I := I) inferInstance _ fun n ↦ ?_
    rw [SModEq.zero]
    have : m - ∑ i, L i • β i = (∑ i, (c n i - L i) • β i) + pi ^ n • seq n := by
      conv_lhs => rw [inv n]
      simp only [sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      abel
    rw [this]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_)
      (Submodule.smul_mem_smul (hpow n) Submodule.mem_top)
    have h1 := SModEq.sub_mem.mp (hL i n)
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] at h1
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul h1 Submodule.mem_top
  rw [key]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_basis_family_basis
statement:
theorem residue_basis_family_basis (O M : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M] (pi : O)
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) O] [IsHausdorff (Ideal.span {pi}) M]
    (hreg : ∀ m : M, pi • m = 0 → m = 0) {N : ℕ} (β : Fin N → M) (hβ : ResidueBasisFamily pi β) :
    ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin N) O M, ∀ i, B i = β i
proof:
:= by
  have hs := residue_basis_family_spans O M pi β hβ
  exact ⟨.mk (residue_basis_family_linearIndependent O M pi hreg β hβ) (by rw [hs]), by simp⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_sub_constantCoeff_mem_parameterIdeal
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_sub_constantCoeff_mem_parameterIdeal (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O)
    (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (s : TwoSeries O) :
    surfaceMk O pi u a b s -
    algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s) ∈
    surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b
proof:
:= by
  have h : s - MvPowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s) ∈
      Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) O), MvPowerSeries.X 1} := by
    rw [mvPowerSeries_fin_two_mem_variableIdeal_iff]
    simp
  have h2 : surfaceMk O pi u a b (s - MvPowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s)) ∈
      surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b := by
    have : Ideal.map (surfaceMk O pi u a b)
        (Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) O), MvPowerSeries.X 1}) ≤
        surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl
      · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [surfaceT, axisT])
      · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [surfaceX, axisX])
    exact this (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ h)
  convert h2 using 1
  rw [map_sub]
  congr 1

name: SurfaceBlowup.residueSeries_surfaceRelation
statement:
private theorem residueSeries_surfaceRelation (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (pi : O)
    (hpi : pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    residueSeries O (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) =
    -(residueSeries O (u : TwoSeries O) * axisT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ a *
      axisX (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ b)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : IsLocalRing.residue O pi = 0 := (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff pi).2 hpi
  have hT : residueSeries O (axisT O) = axisT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := by
    simp [residueSeries, axisT, MvPowerSeries.map_X]
  have hX : residueSeries O (axisX O) = axisX (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := by
    simp [residueSeries, axisX, MvPowerSeries.map_X]
  have hC : residueSeries O (MvPowerSeries.C pi) = 0 := by
    simp [residueSeries, MvPowerSeries.map_C, h0]
  unfold surfaceRelation
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hT, hX, hC, zero_sub]

name: SurfaceBlowup.surfaceRelation_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem surfaceRelation_constantCoeff (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) = pi
proof:
:= by
  have hT : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (axisT O) = 0 := by
    simp [axisT, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_X]
  simp [surfaceRelation, hT, ha.ne']

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_pi_regular
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_pi_regular (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective
    (fun r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ↦ algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi * r)
proof:
:= by
  set P := surfaceRelation O pi u a b
  have hmem : pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O := (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hpi.not_isUnit
  have hker := residueSeries_ker O pi hpi
  have hrel := residueSeries_surfaceRelation O pi hmem u a b
  have key : ∀ d : TwoSeries O, MvPowerSeries.C pi * d ∈ surfaceIdeal O pi u a b →
      d ∈ surfaceIdeal O pi u a b := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hd
    have h1 : residueSeries O (MvPowerSeries.C pi) = 0 := by
      rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    have h2 : residueSeries O h * residueSeries O P = 0 := by
      rw [← map_mul, hh, map_mul, h1, zero_mul]
    have hX (i : Fin 2) : (MvPowerSeries.X i : TwoSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) ≠ 0 :=
      mvPowerSeries_X_ne_zero i
    have hne : residueSeries O P ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hrel, neg_ne_zero]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (u.isUnit.map _).ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (hX 0)))
        (pow_ne_zero _ (hX 1))
    have h3 : residueSeries O h = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.1 h2).resolve_right hne
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hker] at h3
    obtain ⟨h₁, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 h3
    have hC : (MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact hpi.ne_zero (MvPowerSeries.C_injective (by simpa using h0))
    have : d = h₁ * P := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hC
      rw [← hh]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  intro r s hrs
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
  obtain ⟨g', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective s
  simp only at hrs
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  apply key
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_mul, map_sub, mul_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  exact hrs

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_base_injective
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_base_injective (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : ∀ c : O, algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c = 0 → pi ∣ c := by
    intro c hc
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPowerSeries.C c) = 0 at hc
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, surfaceIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hc
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hc
    have := congrArg (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff) hh
    simp only [surfaceRelation, axisT, axisX, map_mul, map_sub, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_C,
      map_pow, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_X, zero_pow ha.ne', mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero] at this
    exact ⟨_, by rw [← this]; ring⟩
  have step2 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ c : O, algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c = 0 → pi ^ k ∣ c := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := step1 c hc
      have h0 : algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c' = 0 := by
        apply concrete_surface_pi_regular O pi hpi u a b
        simp only
        rw [← map_mul, hc, mul_zero]
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := ih c' h0
      exact ⟨d, by ring⟩
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro c hc
  have hI : Ideal.span {pi} ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]; exact hpi.not_isUnit
  have hbot := Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (Ideal.span {pi}) hI
  have : c ∈ ⨅ k : ℕ, Ideal.span {pi} ^ k := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_iInf]
    intro k
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact step2 k c hc
  rw [hbot] at this
  exact (Ideal.mem_bot).1 this

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
    ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b, ∀ s :
    TwoSeries O, e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) (residueSeries O s)
proof:
:= by
  set k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField O
  set ψ : TwoSeries O →+* SpecialFiber k a b :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b)).comp (residueSeries O) with hψdef
  have hψs : Function.Surjective ψ :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).comp (residueSeries_surjective O)
  have hker : RingHom.ker ψ =
      Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.C pi : TwoSeries O), axisT O ^ a * axisX O ^ b} :=
    residueSeries_comp_monomial_ker O pi hpi a b
  have hmax : pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O :=
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hpi.not_isUnit
  have hle : surfaceIdeal O pi u a b ≤ RingHom.ker ψ := by
    rw [surfaceIdeal, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker,
      hψdef, RingHom.comp_apply, residueSeries_surfaceRelation O pi hmax u a b,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.neg_mem_iff, mul_assoc]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  set χ : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b →+* SpecialFiber k a b :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift (surfaceIdeal O pi u a b) ψ fun _ hx ↦ hle hx
  have hχs : Function.Surjective χ := Ideal.Quotient.lift_surjective_of_surjective _ _ hψs
  
  have hrel : surfaceMk O pi u a b (MvPowerSeries.C pi) =
      surfaceMk O pi u a b (u : TwoSeries O) *
        surfaceMk O pi u a b (axisT O ^ a * axisX O ^ b) := by
    rw [← map_mul, surfaceMk, Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hkerχ : RingHom.ker χ = Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi} := by
    rw [show RingHom.ker χ = _ from Ideal.ker_quotient_lift _ _, hker, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_pair, Set.pair_comm]
    refine Submodule.span_insert_eq_span ?_
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := u.isUnit.map (surfaceMk O pi u a b)
    refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.2 ⟨↑v⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change _ * surfaceMk O pi u a b _ = surfaceMk O pi u a b _
    rw [hrel, ← hv, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
  exact ⟨(Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hkerχ).symm.trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hχs),
    fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_equiv_curve_length_and_regular
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_equiv_curve_length_and_regular (S : Type) [CommRing S] (O' : Type)
    [CommRing O'] [IsDomain O'] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O'] (pi' : O')
    (u' : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) (a' b' : ℕ) (Eq : S ≃+* ConcreteSurface O' pi' u' a' b')
    (q : (ConcreteSurface O' pi' u' a' b' ⧸ Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) ≃+*
      PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O')) (g : S) :
    Module.length S (S ⧸ Ideal.span {g, Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')}) =
    (q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) (Eq g))).order ∧
    (Function.Injective
      (fun w : S ⧸ Ideal.span {Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')} ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Ideal.span {Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')}) g * w) ↔
      q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) (Eq g)) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  let f : S →+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') :=
    (q.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}))).comp Eq.toRingHom
  have hfs : Function.Surjective f :=
    (q.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).comp Eq.surjective
  have hfx : ∀ x, f x =
      q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) (Eq x)) := fun x ↦ rfl
  have hker : RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')} := by
    ext x
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, hfx, map_eq_zero_iff _ q.injective, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact ⟨Eq.symm c, by rw [← Eq.symm_apply_apply x, hc]; simp⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩; exact ⟨Eq c, by rw [hc]; simp⟩
  have hfe : f (Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')) = 0 := by
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨hlen, hinj⟩ := powerSeries_quotient_length_eq_order (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') (f g)
  change _ = (f g).order ∧ (_ ↔ f g ≠ 0)
  constructor
  · let _ : Algebra S (PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O')) := f.toAlgebra
    have hJ : Ideal.map f (Ideal.span {g, Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')}) =
        Ideal.span {f g} := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, hfe, Set.pair_comm, Ideal.span_insert_zero]
    let L : S →ₗ[S] (PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') ⧸ Ideal.span {f g}) :=
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ S (Ideal.span {f g})).toLinearMap ∘ₗ Algebra.linearMap S _
    have hL : Function.Surjective L := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp hfs
    have hLk : LinearMap.ker L = Ideal.span {g, Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')} := by
      ext x
      have h1 : L x = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (f x) := rfl
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, h1, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← hJ, ← Ideal.mem_comap,
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hfs, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
      rw [sup_eq_left.mpr (Ideal.span_mono (by simp))]
    rw [((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hLk.symm).trans (L.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hL)).length_eq,
      Module.length_eq_of_surjective hfs, hlen]
  · let ψ : (S ⧸ Ideal.span {Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')}) ≃+*
        PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') :=
      (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker.symm).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hfs)
    have hψ : ∀ x, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = f x := fun x ↦ rfl
    have hfun : (fun w : S ⧸ Ideal.span {Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')} ↦
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b')}) g * w) =
        ψ.symm ∘ (fun w ↦ f g * w) ∘ ψ := by
      funext w
      apply ψ.injective
      simp [map_mul, hψ]
    rw [hfun, ψ.symm.injective.of_comp_iff, Function.Injective.of_comp_iff' _ ψ.bijective, hinj]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b) ≃+*
    IsLocalRing.ResidueField O, ∀ s :
    TwoSeries O, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b) (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
    IsLocalRing.residue O (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s)
proof:
:= by
  set φ : TwoSeries O →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField O :=
    (IsLocalRing.residue O).comp (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : TwoSeries O →+* O) with hφdef
  have hpim : pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O :=
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hpi.not_isUnit
  have hφ : ∀ s : TwoSeries O, φ s = IsLocalRing.residue O (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff s) :=
    fun s ↦ rfl
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φ := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
    exact ⟨MvPowerSeries.C c, by simp [hφ]⟩
  have hkill : ∀ s ∈ surfaceIdeal O pi u a b, φ s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [surfaceIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hs
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hs
    rw [map_mul, hφ, surfaceRelation_constantCoeff O pi u a b ha,
      (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff pi).2 hpim, zero_mul]
  set ψ := Ideal.Quotient.lift (surfaceIdeal O pi u a b) φ hkill with hψdef
  have hψsurj : Function.Surjective ψ :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift_surjective_of_surjective _ _ hsurj
  have hker : RingHom.ker ψ = surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · have hk : RingHom.ker ψ = (RingHom.ker φ).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) :=
        Ideal.ker_quotient_lift φ hkill
      rw [hk, hφdef, constantCoeff_residue_ker O pi hpi,
        Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have : Ideal.Quotient.mk (surfaceIdeal O pi u a b) (MvPowerSeries.C pi) =
            surfaceMk O pi u a b ((u : TwoSeries O) * axisT O ^ a * axisX O ^ b) := by
          rw [surfaceMk, Ideal.Quotient.eq, surfaceIdeal]
          exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, this, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
        obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt ha
        apply Ideal.mul_mem_right
        apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
        apply Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ _ _ (by omega)
        exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [surfaceT])
      · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [surfaceT, surfaceMk])
      · exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [surfaceX, surfaceMk])
    · rw [surfaceParameterIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
      · simp [surfaceT, surfaceMk, hψdef, hφ, axisT]
      · simp [surfaceX, surfaceMk, hψdef, hφ, axisX]
  exact ⟨(Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker).symm.trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hψsurj),
    fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    (surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, -⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  exact Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField _ (e.toMulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField _))

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) = surfaceParameterIdeal O pi u a b
proof:
:=
  (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_residueField_equiv
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_residueField_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] :
    ∃ e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField O ≃+*
    IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b), ∀ c : O, e (IsLocalRing.residue O c) =
    IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hm := concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha
  let g : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField O :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hm).trans f
  exact ⟨g.symm, fun c ↦ g.symm_apply_eq.2
    ((hf (.C c)).trans (congrArg _ (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_C ..))).symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_spanFinrank_le_two
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_spanFinrank_le_two (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) [IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)).spanFinrank ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha]
  unfold surfaceParameterIdeal
  refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.toFinite _)).trans ?_
  calc _ ≤ Set.ncard {surfaceX O pi u a b} + 1 := Set.ncard_insert_le _ _
    _ = 2 := by rw [Set.ncard_singleton]

name: SurfaceBlowup.surfaceIdeal_ne_top
statement:
theorem surfaceIdeal_ne_top (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (hpi : ¬ IsUnit pi) (ha : 0 < a) :
    surfaceIdeal O pi u a b ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [surfaceIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top] at h
  exact hpi (surfaceRelation_constantCoeff O pi u a b ha ▸ MvPowerSeries.isUnit_constantCoeff _ h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_isLocalRing (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    [IsLocalRing O] (hpi : ¬ IsUnit pi) (ha : 0 < a) :
    IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (surfaceIdeal_ne_top O pi u a b hpi ha)
  exact IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (surfaceMk O pi u a b) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: SurfaceBlowup.contact_fiberT_eq_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
private theorem contact_fiberT_eq_zero_of_isUnit (k : Type) [Field k] (a b : ℕ)
    {fb : SpecialFiber k a b} (hu : IsUnit fb) : contact fb (fiberT k a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold contact
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)) hu]
  have : Subsingleton (SpecialFiber k a b ⧸ (⊤ : Ideal (SpecialFiber k a b))) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.2 rfl
  exact Module.length_eq_zero

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_crossing_state_atlas_exists
statement:
theorem concrete_crossing_state_atlas_exists (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hSt : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b) (hSx : S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (hSa : S.a = a)
    (hSb : S.b = b)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O,
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
      (residueSeries O s)) (c h : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∃ A : IdealAtlas O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi (a*c+b*h)
      (surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S (State.crossing a b c h)),
      Nonempty (A.ι ≃ crossingResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b c h)
proof:
:= by
  set k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField O
  have hcard := crossing_residue_ideal_count k a b c h ha hb hc hh
  have hfin : Finite (crossingResidueIdeals k a b c h) := by
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    rw [hcard]
    have : 1 < Nat.card k := Finite.one_lt_card
    have h2 : Nat.card k - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
    have h3 : 0 < Nat.card k := by omega
    positivity
  let : Fintype (crossingResidueIdeals k a b c h) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have key : ∀ I : crossingResidueIdeals k a b c h,
      ∃ ch : IdealChart O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi (a*c+b*h),
      Ideal.span
          {e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})) ch.f)}
          = I.val := by
    intro I
    obtain ⟨fb, hI, hct, hcx⟩ := I.2
    have hnu : ¬ IsUnit fb := fun hu ↦
      hc.ne' (by exact_mod_cast hct.symm.trans (contact_fiberT_eq_zero_of_isUnit k _ _ hu))
    have hreg := special_fiber_crossing_contact_regular k a b c h ha hb fb hct hcx
    have hlen := crossing_special_fiber_length k a b c h ha hb fb hct hcx
    obtain ⟨ch, hch⟩ := concrete_residue_ideal_chart_exists O pi hpi u a b ha e fb hnu hreg
        (a*c+b*h) hlen
    exact ⟨ch, by rw [hch, hI]⟩
  choose ch hch using key
  have hcov :=
      concrete_crossing_state_eq_union_cells O pi u a b ha hb S hSt hSx hSa hSb e he c h hc
      hh (fun I => (ch I).f) hch
  exact ⟨{ ι := crossingResidueIdeals k a b c h, chart := ch, cover := hcov.1, disjoint := hcov.2 },
        ⟨Equiv.refl _⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_single_state_atlas_exists
statement:
theorem concrete_single_state_atlas_exists (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0))
    (hSt : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a 0) (hSa : S.a = a) (hSb : S.b = 0)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0 ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O,
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})
      (surfaceMk O pi u a 0 s)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0)
      (residueSeries O s)) (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ A : IdealAtlas O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi (a*c)
      (surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) S (State.single a c)),
      Nonempty (A.ι ≃ singleResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a c)
proof:
:= by
  set k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField O
  have hcard := single_residue_ideal_count k a c ha
  have hfin : Finite (singleResidueIdeals k a c) := by
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    rw [hcard]
    have : 0 < Nat.card k := Nat.card_pos
    positivity
  let : Fintype (singleResidueIdeals k a c) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have key : ∀ I : singleResidueIdeals k a c,
      ∃ ch : IdealChart O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi (a*c),
      Ideal.span
          {e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})) ch.f)}
          = I.val := by
    intro I
    obtain ⟨fb, hI, hct⟩ := I.2
    have hnu : ¬ IsUnit fb := fun hu ↦
      hc.ne' (by exact_mod_cast hct.symm.trans (contact_fiberT_eq_zero_of_isUnit k _ _ hu))
    have hreg := special_fiber_single_contact_regular k a c ha fb hct
    have hlen := single_special_fiber_length k a c ha fb hct
    obtain ⟨ch, hch⟩ := concrete_residue_ideal_chart_exists O pi hpi u a 0 ha e fb hnu hreg
        (a*c) hlen
    exact ⟨ch, by rw [hch, hI]⟩
  choose ch hch using key
  have hcov := concrete_single_state_eq_union_cells O pi u a ha S hSt hSa hSb e he c hc
      (fun I => (ch I).f) hch
  exact ⟨{ ι := singleResidueIdeals k a c, chart := ch, cover := hcov.1, disjoint := hcov.2 },
        ⟨Equiv.refl _⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap (r : R) : chartBase R t x r = algebraMap R
    (BlowupChart R t x) r
proof: := rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebraMap_sum_eq_left
statement:
private theorem algebraMap_sum_eq_left (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (d + 1) → R) :
    algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) (∑ i : Fin (d+1), c i * t^(d - i.val) * x^i.val) =
      (chartBase R t x t)^d * ∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) (c i) *
        (chartSlope R t x)^i.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  have hx : algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) x = chartBase R t x t * chartSlope R t x :=
    (blowup_chart_relation R t x).symm
  have hd : (chartBase R t x t)^d = (chartBase R t x t)^(d - i.val) *
      (chartBase R t x t)^i.val := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt)]
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hx, hd]; simp only [← chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebraMap_sum_eq_right
statement:
private theorem algebraMap_sum_eq_right (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (d + 1) → R) :
    algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) (∑ i : Fin (d+1), c i * t^(d - i.val) * x^i.val) =
      (chartBase R x t x)^d * ∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) (c i) *
        (chartSlope R x t)^(d - i.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  have ht : algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) t = chartBase R x t x * chartSlope R x t :=
    (blowup_chart_relation R x t).symm
  have hd : (chartBase R x t x)^d = (chartBase R x t x)^(d - i.val) *
      (chartBase R x t x)^i.val := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt)]
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, ht, hd]; simp only [← chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.span_pow_mul_colon_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hed : IsLeftRegular (e^d) := IsLeftRegular.pow d (show IsLeftRegular e from he)
  ext y
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mem_span_singleton,
        Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z, hed ?_⟩
    simp only
    rw [mul_comm (e^d) y, hz]; ring
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z, by ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.strictTransformAt_span_eq
statement:
private theorem strictTransformAt_span_eq (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsPrime] (d : ℕ)
    (f : R) (F : BlowupChart R t x)
    (hF : algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) f = (chartBase R t x t) ^ d * F)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun y : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) P =>
      completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) P (chartBase R t x t) * y)) :
    strictTransformAt R t x P d (Ideal.span {f}) =
      Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) P F}
proof:
:= by
  unfold strictTransformAt
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, RingHom.comp_apply, chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap, hF,
        map_mul, map_pow]
  exact span_pow_mul_colon_eq _ _ d he

name: SurfaceBlowup.quot_ext_eq
statement:
private theorem quot_ext_eq {S : Type} [CommRing S] (I P1 P2 : Ideal S) (h1 : I ≤ P1) (h2 : I ≤ P2)
    (h : P1.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = P2.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) : P1 = P2
proof:
:= by
  have k : ∀ P : Ideal S,
      I ≤ P → (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = P := by
    intro P hP
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      Ideal.mk_ker]
    exact sup_eq_left.mpr hP
  rw [← k P1 h1, ← k P2 h2, h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.localization_map_maximal
statement:
private theorem localization_map_maximal {A S : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (z : A)
    [IsLocalization.Away z S] (P : Ideal A) [hP : P.IsMaximal]
    (hz : z ∉ P) : (P.map (algebraMap A S)).IsMaximal ∧ (P.map (algebraMap A S)).comap
      (algebraMap A S) = P
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint ((Submonoid.powers z : Submonoid A) : Set A) P := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩ hn
    exact hz (hP.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem n hn)
  have hu := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers z) S hP.isPrime hdisj
  refine ⟨?_, hu⟩
  rw [Ideal.isMaximal_def]
  refine ⟨fun htop => hP.ne_top ?_, fun J hJ => ?_⟩
  · rw [← hu, htop]; exact Ideal.comap_top
  · have hlt : P < J.under A := by
      rw [← hu]
      exact (IsLocalization.orderEmbedding (Submonoid.powers z) S).strictMono hJ
    have htop : J.under A = ⊤ := hP.out.2 _ hlt
    rw [← IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers z) S J, htop, Ideal.map_top]

name: SurfaceBlowup.reduction_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem reduction_ne_zero [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
        (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (d+1) → R) (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d+1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {t, x}) :
    e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) (c i) *
        (chartSlope R t x)^i.val)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := hne
  intro h
  apply hi0
  have h2 := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p i0.val) h
  simp only [← chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, he, heZ,
        Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,
    Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at h2
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i0] at h2
  · simpa [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using h2
  · intro j _ hj
    rw [if_neg]
    intro hv; exact hj (Fin.ext hv.symm)
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.transport_finite
statement:
private theorem transport_finite {A : Type} [CommRing A] (z : A) (Q : Ideal (Localization.Away z))
    [Q.IsPrime] (Φ : CompletedLocalAt (Localization.Away z) Q ≃+*
      CompletedLocalAt A (Q.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away z))))
    (hΦ : ∀ a, Φ (completedPointMap _ Q (algebraMap A _ a)) = completedPointMap A _ a) (e : A)
    (g : CompletedLocalAt A (Q.comap (algebraMap A _)))
    (h : ∃ L, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap (algebraMap A _)))).map
      (localCompletionMap _)) ^ L ≤ finiteLocalCurveIdeal A _ e g 1) :
    ∃ L, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)).map (localCompletionMap _)) ^ L ≤
      finiteLocalCurveIdeal _ Q (algebraMap A _ e) (Φ.symm g) 1
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_pow_le_span_pair_transport _ isUnit_one ?_ ?_ h 1
  · rw [mul_one, RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]; exact (hΦ e).symm
  rw [Ideal.map_symm, ← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion Q,
    ← map_maximalIdeal_localCompletion_transport _ _ Q Φ hΦ]
  exact Ideal.map_mono (Ideal.map_mono (IsLocalization.map_under (.powers z) _ Q).ge)

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartExceptional_le
statement:
private theorem chartExceptional_le (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x))
    (hP : chartBase R t x t ∈ P) : chartExceptional R t x ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartExceptional
  rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]; exact hP

name: SurfaceBlowup.points_finite
statement:
private theorem points_finite [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
        (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (F : BlowupChart R t x) (hF : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) F) ≠ 0) :
    Finite {Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) // Q.IsMaximal ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ∈ Q ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) F ∈ Q}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Ideal.Quotient.field (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R))
  set g := e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) F) with hg
  have key : ∀ Q : {Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) // Q.IsMaximal ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ∈ Q ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) F ∈ Q},
      ∃ φ ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors g,
        ((Q.1.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).map
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {φ} := by
    rintro ⟨Q, hQm, hQt, hQF⟩
    have := hQm
    obtain ⟨hPm, -, hPt⟩ := overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal R t x Q hQt
    have := hPm
    obtain ⟨ψ, -, hirr, hmap, -, -⟩ := blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial R t x e he heZ
      (Q.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))) hPt
    have hmem : g ∈ Ideal.span {ψ} := by
      rw [← hmap]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hQF)
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hassoc⟩ :=
        UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd hF hirr hmem
    refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
    rw [hmap]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mpr hassoc
  choose φ hφ hφeq using key
  refine Finite.of_injective (β := (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors g).toFinset)
    (fun Q => ⟨φ Q, Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr (hφ Q)⟩) ?_
  intro Q1 Q2 h12
  have h12' : φ Q1 = φ Q2 := congrArg Subtype.val h12
  have hmaps := (hφeq Q1).trans (h12' ▸ (hφeq Q2).symm)
  rw [← Ideal.comap_symm, ← Ideal.comap_symm] at hmaps
  have hmaps' := Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ e.symm.surjective hmaps
  have ht : ∀ Q : {Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) // Q.IsMaximal ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ∈ Q ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) F ∈ Q},
      chartExceptional R t x ≤ Q.1.comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) :=
    fun Q => chartExceptional_le t x _ Q.2.2.1
  have hc := quot_ext_eq _ _ _ (ht Q1) (ht Q2) hmaps'
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)) (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q1.1,
    ← IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers (chartSlope R t x)) (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q2.1]
  exact congrArg _ hc

name: SurfaceBlowup.zero_points_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem zero_points_subsingleton [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
        (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (F : BlowupChart R t x) :
    Subsingleton {P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) // P.IsMaximal ∧ chartBase R t x t ∈ P ∧
      chartSlope R t x ∈ P ∧ F ∈ P}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  have key : ∀ P : {P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) // P.IsMaximal ∧ chartBase R t x t ∈ P ∧
      chartSlope R t x ∈ P ∧ F ∈ P},
      (P.1.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e = Ideal.span {Polynomial.X} := by
    rintro ⟨P, hPm, hPt, hPZ, -⟩
    have := hPm
    obtain ⟨ψ, -, -, hmap, hZ, -⟩ := blowup_chart_exceptional_point_polynomial R t x e he heZ P hPt
    rw [hmap, hZ.mp hPZ]
  intro P1 P2
  have hmaps := (key P1).trans (key P2).symm
  rw [← Ideal.comap_symm, ← Ideal.comap_symm] at hmaps
  have hmaps' := Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ e.symm.surjective hmaps
  exact Subtype.ext
      (quot_ext_eq _ _ _ (chartExceptional_le t x _ P1.2.2.1)
        (chartExceptional_le t x _ P2.2.2.1) hmaps')

name: SurfaceBlowup.overlap_relation
statement:
private theorem overlap_relation (d : ℕ) (f : R) (FA : BlowupChart R t x) (FB : BlowupChart R x t)
    (hFA : algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) f = (chartBase R t x t) ^ d * FA)
    (hFB : algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) f = (chartBase R x t x) ^ d * FB)
    (hreg : Function.Injective (fun y : BlowupOverlap R t x =>
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) * y)) :
    algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) FA =
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) ^ d *
        beta.right FB
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLeftRegular.pow d (show IsLeftRegular _ from hreg)
  have h1 : algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
      (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) f) = beta.right (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) f) := by
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  have hx : beta.right (chartBase R x t x) =
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) *
        algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x) := by
    rw [← map_mul, blowup_chart_relation, chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap,
      chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  simp only
  rw [hFA, hFB, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hx] at h1
  rw [h1]; ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.right_common_point_span
statement:
private theorem right_common_point_span (d : ℕ) (FA : BlowupChart R t x)
    (FB : BlowupChart R x t)
    (hrel : algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) FA =
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) ^ d *
        beta.right FB)
    (Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)) [hQ : Q.IsMaximal]
    (hQF : algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) FA ∈ Q)
    (Ψ : CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q ≃+*
      CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom))
    (hΨ : ∀ b : BlowupChart R x t, Ψ (completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q (beta.right b)) =
      completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom) b) :
    Ideal.span {Ψ (completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) Q
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) FA))} =
      Ideal.span {completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom) FB} ∧
      beta.right FB ∈ Q
proof:
:= by
  have hZu : IsUnit ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
      (chartSlope R t x)) ^ d) := (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _).pow d
  rw [hrel] at hQF ⊢
  refine ⟨?_, (hQ.isPrime.mem_or_mem hQF).resolve_left
    fun h => hQ.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h hZu)⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, hΨ]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit ((hZu.map _).map Ψ) _

name: SurfaceBlowup.right_point_of_overlap
statement:
private theorem right_point_of_overlap (d : ℕ) (FA : BlowupChart R t x) (FB : BlowupChart R x t)
    (hrel : algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) FA =
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) ^ d *
        beta.right FB)
    (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t)) [P.IsMaximal] (hPx : chartBase R x t x ∈ P) (hPF : FB ∈ P)
    (hW : chartSlope R x t ∉ P) :
    ∃ Q : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x), (Q.IsMaximal ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) ∈ Q ∧
      algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) FA ∈ Q) ∧
      Q.comap beta.right.toRingHom = P
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (BlowupChart R x t) (BlowupOverlap R t x) := beta.right.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have := blowup_overlap_isLocalization_right R t x beta
  obtain ⟨hQm, hQc⟩ := localization_map_maximal (S := BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R x t) P hW
  have ht : algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t) =
      beta.right (chartBase R x t t) := by
    rw [chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap, chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  refine ⟨_, ⟨hQm, ?_, ?_⟩, hQc⟩
  · rw [ht, ← blowup_chart_relation]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hPx)
  · rw [hrel]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap _ _) hPF)

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_curve_datum_points
statement:
private theorem exists_curve_datum_points (hpi : Irreducible pi) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {TT, XX}) (beta : BlowupRestriction RR TT XX) :
    ∃ D : TwoChartCurveData RR TT XX beta,
      (∀ i, D.g i = completedPointMap CC (D.Q i) (algebraMap AA CC FA) ∧
        algebraMap AA CC FA ∈ D.Q i) ∧
      (∀ Q : Ideal CC, Q.IsMaximal → algebraMap AA CC (chartBase RR TT XX TT) ∈ Q →
        algebraMap AA CC FA ∈ Q → ∃ i, D.Q i = Q) ∧
      (∀ k, D.g0 k = completedPointMap AA (D.P0 k) FA ∧ FA ∈ D.P0 k) ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal AA, P.IsMaximal → chartBase RR TT XX TT ∈ P → chartSlope RR TT XX ∈ P →
        FA ∈ P → ∃ k, D.P0 k = P) ∧
      (∀ l, D.ginf l = completedPointMap BB (D.Pinf l) FB ∧ FB ∈ D.Pinf l) ∧
      ∀ P : Ideal BB, P.IsMaximal → chartBase RR XX TT XX ∈ P → chartSlope RR XX TT ∈ P →
        FB ∈ P → ∃ l, D.Pinf l = P
proof:
:= by
  have : (Ideal.span ({TT, XX} : Set RR)).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have : IsNoetherianRing AA := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b TT XX
  have : IsNoetherianRing BB := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b XX TT
  obtain ⟨e, he, heZ⟩ := exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional RR TT XX
  have hgne := reduction_ne_zero TT XX e he heZ d c hne
  
  have hL : ∀ (P : Ideal AA) [P.IsMaximal], chartBase RR TT XX TT ∈ P → _ := fun P _ hP =>
    concrete_strict_transform_transverse_finite O pi hpi u a b ha FA
      (fun h => hgne (by rw [h, map_zero])) P hP
  
  let ι := {Q : Ideal CC // Q.IsMaximal ∧
      algebraMap AA CC (chartBase RR TT XX TT) ∈ Q ∧ algebraMap AA CC FA ∈ Q}
  have hιmax : ∀ i : ι, i.1.IsMaximal := fun i => i.2.1
  have hιP (i : ι) := overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal RR TT XX i.1 i.2.2.1
  choose Φ hΦ using fun i : ι => completed_point_transport_left RR TT XX i.1
  choose Ψ hΨ using fun i : ι => completed_point_transport_right RR TT XX beta i.1
  have heT (i : ι) : (Φ i).symm (completedPointMap AA _ (chartBase RR TT XX TT)) * 1 =
      completedPointMap CC i.1 (overlapException RR TT XX) := by
    rw [mul_one, RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]; exact (hΦ i _).symm
  
  let ι0 := {P : Ideal AA // P.IsMaximal ∧ chartBase RR TT XX TT ∈ P ∧ chartSlope RR TT XX ∈ P ∧
    FA ∈ P}
  have : Subsingleton ι0 := zero_points_subsingleton TT XX e he heZ FA
  have hι0max : ∀ k : ι0, k.1.IsMaximal := fun k => k.2.1
  let ιinf :=
    {P : Ideal BB // P.IsMaximal ∧ chartBase RR XX TT XX ∈ P ∧ chartSlope RR XX TT ∈ P ∧ FB ∈ P}
  have hιinfmax : ∀ l : ιinf, l.1.IsMaximal := fun l => l.2.1
  have hinf (l : ιinf) :=
    concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha l.1 l.2.2.1 l.2.2.2.1
  have : Subsingleton ιinf := ⟨fun l1 l2 => Subtype.ext ((hinf l1).1.trans (hinf l2).1.symm)⟩
  have hinf' (l : ιinf) :=
    concrete_infinity_strict_transform_transverse_finite O pi hpi u a b ha d c hne l.1 l.2.2.1
      l.2.2.2.1
  let D : TwoChartCurveData RR TT XX beta :=
    { ι := ι
      fin := points_finite TT XX e he heZ FA hgne
      Q := fun i => i.1
      inj := Subtype.val_injective
      onE := fun i => i.2.2.1
      g := fun i => (Φ i).symm (completedPointMap AA _ FA)
      transverse := fun i =>
        have := (hιP i).1
        mul_injective_quotient_transport _ isUnit_one (heT i) (hL _ (hιP i).2.2).1
      finite := fun i =>
        have := (hιP i).1
        transport_finite _ i.1 (Φ i) (hΦ i) _ _ (hL _ (hιP i).2.2).2.2
      leftIso := Φ
      leftIso_compat := hΦ
      rightIso := Ψ
      rightIso_compat := hΨ
      ι0 := ι0
      fin0 := Finite.of_subsingleton
      P0 := fun k => k.1
      maximal0 := fun k => k.2.1
      inj0 := Subtype.val_injective
      slope0 := fun k => k.2.2.2.1
      onE0 := fun k => k.2.2.1
      g0 := fun k => completedPointMap AA k.1 FA
      transverse0 := fun k => (hL k.1 k.2.2.1).1
      finite0 := fun k => (hL k.1 k.2.2.1).2.2
      ιinf := ιinf
      fininf := Finite.of_subsingleton
      Pinf := fun l => l.1
      maximalinf := fun l => l.2.1
      injinf := Subtype.val_injective
      slopeinf := fun l => l.2.2.2.1
      onEinf := fun l => l.2.2.1
      ginf := fun l => completedPointMap BB l.1 FB
      transverseinf := fun l => (hinf' l).1
      finiteinf := fun l => (hinf' l).2.2 }
  refine ⟨D, fun i => ⟨(Φ i).symm_apply_eq.2 (hΦ i FA).symm, i.2.2.2⟩,
    fun Q hQm hQt hQF => ⟨⟨Q, hQm, hQt, hQF⟩, rfl⟩,
    fun k => ⟨rfl, k.2.2.2.2⟩, fun P hPm hPt hPZ hPF => ⟨⟨P, hPm, hPt, hPZ, hPF⟩, rfl⟩,
    fun l => ⟨rfl, l.2.2.2.2⟩, fun P hPm hPx hPW hPF => ⟨⟨P, hPm, hPx, hPW, hPF⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.exists_curve_datum_of_sum
statement:
private theorem exists_curve_datum_of_sum (hpi : Irreducible pi) (ha : 0 < a) (f : RR)
    (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), c i * TT ^ (d - i.val) * XX ^ i.val)
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {TT, XX}) (beta : BlowupRestriction (RR) TT XX) :
    ∃ D : TwoChartCurveData (RR) TT XX beta,
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftData D s = completedPointMap AA (leftPoint D s) FA ∧
        FA ∈ leftPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal AA, P.IsMaximal → (chartBase (RR) TT XX) TT ∈ P → FA ∈ P →
        ∃ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftPoint D s = P) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, Ideal.span {rightData D s} =
        Ideal.span {completedPointMap BB (rightPoint D s) FB} ∧ FB ∈ rightPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal BB, P.IsMaximal → (chartBase (RR) XX TT) XX ∈ P → FB ∈ P →
        ∃ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, rightPoint D s = P) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        strictTransformAt (RR) TT XX (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {leftData D s})
      ∧ ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
        strictTransformAt (RR) XX TT (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
          Ideal.span {rightData D s}
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have : (Ideal.span ({TT, XX} : Set RR)).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hFA : algebraMap RR AA f = (chartBase RR TT XX TT)^d * FA := by
    rw [hc]; exact algebraMap_sum_eq_left _ _ d c
  have hFB : algebraMap RR BB f = (chartBase RR XX TT XX)^d * FB := by
    rw [hc]; exact algebraMap_sum_eq_right _ _ d c
  have hrel := overlap_relation TT XX beta d f _ _ hFA hFB
    (nonzerodivisor_survives_localization AA (chartBase RR TT XX TT) (chartSlope RR TT XX)
      (blowup_exceptional_parameter_regular RR TT XX
        (concrete_surface_regular_pair_tx O pi hpi.ne_zero u a b ha)))
  obtain ⟨D, hg, hQ, hg0, hP0, hginf, hPinf⟩ :=
    exists_curve_datum_points O pi u a b d c hpi ha hne beta
  have hleftP : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
      (leftPoint D s).IsMaximal ∧ chartBase RR TT XX TT ∈ leftPoint D s := by
    rintro (i | k)
    · obtain ⟨h1, -, h2⟩ := overlap_exceptional_point_comap_maximal RR TT XX (D.Q i) (D.onE i)
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · exact ⟨D.maximal0 k, D.onE0 k⟩
  have c1 : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftData D s = completedPointMap AA (leftPoint D s) FA ∧
      FA ∈ leftPoint D s := by
    rintro (i | k)
    · exact ⟨(congrArg (D.leftIso i) (hg i).1).trans (D.leftIso_compat i _), (hg i).2⟩
    · exact hg0 k
  have c5 : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, strictTransformAt RR TT XX (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
      Ideal.span {leftData D s} := by
    intro s
    have := (hleftP s).1
    rw [(c1 s).1]
    exact strictTransformAt_span_eq TT XX (leftPoint D s) d f FA hFA
      (concrete_left_point_exceptional_regular O pi hpi u a b ha (leftPoint D s) (hleftP s).2)
  refine ⟨D, c1, ?_, ?_, ?_, c5, ?_⟩
  · intro P hPm hPt hPF
    by_cases hZ : chartSlope RR TT XX ∈ P
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hP0 P hPm hPt hZ hPF
      exact ⟨Sum.inr k, hk⟩
    · obtain ⟨hQm, hQc⟩ := localization_map_maximal (S := CC) (chartSlope RR TT XX) P hZ
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hQ _ hQm (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hPt) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hPF)
      exact ⟨Sum.inl i, (congrArg (Ideal.comap _) hi).trans hQc⟩
  · rintro (i | l)
    · change Ideal.span {D.rightIso i (D.g i)} = _ ∧ _
      rw [(hg i).1]
      exact right_common_point_span TT XX d _ _ hrel (D.Q i) (hg i).2 _ (D.rightIso_compat i)
    · exact ⟨congrArg (fun y => Ideal.span {y}) (hginf l).1, (hginf l).2⟩
  · intro P hPm hPx hPF
    by_cases hW : chartSlope RR XX TT ∈ P
    · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hPinf P hPm hPx hW hPF
      exact ⟨Sum.inr l, hl⟩
    · obtain ⟨Q, ⟨hQm, hQt, hQF⟩, hQc⟩ := right_point_of_overlap TT XX d _ _ hrel P hPx hPF hW
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hQ Q hQm hQt hQF
      exact ⟨Sum.inl i, hQc⟩
  · rintro (i | l)
    · rw [← strict_transform_common_point_transport RR TT XX beta D i d (Ideal.span {f}),
        c5 (Sum.inl i)]
      refine (Ideal.map_span _ _).trans ?_
      rw [Set.image_singleton]
      exact congrArg (fun y => Ideal.span {D.rightIso i y}) ((D.leftIso i).symm_apply_apply _)
    · change _ = Ideal.span {D.ginf l}
      rw [(hginf l).1]
      exact strictTransformAt_span_eq XX TT (D.Pinf l) d f FB hFB
        (concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha (D.Pinf l) (D.onEinf l)
          (D.slopeinf l)).2.2.2.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.curve_datum_of_parent_function
statement:
theorem curve_datum_of_parent_function (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (c : Fin (d + 1) → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (hc : f = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1),
      c i * (surfaceT O pi u a b) ^ (d - i.val) * (surfaceX O pi u a b) ^ i.val)
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin (d + 1), c i ∉ Ideal.span {(surfaceT O pi u a b), (surfaceX O pi u a b)})
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b)) :
    ∃ D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta,
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        leftData D s = completedPointMap
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
        (leftPoint D s)
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
        (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b))^i.val) ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
        (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b))^i.val) ∈ leftPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)),
        P.IsMaximal →
        (chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
        (surfaceT O pi u a b) ∈ P →
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b))
        (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
        (surfaceX O pi u a b))^i.val) ∈ P → ∃ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftPoint D s = P) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
        Ideal.span {rightData D s} = Ideal.span
        {completedPointMap
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))
        (rightPoint D s)
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))
        (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b))^(d - i.val))} ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))
        (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b))^(d - i.val)) ∈ rightPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)),
        P.IsMaximal →
        (chartBase (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))
        (surfaceX O pi u a b) ∈ P →
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1),
        algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (BlowupChart (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b))
        (c i) * (chartSlope (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        (surfaceT O pi u a b))^(d - i.val)) ∈ P → ∃ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, rightPoint D s = P) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {leftData D s}) ∧ ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
      strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {rightData D s}
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_curve_datum_of_sum O pi u a b d c hpi ha f hc hne beta

name: SurfaceBlowup.surfaceRelation_span_axisT_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ : ∃ a', a = a' + 1 := ⟨a - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [show surfaceRelation O pi u (a' + 1) b = MvPowerSeries.C pi +
      -((u : TwoSeries O) * axisT O ^ a' * axisX O ^ b) * axisT O by rw [surfaceRelation]; ring,
    Ideal.span_pair_add_mul_right]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_quotient_T_equiv
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_quotient_T_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ q : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b}) ≃+*
        PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O),
      ∀ s : TwoSeries O, q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b})
        (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) = residueKillT O s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hsurj, hker⟩ := residueKillT_apply_ker O pi hpi
  set I := surfaceIdeal O pi u a b
  set J : Ideal (TwoSeries O) := Ideal.span {axisT O}
  have h1 : Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b} = J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; rfl
  have h2 : I ⊔ J = RingHom.ker (residueKillT O) := by
    rw [hker, ← surfaceRelation_span_axisT_eq O pi u a b ha, Ideal.span_insert]; rfl
  exact ⟨((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq h1).trans (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup I J)).trans
    ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq h2).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj)), fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.surfaceRelation_span_axisT_isPrime
statement:
private theorem surfaceRelation_span_axisT_isPrime (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    (Ideal.span {surfaceRelation O pi u a b, axisT O}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceRelation_span_axisT_eq O pi u a b ha]
  simpa [axisT] using mvPowerSeries_fin_two_span_C_var_isPrime O pi
    (by rw [← hpi.maximalIdeal_eq]; infer_instance) 0

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_span_T_isPrime
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_span_T_isPrime (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    (Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  have := surfaceRelation_span_axisT_isPrime O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hker : RingHom.ker (surfaceMk O pi u a b) ≤
      Ideal.span {surfaceRelation O pi u a b, axisT O} := by
    rw [surfaceMk, Ideal.mk_ker]
    exact Ideal.span_mono (by simp)
  have h0 : surfaceMk O pi u a b (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have himg : (Ideal.span {surfaceRelation O pi u a b, axisT O}).map (surfaceMk O pi u a b) =
      Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b} := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, h0, Ideal.span_insert_zero]; rfl
  exact himg ▸ Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hker

name: SurfaceBlowup.transverse_of_reduction_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transverse_of_reduction_ne_zero (S : Type) [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing S] (e g : S) (hereg : Function.Injective (fun y : S ↦ e * y)) (k : Type)
    [Field k] (q : (S ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) ≃+* PowerSeries k)
    (hg : q (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) g) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (fun a : S ⧸ Ideal.span {g} ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e * a) ∧
      Function.Injective
        (fun a : S ⧸ Ideal.span {e} ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) g * a) ∧
      ∃ L : ℕ, (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)^L ≤ Ideal.span {g, e}
proof:
:= by
  set π := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e})
  have hker : ∀ x : S, q (π x) = 0 ↔ ∃ c, x = e * c := fun x ↦ by
    rw [map_eq_zero_iff q q.injective, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact Iff.rfl
  refine ⟨fun a a' h ↦ ?_, fun a a' h ↦ q.injective (mul_left_cancel₀ hg (by
    simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg q h)), ?_⟩
  · induction a using Quotient.inductionOn' with | h a => ?_
    induction a' using Quotient.inductionOn' with | h a' => ?_
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ e * Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ e * Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a' at h
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a'
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at h
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h
    have h0 : q (π g) * q (π b) = 0 := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_comm, hb, ← mul_sub]
      exact (hker _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (hker b).1 ((mul_eq_zero.1 h0).resolve_left hg)
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    exact ⟨c, hereg (by simp only; rw [mul_sub, ← hb]; ring)⟩
  · 
    set p := q (π g)
    have hu : IsUnit p.divXPowOrder := by
      rw [PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
      exact fun h ↦ hg (PowerSeries.constantCoeff_divXPowOrder_eq_zero_iff.1 h)
    let f : S →+* PowerSeries k := (q : (S ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) →+* PowerSeries k).comp π
    have hfs : Function.Surjective f := q.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    refine ⟨p.order.toNat, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
    have hx' := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f hx
    rw [Ideal.map_pow, IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective f hfs,
      PowerSeries.maximalIdeal_eq_span_X, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : f g ∣ f x := dvd_trans ⟨↑hu.unit⁻¹, by
      change _ = p * _
      rw [← mul_one (_ ^ _), ← hu.mul_val_inv, ← mul_assoc,
        PowerSeries.X_pow_order_mul_divXPowOrder]⟩ hx'
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hfs y
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hker _).1 (by
      change f (x - g * y) = 0
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, hy, sub_self])
    exact Ideal.mem_span_pair.2 ⟨y, c, by linear_combination -hc⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.twoSeries_mem_variableIdeal_pow_of_coeff_eq_zero
proof:
:=
  (axis_ideal_pow_mem_iff O N g).2 hg

name: SurfaceBlowup.twoSeries_ringHom_ext_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem twoSeries_ringHom_ext_of_isNilpotent (O S : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing S]
    (φ ψ : TwoSeries O →+* S) (hC : ∀ c : O, φ (MvPowerSeries.C c) = ψ (MvPowerSeries.C c))
    (hT : φ (axisT O) = ψ (axisT O)) (hX : φ (axisX O) = ψ (axisX O))
    (hTn : IsNilpotent (φ (axisT O))) (hXn : IsNilpotent (φ (axisX O))) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : IsNilpotent (Ideal.span {φ (axisT O), φ (axisX O)}) := by
    rw [Ideal.FG.isNilpotent_iff_le_nilradical (Submodule.fg_span (Set.toFinite _)),
      Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [hTn, hXn]
  
  have kill (χ : TwoSeries O →+* S) (hχT : χ (axisT O) = φ (axisT O))
      (hχX : χ (axisX O) = φ (axisX O)) (g) (hg : g ∈ variableIdeal O ^ N) : χ g = 0 := by
    have : χ g ∈ ((variableIdeal O) ^ N).map χ := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg
    rw [Ideal.map_pow, variableIdeal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, hχT, hχX, hN] at this
    simpa using this
  have hpoly : φ.comp (MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom (σ := Fin 2) (R := O)) =
      ψ.comp (MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simpa using hC c
    · intro s
      fin_cases s
      · simpa [axisT] using hT
      · simpa [axisX] using hX
  ext f
  set p := MvPowerSeries.truncTotal N f
  have hg : f - (p : TwoSeries O) ∈ variableIdeal O ^ N := by
    apply twoSeries_mem_variableIdeal_pow_of_coeff_eq_zero
    intro m hm
    rw [map_sub, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, MvPowerSeries.coeff_truncTotal, sub_self]
    simpa [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hm
  have h1 := kill φ rfl rfl _ hg
  have h2 := kill ψ hT.symm hX.symm _ hg
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact congrArg (fun F ↦ F p) hpoly

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_ringHom_ext_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_ringHom_ext_of_isNilpotent (O S : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing S]
    (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (φ ψ : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b →+* S)
    (hC : ∀ c : O, φ (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c) =
      ψ (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c))
    (hT : φ (surfaceT O pi u a b) = ψ (surfaceT O pi u a b))
    (hX : φ (surfaceX O pi u a b) = ψ (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (hTn : IsNilpotent (φ (surfaceT O pi u a b))) (hXn : IsNilpotent (φ (surfaceX O pi u a b))) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
    (twoSeries_ringHom_ext_of_isNilpotent O S _ _ (fun c ↦ hC c) hT hX hTn hXn)

name: SurfaceBlowup.twoSeries_eval_exists_of_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem twoSeries_eval_exists_of_isAdicComplete (S : Type) [CommRing S] (I : Ideal S)
    [IsAdicComplete I S] (O' : Type) [CommRing O'] (κ : O' →+* S) (e z : S) (he : e ∈ I)
    (hz : z ∈ I) :
    ∃ Θ : TwoSeries O' →+* S,
      (∀ c : O', Θ (MvPowerSeries.C c) = κ c) ∧ Θ (axisT O') = e ∧ Θ (axisX O') = z
proof:
:= by
  have nil : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : S), a ∈ I → IsNilpotent (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) a) :=
    fun n a ha ↦ ⟨n, by
      rw [← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]; exact Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha n⟩
  let f : (n : ℕ) → TwoSeries O' →+* S ⧸ I ^ n := fun n ↦
    nilpotentEval ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)).comp κ) (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) e)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) z) (nil n e he) (nil n z hz)
  have hgen := fun n ↦ nilpotentEval_apply_generators O' (S ⧸ I ^ n)
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)).comp κ) (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) e)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) z) (nil n e he) (nil n z hz)
  have hf : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n), (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I hle).comp (f n) = f m := by
    intro m n hle
    obtain ⟨hC, hT, hX⟩ := hgen n
    obtain ⟨hC', hT', hX'⟩ := hgen m
    apply twoSeries_ringHom_ext_of_isNilpotent
    · intro c; simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, f, hC, hC']; rfl
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, f, hT, hT']; rfl
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, f, hX, hX']; rfl
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, f, hT]; exact (nil n e he).map _
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, f, hX]; exact (nil n z hz).map _
  have hsep : ∀ a b : S, (∀ n : ℕ, Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) a = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) b) →
      a = b := by
    intro a b h
    rw [IsHausdorff.eq_iff_smodEq (I := I)]
    intro n
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    exact h n
  refine ⟨IsAdicComplete.liftRingHom I f hf, fun c ↦ hsep _ _ fun n ↦ ?_,
    hsep _ _ fun n ↦ ?_, hsep _ _ fun n ↦ ?_⟩ <;> rw [IsAdicComplete.mk_liftRingHom]
  exacts [(hgen n).1 c, (hgen n).2.1, (hgen n).2.2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_lift_map_parameter_quotient_irreducible
statement:
theorem unramified_lift_map_parameter_quotient_irreducible (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    Irreducible (Φ.map ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b,
      surfaceX O pi u a b} : Set (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))).comp
