        (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (alg : O →+* R) (I : Ideal R)
      (e : R ⧸ I ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField O),
      (∀ c, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (alg c)) = IsLocalRing.residue O c) →
      Irreducible (Φ.map ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I).comp alg)) := by
    intro R _ alg I e hc
    have hc' : e.toRingHom.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I).comp alg) = IsLocalRing.residue O := by
      ext c; exact hc c
    have h := hΦ.2
    rw [residuePoly, ← hc', ← Polynomial.map_map] at h
    exact (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff (Polynomial.mapEquiv e).toMulEquiv).mp (by simpa using h)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_parameters_equiv O pi hpi u a b ha
  exact key _ _ _ e fun c ↦ (he (.C c)).trans (congrArg _ (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_C ..))

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_root_isUnit_of_two_le_natDegree
statement:
theorem unramified_root_isUnit_of_two_le_natDegree (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (h2 : 2 ≤ Φ.natDegree) :
    IsUnit (AdjoinRoot.root Φ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hunit, _⟩ := base_ideal_maximal_local O Φ hΦ
  apply hunit
  obtain ⟨hfield, _, _⟩ := residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨e, he, _⟩ := residue_extension_equiv O Φ
  have hne : baseReduce O Φ (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 : e (baseReduce O Φ (AdjoinRoot.mk Φ Polynomial.X)) = 0 := by
      rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_X, h0]; simp
    rw [he, Polynomial.map_X, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero] at h1
    exact Polynomial.X_ne_zero (Polynomial.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natDegree_lt h1
      (by rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X, hΦ.1.natDegree_map]; omega))
  let := hfield.toField
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_isAdicComplete_span_pi
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_isAdicComplete_span_pi (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) :
    IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isLocalRing O pi u a b hpi.not_isUnit ha
  have : IsNoetherianRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b
  have := concrete_surface_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal O pi hpi u a b ha
  apply isAdicComplete_of_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal
  have hle : Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi} ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) := by
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, concrete_surface_maximalIdeal_eq O pi hpi u a b ha]
    have h2 : surfaceMk O pi u a b (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) = 0 :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    have h3 : surfaceMk O pi u a b (MvPowerSeries.C pi) =
        (surfaceUnit O pi u a b : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) * surfaceT O pi u a b ^ a *
          surfaceX O pi u a b ^ b := by
      have := sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [surfaceRelation, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow] using h2)
      simpa [surfaceUnit, surfaceT, surfaceX, map_mul, map_pow] using this
    rw [show algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi =
      surfaceMk O pi u a b (MvPowerSeries.C pi) from rfl, h3]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
      (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)) a ha))
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top hle

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_curve_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_curve_isAdicComplete (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :
    IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi} : Ideal O) (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {f})
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isLocalRing O pi u a b hpi.not_isUnit ha
  have : IsNoetherianRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b
  have hI := concrete_surface_isAdicComplete_span_pi O pi hpi u a b ha
  have hItop : Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi} ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ by
    have hH := hI.toIsHausdorff
    rw [h] at hH
    exact not_subsingleton _ hH.subsingleton
  have hc := isAdicComplete_quotient_of_iInf_sup_pow _ _ (Ideal.span {f})
    (iInf_sup_pow_eq_of_isLocalRing _ _ (Ideal.span {f}) hItop)
  rw [← IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff (S := ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {f}),
    Ideal.map_span]
  rw [Ideal.map_span] at hc
  simp only [Set.image_singleton] at hc ⊢
  convert hc using 2
  rfl

statement:
theorem concrete_surface_isAdicComplete_span_pi_base (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

statement:

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_crossing_state_volume
statement:
theorem concrete_crossing_state_volume (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) (hSpi : S.pi = pi)
    (hSt : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b) (hSx : S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (hSa : S.a = a)
    (hSb : S.b = b)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O,
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
      (residueSeries O s)) (c h : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hh : 0 < h) [TopologicalSpace O]
    [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O]
    [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) :
    (letI : MeasurableSpace (Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) := idealChartSigma O
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi; ∃ A : IdealAtlas O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi
        (a*c+b*h) (surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S (State.crossing a b c h)),
        stateMeasure O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi (a*c+b*h)
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A Set.univ =
        ((Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) *
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^(c+h))
proof:
:= by
  let : MeasurableSpace (Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)) := idealChartSigma O
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi
  change ∃ A : IdealAtlas _ _ _ _ _, _
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ :=
      concrete_crossing_state_atlas_exists O pi hpi u a b ha hb S hSt hSx hSa hSb e he c h hc
      hh
  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hp0, hpm⟩ := surface_vertical_parameter O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S
  rw [hSpi] at hp0 hpm
  refine crossing_state_volume O
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) htop pi _ a b c h ha hb hc hh A ?_ hA
  intro i
  have := division_coordinate_module_isAdicComplete O pi hpi u a b ha (a*c+b*h)
  exact coordinate_ideal_measurable_chart_sigma O htop
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi hpi hp0 hpm _ _ _ (A.chart i).isDivisionChart

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_single_state_volume
statement:
theorem concrete_single_state_volume (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)) (hSpi : S.pi = pi)
    (hSt : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a 0) (hSa : S.a = a) (hSb : S.b = 0)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0 ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O,
      e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})
      (surfaceMk O pi u a 0 s)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0)
      (residueSeries O s)) (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) :
    (letI : MeasurableSpace (Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)) := idealChartSigma O
        (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi; ∃ A : IdealAtlas O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi (a*c)
        (surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) S (State.single a c)),
        stateMeasure O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi (a*c)
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) A Set.univ =
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹^c)
proof:
:= by
  let : MeasurableSpace (Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)) := idealChartSigma O
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := concrete_single_state_atlas_exists O pi hpi u a ha S hSt hSa hSb e he c hc
  refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hp0, hpm⟩ := surface_vertical_parameter O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) S
  rw [hSpi] at hp0 hpm
  refine single_state_volume O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) htop pi _ a c ha A ?_ hA
  intro i
  have := division_coordinate_module_isAdicComplete O pi hpi u a 0 ha (a*c)
  exact coordinate_ideal_measurable_chart_sigma O htop (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi hpi hp0 hpm
      _ _ _ (A.chart i).isDivisionChart

name: SurfaceBlowup.completion_isNoetherian_isDomain_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem completion_isNoetherian_isDomain_of_equiv (A : Type) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (e : A) (he : e ∈ P) :
    ∃ _ : IsLocalRing (CompletedLocalAt A P), IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
      (CompletedLocalAt A P)) (CompletedLocalAt A P) ∧
      completedPointMap A P e ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt A P)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
    ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime P) P e).2 he)

name: SurfaceBlowup.injective_mul_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem injective_mul_of_ringEquiv {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A ≃+* B)
    {x : A} {z w : B} (h : φ x = z * w) (hw : IsUnit w)
    (hz : Function.Injective (fun y : B => z * y)) :
    Function.Injective (fun y : A => x * y)
proof:
:= by
  intro y y' hyy
  have h' := congrArg φ hyy
  simp only [map_mul, h, mul_assoc] at h'
  exact φ.injective (hw.mul_left_cancel (hz h'))

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_datum_concrete_instances
statement:
theorem two_chart_datum_concrete_instances (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta) :
    (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun y : (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)) =>
          (completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s))
            (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) * y)) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
        IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s)) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun y : (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s)) =>
          (completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s))
            (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)) * y)) ∧
      ∀ p : AllPoints D, IsNoetherianRing (localRing D p) ∧ ∃ _ : IsLocalRing (localRing D p),
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)) (localRing D p) ∧
      localException D p ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (localRing D p)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} :
      Set (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  obtain ⟨hLmax, -, hLt⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal _ _ _ beta D
  have hL : ∀ s, IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun y : CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s) =>
        completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D s) (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) * y) := by
    intro s
    have := hLmax s
    exact ⟨(concrete_left_point_completion_instances O pi hpi u a b ha (leftPoint D s) (hLt s)).1,
      concrete_left_point_exceptional_regular O pi hpi u a b ha (leftPoint D s) (hLt s)⟩
  have hInf : ∀ l, IsNoetherianRing
      (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun y : CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) =>
        completedPointMap _ (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))
          (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)) * y) := by
    intro l
    have : (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)).IsMaximal := D.maximalinf l
    have h := concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))
      (D.onEinf l) (D.slopeinf l)
    exact ⟨h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2⟩
  
  have hR : ∀ i : D.ι, IsNoetherianRing
      (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D (Sum.inl i))) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun y : CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D (Sum.inl i)) =>
        completedPointMap _ (rightPoint D (Sum.inl i))
          (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)) * y) := by
    intro i
    let P := (D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (tChart O pi u a b) (tOverlap O pi u a b))
    obtain ⟨hLn, hLinj⟩ : IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt _ P) ∧
        Function.Injective (fun y : CompletedLocalAt _ P =>
          completedPointMap _ P (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) * y) := hL (Sum.inl i)
    let φ := (D.rightIso i).symm.trans (D.leftIso i)
    have hbeta : beta.right (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)) =
        algebraMap (tChart O pi u a b) (tOverlap O pi u a b)
          (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)) :=
      beta.right.commutes (surfaceX O pi u a b)
    have hφ : φ (completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) ((D.Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom)
        (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))) =
        completedPointMap _ P (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) *
          completedPointMap _ P (tSlope O pi u a b) := by
      have h1 := D.rightIso_compat i (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))
      rw [hbeta] at h1
      rw [← map_mul, blowup_chart_relation, ← h1]
      change D.leftIso i ((D.rightIso i).symm _) = _
      rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact D.leftIso_compat i _
    have hWnot : tSlope O pi u a b ∉ P := fun hW => (D.maximal i).ne_top
      (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hW (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _))
    have hWunit : IsUnit (completedPointMap _ P (tSlope O pi u a b)) :=
      (IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.AtPrime P)
        (⟨_, hWnot⟩ : P.primeCompl)).map (localCompletionMap _)
    exact ⟨isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv _ φ.symm, injective_mul_of_ringEquiv φ hφ hWunit hLinj⟩
  have hNC : ∀ i : D.ι, IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (tOverlap O pi u a b) (D.Q i)) :=
    fun i => by
      have : IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b)
        ((D.Q i).comap (algebraMap (tChart O pi u a b) (tOverlap O pi u a b)))) :=
        (hL (Sum.inl i)).1
      exact isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv _ (D.leftIso i).symm
  have : IsNoetherianRing (tChart O pi u a b) :=
    blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b _ _
  have : IsNoetherianRing (xChart O pi u a b) :=
    blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b _ _
  refine ⟨hL, fun s => s.casesOn hR hInf, ?_⟩
  rintro (i | k | l)
  · exact ⟨hNC i, completion_isNoetherian_isDomain_of_equiv _ (D.Q i) _ (D.onE i)⟩
  · exact ⟨(hL (Sum.inr k)).1,
      completion_isNoetherian_isDomain_of_equiv _ (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k)) _ (D.onE0 k)⟩
  · exact ⟨(hInf l).1,
      completion_isNoetherian_isDomain_of_equiv _ (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) _ (D.onEinf l)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.injective_mul_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h w hw
    have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) g * Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) w =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) g * 0 := by
      rw [mul_zero, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
      exact hw
    have h2 := h h1
    rwa [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h2
  · intro h x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    simp only at hxy
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← mul_sub] at hxy
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact h _ hxy

name: SurfaceBlowup.transverse_of_regular_local
statement:
private theorem transverse_of_regular_local (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsMaximal]
    (e g : CompletedLocalAt A P)
    (O' : Type) [CommRing O'] [IsDomain O'] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O'] (pi' : O')
    (hpi' : Irreducible pi') (u' : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) (a' b' : ℕ) (ha' : 0 < a')
    (Eq : CompletedLocalAt A P ≃+* ConcreteSurface O' pi' u' a' b')
    (hE : Eq e = surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b') (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P))) ^ L ≤ Ideal.span {g, e ^ 1}) :
    ∀ w, e ∣ g * w → e ∣ w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, -⟩ := concrete_surface_quotient_T_equiv O' pi' hpi' u' a' b' ha'
  have hsymm : Eq.symm (surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b') = e := by rw [← hE]; simp
  have hreg := (concrete_surface_equiv_curve_length_and_regular (CompletedLocalAt A P) O' pi'
    u' a' b' Eq q g).2
  rw [hsymm] at hreg
  rw [← injective_mul_iff]
  refine hreg.mpr ?_
  intro h0
  have hmk : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'}) (Eq g) = 0 := by
    simpa using h0
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmk
  have hge : e ∣ g := by
    have := map_dvd Eq.symm hmk
    rwa [hsymm, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
  have hL' : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)))^L ≤ Ideal.span {e} := by
    refine hL.trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hge
    · simp
  have hsurj := finite_completed_point_quotient_surjective A P L (Ideal.span {e}) hL'
  let θ : CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸ Ideal.span {e} →+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift (Ideal.span {e})
      (q.toRingHom.comp
            ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {surfaceT O' pi' u' a' b'})).comp Eq.toRingHom))
      (fun z hz => by
        have := hE ▸ map_dvd Eq (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hz)
        simp [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr this)])
  have hθ : Function.Surjective θ := by
    intro f
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := q.surjective f
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Eq.symm z), ?_⟩
    simp [θ, hz]
  let ψ : A →+* PowerSeries (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O') :=
    θ.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e})).comp (completedPointMap A P))
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := hθ.comp hsurj
  have hP : ∀ p ∈ P, ψ p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have hm : completedPointMap A P p ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
        (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
      ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime P) P p).mpr hp)
    have hpow := hL' (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hm L)
    have : ψ p ^ L = 0 := by
      rw [← map_pow]
      simp only [ψ, RingHom.comp_apply]
      rw [map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hpow, map_zero]
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff'.mp this |>.1
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hψ PowerSeries.X
  have hcP : c ∉ P := fun hcP => PowerSeries.X_ne_zero (hc ▸ hP c hcP)
  obtain ⟨y, i, hi, hyi⟩ := Ideal.IsMaximal.exists_inv ‹P.IsMaximal› hcP
  have := congrArg ψ hyi
  rw [map_add, map_mul, hP i hi, hc, add_zero, map_one] at this
  have := congrArg PowerSeries.constantCoeff this
  simp at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.dvd_transport
proof:
:= by
  subst he hg
  intro w hw
  rw [hu.mul_right_dvd] at hw ⊢
  simpa using map_dvd Θ (h (Θ.symm w) (by simpa using map_dvd Θ.symm hw))

name: SurfaceBlowup.two_chart_datum_concrete_transverse
statement:
theorem two_chart_datum_concrete_transverse (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta) :
    (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        Function.Injective
        (fun w : (CompletedLocalAt (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)) ⧸ Ideal.span
          {(completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s))
            (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b))} =>
          Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s))
            (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b))}) (leftData D s) * w)) ∧
      ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
      Function.Injective
      (fun w : (CompletedLocalAt (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s)) ⧸ Ideal.span
        {(completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s))
          (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))} =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b) (rightPoint D s))
          (xBase O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b))}) (rightData D s) * w)
proof:
:= by
  have hmaxTX : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} :
      Set (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have : IsNoetherianRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :=
    concrete_surface_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b
  obtain ⟨hLmax, -, hLmem⟩ := two_chart_left_points_maximal _ _ _ beta D
  obtain ⟨hRmax, -, hRmem⟩ := two_chart_right_points_maximal _ _ _ beta D
  obtain ⟨-, hLfin⟩ := two_chart_left_data_transverse_finite _ _ _ beta D 1
  obtain ⟨-, hRfin⟩ := two_chart_right_data_transverse_finite _ _ _ beta D 1
  have hleft : ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, ∀ w,
      completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D s) (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) ∣
        leftData D s * w →
      completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D s) (tBase O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)) ∣ w := by
    intro s
    have := hLmax s
    obtain ⟨O', _, _, _, _, _, pi', u', a', b', hpi', ha', Eq, hEq⟩ :=
      concrete_left_point_completion_is_surface O pi hpi u a b ha (leftPoint D s) (hLmem s)
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hLfin s
    exact transverse_of_regular_local _ (leftPoint D s) _ _ O' pi' hpi' u' a' b' ha'
      Eq hEq L hL
  refine ⟨fun s => (injective_mul_iff _ _).mpr (hleft s), fun s => ?_⟩
  rw [injective_mul_iff]
  rcases s with i | l
  · refine dvd_transport ((D.leftIso i).symm.trans (D.rightIso i))
      (e := D.leftIso i (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (algebraMap _ _ (chartBase _ _ _ _))))
      (u := D.rightIso i (completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (overlapSlope _ _ _)))
      (((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _).map _).map _) ?_
      (congrArg (D.rightIso i) ((D.leftIso i).symm_apply_apply _))
      (by rw [D.leftIso_compat i]; exact hleft (Sum.inl i))
    rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
    exact (congrArg (fun z => D.rightIso i (completedPointMap _ _ z))
      (beta_right_chartBase_self (beta := beta)).symm).trans (D.rightIso_compat i _)
  · have := hRmax (Sum.inr l)
    obtain ⟨-, ⟨Eq, hEq⟩, -⟩ := concrete_infinity_point_completion O pi hpi u a b ha
      (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) (hRmem (Sum.inr l)) (D.slopeinf l)
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hRfin (Sum.inr l)
    exact transverse_of_regular_local _ (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) _ _ O pi hpi
      (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a (by omega) Eq hEq L hL

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_strict_transforms_are_prescribed
statement:
theorem concrete_strict_transforms_are_prescribed (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta) (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (G : GluedGenerators (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta (curveDataDegree D))
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ,
      surfaceToCechInput (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) j f =
      (cechInputLattice (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) j).mkQ
      (gluedFunctionPair (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b) G j))
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
      Ideal.span
      {Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span
      {Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((chartExceptional (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b))^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j) :
    (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
        (leftPoint D s) (curveDataDegree D) (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {leftData D s}) ∧
      ∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
      strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (rightPoint D s) (curveDataDegree D) (Ideal.span {f}) = Ideal.span {rightData D s}
proof:
:= by
  have : (Ideal.span ({surfaceT O pi u a b, surfaceX O pi u a b} :
      Set (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))).IsMaximal :=
    concrete_surface_parameterIdeal_isMaximal O pi hpi u a b ha
  have h1 := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b)
  have h2 := blowupChart_concrete_isNoetherianRing O pi u a b (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      (surfaceT O pi u a b)
  obtain ⟨hI1, hI2, -⟩ := two_chart_datum_concrete_instances O pi hpi u a b ha beta D
  obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := two_chart_datum_concrete_transverse O pi hpi u a b ha beta D
  refine ⟨fun s => ?_, fun s => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨_, hereg⟩ := hI1 s
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := strict_transform_left_point_equation _ _ _ beta D _ G hG f hf s hereg (hT1 s)
    unfold strictTransformAt
    rw [principal_ideal_image, RingHom.comp_apply, chartBase_apply_eq_algebraMap, hv,
      Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit v.isUnit]
    exact span_pow_mul_colon_eq _ _ _ hereg
  · obtain ⟨_, hreg⟩ := hI2 s
    exact global_function_strict_transform_at_right_point _ _ _ beta D _ G hG f hf s hreg (hT2 s)

name: SurfaceBlowup.X_pow_card_pow_sub_X_eq_prod_irreducible
statement:
private theorem X_pow_card_pow_sub_X_eq_prod_irreducible (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (S : Finset (Polynomial k))
    (hS : ∀ g, g ∈ S ↔ g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g ∧ g.natDegree ∣ m) :
    (Polynomial.X ^ (Nat.card k) ^ m - Polynomial.X : Polynomial k) = ∏ g ∈ S, g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Polynomial k := Polynomial.X ^ (Nat.card k) ^ m - Polynomial.X with hPdef
  have hq : 1 < Nat.card k := Finite.one_lt_card
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := FiniteField.X_pow_card_pow_sub_X_ne_zero k hm.ne' hq
  have hPsep : Squarefree P := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := CharP.exists k
    have := Fintype.ofFinite k
    have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨CharP.char_is_prime k p⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hcard⟩ := FiniteField.card k p
    have hdvd : p ∣ Nat.card k ^ m := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard, ← pow_mul]
      exact dvd_pow_self p (Nat.mul_ne_zero n.ne_zero hm.ne')
    exact (galois_poly_separable p _ hdvd).squarefree
  set N := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors P with hN
  have hnodup : N.Nodup :=
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.squarefree_iff_nodup_normalizedFactors hP0).mp hPsep
  have hmonic : ∀ g ∈ N, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g := fun g hg ↦ by
    have hirr := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_normalized_factor g hg
    refine ⟨?_, hirr⟩
    rw [← UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalize_normalized_factor g hg]
    exact Polynomial.monic_normalize hirr.ne_zero
  have hprod : N.prod = P := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated
    · simpa using Polynomial.monic_multiset_prod_of_monic N id (fun g hg ↦ (hmonic g hg).1)
    · rw [hPdef]
      apply Polynomial.Monic.sub_of_left (Polynomial.monic_X_pow _)
      rw [Polynomial.degree_X, Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_lt_pow hm.ne' hq
    · exact UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors hP0
  have hset : N.toFinset = S := by
    ext g
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, hS]
    constructor
    · intro hg
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hmonic g hg
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h2.natDegree_dvd_of_dvd_X_pow_card_pow_sub_X
        (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hg)⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      have hd : g ∣ P := h2.natDegree_dvd_iff_dvd_X_pow_card_pow_sub_X.mp h3
      obtain ⟨g', hg', hass⟩ :=
        UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd hP0 h2 hd
      rwa [Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated h1 (hmonic g' hg').1 hass]
  rw [← hset, Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, Multiset.toFinset_val, Multiset.map_id',
    Multiset.dedup_eq_self.mpr hnodup, hprod]

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_pow_eq_sum_irreducible_degrees
proof:
:= by
  have hMD : ∀ d, ({F : Polynomial k | F.Monic ∧ F.natDegree = d} : Set _).Finite := by
    intro d
    rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff]
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    change Nat.card {F : Polynomial k // F.Monic ∧ F.natDegree = d} ≠ 0
    rw [monic_residue_polynomial_count]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ Nat.card_pos.ne'
  have hSig : ({g : Polynomial k | g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g ∧ g.natDegree ∣ m} : Set _).Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.subset ((Finset.finite_toSet m.divisors).biUnion (fun d _ ↦ hMD d))
    intro g hg
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hg
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.mem_coe, Nat.mem_divisors]
    exact ⟨g.natDegree, ⟨hg.2.2, hm.ne'⟩, hg.1, rfl⟩
  set S := hSig.toFinset with hSdef
  have hS : ∀ g, g ∈ S ↔ g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g ∧ g.natDegree ∣ m := by
    intro g; rw [hSdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]; rfl
  have hprod := X_pow_card_pow_sub_X_eq_prod_irreducible k m hm S hS
  have hdeg := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hprod
  rw [FiniteField.X_pow_card_pow_sub_X_natDegree_eq k hm.ne' Finite.one_lt_card,
    Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun g hg ↦ ((hS g).1 hg).1)] at hdeg
  rw [hdeg, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := Polynomial.natDegree) (t := m.divisors)
    (fun g hg ↦ Nat.mem_divisors.2 ⟨((hS g).1 hg).2.2, hm.ne'⟩)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  have hd' := (Nat.mem_divisors.1 hd).1
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ ↦ d) (fun g hg ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.1 hg).2),
    Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_finsetCard]
  refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun g ↦ ?_)
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, hS]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨⟨h1, h2, _⟩, h4⟩ ↦ ⟨h1, h2, h4⟩, fun ⟨h1, h2, h4⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨h1, h2, h4 ▸ hd'⟩, h4⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.irreducible_count_moebius
statement:
theorem irreducible_count_moebius (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (δ : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (δ : ℚ) * (Nat.card {g : Polynomial k // g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g ∧ g.natDegree = δ} : ℕ) =
    ∑ j ∈ δ.divisors, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius j : ℤ) : ℚ) * (Nat.card k : ℚ) ^ (δ / j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (ArithmeticFunction.sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq (R := ℚ)
    (f := fun d ↦
      (d : ℚ) * (Nat.card {g : Polynomial k // g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g ∧ g.natDegree = d} : ℕ))
    (g := fun n ↦ (Nat.card k : ℚ) ^ n)).mp (by
      intro n hn
      have := congrArg (fun x : ℕ ↦ (x : ℚ))
        (card_pow_eq_sum_irreducible_degrees k n hn)
      simpa [Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow] using this.symm) δ hδ
  rw [← h, Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal
    (fun i j ↦ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius i : ℤ) : ℚ) * (Nat.card k : ℚ) ^ j)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lowOrderIdeal_mul
statement:
private lemma lowOrderIdeal_mul (k : Type) [CommRing k]
    (a b : ℕ) : lowOrderIdeal k a * lowOrderIdeal k b ≤ lowOrderIdeal k (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.mul_le]
  intro x hx y hy m hm
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro p hp
  rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  have h0 := congrArg (fun f ↦ f 0) hp
  have h1 := congrArg (fun f ↦ f 1) hp
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at h0 h1
  by_cases h : p.1 0 + p.1 1 < a
  · rw [hx p.1 h, zero_mul]
  · rw [hy p.2 (by omega), mul_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.lowOrderIdeal_zero
statement: private lemma lowOrderIdeal_zero (k : Type) [CommRing k] : lowOrderIdeal k 0 = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.2 fun _ _ _ hm ↦ by omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.span_le_lowOrderIdeal_one
statement:
private lemma span_le_lowOrderIdeal_one (k : Type) [CommRing k] : Ideal.span
    {axisT k, axisX k} ≤ lowOrderIdeal k 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  have key (s : Fin 2) : (MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ∈ lowOrderIdeal k 1 := fun m hm ↦ by
    obtain rfl : m = 0 := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp <;> omega
    exact MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_X s
  rintro x (rfl | rfl)
  exacts [key 0, key 1]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pow_le_lowOrderIdeal
statement:
private lemma pow_le_lowOrderIdeal (k : Type) [CommRing k] (L : ℕ) :
    (Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k})^L ≤ lowOrderIdeal k L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, lowOrderIdeal_zero]
  | succ L ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact (Ideal.mul_mono ih (span_le_lowOrderIdeal_one k)).trans (lowOrderIdeal_mul k L 1)

name: SurfaceBlowup.lowOrderIdeal_le_pow
statement:
private lemma lowOrderIdeal_le_pow (k : Type) [CommRing k] (L : ℕ) :
    lowOrderIdeal k L ≤ (Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k})^L
proof:
:= by
  have key (s : Fin 2) (a : TwoSeries k) (m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (m + Finsupp.single s 1) (MvPowerSeries.X s * a) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff m a := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.X, MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial_mul, if_pos le_add_self,
      add_tsub_cancel_right, one_mul]
  induction L with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    intro g hg
    
    set g1 : TwoSeries k := fun m ↦ if m 0 = 0 then MvPowerSeries.coeff m g else 0
    have c1 (m) : MvPowerSeries.coeff m g1 = if m 0 = 0 then MvPowerSeries.coeff m g else 0 :=
      rfl
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∣ g - g1 := by
      refine MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.2 fun m hm ↦ ?_
      rw [map_sub, c1, if_pos hm, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : MvPowerSeries.X 1 ∣ g1 := by
      refine MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.2 fun m hm ↦ ?_
      rw [c1]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hg m (by omega)
      · rfl
    have hA : a ∈ lowOrderIdeal k N := fun m hm ↦ by
      rw [← key 0 a m, ← ha, map_sub, c1, if_neg (by simp), sub_zero]
      exact hg _ (by simp; omega)
    have hB : b ∈ lowOrderIdeal k N := fun m hm ↦ by
      rw [← key 1 b m, ← hb, c1]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hg _ (by simp; omega)
      · rfl
    rw [show g = (g - g1) + g1 by ring, ha, hb, pow_succ']
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.subset_span (by simp [axisT])) (ih hA))
      (Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.subset_span (by simp [axisX])) (ih hB))

name: SurfaceBlowup.axis_ideal_pow_mem_iff
statement:
theorem axis_ideal_pow_mem_iff (k : Type) [CommRing k] (L : ℕ) (φ : TwoSeries k) :
    φ ∈ (Ideal.span {axisT k, axisX k})^L ↔ ∀ m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, m 0 + m 1 < L →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff m φ = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ pow_le_lowOrderIdeal k L h, fun h ↦ lowOrderIdeal_le_pow k L h⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.axis_quotient_length_top
statement:
theorem axis_quotient_length_top (k : Type) [Field k] (s t : Fin 2) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    Module.length (TwoSeries k) (TwoSeries k ⧸ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)}) =
    ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set P : Ideal (TwoSeries k) := Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)} with hP
  let N : ℕ → Submodule (TwoSeries k) (TwoSeries k ⧸ P) := fun j ↦
    Submodule.map P.mkQ (Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X t : TwoSeries k) ^ j})
  have hle : ∀ j, N (j+1) ≤ N j := fun j ↦ by
    apply Submodule.map_mono
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]
    exact pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.le_succ j)
  have hlt : ∀ j, N (j+1) < N j := fun j ↦ by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (hle j) fun heq ↦ ?_
    have hmem : P.mkQ ((MvPowerSeries.X t : TwoSeries k) ^ j) ∈ N j :=
      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rw [← heq] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyeq⟩ := hmem
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at hyeq
    rw [hP, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hyeq
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hy
    have h1 := (MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff).1 hyeq (Finsupp.single t j)
      (Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by simpa [eq_comm] using hst))
    have h2 := (MvPowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff).1 hy (Finsupp.single t j)
      (by rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same]; omega)
    rw [map_sub, h2, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X_pow] at h1
    simp at h1
  
  by_contra h
  rw [← ne_eq, Module.length_ne_top_iff, isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian] at h
  have := h.2
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := WellFounded.not_rel_apply_succ (r := (· < ·)) N
  exact hn (hlt n)

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_substAlgHom_kill
statement:
theorem coeff_substAlgHom_kill (O : Type) [CommRing O] (f : Fin 2 → PowerSeries O)
    (hf : MvPowerSeries.HasSubst f) (s t : Fin 2) (hst : s ≠ t) (hs : f s = 0)
    (ht : f t = PowerSeries.X) (g : TwoSeries O) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (MvPowerSeries.substAlgHom hf g) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t n) g
proof:
:= by
  have hprod (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) : d.prod (fun i e ↦ f i ^ e) = f s ^ d s * f t ^ d t := by
    rw [Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (by simp), Fin.prod_univ_two]
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : s = 0 ∧ t = 1 ∨ s = 1 ∧ t = 0 := by omega
    exacts [rfl, mul_comm _ _]
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coe_substAlgHom, PowerSeries.coeff_def (s := Finsupp.single () n) (by simp),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff_subst hf, finsum_eq_single _ (Finsupp.single t n)]
  · simp [hprod, hs, ht, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hst, ← PowerSeries.coeff_def]
  · intro d hd
    rw [hprod, hs, ht]
    by_cases h0 : d s = 0
    · have h1 : d t ≠ n := fun h1 ↦ hd (by
        ext i
        obtain rfl | rfl : i = s ∨ i = t := by omega
        exacts [by simp [h0, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hst], by simp [h1]])
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_def (n := n) (by simp)]
      simp [h0, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, Ne.symm h1]
    · simp [zero_pow h0]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_mem_span_C_var_iff
statement:
theorem mvPowerSeries_mem_span_C_var_iff (σ A : Type) [CommRing A] (c : A) (s : σ)
    (g : MvPowerSeries σ A) :
    g ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.C c : MvPowerSeries σ A), MvPowerSeries.X s} ↔
    ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, m s = 0 → c ∣ MvPowerSeries.coeff m g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_pair]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ m hm
    have hX : MvPowerSeries.coeff m (b * MvPowerSeries.X s) = 0 :=
      MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.mp (dvd_mul_left _ _) m hm
    rw [map_add, hX, add_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul_C]
    exact dvd_mul_left _ _
  · intro h
    let q : MvPowerSeries σ A := fun m ↦
      if hm : m s = 0 then Classical.choose (h m hm) else 0
    have hq : ∀ m, m s = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.C c * q) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff m g := by
      intro m hm
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
      have : MvPowerSeries.coeff m q = Classical.choose (h m hm) := by
        change (if hm : m s = 0 then _ else 0) = _
        rw [dif_pos hm]
      rw [this]
      exact (Classical.choose_spec (h m hm)).symm
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : (MvPowerSeries.X s : MvPowerSeries σ A) ∣ g - MvPowerSeries.C c * q := by
      rw [MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff]
      intro m hm
      rw [map_sub, hq m hm, sub_self]
    refine ⟨q, r, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm q, mul_comm r, ← hr]
    ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.mvPowerSeries_fin_two_span_C_var_isPrime
statement:
theorem mvPowerSeries_fin_two_span_C_var_isPrime (A : Type) [CommRing A] (c : A)
    (hc : (Ideal.span {c}).IsPrime) (s : Fin 2) :
    (Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.C c : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) A), MvPowerSeries.X s}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hts, φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ t ≠ s, ∃ φ : TwoSeries A →+* PowerSeries A,
      ∀ g n, PowerSeries.coeff n (φ g) = MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single t n) g := by
    obtain rfl | rfl : s = 0 ∨ s = 1 := by omega
    exacts [⟨1, by decide, _, coeff_substAlgHom_kill A _ (killTFamily_hasSubst A) 0 1
      (by decide) rfl rfl⟩, ⟨0, by decide, _, coeff_substAlgHom_kill A _
      (killXFamily_hasSubst A) 1 0 (by decide) rfl rfl⟩]
  convert RingHom.ker_isPrime ((PowerSeries.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c}))).comp φ)
  ext g
  rw [mvPowerSeries_mem_span_C_var_iff, RingHom.mem_ker, PowerSeries.ext_iff]
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, PowerSeries.coeff_map, hφ, map_zero,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  refine ⟨fun h n ↦ h _ (by simp [hts.symm]), fun h m hm ↦ ?_⟩
  convert h (m t)
  ext i
  obtain rfl | rfl : i = s ∨ i = t := by omega
  · simp [hm, hts.symm]
  · simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.axis_span_isPrime
statement:
theorem axis_span_isPrime (k : Type) [CommRing k] [IsDomain k] (s : Fin 2) :
    (Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mvPowerSeries_fin_two_span_C_var_isPrime k 0 (by simpa using Ideal.isPrime_bot) s

name: SurfaceBlowup.axis_pow_mul_mem_span_cancel
statement:
theorem axis_pow_mul_mem_span_cancel (k : Type) [Field k] (s : Fin 2) (F : TwoSeries k)
    (hF : F ∉ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)}) (n : ℕ) (G : TwoSeries k)
    (hG : (MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ^ n * G ∈ Ideal.span {F}) :
    G ∈ Ideal.span {F}
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by
    simpa [h] using MvPowerSeries.coeff_index_single_self_X (R := k) s
  have step : ∀ H : TwoSeries k, (MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) * H ∈ Ideal.span {F} →
      H ∈ Ideal.span {F} := by
    intro H hH
    obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hH
    have hmem : Y * F ∈ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)} := by
      rw [hY]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    rcases (axis_span_isPrime k s).mem_or_mem hmem with hY1 | hF1
    · obtain ⟨Y₁, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hY1
      have : H = Y₁ * F := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hX
        rw [← hY]; ring
      rw [this]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    · exact absurd hF1 hF
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero => simpa using hG
  | succ n ih => exact step _ (ih _ (by rwa [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]))

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartSubst_apply_generators
statement:
theorem chartSubst_apply_generators (O : Type) [CommRing O] (α : O) :
    (∀ c : O, chartSubst O α (MvPowerSeries.C c) = MvPowerSeries.C c) ∧
    chartSubst O α (axisT O) = axisT O ∧
    chartSubst O α (axisX O) = axisT O * (axisX O + MvPowerSeries.C α) ∧
    (∀ c : O, xChartSubst O (MvPowerSeries.C c) = MvPowerSeries.C c) ∧
    xChartSubst O (axisT O) = axisT O * axisX O ∧ xChartSubst O (axisX O) = axisT O ∧
    (∀ c : O, killT O (MvPowerSeries.C c) = PowerSeries.C c) ∧ killT O (axisT O) = 0 ∧
    killT O (axisX O) = PowerSeries.X
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := tChartFamily_hasSubst O α
  have h₂ := xChartFamily_hasSubst O
  have h₃ := killTFamily_hasSubst O
  refine ⟨fun c ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_, fun c ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_, fun c ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [chartSubst, xChartSubst, killT, MvPowerSeries.substAlgHom_apply, axisT, axisX,
      MvPowerSeries.subst_X h₁, MvPowerSeries.subst_X h₂, MvPowerSeries.subst_X h₃] <;>
    simp [MvPowerSeries.subst_C, tChartFamily, xChartFamily, killTFamily, axisT, axisX]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartSubst_surfaceRelation
statement:
private theorem chartSubst_surfaceRelation (O O' : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing O'] (ρ : O →+* O')
    (α : O')
    (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    chartSubst O' α (MvPowerSeries.map ρ (surfaceRelation O pi u a b)) = MvPowerSeries.C (ρ pi) -
    (substUnit O' α (baseChangeUnit O ρ u) : TwoSeries O') * axisT O' ^ (a + b) *
    (axisX O' + MvPowerSeries.C α) ^ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hC, hT, hX, -⟩ := chartSubst_apply_generators O' α
  have mT : MvPowerSeries.map ρ (axisT O) = axisT O' := MvPowerSeries.map_X _ _
  have mX : MvPowerSeries.map ρ (axisX O) = axisX O' := MvPowerSeries.map_X _ _
  simp only [surfaceRelation, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, MvPowerSeries.map_C, mT, mX, hC, hT, hX]
  have : ((substUnit O' α (baseChangeUnit O ρ u) : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) : TwoSeries O') =
      chartSubst O' α (MvPowerSeries.map ρ (u : TwoSeries O)) := rfl
  rw [this, pow_add, mul_pow]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartSubst_surfaceRelation_base_change_and_x_chart
statement:
theorem chartSubst_surfaceRelation_base_change_and_x_chart (O O' : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing O']
    (ρ : O →+* O') (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    (∀ (θ : O') (hθ : IsUnit θ), chartSubst O' θ
      (MvPowerSeries.map ρ (surfaceRelation O pi u a b)) =
      surfaceRelation O' (ρ pi) (substUnit O' θ (baseChangeUnit O ρ u) * shiftUnit O' θ hθ ^ b)
      (a + b) 0) ∧
    xChartSubst O (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) =
    surfaceRelation O pi (xSubstUnit O u) (a + b) a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro θ hθ
    rw [chartSubst_surfaceRelation]
    have h : ((shiftUnit O' θ hθ : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) : TwoSeries O') =
        axisX O' + MvPowerSeries.C θ := rfl
    simp only [surfaceRelation, Units.val_mul, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, h, pow_zero, mul_one]
    ring
  · obtain ⟨hC, -, -, hxC, hxT, hxX, -⟩ := chartSubst_apply_generators O 0
    have hx : ((xSubstUnit O u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) : TwoSeries O) =
        xChartSubst O (u : TwoSeries O) := rfl
    simp only [surfaceRelation, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, hxC, hxT, hxX, hx]
    ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.chartSubst_surfaceRelation_origin_and_unit_point
statement:
theorem chartSubst_surfaceRelation_origin_and_unit_point (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O)
    (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    chartSubst O 0 (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) = surfaceRelation O pi (substUnit O 0 u) (a + b) b ∧
    ∀ (α : O) (hα : IsUnit α), chartSubst O α (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) =
    surfaceRelation O pi (substUnit O α u * shiftUnit O α hα ^ b) (a + b) 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ α : O, chartSubst O α (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) =
      MvPowerSeries.C pi - (substUnit O α u : TwoSeries O) * axisT O ^ (a + b) *
        (axisX O + MvPowerSeries.C α) ^ b := by
    intro α
    have h := chartSubst_surfaceRelation O O (RingHom.id O) α pi u a b
    have hb : baseChangeUnit O (RingHom.id O) u = u := by
      ext1; simp [baseChangeUnit]
    rw [hb] at h
    simpa using h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [key 0]; simp [surfaceRelation]
  · intro α hα
    rw [key α]
    have : (shiftUnit O α hα : TwoSeries O) = axisX O + MvPowerSeries.C α := rfl
    simp only [surfaceRelation, Units.val_mul, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, this, pow_zero, mul_one]
    ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_point_isMaximal_of_residue_surjective
statement:
theorem chart_point_isMaximal_of_residue_surjective (A S : Type) [CommRing A] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing S] (Λ : A →+* S) (hsurj : ∀ y : S, ∃ x : A, Λ x - y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) :
    ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap Λ).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  let : Field (S ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  have hs : Function.Surjective ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)).comp Λ) := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj y
    exact ⟨x, (Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem _ _).2 hx⟩
  have h := Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective
    (K := (⊥ : Ideal (S ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S))) _ hs
  rwa [← Ideal.comap_comap, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker] at h

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_isNoetherianRing
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_isNoetherianRing (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) [IsNoetherianRing O] :
    IsNoetherianRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_residue_regular_of_special_fiber
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_residue_regular_of_special_fiber (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
    (hreg : Function.Injective
      (fun w : SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b ↦ e
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi}) f) * w)) :
    Function.Injective
    (fun w : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span
      {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi} => Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi}) f * w)
proof:
:=
  fun w₁ w₂ h ↦ e.injective <| hreg <| by simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg e h

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv_parameters
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv_parameters (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O, e
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
        (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) (residueSeries O s)) :
    e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (surfaceT O pi u a b)) = fiberT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b ∧
    e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (surfaceX O pi u a b)) = fiberX (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b ∧
    ∀ c : O, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPowerSeries.C (IsLocalRing.residue O c))
proof:
:= by
  have hres : ∀ s, residueSeries O s = MvPowerSeries.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) s := fun s ↦ rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := he (axisT O)
    rw [hres] at this
    simpa [surfaceT, fiberT, axisT, axisX, MvPowerSeries.map_X] using this
  · have := he (axisX O)
    rw [hres] at this
    simpa [surfaceX, fiberX, axisT, axisX, MvPowerSeries.map_X] using this
  · intro c
    have h1 : algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) c =
        surfaceMk O pi u a b (MvPowerSeries.C c) := by
      change algebraMap O (TwoSeries O ⧸ surfaceIdeal O pi u a b) c = _
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap]
      rfl
    rw [h1, he, hres, MvPowerSeries.map_C]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_vertical
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_vertical (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) :
    algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi =
    (surfaceUnit O pi u a b : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) * surfaceT O pi u a b ^ a *
    surfaceX O pi u a b ^ b
proof:
:= by
  have h : surfaceMk O pi u a b (surfaceRelation O pi u a b) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  rw [surfaceRelation, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow] at h
  have h2 : algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi =
      surfaceMk O pi u a b (MvPowerSeries.C pi) := rfl
  rw [h2, h]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_quotient_sup_eq_contact
statement:
private theorem length_quotient_sup_eq_contact {R SF : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing SF] (p : R)
    (e : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {p}) ≃+* SF) (g c : R) (hp : p ∈ Ideal.span {c}) :
    Module.length R (R ⧸ (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {c})) =
      contact (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p}) g))
      (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p}) c))
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {p}
  let φ : R →+* SF := e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ :=
    e.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let _ : Algebra R SF := φ.toAlgebra
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R SF) := hφ
  unfold contact
  rw [← Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := R) hsurj]
  let ψ : R →ₐ[R] SF ⧸ Ideal.span {φ g, φ c} := Algebra.ofId R _
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp hφ
  have hkerφ : RingHom.ker φ = I := by
    ext x
    simp [φ, RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have hker : RingHom.ker ψ = Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {c} := by
    ext x
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (φ x) = 0 ↔ _
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have h1 : Ideal.span {φ g, φ c} = (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {c}).map φ := by
      rw [← Ideal.span_insert, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
    rw [h1, ← Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' _ hφ, hkerφ]
    have : I ≤ Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {c} :=
      le_sup_of_le_right ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 hp)
    rw [sup_eq_left.2 this]
  have E := (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hψ).toLinearEquiv
  exact ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker).symm.trans E).length_eq

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_surface_contact_eq_special_fiber_contact
statement:
theorem concrete_surface_contact_eq_special_fiber_contact (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O, e
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
        (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) (residueSeries O s))
    (g : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) :
    Module.length (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {surfaceT O pi u a b})) =
    contact (e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})) g))
    (fiberT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) ∧
    (0 < b →
      Module.length (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
      (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ (Ideal.span {g} ⊔ Ideal.span {surfaceX O pi u a b})) =
      contact (e
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})) g))
      (fiberX (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hT, hX, -⟩ := concrete_surface_special_fiber_equiv_parameters O pi u a b e he
  have hv := concrete_surface_vertical O pi u a b
  refine ⟨?_, fun hb ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← hT]
    refine length_quotient_sup_eq_contact _ e g _ ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, hv]
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_right (Dvd.dvd.mul_left (dvd_pow_self _ ha.ne') _) _
  · rw [← hX]
    refine length_quotient_sup_eq_contact _ e g _ ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, hv]
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left (dvd_pow_self _ hb.ne') _

name: SurfaceBlowup.ideal_map_span_singleton
statement:
private theorem ideal_map_span_singleton {R R' F : Type} [Semiring R] [Semiring R'] [FunLike F R R']
    [RingHomClass F R R'] (f : F) (x : R) : (Ideal.span {x}).map f = Ideal.span {f x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: SurfaceBlowup.span_singleton_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem span_singleton_eq_of_ringEquiv {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (e : A ≃+* B)
    {x y : A} (h : Ideal.span {e x} = Ideal.span {e y}) : Ideal.span {x} = Ideal.span {y}
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ideal_map_span_singleton] using congrArg (Ideal.map e.symm) h

name: SurfaceBlowup.contact_congr_span
statement:
private theorem contact_congr_span {B : Type} [CommRing B] {f f' : B} (t : B)
    (h : Ideal.span {f} = Ideal.span {f'}) : contact f t = contact f' t
proof:
:= by
  unfold contact
  rw [Ideal.span_insert, Ideal.span_insert, h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pairwise_disjoint_residueIdealCell
statement:
private theorem pairwise_disjoint_residueIdealCell {R SF : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing SF]
    (p : R) (e : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {p}) ≃+* SF) {P : Ideal SF → Prop} (F : Subtype P → R)
    (hF : ∀ I, Ideal.span {e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p}) (F I))} = I.val) :
    Pairwise fun I J ↦ Disjoint (residueIdealCell p (F I)) (residueIdealCell p (F J))
proof:
:= by
  intro I I' hII'
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro J ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, h1⟩ ⟨_, h2⟩
  refine hII' (Subtype.ext ?_)
  rw [← hF I, ← hF I', ← ideal_map_span_singleton e, ← ideal_map_span_singleton e, ← h1, ← h2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_crossing_state_eq_union_cells
statement:
theorem concrete_crossing_state_eq_union_cells (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hSt : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b) (hSx : S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (hSa : S.a = a)
    (hSb : S.b = b)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O, e
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})
        (surfaceMk O pi u a b s)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) (residueSeries O s))
    (c h : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c) (hh : 0 < h)
    (F : crossingResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b c h → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (hF : ∀ I, Ideal.span
      {e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi})) (F I))} =
      I.val) :
    surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S (State.crossing a b c h) =
    ⋃ I, residueIdealCell (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi) (F I) ∧
    Pairwise
    (fun I J ↦ Disjoint (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi) (F I))
      (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi) (F J)))
proof:
:= by
  have hIC : ∀ g : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b,
      idealContact (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (Ideal.span {g}) S.t =
        contact
          (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi}) g))
          (fiberT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) := fun g ↦ by
    rw [idealContact, hSt]
    exact (concrete_surface_contact_eq_special_fiber_contact O pi u a b ha e he g).1
  have hIX : ∀ g : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b,
      idealContact (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (Ideal.span {g}) S.x =
        contact
          (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi}) g))
          (fiberX (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) := fun g ↦ by
    rw [idealContact, hSx]
    exact (concrete_surface_contact_eq_special_fiber_contact O pi u a b ha e he g).2 hb
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · ext J
    simp only [surfaceStateSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, residueIdealCell,
      State.Valid]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, _, _, _, hJ, hJ'⟩
      let I : crossingResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b c h :=
        ⟨_, _, rfl, (hIC g).symm.trans hJ, (hIX g).symm.trans hJ'⟩
      refine ⟨I, ⟨g, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [ideal_map_span_singleton]; apply span_singleton_eq_of_ringEquiv e; rw [hF I]
    · rintro ⟨I, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hJ⟩
      rw [ideal_map_span_singleton] at hJ
      obtain ⟨f, hf1, hf2, hf3⟩ := I.2
      have hspan : Ideal.span {e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ g)} = Ideal.span {f} := by
        rw [← hf1, ← hF I, ← ideal_map_span_singleton e, ← ideal_map_span_singleton e, hJ]
      exact ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, ⟨ha, hb, hc, hh⟩, hSa, hSb, by rw [hIC, ← hf2, contact_congr_span _ hspan],
        by rw [hIX, ← hf3, contact_congr_span _ hspan]⟩
  · exact pairwise_disjoint_residueIdealCell _ e F hF

name: SurfaceBlowup.concrete_single_state_eq_union_cells
statement:
theorem concrete_single_state_eq_union_cells (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)]
    (S : SurfaceData O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0))
    (hSt : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a 0) (hSa : S.a = a) (hSb : S.b = 0)
    (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0 ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})
      ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0)
    (he : ∀ s : TwoSeries O, e
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})
        (surfaceMk O pi u a 0 s)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0) (residueSeries O s))
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (F : singleResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a c → ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0)
    (hF : ∀ I, Ideal.span
      {e ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi})) (F I))} =
      I.val) :
    surfaceStateSet O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) S (State.single a c) =
    ⋃ I, residueIdealCell (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi) (F I) ∧
    Pairwise
    (fun I J ↦ Disjoint (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi) (F I))
      (residueIdealCell (algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi) (F J)))
proof:
:= by
  have hIC : ∀ g : ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0,
      idealContact (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) (Ideal.span {g}) S.t =
        contact
          (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a 0) pi}) g))
          (fiberT (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a 0) := fun g ↦ by
    rw [idealContact, hSt]
    exact (concrete_surface_contact_eq_special_fiber_contact O pi u a 0 ha e he g).1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · ext J
    simp only [surfaceStateSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, residueIdealCell,
      State.Valid]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, _, _, _, hJ⟩
      let I : singleResidueIdeals (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a c :=
        ⟨_, _, rfl, (hIC g).symm.trans hJ⟩
      refine ⟨I, ⟨g, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [ideal_map_span_singleton]; apply span_singleton_eq_of_ringEquiv e; rw [hF I]
    · rintro ⟨I, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hJ⟩
      rw [ideal_map_span_singleton] at hJ
      obtain ⟨f, hf1, hf2⟩ := I.2
      refine ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, ⟨ha, hc⟩, hSa, hSb, ?_⟩
      rw [hIC, ← hf2]
      apply contact_congr_span
      rw [← hf1, ← hF I, ← ideal_map_span_singleton e, ← ideal_map_span_singleton e, hJ]
  · exact pairwise_disjoint_residueIdealCell _ e F hF

name: SurfaceBlowup.dvr_isAdicComplete_span_uniformizer
statement:
theorem dvr_isAdicComplete_span_uniformizer (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) :
    IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {pi}) O
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hpi.maximalIdeal_eq]
  infer_instance

name: SurfaceBlowup.iInf_sup_pow_eq_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem iInf_sup_pow_eq_of_isLocalRing (S : Type) [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    (I J : Ideal S) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    (⨅ n : ℕ, J ⊔ I ^ n) = J
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (le_iInf fun n ↦ le_sup_left)
  intro s hs
  have h := Ideal.iInf_pow_smul_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (I := I) (M := S ⧸ J) hI
  have hm : Submodule.Quotient.mk s ∈ (⨅ n : ℕ, I ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule S (S ⧸ J))) := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
    intro n
    have := (Submodule.mem_iInf _).1 hs n
    obtain ⟨j, hj, x, hx, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 this
    have hjx : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (j + x) : S ⧸ J) = x • (Submodule.Quotient.mk 1 : S ⧸ J) := by
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero J).2 hj, zero_add]
    rw [hjx]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul hx Submodule.mem_top
  rw [h, Submodule.mem_bot] at hm
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero J).1 hm

name: SurfaceBlowup.ideal_closed_noetherian_local
statement:
theorem ideal_closed_noetherian_local (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) :
    ⨅ n : ℕ, (I ⊔ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)^n) = I
proof:
:=
  iInf_sup_pow_eq_of_isLocalRing A _ I (Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top inferInstance)

name: SurfaceBlowup.isAdicComplete_of_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_of_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A] (J : Ideal A) (hJ : J ≠ ⊤) :
    IsAdicComplete J A
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (x y : A),
      x ≡ y [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule A A)] ↔ x - y ∈ I ^ n := by
    intro I n x y
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
  have hJm : J ≤ m := IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hJ
  have := IsHausdorff.of_isLocalRing J A hJ
  have : IsPrecomplete J A := ⟨fun f hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact {}
  have hf' : ∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ≤ b → f a ≡ f b [SMOD (m ^ a • ⊤ : Submodule A A)] := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [key]
    exact Ideal.pow_right_mono hJm a ((key J a _ _).1 (hf hab))
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec (inferInstance : IsPrecomplete m A) hf'
  refine ⟨L, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [key, ← iInf_sup_pow_eq_of_isLocalRing A m (J ^ n) (Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top inferInstance),
    Ideal.mem_iInf]
  intro N
  have h1 : f n - f (max n N) ∈ J ^ n := (key J n _ _).1 (hf (le_max_left n N))
  have h2 : f (max n N) - L ∈ m ^ N :=
    Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (le_max_right n N) ((key m _ _ _).1 (hL (max n N)))
  simpa using Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left h1) (Ideal.mem_sup_right h2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.isAdicComplete_prod
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_prod (O M N : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module O N] (I : Ideal O) [IsAdicComplete I M] [IsAdicComplete I N] :
    IsAdicComplete I (M × N)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : M × N), x ∈ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O (M × N)) ↔
      x.1 ∈ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O M) ∧ x.2 ∈ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O N) := by
    intro n x
    constructor
    · intro h
      constructor
      · have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := LinearMap.fst O M N) h
        rwa [Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_fst] at this
      · have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := LinearMap.snd O M N) h
        rwa [Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_snd] at this
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have e : x = LinearMap.inl O M N x.1 + LinearMap.inr O M N x.2 := by simp
      rw [e]
      refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
      · have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := LinearMap.inl O M N) h1
        rw [Submodule.map_smul''] at this
        exact Submodule.smul_mono le_rfl le_top this
      · have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := LinearMap.inr O M N) h2
        rw [Submodule.map_smul''] at this
        exact Submodule.smul_mono le_rfl le_top this
  have hmod (n : ℕ) (x y : M × N) : x ≡ y [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O (M × N))] ↔
      x.1 ≡ y.1 [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O M)] ∧
        x.2 ≡ y.2 [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O N)] := by
    simp only [SModEq.sub_mem, key, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
  refine { haus' := fun x hx ↦ ?_, prec' := fun f hf ↦ ?_ }
  · exact Prod.ext (IsHausdorff.haus inferInstance x.1 fun n ↦ ((hmod n x 0).1 (hx n)).1)
      (IsHausdorff.haus inferInstance x.2 fun n ↦ ((hmod n x 0).1 (hx n)).2)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec (I := I) (M := M) inferInstance (f := fun n ↦ (f n).1)
      fun hmn ↦ ((hmod _ _ _).1 (hf hmn)).1
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec (I := I) (M := N) inferInstance (f := fun n ↦ (f n).2)
      fun hmn ↦ ((hmod _ _ _).1 (hf hmn)).2
    exact ⟨(a, b), fun n ↦ (hmod _ _ _).2 ⟨ha n, hb n⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.isAdicComplete_quotient_of_iInf_sup_pow
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_quotient_of_iInf_sup_pow (S : Type) [CommRing S] (I J : Ideal S)
    [IsAdicComplete I S] (hJ : (⨅ n : ℕ, J ⊔ I ^ n) = J) :
    IsAdicComplete (I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) (S ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : S ⧸ J),
      y ∈ ((I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule (S ⧸ J) (S ⧸ J)) ↔
        ∃ x ∈ I ^ n, Ideal.Quotient.mk J x = y := by
    intro n y
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top, ← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have keyS : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : S), x ∈ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule S S) ↔ x ∈ I ^ n := by
    intro n x
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  have h1 : IsHausdorff (I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) (S ⧸ J) := ⟨fun y hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    refine Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hJ ▸ Ideal.mem_iInf.2 fun n ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := (key n _).1 (by simpa only [SModEq.sub_mem, sub_zero] using hy n)
    simpa using Submodule.add_mem_sup (Ideal.Quotient.eq.1 hxs.symm) hx⟩
  have h2 : IsPrecomplete (I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) (S ⧸ J) := by
    refine ⟨fun f hf ↦ ?_⟩
    
    have hstep (n : ℕ) : ∃ x ∈ I ^ n, Ideal.Quotient.mk J x = f (n + 1) - f n := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := (key n _).1 (SModEq.sub_mem.1 (hf (Nat.le_succ n)))
      exact ⟨-x, neg_mem hx, by rw [map_neg, hxe, neg_sub]⟩
    choose x hxI hxe using hstep
    obtain ⟨s0, hs0⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (f 0)
    let s : ℕ → S := fun n ↦ s0 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x i
    have hs : ∀ n, Ideal.Quotient.mk J (s n) = f n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp [s, hs0]
      | succ n ih =>
        have : s (n + 1) = s n + x n := by
          simp only [s, Finset.sum_range_succ]; ring
        rw [this, map_add, ih, hxe]; ring
    have hdiff : ∀ m n, m ≤ n → s n - s m ∈ I ^ m := by
      intro m n hmn
      have : s n - s m = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x i := by
        simp only [s]
        rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hmn]; ring
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i hi ↦
        Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1 (hxI i)
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (inferInstance : IsPrecomplete I S).prec (f := s) fun hmn ↦ by
      rw [SModEq.sub_mem, keyS, ← neg_sub]
      exact neg_mem (hdiff _ _ hmn)
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk J L, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
    have := hL n
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, keyS] at this
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, key]
    exact ⟨s n - L, this, by rw [map_sub, hs]⟩
  exact { toIsHausdorff := h1, toIsPrecomplete := h2 }

name: SurfaceBlowup.isDomain_of_regular_prime_element
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_regular_prime_element (A : Type) [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A] (e : A)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun a : A ↦ e * a)) (hprime : (Ideal.span {e}).IsPrime)
    (hinf : (⨅ n : ℕ, (Ideal.span {e})^n) = ⊥) :
    IsDomain A
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f : A, f ∉ (Ideal.span {e})^n →
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ f' : A, f = e^m * f' ∧ f' ∉ Ideal.span {e} := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro f hf; simp at hf
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f hf
      by_cases hfe : f ∈ Ideal.span {e}
      · obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hfe
        have hg : g ∉ (Ideal.span {e})^n := by
          intro hg
          apply hf
          rw [pow_succ]
          exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hg (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self e)
        obtain ⟨m, f', rfl, hf'⟩ := ih g hg
        exact ⟨m+1, f', by ring, hf'⟩
      · exact ⟨0, f, by simp, hfe⟩
  have dec (f : A) (hf : f ≠ 0) : ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ f' : A, f = e^m * f' ∧ f' ∉ Ideal.span {e} := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, f ∉ Ideal.span {e} ^ n := by
      by_contra! h
      exact hf (by simpa [hinf] using Ideal.mem_iInf.2 h)
    exact key n f hn
  have cancel (k : ℕ) (x : A) (hx : e ^ k * x = 0) : x = 0 :=
    IsLeftRegular.pow k he (hx.trans (mul_zero _).symm)
  have : NoZeroDivisors A := ⟨fun {f g} hfg ↦ by
    by_contra! ⟨hf, hg⟩
    obtain ⟨m, f', rfl, hf'⟩ := dec f hf
    obtain ⟨n, g', rfl, hg'⟩ := dec g hg
    have h0 : f' * g' = 0 := cancel (m + n) _ (by rw [← hfg]; ring)
    exact (hprime.mem_or_mem (h0 ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _)).elim hf' hg'⟩
  exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain A

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_double_quotient_eq
statement:
theorem length_double_quotient_eq (A : Type) [CommRing A] (J I : Ideal A) :
    Module.length (A ⧸ J) ((A ⧸ J) ⧸ Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) I) =
    Module.length A (A ⧸ (J ⊔ I))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A (A ⧸ J)) := by
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]; exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  rw [← Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := A) (R := A ⧸ J)
    (M := (A ⧸ J) ⧸ Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) I) hs]
  exact (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSupₐ A J I).toLinearEquiv.length_eq

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_quotient_sup_mul_eq_add
statement:
theorem length_quotient_sup_mul_eq_add (R : Type) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (s t : R)
    (hs : ∀ x, s * x ∈ I → x ∈ I) :
    Module.length R (R ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {t * s})) = Module.length R (R ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {t})) +
    Module.length R (R ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {s}))
proof:
:= by
  have mem : ∀ r x, x ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span {r} ↔ ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ u : R, x = i + u * r := fun r x ↦ by
    simp only [Submodule.mem_sup, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, _, ⟨u, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i, hi, u, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, u, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i, hi, _, ⟨u, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  set K₁ : Submodule R R := I ⊔ Ideal.span {t}
  set K : Submodule R R := I ⊔ Ideal.span {t * s}
  set K₂ : Submodule R R := I ⊔ Ideal.span {s}
  have ha : K ≤ K₂ := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, u, rfl⟩ := (mem (t * s) x).1 hx
    exact (mem s _).2 ⟨i, hi, u * t, by ring⟩
  let μ : R →ₗ[R] R := LinearMap.mulLeft R s
  have hb : K₁ ≤ K.comap μ := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, u, rfl⟩ := (mem t x).1 hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
    exact (mem (t * s) _).2 ⟨s * i, I.mul_mem_left s hi, u, by simp [μ]; ring⟩
  let f := Submodule.mapQ K₁ K μ hb
  let g := Submodule.mapQ K K₂ LinearMap.id ha
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
    simp only [f, Submodule.mapQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨i, hi, u, hu⟩ := (mem (t * s) _).1 hy
    have : y - u * t ∈ I := hs _ (by
      have : s * (y - u * t) = i := by simp [μ] at hu; linear_combination hu
      rw [this]; exact hi)
    exact (mem t _).2 ⟨_, this, u, by ring⟩
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := Submodule.factor_surjective ha
  have H : Function.Exact f g := by
    rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
    ext z
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range, g, f, Submodule.mapQ_apply,
      LinearMap.id_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, u, rfl⟩ := (mem s _).1 hx
      refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk u, ?_⟩
      rw [Submodule.mapQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
      exact (mem (t * s) _).2 ⟨-i, I.neg_mem hi, 0, by simp [μ]; ring⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ w
      rw [Submodule.mapQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at hw
      obtain ⟨i, hi, u, hu⟩ := (mem (t * s) _).1 hw
      exact (mem s _).2 ⟨-i, I.neg_mem hi, y - u * t, by simp [μ] at hu; linear_combination -hu⟩
  exact Module.length_eq_add_of_exact f g hf hg H

name: SurfaceBlowup.length_quotient_sup_pow_eq_mul
statement:
theorem length_quotient_sup_pow_eq_mul (R : Type) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (t : R)
    (ht : ∀ x, t * x ∈ I → x ∈ I) (n : ℕ) :
    Module.length R (R ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {t ^ n})) = (n : ℕ∞) *
    Module.length R (R ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {t}))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have : Subsingleton (R ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {t ^ 0})) := by
      rw [pow_zero, Ideal.span_singleton_one, sup_top_eq]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr rfl
    rw [Module.length_eq_zero]
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, length_quotient_sup_mul_eq_add R I t (t ^ n) ht, ih]
    push_cast
    rw [add_mul, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.module_length_quotient_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem module_length_quotient_ringEquiv (S S' : Type) [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] (e : S ≃+* S')
    (I : Ideal S) :
    Module.length S (S ⧸ I) = Module.length S' (S' ⧸ Ideal.map (e : S →+* S') I)
proof:
:= by
  let q := Ideal.quotientEquiv I (I.map (e : S →+* S')) e rfl
  have := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  have := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm e
  let f : (S ⧸ I) ≃ₛₗ[(e : S →+* S')] (S' ⧸ Ideal.map (e : S →+* S') I) :=
    { toFun := q
      invFun := q.symm
      left_inv := q.left_inv
      right_inv := q.right_inv
      map_add' := map_add q
      map_smul' := by
        intro s x
        induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
        | h x =>
          change q (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (s * x)) = _
          simp only [q, Ideal.quotientEquiv_mk, map_mul]
          rfl }
  apply WithBot.coe_injective
  rw [Module.coe_length, Module.coe_length,
    Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap f)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.completedLocalAt_ringHom_eq_id
statement:
private theorem completedLocalAt_ringHom_eq_id (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsMaximal] (φ : CompletedLocalAt A P →+* CompletedLocalAt A P)
    (hφ : φ.comp (completedPointMap A P) = completedPointMap A P)
    (hle : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt A P) ≤
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt A P)).comap φ) :
    φ = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  have : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime P) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl _ inferInstance
  set M := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (CompletedLocalAt A P)
  have hmhat : M = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)) := AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map
  refine RingHom.ext <| congrFun <| IsHausdorff.funext' M (f := fun y => φ y)
    (g := fun y => y) fun n y => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := finite_completed_point_quotient_surjective A P n (M ^ n) (by rw [hmhat])
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ y)
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply] at hx
  have h : φ (completedPointMap A P x - y) ∈ M ^ n :=
    (Ideal.pow_right_mono hle n).trans (Ideal.le_comap_pow φ n) (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hx)
  rw [map_sub, ← RingHom.comp_apply φ, hφ] at h
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr h).symm.trans hx

name: SurfaceBlowup.chart_child_completion_equiv
statement:
theorem chart_child_completion_equiv (O O' : Type) [CommRing O] [IsNoetherianRing O] [CommRing O']
    [IsDomain O'] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O'] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ) (pi' : O')
    (hpi' : Irreducible pi') (u' : (TwoSeries O')ˣ) (a' b' : ℕ) (ha' : 0 < a') (E F : TwoSeries O)
    (hEF : (E = axisT O ∧ F = axisX O) ∨ (E = axisX O ∧ F = axisT O)) (ρ : O →+* O') (α : O')
    (s : TwoSeries O →+* TwoSeries O')
    (hsC : ∀ c : O, s (MvPowerSeries.C c) = MvPowerSeries.C (ρ c)) (hsE : s E = axisT O')
    (hsF : s F = axisT O' * (axisX O' + MvPowerSeries.C α))
