        cellMeasure O N D {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ^ L}) :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving f P (cellMeasure O N D)
proof:
:= by
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  have hgen := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O m htop N
  refine ⟨hf, finite_measures_from_cylinders O (Fin N → O) m _ _ hgen fun L x => ?_⟩
  have hB : {y : Fin N → O | adicCongr m L y x} = {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L} := by
    ext y; exact finite_coordinate_adic_congruence O N m L y x
  have hBm : MeasurableSet {y : Fin N → O | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L} := by
    have h1 : @MeasurableSet _ (adicCylinderSpace m (Fin N → O)) {y | adicCongr m L y x} :=
      MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (Or.inr ⟨L, x, rfl⟩)
    rwa [← hgen, hB] at h1
  rw [hB, MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply hf hBm]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos L with rfl | hL
  · have : {y : Fin N → O | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ 0} = Set.univ := by ext y; simp
    rw [this, Set.preimage_univ, MeasureTheory.measure_univ, MeasureTheory.measure_univ]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ D
  · exact hball L hL x hx
  
  have hfar : ∀ y ∈ D, ¬ ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L := fun y hy hyx => hx <| by
    rw [hDball y hy]
    exact fun j => by simpa only [neg_sub] using m.neg_mem (Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega) (hyx j))
  have h0 : cellMeasure O N D {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L} = 0 := by
    rw [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' hDm,
      show {y : Fin N → O | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L} ∩ D = ∅ from
        Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun y ⟨h1, h2⟩ => hfar y h2 h1]
    simp
  rw [h0]
  exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null (fun a ha haS => hfar _ (hSD haS) ha) hS

name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_cells_measure_preserving
statement:
theorem factor_cells_measure_preserving (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (g : ι → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hg : ∀ i, (g i).Monic)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j))
    [hσ : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite
      (cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))] :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (factorProduct (fun i => (g i).natDegree))
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun i => cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))))
      (cellMeasure O (∑ i, (g i).natDegree)
        (residueCell O (∑ i, (g i).natDegree) (∏ i, g i)))
proof:
:= by
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  set n := ∑ i, (g i).natDegree
  set C := residueCell O n (∏ i, g i)
  set PC := Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))
  set f := factorProduct (O := O) (fun i => (g i).natDegree)
  set q : ℝ≥0∞ := (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) with hq
  have hfm : Measurable f := (factor_product_continuous O ι (fun i => (g i).natDegree)).2
  have hGm : (∏ i, g i).Monic := Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hg i)
  have hGn : (∏ i, g i).natDegree = n := Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hg i)
  obtain ⟨hCm, hCmass, hρprob⟩ := residue_cell_mass O htop n (∏ i, g i) hGm hGn
  obtain ⟨hPprob, hPnull, hPball⟩ := factor_cell_product_measure O htop ι g hg
  have hbij := factor_product_bijection O ι g hg hc
  obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 Nat.card_pos.ne'
  have hqt : q ≠ ⊤ := by simp [hq]
  have hqi0 : q⁻¹ ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr hqt)
  have hqit : q⁻¹ ^ n ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr hq0)
  refine measurePreserving_cellMeasure_of_balls O htop _ n C hCm (residue_cell_cylinder O n _).1 f
    hfm PC hPnull hbij.mapsTo fun j hj x hx => ?_
  set B := {y : Fin n → O | ∀ i, y i - x i ∈ m ^ j} with hBdef
  have hmj : m ^ j ≤ m := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega)
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hfa'⟩ := hbij.surjOn hx
  have hBC : B ⊆ C := fun y hy => by
    change y ∈ residueCell O n (∏ i, g i)
    rw [(residue_cell_cylinder O n _).1 x hx]
    exact fun i => hmj (hy i)
  have hpre : f ⁻¹' B ∩ PC = Set.pi Set.univ
      (fun i => {b : Fin (g i).natDegree → O | ∀ k, b k - a' i k ∈ m ^ j}) := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hfa, haP⟩
      simpa using (factor_product_congruence_iff O ι g hc j a a' haP ha').1
        fun k => by have h := hfa k; rw [← hfa'] at h; exact h
    · intro ha
      simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, true_implies] at ha
      have haP : a ∈ PC := by
        simp only [PC, Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies]
        intro i
        rw [(residue_cell_cylinder O _ _).1 _ (ha' i (Set.mem_univ i))]
        exact fun k => hmj (ha i k)
      refine ⟨?_, haP⟩
      change ∀ k, f a k - x k ∈ m ^ j
      rw [← hfa']
      exact (factor_product_congruence_iff O ι g hc j a a' haP ha').2 ha
  have hmass : coefficientMeasure O n B = q⁻¹ ^ (n * j) := by
    have := coefficient_uniformizer_cylinder_mass O htop n pi hpi j x
    rw [← hpi.maximalIdeal_eq] at this
    rw [← this]
    congr 1
    ext y; exact (finite_coordinate_adic_congruence O n m j y x).symm
  rw [← MeasureTheory.measure_inter_conull hPnull, hpre, hPball j hj a' ha', cellMeasure,
    MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' hCm,
    Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hBC, hCmass, hmass]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, j = k + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_add, mul_one, pow_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (q⁻¹ ^ (n * k)),
    mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hqi0 hqit, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_coeff_fin
statement:
private theorem formPoly_coeff_fin {A : Type} [CommRing A] {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → A)
    (k : Fin (n + 1)) : (formPoly a).coeff (k : ℕ) = a k
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Fin.val_inj]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_inj_fin
statement:
private theorem formPoly_inj_fin {A : Type} [CommRing A] {n : ℕ} (a a' : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    formPoly a = formPoly a' ↔ a = a'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => funext fun k => by rw [← formPoly_coeff_fin a k, ← formPoly_coeff_fin a' k, h],
    fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_map_fin
statement:
private theorem formPoly_map_fin {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) {n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) : (formPoly a).map f = formPoly (fun i => f (a i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, Polynomial.map_sum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_insertOne_last_eq
statement:
private theorem formPoly_insertOne_last_eq {A : Type} [CommRing A] {d : ℕ} (b : Fin d → A) :
    formPoly (insertOne (Fin.last d) b) = monicPolyO b
proof:
:= by
  unfold formPoly monicPolyO insertOne
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp [add_comm]

name: SurfaceBlowup.reducedFormCell_last_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [reducedFormCell, normalizedFormCell, residueCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  have h1 : insertOne (Fin.last d) b (Fin.last d) = 1 := by simp [insertOne]
  rw [← formPoly_insertOne_last_eq, formPoly_map_fin, formPoly_inj_fin]
  simp only [h1, true_and]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.insertOne_last_comp_rev
statement:
private theorem insertOne_last_comp_rev {A : Type} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ} (b : Fin r → A) :
    insertOne (Fin.last r) (b ∘ Fin.rev) = insertOne 0 b ∘ Fin.rev
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp [insertOne]
  · simp [insertOne, Fin.rev_castSucc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_reducedFormCell_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_reducedFormCell_zero_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (r : ℕ)
    (b : Fin r → O) :
    b ∈ reducedFormCell O r 0 (Pi.single 0 1) ↔
      b ∘ Fin.rev ∈ residueCell O r (Polynomial.X ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (Polynomial.X ^ r : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
      = formPoly (Pi.single (Fin.last r) 1) := by
    have h0 : monicPolyO (0 : Fin r → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) = Polynomial.X ^ r := by
      simp [monicPolyO]
    rw [← h0, ← formPoly_insertOne_last_eq]
    congr 1
    funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [insertOne]
    · simp [insertOne, Fin.castSucc_ne_last]
  rw [hX, ← reducedFormCell_last_eq]
  simp only [reducedFormCell, normalizedFormCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, insertOne_last_comp_rev]
  have h0 : insertOne 0 b 0 = 1 := by simp [insertOne]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fin.rev_last, h0, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [← (show (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin (r+1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ∘ Fin.rev
        = Pi.single (Fin.last r) 1 from ?_), ← h]
    · rfl
    · funext i; simp [Pi.single_apply, Fin.rev_eq_iff]
  · intro h
    funext i
    have := congrFun h (Fin.rev i)
    simp only [residueVector, Function.comp_apply, Fin.rev_rev] at this ⊢
    rw [this]; simp [Pi.single_apply, Fin.rev_eq_iff]

name: SurfaceBlowup.comp_rev_comp_rev
statement:
private theorem comp_rev_comp_rev {A : Type} {r : ℕ} (b : Fin r → A) :
    (b ∘ Fin.rev) ∘ Fin.rev = b
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_cell_monic_identification
statement:
theorem form_cell_monic_identification (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (r : ℕ) :
    (∀ (d : ℕ) (g : Fin (d+1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O),
      reducedFormCell O d (Fin.last d) g = residueCell O d (formPoly g)) ∧
    Set.BijOn (fun b : Fin r → O => b ∘ Fin.rev) (reducedFormCell O r 0 (Pi.single 0 1))
      (residueCell O r (Polynomial.X ^ r)) ∧
    (∀ (L : ℕ) (b b' : Fin r → O), (∀ j, b j - b' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) ↔
      ∀ j, (b ∘ Fin.rev) j - (b' ∘ Fin.rev) j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) ∧
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (fun b : Fin r → O => b ∘ Fin.rev)
      (cellMeasure O r (reducedFormCell O r 0 (Pi.single 0 1)))
      (cellMeasure O r (residueCell O r (Polynomial.X ^ r)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcong : ∀ (L : ℕ) (b b' : Fin r → O),
      (∀ j, b j - b' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) ↔
        ∀ j, (b ∘ Fin.rev) j - (b' ∘ Fin.rev) j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L :=
    fun L b b' => ⟨fun h j => h _, fun h j => by simpa using h (Fin.rev j)⟩
  refine ⟨reducedFormCell_last_eq O, ?_, hcong, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun b hb => (mem_reducedFormCell_zero_iff O r b).1 hb, ?_,
      fun b' hb' => ⟨b' ∘ Fin.rev, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro b _ b' _ h
      simpa [comp_rev_comp_rev] using congrArg (fun c : Fin r → O => c ∘ Fin.rev) h
    · rw [mem_reducedFormCell_zero_iff]; simpa [comp_rev_comp_rev] using hb'
    · simp [comp_rev_comp_rev]
  let R : (Fin r → O) ≃ᵐ (Fin r → O) :=
    { toFun := fun b => b ∘ Fin.rev
      invFun := fun b => b ∘ Fin.rev
      left_inv := comp_rev_comp_rev
      right_inv := comp_rev_comp_rev
      measurable_toFun := measurable_pi_iff.2 (fun j => measurable_pi_apply _)
      measurable_invFun := measurable_pi_iff.2 (fun j => measurable_pi_apply _) }
  have hR : ∀ b, R b = b ∘ Fin.rev := fun _ => rfl
  have hμ : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving R (coefficientMeasure O r)
      (coefficientMeasure O r) := by
    refine ⟨R.measurable, ?_⟩
    have huniv : coefficientMeasure O r Set.univ = 1 := by
      simpa using coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop r 0 0
    have : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (coefficientMeasure O r) := ⟨by simp [huniv]⟩
    refine finite_measures_from_cylinders O (Fin r → O) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) _ _
      (finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O _ htop r) fun j x => ?_
    have hset : ∀ z : Fin r → O, {y | adicCongr (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) j y z}
        = {y | ∀ i, y i - z i ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ j} := fun z => by
      ext y; exact finite_coordinate_adic_congruence O r _ j y z
    rw [hset, R.map_apply]
    have hpre : R ⁻¹' {y | ∀ i, y i - x i ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ j}
        = {y | ∀ i, y i - (x ∘ Fin.rev) i ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ j} := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hR]
      rw [hcong j y (x ∘ Fin.rev)]
      simp
    rw [hpre, coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop, coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop]
  have hpre : R ⁻¹' residueCell O r (Polynomial.X ^ r) = reducedFormCell O r 0 (Pi.single 0 1) := by
    ext b; simp [hR, mem_reducedFormCell_zero_iff]
  have h2 := hμ.restrict_preimage_emb R.measurableEmbedding (residueCell O r (Polynomial.X ^ r))
  have hmass := hμ.measure_preimage_emb R.measurableEmbedding (residueCell O r (Polynomial.X ^ r))
  rw [hpre] at h2 hmass
  refine ⟨R.measurable, ?_⟩
  unfold cellMeasure
  rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_smul, show (fun b : Fin r → O => b ∘ Fin.rev) = ⇑R from rfl,
    h2.map_eq, hmass]

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_product_measurable
statement:
theorem form_product_measurable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1) (hc : FormsCoprime d g) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1))
    (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1) :
    Measurable (reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ)
proof:
:= by
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  set f := reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ
  set PC : Set (∀ i, Fin (d i) → O) :=
    Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
  have hPC : MeasurableSet PC := MeasurableSet.univ_pi (fun i ↦
    (normalized_form_cell_cylinder_mass O htop (d i) (ν i) (g i) (hgν i)).2.2.2.1)
  have hoff : ∀ a, a ∉ PC → f a = 0 := fun a ha ↦ by
    simp only [f, reducedFormProduct]
    exact if_neg fun h ↦ ha fun i _ ↦ h i
  have hball : ∀ (k : ℕ) (L : ℕ) (x : Fin k → O),
      MeasurableSet {b : Fin k → O | ∀ j, b j - x j ∈ m ^ L} := fun k L x ↦ by
    have hk := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O m htop k
    have : @MeasurableSet _ (adicCylinderSpace m (Fin k → O)) {b | adicCongr m L b x} :=
      MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom (Or.inr ⟨L, x, rfl⟩)
    rw [← hk] at this
    convert this using 1
    ext b
    exact (finite_coordinate_adic_congruence O k m L b x).symm
  have hk := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O m htop (∑ i, d i)
  change @Measurable _ _ _ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin _ → O)) f
  rw [hk]
  refine measurable_generateFrom ?_
  rintro s (rfl | ⟨L, x, rfl⟩)
  · simp
  obtain ⟨_, hsymm, htrans, -, -⟩ := adic_congruence_rules O (Fin (∑ i, d i) → O) m
  by_cases hne : ∃ a₀ ∈ PC, adicCongr m L (f a₀) x
  · obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hfa₀⟩ := hne
    have heq : f ⁻¹' {y | adicCongr m L y x} =
        (PC ∩ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ {b : Fin (d i) → O | ∀ j, b j - a₀ i j ∈ m ^ L})) ∪
        (PCᶜ ∩ {_a | adicCongr m L (0 : Fin (∑ i, d i) → O) x}) := by
      ext a
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff,
        Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_univ_pi]
      by_cases ha : a ∈ PC
      · simp only [ha, true_and, not_true_eq_false, false_and, or_false]
        constructor
        · intro h
          have h2 : adicCongr m L (f a) (f a₀) := htrans _ _ _ _ h (hsymm _ _ _ hfa₀)
          rw [finite_coordinate_adic_congruence] at h2
          exact form_product_congruence_reflects O ι d ν g hgν hc μ hμ a a₀ ha ha₀ L h2
        · intro h
          refine htrans _ _ _ _ ?_ hfa₀
          rw [finite_coordinate_adic_congruence]
          exact (form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a a₀ ha ha₀).2.2.2 L h
      · simp only [ha, false_and, false_or, not_false_eq_true, true_and, hoff a ha]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hPC.inter (MeasurableSet.univ_pi (fun i ↦ hball _ _ _))).union
      (hPC.compl.inter (MeasurableSet.const _))
  · push Not at hne
    have heq : f ⁻¹' {y | adicCongr m L y x} =
        PCᶜ ∩ {_a | adicCongr m L (0 : Fin (∑ i, d i) → O) x} := by
      ext a
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_compl_iff]
      by_cases ha : a ∈ PC
      · simp only [ha, not_true_eq_false, false_and, iff_false]
        exact hne a ha
      · simp only [ha, not_false_eq_true, true_and, hoff a ha]
    rw [heq]
    exact hPC.compl.inter (MeasurableSet.const _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_cells_measure_preserving
statement:
theorem form_cells_measure_preserving (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1) (hc : FormsCoprime d g) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1))
    (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1)
    [hσ : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite
      (cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))] :
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun i => cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))))
      (cellMeasure O (∑ i, d i) (reducedFormCell O (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g)))
proof:
:= by
  let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  let f := reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ
  let P := MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
    (fun i => cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))
  let PC := Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
  let D := reducedFormCell O (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g)
  have hfm : Measurable f := form_product_measurable O htop ι d ν g hgν hc μ hμ
  obtain ⟨hPprob, hPnull, hPball⟩ := form_cell_product_measure O htop ι d ν g hgν
  obtain ⟨-, hDball, -, hDmeas, -, hDprob, hDmass⟩ :=
    normalized_form_cell_cylinder_mass O htop (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g) hμ
  refine measurePreserving_cellMeasure_of_balls O htop P _ D hDmeas hDball f hfm PC hPnull
    (fun a ha => (form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a a ha ha).1)
    fun L hL x hx => ?_
  have hmL : m ^ L ≤ m := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega)
  rw [hDmass L x hL hx]
  obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := (form_product_bijection O ι d ν g hgν hc μ hμ).surjOn hx
  have hsub : Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => {b : Fin (d i) → O | ∀ j, b j - a' i j ∈ m ^ L}) ⊆
      PC := by
    intro a ha i _
    change a i ∈ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)
    rw [(normalized_form_cell_cylinder_mass O htop (d i) (ν i) (g i) (hgν i)).2.1 (a' i)
      (ha' i trivial)]
    exact fun j => hmL (ha i trivial j)
  rw [← MeasureTheory.measure_inter_conull hPnull, ← hPball L hL a' ha']
  congr 1
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ i _ j
    exact form_product_congruence_reflects O ι d ν g hgν hc μ hμ a a' h2 ha' L h1 i j
  · exact fun ha => ⟨(form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a a' (hsub ha)
      ha').2.2.2 L (fun i j => ha i trivial j), hsub ha⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.card_units_mod_pow
statement:
private theorem card_units_mod_pow (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (L : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    Nat.card {c : O ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L |
        ∃ y, Ideal.Quotient.mk _ y = c ∧ y ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O}
      = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ L -
        Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ (L-1)
proof:
:= by
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  have hle : m ^ L ≤ m := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega)
  set J : Ideal (O ⧸ m ^ L) := m.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ L))
  have hU : {c : O ⧸ m^L | ∃ y, Ideal.Quotient.mk _ y = c ∧ y ∉ m} =
      (J : Set (O ⧸ m^L))ᶜ := by
    ext c
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, J,
      Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl, hy⟩ ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩
      exact hy (by simpa using m.sub_mem hz (hle (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hzy)))
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
      exact ⟨y, rfl, fun hy => h ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩
  have hQ := residue_quotient_card O L
  have hq0 : 0 < Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := Nat.card_pos
  have hfin : Finite (O ⧸ m ^ L) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hQ]; positivity)
  have hcard := Submodule.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card J
  have hquot : Nat.card ((O ⧸ m ^ L) ⧸ J) = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :=
    Nat.card_congr (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE hle).toEquiv
  rw [hquot, hQ] at hcard
  have hJ : Nat.card J = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ (L - 1) := by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, L = k + 1 := ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [pow_succ] at hcard
    simpa using (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hq0 hcard).symm
  rw [hU, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  have h2 := Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl (J : Set (O ⧸ m^L))
  have h3 : (J : Set (O ⧸ m^L)).ncard = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ (L - 1) := by
    rw [← hJ]; rfl
  rw [h3, hQ] at h2
  omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.unit_multiple_cylinder_mass
statement:
private theorem unit_multiple_cylinder_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n L : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (μ : Fin (n + 1))
    (bt : Fin (n + 1) → O) (hb : bt μ = 1) :
    MeasurableSet {a : Fin (n+1) → O | a μ ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ∧
      ∀ j, a j - a μ * bt j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L} ∧
    coefficientMeasure O (n+1) {a : Fin (n+1) → O | a μ ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ∧
      ∀ j, a j - a μ * bt j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L}
      = ((Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ L -
          Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ (L-1) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) /
        ((Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ^ L) ^ (n+1) : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  have hle : m ^ L ≤ m := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega)
  have hQ := residue_quotient_card O L
  have : Finite (O ⧸ m ^ L) :=
    Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hQ]; exact (pow_pos Nat.card_pos L).ne')
  let mk := Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ L)
  let π : (Fin (n+1) → O) →+ (Fin (n+1) → O ⧸ m ^ L) :=
    (mk : O →+ O ⧸ m ^ L).compLeft (Fin (n+1))
  have hπ : ∀ a j, π a j = mk (a j) := fun _ _ => rfl
  set U := {c : O ⧸ m^L | ∃ y, mk y = c ∧ y ∉ m} with hUdef
  set S := (fun c : O ⧸ m^L => fun j => c * mk (bt j)) '' U with hSdef
  have hE : {a : Fin (n+1) → O | a μ ∉ m ∧ ∀ j, a j - a μ * bt j ∈ m ^ L} = π ⁻¹' S := by
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage, hSdef, hUdef, Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨mk (a μ), ⟨a μ, rfl, h1⟩, funext fun j => ?_⟩
      rw [hπ, ← map_mul]
      exact (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (h2 j)).symm
    · rintro ⟨c, ⟨y, rfl, hy⟩, hc⟩
      have hj : ∀ j, mk (a j) = mk y * mk (bt j) := fun j => by rw [← hπ, ← hc]
      have hμ' : mk (a μ) = mk y := by rw [hj μ, hb, map_one, mul_one]
      have hyμ : a μ - y ∈ m ^ L := Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hμ'
      refine ⟨fun h => hy (by simpa using m.sub_mem h (hle hyμ)),
        fun j => Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, hj j, hμ']
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := fun v =>
    ⟨fun j => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (v j)).choose,
      funext fun j => (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (v j)).choose_spec⟩
  have hball : ∀ x0 : Fin (n+1) → O,
      MeasurableSet {b' : Fin (n+1) → O | ∀ j, b' j - x0 j ∈ m ^ L} := by
    intro x0
    have : @MeasurableSet _ (adicCylinderSpace m (Fin (n+1) → O))
        {b' : Fin (n+1) → O | ∀ j, b' j - x0 j ∈ m ^ L} := by
      apply MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom
      refine Or.inr ⟨L, x0, ?_⟩
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      rw [finite_coordinate_adic_congruence]
    rwa [← finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O m htop (n+1)] at this
  have hfib : ∀ v, MeasurableSet {x | π x = v} := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨x0, rfl⟩ := hsurj v
    convert hball x0 using 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact ⟨fun h j => Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp (by rw [← hπ, ← hπ, h]),
      fun h => funext fun j => Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (h j)⟩
  have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop (n+1)
  have : MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddLeftInvariant (coefficientMeasure O (n+1)) := by
    unfold coefficientMeasure; infer_instance
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet (π ⁻¹' S) := by
    have : π ⁻¹' S = ⋃ s ∈ S, {x | π x = s} := by ext; simp
    rw [this]
    exact MeasurableSet.biUnion (Set.to_countable S) fun s _ => hfib s
  refine ⟨hE ▸ hmeas, ?_⟩
  rw [hE, finite_quotient_event_mass _ _ (coefficientMeasure O (n+1)) π hsurj hfib S]
  have hS : Nat.card S = Nat.card U :=
    Nat.card_image_of_injective (fun c c' h => by simpa [hb] using congrFun h μ) _
  rw [hS, card_units_mod_pow O L hL, Nat.card_fun, hQ, Nat.card_fin]

name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_mass_ratio
statement:
private theorem projective_mass_ratio (q n L : ℕ) (hq : 1 < q) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    (((q : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) * (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1))⁻¹ *
        (((q ^ L - q ^ (L-1) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) / ((q ^ L) ^ (n+1) : ℕ))
      = (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n * (L-1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, L = k + 1 := ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [show q ^ (k+1) - q ^ k = q ^ k * (q - 1) by rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_sub, mul_one]]
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  have hqt : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.natCast_ne_top q
  have hqr : (q : ℝ≥0∞) * (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ = 1 := ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hq0 hqt
  have hq1 : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) = (q : ℝ≥0∞) - 1 := by
    rw [ENNReal.natCast_sub]; simp
  have hs0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hq1]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : q - 1 ≠ 0)
  have hst : (q : ℝ≥0∞) - 1 ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.sub_ne_top hqt
  push_cast
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inl hs0) (Or.inl hst), ← pow_mul]
  simp only [ENNReal.inv_pow, inv_inv]
  set r := (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
  set Q := (q : ℝ≥0∞)
  set s := Q - 1
  have hss : s⁻¹ * s = 1 := ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hs0 hst
  rw [show (k+1) * (n+1) = (n + 1 + k) + n * k by ring, pow_add r]
  have hpow : Q ^ (n+1+k) * r ^ (n+1+k) = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, hqr, one_pow]
  calc s⁻¹ * Q ^ (n + 1) * (Q ^ k * s * (r ^ (n + 1 + k) * r ^ (n * k)))
      = (s⁻¹ * s) * (Q ^ (n+1+k) * r ^ (n+1+k)) * r ^ (n * k) := by ring
    _ = r ^ (n * k) := by rw [hss, hpow, one_mul, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.projectiveNormalize_alg
statement:
private theorem projectiveNormalize_alg (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (n : ℕ)
    (G : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (μ : Fin (n + 1)) (hGμ : G μ = 1) :
    Set.MapsTo (projectiveNormalize O n G μ) (projectiveCell O n G) (reducedFormCell O n μ G) ∧
    Set.SurjOn (projectiveNormalize O n G μ) (projectiveCell O n G) (reducedFormCell O n μ G) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ projectiveCell O n G, ∀ a' ∈ projectiveCell O n G,
      projectiveNormalize O n G μ a = projectiveNormalize O n G μ a' ↔
        ∃ u : Oˣ, a' = (u : O) • a)
proof:
:= by
  set PC := projectiveCell O n G
  have hunit : ∀ a ∈ PC, ∃ v : Oˣ, a μ = v ∧
      residueVector O a = IsLocalRing.residue O (v : O) • G := by
    rintro a ⟨-, c, hc, hac⟩
    have hr : IsLocalRing.residue O (a μ) = c := by
      simpa [residueVector, hGμ] using congrFun hac μ
    have hu : IsUnit (a μ) := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, ← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hr]; exact hc
    exact ⟨hu.unit, rfl, by rw [hac]; simp [hr]⟩
  have hnorm : ∀ (a : Fin (n+1) → O) (v : Oˣ), a μ = v →
      normalizeAt μ a = ((v⁻¹ : Oˣ) : O) • a := fun a v hv => by
    simp only [normalizeAt, hv, Ring.inverse_unit]
  have hins : ∀ w : Fin (n+1) → O, w μ = 1 → insertOne μ (dropCoord μ w) = w := fun w hw => by
    simp only [insertOne, dropCoord]
    rw [← hw]; exact Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth μ w
  have hnm : ∀ a ∈ PC, projectiveNormalize O n G μ a = dropCoord μ (normalizeAt μ a) :=
    fun a ha => if_pos ha
  have hnμ : ∀ a ∈ PC, normalizeAt μ a μ = 1 := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := hunit a ha
    rw [hnorm a v hv]; simp [hv]
  have hinj : ∀ a ∈ PC, ∀ a' ∈ PC,
      projectiveNormalize O n G μ a = projectiveNormalize O n G μ a' ↔
        normalizeAt μ a = normalizeAt μ a' := by
    intro a ha a' ha'
    rw [hnm a ha, hnm a' ha']
    exact ⟨fun h => by rw [← hins _ (hnμ a ha), ← hins _ (hnμ a' ha'), h], fun h => by rw [h]⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hres⟩ := hunit a ha
    change insertOne μ (projectiveNormalize O n G μ a) ∈ normalizedFormCell O n μ G
    rw [hnm a ha, hins _ (hnμ a ha)]
    refine ⟨hnμ a ha, ?_⟩
    rw [hnorm a v hv]
    funext i
    have := congrFun hres i
    simp only [residueVector, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul] at this ⊢
    rw [this, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one, one_mul]
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ : insertOne μ b ∈ normalizedFormCell O n μ G := hb
    have hPC : insertOne μ b ∈ PC :=
      ⟨⟨μ, by rw [h1]; exact isUnit_one⟩, 1, one_ne_zero, by rw [h2, one_smul]⟩
    refine ⟨insertOne μ b, hPC, ?_⟩
    rw [hnm _ hPC]
    simp only [normalizeAt]
    rw [h1, Ring.inverse_one, one_smul]
    simp only [dropCoord, insertOne, Fin.removeNth_insertNth]
  · intro a ha a' ha'
    rw [hinj a ha a' ha']
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := hunit a ha
    obtain ⟨v', hv', -⟩ := hunit a' ha'
    rw [hnorm a v hv, hnorm a' v' hv']
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨v' * v⁻¹, funext fun j => ?_⟩
      have := congrFun h j
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this ⊢
      calc a' j = (v' : O) * (((v'⁻¹ : Oˣ) : O) * a' j) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, one_mul]
        _ = _ := by rw [← this]; simp only [Units.val_mul]; ring
    · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
      obtain rfl : v' = u * v := by
        ext; rw [← hv', Units.val_mul, ← hv]; simp
      funext j
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_inv_rev, Units.val_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_assoc (v⁻¹ : Oˣ).val, Units.inv_mul, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.projectiveNormalize_preimage_ball
statement:
private theorem projectiveNormalize_preimage_ball (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    (n : ℕ) (G : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (μ : Fin (n + 1)) (L : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (x : Fin n → O) (hx : x ∈ reducedFormCell O n μ G) :
    projectiveCell O n G ∩
        projectiveNormalize O n G μ ⁻¹' {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L}
      = {a | a μ ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ∧
          ∀ j, a j - a μ * insertOne μ x j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L}
proof:
:= by
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  have hle : m ^ L ≤ m := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ : insertOne μ x ∈ normalizedFormCell O n μ G := hx
  have hxs : ∀ i, insertOne μ x (μ.succAbove i) = x i := fun i => by
    simp [insertOne, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
  ext a
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨-, c, hc, hac⟩, hB⟩
    have hG : G μ = 1 := by simpa [residueVector, h1] using (congrFun h2 μ).symm
    have hr : IsLocalRing.residue O (a μ) = c := by simpa [residueVector, hG] using congrFun hac μ
    have hu : IsUnit (a μ) := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, ← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hr]; exact hc
    refine ⟨IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr hu, fun j => ?_⟩
    rw [projectiveNormalize, if_pos ⟨⟨μ, hu⟩, c, hc, hac⟩] at hB
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove μ j with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rw [h1, mul_one, sub_self]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · have := hB i
      simp only [dropCoord, normalizeAt, Fin.removeNth, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
      rw [hxs]
      convert Ideal.mul_mem_left (m ^ L) (a μ) this using 1
      rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hu, one_mul]
  · rintro ⟨hμ, hj⟩
    have hu : IsUnit (a μ) := IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hμ
    have hres : residueVector O a = IsLocalRing.residue O (a μ) • G := by
      funext j
      have : IsLocalRing.residue O (a j) = IsLocalRing.residue O (a μ * insertOne μ x j) :=
        Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (hle (hj j))
      rw [← h2]
      simpa [residueVector, map_mul] using this
    have hPC : a ∈ projectiveCell O n G :=
      ⟨⟨μ, hu⟩, _, (hu.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)).ne_zero, hres⟩
    refine ⟨hPC, fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [projectiveNormalize, if_pos hPC]
    simp only [dropCoord, normalizeAt, Fin.removeNth, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have h3 := Ideal.mul_mem_left (m ^ L) (Ring.inverse (a μ)) (hj (μ.succAbove i))
    rw [hxs] at h3
    convert h3 using 1
    rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_cell_normalization_pushforward
statement:
theorem projective_cell_normalization_pushforward (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (G : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (μ : Fin (n + 1)) (hGμ : G μ = 1) :
    Set.MapsTo (projectiveNormalize O n G μ) (projectiveCell O n G) (reducedFormCell O n μ G) ∧
    Set.SurjOn (projectiveNormalize O n G μ) (projectiveCell O n G) (reducedFormCell O n μ G) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ projectiveCell O n G, ∀ a' ∈ projectiveCell O n G,
      projectiveNormalize O n G μ a = projectiveNormalize O n G μ a' ↔
        ∃ u : Oˣ, a' = (u : O) • a) ∧
    MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (projectiveNormalize O n G μ)
      (cellMeasure O (n+1) (projectiveCell O n G)) (cellMeasure O n (reducedFormCell O n μ G))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmaps, hsurjOn, hfibre⟩ := projectiveNormalize_alg O n G μ hGμ
  refine ⟨hmaps, hsurjOn, hfibre, ?_⟩
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  set nm := projectiveNormalize O n G μ
  set PC := projectiveCell O n G
  set D := reducedFormCell O n μ G
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  have hq1 : 1 < q := Finite.one_lt_card
  have hG0 : G ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hGμ
  obtain ⟨hPCm, hPCmass⟩ := projective_cell_mass O htop n G hG0
  obtain ⟨-, hDball, -, hDmeas, -, hDprob, hDmass⟩ :=
    normalized_form_cell_cylinder_mass O htop n μ G hGμ
  have hgen := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O m htop n
  have hB : ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : Fin n → O),
      {y : Fin n → O | adicCongr m L y x} = {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L} := fun L x => by
    ext y; exact finite_coordinate_adic_congruence O n m L y x
  
  have hkey : ∀ L (x : Fin n → O), 1 ≤ L → x ∉ D →
      PC ∩ nm ⁻¹' {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L} = ∅ := fun L x hL hx => by
    refine Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun a ⟨ha, hyx⟩ => hx ?_
    change x ∈ reducedFormCell O n μ G
    rw [hDball _ (hmaps ha)]
    exact fun j => by
      simpa only [neg_sub] using m.neg_mem (Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega : L ≠ 0) (hyx j))
  have hPCB : ∀ L (x : Fin n → O), MeasurableSet (PC ∩ nm ⁻¹' {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L}) := by
    intro L x
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos L with rfl | hL
    · have : {y : Fin n → O | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ 0} = Set.univ := by ext y; simp
      rw [this, Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ]; exact hPCm
    by_cases hx : x ∈ D
    · rw [projectiveNormalize_preimage_ball O n G μ L hL x hx]
      exact (unit_multiple_cylinder_mass O htop n L hL μ (insertOne μ x) (by simp [insertOne])).1
    · rw [hkey L x hL hx]; exact MeasurableSet.empty
  have hoff : ∀ a, a ∉ PC → nm a = 0 := fun a ha => if_neg ha
  have hnmm : Measurable nm := by
    change @Measurable _ _ _ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)) nm
    rw [hgen]
    refine measurable_generateFrom ?_
    rintro s (rfl | ⟨L, x, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    rw [hB]
    have : nm ⁻¹' {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L} = (PC ∩ nm ⁻¹' {y | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L}) ∪
        (PCᶜ ∩ {_a | (0 : Fin n → O) ∈ {y : Fin n → O | ∀ j, y j - x j ∈ m ^ L}}) := by
      ext a
      by_cases ha : a ∈ PC
      · simp [ha]
      · simp [ha, hoff a ha]
    rw [this]
    exact (hPCB L x).union (hPCm.compl.inter (MeasurableSet.const _))
  have hμ0 : coefficientMeasure O (n+1) PC ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hPCmass]
    refine mul_ne_zero ?_ (pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)))
    rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← ENNReal.natCast_sub]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : q - 1 ≠ 0)
  have hμt : coefficientMeasure O (n+1) PC ≠ ⊤ := by
    have := coefficient_measure_probability O htop (n+1)
    exact MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _
  have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (cellMeasure O (n+1) PC) := by
    constructor
    rw [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ, Set.univ_inter, smul_eq_mul,
      ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hμ0 hμt]
  refine measurePreserving_cellMeasure_of_balls O htop _ n D hDmeas hDball nm hnmm PC
    (by rw [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' hPCm, Set.compl_inter_self,
      MeasureTheory.measure_empty, smul_zero]) hmaps fun L hL x hx => ?_
  rw [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' hPCm,
    smul_eq_mul, Set.inter_comm, hDmass L x hL hx,
    projectiveNormalize_preimage_ball O n G μ L hL x hx,
    (unit_multiple_cylinder_mass O htop n L hL μ (insertOne μ x) (by simp [insertOne])).2, hPCmass]
  exact projective_mass_ratio q n L hq1 hL

name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_cell_mass
statement:
theorem projective_cell_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    MeasurableSet (projectiveCell O n v) ∧
      coefficientMeasure O (n+1) (projectiveCell O n v) =
        ((Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) *
          (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcard, hne, hfin⟩ := scalar_class_card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n v hv
  set S := hfin.toFinset with hS
  have heq : projectiveCell O n v = ⋃ w ∈ S, {a : Fin (n+1) → O | residueVector O a = w} := by
    ext a
    simp only [projectiveCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, hS, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset,
      exists_prop, exists_eq_right']
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨(primitive_iff_residue_ne_zero O n a).2 (hne _ h), h⟩⟩
  have hmeas : ∀ w ∈ S, MeasurableSet {a : Fin (n+1) → O | residueVector O a = w} :=
    fun w _ => (residue_vector_fiber_mass O htop n w).1
  refine ⟨heq ▸ Finset.measurableSet_biUnion S hmeas, ?_⟩
  rw [heq, MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset _ hmeas]
  · simp only [fun w => (residue_vector_fiber_mass O htop n w).2]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    have : S.card = Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) - 1 := by
      rw [← hcard, hS, Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset hfin]
    rw [this, ENNReal.natCast_sub]
    simp
  · exact fun w _ w' _ hww' => Set.disjoint_left.2 fun a h h' => hww' (h.symm.trans h')

name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_cell_mass_mul_normalizer
statement:
private theorem projective_cell_mass_mul_normalizer (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    coefficientMeasure O (n+1) (projectiveCell O n v) *
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ i) =
      coefficientMeasure O (n+1) {a : Fin (n+1) → O | primitive O a}
proof:
:= by
  rw [(projective_cell_mass O htop n v hv).2, primitive_locus_mass O htop n]
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  have hq : 1 < q := Finite.one_lt_card
  have hN : (q - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), q ^ i = q ^ (n+1) - 1 := by
    have h1 : 1 ≤ q ^ (n+1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    zify [hq.le, h1]
    rw [mul_comm]; exact_mod_cast geom_sum_mul (q : ℤ) (n+1)
  have hE : ((q : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (q : ℝ≥0∞) ^ i
      = (q : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (n+1) - 1 := by
    have := congrArg (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ≥0∞)) hN
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_pow] at this
    rw [ENNReal.natCast_sub, ENNReal.natCast_sub] at this
    simpa [Nat.cast_pow] using this
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  have hqt : (q : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.natCast_ne_top q
  calc ((q : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) * (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (q : ℝ≥0∞) ^ i
      = (((q : ℝ≥0∞) - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (q : ℝ≥0∞) ^ i) *
          (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1) := by ring
    _ = ((q : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (n+1) - 1) * (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1) := by rw [hE]
    _ = 1 - (q : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1) := by
      rw [ENNReal.sub_mul (fun _ _ => ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 hq0)),
        ← mul_pow, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hq0 hqt, one_pow, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_cell_conditional_density
statement:
theorem projective_cell_conditional_density (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    coefficientMeasure O (n+1) (projectiveCell O n v) /
        coefficientMeasure O (n+1) {a : Fin (n+1) → O | primitive O a} =
      densityValue (Expr.inv (projectiveNormalizer n)) (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := projective_cell_mass_mul_normalizer O htop n v hv
  have hP := primitive_locus_mass O htop n
  have hev := (projective_normalizer_eval (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℚ) n).1
  set q := Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  have hq1 : 1 < q := Finite.one_lt_card
  set C := coefficientMeasure O (n+1) (projectiveCell O n v)
  set P := coefficientMeasure O (n+1) {a : Fin (n+1) → O | primitive O a}
  set D : ℝ≥0∞ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (q : ℝ≥0∞) ^ i with hD
  have hD0 : D ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [hD, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff] at h
    simpa using h 0 (by simp)
  have hDtop : D ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.sum_ne_top.2 (fun i _ => ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _))
  have hPtop : P ≠ ⊤ := by rw [hP]; exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.one_ne_top tsub_le_self
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hP]
    apply ne_of_gt
    rw [tsub_pos_iff_lt]
    apply pow_lt_one₀ (zero_le) _ (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
    rw [ENNReal.inv_lt_one]
    exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hC0 : C ≠ 0 := by rintro h; rw [h, zero_mul] at hmul; exact hP0 hmul.symm
  have hCtop : C ≠ ⊤ := by
    rintro h; rw [h, ENNReal.top_mul hD0] at hmul; exact hPtop hmul.symm
  have lhs : C / P = D⁻¹ := by
    rw [← hmul, ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inl hC0) (Or.inl hCtop), mul_comm C⁻¹,
      mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hC0 hCtop, mul_one]
  rw [lhs, densityValue]
  change D⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (((projectiveNormalizer n).eval (q : ℚ))⁻¹ : ℚ)
  rw [hev]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (q : ℚ) ^ i : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => by positivity) ⟨0, by simp⟩
  rw [Rat.cast_inv, ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hpos]
  congr 1
  rw [hD]; push_cast
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity),
    ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_base_invariants
statement:
private theorem unramified_base_invariants (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ)
    (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ) (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi)) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ).ramificationIdx O = 1 ∧
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ).inertiaDeg O = δ
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap O Oδ) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    by_contra hx0
    obtain ⟨k, u, rfl⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible hx0 hpi
    rw [map_mul, map_pow] at hx
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with h | h
    · exact (Units.map (algebraMap O Oδ : O →* Oδ) u).ne_zero h
    · exact hpiδ.ne_zero (pow_eq_zero_iff'.mp h).1
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O Oδ := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite O Oδ
  have h512 := dvr_extension_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow O Oδ hinj
  have h1 : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).map (algebraMap O Oδ) =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ) ^ 1 := by
    rw [pow_one, hpi.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      ← hpiδ.maximalIdeal_eq]
  have he : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ).ramificationIdx O = 1 :=
    dvr_maximalIdeal_pow_injective Oδ _ _ (h512.symm.trans h1)
  have : Module.Flat O Oδ := Module.Flat.of_free
  have h251 := finite_flat_local_ramification_degree O Oδ
  rw [he, hrank, one_mul] at h251
  exact ⟨he, h251⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.inertiaDeg_unramified_tower
statement:
theorem inertiaDeg_unramified_tower (O Oδ B : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [Algebra O Oδ] [Algebra O B]
    [Algebra Oδ B] [IsScalarTower O Oδ B] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ]
    [Module.Finite Oδ B] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ) (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi)) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).inertiaDeg O =
      δ * (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).inertiaDeg Oδ
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral Oδ B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite Oδ B
  have : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ) :=
    ⟨(integral_local_extension_unique_prime Oδ B).1.symm⟩
  rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg_tower (R := O) (S := Oδ) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ)
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B), (unramified_base_invariants O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ).2]

name: SurfaceBlowup.ramificationIdx_unramified_tower
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_unramified_tower (O Oδ B : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [Algebra O Oδ] [Algebra O B]
    [Algebra Oδ B] [IsScalarTower O Oδ B] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ]
    [Module.Finite Oδ B] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ) (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi)) [Module.Free Oδ B] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx O =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx Oδ
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral Oδ B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite Oδ B
  have : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ) :=
    ⟨(integral_local_extension_unique_prime Oδ B).1.symm⟩
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower (R := O) (S := Oδ) (T := B) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ)
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B), (unramified_base_invariants O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ).1,
    one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_fraction_field_lift
statement:
theorem unramified_fraction_field_lift (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)] :
    ∃ ι : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ),
      (∀ c : O, ι (algebraMap O (BaseField O) c) =
        algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c)) ∧
      Function.Injective ι ∧
      (∀ ι' : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ),
        (∀ c : O, ι' (algebraMap O (BaseField O) c) =
          algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c)) →
        ι' = ι) ∧
      (letI := ι.toAlgebra; Module.Finite (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) ∧
        Module.finrank (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = Φ.natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  have hmon : Φ.Monic := hΦ.1
  let pb := AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hmon
  have : Module.Free O (AdjoinRoot Φ) := Module.Free.of_basis pb.basis
  have : Module.Finite O (AdjoinRoot Φ) := pb.finite
  let j : O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ) :=
    (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))).comp (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ))
  have hj : Function.Injective j :=
    (IsFractionRing.injective (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))).comp
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective O (AdjoinRoot Φ))
  refine ⟨IsFractionRing.lift hj, fun c => IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap hj c,
    RingHom.injective (IsFractionRing.lift hj : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)),
    fun ι' h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := O) (K := BaseField O) fun c => by
      rw [h, IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap hj c]; rfl
  · let _ : Algebra (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) := (IsFractionRing.lift hj).toAlgebra
    have : IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
        change _ = IsFractionRing.lift hj _
        rw [IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap hj c]
        exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O (AdjoinRoot Φ) _ c
    have hrank : Module.finrank (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = Φ.natDegree := by
      rw [IsFractionRing.finrank_eq O (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)),
        pb.finrank]
      exact AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'_dim hmon
    refine ⟨?_, hrank⟩
    apply Module.finite_of_finrank_pos
    rw [hrank, ← hmon.natDegree_map (IsLocalRing.residue O)]
    exact Irreducible.natDegree_pos hΦ.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_free_module
statement:
theorem unramified_free_module (O : Type) [CommRing O] [Nontrivial O] (Φ : Polynomial O)
    (hΦ : Φ.Monic) :
    Module.Free O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧ Module.Finite O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      Module.finrank O (AdjoinRoot Φ) = Φ.natDegree
proof:
:=
  ⟨hΦ.free_adjoinRoot, hΦ.finite_adjoinRoot, by simp [(AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hΦ).finrank]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_adic_complete
statement:
private theorem unramified_adic_complete (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : Φ.Monic) :
    IsAdicComplete (baseIdeal O Φ) (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      (∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, (∀ L, x ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ)^L) → x = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : O, (∀ y : O, c * y = 0 → y = 0) →
        ∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c * x = 0 → x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfree, hfin, -⟩ := unramified_free_module O Φ hΦ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff (S := AdjoinRoot Φ) (M := AdjoinRoot Φ)
      (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)).2 (finite_free_adic_complete O (AdjoinRoot Φ) _)
  · intro x hx
    apply (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hΦ).basis.repr.injective
    ext i
    simp only [map_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    have hi : ∀ L, (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hΦ).basis.repr x i ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L :=
      fun L => (base_ideal_coordinates O Φ hΦ L x).1 (hx L) i
    apply IsHausdorff.haus (IsAdicComplete.toIsHausdorff (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O))
    intro n
    simpa [SModEq.zero, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using hi n
  · intro c hc x hx
    rw [← Algebra.smul_def] at hx
    apply (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hΦ).basis.repr.injective
    ext i
    have := congrArg (fun y => (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hΦ).basis.repr y i) hx
    simp only [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero,
      Pi.zero_apply] at this ⊢
    exact hc _ this

name: SurfaceBlowup.base_ideal_maximal_local
statement:
theorem base_ideal_maximal_local (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    (baseIdeal O Φ).IsMaximal ∧ (∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, IsUnit (baseReduce O Φ x) → IsUnit x) ∧
      ∃ _ : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ),
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) = baseIdeal O Φ
proof:
:= by
  have hF := (residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ).1
  have hmax : (baseIdeal O Φ).IsMaximal := Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField _ hF
  have hC := (unramified_adic_complete O Φ hΦ.1).1
  have hloc : IsLocalHom (baseReduce O Φ) :=
    isLocalHom_of_le_jacobson_bot _ (IsAdicComplete.le_jacobson_bot _)
  have hunit : ∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, IsUnit (baseReduce O Φ x) → IsUnit x :=
    fun x hx => IsUnit.of_map (baseReduce O Φ) x hx
  let _ : Field (residueExtension O Φ) := hF.toField
  have : Nontrivial (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    by_contra h
    rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at h
    exact hmax.ne_top (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  have : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    refine IsLocalRing.of_isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self fun a => ?_
    by_cases ha : baseReduce O Φ a = 0
    · right; apply hunit; simp [map_sub, ha]
    · left; exact hunit a (Ne.isUnit ha)
  exact ⟨hmax, hunit, inferInstance, (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax).symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.simple_root_derivative_unit
statement:
theorem simple_root_derivative_unit (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (a : AdjoinRoot Φ)
    (ha : baseReduce O Φ ((Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).eval a) = 0) :
    IsUnit (baseReduce O Φ ((Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).derivative.eval a)) ∧
      IsUnit ((Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).derivative.eval a)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ≤ (baseIdeal O Φ).comap (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) :=
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 le_rfl
  let ρ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField O →+* residueExtension O Φ :=
    Ideal.quotientMap (baseIdeal O Φ) (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) hle
  have hcomp : (baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) = ρ.comp (IsLocalRing.residue O) :=
    (Ideal.quotientMap_comp_mk hle).symm
  have key : ∀ p : Polynomial O, baseReduce O Φ ((p.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).eval a)
      = (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)).eval₂ ρ (baseReduce O Φ a) := fun p => by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.hom_eval₂, Polynomial.eval₂_map, hcomp]
  let _ : Field (residueExtension O Φ) := (residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ).1.toField
  have hsep : (residuePoly O Φ).Separable := PerfectField.separable_of_irreducible hΦ.2
  have h1 : IsUnit (baseReduce O Φ ((Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).derivative.eval a)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.derivative_map, key, ← Polynomial.derivative_map]
    rw [key] at ha
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hsep.eval₂_derivative_ne_zero ρ ha)
  exact ⟨h1, (base_ideal_maximal_local O Φ hΦ).2.1 _ h1⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_root_exists
statement:
private theorem frobenius_root_exists (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    ∃ a : AdjoinRoot Φ, (Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).IsRoot a ∧
      a - (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) ^ residueCard O ∈ baseIdeal O Φ
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAdicComplete (baseIdeal O Φ) (AdjoinRoot Φ) := (unramified_adic_complete O Φ hΦ.1).1
  have : HenselianRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) (baseIdeal O Φ) := IsAdicComplete.henselianRing _ _
  have hker : ∀ c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O,
      ((baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)) c = 0 := fun c hc => by
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, baseReduce, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hc
  let ρ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField O →+* residueExtension O Φ :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift _ ((baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)) hker
  have key : ∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, baseReduce O Φ ((Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).eval x)
      = (residuePoly O Φ).eval₂ ρ (baseReduce O Φ x) := fun x => by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.hom_eval₂, residuePoly, Polynomial.eval₂_map]
    congr 1
  have h0 : baseReduce O Φ
      ((Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).eval (AdjoinRoot.root Φ ^ residueCard O)) = 0 := by
    rw [key, map_pow, residueCard, eval_at_pow_card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) _ ρ
      (residuePoly O Φ) (baseReduce O Φ (AdjoinRoot.root Φ)), ← key,
      show (Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).eval (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) = 0 from AdjoinRoot.isRoot_root Φ,
      map_zero, zero_pow Nat.card_pos.ne']
  exact HenselianRing.is_henselian (Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)) (hΦ.1.map _)
    (AdjoinRoot.root Φ ^ residueCard O) (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h0)
    (simple_root_derivative_unit O Φ hΦ _ h0).1

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_root_spec
statement:
private theorem frobenius_root_spec (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    (Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).IsRoot (frobeniusRoot O Φ) ∧
      frobeniusRoot O Φ - (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) ^ residueCard O ∈ baseIdeal O Φ ∧
      unramifiedFrobenius O Φ (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) = frobeniusRoot O Φ ∧
      ∀ c : O, unramifiedFrobenius O Φ (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c) =
        algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c
proof:
:= by
  have h := frobenius_root_exists O Φ hΦ
  have hr : frobeniusRoot O Φ = Classical.choose h := dif_pos h
  exact ⟨hr ▸ (Classical.choose_spec h).1, hr ▸ (Classical.choose_spec h).2,
    AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root _ _ _ _, (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ).commutes⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_residue_action
statement:
private theorem frobenius_residue_action (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    (∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ,
      baseReduce O Φ (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ x) = (baseReduce O Φ x) ^ residueCard O) ∧
    (∀ (i : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ),
      baseReduce O Φ (frobeniusIter O Φ i x) = (baseReduce O Φ x) ^ (residueCard O ^ i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hcong, hroot, -⟩ := frobenius_root_spec O Φ hΦ
  have hle : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ≤
      RingHom.ker ((baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)) := fun c hc => by
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply, baseReduce, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hc
  let ρ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField O →+* residueExtension O Φ :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift _ ((baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)) hle
  have hρ : ρ.comp (IsLocalRing.residue O) = (baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) := by
    ext c; rfl
  have key : ∀ (p : Polynomial O) (a : AdjoinRoot Φ),
      baseReduce O Φ (Polynomial.aeval a p) =
        (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)).eval₂ ρ (baseReduce O Φ a) := fun p a => by
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_map, hρ, Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
    rfl
  have h1 : ∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, baseReduce O Φ (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ x) =
      (baseReduce O Φ x) ^ residueCard O := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := AdjoinRoot.mk_surjective x
    rw [← AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, hroot, key, key]
    have : baseReduce O Φ (frobeniusRoot O Φ) =
        (baseReduce O Φ (AdjoinRoot.root Φ)) ^ residueCard O := by
      rw [← map_pow, baseReduce, Ideal.Quotient.eq]; exact hcong
    rw [this]
    exact eval_at_pow_card _ _ ρ _ _
  refine ⟨h1, fun i => ?_⟩
  induction i with
  | zero => intro x; simp [frobeniusIter]
  | succ i ih =>
    intro x
    change baseReduce O Φ (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ (frobeniusIter O Φ i x)) = _
    rw [h1, ih, ← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.natDegree_pos_of_isUnramifiedLift
statement:
private theorem natDegree_pos_of_isUnramifiedLift {O : Type} [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    {Φ : Polynomial O} (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) : 0 < Φ.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have := hΦ.2.natDegree_pos
  rwa [residuePoly, hΦ.1.natDegree_map] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_fixed_mod_pow
statement:
private theorem frobenius_fixed_mod_pow (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (L : ℕ) (a : AdjoinRoot Φ)
    (ha : unramifiedFrobenius O Φ a - a ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L) :
    ∃ c : O, a - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ)^L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  set σ := unramifiedFrobenius O Φ
  have hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ j = Ideal.span {algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ ^ j} :=
    fun j => by
      rw [baseIdeal, hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
        Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      rfl
  have hmem1 : ∀ x, x ∈ baseIdeal O Φ ↔ ∃ e, x = e * algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ := fun x => by
    rw [← pow_one (baseIdeal O Φ), hpow, pow_one, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    exact ⟨fun ⟨e, he⟩ => ⟨e, he.symm⟩, fun ⟨e, he⟩ => ⟨e, he.symm⟩⟩
  have htf := (unramified_adic_complete O Φ hΦ.1).2.2
  obtain ⟨hfield, -, -⟩ := residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ
  let _ : Field (residueExtension O Φ) := hfield.toField
  have hres := (frobenius_residue_action O Φ hΦ).1
  let ρ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField O →+* residueExtension O Φ :=
    Ideal.quotientMap (baseIdeal O Φ) (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) Ideal.le_comap_map
  induction L generalizing a with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | succ L ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih a (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ L) ha)
    rw [hpow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hc ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ha
    have ha' : a = algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c + b * algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ ^ L := by
      rw [hb]; ring
    have hσa : σ a - a = algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ϖ ^ L) * (σ b - b) := by
      rw [ha', map_add, map_mul, map_pow, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, map_pow]; ring
    have hkey : σ b - b = algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ * d := by
      have h0 : algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ϖ ^ L) *
          (σ b - b - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ * d) = 0 := by
        rw [mul_sub, ← hσa, ← hd, map_pow]; ring
      exact sub_eq_zero.1 (htf _ (fun y hy => (mul_eq_zero.1 hy).resolve_left
        (pow_ne_zero _ hϖ.ne_zero)) _ h0)
    have hfix : (baseReduce O Φ b) ^ Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) = baseReduce O Φ b := by
      rw [← hres b]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.2 ((hmem1 _).2 ⟨d, by rw [hkey, mul_comm]⟩)
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (finite_field_frobenius_fixed_points _ _ ρ _).1 hfix
    obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective r
    have hbc : b - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c' ∈ baseIdeal O Φ := by
      apply Ideal.Quotient.eq.1
      rw [← hr]; rfl
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (hmem1 _).1 hbc
    refine ⟨c + ϖ ^ L * c', ?_⟩
    rw [hpow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    rw [ha', show b = algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c' + e * algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ by
      rw [← he]; ring, map_add, map_mul, map_pow]
    ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_fixed_ring
statement:
theorem frobenius_fixed_ring (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (a : AdjoinRoot Φ)
    (ha : unramifiedFrobenius O Φ a = a) :
    ∃ c : O, algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c = a
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ L : ℕ, ∃ c : O, a - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ)^L :=
    fun L => frobenius_fixed_mod_pow O Φ hΦ L a (by rw [ha, sub_self]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
  choose c hc using hc
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  have hpure := base_ideal_pure O Φ hΦ.1 (natDegree_pos_of_isUnramifiedLift hΦ)
  have hcompat : ∀ {L L' : ℕ}, L ≤ L' → c L ≡ c L' [SMOD (m ^ L • ⊤ : Submodule O O)] := by
    intro L L' hLL'
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top, ← hpure]
    have : algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (c L - c L') =
        (a - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (c L')) - (a - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (c L)) := by
      rw [map_sub]; ring
    rw [this]; exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hLL' (hc L')) (hc L)
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec (I := m) inferInstance hcompat
  refine ⟨c0, ?_⟩
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← neg_sub, neg_eq_zero]
  refine (unramified_adic_complete O Φ hΦ.1).2.1 _ fun L => ?_
  have h3 : c L - c0 ∈ m ^ L := by
    simpa only [SModEq.sub_mem, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using hc0 L
  rw [← hpure] at h3
  have : a - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c0 =
      (a - algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (c L)) + algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (c L - c0) := by
    rw [map_sub]; ring
  rw [this]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ (hc L) h3

name: SurfaceBlowup.root_unique_of_congruent
statement:
private theorem root_unique_of_congruent (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (a b : AdjoinRoot Φ)
    (ha : (Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).IsRoot a) (hb : (Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).IsRoot b)
    (hab : a - b ∈ baseIdeal O Φ) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  set Φ' := Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)
  set d := b - a with hd
  have hdI : d ∈ baseIdeal O Φ := by simpa [hd] using (baseIdeal O Φ).neg_mem hab
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Polynomial.binomExpansion Φ' a d
  rw [show a + d = b by simp [hd]] at hk
  have h0 : d * (Φ'.derivative.eval a + k * d) = 0 := by
    rw [show Φ'.eval b = 0 from hb, show Φ'.eval a = 0 from ha] at hk
    linear_combination -hk
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (simple_root_derivative_unit O Φ hΦ a (by
    change baseReduce O Φ (Φ'.eval a) = 0
    rw [show Φ'.eval a = 0 from ha, map_zero])).2
  have hC := (unramified_adic_complete O Φ hΦ.1).1
  have hJ : baseIdeal O Φ ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥ := IsAdicComplete.le_jacobson_bot _
  have hkd : (↑v⁻¹ : AdjoinRoot Φ) * (k * d) ∈ baseIdeal O Φ :=
    (baseIdeal O Φ).mul_mem_left _ ((baseIdeal O Φ).mul_mem_left _ hdI)
  have h1 : IsUnit ((↑v⁻¹ : AdjoinRoot Φ) * (k * d) + 1) := by
    simpa using Ideal.mem_jacobson_bot.mp (hJ hkd) 1
  have h2 : IsUnit (Φ'.derivative.eval a + k * d) := by
    have : Φ'.derivative.eval a + k * d = v * ((↑v⁻¹ : AdjoinRoot Φ) * (k * d) + 1) := by
      rw [← hv, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, one_mul, mul_one, add_comm]
    rw [this]; exact v.isUnit.mul h1
  have : d = 0 := h2.mul_right_cancel (by rw [h0, zero_mul])
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp this).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_pow_degree_eq_id
statement:
theorem frobenius_pow_degree_eq_id (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    frobeniusIter O Φ Φ.natDegree = AlgHom.id O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      Function.Bijective (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hroot : ∀ f : AdjoinRoot Φ →ₐ[O] AdjoinRoot Φ,
      (Φ.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).IsRoot (f (AdjoinRoot.root Φ)) := by
    intro f
    have h0 : Polynomial.aeval (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) Φ = 0 := AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq Φ ▸ by simp
    rw [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_map, ← AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq,
      ← Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, h0, map_zero]
  have hid : frobeniusIter O Φ Φ.natDegree = AlgHom.id O (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    apply AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext
    obtain ⟨hF, hFin, hcard⟩ := residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ
    let _ := hF.toField
    let _ := Fintype.ofFinite (residueExtension O Φ)
    have hc : Fintype.card (residueExtension O Φ) = residueCard O ^ Φ.natDegree := by
      rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
    have h2 := (frobenius_residue_action O Φ hΦ).2 Φ.natDegree (AdjoinRoot.root Φ)
    rw [← hc, FiniteField.pow_card] at h2
    exact root_unique_of_congruent O Φ hΦ _ _ (hroot _) (hroot (AlgHom.id O _))
      (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp h2)
  refine ⟨hid, ?_⟩
  have hcomm : ∀ i, frobeniusIter O Φ (i+1) =
      (frobeniusIter O Φ i).comp (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      change (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ).comp (frobeniusIter O Φ (n+1)) = _
      conv_lhs => rw [ih]
      rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc]; rfl
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, Φ.natDegree = d + 1 :=
    ⟨Φ.natDegree - 1, by have := natDegree_pos_of_isUnramifiedLift hΦ; omega⟩
  rw [Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse]
  refine ⟨frobeniusIter O Φ d, fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (fun f : AdjoinRoot Φ →ₐ[O] AdjoinRoot Φ => f x) hid
    simp only [hd, hcomm] at this
    exact this
  · have := congrArg (fun f : AdjoinRoot Φ →ₐ[O] AdjoinRoot Φ => f x) hid
    simp only [hd] at this
    exact this

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_is_domain
statement:
private theorem unramified_is_domain (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hcomp, hsep, htors⟩ := unramified_adic_complete O Φ hΦ.1
  obtain ⟨hfield, -, -⟩ := residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ
  let _ : Field (residueExtension O Φ) := hfield.toField
  obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  set c : AdjoinRoot Φ := algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ with hc
  have hI : baseIdeal O Φ = Ideal.span {c} := by
    rw [baseIdeal, hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hc,
      AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
  have hIpow : ∀ L : ℕ, (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L = Ideal.span {c ^ L} := fun L => by
    rw [hI, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  have key : ∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, x ≠ 0 → ∃ (i : ℕ) (x' : AdjoinRoot Φ),
      x = c ^ i * x' ∧ x' ∉ baseIdeal O Φ := by
    intro x hx
    have hex : ∃ L, x ∉ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hx (hsep x h)
    have hspec := Nat.find_spec hex
    have hn0 : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hspec (by simp [h0])
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
    have hmem : x ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ i := by
      simpa using Nat.find_min hex (show i < Nat.find hex by omega)
    rw [hIpow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmem
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨i, x', by rw [← hx', mul_comm], fun hx'I => ?_⟩
    rw [hI, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hx'I
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hx'I
    apply hspec
    rw [hi, hIpow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    exact ⟨d, by rw [← hx', ← hd, pow_succ]; ring⟩
  have hnt : Nontrivial (AdjoinRoot Φ) := (baseReduce O Φ).domain_nontrivial
  have hnzd : NoZeroDivisors (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    constructor
    intro a b hab
    by_contra hne
    push Not at hne
    obtain ⟨i, a', rfl, ha'⟩ := key a hne.1
    obtain ⟨j, b', rfl, hb'⟩ := key b hne.2
    have h1 : algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ϖ ^ (i + j)) * (a' * b') = 0 := by
      rw [map_pow, ← hc, ← hab]; ring
    have h2 := htors _ (fun y hy => (mul_eq_zero.1 hy).resolve_left
      (pow_ne_zero _ hϖ.ne_zero)) _ h1
    have h3 : baseReduce O Φ a' * baseReduce O Φ b' = 0 := by
      rw [← map_mul, h2, map_zero]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h3 with h | h
    · exact ha' (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1 h)
    · exact hb' (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1 h)
  exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _

name: SurfaceBlowup.conjugate_product_invariant
statement:
private theorem conjugate_product_invariant (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (r : ℕ)
    (b : Fin r → AdjoinRoot Φ) (hb : b ∈ blockCell O Φ r) :
    (conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b)).map (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ).toRingHom =
        conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ c : O,
        algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c = (conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b)).coeff j) ∧
      (conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b)).Monic ∧
      (conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b)).natDegree = Φ.natDegree * r ∧
      (conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b)).map (baseReduce O Φ) =
        ∏ i : Fin Φ.natDegree, conjugateFactor O Φ i ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have := unramified_is_domain O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨hBm, hBd, -, -⟩ := monic_poly_reconstruct (AdjoinRoot Φ) r b
  set B := monicPolyO b
  set δ := Φ.natDegree
  have hid := (frobenius_pow_degree_eq_id O Φ hΦ).1
  have hcomp : ∀ a c : ℕ,
      frobeniusIter O Φ (a + c) = (frobeniusIter O Φ a).comp (frobeniusIter O Φ c) := by
    intro a c
    induction a with
    | zero => simp [frobeniusIter]
    | succ a ih =>
      rw [show a + 1 + c = (a + c) + 1 by omega]
      simp only [frobeniusIter, ih]
      rfl
  have hmul : ∀ m : ℕ, frobeniusIter O Φ (δ * m) = AlgHom.id O (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp [frobeniusIter]
    | succ m ih => rw [Nat.mul_succ, hcomp, ih, hid]; rfl
  have hmod : ∀ n : ℕ, frobeniusIter O Φ n = frobeniusIter O Φ (n % δ) := by
    intro n
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n δ]
    rw [hcomp, hmul]; rfl
  have hP : ∀ i : Fin δ, (B.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).Monic ∧
      (B.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).natDegree = r := fun i =>
    ⟨hBm.map _, by rw [hBm.natDegree_map, hBd]⟩
  have hinv : (conjugateProduct O Φ B).map (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ).toRingHom =
      conjugateProduct O Φ B := by
    unfold conjugateProduct
    rw [Polynomial.map_prod]
    simp_rw [Polynomial.map_map]
    refine Fintype.prod_equiv (finRotate δ) _ _ (fun i => ?_)
    congr 1
    have hi := i.neZero
    rw [finRotate_apply, hmod ((i + 1 : Fin δ) : ℕ), Fin.val_add]
    have : (unramifiedFrobenius O Φ).toRingHom.comp (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom
        = (frobeniusIter O Φ ((i : ℕ) + 1)).toRingHom := rfl
    rw [this, hmod]
    congr 2
    simp [Nat.add_mod]
  refine ⟨hinv, fun j => ?_, Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => (hP i).1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply frobenius_fixed_ring O Φ hΦ
    simpa [Polynomial.coeff_map] using congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p j) hinv
  · unfold conjugateProduct
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => (hP i).1),
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hP i).2)]
    simp [mul_comm]
  · have hres := (frobenius_residue_action O Φ hΦ).2
    unfold conjugateProduct
    rw [Polynomial.map_prod]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    have hle : baseIdeal O Φ ≤ (baseIdeal O Φ).comap (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom := by
      rw [← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, baseIdeal, Ideal.map_map]
      apply le_of_eq
      congr 1
      exact RingHom.ext fun c => (frobeniusIter O Φ i).commutes c
    let g := Ideal.quotientMap (baseIdeal O Φ) (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom hle
    have hg : (baseReduce O Φ).comp (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom =
        g.comp (baseReduce O Φ) := by
      ext x <;> simp [g, Ideal.quotientMap_mk]
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, hg, ← Polynomial.map_map, hb, conjugateFactor, conjugateFactor,
      Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C]
    congr 3
    change g (baseReduce O Φ (AdjoinRoot.root Φ) ^ residueCard O ^ 0) = _
    rw [pow_zero, pow_one]
    simp only [g, Ideal.quotientMap_mk]
    exact hres i _

name: SurfaceBlowup.descend_block_mem_cell
statement:
theorem descend_block_mem_cell (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (r : ℕ) (b : Fin r → AdjoinRoot Φ)
    (hb : b ∈ blockCell O Φ r) :
    descendBlock O Φ r b ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r) ∧
      (monicPolyO (descendBlock O Φ r b)).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) =
        conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, hdesc, hPm, hPdeg, hPred⟩ := conjugate_product_invariant O Φ hΦ r b hb
  obtain ⟨hcompat, hinj, _, _, hfac, _⟩ := conjugate_roots_distinct O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨hFm, hFdeg, hFcoeff, _⟩ :=
    monic_poly_reconstruct O (Φ.natDegree * r) (descendBlock O Φ r b)
  set P := conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO b)
  set F := monicPolyO (descendBlock O Φ r b)
  have hlift : F.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) = P := by
    ext j
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    by_cases hj : j < Φ.natDegree * r
    · rw [show F.coeff j = _ from hFcoeff ⟨j, hj⟩]
      change (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) (descendCoeff O Φ (P.coeff j)) = P.coeff j
      unfold descendCoeff
      rw [dif_pos (hdesc j)]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (hdesc j)
    · rcases (not_lt.mp hj).eq_or_lt with h | h
      · subst h
        have h1 : F.coeff (Φ.natDegree * r) = 1 := by
          have := hFm.coeff_natDegree; rwa [hFdeg] at this
        have h2 : P.coeff (Φ.natDegree * r) = 1 := by
          have := hPm.coeff_natDegree; rwa [hPdeg] at this
        rw [h1, h2, map_one]
      · rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [hFdeg]; exact h),
          Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [hPdeg]; exact h), map_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, hlift⟩
  change F.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = residuePoly O Φ ^ r
  apply Polynomial.map_injective _ hinj
  have hcomp : (residueEmbed O Φ).comp (IsLocalRing.residue O)
      = (baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) := by
    ext c; exact hcompat c
  rw [Polynomial.map_map, hcomp, ← Polynomial.map_map, hlift, hPred, Polynomial.map_pow, hfac,
    Finset.prod_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_is_dvr
statement:
theorem unramified_is_dvr (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    ∃ (_ : IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (_ : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)),
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) = baseIdeal O Φ ∧
      (∀ ϖ : O, Irreducible ϖ → Irreducible (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ)) ∧
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (AdjoinRoot Φ) ∧
      Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) ∧
      Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = residueCard O ^ Φ.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ) := unramified_is_domain O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨-, -, hloc, hmax⟩ := base_ideal_maximal_local O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨hcomp, -, htors⟩ := unramified_adic_complete O Φ hΦ.1
  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hcard⟩ := residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨ϖ₀, hϖ₀⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  
  have hspan : ∀ ϖ : O, Irreducible ϖ →
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) = Ideal.span {algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ} := by
    intro ϖ hϖ
    rw [hmax, baseIdeal, hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  have hnf : ¬ IsField (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq, hspan ϖ₀ hϖ₀, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    intro h
    exact one_ne_zero (htors ϖ₀ (fun y hy => (mul_eq_zero.1 hy).resolve_left hϖ₀.ne_zero) 1
      (by rw [h, zero_mul]))
  have hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (AdjoinRoot Φ) := by
    have := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE (AdjoinRoot Φ) hnf).out 0 4
    exact this.2 ⟨⟨_, hspan ϖ₀ hϖ₀⟩⟩
  have e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≃ residueExtension O Φ :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hmax).toEquiv
