  refine ⟨hdom, hloc, hdvr, hmax, fun ϖ hϖ =>
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer _).2 (hspan ϖ hϖ), hmax ▸ hcomp,
    Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm, by rw [Nat.card_congr e, hcard]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_residue_eq_map_baseReduce
statement:
private theorem map_residue_eq_map_baseReduce {O : Type} [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    {Φ : Polynomial O} [IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) = baseIdeal O Φ)
    (P : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ)) :
    P.map (IsLocalRing.residue (AdjoinRoot Φ)) =
      (P.map (baseReduce O Φ)).map (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hmax.symm).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.map_map]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_residue_eq_of_map_baseReduce_eq
statement:
private theorem map_residue_eq_of_map_baseReduce_eq {O : Type} [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    {Φ : Polynomial O} [IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) = baseIdeal O Φ)
    {P Q : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ)} (h : P.map (baseReduce O Φ) = Q.map (baseReduce O Φ)) :
    P.map (IsLocalRing.residue (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = Q.map (IsLocalRing.residue (AdjoinRoot Φ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_residue_eq_map_baseReduce hmax, map_residue_eq_map_baseReduce hmax, h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.isCoprime_map_residue
statement:
private theorem isCoprime_map_residue {O : Type} [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    {Φ : Polynomial O} [IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) = baseIdeal O Φ)
    {P Q : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ)}
    (h : IsCoprime (P.map (baseReduce O Φ)) (Q.map (baseReduce O Φ))) :
    IsCoprime (P.map (IsLocalRing.residue (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
      (Q.map (IsLocalRing.residue (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_residue_eq_map_baseReduce hmax, map_residue_eq_map_baseReduce hmax]
  exact h.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hmax.symm).toRingHom)

name: SurfaceBlowup.map_frobeniusIter_baseReduce
statement:
private theorem map_frobeniusIter_baseReduce (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (r i : ℕ) (B : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (hB : B.map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ 0 ^ r) :
    (B.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ i ^ r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hinj, -, -, -, -⟩ := conjugate_roots_distinct O Φ hΦ
  have hfrob := (frobenius_residue_action O Φ hΦ).2
  let K := residueExtension O Φ
  let : Fintype (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  obtain ⟨p, hpc⟩ := CharP.exists (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
  obtain ⟨n, hp, hq⟩ := FiniteField.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) p
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have : CharP K p := charP_of_injective_ringHom hinj p
  let fr : K →+* K := iterateFrobenius K p ((n : ℕ) * i)
  have hfr : ∀ x : K, fr x = x ^ (residueCard O ^ i) := fun x => by
    rw [residueCard, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hq, ← pow_mul]; rfl
  have hcomp' : (baseReduce O Φ).comp (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom =
      fr.comp (baseReduce O Φ) := RingHom.ext fun x => by
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, hfr, hfrob]
  rw [Polynomial.map_map, hcomp', ← Polynomial.map_map, hB, Polynomial.map_pow]
  simp [conjugateFactor, hfr]

name: SurfaceBlowup.block_conjugates
statement:
private theorem block_conjugates (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (Φ.natDegree * r) → O)
    (hδ : 0 < Φ.natDegree)
    (B : Fin Φ.natDegree → Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (hB : ∀ i, (B i).Monic)
    (hBr : ∀ i, (B i).map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ i ^ r)
    (hBp : ∏ i, B i = (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)) :
    ∀ i : Fin Φ.natDegree, B i = (B ⟨0, hδ⟩).map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨_, _, -, hmax, -, hcomp, -, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  have hcop := (conjugate_roots_distinct O Φ hΦ).2.2.2.2.2
  set τ := frobeniusIter O Φ (i : ℕ)
  set F' := (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) with hF'
  set D := (B ⟨0, hδ⟩).map τ.toRingHom with hD
  have hτF : F'.map τ.toRingHom = F' := by
    rw [hF', Polynomial.map_map]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp [← AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
  have hDred : D.map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ i ^ r :=
    map_frobeniusIter_baseReduce O Φ hΦ r i _ (hBr _)
  have hprod1 : B i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, B j = F' := by
    rw [Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i), hBp]
  have hprod2 : D * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase ⟨0, hδ⟩, (B j).map τ.toRingHom = F' := by
    rw [hD, Finset.mul_prod_erase (f := fun j => (B j).map τ.toRingHom) _ (Finset.mem_univ _),
      ← Polynomial.map_prod, hBp, hτF]
  have hc0 : IsCoprime ((B i).map (baseReduce O Φ))
      ((∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, B j).map (baseReduce O Φ)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_prod, hBr]
    exact IsCoprime.prod_right fun j hj => by
      rw [hBr]; exact (hcop i j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm).pow
  exact (hensel_factor_unique_of_dvd (AdjoinRoot Φ) _ _ _ _ (hB i)
    (Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun j _ => hB j) ((hB _).map _)
    (Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun j _ => (hB j).map _) (hprod1.trans hprod2.symm)
    (map_residue_eq_of_map_baseReduce_eq hmax (by rw [hBr, hDred]))
    (isCoprime_map_residue hmax hc0)).1

name: SurfaceBlowup.block_conjugates_coprime
statement:
theorem block_conjugates_coprime (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)] (r : ℕ) (b : Fin r → AdjoinRoot Φ) (hb : b ∈ blockCell O Φ r) :
    ∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j →
      IsCoprime (((monicPolyO b).map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))))
        (((monicPolyO b).map (frobeniusIter O Φ j).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  obtain ⟨_, _, hdvr, hmax, -, -, -, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  have hBm : (monicPolyO b).Monic := (monic_poly_reconstruct (AdjoinRoot Φ) r b).1
  refine coprime_of_coprime_residue_dvr (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) _ _
    (hBm.map _) (hBm.map _) (isCoprime_map_residue hmax ?_)
  rw [map_frobeniusIter_baseReduce O Φ hΦ r i _ hb, map_frobeniusIter_baseReduce O Φ hΦ r j _ hb]
  exact ((conjugate_roots_distinct O Φ hΦ).2.2.2.2.2 i j hij).pow

name: SurfaceBlowup.block_splitting
statement:
private theorem block_splitting (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (Φ.natDegree * r) → O)
    (ha : a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r)) :
    ∃! B : Fin Φ.natDegree → Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ), (∀ i, (B i).Monic) ∧
      (∀ i, (B i).natDegree = r) ∧
      (∀ i, (B i).map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ i ^ r) ∧
      ∏ i, B i = (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hm, -, hcomp, -, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨hcompat, -, -, -, hfact, hcop⟩ := conjugate_roots_distinct O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨hFm, -, -, -⟩ := monic_poly_reconstruct O _ a
  set F := monicPolyO a
  let e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≃+* residueExtension O Φ :=
    Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hm
  have hmapE : ∀ P : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ),
      (P.map (IsLocalRing.residue _)).map (e : _ →+* _) = P.map (baseReduce O Φ) := fun P => by
    rw [Polynomial.map_map]; rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Polynomial.map
      (e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ) →+* residueExtension O Φ)) :=
    Polynomial.map_injective _ e.injective
  have hNt : Nontrivial (residueExtension O Φ) := e.symm.toEquiv.nontrivial
  let g : Fin Φ.natDegree → Polynomial (residueExtension O Φ) := fun i => conjugateFactor O Φ i ^ r
  have hgm : ∀ i, (g i).Monic := fun i => (Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C _).pow r
  have hgc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j) := fun i j h => (hcop i j h).pow
  have hgd : ∀ i, (g i).natDegree = r := fun i => by
    simp only [g, conjugateFactor]
    rw [(Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C _).natDegree_pow, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
  have hred : (F.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).map (baseReduce O Φ) = ∏ i, g i := by
    have h1 : (baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) =
        (residueEmbed O Φ).comp (IsLocalRing.residue O) := by
      ext c; exact (hcompat c).symm
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, h1, ← Polynomial.map_map,
      show F.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = residuePoly O Φ ^ r from ha, Polynomial.map_pow, hfact,
      ← Finset.prod_pow]
  have hsymm : ∀ P : Polynomial (residueExtension O Φ),
      (P.map (e.symm : residueExtension O Φ →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ))).map
        (e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ) →+* residueExtension O Φ) = P := fun P => by
    simp [Polynomial.map_map]
  let g' : Fin Φ.natDegree → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) :=
    fun i => (g i).map (e.symm : residueExtension O Φ →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ))
  have hg'c : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g' i) (g' j) := fun i j h =>
    (hgc i j h).map (Polynomial.mapRingHom
      (e.symm : residueExtension O Φ →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
  have hred' : (F.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).map (IsLocalRing.residue _) = ∏ i, g' i := by
    apply hinj
    simp only [hmapE, g', Polynomial.map_prod, hsymm, hred]
  obtain ⟨G, hGm, hGp, hGr, hGd⟩ := hensel_family_exists (AdjoinRoot Φ) (Fin Φ.natDegree)
    (F.map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)) (hFm.map _) g' (fun i => (hgm i).map _) hg'c hred'
  refine ⟨G, ⟨hGm, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_, hGp.symm⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hGd i, (hgm i).natDegree_map, hgd i]
  · rw [← hmapE, hGr i, hsymm]
  · rintro B ⟨hBm, -, hBr, hBp⟩
    have hBr' : ∀ i, (B i).map (IsLocalRing.residue _) = g' i := fun i => by
      apply hinj; rw [hmapE, hBr i, hsymm]
    exact hensel_family_unique (AdjoinRoot Φ) (Fin Φ.natDegree) B G hBm hGm
      (fun i => by rw [hBr' i, hGr i]) (fun i j h => by rw [hBr' i, hBr' j]; exact hg'c i j h)
      (by rw [hBp, hGp])

name: SurfaceBlowup.selectBlock_spec
statement:
private theorem selectBlock_spec (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    (r : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < Φ.natDegree) (a : Fin (Φ.natDegree * r) → O)
    (ha : a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r)) :
    ∃ B : Fin Φ.natDegree → Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ), (∀ i, (B i).Monic) ∧
      (∀ i, (B i).natDegree = r) ∧
      (∀ i, (B i).map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ i ^ r) ∧
      ∏ i, B i = (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) ∧
      (∀ B₀ : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ), B₀.Monic → B₀.natDegree = r →
        B₀.map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ 0 ^ r →
        B₀ ∣ (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) → B₀ = B ⟨0, hδ⟩) ∧
      selectBlock O Φ r a = coeffVec r (B ⟨0, hδ⟩) ∧
      monicPolyO (selectBlock O Φ r a) = B ⟨0, hδ⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, ⟨hBm, hBd, hBr, hBp⟩, -⟩ := block_splitting O Φ hΦ r a ha
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hmax, -, hcomp, -, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  set i0 : Fin Φ.natDegree := ⟨0, hδ⟩
  have huniq : ∀ B₀ : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ), B₀.Monic → B₀.natDegree = r →
      B₀.map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ 0 ^ r →
      B₀ ∣ (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) → B₀ = B i0 := by
    intro B₀ hB₀m hB₀d hB₀r hdvd
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hdvd
    have hC₀m : C₀.Monic := Polynomial.Monic.of_mul_monic_left hB₀m
      (hC₀ ▸ (monic_poly_reconstruct O _ a).1.map _)
    set C := ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i0, B j
    have hprod : B i0 * C = B₀ * C₀ := by
      rw [Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ _), hBp, hC₀]
    have hcop := (conjugate_roots_distinct O Φ hΦ).2.2.2.2.2
    refine (hensel_factor_unique_of_dvd (AdjoinRoot Φ) (B i0) C B₀ C₀ (hBm i0)
      (Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun j _ => hBm j)) hB₀m hC₀m hprod
      (map_residue_eq_of_map_baseReduce_eq hmax (by rw [hBr, hB₀r]))
      (isCoprime_map_residue hmax ?_)).1.symm
    rw [Polynomial.map_prod]
    refine IsCoprime.prod_right (fun j hj => ?_)
    rw [hBr, hBr]
    exact (hcop i0 j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm).pow
  have hw : ∃ B₀ : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ), B₀.Monic ∧ B₀.natDegree = r ∧
      B₀.map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ 0 ^ r ∧
      B₀ ∣ (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) :=
    ⟨B i0, hBm i0, hBd i0, hBr i0, hBp ▸ Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩
  have hs : selectBlock O Φ r a = coeffVec r (B i0) := by
    unfold selectBlock
    rw [dif_pos hw]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := Classical.choose_spec hw
    rw [huniq _ h1 h2 h3 h4]
  refine ⟨B, hBm, hBd, hBr, hBp, huniq, hs, ?_⟩
  rw [hs]
  exact (monic_poly_reconstruct _ r (coeffVec r (B i0))).2.2.2 _ (hBm i0) (hBd i0)

name: SurfaceBlowup.block_descent_bijection
statement:
theorem block_descent_bijection (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    (r : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (selectBlock O Φ r) (residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r))
      (blockCell O Φ r) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r),
      descendBlock O Φ r (selectBlock O Φ r a) = a) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ blockCell O Φ r, selectBlock O Φ r (descendBlock O Φ r b) = b) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r),
      (monicPolyO (selectBlock O Φ r a)).Monic ∧
        monicPolyO (selectBlock O Φ r a) ∣ (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdom, -, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  have hδ := natDegree_pos_of_isUnramifiedLift hΦ
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)) := by
    rw [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
    apply AdjoinRoot.of.injective_of_degree_ne_zero
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hΦ.1.ne_zero]
    exact_mod_cast hδ.ne'
  have hdesc : ∀ c : O, descendCoeff O Φ (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c) = c := by
    intro c
    have h : ∃ c' : O, algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c' = algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c := ⟨c, rfl⟩
    unfold descendCoeff
    rw [dif_pos h]
    exact hinj (Classical.choose_spec h)
  have hleft : ∀ a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r),
      descendBlock O Φ r (selectBlock O Φ r a) = a := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨B, hBm, hBd, hBr, hBp, -, -, hmp⟩ := selectBlock_spec O Φ hΦ r hδ a ha
    have hconj := block_conjugates O Φ hΦ r a hδ B hBm hBr hBp
    have hcp : conjugateProduct O Φ (monicPolyO (selectBlock O Φ r a)) =
        (monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) := by
      rw [hmp, conjugateProduct, ← hBp]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hconj i).symm)
    funext j
    unfold descendBlock
    rw [hcp, Polynomial.coeff_map, (monic_poly_reconstruct O _ a).2.2.1 j,
      ← AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, hdesc]
  have hright : ∀ b ∈ blockCell O Φ r, selectBlock O Φ r (descendBlock O Φ r b) = b := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨hcell, hF⟩ := descend_block_mem_cell O Φ hΦ r b hb
    obtain ⟨B, hBm, hBd, hBr, hBp, huniq, hs, -⟩ := selectBlock_spec O Φ hΦ r hδ _ hcell
    have hb' := monic_poly_reconstruct (AdjoinRoot Φ) r b
    have heq : monicPolyO b = B ⟨0, hδ⟩ := by
      refine huniq _ hb'.1 hb'.2.1 hb ?_
      rw [hF, conjugateProduct]
      have : monicPolyO b =
          (monicPolyO b).map (frobeniusIter O Φ ((⟨0, hδ⟩ : Fin _) : ℕ)).toRingHom :=
        Polynomial.map_id.symm
      conv_lhs => rw [this]
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [hs, ← heq]
    exact funext hb'.2.2.1
  refine ⟨⟨fun a ha => ?_, fun a ha a' ha' h => ?_, fun b hb => ?_⟩, hleft, hright, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨B, -, -, hBr, -, -, -, hmp⟩ := selectBlock_spec O Φ hΦ r hδ a ha
    change (monicPolyO (selectBlock O Φ r a)).map (baseReduce O Φ) = conjugateFactor O Φ 0 ^ r
    rw [hmp, hBr]
  · rw [← hleft a ha, ← hleft a' ha', h]
  · exact ⟨_, (descend_block_mem_cell O Φ hΦ r b hb).1, hright b hb⟩
  · obtain ⟨B, hBm, -, -, hBp, -, -, hmp⟩ := selectBlock_spec O Φ hΦ r hδ a ha
    rw [hmp]
    exact ⟨hBm _, hBp ▸ Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.block_descent_congruence_iff
statement:
theorem block_descent_congruence_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    (r : ℕ) (L : ℕ) (a a' : Fin (Φ.natDegree * r) → O)
    (ha : a ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r))
    (ha' : a' ∈ residueCell O (Φ.natDegree * r) (residuePoly O Φ ^ r)) :
    (∀ j, a j - a' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) ↔
      ∀ j, selectBlock O Φ r a j - selectBlock O Φ r a' j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdom, hloc, -, hmax, hirr, -, -, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  have hδ := natDegree_pos_of_isUnramifiedLift hΦ
  obtain ⟨B, hBm, hBd, hBr, hBp, -, hs, -⟩ := selectBlock_spec O Φ hΦ r hδ a ha
  obtain ⟨B', hBm', hBd', hBr', hBp', -, hs', -⟩ := selectBlock_spec O Φ hΦ r hδ a' ha'
  rw [hs, hs']
  have hpure := base_ideal_pure O Φ hΦ.1 hδ L
  have hA := monic_poly_reconstruct O _ a
  have hA' := monic_poly_reconstruct O _ a'
  
  have hlift : (∀ j, a j - a' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) ↔
      ∀ j, ((monicPolyO a).map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).coeff j -
        ((monicPolyO a').map (AdjoinRoot.of Φ)).coeff j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L := by
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map, ← map_sub, ← AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, hpure]
    refine ⟨fun h => (monic_coeff_sub_mem_iff _ _ _ _ hA.1 hA'.1 hA.2.1 hA'.2.1).1
      (fun j => by rw [hA.2.2.1, hA'.2.2.1]; exact h j), fun h j => ?_⟩
    simpa only [hA.2.2.1, hA'.2.2.1] using h j
  rw [hlift]
  obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  have hspan : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot Φ) =
      Ideal.span {algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ} := by
    rw [hmax, baseIdeal, hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
  have hreg : ∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) ϖ * x = 0 → x = 0 :=
    fun x hx => (mul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_left (hirr ϖ hϖ).ne_zero
  have hcop := (conjugate_roots_distinct O Φ hΦ).2.2.2.2.2
  constructor
  · intro h j
    have := hensel_family_unique_mod_pow (AdjoinRoot Φ) (Fin Φ.natDegree) _ hspan hreg B B' hBm
      hBm' (fun i => map_residue_eq_of_map_baseReduce_eq hmax (by rw [hBr, hBr']))
      (fun i j hij => isCoprime_map_residue hmax (by rw [hBr, hBr]; exact (hcop i j hij).pow)) L
      (by rw [hBp, hBp', hmax]; exact h) ⟨0, hδ⟩ j
    rwa [hmax] at this
  · intro h
    have h0 : ∀ j, (B ⟨0, hδ⟩).coeff j - (B' ⟨0, hδ⟩).coeff j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L :=
      (monic_coeff_sub_mem_iff _ _ _ _ (hBm _) (hBm' _) (hBd _) (hBd' _)).1 h
    have hconj := block_conjugates O Φ hΦ r a hδ B hBm hBr hBp
    have hconj' := block_conjugates O Φ hΦ r a' hδ B' hBm' hBr' hBp'
    have hJ : (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L =
        ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L).map (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)) := by
      rw [baseIdeal, Ideal.map_pow, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
    have hall : ∀ i j, (B i).coeff j - (B' i).coeff j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L := by
      intro i j
      rw [hconj i, hconj' i, Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_map, ← map_sub]
      have hm := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom (h0 j)
      rw [hJ, Ideal.map_map] at hm
      rw [hJ]
      convert hm using 2
      exact ((frobeniusIter O Φ i).comp_algebraMap).symm
    have := (polynomial_congruence_and_product (AdjoinRoot Φ) ((baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L)).2
      (Fin Φ.natDegree) B B' hall
    rwa [hBp, hBp'] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.fieldInvariant_congr
statement:
private theorem fieldInvariant_congr (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (L L' : Type) [Field L] [Field L']
    [Algebra (BaseField O) L] [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) L] [Algebra (BaseField O) L'] [Algebra O L']
    [IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) L'] [FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) L']
    (e : L ≃ₐ[BaseField O] L') [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] :
    fieldInvariant O L = fieldInvariant O L' ∧ Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, -⟩ := integral_closure_algEquiv O L L' (e.restrictScalars O)
  exact ⟨field_invariant_algEquiv O L L' e inferInstance, .equiv φ.toLinearEquiv⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.field_invariant_unramified_tower
statement:
theorem field_invariant_unramified_tower (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ)
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi))
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (L : Type)
    [Field L] [Algebra O L] [Algebra Oδ L] [IsScalarTower O Oδ L] [Algebra (BaseField O) L]
    [IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) L] [FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) L] [Algebra (BaseField Oδ) L]
    [IsScalarTower Oδ (BaseField Oδ) L] [FiniteDimensional (BaseField Oδ) L]
    (hfinδ : Module.Finite Oδ (integralClosure Oδ L)) :
    fieldInvariant O L = ((fieldInvariant Oδ L).1, δ * (fieldInvariant Oδ L).2)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hmap : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).map (algebraMap O Oδ) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ := by
    rw [(IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer pi).1 hpi,
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer _).1 hpiδ, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton]
  have : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ) Oδ := by
    rw [← hmap]
    exact (IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff _ _).2
      (finite_free_adic_complete O Oδ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O))
  have : Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Oδ) := by
    have : Finite (O ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
    have := finite_free_residue_quotient O Oδ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)
    have hle : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O • ⊤ : Submodule O Oδ) ≤
        LinearMap.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ O (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Oδ)).toLinearMap := by
      refine Submodule.smul_le.2 fun r hr n _ ↦ ?_
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
        Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Algebra.smul_def]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hmap ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hr)
    refine Finite.of_surjective ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O • ⊤ : Submodule O Oδ).liftQ _ hle)
      fun y ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk x, rfl⟩
  
  have := closure_finite_descent O Oδ L hfinδ
  have h1 := integral_closure_is_local O (BaseField O) L
  have h2 := integral_closure_is_local Oδ (BaseField Oδ) L
  have := integral_closure_is_dvr O (BaseField O) L
  have := integral_closure_is_dvr Oδ (BaseField Oδ) L
  obtain ⟨-, _, -⟩ := integral_closure_finite_free Oδ (BaseField Oδ) L
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O Oδ := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite O Oδ
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O (integralClosure Oδ L) := .trans Oδ
  obtain ⟨hr, hi⟩ := dvr_algEquiv_ramification_inertia O _ _
    (algebraMap_injective_of_tower O _ L) (algebraMap_injective_of_tower O _ L)
    (integralClosureTowerEquiv O Oδ L)
  unfold fieldInvariant
  rw [dif_pos h1, dif_pos h2]
  rw [hr, hi, ramificationIdx_unramified_tower O Oδ (integralClosure Oδ L) δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ,
    inertiaDeg_unramified_tower O Oδ (integralClosure Oδ L) δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_unramified_descent
statement:
theorem algebra_type_unramified_descent (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ)
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi))
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (B : Type)
    [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] [Algebra Oδ B] [IsScalarTower O Oδ B] (σ : FactorType)
    (h : HasAlgebraType Oδ B σ) :
    HasAlgebraType O B (scaleType δ σ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, L, hF, hK, hO, hT, hFD, e, rfl, hfinL⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hK', hO', hT', hT'', hFD', E, -⟩ :=
    unramified_generic_fibre_witness O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ B ι L e
  refine ⟨ι, hι, L, hF, hK', hO', hT', hFD', E, ?_,
    fun i ↦ closure_finite_descent O Oδ (L i) (hfinL i)⟩
  unfold scaleType
  rw [← Multiset.coe_mapAddMonoidHom, map_sum]
  simp only [Multiset.coe_mapAddMonoidHom, Multiset.map_singleton,
    field_invariant_unramified_tower O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ _ (hfinL _)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobenius_fraction_extension
statement:
theorem frobenius_fraction_extension (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)] (ι : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (hι : ∀ c : O, ι (algebraMap O (BaseField O) c) =
      algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c)) :
    ∃ τ : ℕ → (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≃+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)),
      (∀ (i : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ), τ i (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) x) =
        algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (frobeniusIter O Φ i x))
      ∧ (∀ (i : ℕ) (y : BaseField O), τ i (ι y) = ι y)
      ∧ τ 0 = RingEquiv.refl (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, τ (i + 1) = (τ i).trans (τ 1))
      ∧ (∀ z : BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ), τ Φ.natDegree z = z)
      ∧ (∀ z : BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ), τ 1 z = z → ∃ y : BaseField O, ι y = z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hid, hbij⟩ := frobenius_pow_degree_eq_id O Φ hΦ
  have bij : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (frobeniusIter O Φ i) := fun i ↦ by
    induction i with
    | zero => exact Function.bijective_id
    | succ i ih =>
      change Function.Bijective (⇑(unramifiedFrobenius O Φ) ∘ ⇑(frobeniusIter O Φ i))
      exact hbij.comp ih
  set K := BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)
  let τ : ℕ → (K ≃+* K) := fun i ↦ IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv
    (RingEquiv.ofBijective (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom (bij i))
  have h1 : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ),
      τ i (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) K x) = algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) K (frobeniusIter O Φ i x) :=
    fun i x ↦ IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap _ x
  have ext : ∀ f g : K ≃+* K,
      (∀ x : AdjoinRoot Φ, f (algebraMap _ _ x) = g (algebraMap _ _ x)) → f = g := fun f g h ↦
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_injective
      (IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (nonZeroDivisors (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (RingHom.ext h))
  refine ⟨τ, h1, fun i y ↦ ?_, ext _ _ fun x ↦ by rw [h1]; rfl,
    fun i ↦ ext _ _ fun x ↦ by rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, h1, h1, h1]; rfl,
    fun z ↦ by rw [ext (τ Φ.natDegree) (RingEquiv.refl _) fun x ↦ by rw [h1, hid]; rfl]; rfl,
    fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine RingHom.congr_fun (?_ : (τ i).toRingHom.comp ι = ι) y
    refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (nonZeroDivisors O) (RingHom.ext fun c ↦ ?_)
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
    rw [hι, h1, AlgHom.commutes]
  · 
    obtain ⟨_, _, hdvr, -, hirr, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
    obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
    obtain ⟨a, s, hs, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := AdjoinRoot Φ) z
    obtain ⟨k, u, hu⟩ :=
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hs) (hirr ϖ hϖ)
    have hdK : algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) K (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ϖ ^ k)) ≠ 0 :=
      IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (by
        rw [map_pow]; exact pow_ne_zero _ (hirr ϖ hϖ).ne_zero))
    set a' := a * ↑u⁻¹ with ha'
    have hz' : algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) K a / algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) K s =
        algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) K a' /
          algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) K (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (ϖ ^ k)) := by
      rw [div_eq_div_iff (IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hs) hdK, ← map_mul,
        ← map_mul, hu, ha', map_pow]
      rw [mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]
    rw [hz'] at hz ⊢
    rw [map_div₀, h1, h1, AlgHom.commutes] at hz
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := frobenius_fixed_ring O Φ hΦ a'
      (IsFractionRing.injective (AdjoinRoot Φ) K ((div_left_inj' hdK).mp hz))
    exact ⟨algebraMap O (BaseField O) c / algebraMap O (BaseField O) (ϖ ^ k),
      by rw [map_div₀, hι, hι, hc]⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_fraction_isSeparable
statement:
theorem unramified_fraction_isSeparable :
    letI
proof:
:= ι.toAlgebra
    FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) := by
  let := ι.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨ι0, hι0, -, huniq, hfin0, -⟩ := unramified_fraction_field_lift O Φ hΦ
  obtain rfl : ι = ι0 := huniq ι hι
  have hfd : FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) := hfin0
  obtain ⟨τ, -, hτι, -, -, -, hfix⟩ := frobenius_fraction_extension O Φ hΦ ι hι
  let σ1 : BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≃ₐ[BaseField O] BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ) :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := τ 1) (hτι 1)
  have : IsGalois (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) :=
    IsGalois.of_fixedField_eq_bot _ _ <| eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ by
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hfix x ((IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff _ _).1 hx σ1
        (Subgroup.mem_top σ1))
      exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ y
  exact ⟨hfd, inferInstance⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_invariant_unramified_scale
statement:
theorem factor_invariant_unramified_scale (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)] (ι : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (hι : ∀ c : O, ι (algebraMap O (BaseField O) c) =
      algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c))
    (g : Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))) (hg : g.Monic) (hgi : Irreducible g)
    (H : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hH : H.Monic) (hHi : Irreducible H)
    (hiso : letI := ι.toAlgebra; Nonempty (AdjoinRoot H ≃ₐ[BaseField O] AdjoinRoot g))
    (hfinδ : Module.Finite (AdjoinRoot Φ) (integralClosure (AdjoinRoot Φ) (AdjoinRoot g))) :
    factorInvariant O H = ((factorInvariant (AdjoinRoot Φ) g).1,
      Φ.natDegree * (factorInvariant (AdjoinRoot Φ) g).2) ∧
      Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot H))
proof:
:= by
  let _ := ι.toAlgebra
  set K := BaseField O
  set Oδ := AdjoinRoot Φ
  set Kδ := BaseField Oδ
  set L := AdjoinRoot g
  obtain ⟨_, _, hdvrδ, -, hirrδ, _, _, -⟩ := unramified_is_dvr O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨hfree, hfin, hrank⟩ := unramified_free_module O Φ hΦ.1
  obtain ⟨hfd, -⟩ := unramified_fraction_isSeparable O Φ hΦ ι hι
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hgi⟩
  have : Fact (Irreducible H) := ⟨hHi⟩
  have : IsScalarTower O K Kδ := .of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ (hι c).symm
  have : IsScalarTower O K L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O Kδ L, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K Kδ L,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O K Kδ]
  have : IsScalarTower O Oδ L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O Kδ L, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Oδ Kδ L,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O Oδ Kδ]
  have : Module.Finite K (AdjoinRoot H) := hH.finite_adjoinRoot
  have : Module.Finite Kδ L := hg.finite_adjoinRoot
  have : Module.Finite K L := .trans Kδ L
  have : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L) := closure_finite_descent O Oδ L hfinδ
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (AdjoinRoot H ≃ₐ[K] L) := hiso
  obtain ⟨hinv, hfinH⟩ := fieldInvariant_congr O L (AdjoinRoot H) e.symm
  obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  refine ⟨?_, hfinH⟩
  change fieldInvariant O (AdjoinRoot H) =
    ((fieldInvariant Oδ L).1, Φ.natDegree * (fieldInvariant Oδ L).2)
  rw [← hinv, field_invariant_unramified_tower O Oδ Φ.natDegree hrank pi hpi (hirrδ pi hpi) L hfinδ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_map_irreducible
proof:
:= by
  let := ι.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨hfd, hsep⟩ := unramified_fraction_isSeparable O Φ hΦ ι hι
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hgi⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hfinδ, -⟩ := unramified_free_module O Φ hΦ.1
  have : IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) :=
    .of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))]
      exact (hι c).symm
  refine squarefree_monic_has_polynomial_type (AdjoinRoot Φ) _ (hgm.map _)
    (squarefree_map_of_isSeparable _ _ g) fun h hh ↦ ?_
  exact closure_finite_ascent_root O (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) g hgm
    hgi hfin h (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_normalized_factor h hh)
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hh)

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_map_unramified
statement:
theorem polynomial_type_map_unramified (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType)
    (hF : HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ) :
    ∃ τ' : FactorType, HasPolynomialTypeF (AdjoinRoot Φ) (F.map ι) τ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gs, hgs, hpw, rfl, -, hfin⟩ := hF
  induction gs with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, [], by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  | cons g t ih =>
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hpw
    obtain ⟨τ1, h1⟩ := polynomial_type_map_irreducible O Φ hΦ ι hι g (hgs g (by simp)).1
      (hgs g (by simp)).2 (hfin g (by simp))
    obtain ⟨τ2, h2⟩ := ih (fun x hx ↦ hgs x (by simp [hx])) hpw.2
      (fun x hx ↦ hfin x (by simp [hx]))
    have hc : ∀ l : List (Polynomial (BaseField O)), (∀ x ∈ l, IsCoprime g x) →
        IsCoprime g l.prod := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => exact fun _ ↦ isCoprime_one_right
      | cons x l ih2 => exact fun h ↦
        (h x (by simp)).mul_right (ih2 fun y hy ↦ h y (by simp [hy]))
    have hct : IsCoprime g t.prod := hc t fun x hx ↦
      distinct_monic_irreducible_coprime _ g x (hgs g (by simp)).1 (hgs x (by simp [hx])).1
        (hgs g (by simp)).2 (hgs x (by simp [hx])).2 (hpw.1 x hx)
    rw [List.prod_cons, Polynomial.map_mul]
    exact ⟨_, polynomial_type_mul_coprime _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 (hct.map (mapRingHom ι))⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.descended_polynomial_type
statement:
theorem descended_polynomial_type (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (F : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (σ : FactorType)
    (hσ : HasPolynomialTypeF (AdjoinRoot Φ)
      (F.map (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) σ)
    (hcop : ∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j → IsCoprime
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree ↦ (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) i)
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree ↦ (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) j)) (G : Polynomial O)
    (hG : G.map (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = conjugateProduct O Φ F) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O (G.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))) (scaleType Φ.natDegree σ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gs, hgs, hd, hprod, hσeq, hfinδ⟩ := hσ
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, hinj, -, hfin⟩ := unramified_fraction_field_lift O Φ hΦ
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτι, hτ0, hrec, hτδ, hfix⟩ := frobenius_fraction_extension O Φ hΦ ι hι
  obtain ⟨H, hHmi, hHinj, hHorb, hHdeg, hHprod⟩ := invariant_orbit_factors O Φ hΦ ι τ hτ hτι hτ0
    hrec hτδ hfix hinj F gs hgs hd hprod hcop
  have hcomp : ι.comp (algebraMap O (BaseField O)) =
      (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))).comp (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ)) :=
    RingHom.ext hι
  have hGprod : ∏ a, H a = G.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O)) := by
    apply Polynomial.map_injective ι hinj
    rw [hHprod, ← hG, Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, hcomp]
  have hδpos : 0 < Φ.natDegree := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h ↦ by
    have h2 := hΦ.2
    rw [eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero hΦ.1 h, residuePoly, Polynomial.map_one] at h2
    exact h2.not_isUnit isUnit_one
  have hinv : ∀ a, factorInvariant O (H a) =
      (fun z : ℕ × ℕ ↦ (z.1, Φ.natDegree * z.2)) (factorInvariant (AdjoinRoot Φ) (gs.get a)) ∧
      Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot (H a))) := by
    intro a
    have hga := hgs (gs.get a) (List.get_mem _ _)
    have hdiv : gs.get a ∣ (H a).map ι := by
      rw [hHorb a]
      conv_lhs => rw [← show (gs.get a).map (τ (⟨0, hδpos⟩ : Fin Φ.natDegree)).toRingHom =
        gs.get a by simp [hτ0]]
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
    exact factor_invariant_unramified_scale O Φ hΦ ι hι (gs.get a) hga.1 hga.2 (H a)
      (hHmi a).1 (hHmi a).2 (root_field_algEquiv_conjugate_orbit O Φ ι hfin (gs.get a)
        hga.1 hga.2 (H a) (hHmi a).1 (hHmi a).2 hdiv (hHdeg a)) (hfinδ _ (List.get_mem _ _))
  refine ⟨List.ofFn H, fun g hg ↦ ?_, List.nodup_ofFn.mpr hHinj, by rw [List.prod_ofFn, hGprod],
    ?_, fun g hg ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hg
    exact hHmi a
  · rw [hσeq, List.map_ofFn]
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.ofFn_get gs]
    rw [List.map_ofFn, scaleType, Multiset.map_coe, List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (funext fun a ↦ (hinv a).1.symm))
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hg
    exact (hinv a).2

name: SurfaceBlowup.axis_contact
statement:
private theorem axis_contact (k : Type) [Field k] (a b : ℕ) (F : TwoSeries k) (s t : Fin 2)
    (hst : s ≠ t) (c : ℕ)
    (hdvd : (MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ∣ MvPowerSeries.X 0 ^ a * MvPowerSeries.X 1 ^ b)
    (hc : contact (Ideal.Quotient.mk (monomialIdeal k a b) F)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPowerSeries.X s)) = c) :
    (∀ n x, (MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ^ n * x ∈ Ideal.span {F} → x ∈ Ideal.span {F}) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, Module.length (TwoSeries k) (TwoSeries k ⧸
      (Ideal.span {F} ⊔ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k) ^ n})) = n * c
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : Module.length (TwoSeries k)
      (TwoSeries k ⧸ (Ideal.span {F} ⊔ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)})) = c := by
    have hJ : monomialIdeal k a b ≤ Ideal.span {F, MvPowerSeries.X s} :=
      (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.2 hdvd).trans
        (Ideal.span_mono (Set.subset_insert F _))
    have h1 := length_double_quotient_eq (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b)
      (Ideal.span {F, MvPowerSeries.X s})
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair, sup_eq_right.mpr hJ] at h1
    rw [← Ideal.span_insert, ← h1]
    exact hc
  have hF : F ∉ Ideal.span {(MvPowerSeries.X s : TwoSeries k)} := fun hmem ↦ by
    rw [sup_eq_right.mpr ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hmem),
      axis_quotient_length_top k s t hst] at hc'
    exact ENat.top_ne_natCast c hc'
  have hcan := axis_pow_mul_mem_span_cancel k s F hF
  refine ⟨hcan, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [length_quotient_sup_pow_eq_mul _ _ _ (fun x hx ↦ hcan 1 x (by simpa using hx)) n, hc']

name: SurfaceBlowup.crossing_special_fiber_length
statement:
theorem crossing_special_fiber_length (k : Type) [Field k] (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (f : SpecialFiber k a b) (ht : contact f (fiberT k a b) = c)
    (hx : contact f (fiberX k a b) = h) :
    Module.length (SpecialFiber k a b) ((SpecialFiber k a b) ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) = a * c + b * h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  obtain ⟨-, hT⟩ := axis_contact k a b F 0 1 (by decide) c
    (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_pow_self _ ha.ne') _) ht
  obtain ⟨hX, hX'⟩ := axis_contact k a b F 1 0 (by decide) h
    (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_pow_self _ hb.ne') _) hx
  have h5 := length_double_quotient_eq (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a b) (Ideal.span {F})
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h5
  rw [h5, monomialIdeal, axisT, axisX, sup_comm, length_quotient_sup_mul_eq_add _ _ _ _ (hX b), hT,
    hX']

name: SurfaceBlowup.single_special_fiber_length
statement:
theorem single_special_fiber_length (k : Type) [Field k] (a c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (f : SpecialFiber k a 0) (hf : contact f (fiberT k a 0) = c) :
    Module.length (SpecialFiber k a 0) ((SpecialFiber k a 0) ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) = a * c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective f
  obtain ⟨-, hT⟩ := axis_contact k a 0 F 0 1 (by decide) c
    (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_pow_self _ ha.ne') _) hf
  have h5 := length_double_quotient_eq (TwoSeries k) (monomialIdeal k a 0) (Ideal.span {F})
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h5
  rw [h5, monomialIdeal, pow_zero, mul_one, sup_comm, axisT, hT]

name: SurfaceBlowup.local_completion_finite_quotient
statement:
theorem local_completion_finite_quotient (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (L : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : (LocalCompletion A ⧸ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (localCompletionMap A))^L) ≃ₐ[A]
      (A ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)^L), ∀ a : A,
      E (Ideal.Quotient.mk (((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (localCompletionMap A))^L)
        (localCompletionMap A a)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)^L) a
proof:
:= by
  set I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
  have fg : I.FG := (IsNoetherian.noetherian I)
  have hker : RingHom.ker (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I L) = (I.map (localCompletionMap A))^L := by
    ext x
    trans x ∈ (AdicCompletion.eval I A L).ker
    · have eq : I ^ L • (⊤ : Ideal A) = I ^ L := by simp
      have : Function.Injective (Ideal.Quotient.factor ((le_of_eq eq))) := by
        simpa [RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot, Ideal.Quotient.factor_ker]
          using Ideal.map_mk_eq_bot_of_le (le_of_eq eq.symm)
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, ← AdicCompletion.factor_eval_eq_evalₐ I x (le_of_eq eq)]
      exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ this).trans LinearMap.mem_ker.symm
    · rw [← AdicCompletion.pow_smul_top_eq_ker_eval fg, Ideal.smul_top_eq_map, ← Ideal.map_pow]
      rfl
  refine ⟨(Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq A hker.symm).trans
    (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (AdicCompletion.surjective_evalₐ I L)), fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  exact AdicCompletion.evalₐ_of I L a

name: SurfaceBlowup.completion_to_finite_quotient_surjective
statement:
private theorem completion_to_finite_quotient_surjective (A : Type) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (L : ℕ) (J : Ideal (LocalCompletion A))
    (hJ : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (localCompletionMap A)) ^ L ≤ J) :
    Function.Surjective ((Ideal.Quotient.mk J).comp (localCompletionMap A))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := local_completion_finite_quotient A L
  intro q
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (E (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b))
  refine ⟨a, Ideal.Quotient.eq.2 (hJ (Ideal.Quotient.eq.1 (E.injective ?_)))⟩
  rw [hE, ha]

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_colength_completion_ideal_descent
statement:
theorem finite_colength_completion_ideal_descent (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] (L : ℕ) (J : Ideal (LocalCompletion A))
    (hJ : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (localCompletionMap A)) ^ L ≤ J) :
    (J.comap (localCompletionMap A)).map (localCompletionMap A) = J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm Ideal.map_comap_le fun b hb ↦ ?_
  set M := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (localCompletionMap A)
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := local_completion_finite_quotient A L
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (E (Ideal.Quotient.mk (M ^ L) b))
  have hdiff : b - localCompletionMap A a ∈ M ^ L :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp (E.injective (by rw [hE a, ha]))
  set I := J.comap (localCompletionMap A)
  have hML : M ^ L ≤ I.map (localCompletionMap A) := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.map_mono fun x hx ↦
      hJ ((Ideal.map_pow (localCompletionMap A) _ L).le (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx))
  simpa using (I.map (localCompletionMap A)).add_mem (hML hdiff)
    (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (localCompletionMap A)
      (show a ∈ I from (by simpa using J.sub_mem hb (hJ hdiff) : localCompletionMap A a ∈ J)))

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_completed_point_quotient_surjective
statement:
theorem finite_completed_point_quotient_surjective (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsMaximal] (L : ℕ) (J : Ideal (CompletedLocalAt A P))
    (hJ : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
      (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P))) ^ L ≤ J) :
    Function.Surjective ((Ideal.Quotient.mk J).comp (completedPointMap A P))
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := completion_to_finite_quotient_surjective (Localization.AtPrime P) L J hJ y
  set φ := (Ideal.Quotient.mk J).comp (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)) with hφ
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective P.primeCompl x
  obtain ⟨b, u, hu, hbu⟩ := (inferInstance : P.IsMaximal).exists_inv s.2
  have hu' : u = 1 - b * s := by rw [← hbu]; ring
  have hgeom : (b * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, u ^ i) * s = 1 - u ^ L := by
    rw [← mul_neg_geom_sum, hu']; ring
  have huL : φ (algebraMap A _ (u ^ L)) = 0 := by
    simp only [hφ, RingHom.comp_apply, map_pow]
    rw [← map_pow, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact hJ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
      ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime P) P u).2 hu)) _)
  have hone : φ (algebraMap A _ ((b * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, u ^ i) * s)) = 1 := by
    rw [hgeom, map_sub, map_sub, huL, map_one, map_one, sub_zero]
  refine ⟨a * (b * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, u ^ i), ?_⟩
  have hmk : IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime P) a s * algebraMap A _ (s : A)
      = algebraMap A _ a := IsLocalization.mk'_spec _ _ _
  change φ (algebraMap A _ _) = φ _
  calc φ (algebraMap A _ (a * (b * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, u ^ i)))
      = φ (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime P) a s * algebraMap A _ (s : A))
          * φ (algebraMap A _ (b * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, u ^ i)) := by
        rw [hmk, map_mul, map_mul]
    _ = φ (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime P) a s)
          * φ (algebraMap A _ ((b * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, u ^ i) * s)) := by
        simp only [map_mul]; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hone, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.monicPolyO_map_fraction
statement:
theorem monicPolyO_map_fraction (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → O) :
    (monicPolyO a).map (algebraMap O (BaseField O)) = monicPolynomial O a
proof:
:= by
  simp [monicPolyO, monicPolynomial, Polynomial.map_sum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.frobeniusRoot_eval₂
statement:
private theorem frobeniusRoot_eval₂ (Φ : Polynomial O) :
    Φ.eval₂ (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) (frobeniusRoot O Φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold frobeniusRoot
  split_ifs with h
  · simpa [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_map] using (Classical.choose_spec h).1
  · exact AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root Φ

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_complete_iff_of_pow_le
statement:
theorem adic_complete_iff_of_pow_le (R M : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I J : Ideal R) (k : ℕ) (h1 : J ^ k ≤ I) (h2 : I ≤ J) :
    IsAdicComplete I M ↔ IsAdicComplete J M
proof:
:= by
  set φ : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => max 1 k * n
  have hle : ∀ n, n ≤ φ n := fun n => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n (by omega)
  have hmono : ∀ {m n : ℕ}, m ≤ n → φ m ≤ φ n := fun h => Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h
  have hIJ : ∀ n, (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R M) ≤ J ^ n • ⊤ :=
    fun n => Submodule.smul_mono_left (Ideal.pow_right_mono h2 n)
  have hJI : ∀ n, (J ^ φ n • ⊤ : Submodule R M) ≤ I ^ n • ⊤ := by
    intro n
    apply Submodule.smul_mono_left
    calc J ^ φ n ≤ J ^ (k * n) := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_max_right _ _))
      _ = (J ^ k) ^ n := pow_mul _ _ _
      _ ≤ I ^ n := Ideal.pow_right_mono h1 n
  constructor
  · intro hI
    refine { haus' := ?_, prec' := ?_ }
    · exact fun x hx => hI.haus' x fun n => SModEq.mono (hJI n) (hx (φ n))
    · intro f hf
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hI.prec' (fun n => f (φ n))
        (fun {m n} h => SModEq.mono (hJI m) (hf (hmono h)))
      exact ⟨L, fun n => (hf (hle n)).trans (SModEq.mono (hIJ n) (hL n))⟩
  · intro hJ
    refine { haus' := ?_, prec' := ?_ }
    · exact fun x hx => hJ.haus' x fun n => SModEq.mono (hIJ n) (hx n)
    · intro f hf
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hJ.prec' f (fun {m n} h => SModEq.mono (hIJ m) (hf h))
      exact ⟨L, fun n => (hf (hle n)).trans (SModEq.mono (hJI n) (hL (φ n)))⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.adic_idempotent_lift
statement:
private theorem adic_idempotent_lift (A : Type) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (e : A ⧸ I)
    (he : e * e = e) :
    ∃ x : A, x*x=x ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk I x = e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x0, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective e
  have hmon : (X ^ 2 - X : A[X]).Monic := by
    simpa using monic_X_pow_sub (R := A) (p := X) (n := 2)
      (degree_X_le.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : 1 < 2)))
  have h1 : (X ^ 2 - X : A[X]).eval x0 ∈ I := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    simp [sq, he]
  have h2 : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((X ^ 2 - X : A[X]).derivative.eval x0)) := by
    refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((X ^ 2 - X : A[X]).derivative.eval x0)) ?_
    simp only [derivative_X_pow, derivative_X, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_pow,
      eval_X, eval_one, eval_natCast, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_one, map_natCast]
    norm_num
    linear_combination (4 : A ⧸ I) * he
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := HenselianRing.is_henselian _ hmon x0 h1 h2
  refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := ha.eq_zero
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_X] at this
    linear_combination this
  · exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr hax

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_smul_top_iff_repr
statement:
private theorem mem_smul_top_iff_repr {R M ι : Type} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (J : Ideal R) (x : M) :
    x ∈ (J • ⊤ : Submodule R M) ↔ ∀ i, b.repr x i ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  refine ⟨fun hx => Submodule.smul_induction_on hx
    (fun r hr m _ i => by simpa using J.mul_mem_right _ hr)
    (fun x y hx hy i => by simpa using J.add_mem (hx i) (hy i)), fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [← b.sum_repr x]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem_smul (h i) trivial

name: SurfaceBlowup.base_ideal_coordinates
statement:
theorem base_ideal_coordinates (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (Φ : Polynomial O)
    (hΦ : Φ.Monic) (L : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ) :
    x ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ)^L ↔ ∀ i, (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hΦ).basis.repr x i ∈
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_smul_top_iff_repr, Ideal.smul_top_eq_map, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, baseIdeal,
    ← Ideal.map_pow, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]

name: SurfaceBlowup.base_ideal_pure
statement:
theorem base_ideal_pure (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : Φ.Monic)
    (hdeg : 0 < Φ.natDegree) (L : ℕ) (c : O) :
    algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ)^L ↔ c ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)^L
proof:
:= by
  rw [SurfaceBlowup.base_ideal_coordinates O Φ hΦ L]
  set b := AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hΦ
  have h0 : 0 < b.dim := by simpa [b] using hdeg
  have hb : b.basis ⟨0, h0⟩ = 1 := by
    rw [PowerBasis.coe_basis]; simp
  have hrepr : b.basis.repr (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c) = Finsupp.single ⟨0, h0⟩ c := by
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← hb, map_smul, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hrepr]
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using h ⟨0, h0⟩
  · intro h i
    by_cases hi : i = ⟨0, h0⟩
    · subst hi; simpa using h
    · rw [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hi)]; exact zero_mem _

name: SurfaceBlowup.conjugate_irreducible_factors_distinct
statement:
private theorem conjugate_irreducible_factors_distinct (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (τ : ℕ → (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≃+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
    (hτ : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ), τ i
      (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) x) = algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ)
      (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (frobeniusIter O Φ i x)) (F : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))))
    (hgs : ∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) (hd : gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h))
    (hprod : F.map (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))) = gs.prod)
    (hcop : ∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j → IsCoprime
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree => (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) i)
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree => (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) j)) :
    (∀ (i : ℕ) (g : Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))), g.Monic → Irreducible g →
        (g.map (τ i).toRingHom).Monic ∧ Irreducible (g.map (τ i).toRingHom)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Fin Φ.natDegree) (a b : Fin gs.length), (gs.get a).map (τ i).toRingHom =
        (gs.get b).map (τ j).toRingHom → i = j ∧ a = b) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin Φ.natDegree,
        (fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree => (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) i =
        (gs.map (Polynomial.map (τ i).toRingHom)).prod) ∧ (conjugateProduct O Φ F).map
      (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))) = ∏ i : Fin Φ.natDegree,
      (gs.map (Polynomial.map (τ i).toRingHom)).prod
proof:
:= by
  set L := algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) with hL
  have key : ∀ (i : ℕ) (P : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ)),
      (P.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map L = (P.map L).map (τ i).toRingHom := by
    intro i P
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map]
    congr 1
    exact RingHom.ext fun x => (hτ i x).symm
  have c1 : ∀ (i : ℕ) (g : Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))), g.Monic → Irreducible g →
      (g.map (τ i).toRingHom).Monic ∧ Irreducible (g.map (τ i).toRingHom) := by
    intro i g hm hi
    exact ⟨hm.map _, by simpa using (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff (mapEquiv (τ i)).toMulEquiv).mpr hi⟩
  have c3 : ∀ i : Fin Φ.natDegree, (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map L
      = (gs.map (Polynomial.map (τ i).toRingHom)).prod := fun i => by
    rw [key, hprod, Polynomial.map_list_prod]
  refine ⟨c1, ?_, c3, ?_⟩
  · intro i j a b hab
    have hmem : ∀ (k : Fin Φ.natDegree) (c : Fin gs.length),
        (gs.get c).map (τ k).toRingHom ∣ (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ k).toRingHom).map L := by
      intro k c
      rw [c3]
      exact List.dvd_prod (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, List.get_mem _ _, rfl⟩)
    have hirr := (c1 i (gs.get a) (hgs _ (List.get_mem gs a)).1 (hgs _ (List.get_mem gs a)).2).2
    have hij : i = j := by
      by_contra hne
      apply hirr.not_isUnit
      exact (hcop i j hne).isUnit_of_dvd' (hmem i a) (hab ▸ hmem j b)
    subst hij
    exact ⟨rfl, (List.Nodup.get_inj_iff hd).mp (Polynomial.map_injective _ (τ i).injective hab)⟩
  · rw [conjugateProduct, Polynomial.map_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => c3 i

name: SurfaceBlowup.coprime_family_linear_injective
statement:
theorem coprime_family_linear_injective (k ι : Type) [Field k] [Fintype ι] (g : ι → Polynomial k)
    (hg : ∀ i, (g i).Monic) (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) (h : ι → Polynomial k)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, (h i).degree < ((g i).natDegree : WithBot ℕ))
    (hsum : ∑ i, h i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, g j = 0) :
    ∀ i, h i = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hrest : g i ∣ ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, h l * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, g j := by
    apply Finset.dvd_sum
    intro l hl
    have hil : i ∈ Finset.univ.erase l :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun e => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1 e.symm, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ hil) _
  have hsplit := Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ
    (fun l => h l * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, g j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [hsum] at hsplit
  have hmain : g i ∣ h i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, g j := by
    have : h i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, g j
        = -∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, h l * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, g j := by
      rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]; exact hsplit
    rw [this]; exact (dvd_neg).mpr hrest
  have hcop : IsCoprime (g i) (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, g j) :=
    IsCoprime.prod_right fun j hj => hc i j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1.symm
  have hd : g i ∣ h i := hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hmain
  apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt hd
  rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (hg i).ne_zero]
  exact hdeg i

name: SurfaceBlowup.coprime_of_coprime_residue_dvr
statement:
theorem coprime_of_coprime_residue_dvr (R K : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [CommRing K]
    [Algebra R K] (A B : Polynomial R) (hA : A.Monic) (hB : B.Monic)
    (hc : IsCoprime (A.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) (B.map (IsLocalRing.residue R))) :
    IsCoprime (A.map (algebraMap R K)) (B.map (algebraMap R K))
proof:
:=
  (isCoprime_of_isCoprime_map_residue hA hB hc).map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap R K))

name: SurfaceBlowup.distinct_monic_irreducible_coprime
statement:
theorem distinct_monic_irreducible_coprime (K : Type) [Field K] (g h : Polynomial K) (hg : g.Monic)
    (hh : h.Monic) (hgi : Irreducible g) (hhi : Irreducible h) (hne : g ≠ h) :
    IsCoprime g h
proof:
:= by
  rw [hgi.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
  intro hd
  exact hne (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated hg hh (hgi.associated_of_dvd hhi hd))

name: SurfaceBlowup.dvr_extension_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow
statement:
theorem dvr_extension_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow (O B : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [Algebra O B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral O B] (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap O B)) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O).map (algebraMap O B) =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)^((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx O)
proof:
:= by
  set p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  set q := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
  have hcomap : q.comap (algebraMap O B) = p :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal q)
  have : q.LiesOver p := ⟨hcomap.symm⟩
  have hp : p ≠ ⊥ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field O
  have hq : q ≠ ⊥ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field B
  have hp0 : p.map (algebraMap O B) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rwa [Ne, Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective hinj]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, p.map (algebraMap O B) = q ^ k := by
    obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible B
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.ideal_eq_span_pow_irreducible hp0 hϖ
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [hk, show q = Ideal.span {ϖ} from
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer ϖ).mp hϖ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  have hprime : Prime q := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hq inferInstance
  have he : q.ramificationIdx O = k := by
    rw [Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx_eq_normalizedFactors_count p q hp0, hk,
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_pow,
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_irreducible hprime.irreducible, normalize_eq,
      Multiset.count_nsmul, Multiset.count_singleton_self, mul_one]
  rw [he, hk]

name: SurfaceBlowup.dvr_maximalIdeal_pow_injective
statement:
theorem dvr_maximalIdeal_pow_injective (B : Type) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing B] (a b : ℕ)
    (h : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ^ a = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ^ b) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h0
    exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField B ((IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq).2 h0)
  have h1 : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B ≠ ⊤ := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal B).ne_top
  exact (Ideal.pow_right_strictAnti _ h0 h1).injective h

name: SurfaceBlowup.eval_at_pow_card
statement:
theorem eval_at_pow_card (k K : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] [CommRing K] (ρ : k →+* K)
    (P : Polynomial k) (y : K) :
    P.eval₂ ρ (y ^ Nat.card k) = (P.eval₂ ρ y) ^ Nat.card k
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype k
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map,
    ← Polynomial.expand_eval, ← Polynomial.map_expand, FiniteField.expand_card,
    Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.eval_pow]

name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_product_continuous
statement:
theorem factor_product_continuous (O : Type) [CommRing O] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (d : ι → ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun a : (∀ i, Fin (d i) → O) => factorProduct d a) ∧ Measurable
      (fun a : (∀ i, Fin (d i) → O) => factorProduct d a)
proof:
:= by
  have key := Finset.prod_induction (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i (a : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O) => monicPolyO (a i))
    (fun P => ∀ j, Continuous fun a => (P a).coeff j)
    (fun P Q hP hQ j => by
      simpa [coeff_mul] using continuous_finsetSum _ fun p _ => (hP p.1).mul (hQ p.2))
    (fun j => by simpa using continuous_const) fun i _ m => by
      simp only [monicPolyO, coeff_add, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
      refine continuous_const.add (continuous_finsetSum _ fun k _ => ?_)
      split_ifs <;> fun_prop
  simp only [Finset.prod_apply] at key
  have hc : Continuous fun a => factorProduct d a := continuous_pi fun j => key j
  exact ⟨hc, hc.measurable⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_field_frobenius_fixed_points
statement:
theorem finite_field_frobenius_fixed_points (k K : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] [Field K]
    (ρ : k →+* K) (x : K) :
    x ^ Nat.card k = x ↔ x ∈ Set.range ρ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype k
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  set q := Fintype.card k with hq
  have hq1 : 1 < q := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have himg : ∀ c : k, (ρ c) ^ q = ρ c := by
    intro c; rw [← map_pow, FiniteField.pow_card]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    set P : Polynomial K := Polynomial.X ^ q - Polynomial.X with hP
    have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_ne_zero K hq1
    have hdeg : P.natDegree = q := FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_natDegree_eq K hq1
    have hmem : ∀ y : K, y ^ q = y → y ∈ P.roots.toFinset := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hP0]
      simp [hP, Polynomial.IsRoot, hy]
    have hsub : Finset.univ.image ρ ⊆ P.roots.toFinset := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
      exact hmem _ (himg c)
    have hcard : P.roots.toFinset.card ≤ (Finset.univ.image ρ).card := by
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ ρ.injective, Finset.card_univ]
      calc P.roots.toFinset.card ≤ Multiset.card P.roots := Multiset.toFinset_card_le _
        _ ≤ P.natDegree := Polynomial.card_roots' P
        _ = q := hdeg
    have heq := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub hcard
    have : x ∈ Finset.univ.image ρ := heq ▸ hmem x hx
    obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp this
    exact ⟨c, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact himg c

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_free_adic_complete
statement:
theorem finite_free_adic_complete (O M : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M]
    [Module.Finite O M] [Module.Free O M] (I : Ideal O) [IsAdicComplete I O] :
    IsAdicComplete I M
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis O M
  have key := mem_smul_top_iff_repr b
  have keyO : ∀ (J : Ideal O) (x : O), x ∈ (J • ⊤ : Submodule O O) ↔ x ∈ J := by
    intro J x
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  have hM : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x y : M), x ≡ y [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O M)] ↔
      ∀ i, b.repr x i ≡ b.repr y i [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O O)] := by
    intro n x y
    simp only [SModEq.sub_mem, key, keyO, map_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply]
  refine { haus' := ?_, prec' := ?_ }
  · intro x hx
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext i
    have := IsHausdorff.haus (I := I) (M := O) inferInstance (b.repr x i) fun n =>
      by simpa using (hM n x 0).1 (hx n) i
    simpa using this
  · intro f hf
    have hc : ∀ i, ∃ L : O, ∀ n, b.repr (f n) i ≡ L [SMOD (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule O O)] :=
      fun i => IsPrecomplete.prec (I := I) inferInstance fun {m n} hmn => (hM m _ _).1 (hf hmn) i
    choose L hL using hc
    refine ⟨∑ i, L i • b i, fun n => (hM n _ _).2 fun i => ?_⟩
    simpa [Finsupp.single_apply] using hL i n

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_free_residue_quotient
statement:
theorem finite_free_residue_quotient (O M : Type) [CommRing O] [AddCommGroup M] [Module O M]
    [Module.Finite O M] [Module.Free O M] (I : Ideal O) [Finite (O ⧸ I)] :
    Finite (M ⧸ (I • ⊤ : Submodule O M))
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Finite (O ⧸ I) (M ⧸ (I • ⊤ : Submodule O M)) :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite O _ _
  exact Module.finite_of_finite (O ⧸ I)

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_monoid_idempotent_power
statement:
private theorem finite_monoid_idempotent_power (A : Type) [Monoid A] [Finite A] (a : A) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ a^n * a^n = a^n
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∃ i p : ℕ, 0 < p ∧ a^(i+p) = a^i := by
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, h⟩ := Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite (fun n : ℕ => a^n)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxy with hlt | hlt
    · exact ⟨x, y - x, by omega, by rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hlt.le]; exact h.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨y, x - y, by omega, by rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hlt.le]; exact h⟩
  obtain ⟨i, p, hp, h⟩ := key
  have per : ∀ m k : ℕ, i ≤ k → a^(k + m*p) = a^k := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro k _; simp
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k hk
      have e : k + (m+1)*p = (k - i) + (i + p) + m*p := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul]; omega
      rw [e, pow_add, pow_add, h, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk, ← pow_add, ih k hk]
  refine ⟨p*(i+1), Nat.mul_pos hp (Nat.succ_pos _), ?_⟩
  rw [← pow_add]
  have := per (i+1) (p*(i+1)) (by nlinarith)
  rwa [Nat.mul_comm (i+1) p] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.finite_ring_local_of_idempotents
statement:
private theorem finite_ring_local_of_idempotents (A : Type) [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A] [Finite A]
    (he : ∀ e : A, e*e=e → e=0 ∨ e=1) :
    IsLocalRing A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun {a b} hab => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hidem⟩ := finite_monoid_idempotent_power A a
  rcases he _ hidem with h | h
  · exact Or.inr (eq_sub_of_add_eq' hab ▸ IsNilpotent.isUnit_one_sub ⟨n, h⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (IsUnit.of_pow_eq_one h hn.ne')

name: SurfaceBlowup.complete_domain_finite_quotient_local
statement:
theorem complete_domain_finite_quotient_local (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (I : Ideal A)
    [IsAdicComplete I A] [Finite (A ⧸ I)] :
    IsLocalRing A
proof:
:= by
  have hjac : I ≤ (⊥ : Ideal A).jacobson := IsAdicComplete.le_jacobson_bot I
  have hI : I ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have : (⊥ : Ideal A).jacobson = ⊤ := top_le_iff.mp (h ▸ hjac)
    exact bot_ne_top (Ideal.jacobson_eq_top_iff.mp this)
  have : Nontrivial (A ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hI
  have : IsLocalRing (A ⧸ I) := by
    apply SurfaceBlowup.finite_ring_local_of_idempotents
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.adic_idempotent_lift A I e he
    have : x * (x - 1) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, hx]; ring
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · left; simp [h]
    · right; rw [sub_eq_zero.mp h, map_one]
  have := isLocalHom_of_le_jacobson_bot I hjac
  refine IsLocalRing.of_isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self fun a => ?_
  rcases IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) with h | h
  · left; exact isUnit_of_map_unit _ _ h
  · right; exact isUnit_of_map_unit (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) _ (by simpa using h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_formPoly
statement:
private theorem coeff_formPoly (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (formPoly a).coeff (j : ℕ) = a j
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_X_pow, Fin.val_inj]

name: SurfaceBlowup.natDegree_formPoly_le
statement: private theorem natDegree_formPoly_le (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) : (formPoly a).natDegree ≤ n
proof:
:=
  natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ =>
    (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_eq_zero
statement: private theorem formPoly_eq_zero (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (h : formPoly a = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:=
  funext fun j => by rw [← coeff_formPoly a j, h, coeff_zero, Pi.zero_apply]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_add
statement:
theorem formPoly_add (a b : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    formPoly (a + b) = formPoly a + formPoly b
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_C_smul
statement:
private theorem formPoly_C_smul (c : A) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    formPoly (c • a) = C c * formPoly a
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formProd_map
statement:
private theorem formProd_map {B : Type} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (d : ι → ℕ) (a : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → A) (j : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1)) :
    f (formProd d a j) = formProd d (fun i k => f (a i k)) j
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ i, formPoly (fun k => f (a i k)) = (formPoly (a i)).map f := fun i => by
    simp [formPoly, Polynomial.map_sum]
  simp only [formProd, h1, ← Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.coeff_map]

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_product_maps_to_and_preserves
statement:
theorem form_product_maps_to_and_preserves (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (ι : Type)
    [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ) (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1))
    (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1)) (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1)
    (a a' : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))
    (ha' : a' ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))) :
    reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a ∈ reducedFormCell O (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g) ∧
      residueVector O (formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i))) = formProd d g ∧ IsUnit
      (formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i)) μ) ∧ ∀ L : ℕ,
      (∀ i j, a i j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) → ∀ j,
      reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a j - reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a' j ∈
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  set S := Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
  have hres : ∀ b ∈ S,
      residueVector O (formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (b i))) = formProd d g := by
    intro b hb
    funext j
    simp only [residueVector]
    rw [formProd_map]
    exact congrArg (fun G => formProd d G j) (funext fun i => (Set.mem_univ_pi.mp hb i).2)
  have hunit : ∀ b ∈ S, IsUnit (formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (b i)) μ) := by
    intro b hb
    have h : IsLocalRing.residue O (formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (b i)) μ) = 1 := by
      rw [← hμ]; exact congrFun (hres b hb) μ
    apply IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp
    intro hm
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, h] at hm
    exact one_ne_zero hm
  have hguard : ∀ b ∈ S, reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ b =
      dropCoord μ (normalizeAt μ (formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (b i)))) :=
    fun b hb => if_pos fun i => Set.mem_univ_pi.mp hb i
  refine ⟨?_, hres a ha, hunit a ha, ?_⟩
  · rw [hguard a ha]
    have hu := hunit a ha
    set P := formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i)) with hP
    have hPμ : normalizeAt μ P μ = 1 := by
      simp only [normalizeAt, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; exact Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu
    have hins : insertOne μ (dropCoord μ (normalizeAt μ P)) = normalizeAt μ P := by
      simp only [insertOne, dropCoord]
      rw [Fin.insertNth_eq_iff]
      exact ⟨hPμ.symm, rfl⟩
    simp only [reducedFormCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [hins]
    refine ⟨hPμ, ?_⟩
    funext j
    have h : ∀ m, IsLocalRing.residue O (P m) = formProd d g m := fun m => congrFun (hres a ha) m
    have hμ' : IsLocalRing.residue O (P μ) = 1 := by rw [h, hμ]
    simp only [residueVector, normalizeAt, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, h]
    have : IsLocalRing.residue O (Ring.inverse (P μ)) = 1 := by
      simpa [hμ'] using congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue O) (Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu)
    rw [this, one_mul]
  · intro L hL j
    set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L
    rw [hguard a ha, hguard a' ha', ← Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    set P := formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i)) with hP
    set P' := formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a' i)) with hP'
    have hA : ∀ i k, Ideal.Quotient.mk I (insertOne (ν i) (a i) k) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk I (insertOne (ν i) (a' i) k) := by
      intro i k
      simp only [insertOne]
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove (ν i) k with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · simp
      · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
        exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (hL i k)
    have hPP : ∀ m, Ideal.Quotient.mk I (P m) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (P' m) := by
      intro m
      rw [hP, hP', formProd_map, formProd_map]
      simp only [hA]
    have hu := hunit a ha
    have hu' := hunit a' ha'
    have hinv : Ideal.Quotient.mk I (Ring.inverse (P μ)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk I (Ring.inverse (P' μ)) := by
      have e1 := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu)
      have e2 := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hu')
      simp only [map_mul, map_one] at e1 e2
      rw [hPP μ] at e1
      exact left_inv_eq_right_inv e1 e2
    simp only [dropCoord, Fin.removeNth_apply, normalizeAt, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul,
      hinv, hPP]

name: SurfaceBlowup.forms_linear_injective
statement:
theorem forms_linear_injective (k ι : Type) [Field k] [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) (hg : ∀ i, g i ≠ 0) (hc : FormsCoprime d g)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (hν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) ≠ 0) (h : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k)
    (hh : ∀ i, h i (ν i) = 0) (c : k)
    (hsum : ∑ i, formPoly (h i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (g j) = Polynomial.C c * ∏ i,
      formPoly (g i)) :
    ∀ i, h i = 0
proof:
:= by
  set p : ι → Polynomial k := fun i => formPoly (h i) with hp
  set q : ι → Polynomial k := fun i => formPoly (g i) with hq
  have hq0 : ∀ i, q i ≠ 0 := fun i h0 => hg i (formPoly_eq_zero _ h0)
  have hQ0 : (∏ i, q i) ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hq0 i)
  
  have hdvd : ∀ i, q i ∣ p i := by
    intro i
    have hcop : IsCoprime (q i) (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q j) :=
      IsCoprime.prod_right (fun j hj => hc.1 i j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm)
    apply hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    have hs := hsum
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)] at hs
    have : p i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q j =
        Polynomial.C c * ∏ i, q i - ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          p l * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, q j := by
      rw [← hs]; ring
    rw [this]
    apply dvd_sub
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i)) _
    · apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro l hl
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _
        (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hl).symm, Finset.mem_univ i⟩)) _
  choose u hu using hdvd
  
  have husum : ∑ i, u i = Polynomial.C c := by
    have : (∑ i, u i) * ∏ i, q i = Polynomial.C c * ∏ i, q i := by
      rw [← hsum, Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      change u i * ∏ i, q i = p i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q j
      rw [hu i, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
      ring
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hQ0 this
  have hconst_full : ∀ i, (q i).natDegree = d i → (u i).natDegree = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hu0 : u i = 0
    · simp [hu0]
    have h1 : (p i).natDegree ≤ d i := natDegree_formPoly_le _
    rw [hu i, Polynomial.natDegree_mul (hq0 i) hu0, hi] at h1
    omega
  have hconst : ∀ i, (u i).natDegree = 0 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : (q i).natDegree = d i
    · exact hconst_full i hi
    have hoth : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (u j).natDegree = 0 := fun j hj =>
      hconst_full j ((hc.2 i j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm).resolve_left hi)
    have : u i = Polynomial.C c - ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, u j := by
      rw [← husum, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]; ring
    rw [this, ← Nat.le_zero]
    refine (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [natDegree_C, zero_max]
    exact natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun j hj => (hoth j hj).le
  
  intro i
  have hC : u i = Polynomial.C ((u i).coeff 0) := Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero (hconst i)
  have hco := coeff_formPoly (h i) (ν i)
  change (p i).coeff _ = _ at hco
  rw [hu i, hC, Polynomial.coeff_mul_C, hh i] at hco
  change (formPoly (g i)).coeff _ * _ = 0 at hco
  rw [coeff_formPoly] at hco
  have ha : (u i).coeff 0 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hco).resolve_left (hν i)
  apply formPoly_eq_zero
  change p i = 0
  rw [hu i, hC, ha]
  simp

name: SurfaceBlowup.natDegree_partial_fraction_le
statement:
private theorem natDegree_partial_fraction_le {k ι : Type} [Field k] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (d : ι → ℕ) (g h : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) (c : k) :
    (∑ i, formPoly (h i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (g j) +
      C c * ∏ i, formPoly (g i)).natDegree ≤ ∑ i, d i
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : ∀ s : Finset ι, (∏ j ∈ s, formPoly (g j)).natDegree ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, d j := fun s =>
    (natDegree_prod_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => natDegree_formPoly_le _)
  apply natDegree_add_le_of_degree_le
  · refine natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ => natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
    have h1 := natDegree_formPoly_le (h i)
    have h2 := hprod (Finset.univ.erase i)
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    omega
  · refine natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
    rw [natDegree_C, zero_add]
    exact hprod _

name: SurfaceBlowup.forms_linear_bijective
statement:
theorem forms_linear_bijective (k ι : Type) [Field k] [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) (hg : ∀ i, g i ≠ 0) (hc : FormsCoprime d g)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (hν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) ≠ 0) (w : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1) → k) :
    ∃ (h : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) (c : k), (∀ i, h i (ν i) = 0) ∧ formPoly w = ∑ i, formPoly
      (h i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (g j) + Polynomial.C c * ∏ i, formPoly (g i)
proof:
:= by
  let n := ∑ i, d i
  have hn : n = ∑ i, d i := rfl
  let P : ((∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) × k) → k[X] := fun p =>
    ∑ i, formPoly (p.1 i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (g j) +
      C p.2 * ∏ i, formPoly (g i)
  have hPdeg : ∀ p : (∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) × k, (P p).natDegree ≤ n :=
    fun p => natDegree_partial_fraction_le d g p.1 p.2
  let Φ : ((∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) × k) →ₗ[k] k[X] :=
    { toFun := P
      map_add' := by
        intro p q
        simp only [P, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Pi.add_apply, formPoly_add, add_mul,
          Finset.sum_add_distrib, C_add]
        ring
      map_smul' := by
        intro c p
        simp only [P, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Pi.smul_apply, formPoly_C_smul,
          RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, C_mul, Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul, mul_add,
          Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc] }
  let T : k[X] →ₗ[k] (Fin (n + 1) → k) := LinearMap.pi fun j => Polynomial.lcoeff k (j : ℕ)
  let ev : ((∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) × k) →ₗ[k] (ι → k) :=
    { toFun := fun p i => p.1 i (ν i)
      map_add' := by intros; rfl
      map_smul' := by intros; rfl }
  let V := LinearMap.ker ev
  let L : V →ₗ[k] (Fin (n + 1) → k) := T.comp (Φ.comp V.subtype)
  have hev : Function.Surjective ev := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨(fun i => Pi.single (ν i) (y i), 0), ?_⟩
    funext i
    simp [ev]
