  have hVdim : Module.finrank k V = n + 1 := by
    have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker ev
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hev, finrank_top] at h1
    have h2 : Module.finrank k ((∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → k) × k) = ∑ i, (d i + 1) + 1 := by
      simp [Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_pi_fintype]
    have h3 : ∑ i, (d i + 1) = n + Fintype.card ι := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp [hn]
    rw [h2, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, h3] at h1
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker ev) = n + 1
    omega
  have hL : Function.Injective L := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨⟨h, c⟩, hpv⟩ := p
    have hnu : ∀ i, h i (ν i) = 0 := fun i => by
      simpa [ev] using congrFun (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hpv) i
    have hP0 : P (h, c) = 0 := by
      ext m
      rw [coeff_zero]
      by_cases hm : m ≤ n
      · have := congrFun hp ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩
        simpa [L, T, Φ] using this
      · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (hPdeg _) (by omega))
    have hsum : ∑ i, formPoly (h i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (g j) =
        C (-c) * ∏ i, formPoly (g i) := by
      rw [C_neg, neg_mul, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      exact hP0
    have hh0 := SurfaceBlowup.forms_linear_injective k ι d g hg hc ν hν h hnu (-c) hsum
    have hprod : ∏ i, formPoly (g i) ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ h0 => hg i (formPoly_eq_zero _ h0)
    obtain rfl : h = 0 := funext hh0
    have h3 : ∀ m : ℕ, formPoly (0 : Fin (m + 1) → k) = 0 := fun m => by simp [formPoly]
    obtain rfl : c = 0 := by simpa [P, h3, hprod] using hP0
    rfl
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective L :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
      (by rw [hVdim, Module.finrank_fin_fun])).mp hL
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨h, c⟩, hpv⟩, hp⟩ := hsurj w
  refine ⟨h, c, fun i => by simpa [ev] using congrFun (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hpv) i, ?_⟩
  · change formPoly w = P (h, c)
    ext m
    by_cases hm : m ≤ n
    · have := congrFun hp ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩
      have h5 := coeff_formPoly w ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩
      simp only at h5
      rw [h5, ← this]
      simp [L, T, Φ]
    · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_formPoly_le w) (by omega)),
        coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (hPdeg _) (by omega))]

name: SurfaceBlowup.hensel_factor_unique_of_dvd
statement:
theorem hensel_factor_unique_of_dvd (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    (B C B' C' : Polynomial O) (hB : B.Monic) (hC : C.Monic) (hB' : B'.Monic) (hC' : C'.Monic)
    (hp : B * C = B' * C')
    (hred : B.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = B'.map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
    (hc : IsCoprime (B.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) (C.map (IsLocalRing.residue O))) :
    B = B' ∧ C = C'
proof:
:= by
  have hm := congrArg (Polynomial.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) hp
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, ← hred] at hm
  have hne : B.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) ≠ 0 := (hB.map _).ne_zero
  have hCC : C.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = C'.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ hne hm
  exact SurfaceBlowup.hensel_pair_unique O B C B' C' hB hC hB' hC' hred hCC hc hp

name: SurfaceBlowup.hensel_family_unique
statement:
theorem hensel_family_unique (O ι : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] [Fintype ι]
    (G G' : ι → Polynomial O) (hG : ∀ i, (G i).Monic) (hG' : ∀ i, (G' i).Monic)
    (hred : ∀ i, (G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = (G' i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime ((G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
      ((G j).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))) (hp : ∏ i, G i = ∏ i, G' i) :
    G = G'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∏ i ∈ s, G i = ∏ i ∈ s, G' i → ∀ i ∈ s, G i = G' i := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => intro _ i hi; simp at hi
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      intro h i hi
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha] at h
      have hcop : IsCoprime ((G a).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
          ((∏ j ∈ s, G j).map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) := by
        rw [Polynomial.map_prod]
        exact IsCoprime.prod_right fun j hj => hc a j (fun e => ha (e ▸ hj))
      have hmap : (∏ j ∈ s, G j).map (IsLocalRing.residue O)
          = (∏ j ∈ s, G' j).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) := by
        rw [Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_prod]
        exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => hred j
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.hensel_pair_unique O (G a) (∏ j ∈ s, G j) (G' a)
        (∏ j ∈ s, G' j) (hG a) (Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun j _ => hG j) (hG' a)
        (Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun j _ => hG' j) (hred a) hmap hcop h
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
      · exact h1
      · exact ih h2 i hi
  funext i
  exact key Finset.univ hp i (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: SurfaceBlowup.orbit_product_lifts
statement:
private theorem orbit_product_lifts {K L : Type} [CommRing K] [CommRing L] (ι : K →+* L)
    (τ : ℕ → (L ≃+* L)) (δ : ℕ) (hτ0 : τ 0 = RingEquiv.refl L)
    (hrec : ∀ i : ℕ, τ (i+1) = (τ i).trans (τ 1)) (hτδ : ∀ z : L, τ δ z = z)
    (hfix : ∀ z : L, τ 1 z = z → ∃ y : K, ι y = z) (p : Polynomial L) :
    ∏ i : Fin δ, p.map (τ i).toRingHom ∈ Polynomial.lifts ι
proof:
:= by
  have hτδ' : τ δ = τ 0 := by
    ext z; rw [hτδ, hτ0]; rfl
  have hshift : ∀ i : Fin δ, (τ 1).toRingHom.comp (τ i).toRingHom = (τ (i.val + 1)).toRingHom :=
    fun i => by rw [hrec (i : ℕ)]; rfl
  
  have Pinv : (∏ i : Fin δ, p.map (τ i).toRingHom).map (τ 1).toRingHom =
      ∏ i : Fin δ, p.map (τ i).toRingHom := by
    simp only [Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_map, hshift]
    cases δ with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_zero]
      rw [hτδ', mul_comm]
  exact (Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts _).2 fun n => hfix _ <| by
    simpa [Polynomial.coeff_map] using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · n) Pinv

name: SurfaceBlowup.irreducible_of_map_eq_orbit_product
statement:
private theorem irreducible_of_map_eq_orbit_product {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]
    (ι : K →+* L) (hinj : Function.Injective ι) (τ : ℕ → (L ≃+* L))
    (hτι : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : K), τ i (ι y) = ι y) {δ : ℕ} {g : Polynomial L} (hgi : Irreducible g)
    (hconj : ∀ i : Fin δ, (g.map (τ i).toRingHom).Monic ∧ Irreducible (g.map (τ i).toRingHom))
    (hdist : ∀ i j : Fin δ, g.map (τ i).toRingHom = g.map (τ j).toRingHom → i = j)
    {H : Polynomial K} (hHm : H.Monic) (hH : H.map ι = ∏ i : Fin δ, g.map (τ i).toRingHom)
    (hgdvd : g ∣ H.map ι) : Irreducible H
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ i : ℕ, ((τ i).toRingHom.comp ι) = ι := fun i => RingHom.ext (hτι i)
  
  have key : ∀ A B, H = A * B → g ∣ A.map ι → IsUnit B := by
    intro A B hAB hg
    have hA : A ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hHm.ne_zero (by simp [hAB])
    have hB : B ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hHm.ne_zero (by simp [hAB])
    have hdvd : H.map ι ∣ A.map ι := by
      rw [hH]
      apply Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime
      · exact fun i j hij => distinct_monic_irreducible_coprime _ _ _ (hconj i).1 (hconj j).1
          (hconj i).2 (hconj j).2 fun he => hij (hdist i j he)
      · intro i
        have := Polynomial.map_dvd (τ i).toRingHom hg
        rwa [Polynomial.map_map, hcomp] at this
    have hle := Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hdvd (Polynomial.map_ne_zero hA)
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj,
      Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj, hAB, Polynomial.natDegree_mul hA hB] at hle
    rw [Polynomial.isUnit_iff_degree_eq_zero, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hB]
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : B.natDegree = 0)
  refine ⟨fun hu => hgi.not_isUnit (isUnit_of_dvd_unit hgdvd ((Polynomial.isUnit_map ι).2 hu)),
    fun A B hAB => ?_⟩
  have : g ∣ A.map ι * B.map ι := by rw [← Polynomial.map_mul, ← hAB]; exact hgdvd
  rcases hgi.prime.dvd_or_dvd this with h | h
  · exact Or.inr (key A B hAB h)
  · exact Or.inl (key B A (by rw [hAB, mul_comm]) h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.invariant_orbit_factors
statement:
theorem invariant_orbit_factors (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (ι : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (τ : ℕ → (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≃+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
    (hτ : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ), τ i
      (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) x) = algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ)
      (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (frobeniusIter O Φ i x))
    (hτι : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : BaseField O), τ i (ι y) = ι y)
    (hτ0 : τ 0 = RingEquiv.refl (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
    (hrec : ∀ i : ℕ, τ (i+1) = (τ i).trans (τ 1))
    (hτδ : ∀ z : BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ), τ Φ.natDegree z = z)
    (hfix : ∀ z : BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ), τ 1 z = z → ∃ y : BaseField O, ι y = z)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ι) (F : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) (hgs : ∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g)
    (hd : gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h))
    (hprod : F.map (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))) = gs.prod)
    (hcop : ∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j → IsCoprime
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree => (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) i)
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree => (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) j)) :
    ∃ H : Fin gs.length → Polynomial (BaseField O), (∀ a, (H a).Monic ∧ Irreducible (H a)) ∧
      Function.Injective H ∧
      (∀ a, (H a).map ι = ∏ i : Fin Φ.natDegree, (gs.get a).map (τ i).toRingHom) ∧
      (∀ a, (H a).natDegree = Φ.natDegree * (gs.get a).natDegree) ∧ (∏ a, H a).map ι =
      (conjugateProduct O Φ F).map (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, _h3, h4⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.conjugate_irreducible_factors_distinct O Φ τ hτ
    F gs hgs hd hprod hcop
  
  have hδ : 0 < Φ.natDegree := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 => hΦ.2.not_isUnit <| by
    rw [residuePoly, eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero (hΦ.1.map _) (by rw [hΦ.1.natDegree_map, h0])]
    exact isUnit_one
  set δ := Φ.natDegree with hδdef
  
  let P : Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) → Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) :=
    fun p => ∏ i : Fin δ, p.map (τ i).toRingHom
  have Plifts : ∀ p, P p ∈ Polynomial.lifts ι := orbit_product_lifts ι τ δ hτ0 hrec hτδ hfix
  choose H hH using fun a : Fin gs.length => Polynomial.mem_lifts _ |>.mp (Plifts (gs.get a))
  have gmem : ∀ a : Fin gs.length, gs.get a ∈ gs := fun a => List.get_mem gs a
  have gmon : ∀ a, (gs.get a).Monic := fun a => (hgs _ (gmem a)).1
  have girr : ∀ a, Irreducible (gs.get a) := fun a => (hgs _ (gmem a)).2
  have Pmon : ∀ a, (P (gs.get a)).Monic := fun a =>
    Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun (i : Fin δ) _ => (h1 i _ (gmon a) (girr a)).1
  have Pdeg : ∀ a, (P (gs.get a)).natDegree = δ * (gs.get a).natDegree := by
    intro a
    simp only [P]
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic (h := fun (i : Fin δ) _ => (h1 i _ (gmon a) (girr a)).1)]
    simp [Polynomial.natDegree_map]
  have Hmon : ∀ a, (H a).Monic := fun a =>
    Polynomial.monic_of_injective hinj (by rw [hH a]; exact Pmon a)
  have Hdeg : ∀ a, (H a).natDegree = δ * (gs.get a).natDegree := by
    intro a
    rw [← Pdeg a, ← hH a, Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj]
  have hτ0' : ∀ p : Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)), p.map (τ 0).toRingHom = p :=
    fun p => by simp [hτ0]
  have gdvdP : ∀ a, gs.get a ∣ P (gs.get a) := fun a => by
    have h := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i : Fin δ => (gs.get a).map (τ i).toRingHom)
      (Finset.mem_univ (⟨0, hδ⟩ : Fin δ))
    rwa [Fin.val_mk, hτ0'] at h
  refine ⟨H, fun a => ⟨Hmon a, ?_⟩, ?_, hH, Hdeg, ?_⟩
  · 
    exact irreducible_of_map_eq_orbit_product ι hinj τ hτι (girr a)
      (fun i => h1 i _ (gmon a) (girr a)) (fun i j he => (h2 i j a a he).1) (Hmon a) (hH a)
      (by rw [hH a]; exact gdvdP a)
  · 
    intro a b hab
    have : gs.get a ∣ P (gs.get b) := by
      rw [← hH b, ← hab, hH a]; exact gdvdP a
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := ((girr a).prime).exists_mem_finset_dvd this
    have hm := h1 i _ (gmon b) (girr b)
    have heq := Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated (gmon a) hm.1
      ((girr a).associated_of_dvd hm.2 hi)
    exact (h2 ⟨0, hδ⟩ i a b (by rw [Fin.val_mk, hτ0']; exact heq)).2
  · 
    rw [h4, Polynomial.map_prod]
    simp only [hH, P]
    rw [Finset.prod_comm]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [← Fin.prod_univ_fun_getElem]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.local_algEquiv_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem local_algEquiv_maximalIdeal (O B B' : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing B] [CommRing B']
    [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalRing B'] [Algebra O B] [Algebra O B'] (φ : B ≃ₐ[O] B') :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B').comap (φ : B →+* B') = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B ∧
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (φ : B →+* B') = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B').comap (φ : B →+* B') = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B := by
    have : IsLocalHom (φ : B →+* B') := ⟨fun a ha => by simpa using ha.map φ.symm⟩
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap _
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rw [← h1]
  exact Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ φ.surjective _

name: SurfaceBlowup.dvr_algEquiv_ramification_inertia
statement:
theorem dvr_algEquiv_ramification_inertia (O B B' : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B] [CommRing B']
    [IsDomain B'] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B'] [Algebra O B] [Algebra O B'] [Algebra.IsIntegral O B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral O B'] (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap O B))
    (hinj' : Function.Injective (algebraMap O B')) (φ : B ≃ₐ[O] B') :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx O = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B').ramificationIdx O
      ∧ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).inertiaDeg O = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B').inertiaDeg O
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, hm⟩ := local_algEquiv_maximalIdeal O B B' φ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := dvr_extension_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow O B hinj
    have h2 := dvr_extension_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow O B' hinj'
    have h3 := congrArg (Ideal.map (φ : B →+* B')) h1
    rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_pow, hm] at h3
    have hcomp : ((φ : B →+* B').comp (algebraMap O B)) = algebraMap O B' := by
      ext x; simp
    rw [hcomp, h2] at h3
    exact dvr_maximalIdeal_pow_injective B' _ _ h3.symm
  · have l1 := (integral_local_extension_unique_prime O B).1
    have l2 := (integral_local_extension_unique_prime O B').1
    have : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) := ⟨l1.symm⟩
    have : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B').LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) := ⟨l2.symm⟩
    rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_of_isMaximal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B),
      Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_of_isMaximal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B')]
    exact (Ideal.Quotient.algEquivOfEqComap (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) φ
      (by rw [← hc]; rfl)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_congruent_difference_factor
statement:
theorem monic_congruent_difference_factor (O : Type) [CommRing O] (pi : O)
    (hreg : ∀ x : O, pi * x = 0 → x = 0) (i n : ℕ) (G G' : Polynomial O) (hG : G.Monic)
    (hG' : G'.Monic) (hn : G.natDegree = n) (hn' : G'.natDegree = n)
    (hcong : ∀ j, G'.coeff j - G.coeff j ∈ Ideal.span {pi ^ i}) :
    (∃ H : Polynomial O, G' - G = Polynomial.C (pi ^ i) * H ∧ H.degree < (n : WithBot ℕ)) ∧
      (∀ x : O, pi ^ i * x ∈ Ideal.span {pi ^ (i + 1)} → x ∈ Ideal.span {pi})
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x : O, pi ^ k * x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x hx; simpa using hx
    | succ k ih => exact fun x hx ↦ hreg _ (ih _ (by rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]; exact hx))
  refine ⟨?_, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : Polynomial.C (pi ^ i) ∣ G' - G := by
      rw [Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff]
      exact fun j ↦ by rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (hcong j)
    refine ⟨H, hH, Polynomial.degree_lt_iff_coeff_zero _ _ |>.2 fun m hm ↦ hpow i _ ?_⟩
    rw [← Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, ← hH, Polynomial.coeff_sub]
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hm with rfl | h
    · rw [show G'.coeff n = 1 from hn' ▸ hG'.coeff_natDegree,
        show G.coeff n = 1 from hn ▸ hG.coeff_natDegree, sub_self]
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega),
        Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega), sub_self]
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hx
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.2 ⟨y, (sub_eq_zero.mp (hpow i _ (by
      rw [mul_sub, ← hy, pow_succ]; ring))).symm⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_poly_reconstruct
statement:
theorem monic_poly_reconstruct (O : Type) [CommRing O] [Nontrivial O] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → O) :
    (monicPolyO a).Monic ∧ (monicPolyO a).natDegree = n
      ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, (monicPolyO a).coeff i = a i)
      ∧ (∀ F : Polynomial O, F.Monic → F.natDegree = n → monicPolyO (coeffVec n F) = F)
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg := Polynomial.degree_sum_fin_lt a
  refine ⟨Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add hdeg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold monicPolyO
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt, Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
    rwa [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
  · intro i
    unfold monicPolyO
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, if_neg (by omega), zero_add,
      Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [if_neg (fun h ↦ hj (Fin.ext h.symm)), mul_zero]
    · simp
  · intro F hF hn
    conv_rhs => rw [hF.as_sum, hn]
    unfold monicPolyO coeffVec
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i ↦ Polynomial.C (F.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_product_bijection
statement:
theorem factor_product_bijection (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (g : ι → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hg : ∀ i, (g i).Monic)
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) :
    Set.BijOn (factorProduct (fun i ↦ (g i).natDegree))
      (Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))
      (residueCell O (∑ i, (g i).natDegree) (∏ i, g i))
proof:
:= by
  have R := fun (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → O) ↦ monic_poly_reconstruct O n a
  have hprod : ∀ a : ∀ i, Fin (g i).natDegree → O,
      monicPolyO (factorProduct (fun i ↦ (g i).natDegree) a) = ∏ i, monicPolyO (a i) := by
    intro a
    unfold factorProduct
    apply (R _ (fun _ ↦ (0 : O))).2.2.2
    · exact Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ ↦ (R _ (a i)).1)
    · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ ↦ (R _ (a i)).1)]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ (R _ (a i)).2.1)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, residueCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ha ⊢
    rw [hprod, Polynomial.map_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ ha i)
  · intro a ha a' ha' h
    simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, residueCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ha ha'
    have hp : ∏ i, monicPolyO (a i) = ∏ i, monicPolyO (a' i) := by
      rw [← hprod, ← hprod, h]
    have hG := hensel_family_unique O ι (fun i ↦ monicPolyO (a i))
      (fun i ↦ monicPolyO (a' i)) (fun i ↦ (R _ (a i)).1) (fun i ↦ (R _ (a' i)).1)
      (fun i ↦ by simp only [ha i, ha' i])
      (fun i j hij ↦ by simpa only [ha i, ha j] using hc i j hij) hp
    funext i j
    have := congrFun hG i
    rw [← (R _ (a i)).2.2.1 j, ← (R _ (a' i)).2.2.1 j, this]
  · intro c hc'
    simp only [residueCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hc'
    obtain ⟨G, hGm, hF, hGr, hGd⟩ := hensel_family_exists O ι (monicPolyO c)
      (R _ c).1 g hg hc hc'
    have hrec : ∀ i, monicPolyO (coeffVec (g i).natDegree (G i)) = G i :=
      fun i ↦ (R _ (fun _ ↦ (0 : O))).2.2.2 _ (hGm i) (hGd i)
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ coeffVec (g i).natDegree (G i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, residueCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      intro i
      rw [hrec i, hGr i]
    · unfold factorProduct
      simp only [hrec]
      rw [← hF]
      funext j
      simp only [coeffVec]
      exact (R _ c).2.2.1 j

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_squarefree_factors_of_reduced
statement:
theorem monic_squarefree_factors_of_reduced (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Polynomial K)
    (hF : F.Monic) (hred : IsReduced (AdjoinRoot F)) :
    ∃ gs : List (Polynomial K), (∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) ∧
      gs.Pairwise (fun g h ↦ g ≠ h) ∧ F = gs.prod
proof:
:= by
  classical
  open UniqueFactorizationMonoid in
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := hF.ne_zero
  have hsq : Squarefree F := by
    rintro g ⟨h, rfl⟩
    have hgh : g * h ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; apply hF0; rw [mul_assoc, h0, mul_zero]
    have h0 := (show IsNilpotent (AdjoinRoot.mk (g * g * h) (g * h)) from
      ⟨2, by rw [← map_pow, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero]; exact ⟨h, by ring⟩⟩).eq_zero
    rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero, mul_assoc] at h0
    exact isUnit_of_dvd_one ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_right hgh).1 (by simpa using h0))
  set M := normalizedFactors F
  have hmon : ∀ g ∈ M, g.Monic := fun g hg ↦ by
    rw [← normalize_normalized_factor g hg]
    exact Polynomial.monic_normalize (irreducible_of_normalized_factor g hg).ne_zero
  refine ⟨M.toList, fun g hg ↦ ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Multiset.mem_toList] at hg
    exact ⟨hmon g hg, irreducible_of_normalized_factor g hg⟩
  · change List.Nodup _
    rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, Multiset.coe_toList]
    exact (squarefree_iff_nodup_normalizedFactors hF0).1 hsq
  · rw [Multiset.prod_toList]
    exact (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated
      (by simpa using Polynomial.monic_multiset_prod_of_monic M id hmon) hF
      (prod_normalizedFactors hF0)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.normalized_form_cell_cylinder_mass
statement:
theorem normalized_form_cell_cylinder_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (d : ℕ) (ν : Fin (d + 1))
    (g : Fin (d + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hgν : g ν = 1) :
    (∀ b : Fin d → O, b ∈ reducedFormCell O d ν g ↔
        ∀ j, IsLocalRing.residue O (b j) = g (ν.succAbove j)) ∧
      (∀ b ∈ reducedFormCell O d ν g,
        reducedFormCell O d ν g = {b' | ∀ j, b' j - b j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)}) ∧
      (reducedFormCell O d ν g).Nonempty ∧ MeasurableSet (reducedFormCell O d ν g) ∧
      coefficientMeasure O d (reducedFormCell O d ν g) =
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ d ∧
      MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (cellMeasure O d (reducedFormCell O d ν g)) ∧
      ∀ (L : ℕ) (b : Fin d → O), 1 ≤ L → b ∈ reducedFormCell O d ν g →
        cellMeasure O d (reducedFormCell O d ν g)
            {b' | ∀ j, b' j - b j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L} =
          (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (d * (L - 1))
proof:
:= by
  set C := reducedFormCell O d ν g with hCdef
  set q : ℝ≥0∞ := (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)
  have h1 : ∀ b : Fin d → O, b ∈ C ↔ ∀ j, IsLocalRing.residue O (b j) = g (ν.succAbove j) := by
    intro b
    simp only [hCdef, reducedFormCell, normalizedFormCell, insertOne, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
      Fin.insertNth_apply_same, true_and]
    refine ⟨fun h j ↦ by
      simpa [residueVector, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove] using congrFun h (ν.succAbove j),
      fun h ↦ funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove ν i with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · simp [residueVector, hgν]
    · simp [residueVector, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, h j]
  have h2 : ∀ b ∈ C, C = {b' | ∀ j, b' j - b j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)} := by
    intro b hb
    ext b'
    rw [h1] at hb
    rw [h1, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact forall_congr' fun j ↦ by rw [← hb j]; exact Ideal.Quotient.eq
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0⟩ : C.Nonempty :=
    ⟨fun j ↦ (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (g (ν.succAbove j))).choose,
      (h1 _).2 fun j ↦ (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (g (ν.succAbove j))).choose_spec⟩
  have hball : ∀ L (b : Fin d → O),
      MeasurableSet {b' : Fin d → O | ∀ j, b' j - b j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L} := by
    intro L b
    have hm := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) htop d
    have : @MeasurableSet _ (adicCylinderSpace (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (Fin d → O))
        {b' : Fin d → O | ∀ j, b' j - b j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L} :=
      MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom <| Or.inr ⟨L, b, by
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        rw [finite_coordinate_adic_congruence]⟩
    rwa [← hm] at this
  have hC1 : C = {b' | ∀ j, b' j - b0 j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ 1} := by
    rw [h2 b0 hb0]; simp
  have h4 : MeasurableSet C := by rw [hC1]; exact hball 1 b0
  have h5 : coefficientMeasure O d C = q⁻¹ ^ d := by
    rw [hC1, coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop, mul_one]
  have hμ0 : q⁻¹ ^ d ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _))
  have hμt : q⁻¹ ^ d ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.pow_ne_top <| ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr <| by
    simp only [q]; exact_mod_cast (Nat.card_pos (α := IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)).ne'
  refine ⟨h1, h2, ⟨b0, hb0⟩, h4, h5, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    rw [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ,
      Set.univ_inter, h5, smul_eq_mul, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hμ0 hμt]
  · intro L b hL hb
    have hsub : {b' : Fin d → O | ∀ j, b' j - b j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L} ⊆ C := by
      rw [h2 b hb]
      exact fun y hy j ↦ Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega) (hy j)
    rw [cellMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply (hball L b),
      Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hsub, h5, coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop, smul_eq_mul]
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, L = k + 1 := ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_add, mul_one, pow_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
      ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hμ0 hμt, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_cell_product_measure
statement:
theorem form_cell_product_measure (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1)
    [hσ : ∀ i,
      MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))] :
    MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
          (fun i ↦ cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))) ∧
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (fun i ↦ cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))))
        (Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))ᶜ = 0 ∧
      ∀ (L : ℕ), 1 ≤ L → ∀ a' ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)),
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
            (fun i ↦ cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))))
          (Set.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦
            {b : Fin (d i) → O | ∀ j, b j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L})) =
          (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ ((∑ i, d i) * (L - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have H := fun i ↦ normalized_form_cell_cylinder_mass O htop (d i) (ν i) (g i) (hgν i)
  have : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
      (cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))) := fun i ↦ (H i).2.2.2.2.2.1
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcompl : ∀ i, cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
        (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))ᶜ = 0 := by
      intro i
      unfold cellMeasure
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
        MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply (H i).2.2.2.1.compl, Set.compl_inter_self]
      simp
    have hone : ∀ i, cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
        (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)) = 1 := fun i ↦
      (MeasureTheory.prob_compl_eq_zero_iff (H i).2.2.2.1).1 (hcompl i)
    rw [MeasureTheory.prob_compl_eq_zero_iff (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun i ↦ (H i).2.2.2.1),
      MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_pi]
    simp [hone]
  · intro L hL a' ha'
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_pi]
    have : ∀ i, cellMeasure O (d i) (reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
        {b : Fin (d i) → O | ∀ j, b j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L} =
        (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (d i * (L - 1)) :=
      fun i ↦ (H i).2.2.2.2.2.2 L (a' i) hL (ha' i (Set.mem_univ i))
    simp only [this]
    rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Finset.sum_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_fields_primitive_idempotents
statement:
private theorem pi_fields_primitive_idempotents (ι : Type) [DecidableEq ι] (L : ι → Type)
    [∀ i, Field (L i)] (x : ∀ i, L i) :
    ((IsIdempotentElem x ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ y : (∀ i, L i), IsIdempotentElem y → y * x = y →
      y = 0 ∨ y = x) ↔ ∃ i, x = Pi.single i (1 : L i)) ∧
    ∀ i j : ι, i ≠ j → (Pi.single i (1 : L i) : ∀ i, L i) * Pi.single j (1 : L j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have idem : ∀ i, IsIdempotentElem (Pi.single i (1 : L i) : ∀ i, L i) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [IsIdempotentElem, ← Pi.single_mul, mul_one]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun i j hij ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hne, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      exact hne (funext h)
    have hi1 : x i = 1 :=
      (IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp (congrFun hx i)).resolve_left hi
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    have hy : Pi.single i (1 : L i) * x = Pi.single i 1 := by
      funext l
      by_cases h : l = i
      · subst h; simp [hi1]
      · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne h]
    rcases hp _ (idem i) hy with h | h
    · simpa using congrFun h i
    · exact h.symm
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨idem i, fun h ↦ by simpa using congrFun h i, fun y hy hyx ↦ ?_⟩
    have hj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → y j = 0 := fun j hj ↦ by
      simpa [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj] using (congrFun hyx j).symm
    rcases IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp (congrFun hy i) with h | h
    · left
      funext l
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst hl; simpa using h
      · simpa using hj l hl
    · right
      funext l
      by_cases hl : l = i
      · subst hl; simpa using h
      · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hl, hj l hl]
  · funext l
    by_cases h : l = i
    · subst h; simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hij]
    · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne h]

name: SurfaceBlowup.isPrimitiveIdempotent_map
statement:
private lemma isPrimitiveIdempotent_map {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A ≃+* B) (x : A)
    (h : IsIdempotentElem x ∧ x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ y, IsIdempotentElem y → y * x = y → y = 0 ∨ y = x) :
    IsIdempotentElem (f x) ∧ f x ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ y, IsIdempotentElem y → y * f x = y → y = 0 ∨ y = f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  refine ⟨h1.map f, by simpa using h2, fun y hy hyx ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases h3 (f.symm y) (hy.map f.symm) (by rw [← f.symm_apply_apply x, ← map_mul, hyx]) with h | h
  · exact .inl (by simpa using congrArg f h)
  · exact .inr (by simpa using congrArg f h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_single_one_injective
statement:
private lemma pi_single_one_injective {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] (L : ι → Type) [∀ i, Field (L i)]
    (j j' : ι) (h : (Pi.single j (1 : L j) : ∀ i, L i) = Pi.single j' (1 : L j')) : j = j'
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have := congrFun h j
  rw [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hne] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: SurfaceBlowup.algEquiv_single_eq_single
statement:
private lemma algEquiv_single_eq_single {K ι ι' : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq ι']
    (L : ι → Type) (L' : ι' → Type) [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Field (L' i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra K (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (L' i)] (e : (∀ i, L i) ≃ₐ[K] (∀ i, L' i))
    (i : ι) (j : ι') (hij : e (Pi.single i (1 : L i)) = Pi.single j (1 : L' j)) (x : L i) :
    e (Pi.single i x) = Pi.single j (e (Pi.single i x) j)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : e (Pi.single i x) = e (Pi.single i x) * Pi.single j 1 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← mul_one x, Pi.single_mul]
    rw [map_mul, hij]
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k = j
  · subst hk; simp
  · rw [h2, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk, mul_zero]

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_fields_algEquiv_index_bijection
statement:
theorem pi_fields_algEquiv_index_bijection (K ι ι' : Type) [Field K]
    (L : ι → Type) (L' : ι' → Type) [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Field (L' i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra K (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (L' i)] (e : (∀ i, L i) ≃ₐ[K] (∀ i, L' i)) :
    ∃ π : ι ≃ ι', ∀ i, e (Pi.single i (1 : L i)) = Pi.single (π i) (1 : L' (π i)) ∧
      ∃ φ : L i ≃ₐ[K] L' (π i), ∀ x : L i, e (Pi.single i x) = Pi.single (π i) (φ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : ∀ i, ∃ j, e (Pi.single i (1 : L i)) = Pi.single j (1 : L' j) := fun i ↦
    (pi_fields_primitive_idempotents ι' L' _).1.1
      (isPrimitiveIdempotent_map e.toRingEquiv _
        ((pi_fields_primitive_idempotents ι L _).1.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  have hj' : ∀ j, ∃ i, e.symm (Pi.single j (1 : L' j)) = Pi.single i (1 : L i) := fun j ↦
    (pi_fields_primitive_idempotents ι L _).1.1
      (isPrimitiveIdempotent_map e.symm.toRingEquiv _
        ((pi_fields_primitive_idempotents ι' L' _).1.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩))
  choose f hf using hj
  choose g hg using hj'
  let π : ι ≃ ι' :=
    { toFun := f
      invFun := g
      left_inv := fun i ↦ pi_single_one_injective L _ _ <| by
        rw [← hg, ← hf, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      right_inv := fun j ↦ pi_single_one_injective L' _ _ <| by
        rw [← hf, ← hg, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] }
  refine ⟨π, fun i ↦ ⟨hf i, ?_⟩⟩
  have hs := algEquiv_single_eq_single L L' e i (f i) (hf i)
  let φ₀ : L i →ₐ[K] L' (f i) :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ e (Pi.single i x) (f i)
      map_one' := by simp only [hf i, Pi.single_eq_same]
      map_mul' := fun x y ↦ by simp only [Pi.single_mul, map_mul, Pi.mul_apply]
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := fun x y ↦ by simp only [Pi.single_add, map_add, Pi.add_apply]
      commutes' := fun c ↦ by
        simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Pi.single_smul, map_smul, hf i,
          Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same] }
  have hbij : Function.Bijective φ₀ := by
    refine ⟨φ₀.toRingHom.injective, fun y ↦ ⟨e.symm (Pi.single (f i) y) i, ?_⟩⟩
    have := congrArg e (algEquiv_single_eq_single L' L e.symm (f i) i
      (by rw [← hf i, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]) y)
    rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hs] at this
    exact (Pi.single_injective (f i) this).symm
  exact ⟨AlgEquiv.ofBijective φ₀ hbij, hs⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_congruence_and_product
statement:
theorem polynomial_congruence_and_product (O : Type) [CommRing O] (I : Ideal O) :
    (∀ P Q : Polynomial O, P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ↔
        ∀ j, P.coeff j - Q.coeff j ∈ I) ∧
      (∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (F F' : ι → Polynomial O),
        (∀ i j, (F i).coeff j - (F' i).coeff j ∈ I) →
          ∀ j, (∏ i, F i).coeff j - (∏ i, F' i).coeff j ∈ I)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ P Q : Polynomial O, P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ↔
      ∀ j, P.coeff j - Q.coeff j ∈ I := fun P Q ↦ by
    simp only [Polynomial.ext_iff, Polynomial.coeff_map, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  refine ⟨h1, fun ι _ F F' h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← h1, Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ (h1 _ _).2 (h i)

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_quotient_product_equiv
statement:
theorem polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (K : Type) [Field K] (gs : List (Polynomial K))
    (hgs : ∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) (hd : gs.Pairwise (fun g h ↦ g ≠ h)) :
    ∃ e : AdjoinRoot gs.prod ≃ₐ[K] (∀ i : Fin gs.length, AdjoinRoot (gs.get i)),
      ∀ (P : Polynomial K) (i : Fin gs.length),
        e (AdjoinRoot.mk gs.prod P) i = AdjoinRoot.mk (gs.get i) P
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : ∀ i j : Fin gs.length, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (gs.get i) (gs.get j) := fun i j hij ↦
    distinct_monic_irreducible_coprime K _ _ (hgs _ (List.get_mem gs i)).1
      (hgs _ (List.get_mem gs j)).1 (hgs _ (List.get_mem gs i)).2 (hgs _ (List.get_mem gs j)).2
      fun h ↦ hij (List.Nodup.injective_get hd h)
  let f : Fin gs.length → Ideal (Polynomial K) := fun i ↦ Ideal.span {gs.get i}
  have heq : Ideal.span {gs.prod} = ⨅ i, f i := by
    rw [Ideal.iInf_span_singleton hcop, ← List.prod_ofFn, List.ofFn_get]
  let e1 : AdjoinRoot gs.prod ≃+* (∀ i : Fin gs.length, AdjoinRoot (gs.get i)) :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq heq).trans (Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient f fun i j hij ↦
      (Ideal.isCoprime_span_singleton_iff _ _).mpr (hcop i j hij))
  have hmk : ∀ P : Polynomial K, ∀ i, e1 (AdjoinRoot.mk gs.prod P) i = AdjoinRoot.mk (gs.get i) P :=
    fun P i ↦ rfl
  refine ⟨AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e1) fun c ↦ funext fun i ↦ ?_, hmk⟩
  rw [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, AdjoinRoot.of, RingHom.comp_apply, hmk]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.adjoinRoot_algEquiv_of_dvd_map
statement:
private theorem adjoinRoot_algEquiv_of_dvd_map (K L : Type) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Module.Finite K L] (d : ℕ) (hd : Module.finrank K L = d)
    (g : Polynomial L) (hg : g.Monic) (hgi : Irreducible g)
    (H : Polynomial K) (hH : H.Monic) (hHi : Irreducible H)
    (hdiv : g ∣ H.map (algebraMap K L)) (hdeg : H.natDegree = d * g.natDegree) :
    Nonempty (AdjoinRoot H ≃ₐ[K] AdjoinRoot g)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Irreducible H) := ⟨hHi⟩
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hgi⟩
  have h₀ : H.eval₂ (algebraMap K (AdjoinRoot g)) (AdjoinRoot.root g) = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hdiv
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq K L (AdjoinRoot g), ← Polynomial.eval₂_map, hQ,
      Polynomial.eval₂_mul, show g.eval₂ (algebraMap L (AdjoinRoot g)) (AdjoinRoot.root g) = 0 from
        AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root g, zero_mul]
  let φ := AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom H (Algebra.ofId K (AdjoinRoot g)) (AdjoinRoot.root g) h₀
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ := φ.toRingHom.injective
  have : Module.Finite L (AdjoinRoot g) := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hg.ne_zero).finite
  have : Module.Finite K (AdjoinRoot g) := .trans L (AdjoinRoot g)
  have : Module.Finite K (AdjoinRoot H) := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hH.ne_zero).finite
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φ.toLinearMap :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank (by
      rw [(AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hH.ne_zero).finrank, AdjoinRoot.powerBasis_dim,
        ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank K L (AdjoinRoot g), (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hg.ne_zero).finrank,
        AdjoinRoot.powerBasis_dim, hd, hdeg])).mp hinj
  exact ⟨AlgEquiv.ofBijective φ ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.root_field_algEquiv_conjugate_orbit
statement:
theorem root_field_algEquiv_conjugate_orbit (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)] (ι : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (hfin : letI := ι.toAlgebra; Module.Finite (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    ∧ Module.finrank (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) = Φ.natDegree)
    (g : Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))) (hg : g.Monic) (hgi : Irreducible g)
    (H : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hH : H.Monic) (hHi : Irreducible H) (hdiv : g ∣ H.map ι)
    (hdeg : H.natDegree = Φ.natDegree * g.natDegree) :
    letI
proof:
:= ι.toAlgebra; Nonempty (AdjoinRoot H ≃ₐ[BaseField O] AdjoinRoot g) := by
  let := ι.toAlgebra
  have := hfin.1
  exact adjoinRoot_algEquiv_of_dvd_map (BaseField O) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) Φ.natDegree hfin.2
      g hg hgi H hH
    hHi hdiv hdeg

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_eq_of_algEquiv
statement:
private theorem polynomial_type_eq_of_algEquiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (F F' : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ τ : FactorType)
    (hF : HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ) (hF' : HasPolynomialTypeF O F' τ)
    (e : AdjoinRoot F ≃ₐ[BaseField O] AdjoinRoot F') :
    σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gs, hgs, hgd, rfl, rfl, hfin⟩ := hF
  obtain ⟨hs, hhs, hhd, rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hF'
  obtain ⟨e₁, -⟩ := polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (BaseField O) gs hgs hgd
  obtain ⟨e₂, -⟩ := polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (BaseField O) hs hhs hhd
  have : ∀ i : Fin gs.length, Fact (Irreducible (gs.get i)) :=
    fun i => ⟨(hgs _ (List.get_mem _ _)).2⟩
  have : ∀ j : Fin hs.length, Fact (Irreducible (hs.get j)) :=
    fun j => ⟨(hhs _ (List.get_mem _ _)).2⟩
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := pi_fields_algEquiv_index_bijection (BaseField O) (Fin gs.length)
    (Fin hs.length) (fun i => AdjoinRoot (gs.get i)) (fun j => AdjoinRoot (hs.get j))
    (e₁.symm.trans (e.trans e₂))
  have key : ∀ i, factorInvariant O (gs.get i) = factorInvariant O (hs.get (π i)) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨φ, -⟩ := (hπ i).2
    exact factor_invariant_algEquiv O _ _ (hgs _ (List.get_mem _ _)).1
      (hgs _ (List.get_mem _ _)).2 (hhs _ (List.get_mem _ _)).1 (hhs _ (List.get_mem _ _)).2 φ
      (hfin _ (List.get_mem _ _))
  have hL : ∀ l : List (Polynomial (BaseField O)),
      ((l.map (factorInvariant O) : List (ℕ × ℕ)) : Multiset (ℕ × ℕ)) =
        Multiset.map (factorInvariant O ∘ l.get) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin l.length)).val := by
    intro l
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.ofFn_get l]
    rw [← Multiset.map_coe, ← Multiset.map_map, Fin.univ_val_map]
  rw [hL gs, hL hs, ← Multiset.map_univ_val_equiv π, Multiset.map_map]
  exact Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun i _ => key i)

name: SurfaceBlowup.hasPolynomialTypeF_of_algEquiv
statement:
private theorem hasPolynomialTypeF_of_algEquiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (F F' : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hF' : F'.Monic)
    (e : AdjoinRoot F ≃ₐ[BaseField O] AdjoinRoot F') (σ : FactorType) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ → HasPolynomialTypeF O F' σ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨gs, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := h
  have hred : IsReduced (AdjoinRoot F) := by
    subst h3
    obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (BaseField O) gs h1 h2
    have : ∀ i : Fin gs.length, Fact (Irreducible (gs.get i)) :=
        fun i => ⟨(h1 _ (List.get_mem _ _)).2⟩
    exact isReduced_of_injective (p.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) p.injective
  have hred' : IsReduced (AdjoinRoot F') :=
    isReduced_of_injective (e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) e.symm.injective
  obtain ⟨hs, k1, k2, k3⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.monic_squarefree_factors_of_reduced
      (BaseField O) F' hF' hred'
  
  have k4 : ∀ g ∈ hs, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g)) := by
    obtain ⟨e₁, -⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (BaseField O) gs h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e₂, -⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (BaseField O) hs k1 k2
    have : ∀ i : Fin gs.length, Fact (Irreducible (gs.get i)) :=
      fun i => ⟨(h1 _ (List.get_mem _ _)).2⟩
    have : ∀ j : Fin hs.length, Fact (Irreducible (hs.get j)) :=
      fun j => ⟨(k1 _ (List.get_mem _ _)).2⟩
    have e' : AdjoinRoot gs.prod ≃ₐ[BaseField O] AdjoinRoot hs.prod := by
      rw [← h3, ← k3]; exact e
    obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.pi_fields_algEquiv_index_bijection (BaseField O) (Fin gs.length)
      (Fin hs.length) (fun i => AdjoinRoot (gs.get i)) (fun j => AdjoinRoot (hs.get j))
      (e₁.symm.trans (e'.trans e₂))
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.1 hg
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := π.surjective j
    obtain ⟨φ, -⟩ := (hπ i).2
    obtain ⟨χ, -⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_algEquiv O _ _ (φ.restrictScalars O)
    have := h5 _ (List.get_mem gs i)
    exact Module.Finite.equiv χ.toLinearEquiv
  have hty : HasPolynomialTypeF O F' (hs.map (factorInvariant O) : Multiset (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
    ⟨hs, k1, k2, k3, rfl, k4⟩
  have := SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_eq_of_algEquiv O F F' σ _ ⟨gs, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ hty e
  rw [this]; exact hty

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_algEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem polynomial_type_algEquiv_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (F F' : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hF : F.Monic)
    (hF' : F'.Monic) (e : AdjoinRoot F ≃ₐ[BaseField O] AdjoinRoot F') (σ : FactorType) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ ↔ HasPolynomialTypeF O F' σ
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasPolynomialTypeF_of_algEquiv O F F' hF' e σ, hasPolynomialTypeF_of_algEquiv O F' F hF e.symm σ⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_mul_coprime
statement:
theorem polynomial_type_mul_coprime (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    (G H : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ τ : FactorType) (hG : HasPolynomialTypeF O G σ)
    (hH : HasPolynomialTypeF O H τ) (hc : IsCoprime G H) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O (G * H) (σ + τ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gs, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4, hg5⟩ := hG
  obtain ⟨hs, hh1, hh2, hh3, hh4, hh5⟩ := hH
  refine ⟨gs ++ hs, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun g hg => (List.mem_append.1 hg).elim (hg1 g) (hh1 g)
  · rw [List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨hg2, hh2, ?_⟩
    intro g hg h hh e
    subst e
    have h1 : g ∣ G := hg3 ▸ List.dvd_prod hg
    have h2 : g ∣ H := hh3 ▸ List.dvd_prod hh
    exact (hg1 g hg).2.not_isUnit (hc.isUnit_of_dvd' h1 h2)
  · rw [List.prod_append, hg3, hh3]
  · rw [List.map_append, hg4, hh4]; rfl
  · exact fun g hg => (List.mem_append.1 hg).elim (hg5 g) (hh5 g)

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_unique
statement:
theorem polynomial_type_unique (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (F : Polynomial (BaseField O))
    (σ τ : FactorType) (hσ : HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ) (hτ : HasPolynomialTypeF O F τ) :
    σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gs, hg, -, hF, rfl, -⟩ := hσ
  obtain ⟨hs, hh, -, hF', rfl, -⟩ := hτ
  have hrel : Multiset.Rel Associated (gs : Multiset (Polynomial (BaseField O)))
      (hs : Multiset _) := by
    apply UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors_unique
    · intro x hx; exact (hg x (by simpa using hx)).2
    · intro x hx; exact (hh x (by simpa using hx)).2
    · rw [Multiset.prod_coe, Multiset.prod_coe, ← hF, ← hF']; exact Associated.refl _
  have : Multiset.Rel Eq (gs : Multiset (Polynomial (BaseField O))) (hs : Multiset _) := by
    refine hrel.mono fun a ha b hb hab => ?_
    exact Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated (hg a (by simpa using ha)).1
      (hh b (by simpa using hb)).1 hab
  have h2 := Multiset.rel_eq.mp this
  rw [Multiset.coe_eq_coe] at h2 ⊢
  exact (List.Perm.map _ h2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.primitive_iff_residue_ne_zero
statement:
theorem primitive_iff_residue_ne_zero (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (n : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) :
    primitive O a ↔ residueVector O a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.ne_iff]
  unfold primitive residueVector
  refine exists_congr fun i => ?_
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, ne_eq, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff,
    IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, not_not]

name: SurfaceBlowup.product_first_order_expansion
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    set Q := ∏ i ∈ s, (G i + E i)
    set P := ∏ i ∈ s, G i
    set F := ∑ i ∈ s, E i * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, G j
    have hF : F ∈ J := Ideal.sum_mem _ (fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hE i))
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, E i * ∏ j ∈ (insert a s).erase i, G j = G a * F := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      have hne : i ≠ a := fun h => ha (h ▸ hi)
      rw [Finset.erase_insert_of_ne (Ne.symm hne), Finset.prod_insert
          (fun h => ha (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h))]
      ring
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.erase_insert ha,
      hsum]
    have hR : Q - P - F ∈ J ^ 2 := ih
    have hQP : Q - P ∈ J := by
      have : Q - P = (Q - P - F) + F := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact J.add_mem (Ideal.pow_le_self two_ne_zero hR) hF
    have key : (G a + E a) * Q - G a * P - (E a * P + G a * F)
        = G a * (Q - P - F) + E a * (Q - P) := by ring
    rw [key]
    refine (J ^ 2).add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hR) ?_
    rw [pow_two]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hE a) hQP

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_coeff_eq
statement:
private theorem formPoly_coeff_eq (x : Fin (n + 1) → A) (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (formPoly x).coeff (k : ℕ) = x k
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Fin.val_inj]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_smul_eq
statement:
private theorem formPoly_smul_eq (c : A) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    formPoly (c • a) = Polynomial.C c * formPoly a
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_natDeg_le
statement: private theorem formPoly_natDeg_le (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) : (formPoly a).natDegree ≤ n
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ =>
    (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.2)

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_map_eq
statement:
private theorem formPoly_map_eq {B : Type} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    formPoly (fun k => f (a k)) = (formPoly a).map f
proof:
:= by
  simp [formPoly, Polynomial.map_sum]

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_map_residue
statement:
private theorem formPoly_map_residue (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → O) :
    (formPoly x).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = formPoly (residueVector O x)
proof:
:=
  (formPoly_map_eq _ x).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.formPoly_prod_natDeg_le
statement:
private theorem formPoly_prod_natDeg_le {ι : Type} (d : ι → ℕ) (v : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → A)
    (s : Finset ι) : (∏ i ∈ s, formPoly (v i)).natDegree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, d i
proof:
:=
  (Polynomial.natDegree_prod_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => formPoly_natDeg_le _)

name: SurfaceBlowup.natDegree_sum_formPoly_mul_le
statement:
private theorem natDegree_sum_formPoly_mul_le (A' H : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → A) :
    (∑ i, formPoly (H i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (A' j)).natDegree ≤ ∑ i, d i
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ => Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans <| by
    have := formPoly_prod_natDeg_le d A' (Finset.univ.erase i)
    have := formPoly_natDeg_le (H i)
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    omega

name: SurfaceBlowup.formProd_add_smul_dvd
statement:
private theorem formProd_add_smul_dvd (c : A) (A' H : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → A)
    (k : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1)) :
    c ^ 2 ∣ formProd d (fun i => A' i + c • H i) k - formProd d A' k -
      c * (∑ i, formPoly (H i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (A' j)).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  have h := product_first_order_expansion (Polynomial A) ι (Ideal.span {Polynomial.C c})
    (fun i => formPoly (A' i)) (fun i => Polynomial.C c * formPoly (H i))
    (fun i => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)) Finset.univ
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← map_pow,
    Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff] at h
  simpa only [formProd, formPoly_add, formPoly_smul_eq, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] using h k

name: SurfaceBlowup.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) (n : ℕ) (x : O) :
    x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ^ n ↔ ϖ ^ n ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_eq_zero_iff_dvd
statement:
private theorem residue_eq_zero_iff_dvd (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) (x : O) :
    IsLocalRing.residue O x = 0 ↔ ϖ ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hϖ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]

name: SurfaceBlowup.reducedFormProduct_of_mem
statement:
private theorem reducedFormProduct_of_mem (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] {ι : Type}
    [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ) (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1))
    (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1))
    {a : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O} (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
    (j : Fin (∑ i, d i)) :
    reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a j =
      Ring.inverse (formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i)) μ) *
        formProd d (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i)) (μ.succAbove j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reducedFormProduct, if_pos ha, dropCoord, normalizeAt, Fin.removeNth_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_congruence_step
statement:
private theorem form_congruence_step {O : Type} [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] {ϖ : O} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1) (hc : FormsCoprime d g) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1))
    (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1) (A A' : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → O) (hA1 : ∀ i, A i (ν i) = 1)
    (hA'1 : ∀ i, A' i (ν i) = 1) (hAres : ∀ i, residueVector O (A i) = g i)
    (hPres : ∀ k, IsLocalRing.residue O (formProd d A k) = formProd d g k) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hM : ∀ k, ϖ ^ (t + 1) ∣
      formProd d A' μ * formProd d A k - formProd d A μ * formProd d A' k)
    (H : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → O) (hH : ∀ i k, A' i k - A i k = ϖ ^ t * H i k) :
    ∀ i k, ϖ ^ (t + 1) ∣ A' i k - A i k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hres := residue_eq_zero_iff_dvd hϖ
  set P := formProd d A
  set P' := formProd d A'
  have hHν : ∀ i, H i (ν i) = 0 := fun i => by
    have h := hH i (ν i)
    rw [hA'1 i, hA1 i, sub_self, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hϖ.ne_zero)
  set S := ∑ i, formPoly (H i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (A j)
  have hexp : ∀ k, (ϖ ^ t) ^ 2 ∣ P' k - P k - ϖ ^ t * S.coeff k := by
    have hA'H : A' = fun i => A i + ϖ ^ t • H i := funext fun i => funext fun k => by
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← hH i k]; ring
    intro k
    have h := formProd_add_smul_dvd (ϖ ^ t) A H k
    rwa [← hA'H] at h
  have hX : ∀ k, ϖ ∣ S.coeff μ * P k - P μ * S.coeff k := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ : ∃ s, t = s + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hexp k
    obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := hexp μ
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hM k
    refine (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (pow_ne_zero (s + 1) hϖ.ne_zero)).mp
      ⟨f - ϖ ^ s * (e' * P k - P μ * e), ?_⟩
    linear_combination hf + P μ * he - P k * he'
  have hSmap : S.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue O (S.coeff μ)) * ∏ i, formPoly (g i) := by
    ext n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
    by_cases hn : n ≤ ∑ i, d i
    · have h := (hres _).2 (hX ⟨n, by omega⟩)
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, hPres, hPres, hμ, one_mul, sub_eq_zero] at h
      exact h.symm
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        ((natDegree_sum_formPoly_mul_le A H).trans_lt (by omega)),
        Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        ((formPoly_prod_natDeg_le d g Finset.univ).trans_lt (by omega)), mul_zero, map_zero]
  have hinj := forms_linear_injective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ι d g
    (fun i h0 => by simpa [h0] using hgν i) hc ν (fun i => by simp [hgν])
    (fun i m => IsLocalRing.residue O (H i m)) (fun i => by simp [hHν])
    (IsLocalRing.residue O (S.coeff μ)) (by
      rw [← hSmap, Polynomial.map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_prod, formPoly_map_residue, hAres]
      rfl)
  intro i k
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hres _).1 (congrFun (hinj i) k)
  exact ⟨y, by rw [hH i k, hy]; ring⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_product_congruence_reflects
statement:
theorem form_product_congruence_reflects (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ) (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1))
    (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1)
    (hc : FormsCoprime d g) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1)) (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1)
    (a a' : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))
    (ha' : a' ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : ∀ j, reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a j - reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a' j ∈
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) :
    ∀ i j, a i j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  have hres := residue_eq_zero_iff_dvd hϖ
  have ha₁ : ∀ i, a i ∈ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i) := fun i => ha i (Set.mem_univ _)
  have ha₁' : ∀ i, a' i ∈ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i) := fun i => ha' i (Set.mem_univ _)
  obtain ⟨-, hPres, hu, -⟩ := form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a a ha ha
  obtain ⟨-, -, hu', -⟩ := form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a' a' ha' ha'
  set A : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → O := fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i) with hA
  set A' : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → O := fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a' i) with hA'
  set P := formProd d A
  set P' := formProd d A'
  have hAres : ∀ i k, IsLocalRing.residue O (A i k) = g i k := fun i k => congrFun (ha₁ i).2 k
  have hA'res : ∀ i k, IsLocalRing.residue O (A' i k) = g i k := fun i k => congrFun (ha₁' i).2 k
  have hPres : ∀ k, IsLocalRing.residue O (P k) = formProd d g k := fun k => congrFun hPres k
  have e1 : Ring.inverse (P μ) * P μ = 1 := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu
  have e2 : Ring.inverse (P' μ) * P' μ = 1 := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu'
  
  have hM : ∀ k, ϖ ^ L ∣ P' μ * P k - P μ * P' k := by
    intro k
    have hN : ϖ ^ L ∣ Ring.inverse (P μ) * P k - Ring.inverse (P' μ) * P' k := by
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove μ k with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
      · rw [e1, e2, sub_self]; exact dvd_zero _
      · have h := (mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff hϖ _ _).1 (hL j)
        rwa [reducedFormProduct_of_mem O d ν g μ ha₁, reducedFormProduct_of_mem O d ν g μ ha₁'] at h
    convert dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hN (P μ * P' μ) using 1
    linear_combination (-(P' μ * P k)) * e1 + (P μ * P' k) * e2
  
  have claim : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → t ≤ L → ∀ i k, ϖ ^ t ∣ A' i k - A i k := by
    intro t ht
    induction t, ht using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => intro _ i k; rw [pow_one, ← hres, map_sub, hAres, hA'res, sub_self]
    | succ t ht IH =>
      intro htL
      choose H hH using IH (by omega)
      exact form_congruence_step hϖ d ν g hgν hc μ hμ A A' (fun i => (ha₁ i).1)
        (fun i => (ha₁' i).1) (fun i => (ha₁ i).2) hPres ht
        (fun k => (pow_dvd_pow ϖ htL).trans (hM k)) H hH
  intro i j
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos L with rfl | hL0
  · simp
  · rw [mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff hϖ, ← dvd_neg, neg_sub]
    simpa [hA, hA', insertOne] using claim L hL0 le_rfl i ((ν i).succAbove j)

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_product_digit_lift
statement:
private theorem form_product_digit_lift (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ) (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1))
    (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1)
    (hc : FormsCoprime d g) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1)) (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1)
    (a : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))
    (c : Fin (∑ i, d i) → O) (hcD : c ∈ reducedFormCell O (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g)) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hct : ∀ j, reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a j - c j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ t) :
    ∃ a' ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)),
      (∀ i j, a' i j - a i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ t) ∧ ∀ j,
      reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a' j - c j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ (t+1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
  have hM := mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff hπ
  have hres := residue_eq_zero_iff_dvd hπ
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ : ∃ s, t = s + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
  have ha₁ : ∀ i, a i ∈ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i) := fun i => ha i (Set.mem_univ _)
  obtain ⟨-, hPres, hu, -⟩ := form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a a ha ha
  set A : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → O := fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a i) with hAdef
  have hA1 : ∀ i, A i (ν i) = 1 := fun i => (ha₁ i).1
  have hAres : ∀ i, residueVector O (A i) = g i := fun i => (ha₁ i).2
  set P := formProd d A
  set v := Ring.inverse (P μ)
  have hvu : v * P μ = 1 := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu
  have hu1 : π ∣ P μ - 1 := by
    rw [← hres, map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero, ← hμ]
    exact congrFun hPres μ
  set ct := insertOne μ c
  have hct1 : ct μ = 1 := hcD.1
  
  have hdiff : ∀ k, π ^ (s+1) ∣ ct k - v * P k := by
    intro k
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove μ k with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · rw [hct1, hvu, sub_self]; exact dvd_zero _
    · have h := (hM _ _).1 (hct j)
      rw [reducedFormProduct_of_mem O d ν g μ ha₁, ← dvd_neg, neg_sub] at h
      rwa [show ct (μ.succAbove j) = c j by simp [ct, insertOne]]
  choose w hw using hdiff
  
  obtain ⟨hb, c₀, hbν, hbeq⟩ := forms_linear_bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ι d g
    (fun i h => by simpa [h] using hgν i) hc ν (fun i => by simp [hgν]) (residueVector O w)
  choose H₀ hH₀ using fun i k => IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (hb i k)
  set H : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → O := fun i k => H₀ i k - H₀ i (ν i)
  have hHres : ∀ i, residueVector O (H i) = hb i := fun i => funext fun k => by
    simp [residueVector, H, hH₀, hbν]
  obtain ⟨c₀', hc₀'⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective c₀
  set A' : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → O := fun i => A i + π ^ (s+1) • H i
  set a' : ∀ i, Fin (d i) → O := fun i => dropCoord (ν i) (A' i)
  have hA'1 : ∀ i, A' i (ν i) = 1 := fun i => by simp [A', H, hA1]
  have hins : ∀ i, insertOne (ν i) (a' i) = A' i := fun i => by
    simp only [a', insertOne, dropCoord]
    rw [← hA'1 i, Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth]
  have ha'cell : ∀ i, a' i ∈ reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i) := fun i => by
    change insertOne (ν i) (a' i) ∈ normalizedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)
    rw [hins, ← hAres i]
    refine ⟨hA'1 i, funext fun k => ?_⟩
    simp [residueVector, A', (hres π).2 dvd_rfl]
  refine ⟨a', fun i _ => ha'cell i, fun i j => ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · rw [hM]
    simp [a', A', A, dropCoord, insertOne, Fin.removeNth_apply]
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, hu', -⟩ := form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a' a'
    (fun i _ => ha'cell i) (fun i _ => ha'cell i)
  set S := ∑ i, formPoly (H i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, formPoly (A j)
  have hR : Polynomial.C π ∣ S + Polynomial.C c₀' * ∏ i, formPoly (A i) - formPoly w := by
    rw [Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff]
    intro m
    rw [← hres, ← Polynomial.coeff_map]
    convert Polynomial.coeff_zero m
    simp only [S, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_sum, Polynomial.map_mul,
      Polynomial.map_prod, formPoly_map_residue, hAres, hHres, Polynomial.map_C, hc₀']
    rw [sub_eq_zero, hbeq]
  set lam := P μ - π ^ (s+1) * c₀'
  have hkey : ∀ k, π ^ (s+2) ∣ formProd d A' k - lam * ct k := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := formProd_add_smul_dvd (π ^ (s+1)) A H k
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff _ _).1 hR k
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      formPoly_coeff_eq, show (∏ i, formPoly (A i)).coeff k = P k from rfl] at hr
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hu1
    refine ⟨π ^ s * f + r - e * w k - c₀' * P k * v * e + π ^ s * c₀' * w k, ?_⟩
    linear_combination hf + π ^ (s+1) * hr - lam * hw k -
      (π ^ (s+1) * w k + π ^ (s+1) * c₀' * P k * v) * he + (π ^ (s+1) * c₀' * P k - P k) * hvu
  have hv' := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ hu'
  rw [hM, reducedFormProduct_of_mem O d ν g μ ha'cell]
  have hf : (fun i => insertOne (ν i) (a' i)) = A' := funext hins
  rw [hf] at hv' ⊢
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hkey (μ.succAbove j)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : π ^ (s+2) ∣ formProd d A' μ - lam := by simpa [hct1] using hkey μ
  rw [show c j = ct (μ.succAbove j) by simp [ct, insertOne]]
  refine ⟨Ring.inverse (formProd d A' μ) * (x - y * ct (μ.succAbove j)), ?_⟩
  linear_combination ct (μ.succAbove j) * hv' + Ring.inverse (formProd d A' μ) * hx -
    Ring.inverse (formProd d A' μ) * ct (μ.succAbove j) * hy

name: SurfaceBlowup.reducedFormCell_iff
statement:
private theorem reducedFormCell_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (d : ℕ)
    (ν : Fin (d + 1))
    (g : Fin (d + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (hgν : g ν = 1) (b : Fin d → O) :
    b ∈ reducedFormCell O d ν g ↔ ∀ j, IsLocalRing.residue O (b j) = g (ν.succAbove j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reducedFormCell, normalizedFormCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, insertOne,
    Fin.insertNth_apply_same, true_and, residueVector, funext_iff]
  rw [Fin.forall_iff_succAbove ν]
  simp [hgν]

name: SurfaceBlowup.sub_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
private theorem sub_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (x y : O) :
    x - y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ↔ IsLocalRing.residue O x = IsLocalRing.residue O y
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.Quotient.eq (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)).symm

name: SurfaceBlowup.eq_zero_of_forall_mem_pow
statement:
private theorem eq_zero_of_forall_mem_pow (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    (x : O) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, x ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ n) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  IsHausdorff.haus (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) IsAdicComplete.toIsHausdorff _ fun n => by
    simpa [SModEq.zero, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using h n

name: SurfaceBlowup.form_product_bijection
statement:
theorem form_product_bijection (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (d : ι → ℕ)
    (ν : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1)) (g : ∀ i, Fin (d i + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)
    (hgν : ∀ i, g i (ν i) = 1) (hc : FormsCoprime d g) (μ : Fin ((∑ i, d i) + 1))
    (hμ : formProd d g μ = 1) :
    Set.BijOn (reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ)
      (Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i)))
      (reducedFormCell O (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g))
proof:
:= by
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O
  set S := Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => reducedFormCell O (d i) (ν i) (g i))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun a ha => (form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a a ha ha).1
  · intro a ha a' ha' h
    funext i j
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    apply eq_zero_of_forall_mem_pow O
    intro L
    refine form_product_congruence_reflects O ι d ν g hgν hc μ hμ a a' ha ha' L ?_ i j
    intro j; simp [h]
  · intro c hc'
    have hcell := fun i => reducedFormCell_iff O (d i) (ν i) (g i) (hgν i)
    have hGcell := reducedFormCell_iff O (∑ i, d i) μ (formProd d g) hμ
    
    have a₁ : ∃ a, a ∈ S := by
      refine ⟨fun i j => (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (g i ((ν i).succAbove j))).choose, ?_⟩
      intro i _
      rw [hcell]
      intro j
      exact (IsLocalRing.residue_surjective _).choose_spec
    obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := a₁
    let P : ℕ → (∀ i, Fin (d i) → O) → Prop := fun t a =>
      a ∈ S ∧ ∀ j, reducedFormProduct O d ν g μ a j - c j ∈ m ^ (t + 1)
    have hP0 : P 0 a₁ := by
      refine ⟨ha₁, fun j => ?_⟩
      rw [zero_add, pow_one, sub_mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
      have h1 := (hGcell _).1
        (form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ a₁ a₁ ha₁ ha₁).1 j
      rw [h1, (hGcell c).1 hc' j]
    have step : ∀ t a, P t a → ∃ a', P (t+1) a' ∧ ∀ i j, a' i j - a i j ∈ m ^ (t + 1) := by
      intro t a ha
      obtain ⟨a', ha', h1, h2⟩ := form_product_digit_lift O ι d ν g hgν hc μ hμ a ha.1 c hc'
        (t+1) (by omega) ha.2
      exact ⟨a', ⟨ha', h2⟩, h1⟩
    let f : (t : ℕ) → {a // P t a} := fun t => Nat.rec (motive := fun t => {a // P t a})
      ⟨a₁, hP0⟩ (fun t x => ⟨(step t x.1 x.2).choose, (step t x.1 x.2).choose_spec.1⟩) t
    have hf : ∀ t i j, (f (t+1)).1 i j - (f t).1 i j ∈ m ^ (t + 1) := fun t =>
      (step t (f t).1 (f t).2).choose_spec.2
    have hcompat : ∀ s t, s ≤ t → ∀ i j, (f s).1 i j - (f t).1 i j ∈ m ^ (s + 1) := by
      intro s t hst i j
      induction t, hst using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => simp
      | succ t hst ih =>
        simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] using
          sub_mem ih (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := m) (by omega : s + 1 ≤ t + 1) (hf t i j))
    have hlim : ∀ i j, ∃ ℓ : O, ∀ n, (f n).1 i j - ℓ ∈ m ^ n := by
      intro i j
      obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec (I := m) (IsAdicComplete.toIsPrecomplete)
        (f := fun n => (f n).1 i j) (by
          intro s t hst
          rw [SModEq.sub_mem]
          simpa [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using
            Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := m) (by omega : s ≤ s + 1) (hcompat s t hst i j))
      refine ⟨ℓ, fun n => ?_⟩
      have := hℓ n
      rw [SModEq.sub_mem] at this
      simpa [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using this
    choose ℓ hℓ using hlim
    have haS : ℓ ∈ S := by
      intro i _
      rw [hcell]
      intro j
      have h0' : (f 0).1 i j - ℓ i j ∈ m := by
        rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel _ ((f 1).1 i j)]
        exact add_mem (by simpa using hcompat 0 1 (by omega) i j) (by simpa using hℓ i j 1)
      rw [sub_mem_maximalIdeal_iff] at h0'
      rw [← h0']
      exact (hcell i _).1 ((f 0).2.1 i (Set.mem_univ _)) j
    refine ⟨ℓ, haS, ?_⟩
    funext j
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    apply eq_zero_of_forall_mem_pow O
    intro t
    have h1 := (form_product_maps_to_and_preserves O ι d ν g μ hμ ℓ (f t).1 haS
      (f t).2.1).2.2.2 t (fun i j => by
        have := hℓ i j t
        rw [← neg_sub]; exact neg_mem this) j
    have h2 := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := m) (by omega : t ≤ t + 1) ((f t).2.2 j)
    simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using add_mem h1 h2

name: SurfaceBlowup.hensel_family_unique_mod_pow
statement:
theorem hensel_family_unique_mod_pow (O ι : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] [Fintype ι] (pi : O)
    (hpi : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O = Ideal.span {pi}) (hreg : ∀ x : O, pi * x = 0 → x = 0)
    (G G' : ι → Polynomial O) (hG : ∀ i, (G i).Monic) (hG' : ∀ i, (G' i).Monic)
    (hred : ∀ i, (G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = (G' i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime ((G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
      ((G j).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))) (L : ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ j, (∏ i, G i).coeff j - (∏ i, G' i).coeff j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) :
    ∀ i j, (G i).coeff j - (G' i).coeff j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmpow : ∀ t x, x ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ t ↔ pi ^ t ∣ x := by
    intro t x; rw [hpi, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  have hmem : ∀ x : O, x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O ↔ pi ∣ x := by
    intro x; rw [hpi, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  have hdeg : ∀ i, (G' i).natDegree = (G i).natDegree := by
    intro i
    rw [← (hG i).natDegree_map (IsLocalRing.residue O),
      ← (hG' i).natDegree_map (IsLocalRing.residue O), hred i]
  
  have key : ∀ t, t ≤ L → ∀ i j, pi ^ t ∣ (G' i).coeff j - (G i).coeff j := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => intro _ i j; simp
    | succ t ih =>
      intro htL
      have ih := ih (by omega)
      rcases t with _ | s
      · intro i j
        rw [zero_add, pow_one, ← hmem, ← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
        simpa [Polynomial.coeff_map] using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · j) (hred i).symm
      choose H hHeq hHdeg using fun i =>
        (monic_congruent_difference_factor O pi hreg (s + 1) _ (G i) (G' i) (hG i) (hG' i) rfl
          (hdeg i) (fun j => Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2 (ih i j))).1
      have hcancel := (monic_congruent_difference_factor O pi hreg (s + 1) 0 1 1
        Polynomial.monic_one Polynomial.monic_one Polynomial.natDegree_one
        Polynomial.natDegree_one (fun j => by simp)).2
      set S : Polynomial O := ∑ i, H i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, G j with hS
      have hexp := product_first_order_expansion (Polynomial O) ι
        (Ideal.span {Polynomial.C (pi ^ (s + 1))}) G (fun i => Polynomial.C (pi ^ (s + 1)) * H i)
        (fun i => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)) Finset.univ
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hexp
      obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hexp
      have hprod : ∏ i, (G i + Polynomial.C (pi ^ (s + 1)) * H i) = ∏ i, G' i :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => (sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp (hHeq i)).symm
      
      have hScoeff : ∀ j, pi ∣ S.coeff j := by
        intro j
        refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 (hcancel _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2 ?_))
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (pow_dvd_pow pi htL).trans ((hmpow _ _).1 (hp j))
        have hc := congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · j) hR
        simp only [hprod, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hS, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
          Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, ← map_pow] at hc
        exact ⟨-r - pi ^ s * R.coeff j, by linear_combination -hc - hr⟩
      have hzero := coprime_family_linear_injective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) ι
        (fun i => (G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) (fun i => (hG i).map _) hc
        (fun i => (H i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
        (fun i => by rw [(hG i).natDegree_map]; exact Polynomial.degree_map_le.trans_lt (hHdeg i))
        (by
          have hSmap : S.map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = 0 := by
            ext j
            rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_zero, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, hmem]
            exact hScoeff j
          simpa only [hS, Polynomial.map_sum, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_prod] using hSmap)
      intro i j
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hmem ((H i).coeff j)).1 <| (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).1 <| by
        rw [← Polynomial.coeff_map, hzero i, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
      exact ⟨y, by rw [← Polynomial.coeff_sub, hHeq i, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, hy]; ring⟩
  intro i j
  rw [hmpow, ← neg_sub, dvd_neg]
  exact key L le_rfl i j

name: SurfaceBlowup.coeff_eq_of_monic_of_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases hj.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
  · have h1 := hP.coeff_natDegree
    have h2 := hQ.coeff_natDegree
    rw [hPn] at h1; rw [hQn] at h2; rw [h1, h2]
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega),
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_coeff_sub_mem_iff
statement:
theorem monic_coeff_sub_mem_iff {O : Type} [CommRing O] (I : Ideal O) (N : ℕ)
    (P Q : Polynomial O) (hP : P.Monic) (hQ : Q.Monic) (hPd : P.natDegree = N)
    (hQd : Q.natDegree = N) :
    (∀ j : Fin N, P.coeff j - Q.coeff j ∈ I) ↔ ∀ j, P.coeff j - Q.coeff j ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h j => if hj : j < N then h ⟨j, hj⟩ else ?_, fun h j => h j⟩
  rw [coeff_eq_of_monic_of_le hP hQ hPd hQd (not_lt.mp hj), sub_self]
  exact I.zero_mem

name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_product_congruence_iff
statement:
theorem factor_product_congruence_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (g : ι → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) (L : ℕ) (a a' : ∀ i, Fin (g i).natDegree → O)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))
    (ha' : a' ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))) :
    (∀ j, factorProduct (fun i => (g i).natDegree) a j - factorProduct
        (fun i => (g i).natDegree) a' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) ↔ ∀ i j,
      a i j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L
proof:
:= by
  set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L
  set G : ι → Polynomial O := fun i => monicPolyO (a i)
  set G' : ι → Polynomial O := fun i => monicPolyO (a' i)
  have R := fun i => monic_poly_reconstruct O (g i).natDegree (a i)
  have R' := fun i => monic_poly_reconstruct O (g i).natDegree (a' i)
  have hGm : ∀ i, (G i).Monic := fun i => (R i).1
  have hG'm : ∀ i, (G' i).Monic := fun i => (R' i).1
  have hPm : (∏ i, G i).Monic := Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hGm i)
  have hP'm : (∏ i, G' i).Monic := Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hG'm i)
  have hPd : (∏ i, G i).natDegree = ∑ i, (g i).natDegree := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hGm i)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (R i).2.1)
  have hP'd : (∏ i, G' i).natDegree = ∑ i, (g i).natDegree := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => hG'm i)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (R' i).2.1)
  have hfac : (∀ j, factorProduct (fun i => (g i).natDegree) a j
      - factorProduct (fun i => (g i).natDegree) a' j ∈ I) ↔
      ∀ j, (∏ i, G i).coeff j - (∏ i, G' i).coeff j ∈ I :=
    monic_coeff_sub_mem_iff I _ _ _ hPm hP'm hPd hP'd
  have hcomp : ∀ i, (∀ j, a i j - a' i j ∈ I) ↔ ∀ j, (G i).coeff j - (G' i).coeff j ∈ I := by
    intro i
    rw [← monic_coeff_sub_mem_iff I _ _ _ (hGm i) (hG'm i) (R i).2.1 (R' i).2.1]
    refine forall_congr' fun j => ?_
    rw [(R i).2.2.1 j, (R' i).2.2.1 j]
  rw [hfac]
  constructor
  · intro hp i
    rw [hcomp i]
    obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible O
    have hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O = Ideal.span {pi} :=
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer pi).1 hpi
    have hred : ∀ i, (G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = (G' i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) :=
      fun i => (ha i (Set.mem_univ _)).trans (ha' i (Set.mem_univ _)).symm
    have hcG : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime ((G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O))
        ((G j).map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) := by
      intro i j hij
      have e1 : (G i).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = g i := ha i (Set.mem_univ _)
      have e2 : (G j).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = g j := ha j (Set.mem_univ _)
      rw [e1, e2]; exact hc i j hij
    exact hensel_family_unique_mod_pow O ι pi hm
      (fun x hx => (mul_eq_zero.1 hx).resolve_left hpi.ne_zero) G G' hGm hG'm hred hcG L hp i
  · intro h
    exact (polynomial_congruence_and_product O I).2 ι G G' (fun i => (hcomp i).1 (h i))

name: SurfaceBlowup.projective_normalizer_eval
statement:
theorem projective_normalizer_eval (q : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    (projectiveNormalizer n).eval q = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), q ^ i ∧
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), q ^ i) * (q - 1) = q ^ (n+1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ (x : Expr) (m : ℕ), (x.pow m).eval q = (x.eval q) ^ m := by
    intro x m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp [Expr.pow, Expr.eval]
    | succ m ih => simp [Expr.pow, Expr.eval, ih, pow_succ]
  have hsum : ∀ xs : List Expr, (Expr.sum xs).eval q = (xs.map (Expr.eval q)).sum := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => simp [Expr.sum, Expr.eval]
    | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [Expr.sum, List.foldr_cons, Expr.eval, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at ih ⊢
      rw [ih]
  refine ⟨?_, geom_sum_mul q (n+1)⟩
  unfold projectiveNormalizer
  rw [hsum, List.map_map]
  have : (Expr.eval q ∘ fun i => Expr.pow Expr.var i) = fun i => q ^ i := by
    funext i; simp [hpow, Expr.eval]
  rw [this]
  simp [Finset.sum, Finset.range_val, Multiset.range]

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_cell_cylinder
statement:
theorem residue_cell_cylinder (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (n : ℕ)
    (G : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) :
    (∀ a ∈ residueCell O n G, residueCell O n G =
        {b | ∀ i, b i - a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O}) ∧
      (G.Monic → G.natDegree = n → (residueCell O n G).Nonempty) ∧
      ((residueCell O n G).Nonempty → G.Monic ∧ G.natDegree = n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    ext b
    have hcong := (polynomial_congruence_and_product O (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)).1
      (monicPolyO b) (monicPolyO a)
    obtain ⟨hma, hna, hca, -⟩ := monic_poly_reconstruct O n a
    obtain ⟨hmb, hnb, hcb, -⟩ := monic_poly_reconstruct O n b
    simp only [residueCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ha ⊢
