    rw [← ha]
    change _ ↔ _ at hcong
    refine hcong.trans ⟨fun h i => ?_, fun h j => ?_⟩
    · have := h i; rwa [hca, hcb] at this
    · by_cases hj : j < n
      · have := h ⟨j, hj⟩; rw [← hca ⟨j, hj⟩, ← hcb ⟨j, hj⟩] at this; exact this
      · rw [coeff_eq_of_monic_of_le hmb hma hnb hna (by omega), sub_self]
        exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · intro hG hGn
    choose a ha using fun i : Fin n => IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (G.coeff i)
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hma, hna, hca, -⟩ := monic_poly_reconstruct O n a
    change (monicPolyO a).map (IsLocalRing.residue O) = G
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j < n
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
      have := hca ⟨j, hj⟩
      simp only at this
      rw [this, ha]
    · exact coeff_eq_of_monic_of_le (hma.map _) hG ((hma.natDegree_map _).trans hna) hGn
        (by omega)
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨hma, hna, -, -⟩ := monic_poly_reconstruct O n a
    simp only [residueCell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ha
    subst ha
    exact ⟨hma.map _, (hma.natDegree_map _).trans hna⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_cell_mass
statement:
theorem residue_cell_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (G : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hG : G.Monic) (hGn : G.natDegree = n) :
    MeasurableSet (residueCell O n G) ∧ coefficientMeasure O n (residueCell O n G) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n ∧ MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
      (cellMeasure O n (residueCell O n G))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcyl, hne, -⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.residue_cell_cylinder O n G
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne hG hGn
  have hS := hcyl a ha
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet (residueCell O n G) := by
    have e := SurfaceBlowup.finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) htop n
    have h2 : @MeasurableSet _ (adicCylinderSpace (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) (Fin n → O))
        (residueCell O n G) := by
      apply MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom
      refine Or.inr ⟨1, a, ?_⟩
      rw [hS]
      ext b
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      rw [SurfaceBlowup.finite_coordinate_adic_congruence]
      simp
    rwa [← e] at h2
  have hmass : coefficientMeasure O n (residueCell O n G)
      = (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n := by
    rw [hS]
    have := SurfaceBlowup.coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop n 1 a
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨hmeas, hmass, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have hq : (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by
    have : 0 < Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) := Nat.card_pos
    exact_mod_cast this.ne'
  have h0 : coefficientMeasure O n (residueCell O n G) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hmass]; exact pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.2 (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _))
  have htop' : coefficientMeasure O n (residueCell O n G) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hmass]; exact ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 hq)
  unfold cellMeasure
  rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ,
    Set.univ_inter, smul_eq_mul, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel h0 htop']

name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_cell_product_measure
statement:
theorem factor_cell_product_measure (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (g : ι → Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (hg : ∀ i, (g i).Monic)
    [hσ : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite
      (cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))] :
    MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun i => cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))) ∧
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun i => cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))))
      (Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))ᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ (L : ℕ), 1 ≤ L →
      ∀ a' ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)),
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi
        (fun i => cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))))
      (Set.pi Set.univ
        (fun i =>
          {b : Fin (g i).natDegree → O | ∀ j, b j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L})) =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ ((∑ i, (g i).natDegree) * (L - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hM := fun i => residue_cell_mass O htop (g i).natDegree (g i) (hg i) rfl
  have : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
      (cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))) := fun i => (hM i).2.2
  set q : ℝ≥0∞ := (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞) with hq
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hq]; exact_mod_cast (Nat.card_pos (α := IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)).ne'
  have hqt : q ≠ ⊤ := by rw [hq]; exact ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmeas : MeasurableSet (Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))) :=
      MeasurableSet.univ_pi (fun i => (hM i).1)
    rw [MeasureTheory.prob_compl_eq_zero_iff hmeas, MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_pi]
    refine Finset.prod_eq_one (fun i _ => ?_)
    have h1 := (hM i).1
    rw [← MeasureTheory.measure_univ
        (μ := cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))]
    unfold cellMeasure
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' h1,
      Set.inter_self, Set.univ_inter]
  · intro L hL a' ha'
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_pi]
    have key : ∀ i, cellMeasure O (g i).natDegree (residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))
        {b : Fin (g i).natDegree → O | ∀ j, b j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L}
        = q⁻¹ ^ ((g i).natDegree * (L - 1)) := by
      intro i
      have h1 := (hM i).1
      have hsub :
          {b : Fin (g i).natDegree → O | ∀ j, b j - a' i j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L}
          ⊆ residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i) := by
        rw [(residue_cell_cylinder O (g i).natDegree (g i)).1 (a' i) (ha' i (Set.mem_univ _))]
        intro b hb j
        exact Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega) (hb j)
      unfold cellMeasure
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply' h1,
        Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hsub, (hM i).2.1, coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop, smul_eq_mul]
      have : (g i).natDegree * L = (g i).natDegree + (g i).natDegree * (L - 1) := by
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, L = k + 1 := ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
        simp [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
      rw [this, pow_add, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
      · exact pow_ne_zero _ (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr hqt)
      · exact ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr hq0)
    simp only [key]
    rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, Finset.sum_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_extension_equiv
statement:
theorem residue_extension_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (Φ : Polynomial O) :
    ∃ e : residueExtension O Φ ≃+* AdjoinRoot (residuePoly O Φ),
      (∀ p : Polynomial O, e (baseReduce O Φ (AdjoinRoot.mk Φ p)) = AdjoinRoot.mk (residuePoly O Φ)
        (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue O))) ∧
      (∀ c : O, e (baseReduce O Φ (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c)) = algebraMap
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) (AdjoinRoot (residuePoly O Φ)) (IsLocalRing.residue O c))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ p : Polynomial O,
      (AdjoinRoot.quotEquivQuotMap Φ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)).toRingEquiv
      (baseReduce O Φ (AdjoinRoot.mk Φ p)) = AdjoinRoot.mk (residuePoly O Φ)
          (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue O)) :=
    fun p => AdjoinRoot.quotEquivQuotMap_apply_mk Φ p (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)
  refine ⟨(AdjoinRoot.quotEquivQuotMap Φ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)).toRingEquiv, h1, fun c => ?_⟩
  have := h1 (Polynomial.C c)
  rwa [AdjoinRoot.mk_C, Polynomial.map_C, AdjoinRoot.mk_C] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_extension_field
statement:
theorem residue_extension_field (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    IsField (residueExtension O Φ) ∧ Finite (residueExtension O Φ) ∧ Nat.card
      (residueExtension O Φ) = residueCard O ^ Φ.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, -, -⟩ := SurfaceBlowup.residue_extension_equiv O Φ
  have : Fact (Irreducible (residuePoly O Φ)) := ⟨hΦ.2⟩
  have hm : (residuePoly O Φ).Monic := hΦ.1.map _
  have hdeg : (residuePoly O Φ).natDegree = Φ.natDegree := hΦ.1.natDegree_map _
  let pb := AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hm
  let f : residueExtension O Φ ≃ (Fin (residuePoly O Φ).natDegree → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :=
    e.toEquiv.trans pb.basis.equivFun.toEquiv
  refine ⟨?_, Finite.of_equiv _ f.symm, ?_⟩
  · exact MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField _) e.toMulEquiv
  · rw [Nat.card_congr f, Nat.card_fun, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Fin _), Fintype.card_fin,
      hdeg]

name: SurfaceBlowup.block_translation
statement:
theorem block_translation (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (r : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (translateBlock O Φ r) (blockCell O Φ r) (zeroCell O Φ r) ∧
      (∀ (L : ℕ) (b b' : Fin r → AdjoinRoot Φ), (∀ j, b j - b' j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L) ↔ ∀ j,
        translateBlock O Φ r b j - translateBlock O Φ r b' j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L)
proof:
:= by
  set A := AdjoinRoot Φ
  have : Nontrivial (residueExtension O Φ) := ⟨(residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ).1.exists_pair_ne⟩
  have : Nontrivial A := (baseReduce O Φ).domain_nontrivial
  set θ := AdjoinRoot.root Φ
  have R := fun (a : Fin r → A) => monic_poly_reconstruct A r a
  
  have hT : ∀ b : Fin r → A, monicPolyO (translateBlock O Φ r b) = taylor θ (monicPolyO b) := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := R b
    exact (R b).2.2.2 _ (by rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_taylor]; exact h1)
        (by rw [natDegree_taylor, h2])
  
  have key : ∀ (J : Ideal A) (c c' : Fin r → A),
      (∀ j, c j - c' j ∈ J) ↔ monicPolyO c - monicPolyO c' ∈ J.map (C : A →+* A[X]) := by
    intro J c c'
    obtain ⟨m1, d1, e1, -⟩ := R c
    obtain ⟨m2, d2, e2, -⟩ := R c'
    rw [Ideal.mem_map_C_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h n
      rw [coeff_sub]
      by_cases hn : n < r
      · have := h ⟨n, hn⟩
        rwa [← e1 ⟨n, hn⟩, ← e2 ⟨n, hn⟩] at this
      · rw [coeff_eq_of_monic_of_le m1 m2 d1 d2 (not_lt.mp hn), sub_self]; exact J.zero_mem
    · intro h j
      have := h j
      rwa [coeff_sub, e1, e2] at this
  have tmem : ∀ (J : Ideal A) (s : A) (f : A[X]), f ∈ J.map (C : A →+* A[X]) →
      taylor s f ∈ J.map (C : A →+* A[X]) := by
    intro J s f hf
    have : ((taylorAlgHom s : A[X] →ₐ[A] A[X]) : A[X] →+* A[X]).comp C = C := by
      ext x
      · simp [taylor_C]
      · simp
    have h2 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem ((taylorAlgHom s : A[X] →ₐ[A] A[X]) : A[X] →+* A[X]) hf
    rw [Ideal.map_map, this] at h2
    simpa using h2
  have hinv : ∀ f : A[X], taylor (-θ) (taylor θ f) = f := by
    intro f; rw [taylor_taylor, neg_add_cancel, taylor_zero]
  have hinv' : ∀ f : A[X], taylor θ (taylor (-θ) f) = f := by
    intro f; rw [taylor_taylor, add_neg_cancel, taylor_zero]
  have hcf : conjugateFactor O Φ 0 = X - C (baseReduce O Φ θ) := by
    simp [conjugateFactor, rootBar, θ]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro b hb
    change (monicPolyO _).map _ = _
    change (monicPolyO b).map _ = _ at hb
    rw [hT, map_taylor, hb, hcf, taylor_pow, sub_eq_add_neg, ← C_neg]
    simp [taylor_X, taylor_C]
  · intro b _ b' _ h
    have h1 : monicPolyO b = monicPolyO b' := by
      apply taylor_injective θ
      rw [← hT, ← hT, h]
    funext j
    rw [← (R b).2.2.1 j, ← (R b').2.2.1 j, h1]
  · intro c hc
    change (monicPolyO c).map _ = _ at hc
    set F := taylor (-θ) (monicPolyO c)
    obtain ⟨m1, d1, -, -⟩ := R c
    have hF := (R c).2.2.2 F (by rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_taylor]; exact m1)
      (by rw [natDegree_taylor, d1])
    have hF' : monicPolyO (coeffVec r F) = F := (R (coeffVec r F)).2.2.2 F
      (by rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_taylor]; exact m1) (by rw [natDegree_taylor, d1])
    refine ⟨coeffVec r F, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (monicPolyO _).map _ = _
      rw [hF', map_taylor, hc, hcf, taylor_pow, sub_eq_add_neg, ← C_neg]
      simp [taylor_X]
    · have := hT (coeffVec r F)
      rw [hF', hinv'] at this
      funext j
      rw [← (R (translateBlock O Φ r (coeffVec r F))).2.2.1 j, this, (R c).2.2.1 j]
  · intro L b b'
    rw [key, key, hT, hT, ← map_sub]
    constructor
    · exact tmem _ θ _
    · intro h
      have := tmem _ (-θ) _ h
      rwa [hinv] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.pow_natCard_eq_self
statement:
private theorem pow_natCard_eq_self (K : Type) [CommRing K] (hK : IsField K) [Finite K] (x : K) :
    x ^ Nat.card K = x
proof:
:= by
  let := hK.toField
  cases nonempty_fintype K
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact FiniteField.pow_card x

name: SurfaceBlowup.natCard_le_of_pow_eq_self
statement:
private theorem natCard_le_of_pow_eq_self (K : Type) [CommRing K] (hK : IsField K) [Finite K]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n)
    (hall : ∀ x : K, x ^ n = x) : Nat.card K ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  let := hK.toField
  cases nonempty_fintype K
  have hsub : (Finset.univ : Finset K).val ⊆
      (Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.X : Polynomial K).roots := by
    intro x _
    rw [Polynomial.mem_roots (FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_ne_zero K hn)]
    simp [hall x]
  have := Polynomial.card_le_degree_of_subset_roots hsub
  rw [FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_natDegree_eq K hn, Finset.card_univ] at this
  rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: SurfaceBlowup.monic_eq_prod_X_sub_C
statement:
private theorem monic_eq_prod_X_sub_C (K : Type) [CommRing K] (hK : IsField K) (p : Polynomial K)
    (hp : p.Monic) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : p.natDegree = d) (r : Fin d → K) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hroot : ∀ i, p.IsRoot (r i)) :
    p = ∏ i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (r i)) ∧ ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (r i)) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (r j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := hK.toField
  refine ⟨?_, fun i j hij => Polynomial.pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C hr hij⟩
  set s := Finset.univ.image r
  have hs : s.card = d := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hr, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hle : s.val ≤ p.roots := by
    rw [Multiset.le_iff_subset s.nodup]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finset.mem_val.mp hx)
    exact (Polynomial.mem_roots hp.ne_zero).2 (hroot i)
  have heq : s.val = p.roots :=
    Multiset.eq_of_le_of_card_le hle
        (by rw [Finset.card_val, hs, ← hd]; exact Polynomial.card_roots' p)
  have hcard : Multiset.card p.roots = p.natDegree := by
    rw [← heq, Finset.card_val, hs, hd]
  rw [← Polynomial.prod_multiset_X_sub_C_of_monic_of_roots_card_eq hp hcard, ← heq]
  rw [← Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, Finset.prod_image (fun a _ b _ h => hr h)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.conjugate_roots_distinct
statement:
theorem conjugate_roots_distinct (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    (∀ c : O, residueEmbed O Φ (IsLocalRing.residue O c) = baseReduce O Φ
        (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c)) ∧ Function.Injective (residueEmbed O Φ) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, ((residuePoly O Φ).map (residueEmbed O Φ)).IsRoot (rootBar O Φ ^ residueCard O ^ i))
      ∧ (∀ i j : ℕ, i < Φ.natDegree → j < Φ.natDegree → rootBar O Φ ^ residueCard O ^ i =
        rootBar O Φ ^ residueCard O ^ j → i = j) ∧ (residuePoly O Φ).map (residueEmbed O Φ) = ∏ i :
      Fin Φ.natDegree, conjugateFactor O Φ i ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (conjugateFactor O Φ i) (conjugateFactor O Φ j))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hKf, hKfin, hKcard⟩ := residue_extension_field O Φ hΦ
  set K := residueExtension O Φ
  set q := residueCard O
  set δ := Φ.natDegree
  set ρ := residueEmbed O Φ
  set θ := rootBar O Φ
  
  have hcomp : ∀ c : O, ρ (IsLocalRing.residue O c) = baseReduce O Φ
      (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c) :=
    fun c => rfl
  have hcompR : ρ.comp (IsLocalRing.residue O) = (baseReduce O Φ).comp (AdjoinRoot.of Φ) :=
    RingHom.ext hcomp
  
  have hiter : ∀ (P : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)) (y : K) (n : ℕ),
      P.eval₂ ρ (y ^ q ^ n) = (P.eval₂ ρ y) ^ q ^ n := by
    intro P y n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, pow_mul, eval_at_pow_card, ih]
  
  have hsurj : ∀ x : K, ∃ P : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O), x = P.eval₂ ρ θ := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    induction a using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
    | ih p =>
      refine ⟨p.map (IsLocalRing.residue O), ?_⟩
      rw [Polynomial.eval₂_map, hcompR, ← AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, Polynomial.aeval_def,
        Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
      rfl
  have hq : 1 < q := Finite.one_lt_card
  have hroot : ∀ i : ℕ, ((residuePoly O Φ).map ρ).IsRoot (θ ^ q ^ i) := by
    intro i
    rw [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_map, hiter]
    have : (residuePoly O Φ).eval₂ ρ θ = 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.eval₂_map, hcompR, ← Polynomial.hom_eval₂, AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root, map_zero]
    rw [this, zero_pow (pow_ne_zero _ (by omega))]
  have hθδ : θ ^ q ^ δ = θ := by rw [← hKcard]; exact pow_natCard_eq_self K hKf θ
  have hdist : ∀ i j : ℕ, i < δ → j < δ → θ ^ q ^ i = θ ^ q ^ j → i = j := by
    have key : ∀ i j : ℕ, i < j → j < δ → θ ^ q ^ i = θ ^ q ^ j → False := by
      intro i j hij hj h
      set m := i + (δ - j) with hm
      have h1 : θ ^ q ^ m = θ := by
        have := congrArg (· ^ q ^ (δ - j)) h
        simp only [← pow_mul, ← pow_add] at this
        rw [hm, this, show j + (δ - j) = δ by omega, hθδ]
      have hall : ∀ x : K, x ^ q ^ m = x := by
        intro x
        obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
        rw [← hiter, h1]
      have hm1 : 1 < q ^ m := Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) hq
      have := natCard_le_of_pow_eq_self K hKf _ hm1 hall
      rw [hKcard] at this
      have := (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right hq).1 this
      omega
    intro i j hi hj h
    by_contra hne
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hij | hij
    exacts [key i j hij hj h, key j i hij hi h.symm]
  have hnt : Nontrivial K := ⟨hKf.exists_pair_ne⟩
  have hmon : ((residuePoly O Φ).map ρ).Monic := (hΦ.1.map _).map _
  have hdeg : ((residuePoly O Φ).map ρ).natDegree = δ := by
    rw [(hΦ.1.map _).natDegree_map, hΦ.1.natDegree_map]
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin δ => θ ^ q ^ (i : ℕ)) :=
    fun i j h => Fin.ext (hdist i j i.2 j.2 h)
  obtain ⟨hfac, hcop⟩ := monic_eq_prod_X_sub_C K hKf _ hmon δ hdeg _ hinj (fun i => hroot i)
  exact ⟨hcomp, ρ.injective, hroot, hdist, hfac, hcop⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.residue_vector_fiber_mass
statement:
theorem residue_vector_fiber_mass (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O] [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O]
    [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ)
    (w : Fin (n + 1) → IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) :
    MeasurableSet {a : Fin (n+1) → O | residueVector O a = w} ∧ coefficientMeasure O (n+1)
      {a : Fin (n+1) → O | residueVector O a = w} =
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  choose a₀ ha₀ using fun i => IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (w i)
  have hset : {a : Fin (n+1) → O | residueVector O a = w}
      = {b | ∀ i, b i - a₀ i ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ 1} := by
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, pow_one, residueVector, funext_iff, ← ha₀]
    refine forall_congr' fun i => ?_
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hm := finite_coordinate_borel_cylinders O (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) htop (n+1)
    change @MeasurableSet _ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin (n+1) → O)) _
    rw [hm, hset]
    apply MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom
    right
    refine ⟨1, a₀, ?_⟩
    ext b
    exact (finite_coordinate_adic_congruence O (n+1) _ 1 b a₀).symm
  · rw [hset, coefficient_cylinder_mass O htop (n+1) 1 a₀, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.scalar_class_card
statement:
theorem scalar_class_card (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → k)
    (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (scalarClass v) = Nat.card k - 1 ∧ (∀ w ∈ scalarClass v, w ≠ 0) ∧
      (scalarClass v).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hv
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, Set.toFinite _⟩
  · let f : {c : k // c ≠ 0} → scalarClass v := fun c => ⟨c.1 • v, c.1, c.2, rfl⟩
    have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
      constructor
      · intro a b h
        have h2 := congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) i
        simp only [f, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h2
        exact Subtype.ext (mul_right_cancel₀ hi h2)
      · rintro ⟨w, c, hc, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f hf)]
    have := Fintype.ofFinite k
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl,
      Fintype.card_subtype_eq]
  · rintro w ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ h
    exact hv ((smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hc)

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebraMap_injective_of_tower
statement:
theorem algebraMap_injective_of_tower (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (S L : Type)
    [CommRing S] [Field L] [Algebra O S] [Algebra S L] [Algebra (BaseField O) L] [Algebra O L]
    [IsScalarTower O S L] [IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) L] :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap O S)
proof:
:= by
  refine Function.Injective.of_comp (f := algebraMap S L) ?_
  rw [← RingHom.coe_comp, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq O (BaseField O) L, RingHom.coe_comp]
  exact (algebraMap (BaseField O) L).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective O (BaseField O))

name: SurfaceBlowup.closure_finite_descent
statement:
theorem closure_finite_descent (O Oδ L : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [Algebra O Oδ]
    [Module.Finite O Oδ] [CommRing L] [Algebra O L] [Algebra Oδ L] [IsScalarTower O Oδ L]
    (h : Module.Finite Oδ (integralClosure Oδ L)) : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:=
  have : Module.Finite O (integralClosure Oδ L) := .trans Oδ _
  .equiv (integralClosureTowerEquiv O Oδ L).symm.toLinearEquiv

name: SurfaceBlowup.closure_finite_ascent
statement:
theorem closure_finite_ascent (O Oδ L : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [Algebra O Oδ]
    [Module.Finite O Oδ] [CommRing L] [Algebra O L] [Algebra Oδ L] [IsScalarTower O Oδ L]
    (h : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)) : Module.Finite Oδ (integralClosure Oδ L)

:=
  have := Module.Finite.equiv (integralClosureTowerEquiv O Oδ L).toLinearEquiv
  .of_restrictScalars_finite O Oδ _

name: SurfaceBlowup.faithfulSMul_of_isFractionRing
statement:
private theorem faithfulSMul_of_isFractionRing (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [Field K]
    [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra O L]
    [IsScalarTower O K L] : FaithfulSMul O L
proof:
:= by
  rw [faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq O K L]
  exact (algebraMap K L).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective O K)

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_is_dedekind
statement:
theorem integral_closure_is_dedekind (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] :
    IsDedekindDomain (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:= by
  have := faithfulSMul_of_isFractionRing O K L
  have hN : IsNoetherianRing (integralClosure O L) :=
    isNoetherian_of_tower O (isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite O (integralClosure O L))
  have : IsFractionRing (integralClosure O L) L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension O K L (integralClosure O L)
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O (integralClosure O L) := IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra O L
  exact { hN, Ring.DimensionLEOne.of_isIntegral O (integralClosure O L),
    (isIntegrallyClosed_iff L).mpr fun {x} hx ↦
      ⟨IsIntegralClosure.mk' (integralClosure O L) x (isIntegral_trans (R := O) _ hx),
        IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_mk' _ _ _⟩ with : IsDedekindDomain (integralClosure O L) }

name: SurfaceBlowup.closure_finite_of_separable_tower
statement:
private theorem closure_finite_of_separable_tower (O K L M : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [Field M]
    [Algebra L M] [Algebra O M] [IsScalarTower O L M] [FiniteDimensional L M]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable L M] (hL : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)) :
    Module.Finite O (integralClosure O M)
proof:
:= by
  have := integral_closure_is_dedekind O K L
  have : IsFractionRing (integralClosure O L) L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension O K L (integralClosure O L)
  have := IsIntegralClosure.finite (integralClosure O L) L M
    (integralClosure (integralClosure O L) M)
  have : IsScalarTower O (integralClosure O L) M := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O L M,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (integralClosure O L) L M]
    rfl
  have := Module.Finite.trans (R := O) (integralClosure O L)
    (integralClosure (integralClosure O L) M)
  have : IsNoetherian O (integralClosure (integralClosure O L) M) :=
    isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite _ _
  let f : integralClosure O M →ₗ[O] integralClosure (integralClosure O L) M :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, x.2.tower_top⟩
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  exact .of_injective f fun x y h ↦ Subtype.ext (show x.1 = y.1 from congrArg (fun z ↦ z.1) h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.adjoinRoot_tensor
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : ∀ P : R[X], (polyEquivTensor' R A).symm (1 ⊗ₜ P) = P.map (algebraMap R A) :=
    fun P ↦ by simp [polyEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul_eq_smul]
  have hI : Ideal.span {g.map (algebraMap R A)} =
      ((Ideal.span {g}).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := A) (R := R))).map
        ((polyEquivTensor' R A).symm : A ⊗[R] R[X] →+* A[X]) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Set.image_singleton, ← hmap]
    rfl
  refine ⟨(Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv A R[X] A (Ideal.span {g})).trans
    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ _ (polyEquivTensor' R A).symm hI), fun P ↦ ?_⟩
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((polyEquivTensor' R A).symm (1 ⊗ₜ P)) = _
  rw [hmap]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.adjoinRoot_base_change
statement:
theorem adjoinRoot_base_change (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (F : Polynomial O) :
    ∃ e : TensorProduct O (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot F) ≃ₐ[BaseField O]
      AdjoinRoot (F.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))), ∀ P : Polynomial O,
      e (TensorProduct.tmul O (1 : BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot.mk F P)) =
        AdjoinRoot.mk (F.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))) (P.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O)))
proof:
:=
  adjoinRoot_tensor O (BaseField O) F

name: SurfaceBlowup.squarefree_of_isReduced_adjoinRoot
statement:
theorem squarefree_of_isReduced_adjoinRoot (q : K'[X]) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hred : IsReduced (AdjoinRoot q)) : Squarefree q
proof:
:= by
  rintro g ⟨h, rfl⟩
  have hgh : g * h ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; apply hq; rw [mul_assoc, h0, mul_zero]
  have h0 := (show IsNilpotent (AdjoinRoot.mk (g * g * h) (g * h)) from
    ⟨2, by rw [← map_pow, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero]; exact ⟨h, by ring⟩⟩).eq_zero
  rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero, mul_assoc] at h0
  exact isUnit_of_dvd_one ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_right hgh).1 (by simpa using h0))

name: SurfaceBlowup.squarefree_map_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem squarefree_map_of_isSeparable [FiniteDimensional K K'] [Algebra.IsSeparable K K']
    (g : K[X]) [Fact (Irreducible g)] : Squarefree (g.map (algebraMap K K'))
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.FormallyUnramified K K' := .of_isSeparable K K'
  have hred : IsReduced (TensorProduct K (AdjoinRoot g) K') :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field (AdjoinRoot g) _
  obtain ⟨e, -⟩ := adjoinRoot_tensor K K' g
  let c := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm K K' (AdjoinRoot g)).toRingEquiv
  exact squarefree_of_isReduced_adjoinRoot K' _ (map_ne_zero (Fact.out : Irreducible g).ne_zero)
    (isReduced_of_injective (c.toRingHom.comp e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
      (c.injective.comp e.symm.injective))

name: SurfaceBlowup.rootHom_isSeparable
statement:
private theorem rootHom_isSeparable [Algebra.IsSeparable K K'] (g : K[X]) [Fact (Irreducible g)]
    (h : K'[X]) [Fact (Irreducible h)] (hdvd : h ∣ g.map (algebraMap K K')) :
    letI
proof:
:= (rootHom K K' g h hdvd).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsSeparable (AdjoinRoot g) (AdjoinRoot h) := by
  let := (rootHom K K' g h hdvd).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower K (AdjoinRoot g) (AdjoinRoot h) :=
    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ ((rootHom K K' g h hdvd).commutes x).symm
  rw [← separableClosure.eq_top_iff, eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
  | ih p =>
    induction p using Polynomial.induction_on with
    | C a =>
      rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_C]
      exact mem_separableClosure_iff.2 <| ((Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable K a).map
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K K' (AdjoinRoot h)) (RingHom.injective _)).tower_top _
    | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hp hq
    | monomial n a ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, map_mul, AdjoinRoot.mk_X]
      refine mul_mem ih ?_
      rw [show AdjoinRoot.root h = rootHom K K' g h hdvd (AdjoinRoot.root g) from
        (AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root _ _ _ _).symm]
      exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _

name: SurfaceBlowup.closure_finite_ascent_root
statement:
theorem closure_finite_ascent_root (O Oδ K Kδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ]
    [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field Kδ] [Algebra K Kδ] [Algebra O Kδ]
    [Algebra Oδ Kδ] [IsScalarTower O K Kδ] [IsScalarTower O Oδ Kδ] [FiniteDimensional K Kδ]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable K Kδ] (g : K[X]) (hgm : g.Monic) (hgi : Irreducible g)
    (hfin : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g)))
    (h : Kδ[X]) (hhi : Irreducible h) (hdvd : h ∣ g.map (algebraMap K Kδ)) :
    Module.Finite Oδ (integralClosure Oδ (AdjoinRoot h))
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hgi⟩
  have : Fact (Irreducible h) := ⟨hhi⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional K (AdjoinRoot g) := hgm.finite_adjoinRoot
  have : FiniteDimensional Kδ (AdjoinRoot h) := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hhi.ne_zero).finite
  have : FiniteDimensional K (AdjoinRoot h) := Module.Finite.trans Kδ _
  let := (rootHom K Kδ g h hdvd).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower K (AdjoinRoot g) (AdjoinRoot h) :=
    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ ((rootHom K Kδ g h hdvd).commutes x).symm
  have : FiniteDimensional (AdjoinRoot g) (AdjoinRoot h) := .of_restrictScalars_finite K _ _
  have := rootHom_isSeparable K Kδ g h hdvd
  have : IsScalarTower O (AdjoinRoot g) (AdjoinRoot h) := .of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O K (AdjoinRoot h),
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply O K (AdjoinRoot g),
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (AdjoinRoot g) (AdjoinRoot h)]
  exact closure_finite_ascent O Oδ (AdjoinRoot h)
    (closure_finite_of_separable_tower O K (AdjoinRoot g) (AdjoinRoot h) hfin)

name: SurfaceBlowup.adjoinRoot_isSeparable
statement:
private theorem adjoinRoot_isSeparable {K : Type} [Field K] (g : K[X]) [Fact (Irreducible g)]
    (hs : g.Separable) : Algebra.IsSeparable K (AdjoinRoot g)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : IsSeparable K (AdjoinRoot.root g) :=
    hs.of_dvd (minpoly.dvd K _ (by rw [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_self]))
  have := (IntermediateField.isSeparable_adjoin_simple_iff_isSeparable K (AdjoinRoot g)).2 hx
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ IntermediateField.isSeparable_of_mem_isSeparable K (AdjoinRoot g)
    (L := IntermediateField.adjoin K {AdjoinRoot.root g}) ?_⟩
  have : y ∈ Algebra.adjoin K {AdjoinRoot.root g} := by rw [AdjoinRoot.adjoinRoot_eq_top]; trivial
  exact IntermediateField.algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin K _ this

name: SurfaceBlowup.closure_finite_of_separable
statement:
theorem closure_finite_of_separable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (g : (FractionRing O)[X]) (hirr : Irreducible g)
    (hs : g.Separable) : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hirr⟩
  have : Module.Finite (FractionRing O) (AdjoinRoot g) :=
    (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hirr.ne_zero).finite
  have := adjoinRoot_isSeparable g hs
  exact IsIntegralClosure.finite O (FractionRing O) (AdjoinRoot g) _

name: SurfaceBlowup.HasPolynomialTypeF.to_original
statement:
theorem HasPolynomialTypeF.to_original {O : Type} [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    {F : (BaseField O)[X]} {σ : FactorType} (h : HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ) :
    HasPolynomialType O F σ
proof:
:=
  let ⟨gs, h1, h2, hF, hσ, _⟩ := h; ⟨gs, h1, h2, hF, hσ⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.hasPolynomialTypeF_iff_of_separable
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialTypeF_iff_of_separable (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] {F : (BaseField O)[X]} {σ : FactorType} (hs : F.Separable) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ ↔ HasPolynomialType O F σ
proof:
:=
  ⟨HasPolynomialTypeF.to_original, fun ⟨gs, h1, h2, hF, hσ⟩ => ⟨gs, h1, h2, hF, hσ, fun g hg =>
    closure_finite_of_separable O g (h1 g hg).2 (hs.of_dvd (hF ▸ List.dvd_prod hg))⟩⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.squarefree_monic_has_polynomial_type
statement:
theorem squarefree_monic_has_polynomial_type (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hF : F.Monic) (hsq : Squarefree F)
    (hfin : ∀ g ∈ normalizedFactors F, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))) :
    ∃ σ : FactorType, HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : F ≠ 0 := hF.ne_zero
  have hmon : ∀ g ∈ normalizedFactors F, g.Monic := fun g hg ↦ by
    rw [← normalize_normalized_factor g hg]
    exact monic_normalize (irreducible_of_normalized_factor g hg).ne_zero
  have hprod : (normalizedFactors F).toList.prod = F := by
    rw [Multiset.prod_toList]
    exact eq_of_monic_of_associated (by simpa using monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ id hmon) hF
      (prod_normalizedFactors h0)
  refine ⟨_, (normalizedFactors F).toList, fun g hg ↦ ?_, ?_, hprod.symm, rfl,
    fun g hg ↦ hfin g (Multiset.mem_toList.1 hg)⟩
  · rw [Multiset.mem_toList] at hg
    exact ⟨hmon g hg, irreducible_of_normalized_factor g hg⟩
  · change List.Nodup _
    rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, Multiset.coe_toList]
    exact (squarefree_iff_nodup_normalizedFactors h0).1 hsq

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_dvd
statement:
theorem polynomial_type_dvd (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    (F G : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType)
    (hF : HasPolynomialTypeF O F σ) (hG : G.Monic) (hdvd : G ∣ F) :
    ∃ τ : FactorType, HasPolynomialTypeF O G τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨gs, hgs, hpw, rfl, -, hfin⟩ := hF
  have hNF : normalizedFactors gs.prod = (gs : Multiset _) := by
    rw [← Multiset.prod_coe, normalizedFactors_prod_eq _ fun g hg ↦ (hgs g hg).2]
    exact (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun g hg ↦ (hgs g hg).1.normalize_eq_self).trans
      (Multiset.map_id _)
  have hF0 : gs.prod ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ (hgs 0 (List.prod_eq_zero_iff.1 h0)).2.ne_zero rfl
  have hle : normalizedFactors G ≤ (gs : Multiset _) :=
    hNF ▸ (dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors hG.ne_zero hF0).1 hdvd
  exact squarefree_monic_has_polynomial_type O G hG
    ((squarefree_iff_nodup_normalizedFactors hG.ne_zero).2
      (Multiset.nodup_of_le hle (Multiset.coe_nodup.2 hpw)))
    fun g hg ↦ hfin g (Multiset.mem_coe.1 (Multiset.mem_of_le hle hg))

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_algEquiv
statement:
theorem algebra_type_algEquiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (B B' : Type) [CommRing B]
    [CommRing B'] [Algebra O B] [Algebra O B'] (e : B ≃ₐ[O] B') (σ : FactorType)
    (h : HasAlgebraType O B σ) : HasAlgebraType O B' σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, L, hF, hA, hA2, hT, hD, e₀, hσ⟩ := h
  exact ⟨ι, hι, L, hF, hA, hA2, hT, hD,
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl e).symm.trans e₀, hσ⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_of_generic_fibre_equiv
statement:
theorem algebra_type_of_generic_fibre_equiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (A B : Type)
    [CommRing A] [Algebra O A] [CommRing B] [Algebra O B]
    (e : TensorProduct O (BaseField O) A ≃ₐ[BaseField O] TensorProduct O (BaseField O) B)
    (σ : FactorType) (h : HasAlgebraType O B σ) : HasAlgebraType O A σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, i1, L, i2, i3, i4, i5, i6, g, hg⟩ := h
  exact ⟨ι, i1, L, i2, i3, i4, i5, i6, e.trans g, hg⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_pi
statement:
theorem algebra_type_pi (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → Type)
    [∀ j, CommRing (B j)] [∀ j, Algebra O (B j)] (σ : Fin n → FactorType)
    (h : ∀ j, HasAlgebraType O (B j) (σ j)) : HasAlgebraType O (∀ j, B j) (∑ j, σ j)
proof:
:= by
  choose ι hι L hF hKL hOL hST hFD e hσ using h
  let K := BaseField O
  let Lp : (Σ j, ι j) → Type := fun p ↦ L p.1 p.2
  let c : (∀ p : (Σ j, ι j), Lp p) ≃ₐ[K] ∀ j, ∀ i, L j i :=
    { toEquiv := Equiv.piCurry (fun j i ↦ L j i)
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  refine ⟨Σ j, ι j, inferInstance, Lp, fun p ↦ hF p.1 p.2, fun p ↦ hKL p.1 p.2,
    fun p ↦ hOL p.1 p.2, fun p ↦ hST p.1 p.2, fun p ↦ hFD p.1 p.2,
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight O K K B).trans (AlgEquiv.piCongrRight e)).trans c.symm,
    ?_, fun p ↦ (hσ p.1).2 p.2⟩
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ (hσ j).1

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_algEquiv
statement:
theorem integral_closure_algEquiv (O L L' : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing L] [CommRing L']
    [Algebra O L] [Algebra O L'] (e : L ≃ₐ[O] L') :
    ∃ φ : integralClosure O L ≃ₐ[O] integralClosure O L',
      ∀ x : integralClosure O L, (φ x : L') = e x
proof:
:=
  ⟨(e.subalgebraMap (integralClosure O L)).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (integralClosure_map_algEquiv e)), fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_finite_free
statement:
theorem integral_closure_finite_free (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [hfin : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] :
    Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L) ∧ Module.Free O (integralClosure O L) ∧
      Module.finrank O (integralClosure O L) = Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  have := faithfulSMul_of_isFractionRing O K L
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree O L := .trans_faithfulSMul O K L
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree O (integralClosure O L) := IsIntegralClosure.isTorsionFree O L
  have : IsNoetherian O (integralClosure O L) := isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite _ _
  refine ⟨hfin, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  have : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure O L) (nonZeroDivisors O)) L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isLocalization O K L (integralClosure O L)
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex, Module.finrank_eq_card_basis
    (Module.Basis.localizationLocalization K (nonZeroDivisors O) L
      (Module.Free.chooseBasis O (integralClosure O L)))]

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_invariants_degree
statement:
theorem integral_closure_invariants_degree (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (hlocal : IsLocalRing (integralClosure O L)) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:= hlocal;
      0 < (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure O L)).ramificationIdx O ∧
      0 < (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure O L)).inertiaDeg O ∧
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure O L)).ramificationIdx O *
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (integralClosure O L)).inertiaDeg O = Module.finrank K L := by
  obtain ⟨-, _, hrank⟩ := integral_closure_finite_free O K L
  refine ⟨Ideal.ramificationIdx_pos _ _, Ideal.inertiaDeg_pos _ _, ?_⟩
  rw [finite_flat_local_ramification_degree O (integralClosure O L), hrank]

name: SurfaceBlowup.integral_closure_not_field
statement:
theorem integral_closure_not_field (O K L : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)] : ¬ IsField (integralClosure O L)
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have := faithfulSMul_of_isFractionRing O K L
  exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField O (isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField
    (fun a b hab ↦ FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective O L (congrArg Subtype.val hab)) h)

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_field_maximal_ideals
statement:
theorem pi_field_maximal_ideals (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (L : ι → Type) [∀ i, Field (L i)]
    (m : Ideal (∀ i, L i)) :
    (m.IsMaximal ↔ ∃ i, m = RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom L i)) ∧ ∀ i j : ι,
      RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom L i) = RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom L j) → i = j
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  classical
  have hmax : ∀ i, (RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom L i)).IsMaximal := fun i ↦
    RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective _ (Function.surjective_eval i)
  refine ⟨⟨fun hm ↦ ?_, fun ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ hi ▸ hmax i⟩, fun i j h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, (Pi.single i (1 : L i) : ∀ i, L i) ∉ m := by
      by_contra! hc
      apply hm.ne_top
      rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, show (1 : ∀ i, L i) = ∑ i, Pi.single i (1 : L i) by
        ext k; simp [Finset.sum_apply]]
      exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ hc i
    refine ⟨i, ((hmax i).eq_of_le hm.ne_top fun x (hx : x i = 0) ↦ ?_).symm⟩
    have hxe : x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, x * (Pi.single j (1 : L j) : ∀ i, L i) := by
      ext k
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Pi.mul_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
      by_cases hk : k = i
      · subst hk; simp [hx]
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
        · simp
        · intro b _ hb; simp [hb]
        · simp [hk]
    rw [hxe]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j hj ↦ Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
    have h0 : (Pi.single i (1 : L i) : ∀ i, L i) * Pi.single j (1 : L j) = 0 := by
      ext k; by_cases hk : k = i
      · subst hk; simp [Ne.symm (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
      · simp [hk]
    exact (hm.isPrime.mem_or_mem (h0 ▸ m.zero_mem)).resolve_left hi
  · by_contra hij
    have : (Pi.single j (1 : L j) : ∀ i, L i) ∈ RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom L i) := by
      simp [RingHom.mem_ker, Ne.symm hij]
    simp [h, RingHom.mem_ker] at this

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_fraction_base_change
statement:
theorem unramified_fraction_base_change (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ)
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi)) :
    IsField (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) ∧ Module.finrank (BaseField O)
      (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) = δ
      ∧ (letI : Algebra Oδ (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra;
        IsFractionRing Oδ (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap O Oδ) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    by_contra hx0
    obtain ⟨k, u, rfl⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible hx0 hpi
    rw [map_mul, map_pow] at hx
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with h | h
    · exact (Units.map (algebraMap O Oδ : O →* Oδ) u).ne_zero h
    · exact hpiδ.ne_zero (pow_eq_zero_iff'.mp h).1
  let : Algebra Oδ (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  have hle : Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid Oδ (nonZeroDivisors O) ≤ nonZeroDivisors Oδ := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
      ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero ha))
  have : IsDomain (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) :=
    IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) hle
  have hfield : IsField (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) :=
    isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField' (R := BaseField O) (Field.toIsField _)
  refine ⟨hfield, by rw [Module.finrank_baseChange, hrank], ?_⟩
  let := hfield.toField
  have : FaithfulSMul Oδ (TensorProduct O (BaseField O) Oδ) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr (IsLocalization.injective _ hle)
  refine IsFractionRing.of_field _ _ fun z ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective
    (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid Oδ (nonZeroDivisors O)) z
  refine ⟨x, s, (eq_div_iff ?_).2 (IsLocalization.mk'_spec _ x s)⟩
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsLocalization.injective _ hle)).mpr (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero (hle s.2))

name: SurfaceBlowup.unramified_generic_fibre_witness
statement:
theorem unramified_generic_fibre_witness (O Oδ : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [IsDomain Oδ] [IsDiscreteValuationRing Oδ]
    [Algebra O Oδ] [Module.Finite O Oδ] [Module.Free O Oδ] (δ : ℕ) (hrank : Module.finrank O Oδ = δ)
    (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (hpiδ : Irreducible (algebraMap O Oδ pi))
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (B : Type)
    [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] [Algebra Oδ B] [IsScalarTower O Oδ B] (ι : Type)
    (L : ι → Type) [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra (BaseField Oδ) (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra Oδ (L i)]
    [∀ i, IsScalarTower Oδ (BaseField Oδ) (L i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional (BaseField Oδ) (L i)]
    (e : TensorProduct Oδ (BaseField Oδ) B ≃ₐ[BaseField Oδ] (∀ i, L i)) :
    ∃ (_ : ∀ i, Algebra (BaseField O) (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra O (L i))
      (_ : ∀ i, IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, IsScalarTower O Oδ (L i))
      (_ : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) (L i))
      (_ : TensorProduct O (BaseField O) B ≃ₐ[BaseField O] (∀ i, L i)), True
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hfr⟩ := unramified_fraction_base_change O Oδ δ hrank pi hpi hpiδ
  let K := BaseField O
  let Kδ := BaseField Oδ
  let rA : Algebra Oδ (K ⊗[O] Oδ) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  have : IsFractionRing Oδ (K ⊗[O] Oδ) := hfr
  let χ : K ⊗[O] Oδ ≃ₐ[Oδ] Kδ := IsLocalization.algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors Oδ) (K ⊗[O] Oδ) Kδ
  let χ' : Oδ ⊗[O] K ≃ₐ[Oδ] Kδ :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O Oδ K).toRingEquiv.trans χ.toRingEquiv)
      fun d ↦ χ.commutes d
  let φ : K →+* Kδ := χ.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
  let aKKδ : Algebra K Kδ := φ.toAlgebra
  have : Module.Finite K Kδ := .equiv
    { χ.toRingEquiv with
      map_smul' := fun k x ↦ by
        change χ (k • x) = φ k * χ x
        rw [Algebra.smul_def (R := K) k x, map_mul]
        rfl : K ⊗[O] Oδ ≃ₗ[K] Kδ }
  let E : K ⊗[O] B ≃+* (∀ i, L i) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm O K B).toRingEquiv.trans <|
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange O Oδ Oδ B K).symm.toRingEquiv.trans <|
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl (R := Oδ) (A₁ := B)) χ').toRingEquiv.trans <|
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm Oδ B Kδ).toRingEquiv.trans e.toRingEquiv
  let aK : ∀ i, Algebra K (L i) := fun i ↦ ((algebraMap Kδ (L i)).comp φ).toAlgebra
  let aO : ∀ i, Algebra O (L i) := fun i ↦
    ((algebraMap Oδ (L i)).comp (algebraMap O Oδ)).toAlgebra
  have : ∀ i, IsScalarTower K Kδ (L i) := fun i ↦ .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have t2 : ∀ i, IsScalarTower O Oδ (L i) := fun i ↦ .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have t3 : ∀ i, IsScalarTower O K (L i) := fun i ↦ .of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
    change algebraMap Oδ (L i) (algebraMap O Oδ c) =
      algebraMap Kδ (L i) (χ (algebraMap O K c ⊗ₜ[O] 1))
    have h1 : algebraMap O K c ⊗ₜ[O] (1 : Oδ) = algebraMap Oδ (K ⊗[O] Oδ) (algebraMap O Oδ c) := by
      change _ = (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[O] algebraMap O Oδ c
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
    rw [h1, χ.commutes]
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Oδ Kδ (L i) _
  refine ⟨aK, aO, t3, t2, fun i ↦ Module.Finite.trans Kδ (L i),
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := E) fun x ↦ ?_, trivial⟩
  funext i
  change e (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm Oδ B Kδ
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl (R := Oδ) (A₁ := B)) χ'
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange O Oδ Oδ B K).symm ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[O] x)))) i =
    algebraMap Kδ (L i) (χ (x ⊗ₜ[O] 1))
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange_symm_tmul]
  simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
  change e (algebraMap Kδ (Kδ ⊗[Oδ] B) (χ (x ⊗ₜ[O] 1))) i = _
  rw [e.commutes]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.field_invariant_algEquiv
statement:
theorem field_invariant_algEquiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (L L' : Type) [Field L] [Field L']
    [Algebra (BaseField O) L] [Algebra O L] [IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) L] [Algebra (BaseField O) L'] [Algebra O L']
    [IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) L'] [FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) L']
    (e : L ≃ₐ[BaseField O] L') (hfin : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L)) :
    fieldInvariant O L = fieldInvariant O L'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, -⟩ := integral_closure_algEquiv O L L' (e.restrictScalars O)
  have : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O L') := .equiv φ.toLinearEquiv
  have h1 := integral_closure_is_local O (BaseField O) L
  have h2 := integral_closure_is_local O (BaseField O) L'
  have := integral_closure_is_dvr O (BaseField O) L
  have := integral_closure_is_dvr O (BaseField O) L'
  obtain ⟨hr, hi⟩ := dvr_algEquiv_ramification_inertia O _ _
    (algebraMap_injective_of_tower O _ L) (algebraMap_injective_of_tower O _ L') φ
  unfold fieldInvariant
  rw [dif_pos h1, dif_pos h2, hr, hi]

name: SurfaceBlowup.factor_invariant_algEquiv
statement:
theorem factor_invariant_algEquiv (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (g g' : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hg : g.Monic)
    (hirr : Irreducible g) (hg' : g'.Monic) (hirr' : Irreducible g')
    (e : AdjoinRoot g ≃ₐ[BaseField O] AdjoinRoot g')
    (hfin : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))) :
    factorInvariant O g = factorInvariant O g'
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hirr⟩
  have : Fact (Irreducible g') := ⟨hirr'⟩
  have : Module.Finite (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot g) := hg.finite_adjoinRoot
  have : Module.Finite (BaseField O) (AdjoinRoot g') := hg'.finite_adjoinRoot
  exact field_invariant_algEquiv O _ _ e hfin

name: SurfaceBlowup.rho_mul
statement: private theorem rho_mul (f g : K[X]) : rho (f * g) = rho f * rho g
proof:
:= by
  unfold rho
  rw [mul_coeff_zero, reverse_mul_of_domain, mul_inv, C_mul]
  ring

name: SurfaceBlowup.rho_prod
statement: private theorem rho_prod (gs : List K[X]) : rho gs.prod = (gs.map rho).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction gs with
  | nil => simp [rho, reverse]
  | cons g gs ih => rw [List.prod_cons, rho_mul, ih, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]

name: SurfaceBlowup.reverse_reverse_of
statement: private theorem reverse_reverse_of (f : K[X]) (h0 : f.coeff 0 ≠ 0) : f.reverse.reverse = f
proof:
:= by
  have hd : f.reverse.natDegree = f.natDegree := by
    rw [reverse_natDegree, natTrailingDegree_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_ne_zero h0, Nat.sub_zero]
  ext n
  rw [coeff_reverse, coeff_reverse, hd, revAt_invol]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rho_coeff_zero
statement: private theorem rho_coeff_zero {f : K[X]} (hf : f.Monic) : (rho f).coeff 0 = (f.coeff 0)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho, coeff_C_mul, coeff_zero_reverse, hf.leadingCoeff, mul_one]

name: SurfaceBlowup.rho_rho
statement: private theorem rho_rho (f : K[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (h0 : f.coeff 0 ≠ 0) : rho (rho f) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho, rho_coeff_zero hf, inv_inv, rho, reverse_mul_of_domain, reverse_reverse_of f h0,
    show (C (f.coeff 0)⁻¹).reverse = C (f.coeff 0)⁻¹ by simp [reverse], ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ h0, C_1, one_mul]

name: SurfaceBlowup.reverse_normalized_irreducible
statement:
theorem reverse_normalized_irreducible (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (g : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hg : g.Monic)
    (hgi : Irreducible g) (h0 : g.coeff 0 ≠ 0)
    (hfin : Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))) :
    (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse).Monic
      ∧ Irreducible (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse)
      ∧ (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse).natDegree = g.natDegree
      ∧ (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse).coeff 0 = (g.coeff 0)⁻¹
      ∧ factorInvariant O (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse) = factorInvariant O g
      ∧ C ((C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse).coeff 0)⁻¹ * (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse).reverse =
        g
      ∧ Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse)))
proof:
:= by
  set K := BaseField O
  set c := g.coeff 0
  set h := C c⁻¹ * g.reverse with hh
  have hr : 0 < g.natDegree := natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mpr (degree_pos_of_irreducible hgi)
  have hrevdeg : g.reverse.natDegree = g.natDegree := by
    rw [reverse_natDegree, natTrailingDegree_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_ne_zero h0, Nat.sub_zero]
  have hdeg : h.natDegree = g.natDegree := by rw [hh, natDegree_C_mul (inv_ne_zero h0), hrevdeg]
  have hmon : h.Monic := by
    rw [Monic, hh, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, reverse_leadingCoeff,
      trailingCoeff_eq_coeff_zero h0, inv_mul_cancel₀ h0]
  have hcoeff0 : h.coeff 0 = c⁻¹ := rho_coeff_zero hg
  have hgrev : g.reverse = C c * h := by
    rw [hh, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h0, C_1, one_mul]
  
  have hne : h ≠ 0 := hmon.ne_zero
  have : Nontrivial (AdjoinRoot h) := AdjoinRoot.nontrivial h (by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hne, hdeg]; exact_mod_cast hr.ne')
  set L := AdjoinRoot h
  set β : L := AdjoinRoot.root h
  have hβ : h.eval₂ (algebraMap K L) β = 0 := AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root h
  have hβinv : β * (-(algebraMap K L c) * (divX h).eval₂ (algebraMap K L) β) = 1 := by
    have e1 := congrArg (fun p ↦ p.eval₂ (algebraMap K L) β) (X_mul_divX_add h)
    simp only [eval₂_add, eval₂_mul, eval₂_X, eval₂_C, hβ, hcoeff0] at e1
    calc β * (-(algebraMap K L c) * (divX h).eval₂ (algebraMap K L) β)
        = -(algebraMap K L c) * (β * (divX h).eval₂ (algebraMap K L) β) := by ring
      _ = algebraMap K L (c * c⁻¹) := by rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left e1, map_mul]; ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ h0, map_one]
  let _ : Invertible β := invertibleOfRightInverse _ _ hβinv
  have hgβ : g.eval₂ (algebraMap K L) (⅟β) = 0 := by
    have : Invertible (⅟β) := invertibleInvOf
    rw [← eval₂_reverse_eq_zero_iff, invOf_invOf, hgrev, eval₂_mul, hβ, mul_zero]
  have : Fact (Irreducible g) := ⟨hgi⟩
  let φ : AdjoinRoot g →ₐ[K] L := AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom g (Algebra.ofId K L) (⅟β) hgβ
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ := φ.toRingHom.injective
  have : FiniteDimensional K (AdjoinRoot g) := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hg.ne_zero).finite
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hne).finite
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φ :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank (f := φ.toLinearMap) (by
      rw [(AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hg.ne_zero).finrank, AdjoinRoot.powerBasis_dim,
        (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hne).finrank, AdjoinRoot.powerBasis_dim, hdeg])).mp hinj
  let e : AdjoinRoot g ≃ₐ[K] L := AlgEquiv.ofBijective φ ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  have hirr : Irreducible h := (Ideal.irreducible_iff_isMaximal_span_singleton hne).mpr
    (Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField _
      (MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField (AdjoinRoot g)) e.symm.toMulEquiv))
  obtain ⟨φ', -⟩ := integral_closure_algEquiv O _ _ (e.restrictScalars O)
  exact ⟨hmon, hirr, hdeg, hcoeff0, (factor_invariant_algEquiv O g h hg hgi hmon hirr e hfin).symm,
    rho_rho g hg h0, .equiv φ'.toLinearEquiv⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.rev_type_forward
statement:
private theorem rev_type_forward (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (P : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (h0 : P.coeff 0 ≠ 0)
    (τ : FactorType) : HasPolynomialTypeF O P τ → HasPolynomialTypeF O (rho P) τ
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨gs, hmem, hpw, hprod, hτ, hfin⟩
  have hg0 : ∀ g ∈ gs, g.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := fun g hg hz ↦ by
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := List.dvd_prod hg
    exact h0 (by rw [hprod, hQ, mul_coeff_zero, hz, zero_mul])
  have hrev : ∀ g ∈ gs, _ := fun g hg ↦
    reverse_normalized_irreducible O g (hmem g hg).1 (hmem g hg).2 (hg0 g hg) (hfin g hg)
  refine ⟨gs.map rho, ?_, ?_, by rw [hprod, rho_prod], ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [List.mem_map]
    rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(hrev g hg).1, (hrev g hg).2.1⟩
  · refine List.Nodup.map_on (fun a ha b hb hab ↦ ?_) hpw
    rw [← (hrev a ha).2.2.2.2.2.1, ← (hrev b hb).2.2.2.2.2.1]
    exact congrArg rho hab
  · rw [hτ, List.map_map]
    exact congrArg _ (List.map_congr_left fun g hg ↦ ((hrev g hg).2.2.2.2.1).symm)
  · simp only [List.mem_map]
    rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact (hrev g hg).2.2.2.2.2.2

name: SurfaceBlowup.reverse_polynomial_type_iff
statement:
theorem reverse_polynomial_type_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (P : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (hP : P.Monic)
    (h0 : P.coeff 0 ≠ 0) (τ : FactorType) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O P τ ↔ HasPolynomialTypeF O (Polynomial.C (P.coeff 0)⁻¹ * P.reverse) τ
proof:
:=
  ⟨rev_type_forward O P h0 τ, fun h ↦ rho_rho P hP h0 ▸
    rev_type_forward O (rho P) (by rw [rho_coeff_zero hP]; exact inv_ne_zero h0) τ h⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_field_matching
statement:
private theorem pi_field_matching (K : Type) [Field K] (ι ι' : Type) [Finite ι] [Finite ι']
    (L : ι → Type) [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (L i)]
    (L' : ι' → Type) [∀ i, Field (L' i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (L' i)]
    (f : (∀ i, L i) ≃ₐ[K] (∀ j, L' j)) :
    ∃ φ : ι → ι', Function.Injective φ ∧ ∀ i, Nonempty (L i ≃ₐ[K] L' (φ i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι'
  have hs : ∀ i, Function.Surjective ((Pi.evalAlgHom K L i).comp f.symm.toAlgHom) :=
    fun i x ↦ ⟨f (Pi.single i x), by simp⟩
  have hker : ∀ i, ∃ j, RingHom.ker ((Pi.evalAlgHom K L i).comp f.symm.toAlgHom) =
      RingHom.ker (Pi.evalAlgHom K L' j) := fun i ↦
    (pi_field_maximal_ideals ι' L' _).1.1 (RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective _ (hs i))
  choose φ hφ using hker
  refine ⟨φ, fun i i' h ↦ ?_, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h1 := hφ i
    rw [h] at h1
    apply (pi_field_maximal_ideals ι L ⊥).2 i i'
    ext x
    simpa [RingHom.mem_ker] using Ideal.ext_iff.1 (h1.trans (hφ i').symm) (f x)
  · exact ⟨(Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (hs i)).symm.trans
      ((Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq K (hφ i)).trans
        (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective fun x ↦ ⟨Pi.single (φ i) x, by simp⟩))⟩

name: SurfaceBlowup.algebra_type_unique
statement:
theorem algebra_type_unique (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] (σ τ : FactorType) (hσ : HasAlgebraType O B σ)
    (hτ : HasAlgebraType O B τ) : σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, _, L, _, _, _, _, _, e, rfl, hfinL⟩ := hσ
  obtain ⟨ι', _, L', _, _, _, _, _, e', rfl, -⟩ := hτ
  obtain ⟨φ, hφi, hφ⟩ := pi_field_matching _ ι ι' L L' (e.symm.trans e')
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψi, -⟩ := pi_field_matching _ ι' ι L' L (e'.symm.trans e)
  have hb : Function.Bijective φ := (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card φ).2
    ⟨hφi, le_antisymm (Fintype.card_le_of_injective φ hφi) (Fintype.card_le_of_injective ψ hψi)⟩
  refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_).trans (Fintype.sum_bijective φ hb _ _ fun _ ↦ rfl)
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := hφ i
  rw [field_invariant_algEquiv O (L i) (L' (φ i)) g (hfinL i)]

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_singleton_get
statement:
private theorem sum_singleton_get {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (l : List α) :
    ∑ i : Fin l.length, ({f (l.get i)} : Multiset β) = ((l.map f : List β) : Multiset β)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    refine (Fin.sum_univ_succ
      (fun i : Fin (l.length + 1) ↦ ({f ((a :: l).get i)} : Multiset β))).trans ?_
    rw [show ∑ i : Fin l.length, ({f ((a :: l).get i.succ)} : Multiset β) = _ from ih]
    rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.type_forward
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gs, hgs, hd, hprod, hσ, hfinG⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨e₁, -⟩ := polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (BaseField O) gs hgs hd
  obtain ⟨e₀, -⟩ := adjoinRoot_base_change O F
  rw [hprod] at e₀
  have : ∀ i : Fin gs.length, Fact (Irreducible (gs.get i)) :=
    fun i ↦ ⟨(hgs _ (List.get_mem gs i)).2⟩
  refine ⟨Fin gs.length, inferInstance, fun i ↦ AdjoinRoot (gs.get i),
    fun i ↦ AdjoinRoot.instField, fun i ↦ inferInstance, fun i ↦ inferInstance,
    fun i ↦ inferInstance, fun i ↦ (hgs _ (List.get_mem gs i)).1.finite_adjoinRoot, e₀.trans e₁,
    ?_, fun i ↦ hfinG _ (List.get_mem gs i)⟩
  rw [hσ, ← sum_singleton_get]
  rfl

name: SurfaceBlowup.polynomial_type_iff_algebra_type
statement:
theorem polynomial_type_iff_algebra_type (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (F : Polynomial O) (hF : F.Monic) (σ : FactorType) :
    HasPolynomialTypeF O (F.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))) σ ↔
      HasAlgebraType O (AdjoinRoot F) σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  open UniqueFactorizationMonoid in
  refine ⟨type_forward O F σ, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨e₀, -⟩ := adjoinRoot_base_change O F
  
  set G := F.map (algebraMap O (BaseField O))
  have hGm : G.Monic := hF.map _
  have h0 : G ≠ 0 := hGm.ne_zero
  have hsq : Squarefree G := by
    obtain ⟨ι, _, L, _, _, _, _, _, e, -, -⟩ := h
    exact squarefree_of_isReduced_adjoinRoot _ _ h0
      (isReduced_of_injective (e₀.symm.trans e).toRingHom (e₀.symm.trans e).injective)
  
  have hmon : ∀ g ∈ normalizedFactors G, g.Monic := fun g hg ↦ by
    rw [← normalize_normalized_factor g hg]
    exact monic_normalize (irreducible_of_normalized_factor g hg).ne_zero
  set l := (normalizedFactors G).toList with hl
  have hlm : ∀ g ∈ l, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g := fun g hg ↦ by
    rw [hl, Multiset.mem_toList] at hg
    exact ⟨hmon g hg, irreducible_of_normalized_factor g hg⟩
  have hlnd : l.Pairwise (fun g h ↦ g ≠ h) := by
    change l.Nodup
    rw [hl, ← Multiset.coe_nodup, Multiset.coe_toList]
    exact (squarefree_iff_nodup_normalizedFactors h0).1 hsq
  have hlprod : G = l.prod := by
    rw [hl, Multiset.prod_toList]
    exact (eq_of_monic_of_associated (by simpa using monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ id hmon) hGm
      (prod_normalizedFactors h0)).symm
  obtain ⟨e₁, -⟩ := polynomial_quotient_product_equiv (BaseField O) l hlm hlnd
  rw [hlprod] at e₀
  obtain ⟨ι, _, L, _, _, _, _, _, e, -, hfinL⟩ := id h
  have : ∀ i : Fin l.length, Fact (Irreducible (l.get i)) := fun i ↦ ⟨(hlm _ (List.get_mem l i)).2⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, -, hφ⟩ := pi_field_matching (BaseField O) (Fin l.length) ι
    (fun i ↦ AdjoinRoot (l.get i)) L (e₁.symm.trans (e₀.symm.trans e))
  have hfac : ∀ g ∈ normalizedFactors G, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g)) := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.1 (show g ∈ l by rwa [hl, Multiset.mem_toList])
    obtain ⟨ψ⟩ := hφ j
    obtain ⟨χ, -⟩ := integral_closure_algEquiv O _ _ (ψ.restrictScalars O)
    have := hfinL (φ j)
    exact .equiv χ.symm.toLinearEquiv
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := squarefree_monic_has_polynomial_type O G hGm hsq hfac
  rwa [algebra_type_unique O (AdjoinRoot F) σ τ h (type_forward O F τ hτ)]
